## .vscode/tasks.json

```json
{
  "version": "2.0.0",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "label": "dotnet: restore",
      "type": "process",
      "command": "dotnet",
      "args": ["restore", "${workspaceFolder}/CrowdSim.sln"],
      "problemMatcher": "$msCompile"
    },
    {
      "label": "dotnet: build",
      "type": "process",
      "command": "dotnet",
      "args": ["build", "${workspaceFolder}/CrowdSim.sln", "--configuration", "Debug", "--no-restore"],
      "dependsOn": "dotnet: restore",
      "group": { "kind": "build", "isDefault": true },
      "problemMatcher": "$msCompile"
    },
    {
      "label": "dotnet: test",
      "type": "process",
      "command": "dotnet",
      "args": ["test", "${workspaceFolder}/CrowdSim.sln", "--configuration", "Debug"],
      "group": "test",
      "problemMatcher": "$msCompile"
    },
    {
      "label": "run: CrowdSim 3D",
      "type": "process",
      "command": "dotnet",
      "args": ["run", "--project", "${workspaceFolder}/src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/CrowdSim.OpenGL.csproj"],
      "dependsOn": "dotnet: build",
      "problemMatcher": "$msCompile"
    }
  ]
}
```

## benchmarks/FurnitureLatency/Program.cs

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.Json;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;

// Run from the solution directory; optional arguments: scenario JSON, output CSV, frame count.
CultureInfo.CurrentCulture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
string input = args.Length > 0 ? args[0] : "tests/CrowdSim.Tests/Fixtures/toxic_fume_205.json";
string output = args.Length > 1 ? args[1] : "furniture-latency.csv";
int frames = args.Length > 2 ? int.Parse(args[2]) : 600;
if (frames < 1) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(frames));
ScenarioDefinition saved = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ScenarioDefinition>(File.ReadAllText(input),
    new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true })!;
Simulation sim = new(0, saved.CreateConfig(), saved.RandomSeed);
saved.ApplyLayout(sim);
sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(sim.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions());
Console.WriteLine($"Loaded {sim.Agents.Count} occupants, {sim.Environment.Furniture.Count} furniture sets.");
var checkpoint = FinalizedSceneCheckpoint.Capture(sim, sim.Agents.Count, "latency_check");
Simulation replay = checkpoint.CreateReadySimulation();
if (replay.Running || replay.FrameIndex != 0 ||
    !sim.Agents.Select(a => a.Position).SequenceEqual(replay.Agents.Select(a => a.Position)))
    throw new InvalidOperationException("Replay did not restore the ready scene.");
Console.WriteLine("Replay checkpoint PASS.");
sim.PrecomputeToxicFume();
sim.SetRunning(true);
if (!sim.TriggerToxicFumeRelease()) throw new InvalidOperationException("Fume release failed.");
double[] times = new double[frames];
using StreamWriter csv = new(output);
csv.WriteLine("frame,step_ms,seated,standing_up,fallen_chairs");
for (int frame = 0; frame < frames; frame++)
{
    long start = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
    sim.Step();
    times[frame] = Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(start).TotalMilliseconds;
    csv.WriteLine($"{frame},{times[frame]:F3},{sim.Agents.Count(a => a.Posture == SeatingPosture.Seated)},{sim.Agents.Count(a => a.Posture == SeatingPosture.StandingUp)},{sim.Environment.Furniture.SelectMany(f => f.Chairs).Count(c => c.State == ChairState.Fallen)}");
}
Array.Sort(times);
Console.WriteLine($"CPU step ms: median={times[frames / 2]:F2}, p95={times[(int)(frames * .95)]:F2}, max={times[^1]:F2}; total={times.Sum():F2}");
Console.WriteLine($"Raw timings: {Path.GetFullPath(output)}. These exclude rendering and do not measure display FPS.");
```

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

CultureInfo.CurrentCulture=CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
string output=args.Length>0?args[0]:"benchmark-results";
int frames=args.Length>1?int.Parse(args[1]):400;
if(frames<20) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(frames));
Directory.CreateDirectory(output);
using StreamWriter summary=new(Path.Combine(output,"summary.csv"));
summary.WriteLine("scene,agents,seed,hybrid,median_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,max_ms,allocated_bytes,exited,fatal,incapacitated,mean_open_agents,mean_grouped_agents,shared_field_builds");
foreach(bool furniture in new[]{false,true})
foreach(int count in new[]{220,500,1000})
foreach(bool hybrid in new[]{false,true})
{
    Simulation warm=Create(count,furniture,hybrid);
    for(int i=0;i<25;i++) warm.Step();
    Simulation sim=Create(count,furniture,hybrid);
    string scene=furniture?"furniture":"open";
    using StreamWriter raw=new(Path.Combine(output,$"{scene}-{count}-{hybrid}.csv"));
    raw.WriteLine("frame,sim_seconds,step_ms,furniture_ms,route_ms,route_requests,active,exited,open_agents,grouped_agents");
    double[] times=new double[frames];
    double open=0,grouped=0;
    long allocated=0;
    for(int i=0;i<frames;i++)
    {
        long before=GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread();
        long started=Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        sim.Step();
        times[i]=Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(started).TotalMilliseconds;
        allocated+=GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread()-before;
        if(sim.FrameIndex!=i+1) throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulation did not advance.");
        open+=sim.HybridMovement.OpenSpaceAgents;
        grouped+=sim.HybridMovement.GroupedAgents;
        raw.WriteLine($"{sim.FrameIndex},{sim.FrameIndex*sim.Config.Agent.Dt:F3},{times[i]:F3},{sim.LastFurnitureMilliseconds:F3},{sim.LastRoutePlanningMilliseconds:F3},{sim.LastRoutePlanRequests},{sim.Agents.Count(a=>a.IsActive)},{sim.Agents.Count(a=>a.State==AgentState.Exited)},{sim.HybridMovement.OpenSpaceAgents},{sim.HybridMovement.GroupedAgents}");
    }
    Array.Sort(times);
    summary.WriteLine($"{scene},{count},731,{hybrid},{times[frames/2]:F3},{times[(int)(frames*.95)]:F3},{times[(int)(frames*.99)]:F3},{times[^1]:F3},{allocated},{sim.Agents.Count(a=>a.State==AgentState.Exited)},{sim.Agents.Count(a=>a.State==AgentState.Dead)},{sim.Agents.Count(a=>a.State is AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.TempIncap)},{open/frames:F2},{grouped/frames:F2},{sim.HybridMovement.Fields.FieldBuilds}");
    summary.Flush();
    Console.WriteLine($"{scene} {count} hybrid={hybrid}: p95 {times[(int)(frames*.95)]:F2} ms; exited {sim.Agents.Count(a=>a.State==AgentState.Exited)}");
}
Console.WriteLine("CPU-only results; rendering/recording are not measured. These are comparisons, not realism validation.");

static Simulation Create(int count,bool furniture,bool hybrid)
{
    Simulation sim=new(randomSeed:731);
    sim.Config.HybridEnabled=hybrid;
    foreach(float y in new[]{10f,24f})
    {
        if(!sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(0.3f,y,5)||
            !sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(sim.Environment.Width-0.3f,y,5))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Exit placement failed.");
    }
    if(furniture)
        foreach(float x in new[]{12f,24f,36f,48f})
        foreach(float y in new[]{12f,24f})
            if(!sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet,new Vector2(x,y)))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Furniture placement failed.");
    List<Vector2> positions=sim.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions().ToList();
    // Fixed independent layout RNG keeps reference/hybrid starting positions identical.
    Random layout = new(731);
    int attempts = 0;
    float separation = sim.Config.Agent.Radius * 2.1f;
    while (positions.Count < count && attempts++ < 200000)
    {
        Vector2 candidate = new(1f + (float)layout.NextDouble() * (sim.Environment.Width - 2f),
            1f + (float)layout.NextDouble() * (sim.Environment.Height - 2f));
        if (sim.Environment.IsPointBlocked(candidate, sim.Config.Agent.Radius) ||
            positions.Any(p => Vector2.DistanceSquared(p, candidate) < separation * separation)) continue;
        positions.Add(candidate);
    }
    sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(positions);
    if(sim.Agents.Count!=count) throw new InvalidOperationException("Population mismatch.");
    sim.SetRunning(true);
    if(!sim.Running) throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulation refused to start.");
    sim.TriggerExplosion(28f,17f);
    return sim;
}
```

## benchmarks/NaturalNavigationLatency/Program.cs

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

// Usage: [output-directory] [frames=400] [agents=600] [hybrid=false] [scenario=Explosion]
// Paired runs use identical initial layouts, furniture and seeds. Subsequent trajectories
// intentionally differ. This is a CPU-step benchmark, not a GPU/rendering FPS measurement.
CultureInfo.CurrentCulture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
string output = args.Length > 0 ? args[0] : "benchmark-results/natural-navigation";
int frames = ReadInteger(args, 1, 400, 20, 20000);
int count = ReadInteger(args, 2, 600, 240, 2000);
bool hybrid = args.Length > 3 && bool.Parse(args[3]);
if (args.Length > 5) throw new ArgumentException("Expected at most five positional arguments.");
ScenarioType scenario = ScenarioType.Explosion;
if (args.Length > 4 && (!Enum.TryParse(args[4], ignoreCase: true, out scenario) || !Enum.IsDefined(scenario)))
    throw new ArgumentException("Scenario must be Explosion or ToxicFume.");
Directory.CreateDirectory(output);
File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(output, "environment.txt"),
    $"UTC={DateTime.UtcNow:O}\nRuntime={RuntimeInformation.FrameworkDescription}\n" +
    $"OS={RuntimeInformation.OSDescription}\nProcessors={Environment.ProcessorCount}\n" +
    $"Frames={frames}\nAgents={count}\nTables=24\nSeated=240\nHybrid={hybrid}\nScenario={scenario}\n" +
    "Times include Simulation.Step only; rendering, CSV output and fume precomputation are excluded.\n" +
    "Managed allocation counts are for the stepping thread only.\n" +
    "Natural=false is the retained legacy-navigation path in this revision, not a separately built original ZIP.\n");
using StreamWriter summary = new(Path.Combine(output, "summary.csv"));
summary.WriteLine("scenario,seed,agents,natural,hybrid,median_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,max_ms,step_allocated_bytes,exited,dead,incapacitated,total_recovery_attempts,completed_detours,exit_changes,shared_field_builds,max_natural_plans_per_step,max_recovery_probes_per_step,max_pending_routes,max_pending_recoveries,fume_precompute_ms,fume_cache_bytes");
int[] seeds = { 731, 732, 733 };
for (int seedIndex = 0; seedIndex < seeds.Length; seedIndex++)
foreach (bool natural in seedIndex % 2 == 0 ? new[] { false, true } : new[] { true, false })
{
    int seed = seeds[seedIndex];
    Simulation warm = Create(count, seed, natural, hybrid, scenario);
    for (int i = 0; i < 35; i++) warm.Step();
    Simulation sim = Create(count, seed, natural, hybrid, scenario);
    using StreamWriter raw = new(Path.Combine(output, $"{scenario}-seed-{seed}-natural-{natural}-hybrid-{hybrid}.csv"));
    raw.WriteLine("frame,simulation_seconds,step_ms,furniture_ms,full_astar_ms,all_route_requests,natural_route_plans,recovery_probes,pending_routes,pending_recoveries,active,exited,longest_current_no_progress_seconds");
    double[] times = new double[frames];
    long allocated = 0;
    int maxPlans = 0, maxProbes = 0, maxRoutes = 0, maxRecoveries = 0;
    for (int frame = 0; frame < frames; frame++)
    {
        long beforeBytes = GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread();
        long start = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        sim.Step();
        times[frame] = Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(start).TotalMilliseconds;
        allocated += GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread() - beforeBytes;
        if (sim.FrameIndex != frame + 1) throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulation did not advance.");
        var nav = sim.EvacuationSystem;
        maxPlans = Math.Max(maxPlans, nav.LastNaturalRoutePlans);
        maxProbes = Math.Max(maxProbes, nav.LastNaturalRecoveryProbes);
        maxRoutes = Math.Max(maxRoutes, nav.NaturalPendingRoutes);
        maxRecoveries = Math.Max(maxRecoveries, nav.NaturalPendingRecoveries);
        // Counters and CSV formatting are deliberately outside the timed/allocation interval.
        int active = 0, exited = 0;
        float longest = 0f;
        foreach (Agent agent in sim.Agents)
        {
            if (agent.IsActive) active++;
            if (agent.State == AgentState.Exited) exited++;
            if (agent.State is AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured)
                longest = Math.Max(longest, agent.NavigationMemory.NoProgressSeconds);
        }
        raw.WriteLine($"{sim.FrameIndex},{sim.FrameIndex * sim.Config.Agent.Dt:F3},{times[frame]:F4},{sim.LastFurnitureMilliseconds:F4},{sim.LastRoutePlanningMilliseconds:F4},{sim.LastRoutePlanRequests},{nav.LastNaturalRoutePlans},{nav.LastNaturalRecoveryProbes},{nav.NaturalPendingRoutes},{nav.NaturalPendingRecoveries},{active},{exited},{longest:F3}");
    }
    Array.Sort(times);
    int exitedCount = sim.Agents.Count(a => a.State == AgentState.Exited);
    summary.WriteLine($"{scenario},{seed},{count},{natural},{hybrid},{Percentile(times, .50):F4},{Percentile(times, .95):F4},{Percentile(times, .99):F4},{times[^1]:F4},{allocated},{exitedCount},{sim.Agents.Count(a => a.State == AgentState.Dead)},{sim.Agents.Count(a => a.State is AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.TempIncap)},{sim.Agents.Sum(a => a.NavigationMemory.TotalRecoveryAttempts)},{sim.Agents.Sum(a => a.NavigationMemory.SuccessfulDetours)},{sim.Agents.Sum(a => a.NavigationMemory.ExitChanges)},{sim.HybridMovement.Fields.FieldBuilds},{maxPlans},{maxProbes},{maxRoutes},{maxRecoveries},{sim.ToxicFumeSystem.LastPrecomputeMilliseconds:F4},{sim.ToxicFumeSystem.EstimatedCacheBytes}");
    summary.Flush();
    Console.WriteLine($"Scenario {scenario}; seed {seed}; natural={natural}; hybrid={hybrid}; p95={Percentile(times, .95):F2} ms; p99={Percentile(times, .99):F2} ms; exited={exitedCount}/{count}");
}
Console.WriteLine("Compare paired seed rows and tail latency, not only means. No frame-rate or realism guarantee is implied.");

static int ReadInteger(string[] values, int index, int fallback, int min, int max)
{
    int value = values.Length > index ? int.Parse(values[index], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : fallback;
    if (value < min || value > max) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException($"argument-{index}", $"Expected {min}..{max}.");
    return value;
}

static double Percentile(double[] sorted, double fraction) =>
    sorted[Math.Clamp((int)Math.Ceiling(sorted.Length * fraction) - 1, 0, sorted.Length - 1)];

static Simulation Create(int count, int seed, bool natural, bool hybrid, ScenarioType scenario)
{
    SimulationConfig config = new()
    {
        Agent = new AgentConfig { Count = count, NaturalNavigationEnabled = natural },
        HybridEnabled = hybrid,
    };
    Simulation sim = new(config: config, randomSeed: seed);
    sim.SetScenarioType(scenario);
    foreach (float y in new[] { 10f, 24f })
    {
        if (!sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(0.3f, y, 5) ||
            !sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(sim.Environment.Width - 0.3f, y, 5))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Exit placement failed.");
    }
    foreach (float x in new[] { 6f, 14f, 22f, 30f, 38f, 46f })
    foreach (float y in new[] { 6f, 13f, 20f, 27f })
        if (!sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet, new Vector2(x, y)))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Furniture placement failed.");
    List<Vector2> positions = sim.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions().ToList();
    if (positions.Count != 240) throw new InvalidOperationException("Expected 240 occupied seats.");
    Random layout = new(seed);
    float separation = config.Agent.Radius * 2.1f;
    int attempts = 0;
    while (positions.Count < count && attempts++ < 250000)
    {
        Vector2 candidate = new(1f + (float)layout.NextDouble() * (sim.Environment.Width - 2f),
            1f + (float)layout.NextDouble() * (sim.Environment.Height - 2f));
        if (sim.Environment.IsPointBlocked(candidate, config.Agent.Radius) ||
            positions.Any(p => Vector2.DistanceSquared(p, candidate) < separation * separation)) continue;
        positions.Add(candidate);
    }
    if (positions.Count != count) throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not place requested population.");
    sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(positions);
    if (scenario == ScenarioType.ToxicFume)
    {
        if (!sim.ToxicFumeSystem.TrySetSource(sim, new Vector2(28f, 17f)))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Fume source placement failed.");
        sim.PrecomputeToxicFume(); // setup work, deliberately outside the stepping timer
    }
    sim.SetRunning(true);
    if (!sim.Running) throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulation refused to start.");
    if (scenario == ScenarioType.ToxicFume)
    {
        if (!sim.TriggerToxicFumeRelease()) throw new InvalidOperationException("Fume release failed.");
    }
    else sim.TriggerExplosion(28f, 17f);
    return sim;
}
```

## benchmarks/Program.cs

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.OpenGL.Rendering;
using CrowdSim.OpenGL.UI;
using ImGuiNET;

// The exact same harness compiles against original and updated sources.
// No benchmark framework, extra simulation thread, GPU, or timer is added to the application.
CultureInfo.CurrentCulture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
string output = args.Length > 0 ? args[0] : "benchmark.csv";
int seed = args.Length > 1 ? int.Parse(args[1], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : 42;
const int warmup = 40;
const int measurements = 160;
List<string> rows = new() { "Mode,Agents,MedianMs,P95Ms,MeanMs,BytesPerCall,MeanActiveAgents" };
Console.WriteLine($"{RuntimeInformation.FrameworkDescription}; {RuntimeInformation.OSDescription}; CPU threads={Environment.ProcessorCount}; seed={seed}");
foreach (int count in new[] { 100, 200, 500, 1000 })
{
    foreach (string mode in new[] { "wandering", "emergency", "bottleneck", "forces", "perception", "render-overview", "render-close" })
    {
        Simulation sim = CreateScene(count, mode, seed);
        bool rendering = mode.StartsWith("render-", StringComparison.Ordinal);
        IntPtr context = IntPtr.Zero;
        WorldRenderer? renderer = null;
        if (rendering)
        {
            context = ImGui.CreateContext();
            ImGui.GetIO().DisplaySize = new Vector2(1600f, 900f);
            ImGui.GetIO().DeltaTime = 1f / 60f;
            ImGui.GetIO().Fonts.AddFontDefault();
            ImGui.GetIO().Fonts.Build();
            renderer = new WorldRenderer();
        }
        try
        {
            void RunOnce()
            {
                if (rendering)
                {
                    DrawFrame(sim, renderer!, mode == "render-close");
                }
                else if (mode == "forces")
                {
                    foreach (Agent agent in sim.Agents)
                    {
                        _ = sim.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(sim, agent, Vector2.UnitY);
                    }
                }
                else if (mode == "perception")
                {
                    // Keep the workload identical: all agents remain present, same positions,
                    // same current alarm level. Spatial hashes remain valid on both revisions.
                    foreach (Agent agent in sim.Agents)
                    {
                        agent.PanicLevel = 0.6f;
                        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
                        agent.ActivateDirectAlarm(0, 1000, 0.5f, seed);
                    }
                    sim.EvacuationSystem.UpdatePanic(sim);
                }
                else
                {
                    sim.Step();
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < warmup; i++) RunOnce();
            // GC occurs outside the measured window; per-call samples include allocations
            // and any natural collections caused by the workload itself.
            GC.Collect();
            GC.WaitForPendingFinalizers();
            double[] times = new double[measurements];
            long totalBytes = 0;
            long totalActive = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < measurements; i++)
            {
                long beforeBytes = GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread();
                long start = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
                RunOnce();
                times[i] = Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(start).TotalMilliseconds;
                totalBytes += GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread() - beforeBytes;
                totalActive += sim.Agents.Count(a => a.IsActive);
            }
            Array.Sort(times);
            string row = $"{mode},{count},{times[measurements / 2]:F6},{times[(int)(measurements * 0.95)]:F6},{times.Average():F6},{totalBytes / (double)measurements:F2},{totalActive / (double)measurements:F2}";
            rows.Add(row);
            Console.WriteLine(row);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (context != IntPtr.Zero) ImGui.DestroyContext(context);
        }
    }
}
File.WriteAllLines(output, rows);

static Simulation CreateScene(int count, string mode, int seed)
{
    Simulation sim = new(0, randomSeed: seed);
    sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(28f, 0.3f, 3);
    sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(42f, 33.7f, 5);
    // Common obstacle-rich workload; avoid the dense starting region near the north exit.
    for (int y = 15; y <= 27; y += 4)
        for (int x = 8; x <= 48; x += 8)
            sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(x, y);
    if (mode == "bottleneck")
    {
        List<Vector2> starts = new(count);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            starts.Add(new Vector2(17f + (i % 50) * 0.43f, 1f + (i / 50) * 0.43f));
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(starts);
    }
    else
    {
        sim.SpawnAgents(count);
    }
    if (mode != "wandering" && mode != "emergency")
    {
        foreach (Agent agent in sim.Agents)
        {
            agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
            agent.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
            agent.ExitTarget = sim.Environment.Exits[0];
            agent.PanicLevel = 0.6f;
            agent.HelpingTendency = 0f;
            agent.ActivateDirectAlarm(0, 1000, 0.5f, seed);
        }
    }
    sim.SetRunning(true);
    if (mode == "emergency") sim.TriggerExplosion(28f, 17f);
    return sim;
}

static void DrawFrame(Simulation sim, WorldRenderer renderer, bool close)
{
    ImGui.NewFrame();
    ImGui.SetNextWindowPos(Vector2.Zero);
    ImGui.SetNextWindowSize(new Vector2(880f, 760f));
    ImGui.Begin("benchmark", ImGuiWindowFlags.NoSavedSettings | ImGuiWindowFlags.NoTitleBar);
    renderer.Draw(sim, builderMode: false, builderTool: BuilderTool.Exit,
        blockageCells: 1, exitPersonsWide: 3, agentPlacementCount: 1,
        selectedAgentId: close ? 0 : null, cameraAgent: close ? sim.Agents[0] : null,
        followAgent: false, povEnabled: close, simulationSpeed: 1f,
        debug: DebugSettings.Options);
    ImGui.End();
    ImGui.Render();
}

static class DebugSettings
{
    internal static readonly RenderDebugOptions Options = new();
}
```

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

// Usage: [output-directory] [Explosion|ToxicFume] [frames=400] [agents=600] [barricades=0] [barricade-angle-deg=0]
// Timings are CPU simulation steps only, never rendering FPS or a performance guarantee.
CultureInfo.CurrentCulture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
if (args.Length > 6) throw new ArgumentException("Expected at most six positional arguments.");
string output = args.Length > 0 ? args[0] : "benchmark-results/rectangular-assets";
ScenarioType scenario = args.Length > 1 ? Enum.Parse<ScenarioType>(args[1], true) : ScenarioType.Explosion;
if (!Enum.IsDefined(scenario)) throw new ArgumentException("Unknown scenario.");
int frames = args.Length > 2 ? int.Parse(args[2], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : 400;
int count = args.Length > 3 ? int.Parse(args[3], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : 600;
int barricades = args.Length > 4 ? int.Parse(args[4], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : 0;
float angleDegrees = args.Length > 5 ? float.Parse(args[5], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : 0f;
if (!float.IsFinite(angleDegrees)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(args), "Angle must be finite.");
angleDegrees = (angleDegrees % 360f + 360f) % 360f;
float rotation = angleDegrees * MathF.PI / 180f;
if (barricades is < 0 or > 64) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(args), "Expected 0..64 barricades.");
if (frames is < 20 or > 20000 || count is < 1 or > 5000)
    throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(args), "Expected 20..20000 frames and 1..5000 agents.");
Directory.CreateDirectory(output);
File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(output, "environment.txt"),
    $"UTC={DateTime.UtcNow:O}\nRuntime={RuntimeInformation.FrameworkDescription}\nOS={RuntimeInformation.OSDescription}\n" +
    $"Scenario={scenario}\nAgents={count}\nRectangularTables=24\nStage=15x6 metres\nBarricades={barricades}\nBarricadeAngleDegrees={angleDegrees}\nFrames={frames}\n" +
    "Rendering, output formatting, setup and fume precomputation are excluded from timed steps.\n");
using StreamWriter summary = new(Path.Combine(output, "summary.csv"));
summary.WriteLine("scenario,seed,agents,barricades,barricade_angle_degrees,median_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,max_ms,step_allocated_bytes,exited,tables_destroyed");
foreach (int seed in new[] { 731, 732, 733 })
{
    Simulation warm = CreateScene(count, seed, scenario, barricades, rotation);
    for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) warm.Step();
    Simulation sim = CreateScene(count, seed, scenario, barricades, rotation);
    using StreamWriter raw = new(Path.Combine(output, $"{scenario}-seed-{seed}.csv"));
    raw.WriteLine("frame,step_ms,furniture_ms,route_ms,airborne_tables,destroyed_tables,exited");
    double[] times = new double[frames];
    long allocated = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++)
    {
        long before = GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread();
        long started = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        sim.Step();
        times[i] = Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(started).TotalMilliseconds;
        allocated += GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread() - before;
        if (sim.FrameIndex != i + 1) throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulation did not advance.");
        raw.WriteLine($"{sim.FrameIndex},{times[i]:F4},{sim.LastFurnitureMilliseconds:F4},{sim.LastRoutePlanningMilliseconds:F4}," +
            $"{TableCount(sim, ChairState.Airborne)},{TableCount(sim, ChairState.Destroyed)},{sim.Agents.Count(a => a.State == AgentState.Exited)}");
    }
    Array.Sort(times);
    summary.WriteLine($"{scenario},{seed},{count},{barricades},{angleDegrees},{Percentile(times, .50):F4},{Percentile(times, .95):F4}," +
        $"{Percentile(times, .99):F4},{times[^1]:F4},{allocated},{sim.Agents.Count(a => a.State == AgentState.Exited)},{TableCount(sim, ChairState.Destroyed)}");
    summary.Flush();
    Console.WriteLine($"{scenario}, seed {seed}: p95={Percentile(times, .95):F2} ms, p99={Percentile(times, .99):F2} ms (CPU step only).");
}

static int TableCount(Simulation sim, ChairState state) => sim.Environment.Furniture.Count(
    set => set.Kind == FurnitureKind.RectangularTable && set.Table?.State == state);

static double Percentile(double[] values, double p) => values[
    Math.Clamp((int)Math.Ceiling(values.Length * p) - 1, 0, values.Length - 1)];

static Simulation CreateScene(int count, int seed, ScenarioType scenario, int barricades, float rotation)
{
    Simulation sim = new(config: new SimulationConfig
    {
        Agent = new AgentConfig { Count = count, NaturalNavigationEnabled = true },
    }, randomSeed: seed);
    sim.SetScenarioType(scenario);
    foreach (float y in new[] { 10f, 24f })
        if (!sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(0.3f, y, 5) ||
            !sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(sim.Environment.Width - 0.3f, y, 5))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Exit placement failed.");
    foreach (float x in new[] { 6f, 14f, 22f, 30f, 38f, 46f })
    foreach (float y in new[] { 6f, 12f, 18f, 24f })
        if (!sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, new Vector2(x, y)))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Table placement failed.");
    if (!sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(28f, 30f)))
        throw new InvalidOperationException("Stage placement failed.");
    // Up to four rows in clear lanes, independent of table/stage footprints.
    for (int i = 0; i < barricades; i++)
    {
        Vector2 center = new(4f + 3f * (i % 16), 3f + 6f * (i / 16));
        if (!sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, center, rotation))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Barricade {i} placement failed.");
    }
    if (sim.Environment.PlannedAgentCount != 0)
        throw new InvalidOperationException("These assets must not add occupants.");
    Random layout = new(seed);
    List<Vector2> positions = new(count);
    float gapSquared = MathF.Pow(sim.Config.Agent.Radius * 2.1f, 2f);
    for (int attempts = 0; positions.Count < count && attempts < 500000; attempts++)
    {
        Vector2 point = new(1f + (float)layout.NextDouble() * (sim.Environment.Width - 2f),
            1f + (float)layout.NextDouble() * (sim.Environment.Height - 2f));
        if (sim.Environment.IsPointBlocked(point, sim.Config.Agent.Radius) ||
            positions.Any(other => Vector2.DistanceSquared(point, other) < gapSquared)) continue;
        positions.Add(point);
    }
    if (positions.Count != count) throw new InvalidOperationException("Population placement failed.");
    sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(positions);
    if (scenario == ScenarioType.ToxicFume)
    {
        if (!sim.ToxicFumeSystem.TrySetSource(sim, new Vector2(28f, 17f)))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Fume source placement failed.");
        sim.PrecomputeToxicFume();
    }
    sim.SetRunning(true);
    if (!sim.Running) throw new InvalidOperationException("Scene refused to start.");
    if (scenario == ScenarioType.ToxicFume)
    {
        if (!sim.TriggerToxicFumeRelease()) throw new InvalidOperationException("Fume release failed.");
    }
    else
    {
        sim.TriggerExplosion(22f, 12f);
        if (sim.Environment.Explosion is null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Explosion failed.");
    }
    return sim;
}
```

```csharp
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;

/// <summary>
/// Top-level configuration object. This replaces the Python module-level WINDOW,
/// AGENT, COLORS and GRID singletons while preserving their default values.
/// </summary>
public sealed class SimulationConfig
{
    public WorldConfig World { get; } = new();
    public AgentConfig Agent { get; } = new();
    public ColorPalette Colors { get; } = new();
    public GridConfig Grid { get; }

    public SimulationConfig()
    {
        Grid = new GridConfig { CellSizeMeters = 6f * AgentConfig.RadiusMeters };
    }

    /// <summary>Create an independent configuration using the validated Python defaults.</summary>
    public static SimulationConfig CreateDefault() => new();
}

/// <summary>Metric simulation-world dimensions. All ground-plane coordinates are metres.</summary>
public sealed class WorldConfig
{
    public const float DefaultWidthMeters = 56.0f;
    public const float DefaultLengthMeters = 34.0f;

    public float WidthMeters { get; private set; } = DefaultWidthMeters;
    public float LengthMeters { get; private set; } = DefaultLengthMeters;
    public float MinWidthMeters { get; init; } = 10.0f;
    public float MinLengthMeters { get; init; } = 10.0f;
    public float MaxWidthMeters { get; init; } = 160.0f;
    public float MaxLengthMeters { get; init; } = 120.0f;

    /// <summary>Apply metric room dimensions. Display-window pixels are intentionally unrelated.</summary>
    public void ApplySize(float? widthMeters = null, float? lengthMeters = null)
    {
        if (widthMeters is not null)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(widthMeters.Value) || widthMeters.Value <= 0f)
            {
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(widthMeters));
            }

            WidthMeters = Math.Clamp(widthMeters.Value, MinWidthMeters, MaxWidthMeters);
        }

        if (lengthMeters is not null)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(lengthMeters.Value) || lengthMeters.Value <= 0f)
            {
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(lengthMeters));
            }

            LengthMeters = Math.Clamp(lengthMeters.Value, MinLengthMeters, MaxLengthMeters);
        }
    }
}

    public const float DefaultHardKillRadius = 1.58f;
    public const float DefaultHeatIncapacityRadius = 3.16f;
    public const float DefaultFallenRadius = 6.31f;
    public const float DefaultInjuryRadius = 9.47f;
    public const float DefaultHeatRadius = 18.21f;
    private const float MinimumBlastZoneRadius = 0.10f;
    private const float MaximumBlastZoneRadius = 200.0f;
    private const float MinimumBlastZoneGap = 0.10f;

    /// <summary>Inner abstract simulation zone that produces the terminal direct-blast outcome.</summary>
    public float HardKillRadius { get; private set; } = DefaultHardKillRadius;

    /// <summary>Abstract direct-blast temporary-incapacitation zone.</summary>
    public float HeatIncapacityRadius { get; private set; } = DefaultHeatIncapacityRadius;

    /// <summary>Abstract direct-blast severe/fallen zone.</summary>
    public float FallenRadius { get; private set; } = DefaultFallenRadius;

    /// <summary>Abstract direct-blast injury zone.</summary>
    public float InjuryRadius { get; private set; } = DefaultInjuryRadius;

    /// <summary>Outer direct-threat/panic zone and maximum propagating shock-front radius.</summary>
    public float HeatRadius { get; private set; } = DefaultHeatRadius;

    /// <summary>
    /// Set the five metric blast-zone radii while preserving strict inner-to-outer ordering.
    /// These are simulator tuning values, not real-world explosive-yield or medical calibration data.
    /// </summary>
    public void SetBlastZoneRadii(
        float hardKillRadius,
        float heatIncapacityRadius,
        float fallenRadius,
        float injuryRadius,
        float heatRadius)
    {
        if (!float.IsFinite(hardKillRadius) ||
            !float.IsFinite(heatIncapacityRadius) ||
            !float.IsFinite(fallenRadius) ||
            !float.IsFinite(injuryRadius) ||
            !float.IsFinite(heatRadius))
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(hardKillRadius), "Blast-zone radii must be finite.");
        }

        HardKillRadius = Math.Clamp(
            hardKillRadius,
            MinimumBlastZoneRadius,
            MaximumBlastZoneRadius - 4f * MinimumBlastZoneGap);
        HeatIncapacityRadius = Math.Clamp(
            heatIncapacityRadius,
            HardKillRadius + MinimumBlastZoneGap,
            MaximumBlastZoneRadius - 3f * MinimumBlastZoneGap);
        FallenRadius = Math.Clamp(
            fallenRadius,
            HeatIncapacityRadius + MinimumBlastZoneGap,
            MaximumBlastZoneRadius - 2f * MinimumBlastZoneGap);
        InjuryRadius = Math.Clamp(
            injuryRadius,
            FallenRadius + MinimumBlastZoneGap,
            MaximumBlastZoneRadius - MinimumBlastZoneGap);
        HeatRadius = Math.Clamp(
            heatRadius,
            InjuryRadius + MinimumBlastZoneGap,
            MaximumBlastZoneRadius);
    }

    /// <summary>Restore the validated default metric blast-zone radii.</summary>
    public void ResetBlastZoneRadii()
        => SetBlastZoneRadii(
            DefaultHardKillRadius,
            DefaultHeatIncapacityRadius,
            DefaultFallenRadius,
            DefaultInjuryRadius,
            DefaultHeatRadius);

    public float ExitInfluenceRadius { get; init; } = 2.43f;
    public float ExitMinSpeedFactor { get; init; } = 0.25f;
}

/// <summary>
/// Scenario-level behaviour controls. Defaults preserve the validated Behaviour Rebuild 1
/// response while allowing bounded tuning before agents are spawned. These values are
/// abstract simulation parameters and do not represent demographic assumptions.
/// </summary>
public sealed class BehaviorTuningConfig
{
    public const float DefaultTraitVariation = 0.65f;
    public const float DefaultReactionVariation = 0.75f;
    public const float DefaultStressSusceptibility = 1.00f;
    public const float DefaultStressPersistence = 1.00f;
    public const float DefaultCrowdFollowing = 0.50f;
    public const float DefaultPersonalSpace = 1.00f;
    public const float DefaultPanicSpaceCompression = 0.20f;
    public const float DefaultEmergencyUrgency = 1.00f;
    public const float DefaultHelpingTendency = 0.50f;
    public const float DefaultRouteFamiliarity = 0.50f;
    public const float DefaultBottleneckAssertiveness = 0.50f;
    public const float DefaultBottleneckPressureSensitivity = 1.00f;
    public const float DefaultBottleneckSpaceCompression = 0.18f;

    public float TraitVariation { get; private set; } = DefaultTraitVariation;
    public float ReactionVariation { get; private set; } = DefaultReactionVariation;
    public float StressSusceptibility { get; private set; } = DefaultStressSusceptibility;
    public float StressPersistence { get; private set; } = DefaultStressPersistence;
    public float CrowdFollowing { get; private set; } = DefaultCrowdFollowing;
    public float PersonalSpace { get; private set; } = DefaultPersonalSpace;
    public float PanicSpaceCompression { get; private set; } = DefaultPanicSpaceCompression;
    public float EmergencyUrgency { get; private set; } = DefaultEmergencyUrgency;
    public float HelpingTendency { get; private set; } = DefaultHelpingTendency;
    public float RouteFamiliarity { get; private set; } = DefaultRouteFamiliarity;
    public float BottleneckAssertiveness { get; private set; } = DefaultBottleneckAssertiveness;
    public float BottleneckPressureSensitivity { get; private set; } = DefaultBottleneckPressureSensitivity;
    public float BottleneckSpaceCompression { get; private set; } = DefaultBottleneckSpaceCompression;

    /// <summary>Apply finite values while keeping every behavioural control inside its safe range.</summary>
    public void SetValues(
        float traitVariation,
        float reactionVariation,
        float stressSusceptibility,
        float stressPersistence,
        float crowdFollowing,
        float personalSpace,
        float panicSpaceCompression,
        float emergencyUrgency,
        float helpingTendency,
        float routeFamiliarity,
        float bottleneckAssertiveness = DefaultBottleneckAssertiveness,
        float bottleneckPressureSensitivity = DefaultBottleneckPressureSensitivity,
        float bottleneckSpaceCompression = DefaultBottleneckSpaceCompression)
    {
        float[] values =
        {
            traitVariation,
            reactionVariation,
            stressSusceptibility,
            stressPersistence,
            crowdFollowing,
            personalSpace,
            panicSpaceCompression,
            emergencyUrgency,
            helpingTendency,
            routeFamiliarity,
            bottleneckAssertiveness,
            bottleneckPressureSensitivity,
            bottleneckSpaceCompression,
        };
        if (values.Any(value => !float.IsFinite(value)))
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(traitVariation), "Behaviour tuning values must be finite.");
        }

        TraitVariation = Math.Clamp(traitVariation, 0f, 1f);
        ReactionVariation = Math.Clamp(reactionVariation, 0f, 1f);
        StressSusceptibility = Math.Clamp(stressSusceptibility, 0.60f, 1.40f);
        StressPersistence = Math.Clamp(stressPersistence, 0.50f, 2.00f);
        CrowdFollowing = Math.Clamp(crowdFollowing, 0f, 1f);
        PersonalSpace = Math.Clamp(personalSpace, 0.85f, 1.30f);
        PanicSpaceCompression = Math.Clamp(panicSpaceCompression, 0f, 0.35f);
        EmergencyUrgency = Math.Clamp(emergencyUrgency, 0.80f, 1.30f);
        HelpingTendency = Math.Clamp(helpingTendency, 0f, 1f);
        RouteFamiliarity = Math.Clamp(routeFamiliarity, 0f, 1f);
        BottleneckAssertiveness = Math.Clamp(bottleneckAssertiveness, 0f, 1f);
        BottleneckPressureSensitivity = Math.Clamp(bottleneckPressureSensitivity, 0.50f, 1.50f);
        BottleneckSpaceCompression = Math.Clamp(bottleneckSpaceCompression, 0f, 0.35f);
    }

    public void Reset()
        => SetValues(
            DefaultTraitVariation,
            DefaultReactionVariation,
            DefaultStressSusceptibility,
            DefaultStressPersistence,
            DefaultCrowdFollowing,
            DefaultPersonalSpace,
            DefaultPanicSpaceCompression,
            DefaultEmergencyUrgency,
            DefaultHelpingTendency,
            DefaultRouteFamiliarity,
            DefaultBottleneckAssertiveness,
            DefaultBottleneckPressureSensitivity,
            DefaultBottleneckSpaceCompression);
}

/// <summary>Legacy BGR color triplet preserved from the validated Python configuration.</summary>
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;

/// <summary>Allocation-free helpers for metric circular obstacle geometry.</summary>
public static class CircleGeometry
{
    public static bool SegmentIntersectsCircle(
        Vector2 start,
        Vector2 end,
        Vector2 center,
        float radius)
    {
        float safeRadius = Math.Max(0f, radius);
        Vector2 segment = end - start;
        float lengthSquared = segment.LengthSquared();
        if (!float.IsFinite(lengthSquared) || lengthSquared < 1e-8f)
        {
            return Vector2.DistanceSquared(start, center) <= safeRadius * safeRadius;
        }

        float t = Vector2.Dot(center - start, segment) / lengthSquared;
        t = Math.Clamp(t, 0f, 1f);
        Vector2 closest = start + t * segment;
        return Vector2.DistanceSquared(closest, center) <= safeRadius * safeRadius;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;

/// <summary>Numerically defensive 2D vector helpers shared by all simulation systems.</summary>
public static class VectorMath
{
    public const float Epsilon = 1e-5f;

    public static bool IsFinite(Vector2 v) => float.IsFinite(v.X) && float.IsFinite(v.Y);

    public static Vector2 SafeNormalize(Vector2 value)
    {
        if (!IsFinite(value))
        {
            return Vector2.Zero;
        }

        float length = value.Length();
        return length > Epsilon && float.IsFinite(length) ? value / length : Vector2.Zero;
    }

    public static Vector2 SafeNormalize(Vector2 value, Vector2 fallback)
    {
        Vector2 normalized = SafeNormalize(value);
        return normalized.LengthSquared() > Epsilon * Epsilon ? normalized : SafeNormalize(fallback);
    }

    public static Vector2 ClampMagnitude(Vector2 value, float maxMagnitude)
    {
        if (!IsFinite(value))
        {
            return Vector2.Zero;
        }

        float length = value.Length();
        if (length <= maxMagnitude || length <= Epsilon)
        {
            return value;
        }

        return value / length * maxMagnitude;
    }

    public static float Clamp(float value, float min, float max) => Math.Clamp(value, min, max);

    /// <summary>
    /// Clamps a continuous metric world position to the inclusive room bounds.
    /// Width and height are floats because simulation coordinates are measured in metres.
    /// </summary>
    public static Vector2 ClampToBounds(Vector2 value, float width, float height)
    {
        float safeWidth = Math.Max(0f, width);
        float safeHeight = Math.Max(0f, height);

        if (!IsFinite(value))
        {
            return new Vector2(safeWidth / 2f, safeHeight / 2f);
        }

        return new Vector2(
            Math.Clamp(value.X, 0f, safeWidth),
            Math.Clamp(value.Y, 0f, safeHeight));
    }

    public static Vector2 Perpendicular(Vector2 v) => new(-v.Y, v.X);

    public static Vector2 RandomUnit(Random random)
    {
        double angle = random.NextDouble() * Math.PI * 2.0;
        return new Vector2((float)Math.Cos(angle), (float)Math.Sin(angle));
    }

    public static Vector2 RandomGaussian2(Random random)
        => new(NextGaussian(random), NextGaussian(random));

    private static float NextGaussian(Random random)
    {
        double u1 = Math.Max(double.Epsilon, random.NextDouble());
        double u2 = random.NextDouble();
        return (float)(Math.Sqrt(-2.0 * Math.Log(u1)) * Math.Cos(2.0 * Math.PI * u2));
    }

    public static float DistanceSquared(Vector2 a, Vector2 b)
    {
        Vector2 d = a - b;
        return d.X * d.X + d.Y * d.Y;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>
/// A single simulated pedestrian, including panic, injury, exploration, wall-follow and
/// explosion state. Fields deliberately mirror agents.py so behavioural guardrails can be
/// audited one-to-one.
/// </summary>
public sealed class Agent
{
    private readonly AgentConfig _config;

    public Agent(
        int agentId,
        Vector2 position,
        Vector2 velocity,
        float baseSpeed,
        float panicSpeedMultiplier,
        float reactionDelayFrames,
        DecisionStrategy strategy,
        AgentConfig config)
    {
        AgentId = agentId;
        Position = position;
        Velocity = velocity;
        BaseSpeed = baseSpeed;
        PanicSpeedMultiplier = panicSpeedMultiplier;
        ReactionDelayFrames = reactionDelayFrames;
        Strategy = strategy;
        Mass = config.Mass;
        _config = config;
    }

    public int AgentId { get; }
    public Vector2 Position { get; set; }
    public Vector2 Velocity { get; set; }
    public float BaseSpeed { get; }
    public float PanicSpeedMultiplier { get; }
    public float ReactionDelayFrames { get; }
    public DecisionStrategy Strategy { get; }
    public AgentState State { get; set; } = AgentState.Wandering;
    public BehaviorIntent Intent { get; set; } = BehaviorIntent.Unaware;
    public Exit? ExitTarget { get; set; }

    // Stable per-agent behavioural heterogeneity. These are abstract simulation traits,
    // not demographic stereotypes. They are sampled deterministically from the scenario seed.
    public float ThreatSensitivity { get; set; } = 1f;
    public float FollowTendency { get; set; } = 0.5f;
    public float HelpingTendency { get; set; } = 0.5f;
    public float RouteFamiliarity { get; set; } = 0.5f;
    public float UrgencyBias { get; set; } = 1f;
    public float StressRecoveryBias { get; set; } = 1f;
    public float PersonalSpaceBias { get; set; } = 1f;
    public float Assertiveness { get; set; } = 0.5f;
    public float PatienceBias { get; set; } = 1f;

    // Short-lived local bypass state for very slow crawling casualties. This is deliberately
    // separate from static A* routing: the crawler remains a dynamic SFM obstacle, while a
    // mobile pedestrian may commit briefly to a clear side point instead of shadowing it.
    public int? SlowObstacleCandidateAgentId { get; set; }
    public int SlowObstacleCandidateSinceFrame { get; set; } = -1;
    public int? SlowObstacleBypassAgentId { get; set; }
    public Vector2? SlowObstacleBypassGoal { get; set; }
    public int SlowObstacleBypassUntilFrame { get; set; } = -1;

    // Bounded bottleneck interaction state. Pressure is generated by local density,
    // delayed progress and doorway load rather than panic alone. The selected mode is
    // committed briefly to prevent yield/seek/press oscillation every frame.
    public float BottleneckPressure { get; set; }
    public float BottleneckPressureTarget { get; set; }
    public float BottleneckWaitSeconds { get; set; }
    public BottleneckResponseMode BottleneckMode { get; set; } = BottleneckResponseMode.Free;
    public int BottleneckModeUntilFrame { get; set; } = -1;
    public int BottleneckLastUpdateFrame { get; set; } = -1;
    public Vector2 BottleneckLateralDirection { get; set; }

    // Behaviour commitment windows. Intent is intentionally separate from physical AgentState.
    public int IntentUntilFrame { get; set; } = -1;
    public int? AssistTargetAgentId { get; set; }
    public int AssistPauseUntilFrame { get; set; } = -1;

    // Runtime-only assistance approach state and diagnostics. The progress fields make
    // blocked approaches observable; slot/recovery fields also bound re-routing so a helper
    // cannot remain assigned indefinitely without reaching the casualty.
    public int AssistAssignedFrame { get; set; } = -1;
    public int AssistLastProgressFrame { get; set; } = -1;
    public float AssistBestDistanceMeters { get; set; } = float.PositiveInfinity;
    public Vector2? AssistProgressAnchorPosition { get; set; }
    public int AssistSlotIndex { get; set; } = -1;
    public int AssistRecoveryStage { get; set; }

    public bool AssistanceDecisionMade { get; set; }
    public float PanicLevel { get; set; }
    public float InjurySpeedFactor { get; set; } = 1f;
    public int FreezeUntilFrame { get; set; }
    public int CrawlUntilFrame { get; set; }
    public bool ShockwaveHit { get; set; }
    public int ShockwaveHitFrame { get; set; } = -1;
    public int? GroupId { get; set; }
    public Vector2? WanderDir { get; set; }

    public float TimeStuck { get; set; }
    public float LastGoalDistance { get; set; } = float.PositiveInfinity;

    // Net-progress probe used by the wall-end deadlock detector. Unlike per-frame
    // distance jitter, this measures whether the body actually translated over a
    // short window before declaring that useful motion has resumed.
    public Vector2? StuckProgressAnchorPosition { get; set; }
    public float StuckProgressAnchorExitDistance { get; set; } = float.PositiveInfinity;
    public int StuckProgressAnchorFrame { get; set; } = -1;

    public bool Exploring { get; set; }
    public Vector2? TempGoal { get; set; }
    public int ExplorationReplanAfterFrame { get; set; }

    // Body-clear visibility-graph route. Waypoints are static-geometry guidance only; SFM
    // continues to handle person-person contacts, wall forces, casualties and local congestion.
    public List<Vector2> RouteWaypoints { get; } = new();
    public int RouteWaypointIndex { get; set; }
    public string? RouteExitName { get; set; }
    public int RouteReplanAfterFrame { get; set; } = -1;

    public int? WallFollowDir { get; set; }
    public int WallFollowUntil { get; set; }
    public float WallFollowDistance { get; set; }
    public bool WallFollowReversed { get; set; }
    public int WallFollowStartFrame { get; set; }
    public int WallFollowCooldownUntil { get; set; }
    public Vector2? WallFollowNormal { get; set; }
    public Vector2? WallFollowTangent { get; set; }
    public int WallStuckFrames { get; set; }
    public float LastExitDist { get; set; } = float.PositiveInfinity;

    public float Mass { get; set; }
    public BgrColor Color { get; set; } = new(255, 255, 255);

    // Python used dynamic attributes for these caches. They are explicit in C#.
    public bool BlastShielded { get; set; }
    public int StunnedUntilFrame { get; set; }
    public int LosLastCheckFrame { get; set; } = -999;
    public bool LosCached { get; set; }

    // Emergency-response / Stage 2 state. ReactionStartedFrame makes socially-triggered
    // agents wait from the moment they notice the emergency rather than from the global blast frame.
    public int ReactionStartedFrame { get; set; } = -1;
    public float ReactionDelayScale { get; private set; } = 1f;
    public int ExitCommitUntilFrame { get; set; }
    public int LastExitReselectFrame { get; set; } = -999;

    // Exit-congestion episode state. This is deliberately separate from AgentState so
    // an evacuating/injured pedestrian keeps the same semantic state and body colour.
    public bool ExitCongestionEpisodeActive { get; set; }
    public string? ExitCongestionExitName { get; set; }
    public bool ExitYielding { get; set; }
    public int ExitRetryAfterFrame { get; set; }
    public float ExitCongestionHoldingCoordinate { get; set; } = float.NaN;

    // Stage 2/3 diagnostics and perception. Values are bounded every update and are also
    // useful in the selected-agent UI without feeding renderer state back into physics.
    public float VisibilityFactor { get; set; } = 1f;
    public float LocalCongestion { get; set; }
    public float LastThreatPanicStimulus { get; set; }
    public float LastSocialPanicStimulus { get; set; }
    public float LastRunningPanicStimulus { get; set; }
    public float LastEvacuationAwarenessStimulus { get; set; }

    // Finite panic-source window. This is deliberately distinct from PanicLevel:
    // residual anxiety may remain after the agent stops being an active alarm source.
    // Social/running contagion can relay an alarm once, but cannot keep refreshing it
    // simply because already-alarmed pedestrians continue seeing one another.
    public int ActiveAlarmUntilFrame { get; private set; } = -1;
    public float ActiveAlarmPanicFloor { get; private set; }
    public int ActiveAlarmEpisodeId { get; private set; } = -1;
    public int LastRelayedAlarmEpisodeId { get; private set; } = -1;
    public int LastDirectAlarmEpisodeId { get; private set; } = -1;

    // Debug vectors consumed by the renderer. They do not alter physics.
    public Vector2 LastDesiredDirection { get; set; }
    public Vector2 LastSfmForce { get; set; }
    public Vector2 LastAvoidanceDirection { get; set; }
    public Vector2 LastHerdDirection { get; set; }

    public float DistanceTo(Vector2 point) => Vector2.Distance(Position, point);

    public Exit ChooseExit(IReadOnlyList<Exit> exits, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int> crowdLoads)
    {
        if (exits.Count == 0)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot choose an exit when no exits exist.");
        }

        if (Strategy == DecisionStrategy.Nearest)
        {
            return exits.OrderBy(exit => DistanceTo(exit.Position)).First();
        }

        return exits.OrderBy(exit => crowdLoads.TryGetValue(exit.Name, out int load) ? load : 0).First();
    }

    public void MarkExited()
    {
        State = AgentState.Exited;
        Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        ClearActiveAlarm();
        ClearRoute();
        ResetExitCongestion();
    }

    public void MarkInjured(bool preserveReactionState = false)
    {
        if (State is AgentState.Exited or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.Dead)
        {
            return;
        }

        InjurySpeedFactor = _config.InjuredSpeedFactor;
        if (!(preserveReactionState && State == AgentState.WaitingToReact))
        {
            State = AgentState.Injured;
        }
    }

    public void MarkFallen(int currentFrame, Random random)
    {
        if (State is AgentState.Exited or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.Dead)
        {
            return;
        }

        State = AgentState.Fallen;
        Intent = BehaviorIntent.Unaware;
        Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        InjurySpeedFactor = 0f;
        ClearRoute();
        ResetExitCongestion();
        int delay = RandomRange(random, _config.CrawlDelayMin, _config.CrawlDelayMax);
        CrawlUntilFrame = currentFrame + delay;
    }

    public void MarkCrawling()
    {
        if (State is AgentState.Exited or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.Dead)
        {
            return;
        }

        State = AgentState.Crawling;
        Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        InjurySpeedFactor = _config.CrawlSpeedFactor;
    }

    public void MarkIncapacitated()
    {
        if (State is AgentState.Exited or AgentState.Dead)
        {
            return;
        }

        State = AgentState.Incapacitated;
        Intent = BehaviorIntent.Unaware;
        Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        InjurySpeedFactor = 0f;
        ClearRoute();
        ResetExitCongestion();
    }

    /// <summary>Mark a terminal fatality while leaving the body in the world as an obstacle.</summary>
    public void MarkDead()
    {
        if (State == AgentState.Exited)
        {
            return;
        }

        State = AgentState.Dead;
        Intent = BehaviorIntent.Unaware;
        Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        InjurySpeedFactor = 0f;
        PanicLevel = 0f;
        ClearActiveAlarm();
        ClearRoute();
        ResetExitCongestion();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Start or refresh a direct alarm from the physical event. Direct exposure may
    /// upgrade a previously relayed alarm and keeps the original event episode id.
    /// </summary>
    public void ActivateDirectAlarm(
        int currentFrame,
        int durationFrames,
        float panicFloor,
        int episodeId)
    {
        int boundedDuration = Math.Max(1, durationFrames);
        ActiveAlarmUntilFrame = Math.Max(
            ActiveAlarmUntilFrame,
            currentFrame + boundedDuration);
        ActiveAlarmPanicFloor = Math.Max(
            ActiveAlarmPanicFloor,
            Math.Clamp(panicFloor, 0f, 1f));
        ActiveAlarmEpisodeId = episodeId;
        LastDirectAlarmEpisodeId = episodeId;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Relay an alarm episode once. An agent cannot be socially re-activated by the
    /// same event after its relay window expires, preventing ping-pong panic loops.
    /// </summary>
    public bool TryActivateRelayedAlarm(
        int currentFrame,
        int durationFrames,
        float panicFloor,
        int episodeId)
    {
        if (episodeId < 0 ||
            LastRelayedAlarmEpisodeId == episodeId ||
            LastDirectAlarmEpisodeId == episodeId ||
            IsActiveAlarmSource(currentFrame))
        {
            return false;
        }

        int boundedDuration = Math.Max(1, durationFrames);
        ActiveAlarmUntilFrame = currentFrame + boundedDuration;
        ActiveAlarmPanicFloor = Math.Clamp(panicFloor, 0f, 1f);
        ActiveAlarmEpisodeId = episodeId;
        LastRelayedAlarmEpisodeId = episodeId;
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Whether this agent is currently allowed to transmit alarm contagion.</summary>
    public bool IsActiveAlarmSource(int currentFrame) => currentFrame <= ActiveAlarmUntilFrame;

    /// <summary>Expire the finite alarm source while leaving residual panic to decay naturally.</summary>
    public void ExpireAlarmIfNeeded(int currentFrame)
    {
        if (currentFrame > ActiveAlarmUntilFrame)
        {
            ActiveAlarmPanicFloor = 0f;
            ActiveAlarmEpisodeId = -1;
        }
    }

    private void ClearActiveAlarm()
    {
        ActiveAlarmUntilFrame = -1;
        ActiveAlarmPanicFloor = 0f;
        ActiveAlarmEpisodeId = -1;
        LastRelayedAlarmEpisodeId = -1;
        LastDirectAlarmEpisodeId = -1;
    }

    /// <summary>Begin the bounded startle/reaction sequence at the frame the emergency is perceived.</summary>
    public void BeginReaction(int currentFrame, int freezeUntilFrame, float reactionDelayScale = 1f)
    {
        if (State is AgentState.Exited or AgentState.Dead or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.TempIncap)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (State == AgentState.Wandering)
        {
            State = AgentState.WaitingToReact;
            Intent = BehaviorIntent.Orienting;
        }

        if (ReactionStartedFrame < 0)
        {
            ReactionStartedFrame = currentFrame;
        }

        ReactionDelayScale = Math.Min(
            ReactionDelayScale,
            Math.Clamp(reactionDelayScale, 0.05f, 1f));
        FreezeUntilFrame = Math.Max(FreezeUntilFrame, freezeUntilFrame);
    }

    public void MarkTempIncap(int currentFrame, Random random)
    {
        State = AgentState.TempIncap;
        Intent = BehaviorIntent.Unaware;
        Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        InjurySpeedFactor = 0f;
        ClearRoute();
        ResetExitCongestion();
        int delay = RandomRange(random, _config.CrawlDelayMin, _config.CrawlDelayMax);
        CrawlUntilFrame = currentFrame + delay;
    }

    /// <summary>Clear cached static-geometry route guidance.</summary>
    public void ClearRoute()
    {
        RouteWaypoints.Clear();
        RouteWaypointIndex = 0;
        RouteExitName = null;
        RouteReplanAfterFrame = -1;
    }

    /// <summary>Replace the body-clear route for the current exit.</summary>
    public void SetRoute(IEnumerable<Vector2> waypoints, string exitName, int replanAfterFrame)
    {
        RouteWaypoints.Clear();
        RouteWaypoints.AddRange(waypoints);
        RouteWaypointIndex = 0;
        RouteExitName = exitName;
        RouteReplanAfterFrame = replanAfterFrame;
    }

    public Vector2? CurrentRouteWaypoint
        => RouteWaypointIndex >= 0 && RouteWaypointIndex < RouteWaypoints.Count
            ? RouteWaypoints[RouteWaypointIndex]
            : null;

    public void AdvanceRouteWaypoint()
    {
        if (RouteWaypointIndex < RouteWaypoints.Count)
        {
            RouteWaypointIndex++;
        }
    }

    public void ResetExitCongestion()
    {
        ExitCongestionEpisodeActive = false;
        ExitCongestionExitName = null;
        ExitYielding = false;
        ExitRetryAfterFrame = 0;
        ExitCongestionHoldingCoordinate = float.NaN;
        ResetBottleneckInteraction();
    }

    /// <summary>Clear transient doorway pressure and response commitment.</summary>
    public void ResetBottleneckInteraction()
    {
        BottleneckPressure = 0f;
        BottleneckPressureTarget = 0f;
        BottleneckWaitSeconds = 0f;
        BottleneckMode = BottleneckResponseMode.Free;
        BottleneckModeUntilFrame = -1;
        BottleneckLastUpdateFrame = -1;
        BottleneckLateralDirection = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    /// <summary>True while the agent/body remains present in the simulated room.</summary>
    public bool IsActive => State != AgentState.Exited;

    /// <summary>Whether the agent can currently contribute a visible social panic signal.</summary>
    public bool CanSignalPanic => State is AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured or AgentState.Crawling;

    /// <summary>Static/slow casualty states that other pedestrians should locally route around.</summary>
    public bool IsCasualtyObstacle => State is AgentState.Fallen or AgentState.TempIncap or
        AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.Dead or AgentState.Crawling;

    public float EffectiveReactionDelayFrames => ReactionDelayFrames * ReactionDelayScale;

    public float CurrentDesiredSpeed
    {
        get
        {
            float panic = Math.Clamp(PanicLevel, 0f, 1f);
            float urgencyScale = _config.Behavior.EmergencyUrgency;
            float multiplier = 1f + _config.PanicSpeedGain * urgencyScale * panic;

            if (State is AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured)
            {
                float intentFloor = Intent switch
                {
                    BehaviorIntent.ThreatEscape => _config.ThreatEscapeSpeedMultiplier,
                    BehaviorIntent.FollowCrowd => _config.FollowCrowdSpeedMultiplier,
                    BehaviorIntent.AssistCasualty => _config.AssistanceApproachSpeedMultiplier,
                    _ => _config.EvacuationSpeedFloorMultiplier,
                };
                intentFloor *= urgencyScale;

                // Panic raises urgency, but purposeful evacuation remains brisk even after acute
                // stress subsides. The bounded per-agent urgency bias avoids synchronized motion.
                multiplier = Math.Max(intentFloor, multiplier);
                multiplier *= Math.Clamp(UrgencyBias, 0.75f, 1.25f);

                float bottleneckModeFactor = BottleneckMode switch
                {
                    BottleneckResponseMode.SeekGap => 0.45f,
                    BottleneckResponseMode.Press => 1.00f,
                    _ => 0f,
                };
                if (bottleneckModeFactor > 0f)
                {
                    float pressure = Math.Clamp(BottleneckPressure, 0f, 1f);
                    multiplier *= 1f +
                        _config.BottleneckPressSpeedGain *
                        _config.Behavior.BottleneckPressureSensitivity *
                        pressure *
                        bottleneckModeFactor;
                }

                multiplier = Math.Min(multiplier, _config.MaximumBehaviorSpeedMultiplier);
            }

            return BaseSpeed * multiplier * InjurySpeedFactor;
        }
    }

    private static int RandomRange(Random random, int minInclusive, int maxExclusive)
    {
        if (maxExclusive <= minInclusive)
        {
            return minInclusive;
        }

        return minInclusive + (int)(random.NextDouble() * (maxExclusive - minInclusive));
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>Finite physical/operational states of an agent in the evacuation scenario.</summary>
public enum AgentState
{
    Wandering,
    WaitingToReact,
    Evacuating,
    Exited,
    Injured,
    Fallen,
    Crawling,
    Incapacitated,
    TempIncap,
    Dead
}

/// <summary>
/// Short-lived behavioural intent layered on top of AgentState. This keeps body-state colours
/// stable while allowing heterogeneous emergency responses such as orienting, moving away from
/// the immediate threat, following an obvious evacuation flow, or briefly attending a casualty.
/// </summary>
public enum BehaviorIntent
{
    Unaware,
    Orienting,
    ThreatEscape,
    Evacuate,
    FollowCrowd,
    AssistCasualty
}

/// <summary>
/// Short-lived response to pressure near a congested doorway. This is separate from
/// panic so a calm pedestrian may still yield, seek a gap, or press after prolonged delay.
/// </summary>
public enum BottleneckResponseMode
{
    Free,
    Yield,
    SeekGap,
    Press
}

/// <summary>Strategy used to choose an exit.</summary>
public enum DecisionStrategy
{
    Nearest,
    LeastCrowded
}
```

## benchmarks/baseline/src/CrowdSim.Core/Model/CircleBlockage.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>A true circular static blockage on the metric ground plane.</summary>
public sealed record CircleBlockage(Vector2 Center, float Radius)
{
    public const float DefaultDiameterMeters = 2.50f;
    public const float DefaultRadiusMeters = DefaultDiameterMeters / 2f;

    public float Diameter => 2f * Radius;

    public bool Contains(Vector2 point, float margin = 0f)
    {
        float effectiveRadius = Radius + Math.Max(0f, margin);
        return Vector2.DistanceSquared(point, Center) <= effectiveRadius * effectiveRadius;
    }

    public Vector2 ClosestPoint(Vector2 point)
    {
        Vector2 delta = point - Center;
        float distance = delta.Length();
        if (!float.IsFinite(distance) || distance < 1e-6f)
        {
            return Center + new Vector2(Radius, 0f);
        }

        return Center + delta / distance * Radius;
    }
}
```

## benchmarks/baseline/src/CrowdSim.Core/Model/Debris.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>
/// Lightweight outward-moving debris fragment. Movement is deliberately abstract and deterministic:
/// fragments carry normalized impact energy, decay with travel, collide against walls using their
/// swept segment, and are removed after one person impact so a single fragment cannot repeatedly harm
/// the same person on successive frames.
/// </summary>
public sealed class Debris
{
    public Debris(
        Vector2 position,
        Vector2 velocity,
        int ttl,
        float radius,
        float energy = 1f)
    {
        Position = position;
        PreviousPosition = position;
        Velocity = velocity;
        Ttl = ttl;
        Radius = radius;
        Energy = Math.Clamp(energy, 0f, 1f);
    }

    public Vector2 Position { get; set; }
    public Vector2 PreviousPosition { get; private set; }
    public Vector2 Velocity { get; set; }
    public int Ttl { get; set; }
    public float Radius { get; }
    public float Energy { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Advance one frame. Returns false when the fragment should be discarded.</summary>
    public bool Advance(WorldConfig world, AgentConfig config)
    {
        PreviousPosition = Position;
        Velocity *= 0.96f;
        Energy *= Math.Clamp(config.DebrisEnergyDecay, 0f, 1f);

        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(Velocity) || !float.IsFinite(Energy))
        {
            Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            Energy = 0f;
            Ttl = 0;
            return false;
        }

        Position += Velocity;
        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(Position))
        {
            Ttl = 0;
            return false;
        }

        // Debris does not wrap/clamp around the room. Leaving the simulation boundary ends it.
        if (Position.X < 0f || Position.Y < 0f || Position.X > world.WidthMeters || Position.Y > world.LengthMeters)
        {
            Ttl = 0;
            return false;
        }

        Ttl--;
        return Ttl > 0 && Energy > 0.04f;
    }

    public static List<Debris> SpawnCluster(
        Vector2 explosionPosition,
        int count,
        float speedMin,
        float speedMax,
        int ttlMin,
        int ttlMax,
        float radius,
        Random random)
    {
        List<Debris> fragments = new(count);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            float angle = (float)(random.NextDouble() * Math.PI * 2.0);
            float speed = Lerp(speedMin, speedMax, (float)random.NextDouble());
            Vector2 velocity = new(MathF.Cos(angle) * speed, MathF.Sin(angle) * speed);
            int ttl = ttlMin + (int)(random.NextDouble() * Math.Max(1, ttlMax - ttlMin));
            float normalizedEnergy = Math.Clamp((speed - speedMin) / Math.Max(1e-5f, speedMax - speedMin), 0f, 1f);
            // Keep even slower pieces relevant while still separating low/high energy impacts.
            normalizedEnergy = 0.30f + 0.70f * normalizedEnergy;
            fragments.Add(new Debris(explosionPosition, velocity, ttl, radius, normalizedEnergy));
        }

        return fragments;
    }

    private static float Lerp(float a, float b, float t) => a + (b - a) * t;
}
```
