## benchmarks/baseline/src/CrowdSim.Core/Model/SimulationEnvironment.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>
/// Editable room geometry. Boundary walls are rebuilt whenever an exit or blockage is
/// changed so an exit is a true opening rather than a decorative object.
/// </summary>
public sealed class SimulationEnvironment
{
    private readonly SimulationConfig _config;
    private readonly Stack<(string Kind, object Item)> _undoStack = new();

    public SimulationEnvironment(SimulationConfig config)
    {
        _config = config;
        Width = config.World.WidthMeters;
        Height = config.World.LengthMeters;
        RebuildWalls();
    }

    public float Width { get; private set; }
    public float Height { get; private set; }
    public float BoundaryThickness { get; } = 0.60f;
    public List<Exit> Exits { get; } = new();
    public List<Wall> Blockages { get; } = new();
    public List<CircleBlockage> CircularBlockages { get; } = new();
    public List<Wall> BlueWalls { get; } = new();
    public List<AgentSpawnGroup> AgentSpawnGroups { get; } = new();
    public List<Wall> Walls { get; } = new();
    public Explosion? Explosion { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Monotonic version used by render/navigation caches when static walls change.</summary>
    public int WallLayoutVersion { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Total number of agents currently planned by mouse placement.</summary>
    public int PlannedAgentCount => AgentSpawnGroups.Sum(group => group.Count);

    /// <summary>
    /// Room resizing is intentionally limited to an otherwise empty builder. This avoids silently
    /// moving or clipping exits, obstacles and population placements when a smaller room is chosen.
    /// </summary>
    public bool CanResizeRoom =>
        Exits.Count == 0 && Blockages.Count == 0 && CircularBlockages.Count == 0 &&
        BlueWalls.Count == 0 && AgentSpawnGroups.Count == 0;

    public (float Width, float Height) Bounds() => (Width, Height);

    public void SetExplosion(float x, float y, int frame)
        => Explosion = new Explosion(new Vector2(x, y), frame);

    public bool HasExplosion() => Explosion is not null;

    public bool UndoLast()
    {
        if (!_undoStack.TryPop(out (string Kind, object Item) entry))
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (entry.Kind == "exit" && entry.Item is Exit exit)
        {
            Exits.Remove(exit);
            RebuildWalls();
            return true;
        }

        if (entry.Kind == "blockage" && entry.Item is Wall wall)
        {
            Blockages.Remove(wall);
            RebuildWalls();
            return true;
        }

        if (entry.Kind == "circle_blockage" && entry.Item is CircleBlockage circle)
        {
            CircularBlockages.Remove(circle);
            RebuildWalls();
            return true;
        }

        if (entry.Kind == "bluewall" && entry.Item is Wall blueWall)
        {
            BlueWalls.Remove(blueWall);
            RebuildWalls();
            return true;
        }

        if (entry.Kind == "agent_spawn" && entry.Item is AgentSpawnGroup spawnGroup)
        {
            AgentSpawnGroups.Remove(spawnGroup);
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Place an exit only on a boundary wall. Exit width is snapped to body diameter;
    /// one-person exits receive the validated 1.2x clearance.
    /// </summary>
    public bool AddExitFromClick(float x, float y, int personsWide)
    {
        string? side = DetectBoundarySide(x, y);
        if (side is null)
        {
            return false;
        }

        float agentDiameter = 2f * _config.Agent.Radius;
        personsWide = Math.Max(1, personsWide);
        float exitWidth = personsWide == 1
            ? agentDiameter * 1.2f
            : personsWide * agentDiameter;
        float halfSize = exitWidth / 2f;
        float thickness = BoundaryThickness;

        float cx;
        float cy;
        string name;

        switch (side)
        {
            case "N":
                cx = Math.Clamp(x, thickness + halfSize, Width - thickness - halfSize);
                cy = thickness / 2f;
                name = $"North_{Exits.Count(e => e.Side == "N") + 1}";
                break;
            case "S":
                cx = Math.Clamp(x, thickness + halfSize, Width - thickness - halfSize);
                cy = Height - thickness / 2f;
                name = $"South_{Exits.Count(e => e.Side == "S") + 1}";
                break;
            case "W":
                cx = thickness / 2f;
                cy = Math.Clamp(y, thickness + halfSize, Height - thickness - halfSize);
                name = $"West_{Exits.Count(e => e.Side == "W") + 1}";
                break;
            default:
                cx = Width - thickness / 2f;
                cy = Math.Clamp(y, thickness + halfSize, Height - thickness - halfSize);
                name = $"East_{Exits.Count(e => e.Side == "E") + 1}";
                break;
        }

        Exit candidate = new(name, new Vector2(cx, cy), halfSize, side);
        if (ExitOverlapsExisting(candidate) || ExitOverlapsBlockage(candidate))
        {
            return false;
        }

        Exits.Add(candidate);
        _undoStack.Push(("exit", candidate));
        RebuildWalls();
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Mirror of Python _snap_point_to_grid.</summary>
    public Vector2 SnapPointToGrid(float x, float y)
    {
        if (!_config.Grid.Enabled)
        {
            return new Vector2(x, y);
        }

        float step = Math.Max(0.10f, _config.Grid.CellSizeMeters);
        float t = BoundaryThickness;
        float sx = t + (MathF.Floor((x - t) / step) + 0.5f) * step;
        float sy = t + (MathF.Floor((y - t) / step) + 0.5f) * step;
        return new Vector2(sx, sy);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Place a snapped square blockage fully inside the inner room. One cell preserves the
    /// original blockage footprint; two cells creates a 2 x 2 builder-grid blockage.
    /// </summary>
    public bool AddBlockageFromClick(float x, float y, int cells = 1)
    {
        cells = Math.Clamp(cells, 1, 2);
        float sideLength = cells * Math.Max(0.10f, _config.Grid.CellSizeMeters);
        float half = sideLength / 2f;
        float innerXMin = BoundaryThickness + 0.05f;
        float innerXMax = Width - BoundaryThickness - 0.05f;
        float innerYMin = BoundaryThickness + 0.05f;
        float innerYMax = Height - BoundaryThickness - 0.05f;
        Vector2 snapped = SnapPointToGrid(x, y);

        if (!(innerXMin + half <= snapped.X && snapped.X <= innerXMax - half &&
              innerYMin + half <= snapped.Y && snapped.Y <= innerYMax - half))
        {
            return false;
        }

        Wall candidate = new(
            snapped.X - half,
            snapped.Y - half,
            snapped.X + half,
            snapped.Y + half);

        if (WallOverlapsAny(candidate))
        {
            return false;
        }

        Blockages.Add(candidate);
        _undoStack.Push(("blockage", candidate));
        RebuildWalls();
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Place a true circular blockage with a fixed 2.5 m diameter.</summary>
    public bool AddCircularBlockageFromClick(float x, float y)
    {
        const float radius = CircleBlockage.DefaultRadiusMeters;
        Vector2 center = SnapPointToGrid(x, y);
        float innerMargin = BoundaryThickness + radius + 0.05f;
        if (center.X < innerMargin || center.X > Width - innerMargin ||
            center.Y < innerMargin || center.Y > Height - innerMargin)
        {
            return false;
        }

        CircleBlockage candidate = new(center, radius);
        if (CircleOverlapsAny(candidate))
        {
            return false;
        }

        CircularBlockages.Add(candidate);
        _undoStack.Push(("circle_blockage", candidate));
        RebuildWalls();
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Place a fixed blue 2x2 wall tile. "2x2" means two builder grid cells by two builder
    /// grid cells, keeping the element proportional to the existing snapped blockage tool.
    /// </summary>
    public bool AddBlueWallFromClick(float x, float y)
    {
        float sideLength = 2f * Math.Max(0.10f, _config.Grid.CellSizeMeters);
        float half = sideLength / 2f;
        float innerXMin = BoundaryThickness + 0.05f;
        float innerXMax = Width - BoundaryThickness - 0.05f;
        float innerYMin = BoundaryThickness + 0.05f;
        float innerYMax = Height - BoundaryThickness - 0.05f;
        Vector2 snapped = SnapPointToGrid(x, y);

        if (!(innerXMin + half <= snapped.X && snapped.X <= innerXMax - half &&
              innerYMin + half <= snapped.Y && snapped.Y <= innerYMax - half))
        {
            return false;
        }

        Wall candidate = new(
            snapped.X - half,
            snapped.Y - half,
            snapped.X + half,
            snapped.Y + half);

        if (WallOverlapsAny(candidate))
        {
            return false;
        }

        BlueWalls.Add(candidate);
        _undoStack.Push(("bluewall", candidate));
        RebuildWalls();
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Add a mouse-positioned population group. Candidates expand outwards from the click in a
    /// deterministic square spiral, skipping solid geometry and already planned agents. This lets
    /// a 50-person placement naturally flow around blocked floor instead of stacking inside it.
    /// </summary>
    public bool AddAgentSpawnGroupFromClick(float x, float y, int count)
    {
        count = Math.Clamp(count, 1, 50);
        if (PlannedAgentCount + count > 5000)
        {
            return false;
        }

        Vector2 center = new(x, y);
        if (center.X <= BoundaryThickness || center.X >= Width - BoundaryThickness ||
            center.Y <= BoundaryThickness || center.Y >= Height - BoundaryThickness)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!TryBuildSpawnPositions(center, count, out List<Vector2> positions))
        {
            return false;
        }

        AgentSpawnGroup group = new(center, positions);
        AgentSpawnGroups.Add(group);
        _undoStack.Push(("agent_spawn", group));
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Flatten the builder-time spawn groups into deterministic start positions.</summary>
    public List<Vector2> GetPlannedAgentPositions()
    {
        List<Vector2> result = new(PlannedAgentCount);
        foreach (AgentSpawnGroup group in AgentSpawnGroups)
        {
            result.AddRange(group.Positions);
        }

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>Resize an empty builder room while preserving the existing application window.</summary>
    public bool TryResizeRoom(float widthMeters, float lengthMeters)
    {
        if (!CanResizeRoom)
        {
            return false;
        }

        _config.World.ApplySize(widthMeters, lengthMeters);
        Width = _config.World.WidthMeters;
        Height = _config.World.LengthMeters;
        RebuildWalls();
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Replace builder geometry from a validated saved scenario. The undo history is
    /// cleared because imported geometry is treated as the new builder baseline.
    /// </summary>
    public void ReplaceLayout(
        IEnumerable<Exit> exits,
        IEnumerable<Wall> blockages,
        IEnumerable<CircleBlockage>? circularBlockages = null,
        IEnumerable<Wall>? blueWalls = null,
        IEnumerable<AgentSpawnGroup>? agentSpawnGroups = null)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(exits);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(blockages);

        Exits.Clear();
        Exits.AddRange(exits);
        Blockages.Clear();
        Blockages.AddRange(blockages);
        CircularBlockages.Clear();
        if (circularBlockages is not null)
        {
            CircularBlockages.AddRange(circularBlockages);
        }

        BlueWalls.Clear();
        if (blueWalls is not null)
        {
            BlueWalls.AddRange(blueWalls);
        }

        AgentSpawnGroups.Clear();
        if (agentSpawnGroups is not null)
        {
            AgentSpawnGroups.AddRange(agentSpawnGroups);
        }

        _undoStack.Clear();
        Explosion = null;
        RebuildWalls();
    }

    public bool IsPointBlocked(Vector2 position, float margin = 0f)
    {
        foreach (Wall wall in Walls)
        {
            if (wall.X1 - margin <= position.X && position.X <= wall.X2 + margin &&
                wall.Y1 - margin <= position.Y && position.Y <= wall.Y2 + margin)
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in CircularBlockages)
        {
            if (circle.Contains(position, margin))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public void RebuildWalls()
    {
        Walls.Clear();
        float t = BoundaryThickness;
        Walls.AddRange(BuildHorizontalWallWithOpenings("N", 0f, t, Width));
        Walls.AddRange(BuildHorizontalWallWithOpenings("S", Height - t, Height, Width));
        Walls.AddRange(BuildVerticalWallWithOpenings("W", 0f, t, Height));
        Walls.AddRange(BuildVerticalWallWithOpenings("E", Width - t, Width, Height));
        Walls.AddRange(Blockages);
        Walls.AddRange(BlueWalls);
        WallLayoutVersion++;
    }

    public List<Wall> BuildHorizontalWallWithOpenings(string side, float y1, float y2, float length)
    {
        List<(float Start, float End)> openings = Exits
            .Where(exit => exit.Side == side)
            .Select(exit => (exit.Position.X - exit.Size, exit.Position.X + exit.Size))
            .ToList();

        return SegmentsWithOpenings1D(0f, length, y1, y2, openings, horizontal: true);
    }

    public List<Wall> BuildVerticalWallWithOpenings(string side, float x1, float x2, float length)
    {
        List<(float Start, float End)> openings = Exits
            .Where(exit => exit.Side == side)
            .Select(exit => (exit.Position.Y - exit.Size, exit.Position.Y + exit.Size))
            .ToList();

        return SegmentsWithOpenings1D(0f, length, x1, x2, openings, horizontal: false);
    }

    public static List<Wall> SegmentsWithOpenings1D(
        float axisStart,
        float axisEnd,
        float fixedMin,
        float fixedMax,
        IReadOnlyList<(float Start, float End)> openings,
        bool horizontal)
    {
        if (openings.Count == 0)
        {
            return new List<Wall>
            {
                horizontal
                    ? new Wall(axisStart, fixedMin, axisEnd, fixedMax)
                    : new Wall(fixedMin, axisStart, fixedMax, axisEnd),
            };
        }

        List<(float Start, float End)> clamped = openings
            .Select(opening => (
                Start: Math.Clamp(opening.Start, axisStart, axisEnd),
                End: Math.Clamp(opening.End, axisStart, axisEnd)))
            .Where(opening => opening.End > opening.Start)
            .OrderBy(opening => opening.Start)
            .ToList();

        List<(float Start, float End)> merged = new();
        foreach ((float start, float end) in clamped)
        {
            if (merged.Count == 0)
            {
                merged.Add((start, end));
                continue;
            }

            (float lastStart, float lastEnd) = merged[^1];
            if (start <= lastEnd)
            {
                merged[^1] = (lastStart, Math.Max(lastEnd, end));
            }
            else
            {
                merged.Add((start, end));
            }
        }

        List<Wall> segments = new();
        float cursor = axisStart;
        foreach ((float start, float end) in merged)
        {
            if (start > cursor)
            {
                segments.Add(horizontal
                    ? new Wall(cursor, fixedMin, start, fixedMax)
                    : new Wall(fixedMin, cursor, fixedMax, start));
            }

            cursor = Math.Max(cursor, end);
        }

        if (cursor < axisEnd)
        {
            segments.Add(horizontal
                ? new Wall(cursor, fixedMin, axisEnd, fixedMax)
                : new Wall(fixedMin, cursor, fixedMax, axisEnd));
        }

        return segments;
    }

    public Wall? FindNearestWall(Vector2 position)
    {
        Wall? nearest = null;
        float minDistanceSquared = float.PositiveInfinity;
        foreach (Wall wall in Walls)
        {
            Vector2 closest = wall.ClosestPoint(position);
            float distanceSquared = Vector2.DistanceSquared(position, closest);
            if (distanceSquared < minDistanceSquared)
            {
                minDistanceSquared = distanceSquared;
                nearest = wall;
            }
        }

        return nearest;
    }

    public string? DetectBoundarySide(float x, float y)
    {
        float t = BoundaryThickness;
        const float snap = 0.40f;
        (string Side, float Distance)[] distances =
        {
            ("N", MathF.Abs(y - t / 2f)),
            ("S", MathF.Abs(y - (Height - t / 2f))),
            ("W", MathF.Abs(x - t / 2f)),
            ("E", MathF.Abs(x - (Width - t / 2f))),
        };

        (string side, float best) = distances.OrderBy(pair => pair.Distance).First();
        return best > t / 2f + snap ? null : side;
    }

    public bool ExitOverlapsExisting(Exit candidate)
    {
        foreach (Exit existing in Exits.Where(exit => exit.Side == candidate.Side))
        {
            float a0;
            float a1;
            float b0;
            float b1;
            if (candidate.Side is "N" or "S")
            {
                a0 = candidate.Position.X - candidate.Size;
                a1 = candidate.Position.X + candidate.Size;
                b0 = existing.Position.X - existing.Size;
                b1 = existing.Position.X + existing.Size;
            }
            else
            {
                a0 = candidate.Position.Y - candidate.Size;
                a1 = candidate.Position.Y + candidate.Size;
                b0 = existing.Position.Y - existing.Size;
                b1 = existing.Position.Y + existing.Size;
            }

            if (!(a1 < b0 || b1 < a0))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public bool ExitOverlapsBlockage(Exit candidate)
    {
        float size = candidate.Size;
        float x1 = candidate.Position.X - size;
        float y1 = candidate.Position.Y - size;
        float x2 = candidate.Position.X + size;
        float y2 = candidate.Position.Y + size;

        if (Blockages.Concat(BlueWalls).Any(blockage =>
            !(x2 <= blockage.X1 || blockage.X2 <= x1 || y2 <= blockage.Y1 || blockage.Y2 <= y1)))
        {
            return true;
        }

        return CircularBlockages.Any(circle => CircleIntersectsAabb(circle, x1, y1, x2, y2));
    }

    /// <summary>Check candidate against all current walls and exits; edge-touching is allowed.</summary>
    public bool WallOverlapsAny(Wall candidate)
    {
        foreach (Wall other in Walls)
        {
            if (!(candidate.X2 <= other.X1 || other.X2 <= candidate.X1 ||
                  candidate.Y2 <= other.Y1 || other.Y2 <= candidate.Y1))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in CircularBlockages)
        {
            if (CircleIntersectsAabb(circle, candidate.X1, candidate.Y1, candidate.X2, candidate.Y2))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        foreach (Exit exit in Exits)
        {
            float size = exit.Size;
            float x1 = exit.Position.X - size;
            float y1 = exit.Position.Y - size;
            float x2 = exit.Position.X + size;
            float y2 = exit.Position.Y + size;
            if (!(candidate.X2 <= x1 || x2 <= candidate.X1 || candidate.Y2 <= y1 || y2 <= candidate.Y1))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        float agentMargin = _config.Agent.Radius * 1.08f;
        foreach (AgentSpawnGroup group in AgentSpawnGroups)
        {
            foreach (Vector2 position in group.Positions)
            {
                if (position.X >= candidate.X1 - agentMargin &&
                    position.X <= candidate.X2 + agentMargin &&
                    position.Y >= candidate.Y1 - agentMargin &&
                    position.Y <= candidate.Y2 + agentMargin)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public bool CircleOverlapsAny(CircleBlockage candidate)
    {
        foreach (Wall wall in Walls)
        {
            if (CircleIntersectsAabb(candidate, wall.X1, wall.Y1, wall.X2, wall.Y2))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        foreach (CircleBlockage other in CircularBlockages)
        {
            float combined = candidate.Radius + other.Radius;
            if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(candidate.Center, other.Center) < combined * combined)
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        foreach (Exit exit in Exits)
        {
            float size = exit.Size;
            if (CircleIntersectsAabb(candidate,
                exit.Position.X - size, exit.Position.Y - size,
                exit.Position.X + size, exit.Position.Y + size))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        float agentMargin = _config.Agent.Radius * 1.08f;
        float exclusion = candidate.Radius + agentMargin;
        float exclusionSquared = exclusion * exclusion;
        foreach (AgentSpawnGroup group in AgentSpawnGroups)
        {
            foreach (Vector2 position in group.Positions)
            {
                if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(position, candidate.Center) < exclusionSquared)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static bool CircleIntersectsAabb(
        CircleBlockage circle, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
    {
        float closestX = Math.Clamp(circle.Center.X, x1, x2);
        float closestY = Math.Clamp(circle.Center.Y, y1, y2);
        Vector2 delta = circle.Center - new Vector2(closestX, closestY);
        return delta.LengthSquared() < circle.Radius * circle.Radius;
    }

    private bool TryBuildSpawnPositions(Vector2 center, int count, out List<Vector2> positions)
    {
        List<Vector2> result = new(count);
        positions = result;
        float radius = _config.Agent.Radius;
        float spacing = Math.Max(2.25f * radius, 0.05f);
        float minimumDistanceSquared = spacing * spacing * 0.94f;
        float minX = BoundaryThickness + radius + 0.05f;
        float maxX = Width - BoundaryThickness - radius - 0.05f;
        float minY = BoundaryThickness + radius + 0.05f;
        float maxY = Height - BoundaryThickness - radius - 0.05f;

        if (maxX <= minX || maxY <= minY)
        {
            return false;
        }

        List<Vector2> existing = GetPlannedAgentPositions();
        int maxRing = Math.Max(8, (int)MathF.Ceiling(Math.Max(Width, Height) / spacing) + 2);

        bool TryCandidate(int dx, int dy)
        {
            Vector2 candidate = center + new Vector2(dx * spacing, dy * spacing);
            if (candidate.X < minX || candidate.X > maxX || candidate.Y < minY || candidate.Y > maxY)
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (IsPointBlocked(candidate, radius * 1.08f))
            {
                return false;
            }

            foreach (Vector2 other in existing)
            {
                if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(candidate, other) < minimumDistanceSquared)
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            foreach (Vector2 other in result)
            {
                if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(candidate, other) < minimumDistanceSquared)
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            result.Add(candidate);
            return true;
        }

        TryCandidate(0, 0);
        for (int ring = 1; ring <= maxRing && result.Count < count; ring++)
        {
            for (int dx = -ring; dx <= ring && result.Count < count; dx++)
            {
                TryCandidate(dx, -ring);
                if (result.Count >= count) break;
                TryCandidate(dx, ring);
            }

            for (int dy = -ring + 1; dy <= ring - 1 && result.Count < count; dy++)
            {
                TryCandidate(-ring, dy);
                if (result.Count >= count) break;
                TryCandidate(ring, dy);
            }
        }

        if (result.Count == count)
        {
            return true;
        }

        result.Clear();
        return false;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>Axis-aligned rectangular wall; X1/Y1 is top-left and X2/Y2 is bottom-right.</summary>
public sealed record Wall(float X1, float Y1, float X2, float Y2)
{
    /// <summary>Return a unit tangent along the longer wall axis.</summary>
    public Vector2 TangentDirection()
    {
        float dx = X2 - X1;
        float dy = Y2 - Y1;
        if (MathF.Abs(dx) < 1e-5f && MathF.Abs(dy) < 1e-5f)
        {
            return Vector2.Zero;
        }

        return MathF.Abs(dx) >= MathF.Abs(dy) ? Vector2.UnitX : Vector2.UnitY;
    }

    /// <summary>Return whether a point lies inside the rectangle.</summary>
    public bool Contains(Vector2 position)
        => X1 <= position.X && position.X <= X2 && Y1 <= position.Y && position.Y <= Y2;

    public Vector2 ClosestPoint(Vector2 position)
        => new(Math.Clamp(position.X, X1, X2), Math.Clamp(position.Y, Y1, Y2));
}
```

## benchmarks/baseline/src/CrowdSim.Core/Persistence/ScenarioDefinition.cs

```csharp
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;

/// <summary>
/// Versioned, configuration-only scenario description. Builder-defined initial spawn positions
/// are scenario configuration and are persisted. Runtime-moved positions, injuries, panic, debris,
/// elapsed time and exited agents are intentionally excluded; those belong to a future snapshot feature.
/// </summary>
public sealed class ScenarioDefinition
{
    public const int CurrentVersion = 2;
    public const float LegacyMetersPerUnit = AgentConfig.HeightMeters / 42f;

    public int Version { get; init; } = CurrentVersion;
    public string Name { get; init; } = "Scenario";
    public int AgentCount { get; init; } = 200;
    public int RandomSeed { get; init; }
    public float RoomWidth { get; init; }
    public float RoomHeight { get; init; }
    public BlastZoneScenario BlastZones { get; init; } = new();
    public BehaviorScenario Behavior { get; init; } = new();
    public List<ExitScenario> Exits { get; init; } = new();
    public List<BlockageScenario> Blockages { get; init; } = new();
    public List<CircleBlockageScenario> CircularBlockages { get; init; } = new();
    public List<BlockageScenario> BlueWalls { get; init; } = new();
    public List<AgentSpawnGroupScenario> AgentSpawnGroups { get; init; } = new();

    /// <summary>Capture the current scenario configuration without runtime agent state.</summary>
    public static ScenarioDefinition Capture(
        Simulation simulation,
        int requestedAgentCount,
        string name)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(simulation);
        AgentConfig agent = simulation.Config.Agent;
        int plannedCount = simulation.Environment.PlannedAgentCount;
        int count = plannedCount > 0
            ? plannedCount
            : simulation.Agents.Count > 0
                ? simulation.Agents.Count
                : Math.Clamp(requestedAgentCount, 0, 5000);

        return new ScenarioDefinition
        {
            Name = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name) ? "Scenario" : name.Trim(),
            AgentCount = count,
            RandomSeed = simulation.RandomSeed,
            RoomWidth = simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters,
            RoomHeight = simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters,
            BlastZones = new BlastZoneScenario
            {
                Kill = agent.HardKillRadius,
                Incapacitation = agent.HeatIncapacityRadius,
                Fallen = agent.FallenRadius,
                Injury = agent.InjuryRadius,
                Panic = agent.HeatRadius,
            },
            Behavior = BehaviorScenario.Capture(agent.Behavior),
            Exits = simulation.Environment.Exits
                .Select(exit => new ExitScenario
                {
                    Name = exit.Name,
                    X = exit.Position.X,
                    Y = exit.Position.Y,
                    Size = exit.Size,
                    Side = exit.Side,
                })
                .ToList(),
            Blockages = simulation.Environment.Blockages
                .Select(wall => new BlockageScenario
                {
                    X1 = wall.X1,
                    Y1 = wall.Y1,
                    X2 = wall.X2,
                    Y2 = wall.Y2,
                })
                .ToList(),
            CircularBlockages = simulation.Environment.CircularBlockages
                .Select(circle => new CircleBlockageScenario
                {
                    CenterX = circle.Center.X,
                    CenterY = circle.Center.Y,
                    Radius = circle.Radius,
                })
                .ToList(),
            BlueWalls = simulation.Environment.BlueWalls
                .Select(wall => new BlockageScenario
                {
                    X1 = wall.X1,
                    Y1 = wall.Y1,
                    X2 = wall.X2,
                    Y2 = wall.Y2,
                })
                .ToList(),
            AgentSpawnGroups = simulation.Environment.AgentSpawnGroups
                .Select(group => new AgentSpawnGroupScenario
                {
                    CenterX = group.Center.X,
                    CenterY = group.Center.Y,
                    Positions = group.Positions
                        .Select(position => new AgentStartScenario
                        {
                            X = position.X,
                            Y = position.Y,
                        })
                        .ToList(),
                })
                .ToList(),
        };
    }

    /// <summary>Create a fresh default config and apply this scenario's configurable radii.</summary>
    public SimulationConfig CreateConfig()
    {
        ValidateBasic();
        SimulationConfig config = SimulationConfig.CreateDefault();
        if (RoomWidth > 0 && RoomHeight > 0 &&
            (RoomWidth != config.World.WidthMeters || RoomHeight != config.World.LengthMeters))
        {
            config.World.ApplySize(RoomWidth, RoomHeight);
        }

        config.Agent.SetBlastZoneRadii(
            BlastZones.Kill,
            BlastZones.Incapacitation,
            BlastZones.Fallen,
            BlastZones.Injury,
            BlastZones.Panic);
        Behavior.Apply(config.Agent.Behavior);
        return config;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Apply saved exits, regular blockages, blue walls and planned spawn groups to a fresh
    /// simulation. Agents are intentionally not spawned; the builder finalises the loaded scenario
    /// so optional edits can occur before deterministic population creation.
    /// </summary>
    public void ApplyLayout(Simulation simulation)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(simulation);
        ValidateAgainst(simulation.Config);

        List<Exit> exits = Exits
            .Select(item => new Exit(
                item.Name,
                new System.Numerics.Vector2(item.X, item.Y),
                item.Size,
                item.Side))
            .ToList();
        List<Wall> blockages = Blockages
            .Select(item => new Wall(item.X1, item.Y1, item.X2, item.Y2))
            .ToList();
        List<CircleBlockage> circularBlockages = CircularBlockages
            .Select(item => new CircleBlockage(
                new System.Numerics.Vector2(item.CenterX, item.CenterY),
                item.Radius))
            .ToList();
        List<Wall> blueWalls = BlueWalls
            .Select(item => new Wall(item.X1, item.Y1, item.X2, item.Y2))
            .ToList();
        List<AgentSpawnGroup> spawnGroups = AgentSpawnGroups
            .Select(group => new AgentSpawnGroup(
                new System.Numerics.Vector2(group.CenterX, group.CenterY),
                group.Positions.Select(position => new System.Numerics.Vector2(position.X, position.Y))))
            .ToList();

        simulation.Environment.ReplaceLayout(exits, blockages, circularBlockages, blueWalls, spawnGroups);
        simulation.BuildWallGrid();
    }

    /// <summary>Convert a version-1 pixel/world-unit scenario into version-2 metric metres.</summary>
    public static ScenarioDefinition UpgradeLegacyV1(ScenarioDefinition legacy)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(legacy);
        if (legacy.Version != 1)
        {
            return legacy;
        }

        const float scale = LegacyMetersPerUnit;
        return new ScenarioDefinition
        {
            Version = CurrentVersion,
            Name = legacy.Name,
            AgentCount = legacy.AgentCount,
            RandomSeed = legacy.RandomSeed,
            RoomWidth = legacy.RoomWidth * scale,
            RoomHeight = legacy.RoomHeight * scale,
            BlastZones = new BlastZoneScenario
            {
                Kill = legacy.BlastZones.Kill * scale,
                Incapacitation = legacy.BlastZones.Incapacitation * scale,
                Fallen = legacy.BlastZones.Fallen * scale,
                Injury = legacy.BlastZones.Injury * scale,
                Panic = legacy.BlastZones.Panic * scale,
            },
            Behavior = legacy.Behavior,
            Exits = legacy.Exits.Select(exit => new ExitScenario
            {
                Name = exit.Name,
                X = exit.X * scale,
                Y = exit.Y * scale,
                Size = exit.Size * scale,
                Side = exit.Side,
            }).ToList(),
            Blockages = legacy.Blockages.Select(wall => new BlockageScenario
            {
                X1 = wall.X1 * scale,
                Y1 = wall.Y1 * scale,
                X2 = wall.X2 * scale,
                Y2 = wall.Y2 * scale,
            }).ToList(),
            CircularBlockages = new List<CircleBlockageScenario>(),
            BlueWalls = legacy.BlueWalls.Select(wall => new BlockageScenario
            {
                X1 = wall.X1 * scale,
                Y1 = wall.Y1 * scale,
                X2 = wall.X2 * scale,
                Y2 = wall.Y2 * scale,
            }).ToList(),
            AgentSpawnGroups = legacy.AgentSpawnGroups.Select(group => new AgentSpawnGroupScenario
            {
                CenterX = group.CenterX * scale,
                CenterY = group.CenterY * scale,
                Positions = group.Positions.Select(position => new AgentStartScenario
                {
                    X = position.X * scale,
                    Y = position.Y * scale,
                }).ToList(),
            }).ToList(),
        };
    }

    public void ValidateBasic()
    {
        if (Version != CurrentVersion)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                $"Unsupported scenario version {Version}. Expected {CurrentVersion}.");
        }

        if (AgentCount is < 0 or > 5000)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario AgentCount must be between 0 and 5000.");
        }

        if (BlastZones is null || Behavior is null || Exits is null || Blockages is null ||
            CircularBlockages is null || BlueWalls is null || AgentSpawnGroups is null)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario is missing required configuration sections.");
        }

        int plannedCount = 0;
        foreach (AgentSpawnGroupScenario? group in AgentSpawnGroups)
        {
            if (group?.Positions is null)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid agent-spawn group.");
            }

            plannedCount += group.Positions.Count;
            if (plannedCount > 5000)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains more than 5000 planned agents.");
            }
        }

        Behavior.Validate();

        float[] radii =
        {
            BlastZones.Kill,
            BlastZones.Incapacitation,
            BlastZones.Fallen,
            BlastZones.Injury,
            BlastZones.Panic,
        };
        if (radii.Any(value => !float.IsFinite(value) || value <= 0f))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Blast-zone radii must be finite positive values.");
        }

        if (!(BlastZones.Kill < BlastZones.Incapacitation &&
              BlastZones.Incapacitation < BlastZones.Fallen &&
              BlastZones.Fallen < BlastZones.Injury &&
              BlastZones.Injury < BlastZones.Panic))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                "Blast-zone radii must be strictly ordered: Kill < Incapacitation < Fallen < Injury < Panic.");
        }
    }

    private void ValidateAgainst(SimulationConfig config)
    {
        ValidateBasic();
        if ((RoomWidth > 0 && RoomWidth != config.World.WidthMeters) ||
            (RoomHeight > 0 && RoomHeight != config.World.LengthMeters))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario room dimensions do not match the loaded configuration.");
        }

        foreach (ExitScenario exit in Exits)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(exit.Name) || exit.Size <= 0 ||
                exit.Side is not ("N" or "S" or "E" or "W") ||
                !float.IsFinite(exit.X) || !float.IsFinite(exit.Y))
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid exit definition.");
            }
        }

        foreach (BlockageScenario wall in Blockages)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(wall.X1) || !float.IsFinite(wall.Y1) ||
                !float.IsFinite(wall.X2) || !float.IsFinite(wall.Y2) ||
                wall.X2 <= wall.X1 || wall.Y2 <= wall.Y1)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid blockage definition.");
            }
        }

        foreach (CircleBlockageScenario circle in CircularBlockages)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(circle.CenterX) || !float.IsFinite(circle.CenterY) ||
                !float.IsFinite(circle.Radius) || circle.Radius <= 0f ||
                circle.CenterX - circle.Radius < 0f ||
                circle.CenterY - circle.Radius < 0f ||
                circle.CenterX + circle.Radius > config.World.WidthMeters ||
                circle.CenterY + circle.Radius > config.World.LengthMeters)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid circular blockage definition.");
            }
        }

        foreach (BlockageScenario wall in BlueWalls)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(wall.X1) || !float.IsFinite(wall.Y1) ||
                !float.IsFinite(wall.X2) || !float.IsFinite(wall.Y2) ||
                wall.X2 <= wall.X1 || wall.Y2 <= wall.Y1)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid blue-wall definition.");
            }
        }

        foreach (AgentSpawnGroupScenario group in AgentSpawnGroups)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(group.CenterX) || !float.IsFinite(group.CenterY) || group.Positions is null)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid agent-spawn group.");
            }

            foreach (AgentStartScenario position in group.Positions)
            {
                if (!float.IsFinite(position.X) || !float.IsFinite(position.Y) ||
                    position.X < 0f || position.X > config.World.WidthMeters ||
                    position.Y < 0f || position.Y > config.World.LengthMeters)
                {
                    throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid planned agent position.");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

public sealed class BlastZoneScenario
{
    public float Kill { get; init; } = AgentConfig.DefaultHardKillRadius;
    public float Incapacitation { get; init; } = AgentConfig.DefaultHeatIncapacityRadius;
    public float Fallen { get; init; } = AgentConfig.DefaultFallenRadius;
    public float Injury { get; init; } = AgentConfig.DefaultInjuryRadius;
    public float Panic { get; init; } = AgentConfig.DefaultHeatRadius;
}

public sealed class BehaviorScenario
{
    public float TraitVariation { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultTraitVariation;
    public float ReactionVariation { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultReactionVariation;
    public float StressSusceptibility { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultStressSusceptibility;
    public float StressPersistence { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultStressPersistence;
    public float CrowdFollowing { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultCrowdFollowing;
    public float PersonalSpace { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultPersonalSpace;
    public float PanicSpaceCompression { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultPanicSpaceCompression;
    public float EmergencyUrgency { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultEmergencyUrgency;
    public float HelpingTendency { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultHelpingTendency;
    public float RouteFamiliarity { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultRouteFamiliarity;
    public float BottleneckAssertiveness { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultBottleneckAssertiveness;
    public float BottleneckPressureSensitivity { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultBottleneckPressureSensitivity;
    public float BottleneckSpaceCompression { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultBottleneckSpaceCompression;

    public static BehaviorScenario Capture(BehaviorTuningConfig tuning)
        => new()
        {
            TraitVariation = tuning.TraitVariation,
            ReactionVariation = tuning.ReactionVariation,
            StressSusceptibility = tuning.StressSusceptibility,
            StressPersistence = tuning.StressPersistence,
            CrowdFollowing = tuning.CrowdFollowing,
            PersonalSpace = tuning.PersonalSpace,
            PanicSpaceCompression = tuning.PanicSpaceCompression,
            EmergencyUrgency = tuning.EmergencyUrgency,
            HelpingTendency = tuning.HelpingTendency,
            RouteFamiliarity = tuning.RouteFamiliarity,
            BottleneckAssertiveness = tuning.BottleneckAssertiveness,
            BottleneckPressureSensitivity = tuning.BottleneckPressureSensitivity,
            BottleneckSpaceCompression = tuning.BottleneckSpaceCompression,
        };

    public void Apply(BehaviorTuningConfig tuning)
    {
        Validate();
        tuning.SetValues(
            TraitVariation, ReactionVariation, StressSusceptibility, StressPersistence,
            CrowdFollowing, PersonalSpace, PanicSpaceCompression, EmergencyUrgency,
            HelpingTendency, RouteFamiliarity, BottleneckAssertiveness,
            BottleneckPressureSensitivity, BottleneckSpaceCompression);
    }

    public void Validate()
    {
        float[] values =
        {
            TraitVariation, ReactionVariation, StressSusceptibility, StressPersistence,
            CrowdFollowing, PersonalSpace, PanicSpaceCompression, EmergencyUrgency,
            HelpingTendency, RouteFamiliarity, BottleneckAssertiveness,
            BottleneckPressureSensitivity, BottleneckSpaceCompression,
        };
        if (values.Any(value => !float.IsFinite(value)) ||
            TraitVariation is < 0f or > 1f ||
            ReactionVariation is < 0f or > 1f ||
            StressSusceptibility is < 0.60f or > 1.40f ||
            StressPersistence is < 0.50f or > 2.00f ||
            CrowdFollowing is < 0f or > 1f ||
            PersonalSpace is < 0.85f or > 1.30f ||
            PanicSpaceCompression is < 0f or > 0.35f ||
            EmergencyUrgency is < 0.80f or > 1.30f ||
            HelpingTendency is < 0f or > 1f ||
            RouteFamiliarity is < 0f or > 1f ||
            BottleneckAssertiveness is < 0f or > 1f ||
            BottleneckPressureSensitivity is < 0.50f or > 1.50f ||
            BottleneckSpaceCompression is < 0f or > 0.35f)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains invalid behaviour tuning values.");
        }
    }
}

public sealed class ExitScenario
{
    public string Name { get; init; } = string.Empty;
    public float X { get; init; }
    public float Y { get; init; }
    public float Size { get; init; }
    public string Side { get; init; } = "N";
}

public sealed class BlockageScenario
{
    public float X1 { get; init; }
    public float Y1 { get; init; }
    public float X2 { get; init; }
    public float Y2 { get; init; }
}

public sealed class CircleBlockageScenario
{
    public float CenterX { get; init; }
    public float CenterY { get; init; }
    public float Radius { get; init; } = 1.25f;
}

public sealed class AgentSpawnGroupScenario
{
    public float CenterX { get; init; }
    public float CenterY { get; init; }
    public List<AgentStartScenario> Positions { get; init; } = new();
}

public sealed class AgentStartScenario
{
    public float X { get; init; }
    public float Y { get; init; }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;

/// <summary>JSON file persistence for configuration-only scenario definitions.</summary>
public static class ScenarioFileStore
{
    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions JsonOptions = new()
    {
        WriteIndented = true,
        PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase,
        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
        NumberHandling = JsonNumberHandling.Strict,
    };

    public static string DefaultDirectory => Path.Combine(System.Environment.CurrentDirectory, "scenarios");

    public static IReadOnlyList<string> ListScenarioNames(string? directory = null)
    {
        string targetDirectory = directory ?? DefaultDirectory;
        if (!Directory.Exists(targetDirectory))
        {
            return Array.Empty<string>();
        }

        return Directory.EnumerateFiles(targetDirectory, "*.json", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
            .Select(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension)
            .Where(name => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
            .Select(name => name!)
            .OrderBy(name => name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToArray();
    }

    public static string Save(
        ScenarioDefinition scenario,
        string? directory = null)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(scenario);
        scenario.ValidateBasic();

        string targetDirectory = directory ?? DefaultDirectory;
        Directory.CreateDirectory(targetDirectory);
        string safeName = SanitizeName(scenario.Name);
        string path = Path.Combine(targetDirectory, safeName + ".json");
        string json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(scenario, JsonOptions);
        File.WriteAllText(path, json);
        return path;
    }

    public static ScenarioDefinition Load(
        string scenarioName,
        string? directory = null)
    {
        string targetDirectory = directory ?? DefaultDirectory;
        string safeName = SanitizeName(scenarioName);
        string path = Path.Combine(targetDirectory, safeName + ".json");
        if (!File.Exists(path))
        {
            throw new FileNotFoundException($"Scenario '{safeName}' was not found.", path);
        }

        string json = File.ReadAllText(path);
        ScenarioDefinition? scenario = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ScenarioDefinition>(json, JsonOptions);
        if (scenario is null)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario JSON did not contain a valid scenario object.");
        }

        if (scenario.Version == 1)
        {
            scenario = ScenarioDefinition.UpgradeLegacyV1(scenario);
        }

        scenario.ValidateBasic();
        return scenario;
    }

    public static string SanitizeName(string? name)
    {
        string candidate = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name) ? "scenario" : name.Trim();
        char[] invalid = Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars();
        string safe = new(candidate.Select(character => invalid.Contains(character) ? '_' : character).ToArray());
        safe = safe.Replace(' ', '_');
        while (safe.Contains("__", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            safe = safe.Replace("__", "_", StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }

        safe = safe.Trim('_', '.');
        return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(safe) ? "scenario" : safe;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;

namespace CrowdSim.Core;

public sealed partial class Simulation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Hard collision resolution against walls/blockages and crawling/fallen casualties.
    /// Includes the validated wall-follow, reversal, cooldown, post-blast release and
    /// guaranteed-escape guardrails.
    /// </summary>
    public void ResolveSolidCollisions(Agent agent)
    {
        if (agent.State is AgentState.Fallen or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.Exited or
            AgentState.TempIncap or AgentState.Dead)
        {
            return;
        }

        // Guard before any spatial-hash lookup so NaN/Infinity never participates in
        // float-to-cell conversion. This is equivalent to the source's recovery intent
        // but applies it at the safest possible boundary.
        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(agent.Position))
        {
            agent.Position = new Vector2(Config.World.WidthMeters / 2f, Config.World.LengthMeters / 2f);
        }

        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(agent.Velocity))
        {
            agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }

        float radius = Config.Agent.Radius;
        float casualtyRadius = Config.Agent.Radius * 1.25f;
        float speed = agent.Velocity.Length();

        CollectNearbyWalls(
            agent.Position,
            Config.Agent.Radius * 1.2f,
            _nearbyWallScratch,
            _nearbyWallSeenScratch);
        bool isTouchingWall = false;
        foreach (Wall wall in _nearbyWallScratch)
        {
            if (wall.X1 - Config.Agent.Radius <= agent.Position.X &&
                agent.Position.X <= wall.X2 + Config.Agent.Radius &&
                wall.Y1 - Config.Agent.Radius <= agent.Position.Y &&
                agent.Position.Y <= wall.Y2 + Config.Agent.Radius)
            {
                isTouchingWall = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!isTouchingWall)
        {
            isTouchingWall = IsNearCircularBlockage(agent.Position, Config.Agent.Radius);
        }

        if (speed < 0.05f * agent.BaseSpeed && agent.WallFollowDir is null && !isTouchingWall)
        {
            return;
        }

        const int maxIterations = 8;
        for (int iteration = 0; iteration < maxIterations; iteration++)
        {
            bool moved = false;
            CollectNearbyWalls(
                agent.Position,
                agent.WallFollowDir is not null ? WallFollowRadius : InteractionRadius,
                _nearbyWallScratch,
                _nearbyWallSeenScratch);

            foreach (Wall wall in _nearbyWallScratch)
            {
                if (!(wall.X1 - radius <= agent.Position.X && agent.Position.X <= wall.X2 + radius &&
                      wall.Y1 - radius <= agent.Position.Y && agent.Position.Y <= wall.Y2 + radius))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float dxLeft = wall.X1 - (agent.Position.X - radius);
                float dxRight = (agent.Position.X + radius) - wall.X2;
                float dyTop = wall.Y1 - (agent.Position.Y - radius);
                float dyBottom = (agent.Position.Y + radius) - wall.Y2;

                Vector2 correction = new(-dxLeft, 0f);
                float correctionLengthSquared = correction.LengthSquared();
                Vector2 candidateCorrection = new(dxRight, 0f);
                float candidateLengthSquared = candidateCorrection.LengthSquared();
                if (candidateLengthSquared < correctionLengthSquared)
                {
                    correction = candidateCorrection;
                    correctionLengthSquared = candidateLengthSquared;
                }

                candidateCorrection = new Vector2(0f, -dyTop);
                candidateLengthSquared = candidateCorrection.LengthSquared();
                if (candidateLengthSquared < correctionLengthSquared)
                {
                    correction = candidateCorrection;
                    correctionLengthSquared = candidateLengthSquared;
                }

                candidateCorrection = new Vector2(0f, dyBottom);
                candidateLengthSquared = candidateCorrection.LengthSquared();
                if (candidateLengthSquared < correctionLengthSquared)
                {
                    correction = candidateCorrection;
                }
                float correctionLength = correction.Length();
                if (correctionLength <= 0f || !float.IsFinite(correctionLength))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                agent.Position += correction;
                moved = true;

                Vector2 normal = correction / (correctionLength + 1e-6f);
                float normalVelocity = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, normal);
                if (normalVelocity < 0f)
                {
                    agent.Velocity -= normalVelocity * normal;
                }

                Vector2 tangent = VectorMath.Perpendicular(normal);

                // Finite-blockage termination.
                if (agent.ExitTarget is not null)
                {
                    bool isBlockage =
                        wall.X2 - wall.X1 < 0.9f * Environment.Width &&
                        wall.Y2 - wall.Y1 < 0.9f * Environment.Height;

                    if (isBlockage && agent.WallFollowTangent is not null)
                    {
                        Vector2 toExit = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget.Position - agent.Position);
                        Vector2 followTangent = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.WallFollowTangent.Value);
                        float progress = Vector2.Dot(followTangent, toExit);
                        if (progress < 0.1f)
                        {
                            DetachFromWallFollow(agent);
                            agent.Velocity += toExit * (0.6f * agent.BaseSpeed);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                speed = agent.Velocity.Length();
                bool changedNormal = agent.WallFollowNormal is null ||
                    Vector2.Dot(normal, agent.WallFollowNormal.Value) < 0.95f;

                bool allowLegacyWallFollow =
                    agent.State == AgentState.Wandering || agent.Exploring;
                if (allowLegacyWallFollow &&
                    (normalVelocity < -0.006f || speed < 0.25f * agent.BaseSpeed) &&
                    FrameIndex >= agent.WallFollowCooldownUntil &&
                    changedNormal &&
                    agent.WallFollowUntil < FrameIndex)
                {
                    if (agent.ExitTarget is not null)
                    {
                        Vector2 left = VectorMath.Perpendicular(normal);
                        Vector2 right = -left;
                        const float probeDistance = 0.81f;
                        Vector2 leftProbe = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(
                            agent.Position + left * probeDistance,
                            Config.World.WidthMeters,
                            Config.World.LengthMeters);
                        Vector2 rightProbe = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(
                            agent.Position + right * probeDistance,
                            Config.World.WidthMeters,
                            Config.World.LengthMeters);
                        float leftDistance = Vector2.Distance(leftProbe, agent.ExitTarget.Position);
                        float rightDistance = Vector2.Distance(rightProbe, agent.ExitTarget.Position);
                        agent.WallFollowDir = leftDistance < rightDistance ? 1 : -1;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        agent.WallFollowDir = Random.NextDouble() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
                    }

                    agent.WallFollowUntil = FrameIndex + 9999;
                    agent.WallFollowNormal = normal;
                    agent.WallFollowTangent = tangent;
                    agent.WallFollowDistance = 0f;
                    agent.WallFollowReversed = false;
                    agent.WallFollowStartFrame = FrameIndex;
                }

                if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null && agent.WallFollowUntil > FrameIndex)
                {
                    agent.Position += agent.WallFollowDir.Value * tangent * 0.01f;
                }
            }

            foreach (CircleBlockage circle in Environment.CircularBlockages)
            {
                Vector2 offset = agent.Position - circle.Center;
                float distance = offset.Length();
                float minimumDistance = circle.Radius + radius;
                if (!float.IsFinite(distance) || distance >= minimumDistance)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                Vector2 normal = distance > 1e-6f ? offset / distance : Vector2.UnitX;
                float penetration = minimumDistance - Math.Max(0f, distance);
                agent.Position += normal * (penetration + 0.001f);
                moved = true;

                float inwardVelocity = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, normal);
                if (inwardVelocity < 0f)
                {
                    agent.Velocity -= inwardVelocity * normal;
                }
            }

            CollectNearbyAgents(agent, CollisionRadius, _collisionAgentScratch);
            foreach (Agent other in _collisionAgentScratch)
            {
                if (!other.IsCasualtyObstacle)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (agent.TimeStuck > 2.5f)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                Vector2 difference = agent.Position - other.Position;
                if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(difference))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float distance = difference.Length();
                if (!float.IsFinite(distance) || distance < 1e-6f)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float minSeparation = radius + casualtyRadius;
                if (distance >= minSeparation)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                Vector2 push = difference / distance * (minSeparation - distance);
                agent.Position += push;
                moved = true;

                Vector2 normal = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(push);
                float normalVelocity = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, normal);
                if (normalVelocity < 0f)
                {
                    agent.Velocity -= normalVelocity * normal;
                }

                if (agent.WallFollowUntil > FrameIndex)
                {
                    float inward = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, normal);
                    if (inward < 0f)
                    {
                        agent.Velocity -= inward * normal;
                    }
                }

                float yieldFactor = 0.85f;
                if (agent.ExitTarget is not null && other.ExitTarget is not null)
                {
                    Vector2 toExit = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget.Position - agent.Position);
                    if (toExit.LengthSquared() > 0f)
                    {
                        float agentAlignment = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, toExit);
                        float otherAlignment = Vector2.Dot(other.Velocity, toExit);
                        if (agentAlignment > otherAlignment + 0.05f)
                        {
                            yieldFactor = 0.95f;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (agent.ExitTarget is not null)
                {
                    Vector2 toExit = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget.Position - agent.Position);
                    float alignment = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, toExit);
                    if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null && alignment > 0.3f)
                    {
                        yieldFactor = Math.Max(yieldFactor, 0.95f);
                    }
                }

                agent.Velocity *= yieldFactor;
            }

            if (!moved)
            {
                break;
            }

            if (agent.WallFollowUntil > FrameIndex && agent.WallFollowDir is not null)
            {
                // Commit-phase fast path.
                if (agent.WallFollowDistance < 6.48f)
                {
                    if (agent.WallFollowTangent is null)
                    {
                        break;
                    }

                    Vector2 tangent = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.WallFollowTangent.Value);
                    float tangentialVelocity = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, tangent);
                    agent.Velocity = tangentialVelocity * tangent;
                    continue;
                }

                if (agent.WallFollowTangent is null)
                {
                    break;
                }

                Vector2 wallTangent = agent.WallFollowTangent.Value;
                int stuckTime = FrameIndex - agent.WallFollowStartFrame;
                float exitDistance = agent.ExitTarget is not null
                    ? Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, agent.ExitTarget.Position)
                    : float.PositiveInfinity;
                float exitClearDistance = 4f * Config.Agent.Radius;
                float tangentialSpeed = MathF.Abs(Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, wallTangent));
                const float edgeCommitBonus = 0.6f;
                int delay = (int)(1.5f / Config.Agent.Dt * edgeCommitBonus);
                int rampTime = Math.Max(1, (int)(4f / Config.Agent.Dt * edgeCommitBonus));

                if (stuckTime > delay && exitDistance > exitClearDistance &&
                    tangentialSpeed > 0.15f * agent.BaseSpeed)
                {
                    float factor = Math.Min(1f, stuckTime / (float)rampTime);
                    float jitter = ((float)Random.NextDouble() - 0.5f) * 0.4f * factor * agent.BaseSpeed;
                    agent.Velocity += jitter * agent.WallFollowDir.Value * wallTangent;
                }

                if (agent.ExitTarget is not null && agent.WallFollowDir is not null)
                {
                    CollectNearbyWalls(
                        agent.Position,
                        WallFollowRadius,
                        _nearbyWallScratch,
                        _nearbyWallSeenScratch);
                    if (FrameIndex - agent.LosLastCheckFrame >= Math.Max(1, (int)(0.5f / Config.Agent.Dt)))
                    {
                        agent.LosCached = EvacuationSystem.HasLineOfSight(
                            agent.Position,
                            agent.ExitTarget.Position,
                            _nearbyWallScratch);
                        agent.LosLastCheckFrame = FrameIndex;
                    }

                    if (agent.LosCached)
                    {
                        Vector2? previousNormal = agent.WallFollowNormal;
                        DetachFromWallFollow(agent);
                        if (previousNormal is not null)
                        {
                            agent.Position += previousNormal.Value * (1.2f * Config.Agent.Radius);
                            agent.Position = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(
                                agent.Position,
                                Config.World.WidthMeters,
                                Config.World.LengthMeters);
                        }

                        return;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Post-blast wall-follow decay.
        if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null &&
            (agent.State is AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured) &&
            BlastOver() &&
            agent.Velocity.Length() < 0.15f * agent.BaseSpeed)
        {
            DetachFromWallFollow(agent);
            if (agent.ExitTarget is not null)
            {
                agent.Velocity = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget.Position - agent.Position) *
                    (0.8f * agent.BaseSpeed);
            }
        }

        // Hard failsafe: guaranteed release after six simulated seconds.
        int maxWallFollowFrames = Math.Max(1, (int)(6f / Config.Agent.Dt));
        if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null &&
            (agent.State is AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured) &&
            FrameIndex - agent.WallFollowStartFrame > maxWallFollowFrames)
        {
            DetachFromWallFollow(agent);
            if (agent.ExitTarget is not null)
            {
                agent.Velocity = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget.Position - agent.Position) *
                    (0.9f * agent.BaseSpeed);
            }

            agent.WallFollowCooldownUntil = FrameIndex + (int)(20f / Config.Agent.Dt);
        }

        if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null && agent.ExitTarget is not null)
        {
            float exitDistance = Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, agent.ExitTarget.Position);
            if (!float.IsFinite(agent.LastExitDist))
            {
                agent.LastExitDist = exitDistance;
            }

            if (exitDistance < agent.LastExitDist - 0.08f)
            {
                agent.LastExitDist = exitDistance;
            }
            else if (exitDistance > agent.LastExitDist + 0.24f &&
                     FrameIndex - agent.WallFollowStartFrame > (int)(2f / Config.Agent.Dt))
            {
                DetachFromWallFollow(agent);
                agent.LastExitDist = float.PositiveInfinity;
                agent.WallFollowCooldownUntil = FrameIndex + (int)(10f / Config.Agent.Dt);
            }

            if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null)
            {
                float commitDistance = 8.10f * (1f + 0.8f * agent.PanicLevel);
                int maxTimeFrames = Math.Max(1, (int)(3f / Config.Agent.Dt));
                int timeElapsed = FrameIndex - agent.WallFollowStartFrame;
                if (agent.WallFollowDistance >= commitDistance || timeElapsed >= maxTimeFrames)
                {
                    if (!agent.WallFollowReversed)
                    {
                        agent.WallFollowDir *= -1;
                        agent.WallFollowDistance = 0f;
                        agent.WallFollowReversed = true;
                        agent.WallFollowStartFrame = FrameIndex;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        DetachFromWallFollow(agent);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(agent.Position))
        {
            agent.Position = new Vector2(Config.World.WidthMeters / 2f, Config.World.LengthMeters / 2f);
        }

        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(agent.Velocity))
        {
            agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }

        if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null && agent.WallFollowUntil > FrameIndex &&
            agent.WallFollowNormal is not null && agent.WallFollowTangent is not null)
        {
            Vector2 tangent = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.WallFollowTangent.Value);
            float tangentialVelocity = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, tangent);
            agent.Velocity = tangentialVelocity * tangent;
        }

        // Collision energy dissipation.
        if (agent.Velocity.Length() > VectorMath.Epsilon)
        {
            agent.Velocity *= 0.75f;
        }

        if (agent.WallFollowDir is null)
        {
            agent.WallFollowNormal = null;
            agent.WallFollowTangent = null;
            agent.LastExitDist = float.PositiveInfinity;
            agent.WallFollowCooldownUntil = FrameIndex + (int)(10f / Config.Agent.Dt);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Move one agent with sub-step tunnelling protection and final blockage containment.</summary>
    public void MoveAgent(Agent agent)
    {
        Vector2 newPosition = agent.Position + agent.Velocity;
        float speed = agent.Velocity.Length();
        CollectNearbyWalls(
            agent.Position,
            Config.Agent.Radius * 2f,
            _nearbyWallScratch,
            _nearbyWallSeenScratch);
        bool nearStaticObstacle = _nearbyWallScratch.Count > 0 ||
            IsNearCircularBlockage(agent.Position, Config.Agent.Radius * 2f);
        int substeps = nearStaticObstacle && speed > 0f ? 2 : 1;

        if (substeps > 1)
        {
            Vector2 stepVelocity = agent.Velocity / substeps;
            for (int step = 0; step < substeps; step++)
            {
                Vector2 oldPosition = agent.Position;
                newPosition = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(
                    agent.Position + stepVelocity,
                    Config.World.WidthMeters,
                    Config.World.LengthMeters);
                if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null)
                {
                    agent.WallFollowDistance += Vector2.Distance(oldPosition, newPosition);
                }

                agent.Position = newPosition;
                ResolveSolidCollisions(agent);
            }

            StopExplorationIfGoalReached(agent);
            FinalBlockageContainment(agent);
            return;
        }

        newPosition = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(newPosition, Config.World.WidthMeters, Config.World.LengthMeters);
        if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null)
        {
            agent.WallFollowDistance += Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, newPosition);
        }

        agent.Position = newPosition;
        StopExplorationIfGoalReached(agent);

        speed = agent.Velocity.Length();
        bool needsPreciseCollision = agent.WallFollowDir is not null;
        if (!needsPreciseCollision)
        {
            CollectNearbyWalls(
                agent.Position,
                Config.Agent.Radius * 1.5f,
                _nearbyWallScratch,
                _nearbyWallSeenScratch);
            if (_nearbyWallScratch.Count > 0 ||
                IsNearCircularBlockage(agent.Position, Config.Agent.Radius * 1.5f))
            {
                needsPreciseCollision = true;
            }
            else
            {
                CollectNearbyAgents(agent, CollisionRadius, _collisionAgentScratch);
                foreach (Agent other in _collisionAgentScratch)
                {
                    if (other.IsCasualtyObstacle)
                    {
                        needsPreciseCollision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (needsPreciseCollision)
        {
            ResolveSolidCollisions(agent);
        }
        else if (speed > 0.35f * agent.BaseSpeed && FrameIndex % 2 == 0)
        {
            ResolveSolidCollisions(agent);
        }

        FinalBlockageContainment(agent);
    }

    private void StopExplorationIfGoalReached(Agent agent)
    {
        if (agent.Exploring && agent.TempGoal is not null &&
            Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, agent.TempGoal.Value) < 0.20f)
        {
            agent.Exploring = false;
            agent.TempGoal = null;
            agent.ExplorationReplanAfterFrame = 0;
        }
    }

    private void FinalBlockageContainment(Agent agent)
    {
        float radius = Config.Agent.Radius;
        foreach (Wall wall in Environment.Walls)
        {
            bool isBlockage =
                wall.X2 - wall.X1 < 0.9f * Environment.Width &&
                wall.Y2 - wall.Y1 < 0.9f * Environment.Height;
            if (!isBlockage)
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (!(wall.X1 - radius < agent.Position.X && agent.Position.X < wall.X2 + radius &&
                  wall.Y1 - radius < agent.Position.Y && agent.Position.Y < wall.Y2 + radius))
            {
                continue;
            }

            float leftDistance = MathF.Abs(agent.Position.X - (wall.X1 - radius));
            float rightDistance = MathF.Abs(agent.Position.X - (wall.X2 + radius));
            float topDistance = MathF.Abs(agent.Position.Y - (wall.Y1 - radius));
            float bottomDistance = MathF.Abs(agent.Position.Y - (wall.Y2 + radius));
            float dx = Math.Min(leftDistance, rightDistance);
            float dy = Math.Min(topDistance, bottomDistance);

            if (dx < dy)
            {
                float x = agent.Position.X < (wall.X1 + wall.X2) * 0.5f
                    ? wall.X1 - radius
                    : wall.X2 + radius;
                agent.Position = new Vector2(x, agent.Position.Y);
                agent.Velocity = new Vector2(0f, agent.Velocity.Y);
            }
            else
            {
                float y = agent.Position.Y < (wall.Y1 + wall.Y2) * 0.5f
                    ? wall.Y1 - radius
                    : wall.Y2 + radius;
                agent.Position = new Vector2(agent.Position.X, y);
                agent.Velocity = new Vector2(agent.Velocity.X, 0f);
            }
        }

        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in Environment.CircularBlockages)
        {
            Vector2 offset = agent.Position - circle.Center;
            float distance = offset.Length();
            float minimumDistance = circle.Radius + radius;
            if (!float.IsFinite(distance) || distance >= minimumDistance)
            {
                continue;
            }

            Vector2 normal = distance > 1e-6f ? offset / distance : Vector2.UnitX;
            agent.Position = circle.Center + normal * (minimumDistance + 0.001f);
            float inwardVelocity = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, normal);
            if (inwardVelocity < 0f)
            {
                agent.Velocity -= inwardVelocity * normal;
            }
        }
    }

    private bool IsNearCircularBlockage(Vector2 position, float margin)
    {
        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in Environment.CircularBlockages)
        {
            float reach = circle.Radius + Math.Max(0f, margin);
            if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(position, circle.Center) <= reach * reach)
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private void DetachFromWallFollow(Agent agent)
    {
        agent.WallFollowDir = null;
        agent.WallFollowUntil = FrameIndex;
        agent.WallFollowNormal = null;
        agent.WallFollowTangent = null;
    }
}
```
