```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Systems;

/// <summary>
/// Abstract event-effects subsystem: wall-aware propagating shock front, ordered casualty outcomes,
/// bounded knockback/stun, blast wind and lightweight outward-moving debris. The model intentionally
/// avoids real explosive-yield or fragmentation calculations; it uses normalized simulation severity.
/// </summary>
public sealed class ExplosionSystem
{
    private readonly AgentConfig _config;
    private readonly List<Agent> _debrisAgentScratch = new(64);
    private readonly List<Debris> _debrisSurvivorScratch = new(64);

    public ExplosionSystem(AgentConfig config)
    {
        _config = config;
    }

    /// <summary>Return whether any solid wall rectangle blocks the segment from start to end.</summary>
    public static bool BlastPathIsBlocked(Vector2 start, Vector2 end, IReadOnlyList<Wall> walls)
    {
        float startX = start.X;
        float startY = start.Y;
        float deltaX = end.X - startX;
        float deltaY = end.Y - startY;

        foreach (Wall wall in walls)
        {
            float minimumX = Math.Min(wall.X1, wall.X2);
            float maximumX = Math.Max(wall.X1, wall.X2);
            float minimumY = Math.Min(wall.Y1, wall.Y2);
            float maximumY = Math.Max(wall.Y1, wall.Y2);

            float nearTime = 0f;
            float farTime = 1f;
            bool intersects =
                ClipAxis(startX, deltaX, minimumX, maximumX, ref nearTime, ref farTime) &&
                ClipAxis(startY, deltaY, minimumY, maximumY, ref nearTime, ref farTime);

            if (intersects)
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public void TriggerExplosion(Simulation simulation, float x, float y)
    {
        if (!simulation.Running || simulation.Environment.HasExplosion())
        {
            return;
        }

        simulation.Environment.SetExplosion(x, y, simulation.FrameIndex);
        simulation.ExplosionTriggerFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
        Vector2 explosionPosition = simulation.Environment.Explosion!.Position;

        simulation.DebrisHits = 0;
        simulation.DebrisInjuries = 0;
        simulation.DebrisIncapacitations = 0;
        simulation.DebrisFatalities = 0;
        simulation.Debris.Clear();
        simulation.Debris.AddRange(Debris.SpawnCluster(
            explosionPosition,
            count: _config.DebrisCount,
            speedMin: _config.DebrisSpeedMin,
            speedMax: _config.DebrisSpeedMax,
            ttlMin: 25,
            ttlMax: 70,
            radius: 0.24f,
            simulation.Random));

        // Initialise per-agent shock state. Startle/panic is not applied globally here: direct
        // event response begins when the propagating front reaches the agent. Social/running-crowd
        // contagion can still cause an earlier reaction if the agent observes others first.
        foreach (Agent agent in simulation.Agents)
        {
            agent.ShockwaveHit = false;
            agent.ShockwaveHitFrame = -1;
            agent.BlastShielded = !simulation.HasLineOfSight(
                explosionPosition,
                agent.Position);
        }
    }

    public void ApplyExplosionEffects(Simulation simulation)
    {
        Explosion? explosion = simulation.Environment.Explosion;
        if (explosion is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        int t = simulation.FrameIndex - explosion.TriggeredFrame;
        if (t < 0 || t > _config.BlastWindDurationFrames + 5)
        {
            return;
        }

        float shockRadius = Math.Min(
            _config.HeatRadius,
            _config.ShockwaveSpeedMetersPerFrame * t);

        const float knockMaxMeters = 0.61f;
        const float knockMinMeters = 0.16f;
        float knockDecay = Math.Max(0.04f, 0.5f * _config.InjuryRadius);
        const int knockSubsteps = 3;
        const int stunMinFrames = 10;
        const int stunMaxFrames = 15;

        foreach (Agent agent in simulation.Agents)
        {
            if (!agent.IsActive || agent.State == AgentState.Dead)
            {
                continue;
            }

            Vector2 offset = agent.Position - explosion.Position;
            if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(offset))
            {
                continue;
            }

            float distance = offset.Length();
            if (!float.IsFinite(distance) || distance > _config.HeatRadius)
            {
                continue;
            }

            // Re-evaluate shielding against the agent's current position. An agent that reaches
            // cover before the front arrives should be protected; one that leaves cover can become exposed.
            agent.BlastShielded = !simulation.HasLineOfSight(
                explosion.Position,
                agent.Position);
            if (agent.BlastShielded)
            {
                continue;
            }

            Vector2 direction = distance < VectorMath.Epsilon
                ? VectorMath.RandomUnit(simulation.Random)
                : offset / distance;

            // Casualty and knockback effects are triggered once, when the visible/physical shock
            // front reaches the agent. This keeps simulation timing consistent with the renderer.
            if (!agent.ShockwaveHit && distance <= shockRadius)
            {
                ApplyOrderedShockOutcome(simulation, agent, distance);

                if (agent.State is not (AgentState.Dead or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.TempIncap or AgentState.Fallen))
                {
                    float impulse = _config.ShockwavePeakImpulse *
                        MathF.Exp(-distance / Math.Max(_config.ShockwaveDecayLength, 1e-5f));
                    agent.Velocity += direction * impulse;

                    if ((agent.State is AgentState.WaitingToReact or AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured) &&
                        distance > _config.FallenRadius)
                    {
                        float rawKnock = knockMaxMeters * MathF.Exp(-distance / Math.Max(knockDecay, 1e-5f));
                        float knockDistance = Math.Clamp(rawKnock, knockMinMeters, knockMaxMeters);
                        float step = knockDistance / knockSubsteps;

                        for (int substep = 0; substep < knockSubsteps; substep++)
                        {
                            agent.Position += direction * step;
                            agent.Position = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(
                                agent.Position,
                                simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters,
                                simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters);
                            simulation.ResolveSolidCollisions(agent);
                        }

                        float severity = Math.Clamp(1f - distance / _config.HeatRadius, 0f, 1f);
                        int stunFrames = (int)(stunMinFrames + severity * (stunMaxFrames - stunMinFrames));
                        agent.FreezeUntilFrame = Math.Max(
                            agent.FreezeUntilFrame,
                            simulation.FrameIndex + stunFrames);
                        agent.StunnedUntilFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + stunFrames;
                    }
                }

                agent.ShockwaveHit = true;
                agent.ShockwaveHitFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;

                // A pedestrian may already be evacuating because they observed the emergency
                // before the physical front reached them. Direct exposure should still be able
                // to produce the short threat-escape intent instead of leaving that earlier
                // social route completely unchanged.
                if (agent.State is AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured)
                {
                    simulation.EvacuationSystem.BeginPurposefulResponse(simulation, agent);
                }
            }

            // Short bounded post-front blast wind. It cannot push terminal casualty states.
            if (t <= _config.BlastWindDurationFrames &&
                distance <= shockRadius &&
                agent.State is not (AgentState.Dead or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.TempIncap or AgentState.Fallen))
            {
                float wind = _config.BlastWindStrength *
                    MathF.Exp(-distance / Math.Max(_config.ShockwaveDecayLength, 1e-5f));
                agent.Velocity += direction * wind;
            }

            if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(agent.Velocity))
            {
                agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            }

            agent.Velocity = VectorMath.ClampMagnitude(agent.Velocity, _config.MaxSpeed);
        }
    }

    public void UpdateDebris(Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (simulation.Debris.Count == 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        _debrisSurvivorScratch.Clear();
        foreach (Debris fragment in simulation.Debris)
        {
            if (!fragment.Advance(simulation.Config.World, _config))
            {
                continue;
            }

            // Swept segment collision prevents fast fragments tunnelling through a thin wall.
            if (!simulation.HasLineOfSight(fragment.PreviousPosition, fragment.Position))
            {
                fragment.Ttl = 0;
                continue;
            }

            Agent? hitAgent = null;
            float hitDistance = float.PositiveInfinity;
            float hitRadius = fragment.Radius + simulation.Config.Agent.Radius;
            Vector2 segmentMidpoint = 0.5f * (fragment.PreviousPosition + fragment.Position);
            float segmentHalfLength = 0.5f * Vector2.Distance(fragment.PreviousPosition, fragment.Position);
            simulation.CollectAgentsNearPoint(
                segmentMidpoint,
                segmentHalfLength + hitRadius,
                _debrisAgentScratch);

            foreach (Agent agent in _debrisAgentScratch)
            {
                if (!agent.IsActive || agent.State == AgentState.Exited || agent.State == AgentState.Dead)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float distance = DistancePointToSegment(agent.Position, fragment.PreviousPosition, fragment.Position);
                if (distance <= hitRadius && distance < hitDistance)
                {
                    hitAgent = agent;
                    hitDistance = distance;
                }
            }

            if (hitAgent is not null)
            {
                ApplyDebrisImpact(simulation, hitAgent, fragment);
                fragment.Ttl = 0; // one fragment cannot damage multiple people/frames
                continue;
            }

            _debrisSurvivorScratch.Add(fragment);
        }

        simulation.Debris.Clear();
        simulation.Debris.AddRange(_debrisSurvivorScratch);
    }

    private void ApplyOrderedShockOutcome(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, float distance)
    {
        if (distance <= _config.HardKillRadius)
        {
            agent.MarkDead();
            return;
        }

        int directAlarmFrames = Math.Max(
            1,
            (int)MathF.Round(_config.DirectAlarmSignalSeconds / Math.Max(_config.Dt, 1e-5f)));
        agent.ActivateDirectAlarm(
            simulation.FrameIndex,
            directAlarmFrames,
            _config.DirectAlarmPanicFloor,
            simulation.Environment.Explosion?.TriggeredFrame ?? simulation.FrameIndex);

        if (distance <= _config.HeatIncapacityRadius)
        {
            agent.MarkTempIncap(simulation.FrameIndex, simulation.Random);
            agent.PanicLevel = Math.Max(agent.PanicLevel, 0.8f);
            return;
        }

        if (distance <= _config.FallenRadius)
        {
            agent.MarkFallen(simulation.FrameIndex, simulation.Random);
            agent.PanicLevel = Math.Max(agent.PanicLevel, 0.8f);
            return;
        }

        // Mobile survivors enter the same bounded startle/reaction sequence whether their
        // eventual response is direct evacuation or an injury-limited evacuation.
        if (agent.State == AgentState.Wandering)
        {
            int freezeUntil = simulation.FrameIndex + RandomFrameRange(
                simulation.Random,
                _config.FreezeMinFrames,
                _config.FreezeMaxFrames);
            agent.BeginReaction(simulation.FrameIndex, freezeUntil);
        }

        if (distance <= _config.InjuryRadius &&
            agent.State is (AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.WaitingToReact or AgentState.Injured))
        {
            agent.MarkInjured(preserveReactionState: agent.State == AgentState.WaitingToReact);
        }

        agent.PanicLevel = Math.Max(agent.PanicLevel, 0.8f);
    }

    private void ApplyDebrisImpact(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, Debris fragment)
    {
        float speedFactor = Math.Clamp(
            fragment.Velocity.Length() / Math.Max(_config.DebrisReferenceSpeed, 1e-5f),
            0f,
            1f);
        float severity = Math.Clamp(fragment.Energy * (0.45f + 0.55f * speedFactor), 0f, 1f);

        simulation.DebrisHits++;
        agent.PanicLevel = Math.Max(agent.PanicLevel, Math.Clamp(0.35f + 0.45f * severity, 0f, 0.9f));
        int directAlarmFrames = Math.Max(
            1,
            (int)MathF.Round(_config.DirectAlarmSignalSeconds / Math.Max(_config.Dt, 1e-5f)));
        agent.ActivateDirectAlarm(
            simulation.FrameIndex,
            directAlarmFrames,
            _config.DirectAlarmPanicFloor,
            simulation.Environment.Explosion?.TriggeredFrame ?? simulation.FrameIndex);

        if (agent.State == AgentState.Wandering && severity < _config.DebrisFallenThreshold)
        {
            int freezeUntil = simulation.FrameIndex + RandomFrameRange(
                simulation.Random,
                _config.FreezeMinFrames,
                _config.FreezeMaxFrames);
            agent.BeginReaction(simulation.FrameIndex, freezeUntil);
        }

        if (severity >= _config.DebrisFatalThreshold)
        {
            // Normalized high-severity branch; deterministic random source preserves reproducibility.
            if (simulation.Random.NextDouble() < 0.45)
            {
                agent.MarkDead();
                simulation.DebrisFatalities++;
            }
            else
            {
                agent.MarkIncapacitated();
                simulation.DebrisIncapacitations++;
            }

            return;
        }

        if (severity >= _config.DebrisIncapacityThreshold)
        {
            agent.MarkIncapacitated();
            simulation.DebrisIncapacitations++;
            return;
        }

        if (severity >= _config.DebrisFallenThreshold)
        {
            if (agent.State is AgentState.Fallen or AgentState.Crawling or AgentState.TempIncap or AgentState.Incapacitated)
            {
                agent.MarkIncapacitated();
                simulation.DebrisIncapacitations++;
            }
            else
            {
                agent.MarkFallen(simulation.FrameIndex, simulation.Random);
            }

            return;
        }

        if (severity >= _config.DebrisInjuryThreshold)
        {
            agent.MarkInjured(preserveReactionState: agent.State == AgentState.WaitingToReact);
            simulation.DebrisInjuries++;
        }
    }

    private static float DistancePointToSegment(Vector2 point, Vector2 a, Vector2 b)
    {
        Vector2 ab = b - a;
        float lengthSquared = ab.LengthSquared();
        if (lengthSquared <= 1e-8f || !float.IsFinite(lengthSquared))
        {
            return Vector2.Distance(point, a);
        }

        float t = Vector2.Dot(point - a, ab) / lengthSquared;
        t = Math.Clamp(t, 0f, 1f);
        Vector2 closest = a + t * ab;
        return Vector2.Distance(point, closest);
    }

    private static bool ClipAxis(
        float origin,
        float delta,
        float lower,
        float upper,
        ref float nearTime,
        ref float farTime)
    {
        if (MathF.Abs(delta) < 1e-8f)
        {
            return origin >= lower && origin <= upper;
        }

        float timeOne = (lower - origin) / delta;
        float timeTwo = (upper - origin) / delta;
        if (timeOne > timeTwo)
        {
            (timeOne, timeTwo) = (timeTwo, timeOne);
        }

        nearTime = Math.Max(nearTime, timeOne);
        farTime = Math.Min(farTime, timeTwo);
        return nearTime <= farTime;
    }

    private static int RandomFrameRange(Random random, int minInclusive, int maxExclusive)
        => maxExclusive <= minInclusive
            ? minInclusive
            : minInclusive + (int)(random.NextDouble() * (maxExclusive - minInclusive));
}
```

## benchmarks/baseline/src/CrowdSim.Core/Systems/SfmEngine.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Systems;

/// <summary>
/// Panic-influenced Helbing-style Social Force Model. The implementation keeps the validated
/// force caps, vision-cone gate, interaction cutoff, pressure permeability, wall-follow wall-force
/// suppression and final non-finite guard from physics_sfm.py.
/// </summary>
public sealed class SfmEngine
{
    public const float MaxRepulsion = 6000f;

    private readonly AgentConfig _config;
    private readonly List<Agent> _nearbyScratch = new(96);
    private readonly List<Wall> _nearbyWallScratch = new(24);
    private readonly HashSet<Wall> _nearbyWallSeenScratch = new();

    public SfmEngine(AgentConfig config)
    {
        _config = config;
    }

    public bool InVisionCone(
        Vector2 agentPosition,
        Vector2 agentHeading,
        Vector2 otherPosition,
        float maxRange,
        float cosHalfAngle)
    {
        Vector2 difference = otherPosition - agentPosition;
        float distance = difference.Length();
        if (!float.IsFinite(distance) || distance > maxRange || distance < VectorMath.Epsilon)
        {
            return false;
        }

        Vector2 normalized = difference / distance;
        return Vector2.Dot(agentHeading, normalized) >= cosHalfAngle;
    }

    /// <summary>Compute desired, social and wall forces for one agent.</summary>
    public Vector2 ComputeForces(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, Vector2 desiredDirection)
    {
        Vector2 velocity = VectorMath.IsFinite(agent.Velocity) ? agent.Velocity : Vector2.Zero;
        Vector2 desiredDir = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(desiredDirection);

        float desiredMagnitude = agent.CurrentDesiredSpeed;
        Vector2 desiredVelocity = desiredDir * desiredMagnitude;
        float bottleneckModeFactor = agent.BottleneckMode switch
        {
            BottleneckResponseMode.SeekGap => 0.35f,
            BottleneckResponseMode.Press => 1.00f,
            _ => 0f,
        };
        float relaxationScale = 1f -
            _config.BottleneckPressRelaxationReduction *
            Math.Clamp(agent.BottleneckPressure, 0f, 1f) *
            bottleneckModeFactor;
        float relaxationTime = Math.Max(
            0.20f,
            _config.RelaxationTime * Math.Clamp(relaxationScale, 0.55f, 1f));
        Vector2 desiredForce = (desiredVelocity - velocity) / relaxationTime;

        Vector2 socialForce = Vector2.Zero;
        float interactionRadius = Math.Max(0f, _config.SfmInteractionRadius);
        float interactionRadiusSquared = interactionRadius * interactionRadius;

        Vector2 heading;
        float velocityMagnitude = velocity.Length();
        if (velocityMagnitude > VectorMath.Epsilon)
        {
            heading = velocity / velocityMagnitude;
        }
        else if (agent.ExitTarget is not null)
        {
            heading = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget.Position - agent.Position);
        }
        else
        {
            heading = Vector2.Zero;
        }

        float cosHalfAngle = MathF.Cos(_config.VisionHalfAngleDeg * MathF.PI / 180f);

        // The old implementation scanned the entire population for every pedestrian and then
        // rejected almost everyone by vision/cutoff distance. Query the simulation's existing
        // spatial hash first. Sorting the small candidate set by AgentId preserves deterministic
        // pair-force accumulation order from the former global-list traversal.
        float neighbourQueryRadius = interactionRadius > 0f
            ? Math.Min(_config.VisionRange, interactionRadius)
            : _config.VisionRange;
        simulation.CollectNearbyAgents(agent, neighbourQueryRadius, _nearbyScratch);
        _nearbyScratch.Sort(static (left, right) => left.AgentId.CompareTo(right.AgentId));

        foreach (Agent other in _nearbyScratch)
        {
            if (!other.IsActive)
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (!InVisionCone(
                    agent.Position,
                    heading,
                    other.Position,
                    _config.VisionRange,
                    cosHalfAngle))
            {
                continue;
            }

            Vector2 difference = agent.Position - other.Position;
            if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(difference))
            {
                continue;
            }

            float distanceSquared = difference.LengthSquared();
            if (interactionRadiusSquared > 0f && distanceSquared > interactionRadiusSquared)
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (distanceSquared < 1e-10f || !float.IsFinite(distanceSquared))
            {
                continue;
            }

            float distance = MathF.Sqrt(distanceSquared);
            if (distance < VectorMath.Epsilon)
            {
                continue;
            }

            Vector2 normal = difference / distance;
            float bodyContactRadius = 2f * _config.Radius;

            if (other.State is AgentState.Crawling or AgentState.Fallen or AgentState.TempIncap or
                AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.Dead)
            {
                float pressure = Math.Min(1f, agent.TimeStuck / 3f);
                bodyContactRadius *= 1f - 0.4f * pressure;
            }

            // Personal-space compression changes anticipatory social repulsion, not the hard
            // physical-contact radius. Highly stressed pedestrians may accept closer spacing,
            // but body/contact and collision guardrails remain fully active.
            float panic = Math.Clamp(agent.PanicLevel, 0f, 1f);
            float panicCompression = _config.Behavior.PanicSpaceCompression * panic;
            float localPressure = Math.Clamp(agent.BottleneckPressure, 0f, 1f);
            float bottleneckCompression =
                _config.Behavior.BottleneckSpaceCompression *
                localPressure *
                bottleneckModeFactor;
            float totalCompression = Math.Clamp(
                panicCompression + bottleneckCompression,
                0f,
                0.45f);
            float personalSpaceScale =
                _config.Behavior.PersonalSpace *
                Math.Clamp(agent.PersonalSpaceBias, 0.80f, 1.20f) *
                (1f - totalCompression);
            personalSpaceScale = Math.Clamp(personalSpaceScale, 0.70f, 1.50f);
            float socialRadius = bodyContactRadius * personalSpaceScale;

            float exponent = (socialRadius - distance) / Math.Max(_config.SfmB, 1e-5f);
            exponent = Math.Clamp(exponent, -60f, 20f); // numerical guard; does not change nominal range
            Vector2 pairForce = _config.SfmA * MathF.Exp(exponent) * normal;

            if (distance < bodyContactRadius)
            {
                float overlap = bodyContactRadius - distance;
                Vector2 tangent = VectorMath.Perpendicular(normal);
                Vector2 deltaVelocity = other.Velocity - velocity;
                Vector2 bodyForce = _config.SfmK * overlap * normal;
                Vector2 slideForce =
                    _config.SfmKappa * overlap * Vector2.Dot(deltaVelocity, tangent) * tangent;
                pairForce += bodyForce + slideForce;
            }

            pairForce = SoftCap(pairForce, MaxRepulsion);
            if (VectorMath.IsFinite(pairForce))
            {
                socialForce += pairForce;
            }
        }

        Vector2 wallForce = Vector2.Zero;
        bool wallFollowing = agent.WallFollowDir is not null && agent.WallFollowUntil > simulation.FrameIndex;
        if (!wallFollowing)
        {
            // Static wall force falls off exponentially over SfmB (0.08 by default), so walls
            // more than a small margin outside body contact contribute effectively zero force.
            // Preserve the exact full-wall scan for simple layouts; builder-heavy scenes use the
            // existing wall spatial grid and avoid O(agent x wall) work every physics step.
            IReadOnlyList<Wall> walls;
            if (simulation.Environment.Walls.Count <= 12)
            {
                walls = simulation.Environment.Walls;
            }
            else
            {
                float wallQueryRadius = _config.Radius + Math.Max(0.08f, 25f * _config.SfmB);
                simulation.CollectNearbyWalls(
                    agent.Position,
                    wallQueryRadius,
                    _nearbyWallScratch,
                    _nearbyWallSeenScratch);
                walls = _nearbyWallScratch;
            }

            foreach (Wall wall in walls)
            {
                Vector2 closest = wall.ClosestPoint(agent.Position);
                Vector2 difference = agent.Position - closest;
                if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(difference))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float distance = difference.Length();
                if (distance < VectorMath.Epsilon || !float.IsFinite(distance))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                Vector2 normal = difference / distance;
                float radius = _config.Radius;
                float exponent = (radius - distance) / Math.Max(_config.SfmB, 1e-5f);
                exponent = Math.Clamp(exponent, -60f, 20f);
                Vector2 force = _config.SfmA * MathF.Exp(exponent) * normal;

                if (distance < radius)
                {
                    float overlap = radius - distance;
                    Vector2 tangent = VectorMath.Perpendicular(normal);
                    Vector2 bodyForce = _config.SfmK * overlap * normal;
                    Vector2 slideForce =
                        _config.SfmKappa * overlap * Vector2.Dot(-velocity, tangent) * tangent;
                    force += bodyForce + slideForce;
                }

                force = SoftCap(force, MaxRepulsion);
                if (VectorMath.IsFinite(force))
                {
                    wallForce += force;
                }
            }

            foreach (CircleBlockage circle in simulation.Environment.CircularBlockages)
            {
                Vector2 difference = agent.Position - circle.Center;
                float centerDistance = difference.Length();
                if (!float.IsFinite(centerDistance))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                Vector2 normal = centerDistance > VectorMath.Epsilon
                    ? difference / centerDistance
                    : Vector2.UnitX;
                float surfaceDistance = centerDistance - circle.Radius;
                float bodyRadius = _config.Radius;
                float exponent = (bodyRadius - surfaceDistance) / Math.Max(_config.SfmB, 1e-5f);
                exponent = Math.Clamp(exponent, -60f, 20f);
                Vector2 force = _config.SfmA * MathF.Exp(exponent) * normal;

                if (surfaceDistance < bodyRadius)
                {
                    float overlap = bodyRadius - surfaceDistance;
                    Vector2 tangent = VectorMath.Perpendicular(normal);
                    force += _config.SfmK * overlap * normal +
                        _config.SfmKappa * overlap * Vector2.Dot(-velocity, tangent) * tangent;
                }

                force = SoftCap(force, MaxRepulsion);
                if (VectorMath.IsFinite(force))
                {
                    wallForce += force;
                }
            }
        }

        Vector2 total = desiredForce + socialForce + wallForce;
        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(total))
        {
            total = Vector2.Zero;
        }

        agent.LastDesiredDirection = desiredDir;
        agent.LastSfmForce = total;
        return total;
    }

    private static Vector2 SoftCap(Vector2 force, float cap)
    {
        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(force))
        {
            return Vector2.Zero;
        }

        float magnitude = force.Length();
        if (magnitude > cap && magnitude > VectorMath.Epsilon)
        {
            return force / magnitude * cap;
        }

        return force;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Systems;

/// <summary>
/// Small deterministic A* visibility-graph planner for rectangular and circular builder obstacles.
/// The graph is deliberately limited to static geometry: it tells an agent which side of a
/// blockage is body-clear, while SFM continues to model local people, contacts and congestion.
/// </summary>
public sealed class VisibilityGraphPlanner
{
    private readonly AgentConfig _config;
    private readonly List<Vector2> _cachedNodes = new(128);
    private readonly List<List<(int To, float Cost)>> _cachedGraph = new(128);
    private readonly PriorityQueue<int, (float Score, int Index)> _openQueue = new();
    private bool[] _startVisible = Array.Empty<bool>();
    private bool[] _goalVisible = Array.Empty<bool>();
    private float[] _startCost = Array.Empty<float>();
    private float[] _goalCost = Array.Empty<float>();
    private float[] _gScoreScratch = Array.Empty<float>();
    private int[] _cameFromScratch = Array.Empty<int>();
    private bool[] _closedScratch = Array.Empty<bool>();
    private int _cachedLayoutVersion = -1;

    public VisibilityGraphPlanner(AgentConfig config)
    {
        _config = config;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Runtime path planner that caches the static obstacle-corner visibility graph for the
    /// current layout. Each pedestrian then connects only its dynamic start/goal to that graph,
    /// avoiding a full O(corners^2) graph rebuild for every route request.
    /// </summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<Vector2> Plan(
        Simulation simulation,
        Vector2 start,
        Vector2 goal)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(simulation);
        float clearance = NavigationClearance();
        if (simulation.HasTraversablePath(start, goal, clearance))
        {
            return new[] { goal };
        }

        EnsureStaticGraph(simulation, clearance);
        int staticCount = _cachedNodes.Count;
        if (staticCount == 0)
        {
            return Array.Empty<Vector2>();
        }

        EnsureScratchCapacity(staticCount);
        for (int i = 0; i < staticCount; i++)
        {
            Vector2 node = _cachedNodes[i];
            bool startVisible = simulation.HasTraversablePath(start, node, clearance);
            bool goalVisible = simulation.HasTraversablePath(node, goal, clearance);
            _startVisible[i] = startVisible;
            _goalVisible[i] = goalVisible;
            _startCost[i] = startVisible ? Vector2.Distance(start, node) : float.PositiveInfinity;
            _goalCost[i] = goalVisible ? Vector2.Distance(node, goal) : float.PositiveInfinity;
        }

        // Dynamic indices deliberately mirror the original graph ordering: start=0, goal=1,
        // cached obstacle corners begin at index 2. This preserves deterministic tie-breaking.
        int nodeCount = staticCount + 2;
        Array.Fill(_gScoreScratch, float.PositiveInfinity, 0, nodeCount);
        Array.Fill(_cameFromScratch, -1, 0, nodeCount);
        Array.Fill(_closedScratch, false, 0, nodeCount);
        _openQueue.Clear();

        const int startIndex = 0;
        const int goalIndex = 1;
        _gScoreScratch[startIndex] = 0f;
        float startHeuristic = Vector2.Distance(start, goal);
        _openQueue.Enqueue(startIndex, (startHeuristic, startIndex));

        while (_openQueue.Count > 0)
        {
            int current = _openQueue.Dequeue();
            if (_closedScratch[current])
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (current == goalIndex)
            {
                return ReconstructCachedPath(_cameFromScratch, goalIndex, staticCount, goal);
            }

            _closedScratch[current] = true;
            if (current == startIndex)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < staticCount; i++)
                {
                    if (_startVisible[i])
                    {
                        RelaxCachedEdge(
                            startIndex,
                            i + 2,
                            _startCost[i],
                            goal,
                            staticCount);
                    }
                }

                continue;
            }

            int staticIndex = current - 2;
            if (staticIndex < 0 || staticIndex >= staticCount)
            {
                continue;
            }

            foreach ((int to, float cost) in _cachedGraph[staticIndex])
            {
                RelaxCachedEdge(current, to + 2, cost, goal, staticCount);
            }

            if (_goalVisible[staticIndex])
            {
                RelaxCachedEdge(current, goalIndex, _goalCost[staticIndex], goal, staticCount);
            }
        }

        return Array.Empty<Vector2>();
    }

    private void EnsureStaticGraph(Simulation simulation, float clearance)
    {
        int layoutVersion = simulation.Environment.WallLayoutVersion;
        if (layoutVersion == _cachedLayoutVersion)
        {
            return;
        }

        _cachedLayoutVersion = layoutVersion;
        _cachedNodes.Clear();
        _cachedGraph.Clear();
        SimulationEnvironment environment = simulation.Environment;
        float cornerOffset = clearance + Math.Max(0.02f, _config.RouteCornerBuffer);
        float innerMargin = environment.BoundaryThickness + clearance + 0.02f;

        Span<Vector2> corners = stackalloc Vector2[4];
        foreach (Wall blockage in environment.Blockages.Concat(environment.BlueWalls))
        {
            corners[0] = new Vector2(blockage.X1 - cornerOffset, blockage.Y1 - cornerOffset);
            corners[1] = new Vector2(blockage.X2 + cornerOffset, blockage.Y1 - cornerOffset);
            corners[2] = new Vector2(blockage.X2 + cornerOffset, blockage.Y2 + cornerOffset);
            corners[3] = new Vector2(blockage.X1 - cornerOffset, blockage.Y2 + cornerOffset);

            foreach (Vector2 candidate in corners)
            {
                if (candidate.X <= innerMargin || candidate.Y <= innerMargin ||
                    candidate.X >= environment.Width - innerMargin ||
                    candidate.Y >= environment.Height - innerMargin ||
                    environment.IsPointBlocked(candidate, 0.25f * clearance))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                bool duplicate = false;
                foreach (Vector2 existing in _cachedNodes)
                {
                    if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(existing, candidate) < 0.0004f)
                    {
                        duplicate = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!duplicate)
                {
                    _cachedNodes.Add(candidate);
                }
            }
        }

        AddCircleWaypoints(environment, clearance, innerMargin, _cachedNodes);

        for (int i = 0; i < _cachedNodes.Count; i++)
        {
            _cachedGraph.Add(new List<(int To, float Cost)>(12));
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < _cachedNodes.Count; i++)
        {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < _cachedNodes.Count; j++)
            {
                if (!simulation.HasTraversablePath(_cachedNodes[i], _cachedNodes[j], clearance))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float cost = Vector2.Distance(_cachedNodes[i], _cachedNodes[j]);
                _cachedGraph[i].Add((j, cost));
                _cachedGraph[j].Add((i, cost));
            }
        }
    }

    private void EnsureScratchCapacity(int staticCount)
    {
        int dynamicCount = staticCount + 2;
        if (_startVisible.Length < staticCount)
        {
            int capacity = Math.Max(staticCount, Math.Max(32, _startVisible.Length * 2));
            Array.Resize(ref _startVisible, capacity);
            Array.Resize(ref _goalVisible, capacity);
            Array.Resize(ref _startCost, capacity);
            Array.Resize(ref _goalCost, capacity);
        }

        if (_gScoreScratch.Length < dynamicCount)
        {
            int capacity = Math.Max(dynamicCount, Math.Max(34, _gScoreScratch.Length * 2));
            Array.Resize(ref _gScoreScratch, capacity);
            Array.Resize(ref _cameFromScratch, capacity);
            Array.Resize(ref _closedScratch, capacity);
        }
    }

    private void RelaxCachedEdge(
        int from,
        int to,
        float edgeCost,
        Vector2 goal,
        int staticCount)
    {
        if (_closedScratch[to])
        {
            return;
        }

        float tentative = _gScoreScratch[from] + edgeCost;
        if (tentative >= _gScoreScratch[to])
        {
            return;
        }

        _cameFromScratch[to] = from;
        _gScoreScratch[to] = tentative;
        float heuristic = to switch
        {
            1 => 0f,
            >= 2 when to - 2 < staticCount => Vector2.Distance(_cachedNodes[to - 2], goal),
            _ => 0f,
        };
        _openQueue.Enqueue(to, (tentative + heuristic, to));
    }

    private IReadOnlyList<Vector2> ReconstructCachedPath(
        IReadOnlyList<int> cameFrom,
        int goalIndex,
        int staticCount,
        Vector2 goal)
    {
        List<Vector2> reverse = new();
        int current = goalIndex;
        while (current >= 0)
        {
            if (current == 1)
            {
                reverse.Add(goal);
            }
            else if (current >= 2 && current - 2 < staticCount)
            {
                reverse.Add(_cachedNodes[current - 2]);
            }

            current = cameFrom[current];
        }

        reverse.Reverse();
        return reverse;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Plan a body-clear waypoint chain from start to goal. The returned list excludes start
    /// and includes goal. An empty list means no static-geometry route was found.
    /// </summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<Vector2> Plan(
        SimulationEnvironment environment,
        Vector2 start,
        Vector2 goal)
    {
        float clearance = NavigationClearance();
        if (HasTraversablePath(environment, start, goal, clearance))
        {
            return new[] { goal };
        }

        List<Vector2> nodes = new() { start, goal };
        float cornerOffset = clearance + Math.Max(0.02f, _config.RouteCornerBuffer);
        float innerMargin = environment.BoundaryThickness + clearance + 0.02f;

        foreach (Wall blockage in environment.Blockages.Concat(environment.BlueWalls))
        {
            Vector2[] corners =
            {
                new(blockage.X1 - cornerOffset, blockage.Y1 - cornerOffset),
                new(blockage.X2 + cornerOffset, blockage.Y1 - cornerOffset),
                new(blockage.X2 + cornerOffset, blockage.Y2 + cornerOffset),
                new(blockage.X1 - cornerOffset, blockage.Y2 + cornerOffset),
            };

            foreach (Vector2 candidate in corners)
            {
                if (candidate.X <= innerMargin || candidate.Y <= innerMargin ||
                    candidate.X >= environment.Width - innerMargin ||
                    candidate.Y >= environment.Height - innerMargin)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                // Candidate already contains cornerOffset, so use a small point margin here.
                if (environment.IsPointBlocked(candidate, 0.25f * clearance))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (!nodes.Any(existing => Vector2.DistanceSquared(existing, candidate) < 0.0004f))
                {
                    nodes.Add(candidate);
                }
            }
        }

        AddCircleWaypoints(environment, clearance, innerMargin, nodes);

        int count = nodes.Count;
        if (count <= 2)
        {
            return Array.Empty<Vector2>();
        }

        List<(int To, float Cost)>[] graph = new List<(int To, float Cost)>[count];
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            graph[i] = new List<(int To, float Cost)>();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < count; j++)
            {
                if (!HasTraversablePath(environment, nodes[i], nodes[j], clearance))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float cost = Vector2.Distance(nodes[i], nodes[j]);
                graph[i].Add((j, cost));
                graph[j].Add((i, cost));
            }
        }

        const int startIndex = 0;
        const int goalIndex = 1;
        float[] gScore = Enumerable.Repeat(float.PositiveInfinity, count).ToArray();
        float[] fScore = Enumerable.Repeat(float.PositiveInfinity, count).ToArray();
        int[] cameFrom = Enumerable.Repeat(-1, count).ToArray();
        bool[] closed = new bool[count];
        HashSet<int> open = new() { startIndex };
        gScore[startIndex] = 0f;
        fScore[startIndex] = Vector2.Distance(start, goal);

        while (open.Count > 0)
        {
            int current = open.OrderBy(index => fScore[index]).ThenBy(index => index).First();
            if (current == goalIndex)
            {
                return Reconstruct(nodes, cameFrom, goalIndex);
            }

            open.Remove(current);
            closed[current] = true;

            foreach ((int neighbour, float edgeCost) in graph[current])
            {
                if (closed[neighbour])
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float tentative = gScore[current] + edgeCost;
                if (tentative >= gScore[neighbour])
                {
                    continue;
                }

                cameFrom[neighbour] = current;
                gScore[neighbour] = tentative;
                fScore[neighbour] = tentative + Vector2.Distance(nodes[neighbour], goal);
                open.Add(neighbour);
            }
        }

        return Array.Empty<Vector2>();
    }

    private static void AddCircleWaypoints(
        SimulationEnvironment environment,
        float clearance,
        float innerMargin,
        ICollection<Vector2> nodes)
    {
        const int segments = 12;
        const float radialSafetyMeters = 0.02f;
        float halfSegmentAngle = MathF.PI / segments;
        float chordClearanceScale = 1f / MathF.Cos(halfSegmentAngle);

        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in environment.CircularBlockages)
        {
            // Adjacent waypoint nodes are connected by straight chords. Placing nodes only
            // just outside the inflated circle lets those chords cut back through the obstacle.
            // Increase the waypoint radius by sec(pi / segments) so each chord itself remains
            // body-clear, plus a small metric safety margin for floating-point tolerance.
            float inflatedRadius = circle.Radius + Math.Max(0f, clearance);
            float waypointRadius =
                (inflatedRadius + radialSafetyMeters) * chordClearanceScale;
            for (int i = 0; i < segments; i++)
            {
                float angle = MathF.Tau * i / segments;
                Vector2 candidate = circle.Center +
                    new Vector2(MathF.Cos(angle), MathF.Sin(angle)) * waypointRadius;
                if (candidate.X <= innerMargin || candidate.Y <= innerMargin ||
                    candidate.X >= environment.Width - innerMargin ||
                    candidate.Y >= environment.Height - innerMargin ||
                    environment.IsPointBlocked(candidate, 0.25f * clearance))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                bool duplicate = nodes.Any(existing =>
                    Vector2.DistanceSquared(existing, candidate) < 0.0004f);
                if (!duplicate)
                {
                    nodes.Add(candidate);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static bool HasTraversablePath(
        SimulationEnvironment environment,
        Vector2 start,
        Vector2 end,
        float clearance)
    {
        if (!EvacuationSystem.HasTraversablePath(start, end, environment.Walls, clearance))
        {
            return false;
        }

        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in environment.CircularBlockages)
        {
            if (CircleGeometry.SegmentIntersectsCircle(
                start,
                end,
                circle.Center,
                circle.Radius + Math.Max(0f, clearance)))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static IReadOnlyList<Vector2> Reconstruct(
        IReadOnlyList<Vector2> nodes,
        IReadOnlyList<int> cameFrom,
        int goalIndex)
    {
        List<Vector2> reverse = new();
        int current = goalIndex;
        while (current >= 0)
        {
            reverse.Add(nodes[current]);
            current = cameFrom[current];
        }

        reverse.Reverse();
        if (reverse.Count > 0)
        {
            reverse.RemoveAt(0); // exclude start
        }

        return reverse;
    }

    private float NavigationClearance()
        => Math.Max(0f, _config.Radius * _config.NavigationClearanceFactor);
}
```

## benchmarks/baseline/src/CrowdSim.Core/Systems/VisibilitySystem.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Systems;

/// <summary>
/// Temporary post-event visibility degradation used only for perception and route choice.
/// The field is deliberately abstract: it models a short-lived dust/visual-obscuration effect
/// without attempting to reproduce real smoke or explosive-yield physics.
/// </summary>
public sealed class VisibilitySystem
{
    private readonly AgentConfig _config;

    public VisibilitySystem(AgentConfig config)
    {
        _config = config;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns visual clarity in [MinimumVisibilityFactor, 1]. Walls shield the field so
    /// obscuration does not propagate straight through solid geometry.
    /// </summary>
    public float GetVisibilityFactor(Simulation simulation, Vector2 position)
    {
        Explosion? explosion = simulation.Environment.Explosion;
        if (explosion is null)
        {
            return 1f;
        }

        float eventSeconds = Math.Max(0f, (simulation.FrameIndex - explosion.TriggeredFrame) * _config.Dt);
        float distance = Vector2.Distance(position, explosion.Position);
        if (!float.IsFinite(distance) || distance >= _config.DustVisibilityRadius)
        {
            return 1f;
        }

        // The temporary obscuration begins locally after the same abstract propagating front reaches
        // the point; this avoids degrading perception ahead of the visible/event wave.
        float arrivalSeconds = distance / Math.Max(_config.ShockwaveSpeedMetersPerFrame, 1e-5f) * _config.Dt;
        float localSeconds = eventSeconds - arrivalSeconds;
        if (localSeconds < 0f)
        {
            return 1f;
        }

        float temporal = TemporalEnvelope(localSeconds);
        if (temporal <= 0f)
        {
            return 1f;
        }

        // A wall between the event and the observer blocks the direct dust field. Social
        // contagion can still reach the observer later through visible running pedestrians.
        if (ExplosionSystem.BlastPathIsBlocked(explosion.Position, position, simulation.Environment.Walls))
        {
            return 1f;
        }

        float spatial = 1f - Math.Clamp(distance / Math.Max(_config.DustVisibilityRadius, 1e-5f), 0f, 1f);
        spatial *= spatial;
        float loss = _config.DustPeakVisibilityLoss * temporal * spatial;
        return Math.Clamp(1f - loss, _config.MinimumVisibilityFactor, 1f);
    }

    private float TemporalEnvelope(float seconds)
    {
        float build = Math.Max(0.05f, _config.DustBuildSeconds);
        float holdEnd = build + Math.Max(0f, _config.DustHoldSeconds);
        float decay = Math.Max(0.05f, _config.DustDecaySeconds);

        if (seconds < build)
        {
            return Math.Clamp(seconds / build, 0f, 1f);
        }

        if (seconds <= holdEnd)
        {
            return 1f;
        }

        float afterHold = seconds - holdEnd;
        if (afterHold >= decay)
        {
            return 0f;
        }

        return 1f - afterHold / decay;
    }
}
```

## benchmarks/baseline/src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/Rendering/Camera3D.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.Rendering;

/// <summary>
/// Camera used by the projected 3D renderer. The default view is an elevated orthographic
/// isometric camera. A selected agent can also be followed from an agent-centred isometric
/// view or observed from a head-height first-person perspective camera.
/// </summary>
public sealed class Camera3D
{
    private const float PovNearPlane = 0.04f;
    private const float PovFieldOfViewDegrees = 72f;

    private Vector3 _forward = new(-0.70f, 0.50f, -0.50f);
    private Vector3 _right = Vector3.UnitX;
    private Vector3 _up = Vector3.UnitZ;
    private Vector3 _target;
    private Vector3 _eye;
    private Vector2 _canvasCenter;
    private Vector2 _canvasSize = Vector2.One;
    private float _cameraCenterX;
    private float _cameraCenterY;
    private float _scale = 1f;
    private float _povFocalPixels = 1f;

    /// <summary>Camera azimuth around the world Z axis, in degrees.</summary>
    public float AzimuthDegrees { get; private set; } = -35f;

    /// <summary>Camera elevation above the ground plane, in degrees.</summary>
    public float ElevationDegrees { get; private set; } = 34f;

    /// <summary>Orthographic zoom multiplier.</summary>
    public float Zoom { get; private set; } = 1f;

    /// <summary>True while the camera is configured as the selected agent's first-person view.</summary>
    public bool IsPov { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Set azimuth while keeping a practical three-dimensional viewing range.</summary>
    public void SetAzimuth(float degrees) => AzimuthDegrees = Math.Clamp(degrees, -180f, 180f);

    /// <summary>Set elevation while preventing a near-horizontal or top-down singular view.</summary>
    public void SetElevation(float degrees) => ElevationDegrees = Math.Clamp(degrees, 18f, 70f);

    /// <summary>Set the orthographic zoom multiplier.</summary>
    public void SetZoom(float zoom) => Zoom = Math.Clamp(zoom, 0.45f, 2.5f);

    /// <summary>Adjust zoom from the mouse wheel when the world canvas is hovered.</summary>
    public void AdjustZoom(float wheelDelta)
    {
        if (!IsPov)
        {
            SetZoom(Zoom * MathF.Exp(wheelDelta * 0.10f));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Restore the validated default 3D presentation camera.</summary>
    public void Reset()
    {
        AzimuthDegrees = -35f;
        ElevationDegrees = 34f;
        Zoom = 1f;
        IsPov = false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Configure the standard elevated 3D view. When <paramref name="focusWorld"/> is supplied,
    /// the selected agent is kept near the centre of the canvas while retaining the same
    /// isometric orientation.
    /// </summary>
    public void Configure(
        Vector2 canvasMin,
        Vector2 canvasMax,
        float worldWidth,
        float worldHeight,
        float maximumHeight,
        Vector2? focusWorld = null)
    {
        IsPov = false;
        _canvasSize = Vector2.Max(canvasMax - canvasMin, new Vector2(1f));
        _canvasCenter = (canvasMin + canvasMax) * 0.5f;

        Vector2 groundTarget = focusWorld ?? new Vector2(worldWidth * 0.5f, worldHeight * 0.5f);
        float targetHeight = focusWorld is null ? maximumHeight * 0.25f : 0f;
        _target = new Vector3(groundTarget.X, groundTarget.Y, targetHeight);

        float azimuth = DegreesToRadians(AzimuthDegrees);
        float elevation = DegreesToRadians(ElevationDegrees);

        // Vector from the target towards the camera.
        Vector3 cameraDirection = Vector3.Normalize(new Vector3(
            MathF.Cos(elevation) * MathF.Cos(azimuth),
            MathF.Cos(elevation) * MathF.Sin(azimuth),
            MathF.Sin(elevation)));

        _forward = -cameraDirection;
        _right = Vector3.Normalize(Vector3.Cross(_forward, Vector3.UnitZ));
        _up = Vector3.Normalize(Vector3.Cross(_right, _forward));

        float marginX = Math.Max(0.80f, worldWidth * 0.035f);
        float marginY = Math.Max(0.80f, worldHeight * 0.035f);
        float minX = -marginX;
        float maxX = worldWidth + marginX;
        float minY = -marginY;
        float maxY = worldHeight + marginY;
        float minZ = 0f;
        float maxZ = maximumHeight;

        float minCameraX = float.PositiveInfinity;
        float maxCameraX = float.NegativeInfinity;
        float minCameraY = float.PositiveInfinity;
        float maxCameraY = float.NegativeInfinity;

        // Evaluate the eight AABB corners without allocating temporary arrays every frame.
        for (int xi = 0; xi < 2; xi++)
        {
            float x = xi == 0 ? minX : maxX;
            for (int yi = 0; yi < 2; yi++)
            {
                float y = yi == 0 ? minY : maxY;
                for (int zi = 0; zi < 2; zi++)
                {
                    float z = zi == 0 ? minZ : maxZ;
                    Vector3 relative = new Vector3(x, y, z) - _target;
                    float cameraX = Vector3.Dot(relative, _right);
                    float cameraY = Vector3.Dot(relative, _up);
                    minCameraX = Math.Min(minCameraX, cameraX);
                    maxCameraX = Math.Max(maxCameraX, cameraX);
                    minCameraY = Math.Min(minCameraY, cameraY);
                    maxCameraY = Math.Max(maxCameraY, cameraY);
                }
            }
        }

        if (focusWorld is null)
        {
            _cameraCenterX = (minCameraX + maxCameraX) * 0.5f;
            _cameraCenterY = (minCameraY + maxCameraY) * 0.5f;
        }
        else
        {
            // Because _target is the followed agent, zero camera-space X/Y centres that agent.
            _cameraCenterX = 0f;
            _cameraCenterY = 0f;
        }

        float projectedWidth = Math.Max(0.001f, maxCameraX - minCameraX);
        float projectedHeight = Math.Max(0.001f, maxCameraY - minCameraY);
        const float paddingFraction = 0.90f;
        float followMultiplier = focusWorld is null ? 1f : 1.35f;
        _scale = paddingFraction * Math.Min(
            _canvasSize.X / projectedWidth,
            _canvasSize.Y / projectedHeight) * Zoom * followMultiplier;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Configure a head-height first-person camera that follows one agent's movement heading.
    /// </summary>
    public void ConfigurePov(
        Vector2 canvasMin,
        Vector2 canvasMax,
        Vector2 agentPosition,
        Vector2 heading,
        float eyeHeight)
    {
        IsPov = true;
        _canvasSize = Vector2.Max(canvasMax - canvasMin, new Vector2(1f));
        _canvasCenter = (canvasMin + canvasMax) * 0.5f;

        Vector2 groundDirection = heading.LengthSquared() > 1e-6f
            ? Vector2.Normalize(heading)
            : Vector2.UnitX;

        _eye = new Vector3(agentPosition.X, agentPosition.Y, Math.Max(0.10f, eyeHeight));

        // A slight downward pitch keeps nearby floor geometry visible without turning the
        // camera into a third-person view.
        _forward = Vector3.Normalize(new Vector3(groundDirection.X, groundDirection.Y, -0.055f));
        _right = Vector3.Normalize(Vector3.Cross(_forward, Vector3.UnitZ));
        if (_right.LengthSquared() < 1e-6f)
        {
            _right = Vector3.UnitX;
        }

        _up = Vector3.Normalize(Vector3.Cross(_right, _forward));
        float fovRadians = DegreesToRadians(PovFieldOfViewDegrees);
        _povFocalPixels = (_canvasSize.Y * 0.5f) / MathF.Tan(fovRadians * 0.5f);
    }

    /// <summary>Project one world-space 3D point into ImGui screen coordinates.</summary>
    public Vector2 Project(Vector3 world)
    {
        if (TryProject(world, out Vector2 screen))
        {
            return screen;
        }

        // Keep invalid/behind-camera geometry safely outside the clip rectangle.
        return new Vector2(-100_000f, -100_000f);
    }

    /// <summary>Try to project a world point. POV points behind the near plane are rejected.</summary>
    public bool TryProject(Vector3 world, out Vector2 screen)
    {
        if (!IsPov)
        {
            Vector3 relative = world - _target;
            float orthoCameraX = Vector3.Dot(relative, _right);
            float orthoCameraY = Vector3.Dot(relative, _up);
            screen = new Vector2(
                _canvasCenter.X + (orthoCameraX - _cameraCenterX) * _scale,
                _canvasCenter.Y - (orthoCameraY - _cameraCenterY) * _scale);
            return float.IsFinite(screen.X) && float.IsFinite(screen.Y);
        }

        Vector3 povRelative = world - _eye;
        float depth = Vector3.Dot(povRelative, _forward);
        if (!float.IsFinite(depth) || depth <= PovNearPlane)
        {
            screen = default;
            return false;
        }

        float cameraX = Vector3.Dot(povRelative, _right);
        float cameraY = Vector3.Dot(povRelative, _up);
        screen = new Vector2(
            _canvasCenter.X + cameraX / depth * _povFocalPixels,
            _canvasCenter.Y - cameraY / depth * _povFocalPixels);
        return float.IsFinite(screen.X) && float.IsFinite(screen.Y);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Project a line segment, clipping it against the POV near plane when necessary.
    /// </summary>
    public bool TryProjectSegment(Vector3 a, Vector3 b, out Vector2 screenA, out Vector2 screenB)
    {
        if (!IsPov)
        {
            bool projectedA = TryProject(a, out screenA);
            bool projectedB = TryProject(b, out screenB);
            return projectedA && projectedB;
        }

        float depthA = Vector3.Dot(a - _eye, _forward);
        float depthB = Vector3.Dot(b - _eye, _forward);
        if (depthA <= PovNearPlane && depthB <= PovNearPlane)
        {
            screenA = default;
            screenB = default;
            return false;
        }

        if (depthA <= PovNearPlane)
        {
            float t = (PovNearPlane + 0.01f - depthA) / Math.Max(1e-6f, depthB - depthA);
            a = Vector3.Lerp(a, b, Math.Clamp(t, 0f, 1f));
        }
        else if (depthB <= PovNearPlane)
        {
            float t = (PovNearPlane + 0.01f - depthB) / Math.Max(1e-6f, depthA - depthB);
            b = Vector3.Lerp(b, a, Math.Clamp(t, 0f, 1f));
        }

        bool clippedProjectedA = TryProject(a, out screenA);
        bool clippedProjectedB = TryProject(b, out screenB);
        return clippedProjectedA && clippedProjectedB;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Return camera depth. Larger values are farther from the eye and therefore should be
    /// painted first by the renderer's painter ordering.
    /// </summary>
    public float Depth(Vector3 world)
        => IsPov
            ? Vector3.Dot(world - _eye, _forward)
            : Vector3.Dot(world - _target, _forward);

    /// <summary>Project a screen position onto the simulation's Z=0 ground plane.</summary>
    public bool TryScreenToGround(Vector2 screen, out Vector2 ground)
    {
        ground = default;
        if (IsPov || _scale <= 0.0001f || MathF.Abs(_forward.Z) <= 0.0001f)
        {
            return false;
        }

        float cameraX = _cameraCenterX + (screen.X - _canvasCenter.X) / _scale;
        float cameraY = _cameraCenterY - (screen.Y - _canvasCenter.Y) / _scale;
        Vector3 planePoint = _target + _right * cameraX + _up * cameraY;
        float t = -planePoint.Z / _forward.Z;
        Vector3 worldPoint = planePoint + _forward * t;

        if (!float.IsFinite(worldPoint.X) || !float.IsFinite(worldPoint.Y))
        {
            return false;
        }

        ground = new Vector2(worldPoint.X, worldPoint.Y);
        return true;
    }

    private static float DegreesToRadians(float degrees) => degrees * MathF.PI / 180f;
}
```

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;
using CrowdSim.OpenGL.UI;
using ImGuiNET;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.Rendering;

/// <summary>
/// 3D isometric crowd renderer. Simulation physics stay on the 2D ground plane, but the world is
/// rendered as projected 3D geometry: raised walls, debris and simple humanoids with separate head,
/// torso, arms and legs. Dear ImGui submits the projected primitives through Silk.NET's OpenGL
/// backend, avoiding a second custom matrix/render pipeline.
/// </summary>
public sealed class WorldRenderer
{
    private const float WallHeight = 1.82f;
    private const float HumanoidHeight = 1.70f;
    private const float HumanoidWidth = 0.48f;

    // The original baseline used a 42-world-unit-tall humanoid. Render-only overlays that
    // were authored in those legacy world units must be scaled to metres as well; otherwise
    // panic rings and debug vectors become ~25x too large after the metric conversion.
    private const float LegacyRenderUnitMeters = HumanoidHeight / 42f;
    private const float MinimumAnimationBaseSpeedMetersPerStep = 0.25f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float StandingMotionThresholdMetersPerStep = 0.08f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float CrawlMotionStartMetersPerStep = 0.03f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float CrawlMotionFullMetersPerStep = 0.20f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float HeadingMotionThresholdSquared =
        1e-5f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float PanicRingMaxExpansionMeters = 5f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float DesiredVectorLengthMeters = 32f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float AvoidanceVectorLengthMeters = 30f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float HerdVectorLengthMeters = 28f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float BlastVectorLengthMeters = 26f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float SfmVectorMaxLengthMeters = 45f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private readonly Camera3D _camera = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<int, Vector2> _renderPositions = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<int, Agent> _agentById = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<int, Queue<Vector2>> _trails = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<int, float> _gaitPhases = new();
    private readonly HashSet<int> _activeAgentIds = new();
    private readonly HashSet<int> _visibleAgentIds = new();
    private readonly List<int> _staleAgentIds = new();
    private readonly List<RenderEntity> _renderEntities = new(768);
    private readonly List<CachedWallChunk> _cachedWallChunks = new(128);
    private readonly CachedBlastBand[] _cachedBlastBands =
    {
        new(), new(), new(), new(), new(),
    };
    private int _cachedWallLayoutVersion = -1;
    private int _cachedBlastLayoutHash = int.MinValue;
    private int _lastTrailFrame = -1;
    private Vector2 _canvasMin;
    private Vector2 _canvasMax;
    private int? _hiddenAgentId;
    private bool _followAgent;
    private int? _selectedAgentId;
    private int _currentFrameIndex;
    private float _currentSimulationSpeed = 1f;
    private float _orthographicHumanoidScreenHeight;
    private bool _adaptiveFastHumanoids;

    /// <summary>Whether the pointer is currently inside the 3D simulation canvas.</summary>
    public bool IsHovered { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Camera used by the world and exposed to the sidebar controls.</summary>
    public Camera3D Camera => _camera;

    /// <summary>Approximate visual width of a standing humanoid in world units.</summary>
    public float AgentVisualWidth => HumanoidWidth;

    /// <summary>CPU time used by the projected world draw on the latest frame.</summary>
    public double LastDrawMilliseconds { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Number of active agents that passed the renderer's viewport culling.</summary>
    public int LastVisibleAgentCount { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Clear render-only caches such as position smoothing and trails.</summary>
    public void ResetVisualState()
    {
        _renderPositions.Clear();
        _agentById.Clear();
        _trails.Clear();
        _gaitPhases.Clear();
        _activeAgentIds.Clear();
        _visibleAgentIds.Clear();
        _staleAgentIds.Clear();
        _renderEntities.Clear();
        _cachedWallChunks.Clear();
        foreach (CachedBlastBand band in _cachedBlastBands)
        {
            band.Clear();
        }
        _cachedWallLayoutVersion = -1;
        _cachedBlastLayoutHash = int.MinValue;
        _lastTrailFrame = -1;
        LastVisibleAgentCount = 0;
    }

    /// <summary>Draw the complete world into the currently active ImGui child window.</summary>
    internal void Draw(
        Simulation simulation,
        bool builderMode,
        BuilderTool builderTool,
        int blockageCells,
        int exitPersonsWide,
        int agentPlacementCount,
        int? selectedAgentId,
        Agent? cameraAgent,
        bool followAgent,
        bool povEnabled,
        float simulationSpeed,
        RenderDebugOptions debug)
    {
        long drawStartTimestamp = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        Vector2 available = ImGui.GetContentRegionAvail();
        available.X = Math.Max(100f, available.X);
        available.Y = Math.Max(100f, available.Y);

        ImGui.InvisibleButton("##crowd-world-canvas", available);
        _canvasMin = ImGui.GetItemRectMin();
        _canvasMax = ImGui.GetItemRectMax();
        IsHovered = ImGui.IsItemHovered();

        _hiddenAgentId = povEnabled ? cameraAgent?.AgentId : null;
        _followAgent = followAgent && cameraAgent is not null && !povEnabled;
        _selectedAgentId = selectedAgentId;
        _currentFrameIndex = simulation.FrameIndex;
        _currentSimulationSpeed = Math.Clamp(simulationSpeed, 0.05f, 32f);

        int activeCount = 0;
        _agentById.Clear();
        foreach (Agent candidate in simulation.Agents)
        {
            _agentById[candidate.AgentId] = candidate;
            if (candidate.IsActive)
            {
                activeCount++;
            }
        }

        // Adaptive presentation only: physics remains untouched. Keep the faceted 3D humanoid
        // for the normal overview because that is the intended visual style. The very cheap
        // screen-space figure is now reserved for genuinely heavy scenes / high speed and for
        // agents that are too small on screen for 3D limb facets to be useful. Hysteresis avoids
        // flickering between LODs while still protecting frame rate when the scene becomes heavy.
        if (_currentSimulationSpeed >= 4f || activeCount >= 220 || LastDrawMilliseconds >= 20.0)
        {
            _adaptiveFastHumanoids = true;
        }
        else if (_currentSimulationSpeed <= 2f && activeCount <= 170 && LastDrawMilliseconds <= 11.0)
        {
            _adaptiveFastHumanoids = false;
        }

        if (povEnabled && cameraAgent is not null)
        {
            _camera.ConfigurePov(
                _canvasMin,
                _canvasMax,
                cameraAgent.Position,
                GetHeading(cameraAgent),
                eyeHeight: HumanoidHeight * 0.88f);
        }
        else
        {
            _camera.Configure(
                _canvasMin,
                _canvasMax,
                simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters,
                simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters,
                maximumHeight: 3.24f,
                focusWorld: _followAgent ? cameraAgent?.Position : null);
        }

        if (IsHovered && MathF.Abs(ImGui.GetIO().MouseWheel) > 0.001f && !_camera.IsPov)
        {
            _camera.AdjustZoom(ImGui.GetIO().MouseWheel);
            _camera.Configure(
                _canvasMin,
                _canvasMax,
                simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters,
                simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters,
                maximumHeight: 3.24f,
                focusWorld: _followAgent ? cameraAgent?.Position : null);
        }

        // In the orthographic overview every standing humanoid has the same projected height.
        // Measure it once instead of projecting foot/head again for every agent. POV remains
        // perspective-correct and computes size per agent because distance matters there.
        _orthographicHumanoidScreenHeight = _camera.IsPov
            ? 0f
            : EstimateHumanoidScreenHeight(Vector2.Zero);

        ImDrawListPtr draw = ImGui.GetWindowDrawList();
        draw.PushClipRect(_canvasMin, _canvasMax, true);
        draw.AddRectFilled(_canvasMin, _canvasMax, Color(0.045f, 0.052f, 0.065f, 1f));

        DrawFloor(draw, simulation);
        DrawGrid(draw, simulation);
        DrawExitMarkers(draw, simulation);
        DrawExplosionGroundEffects(draw, simulation, debug);

        if (builderMode)
        {
            DrawPlannedAgentPlacements(draw, simulation);
        }

        if (debug.ShowCongestion)
        {
            DrawCongestion(draw, simulation);
        }

        UpdateRenderPositions(simulation);
        UpdateGaitPhases(simulation, simulationSpeed);
        UpdateTrails(simulation, debug.ShowTrails);
        DrawDepthSortedEntities(draw, simulation);
        DrawAgentOverlays(draw, simulation, selectedAgentId, debug);

        if (builderMode)
        {
            DrawBuilderPreview(draw, simulation, builderTool, blockageCells, exitPersonsWide, agentPlacementCount);
        }

        DrawWorldLegend(draw, simulation, builderMode);
        draw.PopClipRect();
        LastDrawMilliseconds =
            (Stopwatch.GetTimestamp() - drawStartTimestamp) * 1000.0 / Stopwatch.Frequency;
    }

    /// <summary>Convert the current mouse position to the Z=0 simulation ground plane.</summary>
    public bool TryMouseToWorld(out Vector2 world)
    {
        world = default;
        if (!IsHovered || !_camera.TryScreenToGround(ImGui.GetMousePos(), out Vector2 candidate))
        {
            return false;
        }

        world = candidate;
        return true;
    }

    private void DrawFloor(ImDrawListPtr draw, Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (_camera.IsPov)
        {
            // First-person view uses a simple horizon/floor backdrop. The actual room geometry
            // is still projected in front of it, but we avoid projecting a giant floor quad
            // through the near plane behind the agent's head.
            float horizonY = _canvasMin.Y + (_canvasMax.Y - _canvasMin.Y) * 0.43f;
            draw.AddRectFilled(
                _canvasMin,
                new Vector2(_canvasMax.X, horizonY),
                Color(0.035f, 0.043f, 0.055f, 1f));
            draw.AddRectFilled(
                new Vector2(_canvasMin.X, horizonY),
                _canvasMax,
                Color(0.13f, 0.16f, 0.19f, 1f));
            return;
        }

        float w = simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters;
        float h = simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters;
        DrawFlatQuad(
            draw,
            new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f),
            new Vector3(w, 0f, 0f),
            new Vector3(w, h, 0f),
            new Vector3(0f, h, 0f),
            Color(0.13f, 0.16f, 0.19f, 1f));
    }

    private void DrawGrid(ImDrawListPtr draw, Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (!simulation.Config.Grid.Enabled)
        {
            return;
        }

        float width = simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters;
        float height = simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters;
        float step = Math.Max(0.20f, simulation.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters);
        uint color = Color(0.24f, 0.27f, 0.31f, 0.55f);

        for (float x = 0f; x <= width; x += step)
        {
            DrawWorldLine(
                draw,
                new Vector3(x, 0f, 0.05f),
                new Vector3(x, height, 0.05f),
                color,
                1f);
        }

        for (float y = 0f; y <= height; y += step)
        {
            DrawWorldLine(
                draw,
                new Vector3(0f, y, 0.05f),
                new Vector3(width, y, 0.05f),
                color,
                1f);
        }
    }

    private void DrawExitMarkers(ImDrawListPtr draw, Simulation simulation)
    {
        foreach (Exit exit in simulation.Environment.Exits)
        {
            float half = Math.Max(0.08f, exit.Size);
            Vector4 glow = new(0.08f, 0.72f, 0.95f, 0.78f);
            Vector4 post = new(0.12f, 0.82f, 1.00f, 1f);
            const float depth = 0.36f;

            if (exit.Side is "N" or "S")
            {
                DrawFlatQuad(
                    draw,
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X - half, exit.Position.Y - depth, 0.15f),
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X + half, exit.Position.Y - depth, 0.15f),
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X + half, exit.Position.Y + depth, 0.15f),
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X - half, exit.Position.Y + depth, 0.15f),
                    Color(glow));

                DrawOrientedPrism(draw, new Vector2(exit.Position.X - half, exit.Position.Y),
                    -0.08f, 0.08f, -0.08f, 0.08f, 0f, 1.38f, 0f, post);
                DrawOrientedPrism(draw, new Vector2(exit.Position.X + half, exit.Position.Y),
                    -0.08f, 0.08f, -0.08f, 0.08f, 0f, 1.38f, 0f, post);
            }
            else
            {
                DrawFlatQuad(
                    draw,
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X - depth, exit.Position.Y - half, 0.15f),
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X + depth, exit.Position.Y - half, 0.15f),
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X + depth, exit.Position.Y + half, 0.15f),
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X - depth, exit.Position.Y + half, 0.15f),
                    Color(glow));

                DrawOrientedPrism(draw, new Vector2(exit.Position.X, exit.Position.Y - half),
                    -0.08f, 0.08f, -0.08f, 0.08f, 0f, 1.38f, 0f, post);
                DrawOrientedPrism(draw, new Vector2(exit.Position.X, exit.Position.Y + half),
                    -0.08f, 0.08f, -0.08f, 0.08f, 0f, 1.38f, 0f, post);
            }
        }
    }

    private void DrawExplosionGroundEffects(
        ImDrawListPtr draw,
        Simulation simulation,
        RenderDebugOptions debug)
    {
        Explosion? explosion = simulation.Environment.Explosion;
        if (explosion is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        // Persistent analysis zones. The five annuli use the same configured radii as the
        // event physics, are clipped by room boundaries/walls, and are rendering-only after
        // the one-time shock outcome has been applied.
        if (debug.ShowBlastZones)
        {
            DrawPersistentBlastZones(draw, simulation, explosion.Position, debug);
        }

        int elapsed = Math.Max(0, simulation.FrameIndex - explosion.TriggeredFrame);
        float shockRadius = Math.Min(
            simulation.Config.Agent.HeatRadius,
            elapsed * simulation.Config.Agent.ShockwaveSpeedMetersPerFrame);
        int frontEndFrame = (int)MathF.Ceiling(
            simulation.Config.Agent.HeatRadius /
            Math.Max(simulation.Config.Agent.ShockwaveSpeedMetersPerFrame, 1e-5f)) + 3;

        // Active event presentation remains a thin, fast, translucent shock front.
        if (elapsed <= frontEndFrame && shockRadius > 1f)
        {
            DrawShieldedGroundRing(
                draw,
                simulation,
                explosion.Position,
                Math.Max(0.04f, shockRadius - 0.28f),
                shockRadius + 0.20f,
                0.82f,
                new Vector4(0.82f, 0.92f, 1f, 0.16f),
                _adaptiveFastHumanoids ? 56 : 96);
            DrawShieldedGroundCircle(
                draw,
                simulation,
                explosion.Position,
                shockRadius,
                0.90f,
                new Vector4(0.96f, 0.99f, 1f, 0.74f),
                _adaptiveFastHumanoids ? 64 : 112);
        }
    }

    private void DrawPersistentBlastZones(
        ImDrawListPtr draw,
        Simulation simulation,
        Vector2 origin,
        RenderDebugOptions debug)
    {
        EnsurePersistentBlastCache(simulation, origin);

        // Draw outer-to-inner non-overlapping bands so the display remains readable.
        if (debug.ShowPanicZone)
        {
            DrawCachedBlastBand(draw, _cachedBlastBands[4]);
        }

        if (debug.ShowInjuryZone)
        {
            DrawCachedBlastBand(draw, _cachedBlastBands[3]);
        }

        if (debug.ShowFallenZone)
        {
            DrawCachedBlastBand(draw, _cachedBlastBands[2]);
        }

        if (debug.ShowIncapacitationZone)
        {
            DrawCachedBlastBand(draw, _cachedBlastBands[1]);
        }

        if (debug.ShowKillZone)
        {
            DrawCachedBlastBand(draw, _cachedBlastBands[0]);
        }
    }

    private void EnsurePersistentBlastCache(Simulation simulation, Vector2 origin)
    {
        var config = simulation.Config.Agent;
        HashCode hash = new();
        hash.Add(simulation.Environment.WallLayoutVersion);
        hash.Add(origin.X);
        hash.Add(origin.Y);
        hash.Add(config.HardKillRadius);
        hash.Add(config.HeatIncapacityRadius);
        hash.Add(config.FallenRadius);
        hash.Add(config.InjuryRadius);
        hash.Add(config.HeatRadius);
        int layoutHash = hash.ToHashCode();
        if (layoutHash == _cachedBlastLayoutHash)
        {
            return;
        }

        _cachedBlastLayoutHash = layoutHash;
        BuildCachedBlastBand(
            _cachedBlastBands[0], simulation, origin, 0f, config.HardKillRadius, BlastZoneStyle.Kill);
        BuildCachedBlastBand(
            _cachedBlastBands[1], simulation, origin, config.HardKillRadius, config.HeatIncapacityRadius,
            BlastZoneStyle.Incapacitation);
        BuildCachedBlastBand(
            _cachedBlastBands[2], simulation, origin, config.HeatIncapacityRadius, config.FallenRadius,
            BlastZoneStyle.Fallen);
        BuildCachedBlastBand(
```
