## scripts/compare-performance.ps1

```powershell
param(
    [int]$Rounds = 3,
    [double]$AllowedRegressionPercent = 0
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$results = Join-Path $root 'validation'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $results | Out-Null
if ($Rounds -lt 1) { throw 'Rounds must be positive.' }
function Run-Dotnet([string[]]$Arguments) {
    & dotnet @Arguments
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "dotnet failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
}
function Get-Median($Values) {
    $sorted = @($Values | Sort-Object)
    $mid = [int][Math]::Floor($sorted.Count / 2)
    if ($sorted.Count % 2) { return [double]$sorted[$mid] }
    return ([double]$sorted[$mid - 1] + [double]$sorted[$mid]) / 2
}
Push-Location $root
try {
    Run-Dotnet -Arguments @('test', 'CrowdSim.sln', '-c', 'Release', '--logger',
        'trx;LogFileName=regression.trx', '--results-directory', $results)
    foreach ($label in @('Baseline', 'Updated')) {
        Run-Dotnet -Arguments @('build', "benchmarks/$label.csproj", '-c', 'Release',
            '-o', (Join-Path $results "$label-bin"))
    }
    for ($round = 0; $round -lt $Rounds; $round++) {
        $labels = if ($round % 2 -eq 0) { @('Baseline', 'Updated') } else { @('Updated', 'Baseline') }
        foreach ($label in $labels) {
            Write-Host "Round $($round + 1)/${Rounds}: $label (100, 200, 500, 1000 agents)"
            $dll = Join-Path $results "$label-bin/CrowdSim.Bench.$label.dll"
            $csv = Join-Path $results "$label-$round.csv"
            & dotnet $dll $csv (42 + $round) > (Join-Path $results "$label-$round.log")
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "$label benchmark failed; see validation/$label-$round.log" }
        }
    }
    $all = @{}
    foreach ($label in @('Baseline', 'Updated')) {
        $all[$label] = @(for ($round = 0; $round -lt $Rounds; $round++) {
            Import-Csv (Join-Path $results "$label-$round.csv")
        })
    }
    $culture = [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture
    $summary = foreach ($group in ($all['Baseline'] | Group-Object Mode, Agents)) {
        $first = $group.Group[0]
        $candidate = @($all['Updated'] | Where-Object {
            $_.Mode -eq $first.Mode -and $_.Agents -eq $first.Agents
        })
        $oldMedian = Get-Median @($group.Group | ForEach-Object { [double]::Parse($_.MedianMs, $culture) })
        $newMedian = Get-Median @($candidate | ForEach-Object { [double]::Parse($_.MedianMs, $culture) })
        $oldP95 = Get-Median @($group.Group | ForEach-Object { [double]::Parse($_.P95Ms, $culture) })
        $newP95 = Get-Median @($candidate | ForEach-Object { [double]::Parse($_.P95Ms, $culture) })
        $medianChange = 100 * ($newMedian / [Math]::Max($oldMedian, 0.000001) - 1)
        $p95Change = 100 * ($newP95 / [Math]::Max($oldP95, 0.000001) - 1)
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Mode = $first.Mode; Agents = $first.Agents
            BaselineMedianMs = $oldMedian; UpdatedMedianMs = $newMedian
            BaselineP95Ms = $oldP95; UpdatedP95Ms = $newP95
            MedianChangePercent = [Math]::Round($medianChange, 2)
            P95ChangePercent = [Math]::Round($p95Change, 2)
            Status = if ($medianChange -le $AllowedRegressionPercent -and
                $p95Change -le $AllowedRegressionPercent) { 'PASS' } else { 'REVIEW' }
        }
    }
    $summary | Export-Csv (Join-Path $results 'comparison.csv') -NoTypeInformation
    $summary | Format-Table Mode, Agents, MedianChangePercent, P95ChangePercent, Status -AutoSize
    if (@($summary | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'REVIEW' }).Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Warning 'Latency gate not met. Inspect comparison.csv and logs; do not claim no regression.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Host 'Regression suite and CPU benchmark latency gate passed on this machine.'
    Write-Host 'GPU submission, input latency, recording, and full-window FPS still require an app check.'
}
finally {
    Pop-Location
}
```

```powershell
[CmdletBinding()]
param(

    [ValidateSet('Explosion', 'ToxicFume')]
    [string]$Scenario = 'Explosion'
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if (-not (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    throw 'A .NET 8 SDK is required. Install it, reopen PowerShell, and run dotnet --info.'
}
function Invoke-DotNet {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)

}
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
Push-Location $root
try {
    Invoke-DotNet -Arguments @('restore', 'CrowdSim.sln')
    Invoke-DotNet -Arguments @('build', 'CrowdSim.sln', '-c', 'Release', '--no-restore')
    $testArguments = @('test', 'tests/CrowdSim.Tests/CrowdSim.Tests.csproj', '-c', 'Release', '--no-build', '--no-restore', '--logger', 'trx;LogFileName=natural-navigation.trx', '--results-directory', 'validation/natural-navigation')
    if ($NavigationOnly) { $testArguments += @('--filter', 'FullyQualifiedName~NaturalNavigationTests|FullyQualifiedName~ToxicFumeScenarioTests') }
    Invoke-DotNet -Arguments $testArguments

    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.Core/Configuration/SimulationConfig.cs

```csharp
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;

/// <summary>
/// Top-level configuration object. This replaces the Python module-level WINDOW,
/// AGENT, COLORS and GRID singletons while preserving their default values.
/// </summary>
public sealed class SimulationConfig
{
    /// <summary>Opt-in adaptive movement and shared routing; false preserves the reference model.</summary>
    public bool HybridEnabled { get; set; }
    public WorldConfig World { get; } = new();
    public AgentConfig Agent { get; init; } = new();
    public ColorPalette Colors { get; } = new();
    public GridConfig Grid { get; }

    public SimulationConfig()
    {
        Grid = new GridConfig { CellSizeMeters = 6f * AgentConfig.RadiusMeters };
    }

    /// <summary>Create an independent configuration using the validated Python defaults.</summary>
    public static SimulationConfig CreateDefault() => new();
}

/// <summary>Metric simulation-world dimensions. All ground-plane coordinates are metres.</summary>
public sealed class WorldConfig
{
    public const float DefaultWidthMeters = 56.0f;
    public const float DefaultLengthMeters = 34.0f;

    public float WidthMeters { get; private set; } = DefaultWidthMeters;
    public float LengthMeters { get; private set; } = DefaultLengthMeters;
    public float MinWidthMeters { get; init; } = 10.0f;
    public float MinLengthMeters { get; init; } = 10.0f;
    public float MaxWidthMeters { get; init; } = 160.0f;
    public float MaxLengthMeters { get; init; } = 120.0f;

    /// <summary>Apply metric room dimensions. Display-window pixels are intentionally unrelated.</summary>
    public void ApplySize(float? widthMeters = null, float? lengthMeters = null)
    {
        if (widthMeters is not null)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(widthMeters.Value) || widthMeters.Value <= 0f)
            {
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(widthMeters));
            }

            WidthMeters = Math.Clamp(widthMeters.Value, MinWidthMeters, MaxWidthMeters);
        }

        if (lengthMeters is not null)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(lengthMeters.Value) || lengthMeters.Value <= 0f)
            {
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(lengthMeters));
            }

            LengthMeters = Math.Clamp(lengthMeters.Value, MinLengthMeters, MaxLengthMeters);
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>Validated agent, SFM, panic, blast and flow constants.</summary>
public sealed class AgentConfig
{
    public int Count { get; init; } = 200;
    public const float HeightMeters = 1.70f;
    public const float RadiusMeters = 0.20f;

    /// <summary>Fixed standing height for every agent, in metres.</summary>
    public float Height => HeightMeters;

    /// <summary>Physical ground-plane body radius, in metres.</summary>
    public float Radius { get; init; } = RadiusMeters;

    /// <summary>Scenario-level controls for bounded behavioural heterogeneity.</summary>
    public BehaviorTuningConfig Behavior { get; } = new();

    public float BaseSpeedMin { get; init; } = 0.040f;
    public float BaseSpeedMax { get; init; } = 0.081f;
    public float PanicSpeedGain { get; init; } = 3.0f;
    public float EvacuationSpeedFloorMultiplier { get; init; } = 1.85f;
    public float FollowCrowdSpeedMultiplier { get; init; } = 2.05f;
    public float ThreatEscapeSpeedMultiplier { get; init; } = 2.65f;
    public float AssistanceApproachSpeedMultiplier { get; init; } = 1.30f;
    public float MaximumBehaviorSpeedMultiplier { get; init; } = 3.60f;
    public float ReactionDelayMin { get; init; } = 10.0f;
    public float ReactionDelayMax { get; init; } = 60.0f;
    public int FreezeMinFrames { get; init; } = 3;
    public int FreezeMaxFrames { get; init; } = 20;

    public float SfmA { get; init; } = 2000.0f;
    public float SfmB { get; init; } = 0.08f;
    public float SfmK { get; init; } = 120000.0f;
    public float SfmKappa { get; init; } = 240000.0f;
    public float RelaxationTime { get; init; } = 0.5f;
    public float SfmInteractionRadius { get; init; } = 2.43f;
    // Public velocity values retain the existing metres-per-reference-step convention.
    // Force calculations convert to SI; actual displacement scales with Dt below.
    public const float ReferenceStepSeconds = 0.15f;
    public float Dt { get; init; } = ReferenceStepSeconds;
    public float StepScale => Dt / ReferenceStepSeconds;
    /// <summary>Convert legacy duration constants to ticks at the selected Dt.</summary>
    public int ReferenceFramesToTicks(float frames)
        => Math.Max(1, (int)MathF.Ceiling(frames / StepScale));
    public float RetentionAtStep(float retention)
        => StepScale == 1f ? retention : MathF.Pow(retention, StepScale);
    public float MaxAccelerationMetersPerSecondSquared { get; init; } = 3.0f;
    /// <summary>Abstract admission limit per doorway lane, in people per second.</summary>
    public float ExitAdmissionsPerLanePerSecond { get; init; } = 1f / ReferenceStepSeconds;
    public float Mass { get; init; } = 80.0f;
    public float MaxSpeed { get; init; } = 0.607f;
    public float NeighbourRadius { get; init; } = 2.43f;

    public float VisionRange { get; init; } = 4.05f;
    public float VisionHalfAngleDeg { get; init; } = 45.0f;

    public float PanicThreatScale { get; init; } = 8.10f;
    public float PanicKThreat { get; init; } = 0.5f;
    public float PanicKSocial { get; init; } = 0.7f;
    public float PanicKRunning { get; init; } = 0.45f;
    // Legacy per-step decay is retained for configuration compatibility but the behavioural
    // rebuild uses the time-based decay constants below so results are stable if Dt changes.
    public float PanicKDecay { get; init; } = 0.1f;
    public float PanicDecayTimeConstantSeconds { get; init; } = 8.0f;
    public float PanicStimulusRiseSeconds { get; init; } = 0.20f;
    public float PanicActivationThreshold { get; init; } = 0.4f;

    // Only an agent inside a finite active-alarm window may transmit social/running
    // panic. Residual panic can remain after that window, but it is not a contagion source.
    public float PanicSocialSignalThreshold { get; init; } = 0.25f;
    public float DirectAlarmSignalSeconds { get; init; } = 5.0f;
    public float RelayedAlarmSignalSeconds { get; init; } = 4.0f;
    public float DirectAlarmPanicFloor { get; init; } = 0.50f;
    public float RelayedAlarmPanicFloor { get; init; } = 0.45f;
    public float SocialAlarmActivationStimulus { get; init; } = 0.16f;
    public float RunningAlarmActivationStimulus { get; init; } = 0.12f;
    public float SocialAlarmReactionDelayScale { get; init; } = 0.65f;

    // Behavioural emergency awareness is deliberately separate from emotional panic.
    // A coherent nearby flow of evacuees can make an unaware pedestrian start evacuating,
    // but it does not create or refresh a panic alarm episode.
    public float EvacuationAwarenessRadius { get; init; } = 3.85f;
    public int EvacuationAwarenessMinVisibleEvacuees { get; init; } = 2;
    public int EvacuationAwarenessCrowdOverrideCount { get; init; } = 4;
    public float EvacuationAwarenessMinSpeedFactor { get; init; } = 0.55f;
    public float EvacuationAwarenessCoherenceThreshold { get; init; } = 0.35f;
    public float EvacuationAwarenessReactionDelayScale { get; init; } = 0.35f;
    public float RunningContagionRadius { get; init; } = 3.85f;
    public float RunningContagionMinSpeedFactor { get; init; } = 1.30f;
    public int RunningContagionMinVisibleRunners { get; init; } = 2;
    public float RunningContagionCoherenceThreshold { get; init; } = 0.45f;
    public float DirectThreatDurationSeconds { get; init; } = 4.0f;
    public float DirectThreatDecaySeconds { get; init; } = 1.8f;
    public float HerdingLambdaMax { get; init; } = 0.8f;

    // Behaviour-model rebuild: heterogeneous, bounded emergency response. These are abstract
    // human-response timings/weights for the simulator and are not claims about any individual.
    public float ThreatEscapeMinSeconds { get; init; } = 0.8f;
    public float ThreatEscapeMaxSeconds { get; init; } = 2.4f;
    public float FollowCrowdCommitSeconds { get; init; } = 2.0f;
    public float FollowCrowdMinimumTendency { get; init; } = 0.42f;
    public float AssistanceMinimumTendency { get; init; } = 0.72f;
    public float AssistanceMaxPanic { get; init; } = 0.68f;
    public float AssistancePerceptionRadius { get; init; } = 3.04f;
    public float AssistanceReachRadiusFactor { get; init; } = 2.8f;
    public float AssistancePauseSeconds { get; init; } = 2.0f;
    public int AssistanceMaxHelpersPerCasualty { get; init; } = 2;

    // Assistance approach guardrails. Helpers use two body-clear positions on opposite
    // sides of a casualty instead of driving both centres toward the same coordinate.
    // Recovery is based on lack of meaningful progress toward the current assistance
    // position, not total approach duration. Sideways shuffling does not reset the timer.
    public float AssistanceSlotDistanceFactor { get; init; } = 2.55f;
    public float AssistanceSlotArrivalToleranceFactor { get; init; } = 0.80f;
    public float AssistanceMeaningfulProgressMeters { get; init; } = 0.05f;
    public float AssistanceReplanNoProgressSeconds { get; init; } = 2.0f;
    public float AssistanceAlternateSideNoProgressSeconds { get; init; } = 6.0f;
    public float AssistanceAbandonNoProgressSeconds { get; init; } = 10.0f;

    // Static-geometry route planning. A visibility graph over body-inflated blockage corners
    // supplies waypoints; SFM remains responsible for local contact and collision dynamics.
    public float RouteCornerBuffer { get; init; } = 0.20f;
    public float RouteWaypointReachFactor { get; init; } = 0.75f;
    public float RouteReplanSeconds { get; init; } = 2.0f;

    // Shared Explosion/Toxic Fume navigation refinement. These are tunable behavioural heuristics,
    // not empirically calibrated human reaction constants. Both hazard scenarios share recovery.
    public bool NaturalNavigationEnabled { get; init; } = true;
    public float NaturalDecisionSeconds { get; init; } = 0.30f;
    public float NaturalNoProgressSeconds { get; init; } = 1.65f;
    public float NaturalDetourCommitSeconds { get; init; } = 3.2f;
    public float NaturalExitReconsiderSeconds { get; init; } = 6.0f;
    public float NaturalFailureMemorySeconds { get; init; } = 12.0f;
    public float NaturalPerceptionRadiusMeters { get; init; } = 7.0f;
    public float NaturalCircleMaximumSeconds { get; init; } = 6.0f;
    public int NaturalRoutePlansPerStep { get; init; } = 4;
    public int NaturalRecoveryProbesPerStep { get; init; } = 24;
    /// <summary>Preference weight for locally perceived fume on a recovery/exit intention; not a toxicity constant.</summary>
    public float NaturalToxicRiskWeight { get; init; } = 5.0f;

    // Stage 3 perception / rerouting. These are abstract crowd-simulation parameters,
    // not real-world blast or medical calibration constants.
    public float DustVisibilityRadius { get; init; } = 12.14f;
    public float DustPeakVisibilityLoss { get; init; } = 0.65f;
    public float DustBuildSeconds { get; init; } = 0.6f;
    public float DustHoldSeconds { get; init; } = 2.5f;
    public float DustDecaySeconds { get; init; } = 8.0f;
    public float MinimumVisibilityFactor { get; init; } = 0.35f;
    public float RouteCommitmentSeconds { get; init; } = 3.5f;
    public float ExitSwitchImprovementRatio { get; init; } = 0.80f;
    public float ExitCongestionWeight { get; init; } = 0.36f;
    public float ExitCasualtyWeight { get; init; } = 0.97f;
    public float ExitOcclusionPenalty { get; init; } = 3.64f;
    public float ExitVisibilityPenalty { get; init; } = 2.83f;
    public float LocalCongestionRadius { get; init; } = 1.82f;
    public float FallenAvoidanceRadiusFactor { get; init; } = 6.0f;

    // Dynamic slow-casualty bypass. Crawlers remain physical SFM obstacles and panic/alarm
    // sources, but they are not evacuation-flow leaders. A pedestrian that stays directly
    // behind a materially slower crawler briefly commits to a body-clear side point when
    // static geometry and local occupancy leave usable lateral space.
    public float SlowObstacleBypassDetectionRadiusFactor { get; init; } = 6.5f;
    public float SlowObstacleBypassForwardCorridorFactor { get; init; } = 2.8f;
    public float SlowObstacleBypassObservationSeconds { get; init; } = 0.55f;
    public float SlowObstacleBypassLateralOffsetFactor { get; init; } = 3.5f;
    public float SlowObstacleBypassForwardOffsetFactor { get; init; } = 0.50f;
    public float SlowObstacleBypassCommitSeconds { get; init; } = 1.8f;
    public float SlowObstacleBypassMaxSpeedRatio { get; init; } = 0.70f;
    public float SlowObstacleBypassDynamicClearanceFactor { get; init; } = 1.60f;

    // During the short post-blast ThreatEscape phase, casualty piles may block the preferred
    // radial direction. A mobile survivor may make a brief lateral/back-side detour into clear
    // floor, but the maximum radial backtrack is bounded so this never becomes sustained travel
    // back toward the explosion. SFM still owns the actual person-person dynamics.
    public float ThreatEscapeCasualtyBypassProbeDistanceFactor { get; init; } = 5.5f;
    public float ThreatEscapeCasualtyBypassCommitSeconds { get; init; } = 1.2f;
    public float ThreatEscapeCasualtyBypassMaxBacktrackMeters { get; init; } = 0.45f;
    public float ThreatEscapeCasualtyBypassOccupancyRadiusFactor { get; init; } = 3.0f;

    // If no immediate body-clear bypass exists, stop left/right thrashing and use a bounded
    // human-like response sequence: wait briefly, seek a wider gap, then accept tighter social
    // spacing if a physically valid narrow gap appears. Hard body collision is never relaxed.
    public float CasualtyGapWaitMinSeconds { get; init; } = 0.45f;
    public float CasualtyGapWaitMaxSeconds { get; init; } = 1.30f;
    public float CasualtyGapSeekCommitSeconds { get; init; } = 1.35f;
    public float CasualtyPressAfterSeconds { get; init; } = 2.60f;
    public float CasualtyGapProbeDistanceFactor { get; init; } = 7.0f;
    public float CasualtyPressPersonalSpaceCompression { get; init; } = 0.24f;
    public float CasualtyPressSpeedFactor { get; init; } = 0.82f;

    // Curved static-obstacle recovery. An evacuating pedestrian close to a circular blockage
    // follows one tangent direction for a short commitment window instead of alternating
    // between desired-force penetration and collision push-out every frame.
    public float CircleFollowActivationDistanceFactor { get; init; } = 2.5f;
    public float CircleFollowProbeDistanceFactor { get; init; } = 6.0f;
    public float CircleFollowCommitSeconds { get; init; } = 1.80f;
    public float CircleFollowMinimumCommitSeconds { get; init; } = 0.40f;
    public float CircleFollowReleaseClearanceFactor { get; init; } = 2.0f;
    public float CircleFollowSpeedFactor { get; init; } = 0.92f;

    // Local exploration / wall-end recovery. A stuck pedestrian probes wall-clear
    // temporary waypoints instead of committing to a random wall tangent. The short
    // replan interval provides heading commitment and prevents left/right thrashing.
    public float ExplorationProbeDistance { get; init; } = 1.94f;
    public int ExplorationDirectionSamples { get; init; } = 16;
    public float ExplorationReplanSeconds { get; init; } = 1.35f;
    public float ExplorationLowSpeedFactor { get; init; } = 0.15f;
    public float ExplorationEndpointClearanceFactor { get; init; } = 0.75f;

    // Navigation uses body clearance rather than centre-point visibility. The stuck
    // detector samples net displacement over a short window so rotation/jitter at a
    // wall end does not masquerade as useful progress.
    public float NavigationClearanceFactor { get; init; } = 1.05f;
    public float StuckProgressWindowSeconds { get; init; } = 0.75f;
    public float StuckMinimumTravelFactor { get; init; } = 0.40f;
    public float StuckMinimumExitProgressFactor { get; init; } = 0.20f;

    // Exit-congestion behaviour. A rejected pedestrian is displaced once, then either
    // yields for a short panic-dependent interval or maintains forward pressure.
    // High panic never bypasses exit capacity, wall or collision guardrails.
    public float ExitPushPanicThreshold { get; init; } = 0.80f;
    public float ExitYieldMinimumSeconds { get; init; } = 0.20f;
    public float ExitYieldMaximumSeconds { get; init; } = 0.90f;
    public float ExitRetryJitterSeconds { get; init; } = 0.25f;
    public float ExitInitialSetbackMin { get; init; } = 0.08f;
    public float ExitInitialSetbackMax { get; init; } = 0.20f;

    // Final approach corridor. Once a body-clear route to the selected doorway is
    // recovered, the doorway target dominates herding so agents do not orbit a nearby
    // group instead of completing egress. Wide openings use stable per-agent lane targets.
    public float ExitCaptureRadius { get; init; } = 4.86f;
    public float ExitLaneSpreadFactor { get; init; } = 0.65f;
    public float ExitCaptureMotorBlend { get; init; } = 0.36f;

    // Bounded bottleneck-pressure model. These values govern local doorway interaction,
    // not global panic: dense delayed pedestrians may yield, seek a lateral gap, or press
    // while the physical body radius, force caps and exit-capacity guardrails remain active.
    public float BottleneckInfluenceRadius { get; init; } = 3.64f;
    public float BottleneckDensityReference { get; init; } = 7.0f;
    public float BottleneckMinimumCongestion { get; init; } = 0.18f;
    public float BottleneckWaitReferenceSeconds { get; init; } = 2.4f;
    public float BottleneckPressureRiseSeconds { get; init; } = 0.65f;
    public float BottleneckPressureDecaySeconds { get; init; } = 1.40f;
    public float BottleneckSeekGapThreshold { get; init; } = 0.36f;
    public float BottleneckPressThreshold { get; init; } = 0.68f;
    public float BottleneckPressReleaseThreshold { get; init; } = 0.50f;
    public float BottleneckModeCommitSeconds { get; init; } = 0.85f;
    public float BottleneckGapProbeDistanceFactor { get; init; } = 3.5f;
    public float BottleneckGapBlendMin { get; init; } = 0.18f;
    public float BottleneckGapBlendMax { get; init; } = 0.42f;
    public float BottleneckPressSpeedGain { get; init; } = 0.18f;
    public float BottleneckPressRelaxationReduction { get; init; } = 0.35f;

    public const float DefaultHardKillRadius = 1.58f;
    public const float DefaultHeatIncapacityRadius = 3.16f;
    public const float DefaultFallenRadius = 6.31f;
    public const float DefaultInjuryRadius = 9.47f;
    public const float DefaultHeatRadius = 18.21f;
    private const float MinimumBlastZoneRadius = 0.10f;
    private const float MaximumBlastZoneRadius = 200.0f;
    private const float MinimumBlastZoneGap = 0.10f;

    /// <summary>Inner abstract simulation zone that produces the terminal direct-blast outcome.</summary>
    public float HardKillRadius { get; private set; } = DefaultHardKillRadius;

    /// <summary>Abstract direct-blast temporary-incapacitation zone.</summary>
    public float HeatIncapacityRadius { get; private set; } = DefaultHeatIncapacityRadius;

    /// <summary>Abstract direct-blast severe/fallen zone.</summary>
    public float FallenRadius { get; private set; } = DefaultFallenRadius;

    /// <summary>Abstract direct-blast injury zone.</summary>
    public float InjuryRadius { get; private set; } = DefaultInjuryRadius;

    /// <summary>Outer direct-threat/panic zone and maximum propagating shock-front radius.</summary>
    public float HeatRadius { get; private set; } = DefaultHeatRadius;

    /// <summary>
    /// Set the five metric blast-zone radii while preserving strict inner-to-outer ordering.
    /// These are simulator tuning values, not real-world explosive-yield or medical calibration data.
    /// </summary>
    public void SetBlastZoneRadii(
        float hardKillRadius,
        float heatIncapacityRadius,
        float fallenRadius,
        float injuryRadius,
        float heatRadius)
    {
        if (!float.IsFinite(hardKillRadius) ||
            !float.IsFinite(heatIncapacityRadius) ||
            !float.IsFinite(fallenRadius) ||
            !float.IsFinite(injuryRadius) ||
            !float.IsFinite(heatRadius))
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(hardKillRadius), "Blast-zone radii must be finite.");
        }

        HardKillRadius = Math.Clamp(
            hardKillRadius,
            MinimumBlastZoneRadius,
            MaximumBlastZoneRadius - 4f * MinimumBlastZoneGap);
        HeatIncapacityRadius = Math.Clamp(
            heatIncapacityRadius,
            HardKillRadius + MinimumBlastZoneGap,
            MaximumBlastZoneRadius - 3f * MinimumBlastZoneGap);
        FallenRadius = Math.Clamp(
            fallenRadius,
            HeatIncapacityRadius + MinimumBlastZoneGap,
            MaximumBlastZoneRadius - 2f * MinimumBlastZoneGap);
        InjuryRadius = Math.Clamp(
            injuryRadius,
            FallenRadius + MinimumBlastZoneGap,
            MaximumBlastZoneRadius - MinimumBlastZoneGap);
        HeatRadius = Math.Clamp(
            heatRadius,
            InjuryRadius + MinimumBlastZoneGap,
            MaximumBlastZoneRadius);
    }

    /// <summary>Restore the validated default metric blast-zone radii.</summary>
    public void ResetBlastZoneRadii()
        => SetBlastZoneRadii(
            DefaultHardKillRadius,
            DefaultHeatIncapacityRadius,
            DefaultFallenRadius,
            DefaultInjuryRadius,
            DefaultHeatRadius);

    public float ShockwaveSpeedMetersPerFrame { get; init; } = 1.21f;
    public float ShockwavePeakImpulse { get; init; } = 0.121f;
    public float ShockwaveDecayLength { get; init; } = 6.07f;
    public int BlastWindDurationFrames { get; init; } = 40;
    public float BlastWindStrength { get; init; } = 0.032f;
    public float ExplosionRepulsionCoeff { get; init; } = 5000.0f;

    // Lightweight debris-impact model. Severity is normalized for this simulator and
    // deliberately avoids real ordnance/yield calculations.
    public int DebrisCount { get; init; } = 36;
    public float DebrisSpeedMin { get; init; } = 0.40f;
    public float DebrisSpeedMax { get; init; } = 1.42f;
    public float DebrisReferenceSpeed { get; init; } = 1.42f;
    public float DebrisEnergyDecay { get; init; } = 0.975f;
    public float DebrisInjuryThreshold { get; init; } = 0.28f;
    public float DebrisFallenThreshold { get; init; } = 0.48f;
    public float DebrisIncapacityThreshold { get; init; } = 0.68f;
    public float DebrisFatalThreshold { get; init; } = 0.86f;

    public float InjuredSpeedFactor { get; init; } = 0.4f;
    public float CrawlSpeedFactor { get; init; } = 0.25f;
    public int CrawlDelayMin { get; init; } = 30;
    public int CrawlDelayMax { get; init; } = 120;

    public float ExitCapacityBase { get; init; } = 3.0f;
    public float ExitDensityFree { get; init; } = 0.2f;
    public float ExitDensityJam { get; init; } = 2.5f;
    public float ExitInfluenceRadius { get; init; } = 2.43f;
    public float ExitMinSpeedFactor { get; init; } = 0.25f;
}

/// <summary>
/// Scenario-level behaviour controls. Defaults preserve the validated Behaviour Rebuild 1
/// response while allowing bounded tuning before agents are spawned. These values are
/// abstract simulation parameters and do not represent demographic assumptions.
/// </summary>
public sealed class BehaviorTuningConfig
{
    public const float DefaultTraitVariation = 0.65f;
    public const float DefaultReactionVariation = 0.75f;
    public const float DefaultStressSusceptibility = 1.00f;
    public const float DefaultStressPersistence = 1.00f;
    public const float DefaultCrowdFollowing = 0.50f;
    public const float DefaultPersonalSpace = 1.00f;
    public const float DefaultPanicSpaceCompression = 0.20f;
    public const float DefaultEmergencyUrgency = 1.00f;
    // A locomotion ceiling, not a new desired speed or a playback multiplier.
    public const float DefaultMaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond = 0.607f / AgentConfig.ReferenceStepSeconds;
    public const float MinimumRunningSpeedLimitMetersPerSecond = 0.50f;
    public const float MaximumRunningSpeedLimitMetersPerSecond = 6.00f;
    public const float DefaultHelpingTendency = 0.50f;
    public const float DefaultRouteFamiliarity = 0.50f;
    public const float DefaultBottleneckAssertiveness = 0.50f;
    public const float DefaultBottleneckPressureSensitivity = 1.00f;
    public const float DefaultBottleneckSpaceCompression = 0.18f;

    public float TraitVariation { get; private set; } = DefaultTraitVariation;
    public float ReactionVariation { get; private set; } = DefaultReactionVariation;
    public float StressSusceptibility { get; private set; } = DefaultStressSusceptibility;
    public float StressPersistence { get; private set; } = DefaultStressPersistence;
    public float CrowdFollowing { get; private set; } = DefaultCrowdFollowing;
    public float PersonalSpace { get; private set; } = DefaultPersonalSpace;
    public float PanicSpaceCompression { get; private set; } = DefaultPanicSpaceCompression;
    public float EmergencyUrgency { get; private set; } = DefaultEmergencyUrgency;
    /// <summary>Ceiling for voluntary movement, in physical metres per second.</summary>
    public float MaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond { get; private set; } = DefaultMaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond;
    public float MaxRunningSpeedPerReferenceStep => MaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond * AgentConfig.ReferenceStepSeconds;

    /// <summary>Reject invalid values and clamp the user control; independent of integration Dt.</summary>
    public void SetMaxRunningSpeed(float metresPerSecond)
    {
        if (!float.IsFinite(metresPerSecond)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(metresPerSecond));
        MaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond = Math.Clamp(metresPerSecond,
            MinimumRunningSpeedLimitMetersPerSecond, MaximumRunningSpeedLimitMetersPerSecond);
    }

    public float HelpingTendency { get; private set; } = DefaultHelpingTendency;
    public float RouteFamiliarity { get; private set; } = DefaultRouteFamiliarity;
    public float BottleneckAssertiveness { get; private set; } = DefaultBottleneckAssertiveness;
    public float BottleneckPressureSensitivity { get; private set; } = DefaultBottleneckPressureSensitivity;
    public float BottleneckSpaceCompression { get; private set; } = DefaultBottleneckSpaceCompression;

    /// <summary>Apply finite values while keeping every behavioural control inside its safe range.</summary>
    public void SetValues(
        float traitVariation,
        float reactionVariation,
        float stressSusceptibility,
        float stressPersistence,
        float crowdFollowing,
        float personalSpace,
        float panicSpaceCompression,
        float emergencyUrgency,
        float helpingTendency,
        float routeFamiliarity,
        float bottleneckAssertiveness = DefaultBottleneckAssertiveness,
        float bottleneckPressureSensitivity = DefaultBottleneckPressureSensitivity,
        float bottleneckSpaceCompression = DefaultBottleneckSpaceCompression)
    {
        float[] values =
        {
            traitVariation,
            reactionVariation,
            stressSusceptibility,
            stressPersistence,
            crowdFollowing,
            personalSpace,
            panicSpaceCompression,
            emergencyUrgency,
            helpingTendency,
            routeFamiliarity,
            bottleneckAssertiveness,
            bottleneckPressureSensitivity,
            bottleneckSpaceCompression,
        };
        if (values.Any(value => !float.IsFinite(value)))
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(traitVariation), "Behaviour tuning values must be finite.");
        }

        TraitVariation = Math.Clamp(traitVariation, 0f, 1f);
        ReactionVariation = Math.Clamp(reactionVariation, 0f, 1f);
        StressSusceptibility = Math.Clamp(stressSusceptibility, 0.60f, 1.40f);
        StressPersistence = Math.Clamp(stressPersistence, 0.50f, 2.00f);
        CrowdFollowing = Math.Clamp(crowdFollowing, 0f, 1f);
        PersonalSpace = Math.Clamp(personalSpace, 0.85f, 1.30f);
        PanicSpaceCompression = Math.Clamp(panicSpaceCompression, 0f, 0.35f);
        EmergencyUrgency = Math.Clamp(emergencyUrgency, 0.80f, 1.30f);
        HelpingTendency = Math.Clamp(helpingTendency, 0f, 1f);
        RouteFamiliarity = Math.Clamp(routeFamiliarity, 0f, 1f);
        BottleneckAssertiveness = Math.Clamp(bottleneckAssertiveness, 0f, 1f);
        BottleneckPressureSensitivity = Math.Clamp(bottleneckPressureSensitivity, 0.50f, 1.50f);
        BottleneckSpaceCompression = Math.Clamp(bottleneckSpaceCompression, 0f, 0.35f);
    }

    public void Reset()
    {
        SetMaxRunningSpeed(DefaultMaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond);
        SetValues(
            DefaultTraitVariation,
            DefaultReactionVariation,
            DefaultStressSusceptibility,
            DefaultStressPersistence,
            DefaultCrowdFollowing,
            DefaultPersonalSpace,
            DefaultPanicSpaceCompression,
            DefaultEmergencyUrgency,
            DefaultHelpingTendency,
            DefaultRouteFamiliarity,
            DefaultBottleneckAssertiveness,
            DefaultBottleneckPressureSensitivity,
            DefaultBottleneckSpaceCompression);
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;

/// <summary>
/// Scenario-level parameters for the abstract toxic-fume model. Concentration is normalized
/// to [0,1]; these values are intentionally generic and are not calibrated to a named chemical.
/// </summary>
public sealed class ToxicFumeConfig
{
    public const float DefaultInitialRadiusMeters = 0.60f;
    public const float DefaultDispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond = 0.30f;
    public const float DefaultMaximumExtentMeters = 12.0f;
    public const float DefaultReleaseDurationSeconds = 30.0f;
    public const float DefaultDriftDirectionDegrees = 0.0f;
    public const float DefaultDriftBias = 0.0f;
    public const float DefaultGridCellSizeMeters = 0.50f;
    public const float DefaultAwarenessConcentration = 0.12f;
    public const float DefaultDangerConcentration = 0.55f;
    public const float DefaultImpairmentExposure = 8.0f;
    public const float DefaultIncapacitationExposure = 20.0f;
    public const float DefaultPostReleaseDecaySeconds = 24.0f;

    public float InitialRadiusMeters { get; private set; } = DefaultInitialRadiusMeters;
    public float DispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond { get; private set; } = DefaultDispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond;
    public float MaximumExtentMeters { get; private set; } = DefaultMaximumExtentMeters;
    public float ReleaseDurationSeconds { get; private set; } = DefaultReleaseDurationSeconds;
    public float DriftDirectionDegrees { get; private set; } = DefaultDriftDirectionDegrees;
    public float DriftBias { get; private set; } = DefaultDriftBias;
    public float GridCellSizeMeters { get; private set; } = DefaultGridCellSizeMeters;
    public float AwarenessConcentration { get; private set; } = DefaultAwarenessConcentration;
    public float DangerConcentration { get; private set; } = DefaultDangerConcentration;
    public float ImpairmentExposure { get; private set; } = DefaultImpairmentExposure;
    public float IncapacitationExposure { get; private set; } = DefaultIncapacitationExposure;
    public float PostReleaseDecaySeconds { get; private set; } = DefaultPostReleaseDecaySeconds;

    /// <summary>Monotonic setup revision used to invalidate precomputed plume caches.</summary>
    public int Revision { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Apply validated generic fume settings in one atomic update.</summary>
    public void SetValues(
        float initialRadiusMeters,
        float dispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond,
        float maximumExtentMeters,
        float releaseDurationSeconds,
        float driftDirectionDegrees,
        float driftBias,
        float awarenessConcentration,
        float dangerConcentration,
        float impairmentExposure,
        float incapacitationExposure)
    {
        InitialRadiusMeters = ClampFinite(initialRadiusMeters, 0.20f, 5.00f, DefaultInitialRadiusMeters);
        DispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond = ClampFinite(
            dispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond, 0.05f, 2.00f, DefaultDispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond);
        MaximumExtentMeters = ClampFinite(
            maximumExtentMeters, Math.Max(2.00f, InitialRadiusMeters), 60.0f, DefaultMaximumExtentMeters);
        ReleaseDurationSeconds = ClampFinite(releaseDurationSeconds, 1.0f, 180.0f, DefaultReleaseDurationSeconds);
        DriftDirectionDegrees = NormalizeDegrees(driftDirectionDegrees);
        DriftBias = ClampFinite(driftBias, 0.0f, 1.0f, DefaultDriftBias);
        AwarenessConcentration = ClampFinite(awarenessConcentration, 0.02f, 0.80f, DefaultAwarenessConcentration);
        DangerConcentration = ClampFinite(
            dangerConcentration,
            Math.Min(0.95f, AwarenessConcentration + 0.05f),
            0.98f,
            DefaultDangerConcentration);
        ImpairmentExposure = ClampFinite(impairmentExposure, 1.0f, 120.0f, DefaultImpairmentExposure);
        IncapacitationExposure = ClampFinite(
            incapacitationExposure,
            ImpairmentExposure + 1.0f,
            300.0f,
            DefaultIncapacitationExposure);
        Revision++;
    }

    public void ResetDefaults()
        => SetValues(
            DefaultInitialRadiusMeters,
            DefaultDispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond,
            DefaultMaximumExtentMeters,
            DefaultReleaseDurationSeconds,
            DefaultDriftDirectionDegrees,
            DefaultDriftBias,
            DefaultAwarenessConcentration,
            DefaultDangerConcentration,
            DefaultImpairmentExposure,
            DefaultIncapacitationExposure);

    private static float ClampFinite(float value, float minimum, float maximum, float fallback)
        => Math.Clamp(float.IsFinite(value) ? value : fallback, minimum, maximum);

    private static float NormalizeDegrees(float value)
    {
        if (!float.IsFinite(value))
        {
            return 0f;
        }

        value %= 360f;
        return value < 0f ? value + 360f : value;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;

/// <summary>Allocation-free helpers for metric circular obstacle geometry.</summary>
public static class CircleGeometry
{
    public static bool SegmentIntersectsCircle(
        Vector2 start,
        Vector2 end,
        Vector2 center,
        float radius)
    {
        float safeRadius = Math.Max(0f, radius);
        // Cheap conservative rejection is especially useful for short navigation-grid edges.
        if (center.X + safeRadius < Math.Min(start.X, end.X) ||
            center.X - safeRadius > Math.Max(start.X, end.X) ||
            center.Y + safeRadius < Math.Min(start.Y, end.Y) ||
            center.Y - safeRadius > Math.Max(start.Y, end.Y)) return false;
        Vector2 segment = end - start;
        float lengthSquared = segment.LengthSquared();
        if (!float.IsFinite(lengthSquared) || lengthSquared < 1e-8f)
        {
            return Vector2.DistanceSquared(start, center) <= safeRadius * safeRadius;
        }

        float t = Vector2.Dot(center - start, segment) / lengthSquared;
        t = Math.Clamp(t, 0f, 1f);
        Vector2 closest = start + t * segment;
        return Vector2.DistanceSquared(closest, center) <= safeRadius * safeRadius;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;

/// <summary>
/// Immutable oriented footprint. Axes and broad-phase bounds are computed once at
/// placement, not per pedestrian. Narrow-phase tests use its actual rotated shape.
/// </summary>
public readonly record struct OrientedRectangle
{
    public OrientedRectangle(Vector2 center, Vector2 halfExtents, float rotation)
    {
        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(center) || !VectorMath.IsFinite(halfExtents) ||
            halfExtents.X <= 0f || halfExtents.Y <= 0f || !float.IsFinite(rotation))
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(halfExtents));
        Center = center;
        HalfExtents = halfExtents;
        // Cardinal axes stay exact, including old saved quarter-turn placements.
        float cosine = MathF.Cos(rotation), sine = MathF.Sin(rotation);
        if (MathF.Abs(cosine) < 1e-6f) cosine = 0f;
        if (MathF.Abs(sine) < 1e-6f) sine = 0f;
        AxisX = Vector2.Normalize(new Vector2(cosine, sine));
        AxisY = new Vector2(-AxisX.Y, AxisX.X);
        BoundsHalfExtents = new Vector2(
            MathF.Abs(AxisX.X) * halfExtents.X + MathF.Abs(AxisY.X) * halfExtents.Y,
            MathF.Abs(AxisX.Y) * halfExtents.X + MathF.Abs(AxisY.Y) * halfExtents.Y);
    }

    public Vector2 Center { get; }
    public Vector2 HalfExtents { get; }
    public Vector2 AxisX { get; }
    public Vector2 AxisY { get; }
    public Vector2 BoundsHalfExtents { get; }
    public Vector2 Minimum => Center - BoundsHalfExtents;
    public Vector2 Maximum => Center + BoundsHalfExtents;

    public Vector2 ToLocal(Vector2 point)
    {
        Vector2 delta = point - Center;
        return new Vector2(Vector2.Dot(delta, AxisX), Vector2.Dot(delta, AxisY));
    }

    public Vector2 ToWorld(Vector2 point) => Center + AxisX * point.X + AxisY * point.Y;

    public Vector2 ClosestPoint(Vector2 point)
    {
        Vector2 local = ToLocal(point);
        return ToWorld(Vector2.Clamp(local, -HalfExtents, HalfExtents));
    }

    /// <summary>Point membership, optionally expanded by a circular body's radius.</summary>
    public bool Contains(Vector2 point, float clearance = 0f)
    {
        Vector2 local = ToLocal(point);
        Vector2 outside = Vector2.Max(Vector2.Abs(local) - HalfExtents, Vector2.Zero);
        float margin = Math.Max(0f, clearance);
        return outside.LengthSquared() <= margin * margin;
    }

    /// <summary>Separating-axis test; exact edge contact is not a positive-area overlap.</summary>
    public bool Overlaps(OrientedRectangle other, float tolerance = 0f)
    {
        Vector2 delta = other.Center - Center;
        return OverlapsOnAxis(other, delta, AxisX, tolerance) &&
            OverlapsOnAxis(other, delta, AxisY, tolerance) &&
            OverlapsOnAxis(other, delta, other.AxisX, tolerance) &&
            OverlapsOnAxis(other, delta, other.AxisY, tolerance);
    }

    private bool OverlapsOnAxis(OrientedRectangle other, Vector2 delta, Vector2 axis, float tolerance)
    {
        float radius = HalfExtents.X * MathF.Abs(Vector2.Dot(AxisX, axis)) +
            HalfExtents.Y * MathF.Abs(Vector2.Dot(AxisY, axis));
        float otherRadius = other.HalfExtents.X * MathF.Abs(Vector2.Dot(other.AxisX, axis)) +
            other.HalfExtents.Y * MathF.Abs(Vector2.Dot(other.AxisY, axis));
        return radius + otherRadius - MathF.Abs(Vector2.Dot(delta, axis)) > tolerance;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sweep a disc along a line. Two strips plus four corner discs are the exact
    /// rounded expansion of a rectangle, not its much larger world-aligned bounds.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IntersectsSegment(Vector2 start, Vector2 end, float clearance = 0f)
    {
        Vector2 a = ToLocal(start), b = ToLocal(end);
        float margin = Math.Max(0f, clearance);
        if (!IntersectsBox(a, b, HalfExtents + new Vector2(margin))) return false;
        if (margin == 0f || IntersectsBox(a, b, HalfExtents + new Vector2(margin, 0f)) ||
            IntersectsBox(a, b, HalfExtents + new Vector2(0f, margin))) return true;
        return SegmentTouchesDisc(a, b, HalfExtents, margin) ||
            SegmentTouchesDisc(a, b, -HalfExtents, margin) ||
            SegmentTouchesDisc(a, b, new Vector2(HalfExtents.X, -HalfExtents.Y), margin) ||
            SegmentTouchesDisc(a, b, new Vector2(-HalfExtents.X, HalfExtents.Y), margin);
    }

    private static bool SegmentTouchesDisc(Vector2 a, Vector2 b, Vector2 center, float radius)
    {
        Vector2 delta = b - a;
        float squared = delta.LengthSquared();
        float t = squared > 1e-12f ? Math.Clamp(Vector2.Dot(center - a, delta) / squared, 0f, 1f) : 0f;
        return Vector2.DistanceSquared(a + t * delta, center) <= radius * radius;
    }

    private static bool IntersectsBox(Vector2 a, Vector2 b, Vector2 half)
    {
        Vector2 delta = b - a;
        float near = 0f, far = 1f;
        return ClipAxis(a.X, delta.X, half.X, ref near, ref far) &&
            ClipAxis(a.Y, delta.Y, half.Y, ref near, ref far);
    }

    private static bool ClipAxis(float origin, float direction, float half, ref float near, ref float far)
    {
        if (MathF.Abs(direction) < 1e-8f) return origin >= -half && origin <= half;
        float first = (-half - origin) / direction, last = (half - origin) / direction;
        if (first > last) (first, last) = (last, first);
        near = Math.Max(near, first);
        far = Math.Min(far, last);
        return near <= far;
    }

    /// <summary>Minimum translation to separate a pedestrian disc; zero means no penetration.</summary>
    public Vector2 CircleSeparation(Vector2 center, float radius)
    {
        Vector2 local = ToLocal(center);
        Vector2 closest = Vector2.Clamp(local, -HalfExtents, HalfExtents);
        Vector2 difference = local - closest;
        float squared = difference.LengthSquared();
        if (squared > 1e-12f)
        {
            if (squared >= radius * radius) return Vector2.Zero;
            float distance = MathF.Sqrt(squared);
            Vector2 correction = difference * ((radius - distance + 1e-5f) / distance);
            return AxisX * correction.X + AxisY * correction.Y;
        }
        float xDepth = HalfExtents.X - MathF.Abs(local.X) + radius;
        float yDepth = HalfExtents.Y - MathF.Abs(local.Y) + radius;
        return xDepth < yDepth
            ? AxisX * ((local.X < 0f ? -1f : 1f) * (xDepth + 1e-5f))
            : AxisY * ((local.Y < 0f ? -1f : 1f) * (yDepth + 1e-5f));
    }

    /// <summary>Four safe routing corners, expanded in the rectangle's own coordinate system.</summary>
    public void CopyExpandedCorners(Span<Vector2> corners, float margin)
    {
        if (corners.Length < 4) throw new ArgumentException("Four corners are required.", nameof(corners));
        Vector2 half = HalfExtents + new Vector2(Math.Max(0f, margin));
        corners[0] = ToWorld(-half);
        corners[1] = ToWorld(new Vector2(half.X, -half.Y));
        corners[2] = ToWorld(half);
        corners[3] = ToWorld(new Vector2(-half.X, half.Y));
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;

/// <summary>Numerically defensive 2D vector helpers shared by all simulation systems.</summary>
public static class VectorMath
{
    public const float Epsilon = 1e-5f;

    public static bool IsFinite(Vector2 v) => float.IsFinite(v.X) && float.IsFinite(v.Y);

    public static Vector2 SafeNormalize(Vector2 value)
    {
        if (!IsFinite(value))
        {
            return Vector2.Zero;
        }

        float length = value.Length();
        return length > Epsilon && float.IsFinite(length) ? value / length : Vector2.Zero;
    }

    public static Vector2 SafeNormalize(Vector2 value, Vector2 fallback)
    {
        Vector2 normalized = SafeNormalize(value);
        return normalized.LengthSquared() > Epsilon * Epsilon ? normalized : SafeNormalize(fallback);
    }

    public static Vector2 ClampMagnitude(Vector2 value, float maxMagnitude)
    {
        if (!IsFinite(value))
        {
            return Vector2.Zero;
        }

        float length = value.Length();
        if (length <= maxMagnitude || length <= Epsilon)
        {
            return value;
        }

        return value / length * maxMagnitude;
    }

    public static float Clamp(float value, float min, float max) => Math.Clamp(value, min, max);

    /// <summary>
    /// Clamps a continuous metric world position to the inclusive room bounds.
    /// Width and height are floats because simulation coordinates are measured in metres.
    /// </summary>
    public static Vector2 ClampToBounds(Vector2 value, float width, float height)
    {
        float safeWidth = Math.Max(0f, width);
        float safeHeight = Math.Max(0f, height);

        if (!IsFinite(value))
        {
            return new Vector2(safeWidth / 2f, safeHeight / 2f);
        }

        return new Vector2(
            Math.Clamp(value.X, 0f, safeWidth),
            Math.Clamp(value.Y, 0f, safeHeight));
    }

    public static Vector2 Perpendicular(Vector2 v) => new(-v.Y, v.X);

    public static Vector2 RandomUnit(Random random)
    {
        double angle = random.NextDouble() * Math.PI * 2.0;
        return new Vector2((float)Math.Cos(angle), (float)Math.Sin(angle));
    }

    public static Vector2 RandomGaussian2(Random random)
        => new(NextGaussian(random), NextGaussian(random));

    private static float NextGaussian(Random random)
    {
        double u1 = Math.Max(double.Epsilon, random.NextDouble());
        double u2 = random.NextDouble();
        return (float)(Math.Sqrt(-2.0 * Math.Log(u1)) * Math.Cos(2.0 * Math.PI * u2));
    }

    public static float DistanceSquared(Vector2 a, Vector2 b)
    {
        Vector2 d = a - b;
        return d.X * d.X + d.Y * d.Y;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>
/// A single simulated pedestrian, including panic, injury, exploration, wall-follow and
/// explosion state. Fields deliberately mirror agents.py so behavioural guardrails can be
/// audited one-to-one.
/// </summary>
public sealed class Agent
{
    private readonly AgentConfig _config;

    public Agent(

        Vector2 position,
        Vector2 velocity,
        float baseSpeed,
        float panicSpeedMultiplier,
        float reactionDelayFrames,
        DecisionStrategy strategy,
        AgentConfig config)
    {
        AgentId = agentId;
        Position = position;
        Velocity = velocity;
        BaseSpeed = baseSpeed;
        PanicSpeedMultiplier = panicSpeedMultiplier;
        ReactionDelayFrames = reactionDelayFrames;
        Strategy = strategy;
        Mass = config.Mass;
        _config = config;
    }

    public int AgentId { get; }
    public Vector2 Position { get; set; }
    /// <summary>Metres per ReferenceStepSeconds; independent of the chosen integration Dt.</summary>
    public Vector2 Velocity { get; set; }

    public float StandUpProgress => StandUpSeconds > 0f ? Math.Clamp(StandUpElapsed / StandUpSeconds, 0f, 1f) : 0f;
    public float PanicSpeedMultiplier { get; }
    public float ReactionDelayFrames { get; }

    // Stable per-agent behavioural heterogeneity. These are abstract simulation traits,
    // not demographic stereotypes. They are sampled deterministically from the scenario seed.
    public float ThreatSensitivity { get; set; } = 1f;
    public float FollowTendency { get; set; } = 0.5f;

    public LocalNavigationMode LocalNavigationMode { get; set; } = CrowdSim.Core.Model.LocalNavigationMode.Free;

    public int ExplorationReplanAfterFrame { get; set; }

    // Body-clear visibility-graph route. Waypoints are static-geometry guidance only; SFM

    public List<Vector2> RouteWaypoints { get; } = new();
    public int RouteWaypointIndex { get; set; }

    public Vector2? WallFollowNormal { get; set; }
    public Vector2? WallFollowTangent { get; set; }
    public int WallStuckFrames { get; set; }
    public float LastExitDist { get; set; } = float.PositiveInfinity;

    public BgrColor Color { get; set; } = new(255, 255, 255);

    // Emergency-response / Stage 2 state. ReactionStartedFrame makes socially-triggered

    public int ReactionStartedFrame { get; set; } = -1;

    public int LastExitReselectFrame { get; set; } = -999;

    public bool ExitCongestionEpisodeActive { get; set; }
    public string? ExitCongestionExitName { get; set; }
    public bool ExitYielding { get; set; }
    public int ExitRetryAfterFrame { get; set; }
    public float ExitCongestionHoldingCoordinate { get; set; } = float.NaN;

    public float VisibilityFactor { get; set; } = 1f;
    public float LocalCongestion { get; set; }
    public float LastThreatPanicStimulus { get; set; }
    public float LastSocialPanicStimulus { get; set; }
    public float LastRunningPanicStimulus { get; set; }
    public float LastEvacuationAwarenessStimulus { get; set; }

    // Finite panic-source window. This is deliberately distinct from PanicLevel:
    // residual anxiety may remain after the agent stops being an active alarm source.
    // Social/running contagion can relay an alarm once, but cannot keep refreshing it
    // simply because already-alarmed pedestrians continue seeing one another.
    public int ActiveAlarmUntilFrame { get; private set; } = -1;
    public float ActiveAlarmPanicFloor { get; private set; }
    public int ActiveAlarmEpisodeId { get; private set; } = -1;

    public Vector2 LastHerdDirection { get; set; }

    public float DistanceTo(Vector2 point) => Vector2.Distance(Position, point);

    public Exit ChooseExit(IReadOnlyList<Exit> exits, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int> crowdLoads)
    {
        if (exits.Count == 0)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot choose an exit when no exits exist.");
        }

        if (Strategy == DecisionStrategy.Nearest)
        {
            return exits.OrderBy(exit => DistanceTo(exit.Position)).First();
        }

        return exits.OrderBy(exit => crowdLoads.TryGetValue(exit.Name, out int load) ? load : 0).First();
    }

    public void MarkExited()
    {
        State = AgentState.Exited;
        Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        ClearActiveAlarm();
        ClearRoute();
        ResetExitCongestion();
    }

    public void MarkInjured(bool preserveReactionState = false)
    {
        if (State is AgentState.Exited or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.Dead)
        {
            return;
        }

        InjurySpeedFactor = _config.InjuredSpeedFactor;
        if (!(preserveReactionState && State == AgentState.WaitingToReact))
        {
            State = AgentState.Injured;
        }
    }

    public void MarkFallen(int currentFrame, Random random)
    {
        if (State is AgentState.Exited or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.Dead)
        {
            return;
        }

        State = AgentState.Fallen;
        Intent = BehaviorIntent.Unaware;
        Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        InjurySpeedFactor = 0f;
        ClearRoute();
        ResetExitCongestion();
        int delay = RandomRange(random, _config.CrawlDelayMin, _config.CrawlDelayMax);
        CrawlUntilFrame = currentFrame + _config.ReferenceFramesToTicks(delay);
    }

    public void MarkCrawling()
    {
        if (State is AgentState.Exited or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.Dead)
        {
            return;
        }

        State = AgentState.Crawling;
        Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        InjurySpeedFactor = _config.CrawlSpeedFactor;
    }

    public void MarkIncapacitated()
    {
        if (State is AgentState.Exited or AgentState.Dead)
        {
            return;
        }

        State = AgentState.Incapacitated;
        Intent = BehaviorIntent.Unaware;
        Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        InjurySpeedFactor = 0f;
        ClearRoute();
        ResetExitCongestion();
    }

    /// <summary>Mark a terminal fatality while leaving the body in the world as an obstacle.</summary>
    public void MarkDead()
    {
        if (State == AgentState.Exited)
        {
            return;
        }

        State = AgentState.Dead;
        Intent = BehaviorIntent.Unaware;
        Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        InjurySpeedFactor = 0f;
        PanicLevel = 0f;
        ClearActiveAlarm();
        ClearRoute();
        ResetExitCongestion();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Start or refresh a direct alarm from the physical event. Direct exposure may
    /// upgrade a previously relayed alarm and keeps the original event episode id.
    /// </summary>
    public void ActivateDirectAlarm(
        int currentFrame,
        int durationFrames,
        float panicFloor,
        int episodeId)
    {
        int boundedDuration = Math.Max(1, durationFrames);
        ActiveAlarmUntilFrame = Math.Max(
            ActiveAlarmUntilFrame,
            currentFrame + boundedDuration);
        ActiveAlarmPanicFloor = Math.Max(
            ActiveAlarmPanicFloor,
            Math.Clamp(panicFloor, 0f, 1f));
        ActiveAlarmEpisodeId = episodeId;
        LastDirectAlarmEpisodeId = episodeId;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Relay an alarm episode once. An agent cannot be socially re-activated by the
    /// same event after its relay window expires, preventing ping-pong panic loops.
    /// </summary>
    public bool TryActivateRelayedAlarm(
        int currentFrame,
        int durationFrames,
        float panicFloor,
        int episodeId)
    {
        if (episodeId < 0 ||
            LastRelayedAlarmEpisodeId == episodeId ||
            LastDirectAlarmEpisodeId == episodeId ||
            IsActiveAlarmSource(currentFrame))
        {
            return false;
        }

        int boundedDuration = Math.Max(1, durationFrames);
        ActiveAlarmUntilFrame = currentFrame + boundedDuration;
        ActiveAlarmPanicFloor = Math.Clamp(panicFloor, 0f, 1f);
        ActiveAlarmEpisodeId = episodeId;
        LastRelayedAlarmEpisodeId = episodeId;
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Whether this agent is currently allowed to transmit alarm contagion.</summary>
    public bool IsActiveAlarmSource(int currentFrame) => currentFrame <= ActiveAlarmUntilFrame;

    /// <summary>Expire the finite alarm source while leaving residual panic to decay naturally.</summary>
    public void ExpireAlarmIfNeeded(int currentFrame)
    {
        if (currentFrame > ActiveAlarmUntilFrame)
        {
            ActiveAlarmPanicFloor = 0f;
            ActiveAlarmEpisodeId = -1;
        }
    }

    private void ClearActiveAlarm()
    {
        ActiveAlarmUntilFrame = -1;
        ActiveAlarmPanicFloor = 0f;
        ActiveAlarmEpisodeId = -1;
        LastRelayedAlarmEpisodeId = -1;
        LastDirectAlarmEpisodeId = -1;
    }

    /// <summary>Begin the bounded startle/reaction sequence at the frame the emergency is perceived.</summary>
    public void BeginReaction(int currentFrame, int freezeUntilFrame, float reactionDelayScale = 1f)
    {
        if (State is AgentState.Exited or AgentState.Dead or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.TempIncap)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (State == AgentState.Wandering)
        {
            State = AgentState.WaitingToReact;
            Intent = BehaviorIntent.Orienting;
        }

        if (ReactionStartedFrame < 0)
        {
            ReactionStartedFrame = currentFrame;
        }

        ReactionDelayScale = Math.Min(
            ReactionDelayScale,
            Math.Clamp(reactionDelayScale, 0.05f, 1f));
        FreezeUntilFrame = Math.Max(FreezeUntilFrame, freezeUntilFrame);
    }

    public void MarkTempIncap(int currentFrame, Random random)
    {
        State = AgentState.TempIncap;
        Intent = BehaviorIntent.Unaware;
        Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        InjurySpeedFactor = 0f;
        ClearRoute();
        ResetExitCongestion();
        int delay = RandomRange(random, _config.CrawlDelayMin, _config.CrawlDelayMax);
        CrawlUntilFrame = currentFrame + _config.ReferenceFramesToTicks(delay);
    }

    /// <summary>Clear cached static-geometry route guidance.</summary>
    internal int HybridGroupLeaderId { get; set; } = -1;
    internal int HybridRegroupAfterFrame { get; set; } = -1;
    internal int HybridLastPanicFrame { get; set; } = -1;

    internal int LastChairPushFrame { get; set; } = -1;
    internal Vector2 LastChairPushDirection { get; set; }

    internal string? FailedRouteKey { get; set; }
    internal int FailedRouteRetryFrame { get; set; } = -1;

    internal int NextSeatDepartureProbeFrame { get; set; } = -1;

    internal int NextOpenSpaceProbeFrame { get; set; } = -1;

    public void ClearRoute()
    {
        RouteWaypoints.Clear();
        RouteWaypointIndex = 0;
        RouteExitName = null;
        RouteReplanAfterFrame = -1;
    }

    /// <summary>Replace the body-clear route for the current exit.</summary>
    public void SetRoute(IEnumerable<Vector2> waypoints, string exitName, int replanAfterFrame)
    {
        RouteWaypoints.Clear();
        RouteWaypoints.AddRange(waypoints);
        RouteWaypointIndex = 0;
        RouteExitName = exitName;
        RouteReplanAfterFrame = replanAfterFrame;
    }

    public Vector2? CurrentRouteWaypoint
        => RouteWaypointIndex >= 0 && RouteWaypointIndex < RouteWaypoints.Count
            ? RouteWaypoints[RouteWaypointIndex]
            : null;

    public void AdvanceRouteWaypoint()
    {
        if (RouteWaypointIndex < RouteWaypoints.Count)
        {
            RouteWaypointIndex++;
        }
    }

    public void ResetExitCongestion()
    {
        ExitCongestionEpisodeActive = false;
        ExitCongestionExitName = null;
        ExitYielding = false;
        ExitRetryAfterFrame = 0;
        ExitCongestionHoldingCoordinate = float.NaN;
        ResetBottleneckInteraction();
    }

    /// <summary>Clear transient doorway pressure and response commitment.</summary>
    public void ResetBottleneckInteraction()
    {
        BottleneckPressure = 0f;
        BottleneckPressureTarget = 0f;
        BottleneckWaitSeconds = 0f;
        BottleneckMode = BottleneckResponseMode.Free;
        BottleneckModeUntilFrame = -1;
        BottleneckLastUpdateFrame = -1;
        BottleneckLateralDirection = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    /// <summary>True while the agent/body remains present in the simulated room.</summary>
    public bool IsActive => State != AgentState.Exited;

    /// <summary>Whether the agent can currently contribute a visible social panic signal.</summary>
    public bool CanSignalPanic => State is AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured or AgentState.Crawling;

    /// <summary>Static/slow casualty states that other pedestrians should locally route around.</summary>
    public bool IsCasualtyObstacle => State is AgentState.Fallen or AgentState.TempIncap or
        AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.Dead or AgentState.Crawling;

    public float EffectiveReactionDelayFrames => ReactionDelayFrames * ReactionDelayScale;

    public float CurrentDesiredSpeed
    {
        get
        {
            if (Posture != SeatingPosture.Walking) return 0f;
            float panic = Math.Clamp(PanicLevel, 0f, 1f);
            if (State == AgentState.Crawling)
            {
                // Retain the former smoothed crawler's steady-state speed (0.28 / 0.58).
                return Math.Min(BaseSpeed * _config.CrawlSpeedFactor * (1f + 0.5f * panic) *
                    (0.28f / 0.58f), _config.Behavior.MaxRunningSpeedPerReferenceStep) *
                    Math.Clamp(ToxicMobilityFactor, 0f, 1f);
            }
            float urgencyScale = _config.Behavior.EmergencyUrgency;
            float multiplier = 1f + _config.PanicSpeedGain * urgencyScale * panic;

            if (State is AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured)
            {
                float intentFloor = Intent switch
                {
                    BehaviorIntent.ThreatEscape => _config.ThreatEscapeSpeedMultiplier,
                    BehaviorIntent.FollowCrowd => _config.FollowCrowdSpeedMultiplier,
                    BehaviorIntent.AssistCasualty => _config.AssistanceApproachSpeedMultiplier,
                    _ => _config.EvacuationSpeedFloorMultiplier,
                };
                intentFloor *= urgencyScale;

                // Panic raises urgency, but purposeful evacuation remains brisk even after acute
                // stress subsides. The bounded per-agent urgency bias avoids synchronized motion.
                multiplier = Math.Max(intentFloor, multiplier);
                multiplier *= Math.Clamp(UrgencyBias, 0.75f, 1.25f);

                float bottleneckModeFactor = BottleneckMode switch
                {
                    BottleneckResponseMode.SeekGap => 0.45f,
                    BottleneckResponseMode.Press => 1.00f,
                    _ => 0f,
                };
                if (bottleneckModeFactor > 0f)
                {
                    float pressure = Math.Clamp(BottleneckPressure, 0f, 1f);
                    multiplier *= 1f +
                        _config.BottleneckPressSpeedGain *
                        _config.Behavior.BottleneckPressureSensitivity *
                        pressure *
                        bottleneckModeFactor;
                }

                multiplier = Math.Min(multiplier, _config.MaximumBehaviorSpeedMultiplier);
            }

            float localNavigationSpeedFactor = LocalNavigationMode switch
            {
                CrowdSim.Core.Model.LocalNavigationMode.WaitingForGap => 0f,
                CrowdSim.Core.Model.LocalNavigationMode.SeekingGap => 0.90f,
                CrowdSim.Core.Model.LocalNavigationMode.PressingThrough => _config.CasualtyPressSpeedFactor,
                CrowdSim.Core.Model.LocalNavigationMode.CircleFollow => _config.CircleFollowSpeedFactor,
                _ => 1f,
            };

            // Cap healthy purposeful locomotion first, so injury, fumes and local waiting
            // can still reduce it. Raising the ceiling does not make slower agents run faster.
            float cappedSpeed = Math.Min(BaseSpeed * multiplier, _config.Behavior.MaxRunningSpeedPerReferenceStep);
            return cappedSpeed * InjurySpeedFactor *
                Math.Clamp(ToxicMobilityFactor, 0f, 1f) *
                localNavigationSpeedFactor;
        }
    }

    private static int RandomRange(Random random, int minInclusive, int maxExclusive)
    {
        if (maxExclusive <= minInclusive)
        {
            return minInclusive;
        }

        return minInclusive + (int)(random.NextDouble() * (maxExclusive - minInclusive));
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.Core/Model/AgentState.cs

```csharp
namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>Finite physical/operational states of an agent in the evacuation scenario.</summary>
public enum AgentState
{
    Wandering,
    WaitingToReact,
    Evacuating,
    Exited,
    Injured,
    Fallen,
    Crawling,
    Incapacitated,
    TempIncap,
    Dead
}

/// <summary>
/// Short-lived behavioural intent layered on top of AgentState. This keeps body-state colours
/// stable while allowing heterogeneous emergency responses such as orienting, moving away from
/// the immediate threat, following an obvious evacuation flow, or briefly attending a casualty.
/// </summary>
public enum BehaviorIntent
{
    Unaware,
    Orienting,
    ThreatEscape,
    Evacuate,
    FollowCrowd,
    AssistCasualty
}

/// <summary>
/// Short-lived response to pressure near a congested doorway. This is separate from
/// panic so a calm pedestrian may still yield, seek a gap, or press after prolonged delay.
/// </summary>
public enum BottleneckResponseMode
{
    Free,
    Yield,
    SeekGap,
    Press
}

/// <summary>
/// Short-lived local navigation response used when static obstacles or casualty clusters
/// temporarily block an otherwise valid evacuation objective. This is deliberately separate
/// from AgentState so an evacuating pedestrian keeps the same physical/health state.
/// </summary>
public enum LocalNavigationMode
{
    Free,
    CasualtyBypass,
    WaitingForGap,
    SeekingGap,
    PressingThrough,
    CircleFollow
}

/// <summary>Strategy used to choose an exit.</summary>
public enum DecisionStrategy
{
    Nearest,
    LeastCrowded
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>A true circular static blockage on the metric ground plane.</summary>
public sealed record CircleBlockage(Vector2 Center, float Radius)
{
    /// <summary>Furniture proxies share navigation but use dedicated rendering/persistence.</summary>
    public bool IsFurniture { get; init; }

    /// <summary>Runtime seat owner for constant-time pushability lookup; tables have no owner.</summary>
    internal FurnitureChair? ChairOwner { get; init; }

    public const float DefaultDiameterMeters = 2.50f;
    public const float DefaultRadiusMeters = DefaultDiameterMeters / 2f;

    public float Diameter => 2f * Radius;

    public bool Contains(Vector2 point, float margin = 0f)
    {
        float effectiveRadius = Radius + Math.Max(0f, margin);
        return Vector2.DistanceSquared(point, Center) <= effectiveRadius * effectiveRadius;
    }

    public Vector2 ClosestPoint(Vector2 point)
    {
        Vector2 delta = point - Center;
        float distance = delta.Length();
        if (!float.IsFinite(distance) || distance < 1e-6f)
        {
            return Center + new Vector2(Radius, 0f);
        }

        return Center + delta / distance * Radius;
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.Core/Model/Debris.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>
/// Lightweight outward-moving debris fragment. Movement is deliberately abstract and deterministic:
/// fragments carry normalized impact energy, decay with travel, collide against walls using their
/// swept segment, and are removed after one person impact so a single fragment cannot repeatedly harm
/// the same person on successive frames.
/// </summary>
public sealed class Debris
{
    public Debris(
        Vector2 position,
        Vector2 velocity,
        int ttl,
        float radius,
        float energy = 1f)
    {
        Position = position;
        PreviousPosition = position;
        Velocity = velocity;
        Ttl = ttl;
        Radius = radius;
        Energy = Math.Clamp(energy, 0f, 1f);
    }

    private float _elapsedReferenceFrames;

    public Vector2 Position { get; set; }
    public Vector2 PreviousPosition { get; private set; }
    public Vector2 Velocity { get; set; }
    public int Ttl { get; set; }
    public float Radius { get; }
    public float Energy { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Advance one frame. Returns false when the fragment should be discarded.</summary>
    public bool Advance(WorldConfig world, AgentConfig config)
    {
        PreviousPosition = Position;
        Velocity *= config.RetentionAtStep(0.96f);
        Energy *= config.RetentionAtStep(Math.Clamp(config.DebrisEnergyDecay, 0f, 1f));

        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(Velocity) || !float.IsFinite(Energy))
        {
            Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            Energy = 0f;
            Ttl = 0;
            return false;
        }

        Position += Velocity * config.StepScale;
        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(Position))
        {
            Ttl = 0;
            return false;
        }

        // Debris does not wrap/clamp around the room. Leaving the simulation boundary ends it.
        if (Position.X < 0f || Position.Y < 0f || Position.X > world.WidthMeters || Position.Y > world.LengthMeters)
        {
            Ttl = 0;
            return false;
        }

        _elapsedReferenceFrames += config.StepScale;
        int elapsedWholeFrames = (int)(_elapsedReferenceFrames + 1e-6f);
        Ttl -= elapsedWholeFrames;
        _elapsedReferenceFrames -= elapsedWholeFrames;
        return Ttl > 0 && Energy > 0.04f;
    }

    public static List<Debris> SpawnCluster(
        Vector2 explosionPosition,
        int count,
        float speedMin,
        float speedMax,
        int ttlMin,
        int ttlMax,
        float radius,
        Random random)
    {
        List<Debris> fragments = new(count);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            float angle = (float)(random.NextDouble() * Math.PI * 2.0);
            float speed = Lerp(speedMin, speedMax, (float)random.NextDouble());
            Vector2 velocity = new(MathF.Cos(angle) * speed, MathF.Sin(angle) * speed);
            int ttl = ttlMin + (int)(random.NextDouble() * Math.Max(1, ttlMax - ttlMin));
            float normalizedEnergy = Math.Clamp((speed - speedMin) / Math.Max(1e-5f, speedMax - speedMin), 0f, 1f);
            // Keep even slower pieces relevant while still separating low/high energy impacts.
            normalizedEnergy = 0.30f + 0.70f * normalizedEnergy;
            fragments.Add(new Debris(explosionPosition, velocity, ttl, radius, normalizedEnergy));
        }

        return fragments;
    }

    private static float Lerp(float a, float b, float t) => a + (b - a) * t;
}
```
