## src/CrowdSim.Core/Model/Furniture.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>Posture is independent of injury, panic and evacuation state.</summary>
public enum SeatingPosture { Walking, Seated, StandingUp }
/// <summary>Stable persisted asset identifiers. Only the first two kinds create seated occupants.</summary>
public enum FurnitureKind
{
    RoundTableSet = 0,
    SingleChair = 1,
    RectangularTable = 2,
    Stage = 3,
    Barricade = 4,
}
/// <summary>Furniture motion state; the original ChairState name is retained for compatibility.</summary>
public enum ChairState { Upright, Airborne, Fallen, Destroyed }

/// <summary>
/// Authored furniture in metres. Round tables/chairs retain their existing movable bodies;
/// the unoccupied rectangular table is blast-movable; stages and road barricades are fixed.
/// </summary>
public sealed class FurnitureSet
{
    public const float TableRadius = 0.90f;
    public const float SeatRingRadius = 1.50f;
    public const float ChairRadius = 0.30f;
    public const float RectangularTableLength = 3f;
    public const float RectangularTableWidth = 1f;
    public const float RectangularTableHeight = 0.78f;
    public const float StageLength = 15f;
    public const float StageWidth = 6f;
    public const float StageHeight = 0.80f;
    public const float BarricadeLength = 1.50f;
    /// <summary>Assumed base depth for the road barricade; not a certified product dimension.</summary>
    public const float BarricadeWidth = 0.40f;
    public const float BarricadeHeight = 1.00f;

    public FurnitureSet(FurnitureKind kind, Vector2 center, float rotation = 0f)
    {
        if (!Enum.IsDefined(kind)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(kind));
        if (!float.IsFinite(center.X) || !float.IsFinite(center.Y))
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(center));
        if (!float.IsFinite(rotation)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(rotation));

        Kind = kind;
        Center = center;
        Rotation = kind == FurnitureKind.Barricade ? NormalizeRotation(rotation)
            : IsRectangular(kind) ? SnapRectangleRotation(rotation) : rotation;
        if (kind == FurnitureKind.Barricade)
        {
            OrientedRectangle footprint = new(center,
                new Vector2(BarricadeLength, BarricadeWidth) * 0.5f, Rotation);
            _fixedObstacle = new Wall(footprint.Minimum.X, footprint.Minimum.Y,
                footprint.Maximum.X, footprint.Maximum.Y)
                { IsFurniture = true, OrientedFootprint = footprint };
            return;
        }
        if (IsRectangular(kind))
        {
            (float length, float width) = kind switch
            {
                FurnitureKind.Stage => (StageLength, StageWidth),
                FurnitureKind.Barricade => (BarricadeLength, BarricadeWidth),
                _ => (RectangularTableLength, RectangularTableWidth),
            };
            bool swapped = MathF.Abs(MathF.Sin(Rotation)) > 0.5f;
            float halfX = (swapped ? width : length) * 0.5f;
            float halfY = (swapped ? length : width) * 0.5f;
            // Use the existing AABB spatial index and route/collision checks. No circular
            // proxy: a long table/stage must not acquire an oversized invisible footprint.
            if (kind == FurnitureKind.RectangularTable)
                Table = new RectangularFurnitureBody(center, Rotation, new Vector2(halfX, halfY));
            else
                _fixedObstacle = new Wall(center.X - halfX, center.Y - halfY,
                    center.X + halfX, center.Y + halfY) { IsFurniture = true };
            return;
        }

        if (kind == FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet)
            Table = new FurnitureBody(center, rotation, TableRadius);
        int count = GetSeatCount(kind);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            float angle = rotation + MathF.Tau * i / count;
            Vector2 outward = new(MathF.Cos(angle), MathF.Sin(angle));
            Vector2 seat = kind == FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet ? center + outward * SeatRingRadius : center;
            Chairs.Add(new FurnitureChair(seat, kind == FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet ? angle + MathF.PI : rotation));
        }
    }

    public FurnitureKind Kind { get; }
    public Vector2 Center { get; }
    public float Rotation { get; }
    public float PlacementRadius => Kind switch
    {
        FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet => 2.25f,
        FurnitureKind.SingleChair => 1.05f,
        FurnitureKind.RectangularTable => MathF.Sqrt(10f) * 0.5f,
        FurnitureKind.Stage => MathF.Sqrt(StageLength * StageLength + StageWidth * StageWidth) * 0.5f,
        FurnitureKind.Barricade => MathF.Sqrt(BarricadeLength * BarricadeLength + BarricadeWidth * BarricadeWidth) * 0.5f,
        _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Unsupported furniture kind."),
    };
    public FurnitureBody? Table { get; }
    public CircleBlockage? TableObstacle => Table?.Obstacle;
    private readonly Wall? _fixedObstacle;
    /// <summary>
    /// Current exact rectangular footprint (legacy property name retained). Moving tables
    /// update it after physics; destroyed tables return null. Stages and barricades remain fixed.
    /// These low footprints do not occlude full-height sight, blast or the fume field.
    /// </summary>
    public Wall? StaticObstacle => Table is RectangularFurnitureBody rectangle
        ? rectangle.RectangleObstacle : _fixedObstacle;
    public List<FurnitureChair> Chairs { get; } = new();

    /// <summary>Count authored occupants without allocating a preview or runtime furniture.</summary>
    public static int GetSeatCount(FurnitureKind kind) => kind switch
    {
        FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet => 10,
        FurnitureKind.SingleChair => 1,
        FurnitureKind.RectangularTable or FurnitureKind.Stage or FurnitureKind.Barricade => 0,
        _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(kind)),
    };

    public static bool IsRectangular(FurnitureKind kind) =>
        kind is FurnitureKind.RectangularTable or FurnitureKind.Stage or FurnitureKind.Barricade;

    /// <summary>Normalize a free angle without snapping away the authored orientation.</summary>
    public static float NormalizeRotation(float radians)
    {
        if (!float.IsFinite(radians)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(radians));
        float wrapped = radians % MathF.Tau;
        return wrapped < 0f ? wrapped + MathF.Tau : wrapped;
    }

    /// <summary>Tables and stages retain quarter turns and inexpensive axis-aligned footprints.</summary>
    public static float SnapRectangleRotation(float radians)
    {
        if (!float.IsFinite(radians)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(radians));
        float wrapped = radians % MathF.Tau;
        if (wrapped < 0f) wrapped += MathF.Tau;
        int quarter = (int)MathF.Round(wrapped / (MathF.PI * 0.5f), MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero) % 4;
        return quarter * MathF.PI * 0.5f;
    }
}

/// <summary>Lightweight furniture rigid-body approximation; no calibrated explosive yield is implied.</summary>
public class FurnitureBody
{
    public FurnitureBody(Vector2 position, float heading, float radius)
    {
        StartPosition = Position = position; StartHeading = Heading = heading;
        Radius = radius;
        Obstacle = new CircleBlockage(position, radius) { IsFurniture = true };
    }
    public Vector2 StartPosition { get; }
    public Vector2 Position { get; internal set; }
    public float StartHeading { get; }
    public float Heading { get; internal set; }
    public ChairState State { get; internal set; }
    public Vector2 Velocity { get; internal set; }
    public float Height { get; internal set; }
    public float VerticalSpeed { get; internal set; }
    public float FlightSeconds { get; internal set; }
    public bool BlastApplied { get; internal set; }
    public bool ImpactApplied { get; internal set; }
    internal int PhysicsActiveFrame { get; set; } = -1;
    internal FurnitureBody? SupportBody { get; set; }
    public float Radius { get; }
    public CircleBlockage? Obstacle { get; internal set; }
}

/// <summary>A seat adds occupant identity to the shared lightweight furniture physics body.</summary>
public sealed class FurnitureChair : FurnitureBody
{
    public FurnitureChair(Vector2 position, float heading)
        : base(position, heading, FurnitureSet.ChairRadius)
    {
        Obstacle = Obstacle! with { ChairOwner = this };
    }

    internal int LastPushFrame { get; set; } = -1;

    public int? OccupantId { get; internal set; }
    public int? OriginalOccupantId { get; internal set; }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.Core/Model/NaturalNavigationMemory.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>Navigation decisions, independent of injury, panic and physical body state.</summary>
public enum NavigationRecoveryStage
{
    FollowingRoute,
    AssessingBlockage,
    LocalDetour,
    WiderDetour,
    ReconsideringExit,
    WaitingForOpening,
}

/// <summary>
/// Small, fixed-capacity movement/failure history. Route replacement deliberately does not
/// clear this memory: repeatedly issuing the same unsuccessful plan is not actual progress.
/// </summary>
public sealed class NaturalNavigationMemory
{
    private readonly PositionSample[] _history = new PositionSample[24];
    private readonly FailedLocation[] _failures = new FailedLocation[6];
    private int _historyCount;
    private int _historyHead;
    private int _failureHead;
    private int _lastSampleFrame = -1;
    private int _lastProgressFrame = -1;
    private int _loopSuppressedUntilFrame = -1;
    private Vector2 _lastPosition;
    private Vector2 _lastTarget;
    private float _bestTargetDistance;
    private float _travelled;
    private float _bestFieldCost = float.PositiveInfinity;
    private int _fieldVersion = -1;

    public NavigationRecoveryStage Stage { get; internal set; }
    public float NoProgressSeconds { get; private set; }
    public float LongestNoProgressSeconds { get; private set; }
    public bool LoopDetected { get; private set; }
    public Vector2? DetourGoal { get; internal set; }
    public int RecoveryAttempts { get; internal set; }
    public int TotalRecoveryAttempts { get; internal set; }
    public int SuccessfulDetours { get; internal set; }
    public int ExitChanges { get; internal set; }
    public int RoutePlans { get; internal set; }
    public bool RecoveryRequested { get; internal set; }

    internal float RemainingFieldCost { get; set; } = float.PositiveInfinity;
    internal int FieldGeometryVersion { get; set; } = -1;
    internal int FieldCostFrame { get; set; } = -9999;
    internal int LastRecoveryFrame { get; set; } = -9999;
    internal int RecoveryEpisodeStartedFrame { get; set; } = -1;
    internal bool ReplanAfterDetour { get; set; }
    internal Vector2 RecoveryRequestPosition { get; set; }
    internal int NextObservationFrame { get; set; }
    internal int NextRecoveryFrame { get; set; }
    internal int DetourStartedFrame { get; set; }
    internal int DetourUntilFrame { get; set; }
    internal int DetourLastProgressFrame { get; set; }
    internal int DetourNextCheckFrame { get; set; }
    internal float DetourBestDistance { get; set; }
    internal bool RouteQueued { get; set; }
    internal Vector2 RequestedRouteGoal { get; set; }
    internal string? RequestedRouteKey { get; set; }
    internal int NextRouteRequestFrame { get; set; }
    internal int NextRouteCheckFrame { get; set; }
    internal int IgnoreSharedFieldUntilFrame { get; set; }
    internal Vector2? GuidancePoint { get; set; }
    internal string? GuidanceKey { get; set; }
    internal int GuidanceRefreshFrame { get; set; }
    internal int LastExitChangeFrame { get; set; } = -9999;
    internal string? RecentlyFailedExit { get; set; }
    internal int FailedExitUntilFrame { get; set; }
    internal int NextHazardCheckFrame { get; set; }
    internal Vector2 FurnitureAvoidance { get; set; }
    internal int NextToxicExitCheckFrame { get; set; }
    internal int NextToxicSteeringFrame { get; set; }
    internal Vector2 ToxicSteeringInput { get; set; }
    internal Vector2 ToxicSteeringDirection { get; set; }
    internal bool ToxicSteeringActive { get; set; }
    internal float DetourToxicPeak { get; set; }
    internal float DetourToxicEnd { get; set; }
    internal Dictionary<string, (float Cost, int Frame)> ExitObservations { get; } = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);

    /// <summary>
    /// Observe real motion toward a stable waypoint. Changing the waypoint does not itself
    /// reset the clock. A returning, sufficiently long trajectory is a loop even if intermediate
    /// samples briefly got closer to the destination. All distances here are metres.
    /// </summary>
    internal void Observe(Vector2 position, Vector2 target, int frame, float dt,
        float remainingFieldCost = float.PositiveInfinity, int fieldVersion = -1)
    {
        if (_lastSampleFrame == frame) return;
        float distance = Vector2.Distance(position, target);
        if (_lastSampleFrame < 0 || frame < _lastSampleFrame)
        {
            _lastPosition = position;
            _lastTarget = target;
            _bestTargetDistance = distance;
            _lastProgressFrame = frame;
            _lastSampleFrame = frame;
            Record(position, frame);
            return;
        }

        float moved = Vector2.Distance(position, _lastPosition);
        _travelled += moved;
        bool sameTarget = Vector2.DistanceSquared(target, _lastTarget) < 0.04f;
        bool reachedPrevious = Vector2.Distance(position, _lastTarget) <= 0.32f && moved >= 0.025f;
        bool usefulProgress = sameTarget && _bestTargetDistance - distance >= 0.10f;
        bool fieldProgress = false;
        if (float.IsFinite(remainingFieldCost))
        {
            if (_fieldVersion != fieldVersion)
            {
                _fieldVersion = fieldVersion;
                _bestFieldCost = remainingFieldCost;
            }
            else if (_bestFieldCost - remainingFieldCost >= 0.10f && moved >= 0.025f)
            {
                fieldProgress = true;
                _bestFieldCost = remainingFieldCost;
            }
        }
        if (reachedPrevious || usefulProgress || fieldProgress)
        {
            _lastProgressFrame = frame;
            _bestTargetDistance = distance;
        }
        else if (!sameTarget)
        {
            _bestTargetDistance = distance;
        }

        if (frame >= _loopSuppressedUntilFrame)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _historyCount; i++)
            {
                PositionSample previous = _history[i];
                if ((frame - previous.Frame) * dt < 1.8f ||
                    _travelled - previous.Travelled < 2.2f) continue;
                if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(position, previous.Position) < 0.20f)
                {
                    LoopDetected = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        NoProgressSeconds = Math.Max(0f, (frame - _lastProgressFrame) * dt);
        LongestNoProgressSeconds = Math.Max(LongestNoProgressSeconds, NoProgressSeconds);
        _lastPosition = position;
        _lastTarget = target;
        _lastSampleFrame = frame;
        Record(position, frame);
    }

    /// <summary>A new exit changes the cost scale, not the physical progress clock.</summary>
    internal void ResetRouteCostObservation()
    {
        _fieldVersion = -1;
        _bestFieldCost = float.PositiveInfinity;
        RemainingFieldCost = float.PositiveInfinity;
        FieldCostFrame = -9999;
    }

    private void Record(Vector2 position, int frame)
    {
        _history[_historyHead] = new PositionSample(position, frame, _travelled);
        _historyHead = (_historyHead + 1) % _history.Length;
        _historyCount = Math.Min(_history.Length, _historyCount + 1);
    }

    internal void AcknowledgeLoop(int frame, int suppressionFrames)
    {
        LoopDetected = false;
        _loopSuppressedUntilFrame = frame + suppressionFrames;
        // Keep breadcrumbs for candidate scoring. Suppression alone prevents rediscovery
        // of the same old loop while the newly selected escape is just starting.
    }

    internal void RememberFailure(Vector2 point, int untilFrame)
    {
        _failures[_failureHead] = new FailedLocation(point, untilFrame);
        _failureHead = (_failureHead + 1) % _failures.Length;
    }

    internal float FailurePenalty(Vector2 point, int frame)
    {
        float penalty = 0f;
        foreach (FailedLocation failure in _failures)
        {
            if (failure.UntilFrame <= frame) continue;
            float distance = Vector2.Distance(point, failure.Position);
            penalty += Math.Max(0f, 1f - distance / 1.35f);
        }
        return penalty;
    }

    internal float RecentVisitPenalty(Vector2 point, int frame, float dt)
    {
        float penalty = 0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < _historyCount; i++)
        {
            PositionSample sample = _history[i];
            if ((frame - sample.Frame) * dt < 1.2f) continue;
            penalty = Math.Max(penalty, Math.Max(0f, 1f - Vector2.Distance(point, sample.Position) / 0.85f));
        }
        return penalty;
    }

    private readonly record struct PositionSample(Vector2 Position, int Frame, float Travelled);
    private readonly record struct FailedLocation(Vector2 Position, int UntilFrame);
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.Core/Model/RectangularFurnitureBody.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>
/// Translating, airborne or fallen rectangular table. The authored quarter-turn heading
/// stays fixed, keeping the visible 3 x 1 m body and its inexpensive AABB footprint aligned.
/// Radius is broad-phase only; contacts use the exact rectangle. No chairs or occupants.
/// </summary>
public sealed class RectangularFurnitureBody : FurnitureBody
{
    public RectangularFurnitureBody(Vector2 position, float heading, Vector2 halfExtents)
        : base(position, heading, halfExtents.Length())
    {
        if (!float.IsFinite(position.X) || !float.IsFinite(position.Y))
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(position));
        if (!float.IsFinite(heading)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(heading));
        if (!float.IsFinite(halfExtents.X) || !float.IsFinite(halfExtents.Y) ||
            halfExtents.X <= 0f || halfExtents.Y <= 0f)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(halfExtents));
        HalfExtents = halfExtents;
        Obstacle = null; // Never register an oversized circular navigation obstacle.
        RectangleObstacle = BoundsAt(position);
    }

    public Vector2 HalfExtents { get; }
    public Wall? RectangleObstacle { get; internal set; }

    /// <summary>Exact world-axis footprint at a proposed position.</summary>
    internal Wall BoundsAt(Vector2 position) => new(
        position.X - HalfExtents.X, position.Y - HalfExtents.Y,
        position.X + HalfExtents.X, position.Y + HalfExtents.Y)
        { IsFurniture = true, IsMovableFurniture = true };
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

public sealed partial class SimulationEnvironment
{
    private int _furnitureMotionVersion;
    /// <summary>Navigation changes independently of static fume-precompute geometry.</summary>
    public int NavigationLayoutVersion => WallLayoutVersion + _furnitureMotionVersion;
    internal void InvalidateFurnitureNavigation() => _furnitureMotionVersion++;
    /// <summary>Low, open furniture does not seal the simplified floor-plane fume field.</summary>
    public bool IsFumeBlocked(Vector2 p, float margin) =>
        Walls.Any(w => !w.IsFurniture && p.X >= w.X1 - margin && p.X <= w.X2 + margin && p.Y >= w.Y1 - margin && p.Y <= w.Y2 + margin) ||
        CircularBlockages.Any(c => !c.IsFurniture && c.Contains(p, margin));

    public List<FurnitureSet> Furniture { get; } = new();

    /// <summary>At most one authored stage is allowed in a scenario, including restored layouts.</summary>
    public bool HasStage => Furniture.Any(set => set.Kind == FurnitureKind.Stage);

    /// <summary>Validate exact rectangular footprints, or the existing seated-set clearance.</summary>
    public bool CanPlaceFurniture(FurnitureKind kind, Vector2 center, float rotation = 0f)
    {
        if (!Enum.IsDefined(kind) || !float.IsFinite(center.X) || !float.IsFinite(center.Y) || !float.IsFinite(rotation)) return false;
        if (kind == FurnitureKind.Stage && HasStage) return false;
        if (PlannedAgentCount + FurnitureSet.GetSeatCount(kind) > 5000) return false;
        FurnitureSet set = new(kind, center, rotation);
        if (set.StaticObstacle is Wall rectangle)
        {
            if (!RectangleIsInsideRoom(rectangle) || WallOverlapsAny(rectangle)) return false;
            // Preserve the departure reservation of occupied chairs/table sets.
            foreach (FurnitureSet other in Furniture)
            {
                if (other.StaticObstacle is null && rectangle.OverlapsCircle(other.Center, other.PlacementRadius)) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        float r = set.PlacementRadius;
        if (center.X - r < BoundaryThickness || center.Y - r < BoundaryThickness ||
            center.X + r > Width - BoundaryThickness || center.Y + r > Height - BoundaryThickness) return false;
        if (CircleOverlapsAny(new CircleBlockage(center, r))) return false;
        if (Furniture.Any(other => other.StaticObstacle is null &&
            Vector2.Distance(other.Center, center) < other.PlacementRadius + r)) return false;
        return !GetPlannedAgentPositions().Any(p => Vector2.Distance(p, center) < r + _config.Agent.Radius);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Optional builder-only end-to-end snap for parallel road barricades. Nearby valid
    /// endpoints win; distant, perpendicular or obstructed endpoints never pull the cursor.
    /// Does not mutate the layout. The same result is used for preview and commit.
    /// </summary>
    public Vector2 SnapBarricadePlacement(Vector2 requested, float rotation, float snapDistance = 0.30f)
    {
        if (!float.IsFinite(requested.X) || !float.IsFinite(requested.Y) ||
            !float.IsFinite(rotation) || !float.IsFinite(snapDistance) || snapDistance <= 0f)
            return requested;
        float angle = FurnitureSet.NormalizeRotation(rotation);
        Vector2 requestedAxis = new(MathF.Cos(angle), MathF.Sin(angle));
        float bestSquared = snapDistance * snapDistance;
        Vector2 best = requested;
        foreach (FurnitureSet other in Furniture)
        {
            if (other.Kind != FurnitureKind.Barricade) continue;
            Vector2 axis = other.StaticObstacle!.OrientedFootprint!.Value.AxisX;
            // Opposite facing is still parallel. Do not change the user's chosen angle.
            float cross = axis.X * requestedAxis.Y - axis.Y * requestedAxis.X;
            if (MathF.Abs(cross) > 1e-5f) continue;
            for (int side = -1; side <= 1; side += 2)
            {
                Vector2 candidate = other.Center + axis * (side * FurnitureSet.BarricadeLength);
                float squared = Vector2.DistanceSquared(requested, candidate);
                if (squared > bestSquared ||
                    !CanPlaceFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, candidate, angle)) continue;
                bestSquared = squared;
                best = candidate;
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    /// <summary>One undo item owns its table, chairs and all seated occupants.</summary>
    public bool AddFurniture(FurnitureKind kind, Vector2 center, float rotation = 0f)
    {
        if (!CanPlaceFurniture(kind, center, rotation)) return false;
        FurnitureSet set = new(kind, center, rotation);
        InsertFurniture(set);
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Restore actual saved footprints without reapplying the builder's empty-space reservation.</summary>
    internal bool RestoreFurniture(FurnitureKind kind, Vector2 center, float rotation)
    {
        if (!Enum.IsDefined(kind) || !float.IsFinite(center.X) || !float.IsFinite(center.Y) ||
            !float.IsFinite(rotation) || (kind == FurnitureKind.Stage && HasStage)) return false;
        FurnitureSet set = new(kind, center, rotation);
        if (set.StaticObstacle is Wall rectangle)
        {
            if (!RectangleIsInsideRoom(rectangle) || WallOverlapsAny(rectangle)) return false;
            InsertFurniture(set);
            return true;
        }
        IEnumerable<CircleBlockage> footprints = set.Chairs.Select(chair => chair.Obstacle!);
        if (set.TableObstacle is not null) footprints = footprints.Prepend(set.TableObstacle);
        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in footprints)
        {
            if (circle.Center.X - circle.Radius < BoundaryThickness ||
                circle.Center.Y - circle.Radius < BoundaryThickness ||
                circle.Center.X + circle.Radius > Width - BoundaryThickness ||
                circle.Center.Y + circle.Radius > Height - BoundaryThickness || CircleOverlapsAny(circle))
                return false;
        }
        InsertFurniture(set);
        return true;
    }

    private void InsertFurniture(FurnitureSet set)
    {
        Furniture.Add(set);
        if (set.TableObstacle is not null) CircularBlockages.Add(set.TableObstacle);
        foreach (FurnitureChair chair in set.Chairs) CircularBlockages.Add(chair.Obstacle!);
        _undoStack.Push(("furniture", set));
        RebuildWalls();
    }

    /// <summary>Ignore only the attached chair for its seated occupant.</summary>
    public bool IsSeatStart(Vector2 position) => Furniture.SelectMany(set => set.Chairs)
        .Any(chair => Vector2.DistanceSquared(chair.StartPosition, position) < 0.000001f);
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>
/// Editable room geometry. Boundary walls are rebuilt whenever an exit or blockage is
/// changed so an exit is a true opening rather than a decorative object.
/// </summary>
public sealed partial class SimulationEnvironment
{
    private readonly SimulationConfig _config;
    private readonly Stack<(string Kind, object Item)> _undoStack = new();

    public SimulationEnvironment(SimulationConfig config)
    {
        _config = config;
        Width = config.World.WidthMeters;
        Height = config.World.LengthMeters;
        RebuildWalls();
    }

    public float Width { get; private set; }
    public float Height { get; private set; }
    public float BoundaryThickness { get; } = 0.60f;
    public List<Exit> Exits { get; } = new();
    public List<Wall> Blockages { get; } = new();
    public List<CircleBlockage> CircularBlockages { get; } = new();
    public List<Wall> BlueWalls { get; } = new();
    public List<AgentSpawnGroup> AgentSpawnGroups { get; } = new();
    public List<Wall> Walls { get; } = new();
    public Explosion? Explosion { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Monotonic version used by render/navigation caches when static walls change.</summary>
    public int WallLayoutVersion { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Total number of agents currently planned by mouse placement.</summary>
    public int PlannedAgentCount => AgentSpawnGroups.Sum(group => group.Count) + Furniture.Sum(set => set.Chairs.Count);

    /// <summary>
    /// Room resizing is intentionally limited to an otherwise empty builder. This avoids silently
    /// moving or clipping exits, obstacles and population placements when a smaller room is chosen.
    /// </summary>
    public bool CanResizeRoom =>
        Exits.Count == 0 && Blockages.Count == 0 && CircularBlockages.Count == 0 &&
        BlueWalls.Count == 0 && AgentSpawnGroups.Count == 0 && Furniture.Count == 0;

    public (float Width, float Height) Bounds() => (Width, Height);

    public void SetExplosion(float x, float y, int frame)
        => Explosion = new Explosion(new Vector2(x, y), frame);

    public bool HasExplosion() => Explosion is not null;

    public bool UndoLast()
    {
        if (!_undoStack.TryPop(out (string Kind, object Item) entry))
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (entry.Kind == "furniture" && entry.Item is FurnitureSet furniture)
        {
            Furniture.Remove(furniture);
            if (furniture.TableObstacle is not null) CircularBlockages.Remove(furniture.TableObstacle);
            foreach (FurnitureChair chair in furniture.Chairs)
                if (chair.Obstacle is not null) CircularBlockages.Remove(chair.Obstacle);
            RebuildWalls();
            return true;
        }

        if (entry.Kind == "exit" && entry.Item is Exit exit)
        {
            Exits.Remove(exit);
            RebuildWalls();
            return true;
        }

        if (entry.Kind == "blockage" && entry.Item is Wall wall)
        {
            Blockages.Remove(wall);
            RebuildWalls();
            return true;
        }

        if (entry.Kind == "circle_blockage" && entry.Item is CircleBlockage circle)
        {
            CircularBlockages.Remove(circle);
            RebuildWalls();
            return true;
        }

        if (entry.Kind == "bluewall" && entry.Item is Wall blueWall)
        {
            BlueWalls.Remove(blueWall);
            RebuildWalls();
            return true;
        }

        if (entry.Kind == "agent_spawn" && entry.Item is AgentSpawnGroup spawnGroup)
        {
            AgentSpawnGroups.Remove(spawnGroup);
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Place an exit only on a boundary wall. Exit width is snapped to body diameter;
    /// one-person exits receive the validated 1.2x clearance.
    /// </summary>
    public bool AddExitFromClick(float x, float y, int personsWide)
    {
        string? side = DetectBoundarySide(x, y);
        if (side is null)
        {
            return false;
        }

        float agentDiameter = 2f * _config.Agent.Radius;
        personsWide = Math.Max(1, personsWide);
        float exitWidth = personsWide == 1
            ? agentDiameter * 1.2f
            : personsWide * agentDiameter;
        float halfSize = exitWidth / 2f;
        float thickness = BoundaryThickness;

        float cx;
        float cy;
        string name;

        switch (side)
        {
            case "N":
                cx = Math.Clamp(x, thickness + halfSize, Width - thickness - halfSize);
                cy = thickness / 2f;
                name = $"North_{Exits.Count(e => e.Side == "N") + 1}";
                break;
            case "S":
                cx = Math.Clamp(x, thickness + halfSize, Width - thickness - halfSize);
                cy = Height - thickness / 2f;
                name = $"South_{Exits.Count(e => e.Side == "S") + 1}";
                break;
            case "W":
                cx = thickness / 2f;
                cy = Math.Clamp(y, thickness + halfSize, Height - thickness - halfSize);
                name = $"West_{Exits.Count(e => e.Side == "W") + 1}";
                break;
            default:
                cx = Width - thickness / 2f;
                cy = Math.Clamp(y, thickness + halfSize, Height - thickness - halfSize);
                name = $"East_{Exits.Count(e => e.Side == "E") + 1}";
                break;
        }

        Exit candidate = new(name, new Vector2(cx, cy), halfSize, side);
        if (ExitOverlapsExisting(candidate) || ExitOverlapsBlockage(candidate))
        {
            return false;
        }

        Exits.Add(candidate);
        _undoStack.Push(("exit", candidate));
        RebuildWalls();
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Mirror of Python _snap_point_to_grid.</summary>
    public Vector2 SnapPointToGrid(float x, float y)
    {
        if (!_config.Grid.Enabled)
        {
            return new Vector2(x, y);
        }

        float step = Math.Max(0.10f, _config.Grid.CellSizeMeters);
        float t = BoundaryThickness;
        float sx = t + (MathF.Floor((x - t) / step) + 0.5f) * step;
        float sy = t + (MathF.Floor((y - t) / step) + 0.5f) * step;
        return new Vector2(sx, sy);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Placement-only tolerance (0.1 mm). This absorbs single-precision rounding at
    /// touching edges; it never shrinks collision geometry or creates a walkable gap.
    /// </summary>
    internal const float PlacementToleranceMeters = 0.0001f;

    /// <summary>
    /// Compute the exact same footprint used by the preview and placement. Both one-
    /// and two-cell blocks use GRID EDGES, not a common cell-centre grid. Consequently
    /// different-sized blocks can meet flush rather than being half a cell out of phase.
    /// </summary>
    public Wall GetBlockagePlacementBounds(float x, float y, int cells = 1)
    {
        if (!float.IsFinite(x)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(x));
        if (!float.IsFinite(y)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(y));
        cells = Math.Clamp(cells, 1, 2);
        float step = Math.Max(0.10f, _config.Grid.CellSizeMeters);
        if (!_config.Grid.Enabled)
        {
            float half = cells * step * 0.5f;
            return new Wall(x - half, y - half, x + half, y + half);
        }

        double origin = BoundaryThickness;
        // Odd footprints snap their centre to cell centres, even ones to intersections.
        // Calculate both edges directly from the SAME integer grid coordinates. Avoid
        // centre +/- half-size: adjacent cells could otherwise differ by a float ULP.
        double ix = Math.Floor(((double)x - origin) / step - cells * 0.5 + 0.5);
        double iy = Math.Floor(((double)y - origin) / step - cells * 0.5 + 0.5);
        Wall gridBounds = new((float)(origin + ix * step), (float)(origin + iy * step),
            (float)(origin + (ix + cells) * step), (float)(origin + (iy + cells) * step));
        return SnapToLegacyBlockNeighbours(gridBounds, new Vector2(x, y), cells, step);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Old two-cell blocks were centred half a cell out of phase. Leave those saved
    /// blocks untouched, but allow a new neighbour to inherit their edge grid locally.
    /// Only nearby, physically valid face-adjacent positions are eligible.
    /// </summary>
    private Wall SnapToLegacyBlockNeighbours(Wall gridBounds, Vector2 mouse, int cells, float step)
    {
        Wall best = gridBounds;
        float bestSquared = step * step * 0.85f * 0.85f;
        float size = cells * step;
        for (int collection = 0; collection < 2; collection++)
        {
            IReadOnlyList<Wall> blocks = collection == 0 ? Blockages : BlueWalls;
            foreach (Wall other in blocks)
            {
                bool xAligned = IsPlacementGridEdge(other.X1, step);
                bool yAligned = IsPlacementGridEdge(other.Y1, step);
                if (xAligned && yAligned) continue;
                double ix = Math.Floor(((double)mouse.X - other.X1) / step - cells * 0.5 + 0.5);
                double iy = Math.Floor(((double)mouse.Y - other.Y1) / step - cells * 0.5 + 0.5);
                float alignedX = (float)(other.X1 + ix * step);
                float alignedY = (float)(other.Y1 + iy * step);
                for (int side = 0; side < 4; side++)
                {
                    float x1 = side == 0 ? other.X2 : side == 1 ? other.X1 - size : alignedX;
                    float y1 = side == 2 ? other.Y2 : side == 3 ? other.Y1 - size : alignedY;
                    float x2 = side == 1 ? other.X1 : x1 + size;
                    float y2 = side == 3 ? other.Y1 : y1 + size;
                    float contactLength = side < 2
                        ? MathF.Min(y2, other.Y2) - MathF.Max(y1, other.Y1)
                        : MathF.Min(x2, other.X2) - MathF.Max(x1, other.X1);
                    if (contactLength <= PlacementToleranceMeters) continue;
                    float distance = Vector2.DistanceSquared(mouse, new Vector2((x1 + x2) * 0.5f, (y1 + y2) * 0.5f));
                    if (distance >= bestSquared) continue;
                    Wall candidate = new(x1, y1, x2, y2);
                    if (!RectangleIsInsideRoom(candidate) || WallOverlapsAny(candidate)) continue;
                    best = candidate;
                    bestSquared = distance;
                }
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    private bool IsPlacementGridEdge(float coordinate, float step)
    {
        double index = Math.Round(((double)coordinate - BoundaryThickness) / step);
        return Math.Abs(coordinate - (BoundaryThickness + index * step)) <= PlacementToleranceMeters;
    }

    /// <summary>Validate a square preview without changing the environment or undo stack.</summary>
    public bool CanPlaceBlockageFromClick(float x, float y, int cells = 1)
    {
        if (!float.IsFinite(x) || !float.IsFinite(y)) return false;
        Wall candidate = GetBlockagePlacementBounds(x, y, cells);
        return RectangleIsInsideRoom(candidate) && !WallOverlapsAny(candidate);
    }

    private bool RectangleIsInsideRoom(Wall rectangle) =>
        rectangle.X1 >= BoundaryThickness - PlacementToleranceMeters &&
        rectangle.Y1 >= BoundaryThickness - PlacementToleranceMeters &&
        rectangle.X2 <= Width - BoundaryThickness + PlacementToleranceMeters &&
        rectangle.Y2 <= Height - BoundaryThickness + PlacementToleranceMeters;

    /// <summary>Place a grid-aligned square. Edge/corner contact is allowed; overlap is not.</summary>
    public bool AddBlockageFromClick(float x, float y, int cells = 1)
    {
        if (!CanPlaceBlockageFromClick(x, y, cells)) return false;
        Wall candidate = GetBlockagePlacementBounds(x, y, cells);
        Blockages.Add(candidate);
        _undoStack.Push(("blockage", candidate));
        RebuildWalls();
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Place a true circular blockage with a fixed 2.5 m diameter.</summary>
    public bool AddCircularBlockageFromClick(float x, float y)
    {
        const float radius = CircleBlockage.DefaultRadiusMeters;
        Vector2 center = SnapPointToGrid(x, y);
        float innerMargin = BoundaryThickness + radius + 0.05f;
        if (center.X < innerMargin || center.X > Width - innerMargin ||
            center.Y < innerMargin || center.Y > Height - innerMargin)
        {
            return false;
        }

        CircleBlockage candidate = new(center, radius);
        if (CircleOverlapsAny(candidate))
        {
            return false;
        }

        CircularBlockages.Add(candidate);
        _undoStack.Push(("circle_blockage", candidate));
        RebuildWalls();
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Place a fixed blue 2x2 wall tile. "2x2" means two builder grid cells by two builder
    /// grid cells, keeping the element proportional to the existing snapped blockage tool.
    /// </summary>
    public bool AddBlueWallFromClick(float x, float y)
    {
        if (!CanPlaceBlockageFromClick(x, y, cells: 2)) return false;
        Wall candidate = GetBlockagePlacementBounds(x, y, cells: 2);
        BlueWalls.Add(candidate);
        _undoStack.Push(("bluewall", candidate));
        RebuildWalls();
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Add a mouse-positioned population group. Candidates expand outwards from the click in a
    /// deterministic square spiral, skipping solid geometry and already planned agents. This lets
    /// a 50-person placement naturally flow around blocked floor instead of stacking inside it.
    /// </summary>
    public bool AddAgentSpawnGroupFromClick(float x, float y, int count)
    {
        count = Math.Clamp(count, 1, 50);
        if (PlannedAgentCount + count > 5000)
        {
            return false;
        }

        Vector2 center = new(x, y);
        if (center.X <= BoundaryThickness || center.X >= Width - BoundaryThickness ||
            center.Y <= BoundaryThickness || center.Y >= Height - BoundaryThickness)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!TryBuildSpawnPositions(center, count, out List<Vector2> positions))
        {
            return false;
        }

        AgentSpawnGroup group = new(center, positions);
        AgentSpawnGroups.Add(group);
        _undoStack.Push(("agent_spawn", group));
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Flatten the builder-time spawn groups into deterministic start positions.</summary>
    public List<Vector2> GetPlannedAgentPositions()
    {
        List<Vector2> result = new(PlannedAgentCount);
        foreach (AgentSpawnGroup group in AgentSpawnGroups)
        {
            result.AddRange(group.Positions);
        }

        result.AddRange(Furniture.SelectMany(set => set.Chairs).Select(chair => chair.StartPosition));
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>Resize an empty builder room while preserving the existing application window.</summary>
    public bool TryResizeRoom(float widthMeters, float lengthMeters)
    {
        if (!CanResizeRoom)
        {
            return false;
        }

        _config.World.ApplySize(widthMeters, lengthMeters);
        Width = _config.World.WidthMeters;
        Height = _config.World.LengthMeters;
        RebuildWalls();
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Replace builder geometry from a validated saved scenario. The undo history is
    /// cleared because imported geometry is treated as the new builder baseline.
    /// </summary>
    public void ReplaceLayout(
        IEnumerable<Exit> exits,
        IEnumerable<Wall> blockages,
        IEnumerable<CircleBlockage>? circularBlockages = null,
        IEnumerable<Wall>? blueWalls = null,
        IEnumerable<AgentSpawnGroup>? agentSpawnGroups = null)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(exits);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(blockages);

        Furniture.Clear();
        Exits.Clear();
        Exits.AddRange(exits);
        Blockages.Clear();
        Blockages.AddRange(blockages);
        CircularBlockages.Clear();
        if (circularBlockages is not null)
        {
            CircularBlockages.AddRange(circularBlockages);
        }

        BlueWalls.Clear();
        if (blueWalls is not null)
        {
            BlueWalls.AddRange(blueWalls);
        }

        AgentSpawnGroups.Clear();
        if (agentSpawnGroups is not null)
        {
            AgentSpawnGroups.AddRange(agentSpawnGroups);
        }

        _undoStack.Clear();
        Explosion = null;
        RebuildWalls();
    }

    public bool IsPointBlocked(Vector2 position, float margin = 0f)
    {
        foreach (Wall wall in Walls)
        {
            if (wall.Contains(position, margin))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in CircularBlockages)
        {
            if (circle.Contains(position, margin))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public void RebuildWalls()
    {
        Walls.Clear();
        float t = BoundaryThickness;
        Walls.AddRange(BuildHorizontalWallWithOpenings("N", 0f, t, Width));
        Walls.AddRange(BuildHorizontalWallWithOpenings("S", Height - t, Height, Width));
        Walls.AddRange(BuildVerticalWallWithOpenings("W", 0f, t, Height));
        Walls.AddRange(BuildVerticalWallWithOpenings("E", Width - t, Width, Height));
        Walls.AddRange(Blockages);
        Walls.AddRange(BlueWalls);
        foreach (FurnitureSet set in Furniture)
            if (set.StaticObstacle is Wall rectangle) Walls.Add(rectangle);
        WallLayoutVersion++;
    }

    public List<Wall> BuildHorizontalWallWithOpenings(string side, float y1, float y2, float length)
    {
        List<(float Start, float End)> openings = Exits
            .Where(exit => exit.Side == side)
            .Select(exit => (exit.Position.X - exit.Size, exit.Position.X + exit.Size))
            .ToList();

        return SegmentsWithOpenings1D(0f, length, y1, y2, openings, horizontal: true);
    }

    public List<Wall> BuildVerticalWallWithOpenings(string side, float x1, float x2, float length)
    {
        List<(float Start, float End)> openings = Exits
            .Where(exit => exit.Side == side)
            .Select(exit => (exit.Position.Y - exit.Size, exit.Position.Y + exit.Size))
            .ToList();

        return SegmentsWithOpenings1D(0f, length, x1, x2, openings, horizontal: false);
    }

    public static List<Wall> SegmentsWithOpenings1D(
        float axisStart,
        float axisEnd,
        float fixedMin,
        float fixedMax,
        IReadOnlyList<(float Start, float End)> openings,
        bool horizontal)
    {
        if (openings.Count == 0)
        {
            return new List<Wall>
            {
                horizontal
                    ? new Wall(axisStart, fixedMin, axisEnd, fixedMax)
                    : new Wall(fixedMin, axisStart, fixedMax, axisEnd),
            };
        }

        List<(float Start, float End)> clamped = openings
            .Select(opening => (
                Start: Math.Clamp(opening.Start, axisStart, axisEnd),
                End: Math.Clamp(opening.End, axisStart, axisEnd)))
            .Where(opening => opening.End > opening.Start)
            .OrderBy(opening => opening.Start)
            .ToList();

        List<(float Start, float End)> merged = new();
        foreach ((float start, float end) in clamped)
        {
            if (merged.Count == 0)
            {
                merged.Add((start, end));
                continue;
            }

            (float lastStart, float lastEnd) = merged[^1];
            if (start <= lastEnd)
            {
                merged[^1] = (lastStart, Math.Max(lastEnd, end));
            }
            else
            {
                merged.Add((start, end));
            }
        }

        List<Wall> segments = new();
        float cursor = axisStart;
        foreach ((float start, float end) in merged)
        {
            if (start > cursor)
            {
                segments.Add(horizontal
                    ? new Wall(cursor, fixedMin, start, fixedMax)
                    : new Wall(fixedMin, cursor, fixedMax, start));
            }

            cursor = Math.Max(cursor, end);
        }

        if (cursor < axisEnd)
        {
            segments.Add(horizontal
                ? new Wall(cursor, fixedMin, axisEnd, fixedMax)
                : new Wall(fixedMin, cursor, fixedMax, axisEnd));
        }

        return segments;
    }

    public Wall? FindNearestWall(Vector2 position)
    {
        Wall? nearest = null;
        float minDistanceSquared = float.PositiveInfinity;
        foreach (Wall wall in Walls)
        {
            Vector2 closest = wall.ClosestPoint(position);
            float distanceSquared = Vector2.DistanceSquared(position, closest);
            if (distanceSquared < minDistanceSquared)
            {
                minDistanceSquared = distanceSquared;
                nearest = wall;
            }
        }

        return nearest;
    }

    public string? DetectBoundarySide(float x, float y)
    {
        float t = BoundaryThickness;
        const float snap = 0.40f;
        (string Side, float Distance)[] distances =
        {
            ("N", MathF.Abs(y - t / 2f)),
            ("S", MathF.Abs(y - (Height - t / 2f))),
            ("W", MathF.Abs(x - t / 2f)),
            ("E", MathF.Abs(x - (Width - t / 2f))),
        };

        (string side, float best) = distances.OrderBy(pair => pair.Distance).First();
        return best > t / 2f + snap ? null : side;
    }

    public bool ExitOverlapsExisting(Exit candidate)
    {
        foreach (Exit existing in Exits.Where(exit => exit.Side == candidate.Side))
        {
            float a0;
            float a1;
            float b0;
            float b1;
            if (candidate.Side is "N" or "S")
            {
                a0 = candidate.Position.X - candidate.Size;
                a1 = candidate.Position.X + candidate.Size;
                b0 = existing.Position.X - existing.Size;
                b1 = existing.Position.X + existing.Size;
            }
            else
            {
                a0 = candidate.Position.Y - candidate.Size;
                a1 = candidate.Position.Y + candidate.Size;
                b0 = existing.Position.Y - existing.Size;
                b1 = existing.Position.Y + existing.Size;
            }

            if (!(a1 < b0 || b1 < a0))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public bool ExitOverlapsBlockage(Exit candidate)
    {
        float size = candidate.Size;
        float x1 = candidate.Position.X - size;
        float y1 = candidate.Position.Y - size;
        float x2 = candidate.Position.X + size;
        float y2 = candidate.Position.Y + size;

        if (Blockages.Concat(BlueWalls).Concat(Furniture
            .Where(set => set.StaticObstacle is not null).Select(set => set.StaticObstacle!)).Any(blockage =>
            blockage.Overlaps(new Wall(x1, y1, x2, y2))))
        {
            return true;
        }

        return CircularBlockages.Any(circle => CircleIntersectsAabb(circle, x1, y1, x2, y2));
    }

    /// <summary>Check candidate against all current walls and exits; edge-touching is allowed.</summary>
    public bool WallOverlapsAny(Wall candidate)
    {
        foreach (Wall other in Walls)
        {
            if (PlacementRectanglesOverlap(candidate, other)) return true;
        }

        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in CircularBlockages)
        {
            if (candidate.OverlapsCircle(circle.Center, circle.Radius))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        foreach (Exit exit in Exits)
        {
            float size = exit.Size;
            float x1 = exit.Position.X - size;
            float y1 = exit.Position.Y - size;
            float x2 = exit.Position.X + size;
            float y2 = exit.Position.Y + size;
            if (PlacementRectanglesOverlap(candidate, new Wall(x1, y1, x2, y2)))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        float agentMargin = _config.Agent.Radius * 1.08f;
        foreach (AgentSpawnGroup group in AgentSpawnGroups)
        {
            foreach (Vector2 position in group.Positions)
            {
                if (candidate.Contains(position, agentMargin))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>True only for positive-area overlap exceeding placement rounding noise.</summary>
    private static bool PlacementRectanglesOverlap(Wall a, Wall b) =>
        a.Overlaps(b, PlacementToleranceMeters);

    public bool CircleOverlapsAny(CircleBlockage candidate)
    {
        foreach (Wall wall in Walls)
        {
            if (wall.OverlapsCircle(candidate.Center, candidate.Radius))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        foreach (CircleBlockage other in CircularBlockages)
        {
            float combined = candidate.Radius + other.Radius;
            if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(candidate.Center, other.Center) < combined * combined)
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        foreach (Exit exit in Exits)
        {
            float size = exit.Size;
            if (CircleIntersectsAabb(candidate,
                exit.Position.X - size, exit.Position.Y - size,
                exit.Position.X + size, exit.Position.Y + size))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        float agentMargin = _config.Agent.Radius * 1.08f;
        float exclusion = candidate.Radius + agentMargin;
        float exclusionSquared = exclusion * exclusion;
        foreach (AgentSpawnGroup group in AgentSpawnGroups)
        {
            foreach (Vector2 position in group.Positions)
            {
                if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(position, candidate.Center) < exclusionSquared)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static bool CircleIntersectsAabb(
        CircleBlockage circle, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
    {
        float closestX = Math.Clamp(circle.Center.X, x1, x2);
        float closestY = Math.Clamp(circle.Center.Y, y1, y2);
        Vector2 delta = circle.Center - new Vector2(closestX, closestY);
        return delta.LengthSquared() < circle.Radius * circle.Radius;
    }

    private bool TryBuildSpawnPositions(Vector2 center, int count, out List<Vector2> positions)
    {
        List<Vector2> result = new(count);
        positions = result;
        float radius = _config.Agent.Radius;
        float spacing = Math.Max(2.25f * radius, 0.05f);
        float minimumDistanceSquared = spacing * spacing * 0.94f;
        float minX = BoundaryThickness + radius + 0.05f;
        float maxX = Width - BoundaryThickness - radius - 0.05f;
        float minY = BoundaryThickness + radius + 0.05f;
        float maxY = Height - BoundaryThickness - radius - 0.05f;

        if (maxX <= minX || maxY <= minY)
        {
            return false;
        }

        List<Vector2> existing = GetPlannedAgentPositions();
        int maxRing = Math.Max(8, (int)MathF.Ceiling(Math.Max(Width, Height) / spacing) + 2);

        bool TryCandidate(int dx, int dy)
        {
            Vector2 candidate = center + new Vector2(dx * spacing, dy * spacing);
            if (candidate.X < minX || candidate.X > maxX || candidate.Y < minY || candidate.Y > maxY)
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (IsPointBlocked(candidate, radius * 1.08f))
            {
                return false;
            }

            foreach (Vector2 other in existing)
            {
                if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(candidate, other) < minimumDistanceSquared)
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            foreach (Vector2 other in result)
            {
                if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(candidate, other) < minimumDistanceSquared)
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            result.Add(candidate);
            return true;
        }

        TryCandidate(0, 0);
        for (int ring = 1; ring <= maxRing && result.Count < count; ring++)
        {
            for (int dx = -ring; dx <= ring && result.Count < count; dx++)
            {
                TryCandidate(dx, -ring);
                if (result.Count >= count) break;
                TryCandidate(dx, ring);
            }

            for (int dy = -ring + 1; dy <= ring - 1 && result.Count < count; dy++)
            {
                TryCandidate(-ring, dy);
                if (result.Count >= count) break;
                TryCandidate(ring, dy);
            }
        }

        if (result.Count == count)
        {
            return true;
        }

        result.Clear();
        return false;
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.Core/Model/Wall.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Model;

/// <summary>
/// Rectangular obstacle. X1/Y1 and X2/Y2 are its broad-phase bounds; a rotated
/// barricade additionally supplies an exact cached narrow-phase footprint.
/// </summary>
public sealed record Wall(float X1, float Y1, float X2, float Y2)
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A low furniture footprint blocks locomotion, but is not a full-height wall
    /// for visual perception, blast shielding or the existing simplified fume field.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsFurniture { get; init; }

    /// <summary>Moving furniture uses live body contacts, not its previous-frame wall proxy.</summary>
    public bool IsMovableFurniture { get; init; }

    /// <summary>Present only for free-angle assets; ordinary walls retain the original fast path.</summary>
    public OrientedRectangle? OrientedFootprint { get; init; }

    public OrientedRectangle AsRectangle() => OrientedFootprint ?? new OrientedRectangle(
        new Vector2((X1 + X2) * 0.5f, (Y1 + Y2) * 0.5f),
        new Vector2((X2 - X1) * 0.5f, (Y2 - Y1) * 0.5f), 0f);

    /// <summary>True only for positive-area overlap, ignoring the supplied rounding tolerance.</summary>
    public bool Overlaps(Wall other, float tolerance = 0f)
    {
        if (MathF.Min(X2, other.X2) - MathF.Max(X1, other.X1) <= tolerance ||
            MathF.Min(Y2, other.Y2) - MathF.Max(Y1, other.Y1) <= tolerance) return false;
        return (OrientedFootprint is null && other.OrientedFootprint is null) ||
            AsRectangle().Overlaps(other.AsRectangle(), tolerance);
    }

    public bool OverlapsCircle(Vector2 center, float radius) =>
        Vector2.DistanceSquared(center, ClosestPoint(center)) < radius * radius;

    public void CopyExpandedCorners(Span<Vector2> corners, float margin)
    {
        if (OrientedFootprint is OrientedRectangle rotated)
        {
            rotated.CopyExpandedCorners(corners, margin);
            return;
        }
        if (corners.Length < 4) throw new ArgumentException("Four corners are required.", nameof(corners));
        corners[0] = new Vector2(X1 - margin, Y1 - margin);
        corners[1] = new Vector2(X2 + margin, Y1 - margin);
        corners[2] = new Vector2(X2 + margin, Y2 + margin);
        corners[3] = new Vector2(X1 - margin, Y2 + margin);
    }

    /// <summary>Return a unit tangent along the longer wall axis.</summary>
    public Vector2 TangentDirection()
    {
        if (OrientedFootprint is OrientedRectangle rotated)
            return rotated.HalfExtents.X >= rotated.HalfExtents.Y ? rotated.AxisX : rotated.AxisY;
        float dx = X2 - X1;
        float dy = Y2 - Y1;
        if (MathF.Abs(dx) < 1e-5f && MathF.Abs(dy) < 1e-5f)
        {
            return Vector2.Zero;
        }

        return MathF.Abs(dx) >= MathF.Abs(dy) ? Vector2.UnitX : Vector2.UnitY;
    }

    /// <summary>Return whether a point lies inside the rectangle.</summary>
    public bool Contains(Vector2 position, float margin = 0f)
        => OrientedFootprint is OrientedRectangle rotated
            ? rotated.Contains(position, margin)
            : X1 - margin <= position.X && position.X <= X2 + margin &&
                Y1 - margin <= position.Y && position.Y <= Y2 + margin;

    public Vector2 ClosestPoint(Vector2 position)
        => OrientedFootprint is OrientedRectangle rotated ? rotated.ClosestPoint(position)
            : new Vector2(Math.Clamp(position.X, X1, X2), Math.Clamp(position.Y, Y1, Y2));
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.Core/Persistence/FinalizedSceneCheckpoint.cs

```csharp
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;

/// <summary>
/// Immutable-in-practice configuration checkpoint captured when the builder finalises a scene.
/// Runtime positions, hazard effects, injuries, chair damage and elapsed time are intentionally
/// excluded, so every replay returns to the ready-but-not-started state.
/// </summary>
public sealed class FinalizedSceneCheckpoint
{
    private FinalizedSceneCheckpoint(ScenarioDefinition definition)
    {
        Definition = definition;
    }

    public ScenarioDefinition Definition { get; }

    /// <summary>Capture the exact authored scene that is about to become a simulation run.</summary>
    public static FinalizedSceneCheckpoint Capture(
        Simulation simulation,
        int requestedAgentCount,
        string scenarioName)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(simulation);
        ScenarioDefinition definition = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(
            simulation,
            requestedAgentCount,
            scenarioName);
        definition.ValidateBasic();
        return new FinalizedSceneCheckpoint(definition);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Recreate frame zero with the same seed and authored population. Toxic-fume fields are
    /// recomputed because their cache is runtime data derived from the restored static layout.
    /// </summary>
    public Simulation CreateReadySimulation()
    {
        SimulationConfig config = Definition.CreateConfig();
        Simulation simulation = new(0, config, Definition.RandomSeed);
        Definition.ApplyLayout(simulation);

        if (simulation.ScenarioType == CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.ToxicFume &&
            simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.SourcePosition is not null)
        {
            simulation.PrecomputeToxicFume();
        }

        if (simulation.Environment.PlannedAgentCount > 0)
        {
            simulation.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(simulation.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions());
        }
        else
        {
            simulation.SpawnAgents(Definition.AgentCount);
        }

        simulation.SetRunning(false);
        return simulation;
    }
}
```
