## src/CrowdSim.Core/Persistence/ScenarioDefinition.cs

```csharp
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;

/// <summary>
/// Versioned, configuration-only scenario description. Builder-defined initial spawn positions
/// are scenario configuration and are persisted. Runtime-moved positions, injuries, panic, debris,
/// elapsed time and exited agents are intentionally excluded; those belong to a future snapshot feature.
/// </summary>
public sealed class ScenarioDefinition
{
    public const int CurrentVersion = 4;
    public const float LegacyMetersPerUnit = AgentConfig.HeightMeters / 42f;

    public int Version { get; init; } = CurrentVersion;
    public string Name { get; init; } = "Scenario";
    public int AgentCount { get; init; } = 200;
    public bool HybridEnabled { get; init; }
    public int RandomSeed { get; init; }
    public float RoomWidth { get; init; }
    public float RoomHeight { get; init; }
    public ScenarioType ScenarioType { get; init; } = CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.Explosion;
    public ToxicFumeScenario ToxicFume { get; init; } = new();
    public BlastZoneScenario BlastZones { get; init; } = new();
    public BehaviorScenario Behavior { get; init; } = new();
    public List<ExitScenario> Exits { get; init; } = new();
    public List<BlockageScenario> Blockages { get; init; } = new();
    public List<FurnitureScenario> Furniture { get; init; } = new();
    public List<CircleBlockageScenario> CircularBlockages { get; init; } = new();
    public List<BlockageScenario> BlueWalls { get; init; } = new();
    public List<AgentSpawnGroupScenario> AgentSpawnGroups { get; init; } = new();

    /// <summary>Capture the current scenario configuration without runtime agent state.</summary>
    public static ScenarioDefinition Capture(
        Simulation simulation,
        int requestedAgentCount,
        string name)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(simulation);
        AgentConfig agent = simulation.Config.Agent;
        int plannedCount = simulation.Environment.PlannedAgentCount;
        int count = plannedCount > 0
            ? plannedCount
            : simulation.Agents.Count > 0
                ? simulation.Agents.Count
                : Math.Clamp(requestedAgentCount, 0, 5000);

        return new ScenarioDefinition
        {
            Name = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name) ? "Scenario" : name.Trim(),
            AgentCount = count,
            RandomSeed = simulation.RandomSeed,
            HybridEnabled = simulation.Config.HybridEnabled,
            RoomWidth = simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters,
            RoomHeight = simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters,
            ScenarioType = simulation.ScenarioType,
            ToxicFume = ToxicFumeScenario.Capture(simulation),
            BlastZones = new BlastZoneScenario
            {
                Kill = agent.HardKillRadius,
                Incapacitation = agent.HeatIncapacityRadius,
                Fallen = agent.FallenRadius,
                Injury = agent.InjuryRadius,
                Panic = agent.HeatRadius,
            },
            Behavior = BehaviorScenario.Capture(agent.Behavior),
            Exits = simulation.Environment.Exits
                .Select(exit => new ExitScenario
                {
                    Name = exit.Name,
                    X = exit.Position.X,
                    Y = exit.Position.Y,
                    Size = exit.Size,
                    Side = exit.Side,
                })
                .ToList(),
            Blockages = simulation.Environment.Blockages
                .Select(wall => new BlockageScenario
                {
                    X1 = wall.X1,
                    Y1 = wall.Y1,
                    X2 = wall.X2,
                    Y2 = wall.Y2,
                })
                .ToList(),
            Furniture = simulation.Environment.Furniture.Select(set => new FurnitureScenario
            { Kind = set.Kind, X = set.Center.X, Y = set.Center.Y, Rotation = set.Rotation }).ToList(),
            CircularBlockages = simulation.Environment.CircularBlockages.Where(circle => !circle.IsFurniture)
                .Select(circle => new CircleBlockageScenario
                {
                    CenterX = circle.Center.X,
                    CenterY = circle.Center.Y,
                    Radius = circle.Radius,
                })
                .ToList(),
            BlueWalls = simulation.Environment.BlueWalls
                .Select(wall => new BlockageScenario
                {
                    X1 = wall.X1,
                    Y1 = wall.Y1,
                    X2 = wall.X2,
                    Y2 = wall.Y2,
                })
                .ToList(),
            AgentSpawnGroups = simulation.Environment.AgentSpawnGroups
                .Select(group => new AgentSpawnGroupScenario
                {
                    CenterX = group.Center.X,
                    CenterY = group.Center.Y,
                    Positions = group.Positions
                        .Select(position => new AgentStartScenario
                        {
                            X = position.X,
                            Y = position.Y,
                        })
                        .ToList(),
                })
                .ToList(),
        };
    }

    /// <summary>Create a fresh default config and apply this scenario's configurable radii.</summary>
    public SimulationConfig CreateConfig()
    {
        ValidateBasic();
        SimulationConfig config = SimulationConfig.CreateDefault();
        config.HybridEnabled = HybridEnabled;
        if (RoomWidth > 0 && RoomHeight > 0 &&
            (RoomWidth != config.World.WidthMeters || RoomHeight != config.World.LengthMeters))
        {
            config.World.ApplySize(RoomWidth, RoomHeight);
        }

        config.Agent.SetBlastZoneRadii(
            BlastZones.Kill,
            BlastZones.Incapacitation,
            BlastZones.Fallen,
            BlastZones.Injury,
            BlastZones.Panic);
        Behavior.Apply(config.Agent.Behavior);
        return config;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Apply saved exits, regular blockages, blue walls and planned spawn groups to a fresh
    /// simulation. Agents are intentionally not spawned; the builder finalises the loaded scenario
    /// so optional edits can occur before deterministic population creation.
    /// </summary>
    public void ApplyLayout(Simulation simulation)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(simulation);
        ValidateAgainst(simulation.Config);

        List<Exit> exits = Exits
            .Select(item => new Exit(
                item.Name,
                new System.Numerics.Vector2(item.X, item.Y),
                item.Size,
                item.Side))
            .ToList();
        List<Wall> blockages = Blockages
            .Select(item => new Wall(item.X1, item.Y1, item.X2, item.Y2))
            .ToList();
        List<CircleBlockage> circularBlockages = CircularBlockages
            .Select(item => new CircleBlockage(
                new System.Numerics.Vector2(item.CenterX, item.CenterY),
                item.Radius))
            .ToList();
        List<Wall> blueWalls = BlueWalls
            .Select(item => new Wall(item.X1, item.Y1, item.X2, item.Y2))
            .ToList();
        List<AgentSpawnGroup> spawnGroups = AgentSpawnGroups
            .Select(group => new AgentSpawnGroup(
                new System.Numerics.Vector2(group.CenterX, group.CenterY),
                group.Positions.Select(position => new System.Numerics.Vector2(position.X, position.Y))))
            .ToList();

        // Restore physical furniture first. Builder placement reserves additional departure
        // space, but standing groups placed later are allowed to occupy that free space.
        simulation.Environment.ReplaceLayout(exits, blockages, circularBlockages, blueWalls);
        foreach (FurnitureScenario set in Furniture)
        {
            if (!simulation.Environment.RestoreFurniture(set.Kind, new System.Numerics.Vector2(set.X, set.Y), set.Rotation))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Saved furniture physically overlaps geometry or room bounds.");
        }
        foreach (AgentSpawnGroup group in spawnGroups)
        foreach (System.Numerics.Vector2 position in group.Positions)
        {
            float margin = simulation.Config.Agent.Radius * 1.08f;
            if (simulation.Environment.CircularBlockages.Any(circle => circle.IsFurniture &&
                circle.Contains(position, margin)) ||
                simulation.Environment.Furniture.Any(set => set.StaticObstacle is Wall wall &&
                    wall.Contains(position, margin)))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("A saved standing occupant physically overlaps furniture.");
        }
        simulation.Environment.AgentSpawnGroups.AddRange(spawnGroups);
        simulation.BuildWallGrid();
        simulation.Config.HybridEnabled = HybridEnabled;
        simulation.SetScenarioType(ScenarioType);
        if (ScenarioType == CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.ToxicFume)
        {
            ToxicFume.Apply(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration);
            simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.RestoreSource(ToxicFume.HasSource
                ? new System.Numerics.Vector2(ToxicFume.SourceX, ToxicFume.SourceY)
                : null);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Convert a version-1 pixel/world-unit scenario into the version-2 metric schema.</summary>
    public static ScenarioDefinition UpgradeLegacyV1(ScenarioDefinition legacy)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(legacy);
        if (legacy.Version != 1)
        {
            return legacy;
        }

        const float scale = LegacyMetersPerUnit;
        return new ScenarioDefinition
        {
            Version = 2,
            Name = legacy.Name,
            AgentCount = legacy.AgentCount,
            RandomSeed = legacy.RandomSeed,
            RoomWidth = legacy.RoomWidth * scale,
            RoomHeight = legacy.RoomHeight * scale,
            ScenarioType = CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.Explosion,
            ToxicFume = new ToxicFumeScenario(),
            BlastZones = new BlastZoneScenario
            {
                Kill = legacy.BlastZones.Kill * scale,
                Incapacitation = legacy.BlastZones.Incapacitation * scale,
                Fallen = legacy.BlastZones.Fallen * scale,
                Injury = legacy.BlastZones.Injury * scale,
                Panic = legacy.BlastZones.Panic * scale,
            },
            Behavior = legacy.Behavior,
            Exits = legacy.Exits.Select(exit => new ExitScenario
            {
                Name = exit.Name,
                X = exit.X * scale,
                Y = exit.Y * scale,
                Size = exit.Size * scale,
                Side = exit.Side,
            }).ToList(),
            Blockages = legacy.Blockages.Select(wall => new BlockageScenario
            {
                X1 = wall.X1 * scale,
                Y1 = wall.Y1 * scale,
                X2 = wall.X2 * scale,
                Y2 = wall.Y2 * scale,
            }).ToList(),
            CircularBlockages = new List<CircleBlockageScenario>(),
            BlueWalls = legacy.BlueWalls.Select(wall => new BlockageScenario
            {
                X1 = wall.X1 * scale,
                Y1 = wall.Y1 * scale,
                X2 = wall.X2 * scale,
                Y2 = wall.Y2 * scale,
            }).ToList(),
            AgentSpawnGroups = legacy.AgentSpawnGroups.Select(group => new AgentSpawnGroupScenario
            {
                CenterX = group.CenterX * scale,
                CenterY = group.CenterY * scale,
                Positions = group.Positions.Select(position => new AgentStartScenario
                {
                    X = position.X * scale,
                    Y = position.Y * scale,
                }).ToList(),
            }).ToList(),
        };
    }

    /// <summary>Upgrade version-2 metric scenarios by assigning the historical Explosion mode.</summary>
    public static ScenarioDefinition UpgradeLegacyV2(ScenarioDefinition legacy)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(legacy);
        if (legacy.Version != 2)
        {
            return legacy;
        }

        return new ScenarioDefinition
        {
            Version = CurrentVersion,
            Name = legacy.Name,
            AgentCount = legacy.AgentCount,
            RandomSeed = legacy.RandomSeed,
            RoomWidth = legacy.RoomWidth,
            RoomHeight = legacy.RoomHeight,
            ScenarioType = CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.Explosion,
            ToxicFume = new ToxicFumeScenario(),
            BlastZones = legacy.BlastZones,
            Behavior = legacy.Behavior,
            Exits = legacy.Exits,
            Blockages = legacy.Blockages,
            CircularBlockages = legacy.CircularBlockages,
            BlueWalls = legacy.BlueWalls,
            AgentSpawnGroups = legacy.AgentSpawnGroups,
        };
    }

    /// <summary>Upgrade version-3 scenarios by adding an empty furniture layout.</summary>
    public static ScenarioDefinition UpgradeLegacyV3(ScenarioDefinition legacy)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(legacy);
        if (legacy.Version != 3)
        {
            return legacy;
        }

        return new ScenarioDefinition
        {
            Version = CurrentVersion,
            Name = legacy.Name,
            AgentCount = legacy.AgentCount,
            RandomSeed = legacy.RandomSeed,
            RoomWidth = legacy.RoomWidth,
            RoomHeight = legacy.RoomHeight,
            ScenarioType = legacy.ScenarioType,
            ToxicFume = legacy.ToxicFume,
            BlastZones = legacy.BlastZones,
            Behavior = legacy.Behavior,
            Exits = legacy.Exits,
            Blockages = legacy.Blockages,
            CircularBlockages = legacy.CircularBlockages,
            BlueWalls = legacy.BlueWalls,
            AgentSpawnGroups = legacy.AgentSpawnGroups,
        };
    }

    public void ValidateBasic()
    {
        if (Version != CurrentVersion)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                $"Unsupported scenario version {Version}. Expected {CurrentVersion}.");
        }

        if (AgentCount is < 0 or > 5000)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario AgentCount must be between 0 and 5000.");
        }

        if (ToxicFume is null || BlastZones is null || Behavior is null || Exits is null || Blockages is null ||
            CircularBlockages is null || BlueWalls is null || AgentSpawnGroups is null || Furniture is null)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario is missing required configuration sections.");
        }

        if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType), ScenarioType))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an unsupported scenario type.");
        }

        ToxicFume.Validate();

        int plannedCount = 0;
        int stageCount = 0;
        foreach (FurnitureScenario? set in Furniture)
        {
            if (set is null || !Enum.IsDefined(set.Kind) || !float.IsFinite(set.X) || !float.IsFinite(set.Y) || !float.IsFinite(set.Rotation))
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains invalid furniture.");
            if (set.Kind == FurnitureKind.Stage && ++stageCount > 1)
                throw new InvalidDataException("A scenario may contain at most one stage.");
            plannedCount += FurnitureSet.GetSeatCount(set.Kind);
            if (plannedCount > 5000) throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains more than 5000 occupants.");
        }
        foreach (AgentSpawnGroupScenario? group in AgentSpawnGroups)
        {
            if (group?.Positions is null)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid agent-spawn group.");
            }

            plannedCount += group.Positions.Count;
            if (plannedCount > 5000)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains more than 5000 planned agents.");
            }
        }

        Behavior.Validate();

        float[] radii =
        {
            BlastZones.Kill,
            BlastZones.Incapacitation,
            BlastZones.Fallen,
            BlastZones.Injury,
            BlastZones.Panic,
        };
        if (radii.Any(value => !float.IsFinite(value) || value <= 0f))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Blast-zone radii must be finite positive values.");
        }

        if (!(BlastZones.Kill < BlastZones.Incapacitation &&
              BlastZones.Incapacitation < BlastZones.Fallen &&
              BlastZones.Fallen < BlastZones.Injury &&
              BlastZones.Injury < BlastZones.Panic))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                "Blast-zone radii must be strictly ordered: Kill < Incapacitation < Fallen < Injury < Panic.");
        }
    }

    private void ValidateAgainst(SimulationConfig config)
    {
        ValidateBasic();
        if ((RoomWidth > 0 && RoomWidth != config.World.WidthMeters) ||
            (RoomHeight > 0 && RoomHeight != config.World.LengthMeters))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario room dimensions do not match the loaded configuration.");
        }

        if (ScenarioType == CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.ToxicFume && ToxicFume.HasSource &&
            (!float.IsFinite(ToxicFume.SourceX) || !float.IsFinite(ToxicFume.SourceY) ||
             ToxicFume.SourceX < 0f || ToxicFume.SourceX > config.World.WidthMeters ||
             ToxicFume.SourceY < 0f || ToxicFume.SourceY > config.World.LengthMeters))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid toxic-fume source position.");
        }

        foreach (ExitScenario exit in Exits)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(exit.Name) || exit.Size <= 0 ||
                exit.Side is not ("N" or "S" or "E" or "W") ||
                !float.IsFinite(exit.X) || !float.IsFinite(exit.Y))
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid exit definition.");
            }
        }

        foreach (BlockageScenario wall in Blockages)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(wall.X1) || !float.IsFinite(wall.Y1) ||
                !float.IsFinite(wall.X2) || !float.IsFinite(wall.Y2) ||
                wall.X2 <= wall.X1 || wall.Y2 <= wall.Y1)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid blockage definition.");
            }
        }

        foreach (CircleBlockageScenario circle in CircularBlockages)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(circle.CenterX) || !float.IsFinite(circle.CenterY) ||
                !float.IsFinite(circle.Radius) || circle.Radius <= 0f ||
                circle.CenterX - circle.Radius < 0f ||
                circle.CenterY - circle.Radius < 0f ||
                circle.CenterX + circle.Radius > config.World.WidthMeters ||
                circle.CenterY + circle.Radius > config.World.LengthMeters)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid circular blockage definition.");
            }
        }

        foreach (BlockageScenario wall in BlueWalls)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(wall.X1) || !float.IsFinite(wall.Y1) ||
                !float.IsFinite(wall.X2) || !float.IsFinite(wall.Y2) ||
                wall.X2 <= wall.X1 || wall.Y2 <= wall.Y1)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid blue-wall definition.");
            }
        }

        foreach (AgentSpawnGroupScenario group in AgentSpawnGroups)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(group.CenterX) || !float.IsFinite(group.CenterY) || group.Positions is null)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid agent-spawn group.");
            }

            foreach (AgentStartScenario position in group.Positions)
            {
                if (!float.IsFinite(position.X) || !float.IsFinite(position.Y) ||
                    position.X < 0f || position.X > config.World.WidthMeters ||
                    position.Y < 0f || position.Y > config.World.LengthMeters)
                {
                    throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains an invalid planned agent position.");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

public sealed class ToxicFumeScenario
{
    public bool HasSource { get; init; }
    public float SourceX { get; init; }
    public float SourceY { get; init; }
    public float InitialRadiusMeters { get; init; } = ToxicFumeConfig.DefaultInitialRadiusMeters;
    public float DispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond { get; init; } = ToxicFumeConfig.DefaultDispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond;
    public float MaximumExtentMeters { get; init; } = ToxicFumeConfig.DefaultMaximumExtentMeters;
    public float ReleaseDurationSeconds { get; init; } = ToxicFumeConfig.DefaultReleaseDurationSeconds;
    public float DriftDirectionDegrees { get; init; } = ToxicFumeConfig.DefaultDriftDirectionDegrees;
    public float DriftBias { get; init; } = ToxicFumeConfig.DefaultDriftBias;
    public float AwarenessConcentration { get; init; } = ToxicFumeConfig.DefaultAwarenessConcentration;
    public float DangerConcentration { get; init; } = ToxicFumeConfig.DefaultDangerConcentration;
    public float ImpairmentExposure { get; init; } = ToxicFumeConfig.DefaultImpairmentExposure;
    public float IncapacitationExposure { get; init; } = ToxicFumeConfig.DefaultIncapacitationExposure;

    public static ToxicFumeScenario Capture(Simulation simulation)
    {
        ToxicFumeConfig config = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration;
        System.Numerics.Vector2? source = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.SourcePosition;
        return new ToxicFumeScenario
        {
            HasSource = source.HasValue,
            SourceX = source?.X ?? 0f,
            SourceY = source?.Y ?? 0f,
            InitialRadiusMeters = config.InitialRadiusMeters,
            DispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond = config.DispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond,
            MaximumExtentMeters = config.MaximumExtentMeters,
            ReleaseDurationSeconds = config.ReleaseDurationSeconds,
            DriftDirectionDegrees = config.DriftDirectionDegrees,
            DriftBias = config.DriftBias,
            AwarenessConcentration = config.AwarenessConcentration,
            DangerConcentration = config.DangerConcentration,
            ImpairmentExposure = config.ImpairmentExposure,
            IncapacitationExposure = config.IncapacitationExposure,
        };
    }

    public void Apply(ToxicFumeConfig config)
    {
        Validate();
        config.SetValues(
            InitialRadiusMeters,
            DispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond,
            MaximumExtentMeters,
            ReleaseDurationSeconds,
            DriftDirectionDegrees,
            DriftBias,
            AwarenessConcentration,
            DangerConcentration,
            ImpairmentExposure,
            IncapacitationExposure);
    }

    public void Validate()
    {
        float[] values =
        {
            InitialRadiusMeters, DispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond, MaximumExtentMeters,
            ReleaseDurationSeconds, DriftDirectionDegrees, DriftBias, AwarenessConcentration,
            DangerConcentration, ImpairmentExposure, IncapacitationExposure,
        };
        if (values.Any(value => !float.IsFinite(value)) ||
            InitialRadiusMeters is < 0.20f or > 5.00f ||
            DispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond is < 0.05f or > 2.00f ||
            MaximumExtentMeters is < 2.00f or > 60.0f ||
            MaximumExtentMeters < InitialRadiusMeters ||
            ReleaseDurationSeconds is < 1.0f or > 180.0f ||
            DriftBias is < 0f or > 1f ||
            AwarenessConcentration is < 0.02f or > 0.80f ||
            DangerConcentration <= AwarenessConcentration || DangerConcentration > 0.98f ||
            ImpairmentExposure is < 1f or > 120f ||
            IncapacitationExposure <= ImpairmentExposure || IncapacitationExposure > 300f)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains invalid toxic-fume configuration values.");
        }
    }
}

public sealed class BehaviorScenario
{
    public float TraitVariation { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultTraitVariation;
    public float ReactionVariation { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultReactionVariation;
    public float StressSusceptibility { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultStressSusceptibility;
    public float StressPersistence { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultStressPersistence;
    public float CrowdFollowing { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultCrowdFollowing;
    public float PersonalSpace { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultPersonalSpace;
    public float PanicSpaceCompression { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultPanicSpaceCompression;
    public float EmergencyUrgency { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultEmergencyUrgency;
    public float MaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultMaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond;
    public float HelpingTendency { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultHelpingTendency;
    public float RouteFamiliarity { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultRouteFamiliarity;
    public float BottleneckAssertiveness { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultBottleneckAssertiveness;
    public float BottleneckPressureSensitivity { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultBottleneckPressureSensitivity;
    public float BottleneckSpaceCompression { get; init; } = BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultBottleneckSpaceCompression;

    public static BehaviorScenario Capture(BehaviorTuningConfig tuning)
        => new()
        {
            TraitVariation = tuning.TraitVariation,
            ReactionVariation = tuning.ReactionVariation,
            StressSusceptibility = tuning.StressSusceptibility,
            StressPersistence = tuning.StressPersistence,
            CrowdFollowing = tuning.CrowdFollowing,
            PersonalSpace = tuning.PersonalSpace,
            PanicSpaceCompression = tuning.PanicSpaceCompression,
            EmergencyUrgency = tuning.EmergencyUrgency,
            MaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond = tuning.MaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond,
            HelpingTendency = tuning.HelpingTendency,
            RouteFamiliarity = tuning.RouteFamiliarity,
            BottleneckAssertiveness = tuning.BottleneckAssertiveness,
            BottleneckPressureSensitivity = tuning.BottleneckPressureSensitivity,
            BottleneckSpaceCompression = tuning.BottleneckSpaceCompression,
        };

    public void Apply(BehaviorTuningConfig tuning)
    {
        Validate();
        tuning.SetMaxRunningSpeed(MaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond);
        tuning.SetValues(
            TraitVariation, ReactionVariation, StressSusceptibility, StressPersistence,
            CrowdFollowing, PersonalSpace, PanicSpaceCompression, EmergencyUrgency,
            HelpingTendency, RouteFamiliarity, BottleneckAssertiveness,
            BottleneckPressureSensitivity, BottleneckSpaceCompression);
    }

    public void Validate()
    {
        float[] values =
        {
            TraitVariation, ReactionVariation, StressSusceptibility, StressPersistence,
            CrowdFollowing, PersonalSpace, PanicSpaceCompression, EmergencyUrgency,
            MaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond,
            HelpingTendency, RouteFamiliarity, BottleneckAssertiveness,
            BottleneckPressureSensitivity, BottleneckSpaceCompression,
        };
        if (values.Any(value => !float.IsFinite(value)) ||
            TraitVariation is < 0f or > 1f ||
            ReactionVariation is < 0f or > 1f ||
            StressSusceptibility is < 0.60f or > 1.40f ||
            StressPersistence is < 0.50f or > 2.00f ||
            CrowdFollowing is < 0f or > 1f ||
            PersonalSpace is < 0.85f or > 1.30f ||
            PanicSpaceCompression is < 0f or > 0.35f ||
            EmergencyUrgency is < 0.80f or > 1.30f ||
            MaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond < BehaviorTuningConfig.MinimumRunningSpeedLimitMetersPerSecond ||
            MaxRunningSpeedMetersPerSecond > BehaviorTuningConfig.MaximumRunningSpeedLimitMetersPerSecond ||
            HelpingTendency is < 0f or > 1f ||
            RouteFamiliarity is < 0f or > 1f ||
            BottleneckAssertiveness is < 0f or > 1f ||
            BottleneckPressureSensitivity is < 0.50f or > 1.50f ||
            BottleneckSpaceCompression is < 0f or > 0.35f)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario contains invalid behaviour tuning values.");
        }
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.Core/Persistence/ScenarioFileStore.cs

```csharp
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;

/// <summary>JSON file persistence for configuration-only scenario definitions.</summary>
public static class ScenarioFileStore
{
    private const string ApplicationFolderName = "CrowdSimCs";
    private const string ScenarioFolderName = "scenarios";

    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions JsonOptions = new()
    {
        WriteIndented = true,
        PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase,
        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
        NumberHandling = JsonNumberHandling.Strict,
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// Stable, user-writable scenario directory. A packaged desktop application must not depend
    /// on its process working directory, which can be read-only or change between launch methods.
    /// </summary>
    public static string DefaultDirectory
    {
        get
        {
            string localData = System.Environment.GetFolderPath(
                System.Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData,
                System.Environment.SpecialFolderOption.Create);
            return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(localData)
                ? Path.Combine(localData, ApplicationFolderName, ScenarioFolderName)
                : Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, ScenarioFolderName);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Former working-directory location retained as a read-only compatibility source.</summary>
    public static string LegacyDirectory
        => Path.Combine(System.Environment.CurrentDirectory, ScenarioFolderName);

    public static IReadOnlyList<string> ListScenarioNames(string? directory = null)
    {
        if (directory is not null)
        {
            return ListNamesInDirectory(directory);
        }

        // Show previous working-directory saves alongside new per-user saves without moving or
        // overwriting user files. The per-user copy wins if names collide.
        return ListNamesInDirectory(DefaultDirectory)
            .Concat(PathsEqual(DefaultDirectory, LegacyDirectory)
                ? Array.Empty<string>()
                : ListNamesInDirectory(LegacyDirectory))
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(name => name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToArray();
    }

    private static IReadOnlyList<string> ListNamesInDirectory(string targetDirectory)
    {
        try
        {
            if (!Directory.Exists(targetDirectory))
            {
                return Array.Empty<string>();
            }

            return Directory.EnumerateFiles(targetDirectory, "*.json", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
                .Select(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension)
                .Where(name => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
                .Select(name => name!)
                .OrderBy(name => name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToArray();
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (
            exception is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException or DirectoryNotFoundException)
        {
            // One inaccessible compatibility directory must not hide valid per-user saves.
            return Array.Empty<string>();
        }
    }

    public static string Save(
        ScenarioDefinition scenario,
        string? directory = null)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(scenario);
        scenario.ValidateBasic();

        string targetDirectory = directory ?? DefaultDirectory;
        Directory.CreateDirectory(targetDirectory);
        string safeName = SanitizeName(scenario.Name);
        string path = Path.Combine(targetDirectory, safeName + ".json");
        string json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(scenario, JsonOptions);
        string temporaryPath = Path.Combine(
            targetDirectory,
            $".{safeName}.{Guid.NewGuid():N}.tmp");
        try
        {
            File.WriteAllText(temporaryPath, json);
            File.Move(temporaryPath, path, overwrite: true);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (File.Exists(temporaryPath))
            {
                File.Delete(temporaryPath);
            }
        }

        return path;
    }

    public static ScenarioDefinition Load(
        string scenarioName,
        string? directory = null)
    {
        string safeName = SanitizeName(scenarioName);
        string path = ResolveLoadPath(safeName, directory);
        if (!File.Exists(path))
        {
            throw new FileNotFoundException($"Scenario '{safeName}' was not found.", path);
        }

        string json = File.ReadAllText(path);
        ScenarioDefinition? scenario = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ScenarioDefinition>(json, JsonOptions);
        if (scenario is null)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Scenario JSON did not contain a valid scenario object.");
        }

        if (scenario.Version == 1)
        {
            scenario = ScenarioDefinition.UpgradeLegacyV1(scenario);
        }

        if (scenario.Version == 2)
        {
            scenario = ScenarioDefinition.UpgradeLegacyV2(scenario);
        }

        if (scenario.Version == 3)
        {
            scenario = ScenarioDefinition.UpgradeLegacyV3(scenario);
        }
        scenario.ValidateBasic();
        return scenario;
    }

    private static string ResolveLoadPath(string safeName, string? directory)
    {
        if (directory is not null)
        {
            return Path.Combine(directory, safeName + ".json");
        }

        string primary = Path.Combine(DefaultDirectory, safeName + ".json");
        if (File.Exists(primary) || PathsEqual(DefaultDirectory, LegacyDirectory))
        {
            return primary;
        }

        return Path.Combine(LegacyDirectory, safeName + ".json");
    }

    private static bool PathsEqual(string left, string right)
        => string.Equals(
            Path.GetFullPath(left).TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar),
            Path.GetFullPath(right).TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar),
            OperatingSystem.IsWindows()
                ? StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase
                : StringComparison.Ordinal);

    public static string SanitizeName(string? name)
    {
        string candidate = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name) ? "scenario" : name.Trim();
        char[] invalid = Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars();
        string safe = new(candidate.Select(character => invalid.Contains(character) ? '_' : character).ToArray());
        safe = safe.Replace(' ', '_');
        while (safe.Contains("__", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            safe = safe.Replace("__", "_", StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }

        safe = safe.Trim('_', '.');
        return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(safe) ? "scenario" : safe;
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.Core/Simulation.ChairPushing.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core;

public sealed partial class Simulation
{
    private readonly List<Agent> _chairPushAgentScratch = new(32);
    private readonly List<FurnitureChair> _chairPushGroup = new(3);

    /// <summary>
    /// Push a reachable loose chair, or a bounded group when individual shifts are blocked.
    /// Jammed chairs remain solid and let the existing bypass/wait/replan behaviour proceed.
    /// </summary>
    internal bool TryPushLooseChair(Agent agent, CircleBlockage obstacle, Vector2 desired)
    {
        FurnitureChair? chair = obstacle.ChairOwner;
        if (chair is null || !ReferenceEquals(chair.Obstacle, obstacle) ||
            chair.State is not (ChairState.Upright or ChairState.Fallen) ||
            chair.OccupantId is not null || chair.LastPushFrame == FrameIndex ||
            (agent.Posture != SeatingPosture.Walking &&
             !(agent.Posture == SeatingPosture.StandingUp && agent.StandUpElapsed >= agent.StandUpSeconds)) ||
            agent.State is not (AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured) ||
            agent.Intent == BehaviorIntent.AssistCasualty ||
            !VectorMath.IsFinite(desired) || desired.LengthSquared() < 1e-8f)
            return false;

        Vector2 offset = chair.Position - agent.Position;
        float distance = offset.Length();
        float reachMargin = agent.State == AgentState.Injured ? 0.45f : 0.30f;
        if (distance > obstacle.Radius + Config.Agent.Radius + reachMargin || distance < 1e-5f)
            return false;
        Vector2 away = offset / distance;
        if (Vector2.Dot(VectorMath.SafeNormalize(desired), away) < 0.10f) return false;

        // Agent velocities use metres per reference tick; the push itself uses SI seconds.
        float walkingSpeed = agent.Velocity.Length() / Configuration.AgentConfig.ReferenceStepSeconds;
        float pushSpeed = Math.Clamp(0.5f + walkingSpeed * 0.55f, 0.5f, 1.5f);
        if (agent.State == AgentState.Injured)
        {
            float mobility = Math.Clamp(agent.InjurySpeedFactor * agent.ToxicMobilityFactor, 0.15f, 1f);
            pushSpeed = Math.Min(pushSpeed, 0.20f + 0.40f * mobility);
        }
        float travel = Math.Min(0.12f, pushSpeed * Config.Agent.Dt);
        Vector2 side = VectorMath.Perpendicular(away);
        if ((agent.AgentId & 1) != 0) side = -side;
        // Forward first, then bounded diagonal/sideways shifts to open a local gap.
        Span<Vector2> directions = stackalloc Vector2[5]
        {
            away, VectorMath.SafeNormalize(away + side), VectorMath.SafeNormalize(away - side), side, -side
        };
        foreach (Vector2 direction in directions)
        {
            Vector2 destination = chair.Position + direction * travel;
            if (!ChairPushPathIsClear(chair, destination)) continue;
            chair.Position = destination;
            chair.LastPushFrame = FrameIndex; // dense crowds cannot multiply speed in one tick
            chair.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; // friction stops the chair when contact ends
            SetFurnitureObstacle(chair, chair.State);
            agent.ClearRoute();
            agent.LastChairPushFrame = FrameIndex;
            agent.LastChairPushDirection = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(desired);
            agent.Velocity *= 0.90f;
            return true;
        }
        // Prefer shifting a single chair; only then try moving a small contacting group.
        foreach (Vector2 direction in directions)
        {
            if (!TryTranslateChairGroup(chair, direction * travel)) continue;
            agent.ClearRoute();
            agent.LastChairPushFrame = FrameIndex;
            agent.LastChairPushDirection = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(desired);
            agent.Velocity *= 0.90f;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>Discover at most three loose chairs and validate their motion before atomic commit.</summary>
    internal bool TryTranslateChairGroup(FurnitureChair first, Vector2 displacement)
    {
        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(displacement) || displacement.LengthSquared() < 1e-8f ||
            displacement.LengthSquared() > 0.1201f * 0.1201f || !CanJoinChairGroup(first)) return false;
        _chairPushGroup.Clear();
        _chairPushGroup.Add(first);
        int steps = Math.Max(1, (int)MathF.Ceiling(displacement.Length() / 0.025f));
        for (int index = 0; index < _chairPushGroup.Count; index++)
        {
            FurnitureChair member = _chairPushGroup[index];
            Vector2 previous = member.Position;
            for (int step = 1; step <= steps; step++)
            {
                Vector2 point = member.Position + displacement * (step / (float)steps);
                foreach (CircleBlockage obstacle in Environment.CircularBlockages)
                {
                    if (ReferenceEquals(obstacle, member.Obstacle) ||
                        (obstacle.ChairOwner is FurnitureChair grouped && _chairPushGroup.Contains(grouped))) continue;
                    if (SeparatingOrClear(previous, point, obstacle.Center, member.Obstacle!.Radius + obstacle.Radius)) continue;
                    FurnitureChair? next = obstacle.ChairOwner;
                    if (next is null || !CanJoinChairGroup(next) || _chairPushGroup.Count == 3) return false;
                    _chairPushGroup.Add(next);
                }
                previous = point;
            }
        }
        if (_chairPushGroup.Count < 2) return false;
        // Added resistance: two chairs move at 2/3 speed, three at 1/2 speed.
        Vector2 reduced = displacement / (1f + 0.5f * (_chairPushGroup.Count - 1));
        foreach (FurnitureChair member in _chairPushGroup)
            if (!ChairPushPathIsClear(member, member.Position + reduced, _chairPushGroup)) return false;
        foreach (FurnitureChair member in _chairPushGroup)
        {
            member.Position += reduced;
            member.LastPushFrame = FrameIndex;
            member.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }
        foreach (FurnitureChair member in _chairPushGroup) SetFurnitureObstacle(member, member.State);
        return true;
    }

    private bool CanJoinChairGroup(FurnitureChair chair) => chair.Obstacle is not null &&
        (chair.State is ChairState.Upright or ChairState.Fallen) && chair.OccupantId is null &&
        chair.LastPushFrame != FrameIndex;

    private bool ChairPushPathIsClear(FurnitureChair chair, Vector2 destination,
        List<FurnitureChair>? movingGroup = null)
    {
        float radius = chair.Obstacle!.Radius;
        Vector2 start = chair.Position;
        int steps = Math.Max(1, (int)MathF.Ceiling(Vector2.Distance(start, destination) / 0.025f));
        // Use a dedicated scratch list: navigation/collision callers may be enumerating theirs.
        CollectAgentsNearPoint(start, radius + Config.Agent.Radius * 1.25f + 0.15f, _chairPushAgentScratch);
        Vector2 previous = start;
        for (int step = 1; step <= steps; step++)
        {
            Vector2 point = Vector2.Lerp(start, destination, step / (float)steps);
            if (point.X < Environment.BoundaryThickness + radius ||
                point.Y < Environment.BoundaryThickness + radius ||
                point.X > Environment.Width - Environment.BoundaryThickness - radius ||
                point.Y > Environment.Height - Environment.BoundaryThickness - radius ||
                Environment.Walls.Any(w => w.Contains(point, radius))) return false;
            foreach (CircleBlockage other in Environment.CircularBlockages)
            {
                if (ReferenceEquals(other, chair.Obstacle) ||
                    (other.ChairOwner is FurnitureChair member && movingGroup?.Contains(member) == true)) continue;
                if (!SeparatingOrClear(previous, point, other.Center, radius + other.Radius)) return false;
            }
            foreach (Agent other in _chairPushAgentScratch)
            {
                if (!other.IsActive) continue;
                float bodyRadius = Config.Agent.Radius * (other.IsCasualtyObstacle ? 1.25f : 1f);
                if (!SeparatingOrClear(previous, point, other.Position, radius + bodyRadius)) return false;
            }
            previous = point;
        }
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Existing blast pile overlap may decrease, but a push cannot create/deepen overlap.</summary>
    private static bool SeparatingOrClear(Vector2 previous, Vector2 next, Vector2 center, float radius)
    {
        float nextDistance = Vector2.DistanceSquared(next, center);
        return nextDistance >= radius * radius ||
            nextDistance > Vector2.DistanceSquared(previous, center) + 1e-7f;
    }

    private void PushChairInMovementDirection(Agent agent)
    {
        TryPushChairTowardGoal(agent, agent.Velocity);
    }

    /// <summary>Reach for a nearby chair even while waiting with zero actual velocity.</summary>
    internal bool TryPushChairTowardGoal(Agent agent, Vector2 desired)
    {
        if (Environment.Furniture.Count == 0 || !VectorMath.IsFinite(desired) ||
            desired.LengthSquared() < 1e-8f || agent.State is not (AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured))
            return false;
        CircleBlockage? nearest = null;
        float best = float.PositiveInfinity;
        Vector2 direction = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(desired);
        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in Environment.CircularBlockages)
        {
            if (circle.ChairOwner is not FurnitureChair chair || chair.OccupantId is not null ||
                chair.State is not (ChairState.Upright or ChairState.Fallen)) continue;
            Vector2 delta = circle.Center - agent.Position;
            float distance = delta.Length();
            float gap = distance - circle.Radius - Config.Agent.Radius;
            float reachMargin = agent.State == AgentState.Injured ? 0.45f : 0.30f;
            if (gap > reachMargin || Vector2.Dot(direction, VectorMath.SafeNormalize(delta)) < 0.10f) continue;
            if (gap < best) { best = gap; nearest = circle; }
        }
        // Mutation happens after enumeration, so replacing the proxy cannot invalidate it.
        return nearest is not null && TryPushLooseChair(agent, nearest, direction);
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.Core/Simulation.Collisions.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;

namespace CrowdSim.Core;

public sealed partial class Simulation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Hard collision resolution against walls/blockages and crawling/fallen casualties.
    /// Includes the validated wall-follow, reversal, cooldown, post-blast release and
    /// guaranteed-escape guardrails.
    /// </summary>
    public void ResolveSolidCollisions(Agent agent)
    {
        if (agent.State is AgentState.Fallen or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.Exited or
            AgentState.TempIncap or AgentState.Dead)
        {
            return;
        }

        // Guard before any spatial-hash lookup so NaN/Infinity never participates in
        // float-to-cell conversion. This is equivalent to the source's recovery intent
        // but applies it at the safest possible boundary.
        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(agent.Position))
        {
            agent.Position = new Vector2(Config.World.WidthMeters / 2f, Config.World.LengthMeters / 2f);
        }

        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(agent.Velocity))
        {
            agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }

        float radius = Config.Agent.Radius;
        float casualtyRadius = Config.Agent.Radius * 1.25f;
        float speed = agent.Velocity.Length();
        bool collisionResolved = false;

        CollectNearbyWalls(
            agent.Position,
            Config.Agent.Radius * 1.2f,
            _nearbyWallScratch,
            _nearbyWallSeenScratch);
        bool isTouchingWall = false;
        foreach (Wall wall in _nearbyWallScratch)
        {
            if (wall.Contains(agent.Position, Config.Agent.Radius))
            {
                isTouchingWall = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!isTouchingWall)
        {
            isTouchingWall = IsNearCircularBlockage(agent.Position, Config.Agent.Radius);
        }

        if (speed < 0.05f * agent.BaseSpeed && agent.WallFollowDir is null && !isTouchingWall)
        {
            // A locally waiting pedestrian can be almost stationary while a crawling/fallen
            // casualty is still inside the larger casualty contact envelope (2.25 body radii).
            // Do not let the low-speed fast path skip that hard separation: controlled pressing
            // is allowed to compress social space, never physical body space.
            bool overlappingCasualty = false;
            CollectNearbyAgents(agent, CollisionRadius, _collisionAgentScratch);
            float minimumCasualtySeparation = radius + casualtyRadius;
            float minimumCasualtySeparationSquared =
                minimumCasualtySeparation * minimumCasualtySeparation;
            foreach (Agent other in _collisionAgentScratch)
            {
                if (!other.IsCasualtyObstacle)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float separationSquared = Vector2.DistanceSquared(agent.Position, other.Position);
                if (float.IsFinite(separationSquared) &&
                    separationSquared < minimumCasualtySeparationSquared)
                {
                    overlappingCasualty = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (!overlappingCasualty)
            {
                return;
            }
        }

        const int maxIterations = 8;
        for (int iteration = 0; iteration < maxIterations; iteration++)
        {
            bool moved = false;
            CollectNearbyWalls(
                agent.Position,
                agent.WallFollowDir is not null ? WallFollowRadius : InteractionRadius,
                _nearbyWallScratch,
                _nearbyWallSeenScratch);

            foreach (Wall wall in _nearbyWallScratch)
            {
                if (!(wall.X1 - radius <= agent.Position.X && agent.Position.X <= wall.X2 + radius &&
                      wall.Y1 - radius <= agent.Position.Y && agent.Position.Y <= wall.Y2 + radius))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                Vector2 correction;
                if (wall.OrientedFootprint is OrientedRectangle rotated)
                {
                    correction = rotated.CircleSeparation(agent.Position, radius);
                }
                else
                {
                    float dxLeft = wall.X1 - (agent.Position.X - radius);
                    float dxRight = (agent.Position.X + radius) - wall.X2;
                    float dyTop = wall.Y1 - (agent.Position.Y - radius);
                    float dyBottom = (agent.Position.Y + radius) - wall.Y2;

                    correction = new Vector2(-dxLeft, 0f);
                    float correctionLengthSquared = correction.LengthSquared();
                    Vector2 candidateCorrection = new(dxRight, 0f);
                    float candidateLengthSquared = candidateCorrection.LengthSquared();
                    if (candidateLengthSquared < correctionLengthSquared)
                    {
                        correction = candidateCorrection;
                        correctionLengthSquared = candidateLengthSquared;
                    }

                    candidateCorrection = new Vector2(0f, -dyTop);
                    candidateLengthSquared = candidateCorrection.LengthSquared();
                    if (candidateLengthSquared < correctionLengthSquared)
                    {
                        correction = candidateCorrection;
                        correctionLengthSquared = candidateLengthSquared;
                    }

                    candidateCorrection = new Vector2(0f, dyBottom);
                    candidateLengthSquared = candidateCorrection.LengthSquared();
                    if (candidateLengthSquared < correctionLengthSquared)
                    {
                        correction = candidateCorrection;
                    }
                }
                float correctionLength = correction.Length();
                if (correctionLength <= 0f || !float.IsFinite(correctionLength))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                agent.Position += correction;
                moved = true;
                collisionResolved = true;

                Vector2 normal = correction / (correctionLength + 1e-6f);
                float normalVelocity = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, normal);
                if (normalVelocity < 0f)
                {
                    agent.Velocity -= normalVelocity * normal;
                }

                Vector2 tangent = VectorMath.Perpendicular(normal);

                // Finite-blockage termination.
                if (agent.ExitTarget is not null)
                {
                    bool isBlockage =
                        wall.X2 - wall.X1 < 0.9f * Environment.Width &&
                        wall.Y2 - wall.Y1 < 0.9f * Environment.Height;

                    if (isBlockage && agent.WallFollowTangent is not null)
                    {
                        Vector2 toExit = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget.Position - agent.Position);
                        Vector2 followTangent = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.WallFollowTangent.Value);
                        float progress = Vector2.Dot(followTangent, toExit);
                        if (progress < 0.1f)
                        {
                            DetachFromWallFollow(agent);
                            agent.Velocity = VectorMath.ClampMagnitude(
                                agent.Velocity + toExit * (0.6f * agent.BaseSpeed),
                                Config.Agent.Behavior.MaxRunningSpeedPerReferenceStep);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                speed = agent.Velocity.Length();
                bool changedNormal = agent.WallFollowNormal is null ||
                    Vector2.Dot(normal, agent.WallFollowNormal.Value) < 0.95f;

                bool allowLegacyWallFollow =
                    agent.State == AgentState.Wandering || agent.Exploring;
                if (allowLegacyWallFollow &&
                    (normalVelocity < -0.006f || speed < 0.25f * agent.BaseSpeed) &&
                    FrameIndex >= agent.WallFollowCooldownUntil &&
                    changedNormal &&
                    agent.WallFollowUntil < FrameIndex)
                {
                    if (agent.ExitTarget is not null)
                    {
                        Vector2 left = VectorMath.Perpendicular(normal);
                        Vector2 right = -left;
                        const float probeDistance = 0.81f;
                        Vector2 leftProbe = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(
                            agent.Position + left * probeDistance,
                            Config.World.WidthMeters,
                            Config.World.LengthMeters);
                        Vector2 rightProbe = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(
                            agent.Position + right * probeDistance,
                            Config.World.WidthMeters,
                            Config.World.LengthMeters);
                        float leftDistance = Vector2.Distance(leftProbe, agent.ExitTarget.Position);
                        float rightDistance = Vector2.Distance(rightProbe, agent.ExitTarget.Position);
                        agent.WallFollowDir = leftDistance < rightDistance ? 1 : -1;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        agent.WallFollowDir = Random.NextDouble() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
                    }

                    agent.WallFollowUntil = FrameIndex + 9999;
                    agent.WallFollowNormal = normal;
                    agent.WallFollowTangent = tangent;
                    agent.WallFollowDistance = 0f;
                    agent.WallFollowReversed = false;
                    agent.WallFollowStartFrame = FrameIndex;
                }

                if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null && agent.WallFollowUntil > FrameIndex)
                {
                    agent.Position += agent.WallFollowDir.Value * tangent * 0.01f;
                }
            }

            foreach (CircleBlockage circle in Environment.CircularBlockages)
            {
                if (agent.Posture != SeatingPosture.Walking && ReferenceEquals(circle, agent.Chair?.Obstacle)) continue;
                Vector2 offset = agent.Position - circle.Center;
                float distance = offset.Length();
                float minimumDistance = circle.Radius + radius;
                if (!float.IsFinite(distance) || distance >= minimumDistance)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                Vector2 normal = distance > 1e-6f ? offset / distance : Vector2.UnitX;
                float penetration = minimumDistance - Math.Max(0f, distance);
                agent.Position += normal * (penetration + 0.001f);
                moved = true;
                collisionResolved = true;

                float inwardVelocity = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, normal);
                if (inwardVelocity < 0f)
                {
                    agent.Velocity -= inwardVelocity * normal;
                }

                // Curved-obstacle anti-banging fallback. The evacuation layer normally starts
                // tangent following before contact; if crowd pressure still produces physical
                // overlap, latch the same short local mode here so the next desired direction
                // cannot immediately drive back into the cylinder. Hard collision stays intact.
                if ((agent.State is AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured) &&
                    agent.Intent != BehaviorIntent.AssistCasualty &&
                    agent.NavigationMemory.DetourGoal is null)
                {
                    bool sameCircleFollow =
                        agent.LocalNavigationMode == LocalNavigationMode.CircleFollow &&
                        agent.CircleFollowCenter is Vector2 followCenter &&
                        Vector2.DistanceSquared(followCenter, circle.Center) <= 0.0004f;
                    if (!sameCircleFollow)
                    {
                        Vector2 desired = agent.LastDesiredDirection.LengthSquared() >
                            VectorMath.Epsilon * VectorMath.Epsilon
                            ? VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.LastDesiredDirection)
                            : agent.ExitTarget is not null
                                ? VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget.Position - agent.Position)
                                : Vector2.Zero;
                        Vector2 tangent = VectorMath.Perpendicular(normal);
                        float positiveAlignment = Vector2.Dot(tangent, desired);
                        float negativeAlignment = Vector2.Dot(-tangent, desired);
                        int direction = MathF.Abs(positiveAlignment - negativeAlignment) < 0.02f
                            ? ((agent.AgentId & 1) == 0 ? 1 : -1)
                            : (positiveAlignment >= negativeAlignment ? 1 : -1);

                        agent.SlowObstacleCandidateAgentId = null;
                        agent.SlowObstacleCandidateSinceFrame = -1;
                        agent.SlowObstacleBypassAgentId = null;
                        agent.SlowObstacleBypassGoal = null;
                        agent.SlowObstacleBypassUntilFrame = -1;
                        agent.LocalNavigationBlockerAgentId = null;
                        agent.LocalNavigationBlockedSinceFrame = -1;
                        agent.LocalNavigationBypassAttempts = 0;
                        agent.LocalNavigationMode = LocalNavigationMode.CircleFollow;
                        agent.LocalNavigationModeSinceFrame = FrameIndex;
                        agent.LocalNavigationModeUntilFrame = FrameIndex + Math.Max(
                            1,
                            (int)MathF.Ceiling(
                                Config.Agent.CircleFollowCommitSeconds /
                                Math.Max(Config.Agent.Dt, 1e-5f)));
                        agent.CircleFollowCenter = circle.Center;
                        agent.CircleFollowObstacleRadius = circle.Radius;
                        agent.CircleFollowDirection = direction;
                    }
                }
            }

            CollectNearbyAgents(agent, CollisionRadius, _collisionAgentScratch);
            foreach (Agent other in _collisionAgentScratch)
            {
                if (!other.IsCasualtyObstacle)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                // Casualty bodies remain solid even after prolonged blockage. Deadlock
                // recovery is now handled by wait/seek/press navigation; it must never depend
                // on disabling hard body separation after a stuck timeout.

                Vector2 difference = agent.Position - other.Position;
                if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(difference))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float distance = difference.Length();
                if (!float.IsFinite(distance) || distance < 1e-6f)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float minSeparation = radius + casualtyRadius;
                if (distance >= minSeparation)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                Vector2 push = difference / distance * (minSeparation - distance);
                agent.Position += push;
                moved = true;
                collisionResolved = true;

                Vector2 normal = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(push);
                float normalVelocity = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, normal);
                if (normalVelocity < 0f)
                {
                    agent.Velocity -= normalVelocity * normal;
                }

                if (agent.WallFollowUntil > FrameIndex)
                {
                    float inward = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, normal);
                    if (inward < 0f)
                    {
                        agent.Velocity -= inward * normal;
                    }
                }

                float yieldFactor = 0.85f;
                if (agent.ExitTarget is not null && other.ExitTarget is not null)
                {
                    Vector2 toExit = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget.Position - agent.Position);
                    if (toExit.LengthSquared() > 0f)
                    {
                        float agentAlignment = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, toExit);
                        float otherAlignment = Vector2.Dot(other.Velocity, toExit);
                        if (agentAlignment > otherAlignment + 0.05f)
                        {
                            yieldFactor = 0.95f;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (agent.ExitTarget is not null)
                {
                    Vector2 toExit = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget.Position - agent.Position);
                    float alignment = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, toExit);
                    if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null && alignment > 0.3f)
                    {
                        yieldFactor = Math.Max(yieldFactor, 0.95f);
                    }
                }

                agent.Velocity *= yieldFactor;
            }

            if (!moved)
            {
                break;
            }

            if (agent.WallFollowUntil > FrameIndex && agent.WallFollowDir is not null)
            {
                // Commit-phase fast path.
                if (agent.WallFollowDistance < 6.48f)
                {
                    if (agent.WallFollowTangent is null)
                    {
                        break;
                    }

                    Vector2 tangent = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.WallFollowTangent.Value);
                    float tangentialVelocity = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, tangent);
                    agent.Velocity = tangentialVelocity * tangent;
                    continue;
                }

                if (agent.WallFollowTangent is null)
                {
                    break;
                }

                Vector2 wallTangent = agent.WallFollowTangent.Value;
                int stuckTime = FrameIndex - agent.WallFollowStartFrame;
                float exitDistance = agent.ExitTarget is not null
                    ? Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, agent.ExitTarget.Position)
                    : float.PositiveInfinity;
                float exitClearDistance = 4f * Config.Agent.Radius;
                float tangentialSpeed = MathF.Abs(Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, wallTangent));
                const float edgeCommitBonus = 0.6f;
                int delay = (int)(1.5f / Config.Agent.Dt * edgeCommitBonus);
                int rampTime = Math.Max(1, (int)(4f / Config.Agent.Dt * edgeCommitBonus));

                if (stuckTime > delay && exitDistance > exitClearDistance &&
                    tangentialSpeed > 0.15f * agent.BaseSpeed)
                {
                    float factor = Math.Min(1f, stuckTime / (float)rampTime);
                    float jitter = ((float)Random.NextDouble() - 0.5f) * 0.4f * factor * agent.BaseSpeed;
                    agent.Velocity = VectorMath.ClampMagnitude(
                        agent.Velocity + jitter * agent.WallFollowDir.Value * wallTangent,
                        Config.Agent.Behavior.MaxRunningSpeedPerReferenceStep);
                }

                if (agent.ExitTarget is not null && agent.WallFollowDir is not null)
                {
                    CollectNearbyWalls(
                        agent.Position,
                        WallFollowRadius,
                        _nearbyWallScratch,
                        _nearbyWallSeenScratch);
                    if (FrameIndex - agent.LosLastCheckFrame >= Math.Max(1, (int)(0.5f / Config.Agent.Dt)))
                    {
                        agent.LosCached = EvacuationSystem.HasLineOfSight(
                            agent.Position,
                            agent.ExitTarget.Position,
                            _nearbyWallScratch);
                        agent.LosLastCheckFrame = FrameIndex;
                    }

                    if (agent.LosCached)
                    {
                        Vector2? previousNormal = agent.WallFollowNormal;
                        DetachFromWallFollow(agent);
                        if (previousNormal is not null)
                        {
                            agent.Position += previousNormal.Value * (1.2f * Config.Agent.Radius);
                            agent.Position = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(
                                agent.Position,
                                Config.World.WidthMeters,
                                Config.World.LengthMeters);
                        }

                        return;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Post-blast wall-follow decay.
        if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null &&
            (agent.State is AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured) &&
            BlastOver() &&
            agent.Velocity.Length() < 0.15f * agent.BaseSpeed)
        {
            DetachFromWallFollow(agent);
            if (agent.ExitTarget is not null)
            {
                agent.Velocity = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget.Position - agent.Position) *
                    Math.Min(0.8f * agent.BaseSpeed, Config.Agent.Behavior.MaxRunningSpeedPerReferenceStep);
            }
        }

        // Hard failsafe: guaranteed release after six simulated seconds.
        int maxWallFollowFrames = Math.Max(1, (int)(6f / Config.Agent.Dt));
        if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null &&
            (agent.State is AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured) &&
            FrameIndex - agent.WallFollowStartFrame > maxWallFollowFrames)
        {
            DetachFromWallFollow(agent);
            if (agent.ExitTarget is not null)
            {
                agent.Velocity = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget.Position - agent.Position) *
                    Math.Min(0.9f * agent.BaseSpeed, Config.Agent.Behavior.MaxRunningSpeedPerReferenceStep);
            }

            agent.WallFollowCooldownUntil = FrameIndex + (int)(20f / Config.Agent.Dt);
        }

        if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null && agent.ExitTarget is not null)
        {
            float exitDistance = Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, agent.ExitTarget.Position);
            if (!float.IsFinite(agent.LastExitDist))
            {
                agent.LastExitDist = exitDistance;
            }

            if (exitDistance < agent.LastExitDist - 0.08f)
            {
                agent.LastExitDist = exitDistance;
            }
            else if (exitDistance > agent.LastExitDist + 0.24f &&
                     FrameIndex - agent.WallFollowStartFrame > (int)(2f / Config.Agent.Dt))
            {
                DetachFromWallFollow(agent);
                agent.LastExitDist = float.PositiveInfinity;
                agent.WallFollowCooldownUntil = FrameIndex + (int)(10f / Config.Agent.Dt);
            }

            if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null)
            {
                float commitDistance = 8.10f * (1f + 0.8f * agent.PanicLevel);
                int maxTimeFrames = Math.Max(1, (int)(3f / Config.Agent.Dt));
                int timeElapsed = FrameIndex - agent.WallFollowStartFrame;
                if (agent.WallFollowDistance >= commitDistance || timeElapsed >= maxTimeFrames)
                {
                    if (!agent.WallFollowReversed)
                    {
                        agent.WallFollowDir *= -1;
                        agent.WallFollowDistance = 0f;
                        agent.WallFollowReversed = true;
                        agent.WallFollowStartFrame = FrameIndex;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        DetachFromWallFollow(agent);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(agent.Position))
        {
            agent.Position = new Vector2(Config.World.WidthMeters / 2f, Config.World.LengthMeters / 2f);
        }

        if (!VectorMath.IsFinite(agent.Velocity))
        {
            agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }

        if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null && agent.WallFollowUntil > FrameIndex &&
            agent.WallFollowNormal is not null && agent.WallFollowTangent is not null)
        {
            Vector2 tangent = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.WallFollowTangent.Value);
            float tangentialVelocity = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, tangent);
            agent.Velocity = tangentialVelocity * tangent;
        }

        // Collision energy dissipation applies only when this call actually resolved
        // a physical overlap. Merely running the collision check must not damp free motion.
        if (collisionResolved && agent.Velocity.Length() > VectorMath.Epsilon)
        {
            agent.Velocity *= 0.75f;
        }

        if (agent.WallFollowDir is null)
        {
            agent.WallFollowNormal = null;
            agent.WallFollowTangent = null;
            agent.LastExitDist = float.PositiveInfinity;
            agent.WallFollowCooldownUntil = FrameIndex + (int)(10f / Config.Agent.Dt);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Move one agent with sub-step tunnelling protection and final blockage containment.</summary>
    public void MoveAgent(Agent agent)
    {
        PushChairInMovementDirection(agent);
        Vector2 newPosition = agent.Position + agent.Velocity * Config.Agent.StepScale;
        float speed = agent.Velocity.Length();
        CollectNearbyWalls(
            agent.Position,
            Config.Agent.Radius * 2f,
            _nearbyWallScratch,
            _nearbyWallSeenScratch);
        bool nearStaticObstacle = _nearbyWallScratch.Count > 0 ||
            IsNearCircularBlockage(agent.Position, Config.Agent.Radius * 2f);
        int substeps = nearStaticObstacle && speed > 0f ? 2 : 1;

        if (substeps > 1)
        {
            Vector2 stepVelocity = agent.Velocity * (Config.Agent.StepScale / substeps);
            for (int step = 0; step < substeps; step++)
            {
                Vector2 oldPosition = agent.Position;
                newPosition = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(
                    agent.Position + stepVelocity,
                    Config.World.WidthMeters,
                    Config.World.LengthMeters);
                if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null)
                {
                    agent.WallFollowDistance += Vector2.Distance(oldPosition, newPosition);
                }

                agent.Position = newPosition;
                ResolveSolidCollisions(agent);
            }

            StopExplorationIfGoalReached(agent);
            FinalBlockageContainment(agent);
            return;
        }

        newPosition = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(newPosition, Config.World.WidthMeters, Config.World.LengthMeters);
        if (agent.WallFollowDir is not null)
        {
            agent.WallFollowDistance += Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, newPosition);
        }

        agent.Position = newPosition;
        StopExplorationIfGoalReached(agent);

        speed = agent.Velocity.Length();
        bool needsPreciseCollision = agent.WallFollowDir is not null;
        if (!needsPreciseCollision)
        {
            CollectNearbyWalls(
                agent.Position,
                Config.Agent.Radius * 1.5f,
                _nearbyWallScratch,
                _nearbyWallSeenScratch);
            if (_nearbyWallScratch.Count > 0 ||
                IsNearCircularBlockage(agent.Position, Config.Agent.Radius * 1.5f))
            {
                needsPreciseCollision = true;
            }
            else
            {
                CollectNearbyAgents(agent, CollisionRadius, _collisionAgentScratch);
                foreach (Agent other in _collisionAgentScratch)
                {
                    if (other.IsCasualtyObstacle)
                    {
                        needsPreciseCollision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (needsPreciseCollision)
        {
            ResolveSolidCollisions(agent);
        }
        else if (speed > 0.35f * agent.BaseSpeed && FrameIndex % 2 == 0)
        {
            ResolveSolidCollisions(agent);
        }

        FinalBlockageContainment(agent);
    }

    private void StopExplorationIfGoalReached(Agent agent)
    {
        if (agent.Exploring && agent.TempGoal is not null &&
            Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, agent.TempGoal.Value) < 0.20f)
        {
            agent.Exploring = false;
            agent.TempGoal = null;
            agent.ExplorationReplanAfterFrame = 0;
        }
    }

    private void FinalBlockageContainment(Agent agent)
    {
        float radius = Config.Agent.Radius;
        foreach (Wall wall in Environment.Walls)
        {
            bool isBlockage =
                wall.X2 - wall.X1 < 0.9f * Environment.Width &&
                wall.Y2 - wall.Y1 < 0.9f * Environment.Height;
            if (!isBlockage)
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (!(wall.X1 - radius < agent.Position.X && agent.Position.X < wall.X2 + radius &&
                  wall.Y1 - radius < agent.Position.Y && agent.Position.Y < wall.Y2 + radius))
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (wall.OrientedFootprint is OrientedRectangle rotated)
            {
                Vector2 correction = rotated.CircleSeparation(agent.Position, radius);
                if (correction != Vector2.Zero)
                {
                    agent.Position += correction;
                    Vector2 normal = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(correction);
                    float inward = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, normal);
                    if (inward < 0f) agent.Velocity -= inward * normal;
                }
                continue;
            }

            float leftDistance = MathF.Abs(agent.Position.X - (wall.X1 - radius));
            float rightDistance = MathF.Abs(agent.Position.X - (wall.X2 + radius));
            float topDistance = MathF.Abs(agent.Position.Y - (wall.Y1 - radius));
            float bottomDistance = MathF.Abs(agent.Position.Y - (wall.Y2 + radius));
            float dx = Math.Min(leftDistance, rightDistance);
            float dy = Math.Min(topDistance, bottomDistance);

            if (dx < dy)
            {
                float x = agent.Position.X < (wall.X1 + wall.X2) * 0.5f
                    ? wall.X1 - radius
                    : wall.X2 + radius;
                agent.Position = new Vector2(x, agent.Position.Y);
                agent.Velocity = new Vector2(0f, agent.Velocity.Y);
            }
            else
            {
                float y = agent.Position.Y < (wall.Y1 + wall.Y2) * 0.5f
                    ? wall.Y1 - radius
                    : wall.Y2 + radius;
                agent.Position = new Vector2(agent.Position.X, y);
                agent.Velocity = new Vector2(agent.Velocity.X, 0f);
            }
        }

        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in Environment.CircularBlockages)
        {
            if (agent.Posture != SeatingPosture.Walking && ReferenceEquals(circle, agent.Chair?.Obstacle)) continue;
            Vector2 offset = agent.Position - circle.Center;
            float distance = offset.Length();
            float minimumDistance = circle.Radius + radius;
            if (!float.IsFinite(distance) || distance >= minimumDistance)
            {
                continue;
            }

            Vector2 normal = distance > 1e-6f ? offset / distance : Vector2.UnitX;
            agent.Position = circle.Center + normal * (minimumDistance + 0.001f);
            float inwardVelocity = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, normal);
            if (inwardVelocity < 0f)
            {
                agent.Velocity -= inwardVelocity * normal;
            }
        }
    }

    private bool IsNearCircularBlockage(Vector2 position, float margin)
    {
        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in Environment.CircularBlockages)
        {
            float reach = circle.Radius + Math.Max(0f, margin);
            if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(position, circle.Center) <= reach * reach)
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private void DetachFromWallFollow(Agent agent)
    {
        agent.WallFollowDir = null;
        agent.WallFollowUntil = FrameIndex;
        agent.WallFollowNormal = null;
        agent.WallFollowTangent = null;
    }
}
```
