## src/CrowdSim.Core/Simulation.Contacts.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core;

public sealed partial class Simulation
{
    private readonly List<Agent> _contactScratch = new(32);
    private readonly List<Wall> _contactWallScratch = new(8);
    private readonly HashSet<Wall> _contactWallSeen = new();

    /// <summary>
    /// One local, unordered-pair projection pass bounds body penetration at the coarse
    /// fixed step. This is a numerical contact guard, not another steering controller.
    /// Dense multi-body contacts can retain small residual overlap after one pass;
    /// a global iterative solver is deliberately avoided to bound per-step cost.
    /// </summary>
    private void ResolveCrowdContacts()
    {
        float diameter = 2f * Config.Agent.Radius;
        float diameterSquared = diameter * diameter;
        foreach (Agent agent in Agents)
        {
            if (!agent.IsActive)
            {
                continue;
            }
            CollectNearbyAgents(agent, diameter, _contactScratch);
            foreach (Agent other in _contactScratch)
            {
                if (other.AgentId <= agent.AgentId || !other.IsActive)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                float ownWeight = CanDisplace(agent) ? 1f : 0f;
                float otherWeight = CanDisplace(other) ? 1f : 0f;
                float totalWeight = ownWeight + otherWeight;
                if (totalWeight == 0f)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                Vector2 offset = agent.Position - other.Position;
                float squared = offset.LengthSquared();
                if (!float.IsFinite(squared) || squared >= diameterSquared)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                float distance = MathF.Sqrt(squared);
                Vector2 normal = distance > VectorMath.Epsilon ? offset / distance : -Vector2.UnitX;
                Vector2 correction = normal * ((diameter - distance) / totalWeight);
                if (ownWeight > 0f)
                {
                    ApplyContactCorrection(agent, correction);
                }
                if (otherWeight > 0f)
                {
                    ApplyContactCorrection(other, -correction);
                }
                // Remove closing normal velocity only. Tangential locomotion is retained.
                float closing = Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity - other.Velocity, normal);
                if (closing < 0f)
                {
                    Vector2 impulse = normal * (closing / totalWeight);
                    agent.Velocity -= ownWeight * impulse;
                    other.Velocity += otherWeight * impulse;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static bool CanDisplace(Agent agent)
        => agent.Posture == SeatingPosture.Walking && (agent.State is AgentState.Wandering or AgentState.WaitingToReact or
            AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured or AgentState.Crawling);

    private void ApplyContactCorrection(Agent agent, Vector2 correction)
    {
        Vector2 candidate = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(agent.Position + correction,
            Config.World.WidthMeters, Config.World.LengthMeters);
        float radius = Config.Agent.Radius;
        CollectNearbyWalls(candidate, radius, _contactWallScratch, _contactWallSeen);
        foreach (Wall wall in _contactWallScratch)
        {
            if (wall.OrientedFootprint is OrientedRectangle rotated
                ? rotated.CircleSeparation(candidate, radius) != Vector2.Zero
                : candidate.X > wall.X1 - radius && candidate.X < wall.X2 + radius &&
                    candidate.Y > wall.Y1 - radius && candidate.Y < wall.Y2 + radius)
            {
                // Do not resolve a crowd overlap by putting the pedestrian into a wall.
                return;
            }
        }
        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in Environment.CircularBlockages)
        {
            float clearance = circle.Radius + radius;
            if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(candidate, circle.Center) < clearance * clearance)
            {
                return;
            }
        }
        agent.Position = candidate;
        RefreshAgentCell(agent);
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.Core/Simulation.Furniture.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;
namespace CrowdSim.Core;

public sealed partial class Simulation
{
    /// <summary>Pause locomotion while seated/rising, while hazard and panic systems keep running.</summary>
    private bool UpdateSeating(Agent agent)
    {
        if (agent.Posture == SeatingPosture.Walking || agent.Chair is not FurnitureChair chair) return false;
        // A casualty must never be revived or forced to stand by the furniture controller.
        if (agent.State is AgentState.Dead or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.TempIncap or AgentState.Fallen or AgentState.Crawling or AgentState.Exited)
        {
            agent.Posture = SeatingPosture.Walking;
            chair.OccupantId = null;
            agent.Chair = null;
            return false;
        }
        agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        if (agent.Posture == SeatingPosture.Seated)
        {
            if (agent.State == AgentState.Wandering && chair.State == ChairState.Upright) return true;
            agent.Posture = SeatingPosture.StandingUp;
            float normal = 0.8f + 0.8f * (float)Random.NextDouble();
            float mobility = Math.Clamp(agent.InjurySpeedFactor * agent.ToxicMobilityFactor, 0.35f, 1f);
            agent.StandUpSeconds = Math.Clamp(normal + (1f - mobility) * 0.5f + Math.Max(0f, 1f - agent.UrgencyBias) * 0.4f + Math.Max(0f, 0.3f - agent.PanicLevel) * 0.3f - Math.Max(0f, agent.PanicLevel - 0.8f) * 1.0f, 0.6f, 2.1f);
            agent.StandUpElapsed = 0f;
        }
        agent.StandUpElapsed += Config.Agent.Dt;
        if (agent.StandUpElapsed < agent.StandUpSeconds || agent.StunnedUntilFrame > FrameIndex) return true;

        // Reserve the fallen footprint too, so toppling cannot overlap the departing person.
        float seatMargin = Config.Agent.Radius + 0.01f + Math.Max(0f, 0.40f - (chair.Obstacle?.Radius ?? 0.40f));
        // Once the seat has moved away or the person clears it, release normal navigation.
        if (chair.Obstacle is null || !chair.Obstacle.Contains(agent.Position, seatMargin))
        {
            FinishSeatDeparture(agent, chair);
            return false;
        }
        if (FrameIndex < agent.NextSeatDepartureProbeFrame) return true;
        float preferred = chair.StartHeading + MathF.PI;
        float travel = 0.7f * Config.Agent.Dt;
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
        {
            int offset = i == 0 ? 0 : (i + 1) / 2 * (i % 2 == 1 ? 1 : -1);
            float angle = preferred + offset * MathF.PI / 8f;
            Vector2 direction = new(MathF.Cos(angle), MathF.Sin(angle));
            Vector2 next = agent.Position + direction * travel;
            if (!SeatDepartureStepIsClear(agent, chair, next)) continue;
            agent.Position = next;
            if (!chair.Obstacle.Contains(next, seatMargin))
            {
                FinishSeatDeparture(agent, chair);
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
        // A nearby loose chair can be shifted while standing; an occupied chair cannot.
        foreach (FurnitureSet set in Environment.Furniture)
        foreach (FurnitureChair other in set.Chairs)
        {
            if (ReferenceEquals(other, chair) || other.Obstacle is null) continue;
            if (TryPushLooseChair(agent, other.Obstacle, other.Position - agent.Position)) return true;
        }
        agent.NextSeatDepartureProbeFrame = FrameIndex + Math.Max(1,
            (int)MathF.Ceiling((0.20f + (agent.AgentId % 3) * 0.05f) / Config.Agent.Dt));
        return true;
    }

    private void FinishSeatDeparture(Agent agent, FurnitureChair chair)
    {
        agent.SeatDepartureTarget = null;
        agent.Posture = SeatingPosture.Walking;
        agent.Chair = null;
        chair.OccupantId = null;
        // Never enlarge a toppling footprint into the person who just left it.
        if (chair.State == ChairState.Upright &&
            Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, chair.Position) > 0.40f + Config.Agent.Radius &&
            Random.NextDouble() < 0.08 + 0.32 * agent.PanicLevel)
            SetFurnitureObstacle(chair, ChairState.Fallen);
    }

    private bool SeatDepartureStepIsClear(Agent agent, FurnitureChair chair, Vector2 next)
    {
        float radius = Config.Agent.Radius;
        CollectAgentsNearPoint(agent.Position, radius * 2.25f + 0.2f, _collisionAgentScratch, agent.AgentId);
        Vector2 previous = agent.Position;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 4; i++)
        {
            Vector2 point = Vector2.Lerp(agent.Position, next, i / 4f);
            if (point.X < Environment.BoundaryThickness + radius || point.Y < Environment.BoundaryThickness + radius ||
                point.X > Environment.Width - Environment.BoundaryThickness - radius ||
                point.Y > Environment.Height - Environment.BoundaryThickness - radius ||
                Environment.Walls.Any(w => w.Contains(point, radius))) return false;
            foreach (CircleBlockage circle in Environment.CircularBlockages)
                if (!ReferenceEquals(circle, chair.Obstacle) &&
                    !SeparatingOrClear(previous, point, circle.Center, radius + circle.Radius + 0.005f)) return false;
            foreach (Agent other in _collisionAgentScratch)
                if (other.IsActive && !SeparatingOrClear(previous, point, other.Position,
                    radius * (other.IsCasualtyObstacle ? 2.25f : 2f) + 0.005f)) return false;
            previous = point;
        }
        // Make outward progress rather than orbiting forever inside the attached seat proxy.
        return Vector2.DistanceSquared(next, chair.Position) >
            Vector2.DistanceSquared(agent.Position, chair.Position) + 1e-6f;
    }

    private void SetFurnitureObstacle(FurnitureBody body, ChairState state)
    {
        if (body is RectangularFurnitureBody rectangle)
        {
            SetRectangularFurnitureObstacle(rectangle, state);
            return;
        }
        float radius = body is FurnitureChair && state != ChairState.Upright ? 0.40f : body.Radius;
        CircleBlockage? next = state == ChairState.Destroyed ? null :
            new CircleBlockage(body.Position, radius) { IsFurniture = true, ChairOwner = body as FurnitureChair };
        body.State = state;
        // Stationary bodies do not invalidate paths or churn the obstacle collection.
        if (Equals(body.Obstacle, next)) return;
        if (body.Obstacle is not null) Environment.CircularBlockages.Remove(body.Obstacle);
        body.Obstacle = next;
        if (next is not null) Environment.CircularBlockages.Add(next);
        Environment.InvalidateFurnitureNavigation();
    }

    /// <summary>Apply the shock front to every body before integrating any motion.</summary>
    private void UpdateFurniture()
    {
        _blastFurnitureBodies.Clear();
        foreach (FurnitureSet set in Environment.Furniture)
        {
            if (set.Table is not null) _blastFurnitureBodies.Add(set.Table);
            _blastFurnitureBodies.AddRange(set.Chairs);
        }
        foreach (FurnitureBody body in _blastFurnitureBodies) ApplyFurnitureBlast(body);
        _blastStaticCircles.Clear();
        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in Environment.CircularBlockages)
            if (!circle.IsFurniture) _blastStaticCircles.Add(circle);
        _activeBlastFurniture.Clear();
        float maximumSpeed = 0f;
        foreach (FurnitureBody body in _blastFurnitureBodies)
        {
            if (body.State == ChairState.Destroyed) continue;
            maximumSpeed = Math.Max(maximumSpeed, body.Velocity.Length() + MathF.Abs(body.VerticalSpeed));
            if (body.State == ChairState.Airborne || body.SupportBody is not null ||
                body.Velocity.LengthSquared() >= 0.0004f) ActivateFurniture(body);
            else body.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }
        if (_activeBlastFurniture.Count == 0) return;
        RebuildFurnitureImpactGrid();
        // Allow a factor of two for speed gained in a light/heavy-body collision.
        int steps = Math.Max(1, (int)MathF.Ceiling((2f * maximumSpeed + 9.81f * Config.Agent.Dt) * Config.Agent.Dt / 0.04f));
        float dt = Config.Agent.Dt / steps;
        for (int step = 0; step < steps; step++)
            for (int index = 0; index < _activeBlastFurniture.Count; index++)
                IntegrateFurniture(_activeBlastFurniture[index], dt);
        foreach (FurnitureBody body in _activeBlastFurniture)
            if (body.State != ChairState.Destroyed) SetFurnitureObstacle(body, body.State);
    }

    private void ApplyFurnitureBlast(FurnitureBody body)
    {
        if (Environment.Explosion is not Explosion blast || body.BlastApplied) return;
        float distance = Vector2.Distance(body.Position, blast.Position);
        float waveRadius = Config.Agent.ShockwaveSpeedMetersPerFrame *
            (FrameIndex - blast.TriggeredFrame) * Config.Agent.StepScale;
        if (distance > waveRadius) return;
        body.BlastApplied = true;
        if (ExplosionSystem.BlastPathIsBlocked(blast.Position, body.Position, Environment.Walls)) return;
        if (distance <= Config.Agent.HeatIncapacityRadius)
        {
            SetFurnitureObstacle(body, ChairState.Destroyed);
        }
        else if (distance < Config.Agent.HeatRadius)
        {
            float strength = Math.Clamp((Config.Agent.HeatRadius - distance) /
                Math.Max(0.1f, Config.Agent.HeatRadius - Config.Agent.HeatIncapacityRadius), 0f, 1f);
            // Heavier tables receive less speed than chairs from the same stylised impulse.
            float massFactor = body is FurnitureChair ? 1f : 0.65f;
            body.Velocity = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(body.Position - blast.Position, Vector2.UnitX) *
                (6f * strength * massFactor);
            body.VerticalSpeed = (4f * strength) * MathF.Sqrt(massFactor);
            body.SupportBody = null;
            body.FlightSeconds = 0f;
            SetFurnitureObstacle(body, ChairState.Airborne);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Ballistic flight with drag, swept wall collision and a persistent ground footprint.</summary>
    private void IntegrateFurniture(FurnitureBody body, float dt)
    {
        if (body.State == ChairState.Destroyed) return;
        if (body.SupportBody is FurnitureBody support)
        {
            if (support.State == ChairState.Destroyed ||
                !FurnitureFootprintsOverlap(body, body.Position, support, support.Position))
            {
                body.SupportBody = null;
                body.State = ChairState.Airborne;
                body.FlightSeconds = 0f;
            }
            else body.Height = support.Height + FurnitureBodyHeight(support) + 0.002f;
        }
        bool airborne = body.State == ChairState.Airborne;
        if (!airborne && body.Velocity.LengthSquared() < 0.0004f)
        {
            body.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            return;
        }
        Vector2 oldPosition = body.Position;
        float oldHeight = body.Height;
        float nextHeight = oldHeight;
        if (airborne)
        {
            body.FlightSeconds += dt;
            nextHeight = Math.Max(0f, oldHeight + body.VerticalSpeed * dt - 0.5f * 9.81f * dt * dt);
            body.VerticalSpeed -= 9.81f * dt;
        }
        Vector2 next = oldPosition + body.Velocity * dt;
        if (FurnitureHitsStaticGeometry(body, next))
        {
            next = oldPosition;
            body.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }
        ResolveFurnitureImpact(body, oldPosition, oldHeight, ref next, ref nextHeight);
        body.Height = nextHeight;
        float radius = FurnitureCollisionRadius(body);
        if (!body.ImpactApplied && body.Height < 1.6f && body.Velocity.LengthSquared() > 0.01f)
        {
            CollectAgentsNearPoint(next, radius + Config.Agent.Radius, _collisionAgentScratch);
            Agent? hit = null;
            float closestSquared = float.PositiveInfinity;
            foreach (Agent candidate in _collisionAgentScratch)
            {
                if (!candidate.IsActive || candidate.State == AgentState.Dead ||
                    (body is FurnitureChair chair && candidate.AgentId == chair.OriginalOccupantId)) continue;
                if (body is RectangularFurnitureBody &&
                    !FurnitureOverlapsDisc(body, next, candidate.Position, Config.Agent.Radius)) continue;
                float squared = Vector2.DistanceSquared(candidate.Position, next);
                if (squared < closestSquared || (squared == closestSquared &&
                    (hit is null || candidate.AgentId < hit.AgentId)))
                {
                    closestSquared = squared;
                    hit = candidate;
                }
            }
            if (hit is not null)
            {
                float speed = body.Velocity.Length();
                ExplosionSystem.ApplyDebrisImpact(this, hit, new Debris(next,
                    body.Velocity * Configuration.AgentConfig.ReferenceStepSeconds, 1, radius,
                    Math.Clamp(speed * speed / 50f, 0.05f, 0.85f)));
                body.ImpactApplied = true;
                body.Velocity *= 0.65f;
            }
        }
        body.Position = next;
        UpdateFurnitureImpactCell(body, oldPosition);
        // A translating rectangle retains its authored axis alignment: visible geometry
        // and collision shape must never disagree during flight or after landing.
        if (airborne && body is not RectangularFurnitureBody)
            body.Heading += dt * (body is FurnitureChair ? 4f : 2f);
        body.Velocity *= MathF.Exp(-(body.State == ChairState.Airborne ? 0.9f : 4f) * dt);
        if (body.State == ChairState.Airborne && body.Height <= 0f)
        {
            body.Height = 0f;
            body.VerticalSpeed = 0f;
            body.State = ChairState.Fallen;
            body.Velocity *= 0.55f; // landing dissipates energy; remaining momentum slides
        }
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.Core/Simulation.FurnitureImpacts.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core;

public sealed partial class Simulation
{
    private const float FurnitureCellSize = 2f;
    private readonly List<FurnitureBody> _blastFurnitureBodies = new();
    private readonly List<CircleBlockage> _blastStaticCircles = new();
    private readonly List<FurnitureBody> _activeBlastFurniture = new();

    private void ActivateFurniture(FurnitureBody body)
    {
        if (body.PhysicsActiveFrame == FrameIndex || body.State == ChairState.Destroyed) return;
        body.PhysicsActiveFrame = FrameIndex;
        _activeBlastFurniture.Add(body);
    }
    private readonly Dictionary<(int X, int Y), List<FurnitureBody>> _furnitureImpactGrid = new();
    private float _maximumFurnitureRadius;

    internal static float FurnitureCollisionRadius(FurnitureBody body) =>
        body is FurnitureChair && body.State != ChairState.Upright ? 0.40f : body.Radius;

    internal static float FurnitureBodyHeight(FurnitureBody body) => body is FurnitureChair
        ? (body.State == ChairState.Upright ? 0.94f : 0.50f)
        : (body.State == ChairState.Upright ? 0.78f : 0.18f);

    private static (int X, int Y) FurnitureCell(Vector2 point) =>
        ((int)MathF.Floor(point.X / FurnitureCellSize), (int)MathF.Floor(point.Y / FurnitureCellSize));

    private void RebuildFurnitureImpactGrid()
    {
        foreach (List<FurnitureBody> bucket in _furnitureImpactGrid.Values) bucket.Clear();
        _maximumFurnitureRadius = 0f;
        foreach (FurnitureBody body in _blastFurnitureBodies)
        {
            if (body.State == ChairState.Destroyed) continue;
            _maximumFurnitureRadius = Math.Max(_maximumFurnitureRadius,
                body is FurnitureChair ? 0.40f : body.Radius);
            var cell = FurnitureCell(body.Position);
            if (!_furnitureImpactGrid.TryGetValue(cell, out var bucket))
                _furnitureImpactGrid[cell] = bucket = new List<FurnitureBody>();
            bucket.Add(body);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Reuse the furniture-physics spatial grid for visible short-horizon hazards.</summary>
    internal void CollectMovingFurnitureNear(Vector2 position, float radius, List<FurnitureBody> result)
    {
        result.Clear();
        if (_activeBlastFurniture.Count == 0) return;
        var min = FurnitureCell(position - new Vector2(radius));
        var max = FurnitureCell(position + new Vector2(radius));
        float radiusSquared = radius * radius;
        for (int x = min.X; x <= max.X; x++)
        for (int y = min.Y; y <= max.Y; y++)
        {
            if (!_furnitureImpactGrid.TryGetValue((x, y), out var bucket)) continue;
            foreach (FurnitureBody body in bucket)
            {
                if (body.State == ChairState.Destroyed || body.Velocity.LengthSquared() < 0.25f ||
                    Vector2.DistanceSquared(position, body.Position) > radiusSquared) continue;
                result.Add(body);
            }
        }
    }

    private void UpdateFurnitureImpactCell(FurnitureBody body, Vector2 oldPosition)
    {
        var oldCell = FurnitureCell(oldPosition);
        var newCell = FurnitureCell(body.Position);
        if (oldCell == newCell) return;
        _furnitureImpactGrid[oldCell].Remove(body);
        if (!_furnitureImpactGrid.TryGetValue(newCell, out var bucket))
            _furnitureImpactGrid[newCell] = bucket = new List<FurnitureBody>();
        bucket.Add(body);
    }

    private bool FurnitureHitsStaticGeometry(FurnitureBody body, Vector2 point)
    {
        float radius = FurnitureCollisionRadius(body);
        Vector2 half = body is RectangularFurnitureBody rectangle
            ? rectangle.HalfExtents : new Vector2(radius);
        if (point.X < Environment.BoundaryThickness + half.X ||
            point.Y < Environment.BoundaryThickness + half.Y ||
            point.X > Environment.Width - Environment.BoundaryThickness - half.X ||
            point.Y > Environment.Height - Environment.BoundaryThickness - half.Y) return true;
        CollectNearbyWalls(point, radius, _nearbyWallScratch, _nearbyWallSeenScratch);
        foreach (Wall wall in _nearbyWallScratch)
        {
            // Live rectangular bodies are resolved in the furniture contact grid below.
            // Testing their last-frame proxies here would make a table collide with itself.
            if (wall.IsMovableFurniture) continue;
            if (wall.OrientedFootprint is OrientedRectangle rotated)
            {
                if (body is RectangularFurnitureBody
                    ? rotated.Overlaps(new OrientedRectangle(point, half, 0f))
                    : rotated.Contains(point, radius)) return true;
            }
            else if (point.X >= wall.X1 - half.X && point.X <= wall.X2 + half.X &&
                point.Y >= wall.Y1 - half.Y && point.Y <= wall.Y2 + half.Y) return true;
        }
        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in _blastStaticCircles)
            if (body is RectangularFurnitureBody
                ? FurnitureOverlapsDisc(body, point, circle.Center, circle.Radius)
                : circle.Contains(point, radius)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>Local cylinder contacts: overhead clearance, supported landing, and inelastic impulses.</summary>
    private void ResolveFurnitureImpact(FurnitureBody body, Vector2 oldPosition, float oldHeight,
        ref Vector2 next, ref float nextHeight)
    {
        // A long table can overlap a body more than one grid cell away. Query by
        // combined broad-phase radii, then reject with exact rectangle/circle contacts.
        float searchRadius = FurnitureCollisionRadius(body) + _maximumFurnitureRadius;
        var minimum = FurnitureCell(next - new Vector2(searchRadius));
        var maximum = FurnitureCell(next + new Vector2(searchRadius));
        for (int x = minimum.X; x <= maximum.X; x++)
        for (int y = minimum.Y; y <= maximum.Y; y++)
        {
            if (!_furnitureImpactGrid.TryGetValue((x, y), out var bucket)) continue;
            foreach (FurnitureBody other in bucket)
            {
                if (ReferenceEquals(body, other) || other.State == ChairState.Destroyed) continue;
                float reach = FurnitureCollisionRadius(body) + FurnitureCollisionRadius(other);
                if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(next, other.Position) >= reach * reach ||
                    !FurnitureFootprintsOverlap(body, next, other, other.Position)) continue;
                float otherTop = other.Height + FurnitureBodyHeight(other);
                if (body.VerticalSpeed <= 0f && oldHeight >= otherTop && nextHeight <= otherTop)
                {
                    // Stop downward penetration. The support is checked again on each microstep.
                    nextHeight = otherTop + 0.002f;
                    body.VerticalSpeed = 0f;
                    body.SupportBody = other;
                    body.State = ChairState.Fallen;
                    body.Velocity *= 0.55f;
                    continue;
                }
                if (nextHeight >= otherTop || nextHeight + FurnitureBodyHeight(body) <= other.Height) continue;
                Vector2 normal = body is RectangularFurnitureBody || other is RectangularFurnitureBody
                    ? FurnitureContactNormal(body, next, other, other.Position)
                    : VectorMath.SafeNormalize(other.Position - oldPosition, Vector2.UnitX);
                ApplyFurnitureContactImpulse(body, other, normal,
                    other is FurnitureChair { OccupantId: not null } ||
                    FurnitureHitsStaticGeometry(other, other.Position + normal * 0.02f));
                if (other.Velocity.LengthSquared() >= 0.0004f) ActivateFurniture(other);
                // Never advance through a contact. Already overlapping blast footprints may separate.
                if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(next, other.Position) <=
                    Vector2.DistanceSquared(oldPosition, other.Position)) next = oldPosition;
                if (oldHeight + FurnitureBodyHeight(body) <= other.Height && nextHeight > oldHeight)
                {
                    nextHeight = oldHeight;
                    body.VerticalSpeed = Math.Min(0f, body.VerticalSpeed);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Normal impulse with restitution 0.15 and a 6:1 table/chair mass ratio.</summary>
    internal static void ApplyFurnitureContactImpulse(FurnitureBody moving, FurnitureBody target,
        Vector2 normal, bool targetPinned)
    {
        float closingSpeed = Vector2.Dot(moving.Velocity - target.Velocity, normal);
        if (closingSpeed <= 0f) return;
        float inverseMovingMass = moving is FurnitureChair ? 1f : 1f / 6f;
        float inverseTargetMass = targetPinned ? 0f : target is FurnitureChair ? 1f : 1f / 6f;
        float impulse = 1.15f * closingSpeed / (inverseMovingMass + inverseTargetMass);
        moving.Velocity -= normal * (impulse * inverseMovingMass);
        target.Velocity += normal * (impulse * inverseTargetMass);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core;

public sealed partial class Simulation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Publish a table's exact current footprint once per outer physics step. Updating only
    /// the touched spatial-hash cells preserves wall, stage-render and fume caches.
    /// </summary>
    private void SetRectangularFurnitureObstacle(RectangularFurnitureBody body, ChairState state)
    {
        body.State = state;
        Wall? previous = body.RectangleObstacle;
        Wall? next = state == ChairState.Destroyed ? null : body.BoundsAt(body.Position);
        if (Equals(previous, next)) return;

        int index = previous is null ? -1 : Environment.Walls.IndexOf(previous);
        if (index >= 0)
        {
            if (next is null) Environment.Walls.RemoveAt(index);
            else Environment.Walls[index] = next;
        }
        else if (next is not null) Environment.Walls.Add(next);

        body.RectangleObstacle = next;
        if (previous is not null) UpdateFurnitureWallIndex(previous, add: false);
        if (next is not null) UpdateFurnitureWallIndex(next, add: true);
        Environment.InvalidateFurnitureNavigation();
    }

    private void UpdateFurnitureWallIndex(Wall wall, bool add)
    {
        float inverse = 1f / _gridCellSize;
        int x1 = (int)MathF.Floor(wall.X1 * inverse), x2 = (int)MathF.Floor(wall.X2 * inverse);
        int y1 = (int)MathF.Floor(wall.Y1 * inverse), y2 = (int)MathF.Floor(wall.Y2 * inverse);
        for (int x = x1; x <= x2; x++)
        for (int y = y1; y <= y2; y++)
        {
            if (!_wallGrid.TryGetValue((x, y), out List<Wall>? bucket))
            {
                if (!add) continue;
                _wallGrid[(x, y)] = bucket = new List<Wall>();
            }
            if (add) bucket.Add(wall);
            else bucket.Remove(wall);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>True footprint contact, not a table's larger broad-phase bounding circle.</summary>
    internal static bool FurnitureOverlapsDisc(FurnitureBody body, Vector2 position,
        Vector2 discCenter, float discRadius)
    {
        if (body is RectangularFurnitureBody rectangle)
        {
            Vector2 closest = Vector2.Clamp(discCenter,
                position - rectangle.HalfExtents, position + rectangle.HalfExtents);
            return Vector2.DistanceSquared(closest, discCenter) < discRadius * discRadius;
        }
        float reach = FurnitureCollisionRadius(body) + discRadius;
        return Vector2.DistanceSquared(position, discCenter) < reach * reach;
    }

    internal static bool FurnitureFootprintsOverlap(FurnitureBody first, Vector2 firstPosition,
        FurnitureBody second, Vector2 secondPosition)
    {
        if (first is RectangularFurnitureBody a && second is RectangularFurnitureBody b)
        {
            Vector2 delta = Vector2.Abs(secondPosition - firstPosition);
            Vector2 reach = a.HalfExtents + b.HalfExtents;
            return delta.X < reach.X && delta.Y < reach.Y;
        }
        if (first is RectangularFurnitureBody)
            return FurnitureOverlapsDisc(first, firstPosition, secondPosition, FurnitureCollisionRadius(second));
        if (second is RectangularFurnitureBody)
            return FurnitureOverlapsDisc(second, secondPosition, firstPosition, FurnitureCollisionRadius(first));
        float radius = FurnitureCollisionRadius(first) + FurnitureCollisionRadius(second);
        return Vector2.DistanceSquared(firstPosition, secondPosition) < radius * radius;
    }

    /// <summary>Contact normal points from the moving body into the contacted body.</summary>
    internal static Vector2 FurnitureContactNormal(FurnitureBody first, Vector2 firstPosition,
        FurnitureBody second, Vector2 secondPosition)
    {
        Vector2 delta = secondPosition - firstPosition;
        if (first is RectangularFurnitureBody a && second is RectangularFurnitureBody b)
        {
            Vector2 penetration = a.HalfExtents + b.HalfExtents - Vector2.Abs(delta);
            return penetration.X <= penetration.Y
                ? new Vector2(delta.X >= 0f ? 1f : -1f, 0f)
                : new Vector2(0f, delta.Y >= 0f ? 1f : -1f);
        }
        if (second is RectangularFurnitureBody rectangle)
            return NormalTowardRectangle(firstPosition, secondPosition, rectangle.HalfExtents);
        if (first is RectangularFurnitureBody movingRectangle)
            return -NormalTowardRectangle(secondPosition, firstPosition, movingRectangle.HalfExtents);
        return VectorMath.SafeNormalize(delta, Vector2.UnitX);
    }

    private static Vector2 NormalTowardRectangle(Vector2 point, Vector2 center, Vector2 half)
    {
        Vector2 closest = Vector2.Clamp(point, center - half, center + half);
        Vector2 normal = closest - point;
        if (normal.LengthSquared() > 1e-10f) return Vector2.Normalize(normal);
        // A body already inside the rectangle resolves toward its nearest face, not
        // an arbitrary diagonal that could keep it sliding along the same obstacle.
        Vector2 delta = center - point;
        Vector2 edgeDistance = half - Vector2.Abs(delta);
        return edgeDistance.X <= edgeDistance.Y
            ? new Vector2(delta.X >= 0f ? 1f : -1f, 0f)
            : new Vector2(0f, delta.Y >= 0f ? 1f : -1f);
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.Core/Simulation.Step.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core;

public sealed partial class Simulation
{
    /// <summary>Simple pre-explosion wandering with noisy direction drift.</summary>
    public void UpdateWandering(Agent agent)
    {
        if (agent.WanderDir is null)
        {
            agent.WanderDir = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(VectorMath.RandomGaussian2(Random));
        }

        Vector2 wander = agent.WanderDir.Value + 0.2f * MathF.Sqrt(Config.Agent.StepScale) * VectorMath.RandomGaussian2(Random);
        wander = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(wander, agent.WanderDir.Value);
        agent.WanderDir = wander;
        agent.Velocity = wander * Math.Min(agent.BaseSpeed * 0.7f, Config.Agent.Behavior.MaxRunningSpeedPerReferenceStep);
        MoveAgent(agent);
    }

    /// <summary>Advance the simulation by one fixed frame.</summary>
    public void Step()
    {
        if (!Running || Agents.Count == 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        long stepStarted = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        LastRoutePlanningMilliseconds = 0d;
        LastRoutePlanRequests = 0;
        RebuildAgentGrid();

        // Resolve the selected hazard before panic for this frame. Both scenarios feed the same
        // panic/SFM/route engine; only the hazard-specific exposure calculation differs.
        if (ScenarioType == CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.Explosion)
        {
            ExplosionSystem.ApplyExplosionEffects(this);
            if (Environment.Explosion is not null && !BlastOver())
            {
                foreach (Agent agent in Agents)
                {
                    RefreshAgentCell(agent); // knockback can cross a cell before perception
                }
            }
        }
        else if (ScenarioType == CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.ToxicFume)
        {
            ToxicFumeSystem.UpdateAgents(this);
        }

        EvacuationSystem.UpdatePanic(this);
        if (ScenarioType == CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.Explosion)
        {
            ExplosionSystem.UpdateDebris(this);
        }

        if (FrameIndex - _exitLoadLastUpdate >= _exitLoadUpdateInterval)
        {
            _exitLoadCache.Clear();
            foreach (Agent agent in Agents)
            {
                if (agent.ExitTarget is null || !agent.IsActive)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                _exitLoadCache.TryGetValue(agent.ExitTarget.Name, out int load);
                _exitLoadCache[agent.ExitTarget.Name] = load + 1;
            }

            _exitLoadLastUpdate = FrameIndex;
        }

        foreach (Agent agent in Agents)
        {
            if (agent.State != AgentState.WaitingToReact)
            {
                continue;
            }

            int reactionStart = agent.ReactionStartedFrame >= 0
                ? agent.ReactionStartedFrame
                : FrameIndex;
            if (FrameIndex - reactionStart < agent.EffectiveReactionDelayFrames ||
                FrameIndex < agent.FreezeUntilFrame)
            {
                continue;
            }

            agent.ExitTarget = ChooseInitialExit(agent);
            if (agent.ExitTarget is not null)
            {
                agent.ExitCommitUntilFrame = FrameIndex +
                    Math.Max(1, (int)(Config.Agent.RouteCommitmentSeconds / Config.Agent.Dt));

                // Update the local assignment estimate immediately so agents that finish their
                // reaction on the same frame do not all see an identical stale "least crowded"
                // cache and select the same doorway. The periodic cache rebuild still remains
                // the authoritative correction once movement is under way.
                _exitLoadCache.TryGetValue(agent.ExitTarget.Name, out int assignedLoad);
                _exitLoadCache[agent.ExitTarget.Name] = assignedLoad + 1;
            }

            if (agent.State is not (AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.Fallen or AgentState.Dead))
            {
                agent.State = agent.InjurySpeedFactor < 0.999f
                    ? AgentState.Injured
                    : AgentState.Evacuating;
                EvacuationSystem.BeginPurposefulResponse(this, agent);
            }
        }

        foreach (Agent agent in Agents)
        {
            if (agent.State == AgentState.Fallen && agent.CrawlUntilFrame > 0 && FrameIndex >= agent.CrawlUntilFrame)
            {
                agent.MarkCrawling();
            }
            else if (agent.State == AgentState.TempIncap && agent.CrawlUntilFrame > 0 && FrameIndex >= agent.CrawlUntilFrame)
            {
                agent.MarkCrawling();
            }
        }

        long furnitureStarted = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        UpdateFurniture();
        LastFurnitureMilliseconds = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(furnitureStarted).TotalMilliseconds;
        EvacuationSystem.BeginNaturalNavigationFrame(this);
        HybridMovement.BeginFrame(this);
        foreach (Agent agent in Agents)
        {
            if (UpdateSeating(agent))
            {
                RefreshAgentCell(agent);
                continue;
            }
            switch (agent.State)
            {
                case AgentState.Wandering:
                    UpdateWandering(agent);
                    break;

                case AgentState.Evacuating:
                case AgentState.Injured:
                case AgentState.Crawling:
                    // The Python source stores a stunned-until guard but only renders its halo.
                    // This C# port enforces the documented short stun so the feature is functional.
                    if (agent.StunnedUntilFrame > FrameIndex && agent.State != AgentState.Crawling)
                    {
                        agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                        break;
                    }

                    if (agent.ExitTarget is null && Environment.Exits.Count > 0)
                    {
                        agent.ExitTarget = ChooseInitialExit(agent);
                    }

                    bool applyLaneLogic = true;
                    if (agent.ExitTarget is not null && agent.WallFollowDir is not null &&
                        !EvacuationSystem.UsesNaturalNavigation(this))
                    {
                        float exitDistance = Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, agent.ExitTarget.Position);
                        if (!float.IsFinite(agent.LastExitDist))
                        {
                            agent.LastExitDist = exitDistance;
                        }

                        int stuckFrameCount = FrameIndex - agent.WallFollowStartFrame;
                        if (stuckFrameCount > (int)(1.5f / Config.Agent.Dt) &&
                            exitDistance > agent.LastExitDist - 2f)
                        {
                            applyLaneLogic = false;
                        }
                        else if (exitDistance < agent.LastExitDist)
                        {
                            agent.LastExitDist = exitDistance;
                        }
                    }

                    if (!Config.HybridEnabled || agent.State != AgentState.Evacuating ||
                        agent.ExitTarget is null || (FrameIndex + agent.AgentId) % 3 == 0)
                        EvacuationSystem.MaybeReselectExit(this, agent);

                    if (applyLaneLogic)
                    {
                        EvacuationSystem.UpdateEvacAgent(this, agent);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        agent.Velocity *= 0.7f;
                        if (agent.Velocity.Length() > 0.3f * agent.BaseSpeed)
                        {
                            agent.Velocity *= 0.5f;
                        }
                    }

                    break;

                case AgentState.WaitingToReact:
                case AgentState.Fallen:
                case AgentState.Incapacitated:
                case AgentState.TempIncap:
                case AgentState.Dead:
                    agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                    break;

                case AgentState.Exited:
                    break;
            }
            RefreshAgentCell(agent);
        }

        ResolveCrowdContacts();
        EvacuationSystem.ApplyExitFlows(this);
        UpdateExitMetrics();
        FrameIndex++;
        LastStepMilliseconds = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(stepStarted).TotalMilliseconds;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Replacement for the stale Python Simulation.render metrics path. Front ends render
    /// directly from this immutable lightweight snapshot without coupling the physics core to a renderer.
    /// </summary>
    public SimulationRenderSnapshot Render()
        => new(
            FrameIndex,
            Environment.Walls.ToArray(),
            Environment.Exits.ToArray(),
            Agents.ToArray(),
            Debris.ToArray(),
            ExitMetrics.ToDictionary(pair => pair.Key, pair => pair.Value),
            Environment.Explosion);

    private Exit? ChooseInitialExit(Agent agent)
    {
        if (Environment.Exits.Count == 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        // Low-familiarity pedestrians prefer currently visible exits. Select directly without
        // allocating temporary arrays or LINQ sort buffers; if none are visible, fall back to
        // the full exit set exactly as before.
        bool requireVisible = agent.RouteFamiliarity < 0.45f;
        Exit? selected = SelectInitialExit(agent, requireVisible);
        return selected ?? SelectInitialExit(agent, requireVisible: false);
    }

    private Exit? SelectInitialExit(Agent agent, bool requireVisible)
    {
        Exit? best = null;
        int bestLoad = int.MaxValue;
        float bestDistance = float.PositiveInfinity;

        foreach (Exit exit in Environment.Exits)
        {
            if (requireVisible && !HasLineOfSight(agent.Position, exit.Position))
            {
                continue;
            }

            float distance = Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, exit.Position);
            if (agent.Strategy == DecisionStrategy.Nearest)
            {
                if (best is null ||
                    distance < bestDistance ||
                    (distance == bestDistance &&
                     string.Compare(exit.Name, best.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal) < 0))
                {
                    best = exit;
                    bestDistance = distance;
                }

                continue;
            }

            int load = _exitLoadCache.TryGetValue(exit.Name, out int currentLoad) ? currentLoad : 0;
            if (best is null ||
                load < bestLoad ||
                (load == bestLoad && distance < bestDistance) ||
                (load == bestLoad && distance == bestDistance &&
                 string.Compare(exit.Name, best.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal) < 0))
            {
                best = exit;
                bestLoad = load;
                bestDistance = distance;
            }
        }

        return best;
    }

    private void UpdateExitMetrics()
    {
        float roiRadius = 10f * Config.Agent.Radius;
        float roiRadiusSquared = roiRadius * roiRadius;
        float dt = Config.Agent.Dt;

        foreach (Exit exit in Environment.Exits)
        {
            int densityRaw = 0;
            int exitedTotal = 0;
            foreach (Agent agent in Agents)
            {
                if (agent.IsActive &&
                    Vector2.DistanceSquared(agent.Position, exit.Position) <= roiRadiusSquared)
                {
                    densityRaw++;
                }

                if (agent.State == AgentState.Exited && ReferenceEquals(agent.ExitTarget, exit))
                {
                    exitedTotal++;
                }
            }

            _previousExitedByExit.TryGetValue(exit.Name, out int previousTotal);
            int exitedDelta = Math.Max(0, exitedTotal - previousTotal);
            _previousExitedByExit[exit.Name] = exitedTotal;
            float flowRate = exitedDelta / dt;
            ExitMetrics[exit.Name] = new ExitMetrics(densityRaw, flowRate);
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>Renderer-neutral frame snapshot returned by Simulation.Render().</summary>
public sealed record SimulationRenderSnapshot(
    int FrameIndex,
    IReadOnlyList<Wall> Walls,
    IReadOnlyList<Exit> Exits,
    IReadOnlyList<Agent> Agents,
    IReadOnlyList<Debris> Debris,
    IReadOnlyDictionary<string, ExitMetrics> ExitMetrics,
    Explosion? Explosion);
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;

namespace CrowdSim.Core;

/// <summary>
/// Core simulation orchestrator. This is the C# counterpart of simulation.py and deliberately
/// exposes the same major subsystem boundaries while using deterministic per-simulation randomness.
/// </summary>
public sealed partial class Simulation
{
    /// <summary>Opt-in shared navigation and open-space movement.</summary>
    public HybridMovementSystem HybridMovement { get; } = new();

    /// <summary>Wall-clock CPU time for the last completed simulation tick.</summary>
    public double LastStepMilliseconds { get; private set; }
    public double LastFurnitureMilliseconds { get; private set; }
    public double LastRoutePlanningMilliseconds { get; internal set; }
    public int LastRoutePlanRequests { get; internal set; }

    private readonly Dictionary<(int X, int Y), List<Agent>> _agentGrid = new();
    private (int X, int Y)[] _indexedAgentCells = Array.Empty<(int, int)>();
    private readonly List<(int X, int Y)> _activeAgentGridCells = new(512);
    private readonly Dictionary<(int X, int Y), List<Wall>> _wallGrid = new();
    private readonly HashSet<Wall> _segmentWallSeenScratch = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<string, int> _exitLoadCache = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Dictionary<string, int> _previousExitedByExit = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly List<Agent> _collisionAgentScratch = new(64);
    private readonly List<Wall> _nearbyWallScratch = new(32);
    private readonly HashSet<Wall> _nearbyWallSeenScratch = new();
    private int _exitLoadLastUpdate = -999;
    private readonly int _exitLoadUpdateInterval;
    private readonly float _gridCellSize;

    public Simulation(int agentCount = 0, SimulationConfig? config = null, int? randomSeed = null)
    {
        Config = config ?? SimulationConfig.CreateDefault();
        RandomSeed = randomSeed ?? Random.Shared.Next();
        Random = new Random(RandomSeed);
        Environment = new SimulationEnvironment(Config);
        SfmEngine = new SfmEngine(Config.Agent);
        ExplosionSystem = new ExplosionSystem(Config.Agent);
        ToxicFumeSystem = new ToxicFumeSystem();
        EvacuationSystem = new EvacuationSystem(Config.Agent);
        VisibilitySystem = new VisibilitySystem(Config.Agent);

        // Query slightly beyond the 2.25R mobile-to-casualty hard separation envelope.
        CollisionRadius = 2.30f * Config.Agent.Radius;
        InteractionRadius = 7f * Config.Agent.Radius;
        WallFollowRadius = 14f * Config.Agent.Radius;
        // Match the grid to interaction ranges, rather than body radius. A typical
        // perception query now visits tens of buckets instead of hundreds.
        _gridCellSize = Math.Clamp(Config.Agent.SfmInteractionRadius, 1f, 4f);
        if (!float.IsFinite(Config.Agent.Dt) || Config.Agent.Dt <= 0f ||
            Config.Agent.Dt > AgentConfig.ReferenceStepSeconds)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(config),
                "Dt must be finite and in (0, 0.15] seconds for the bounded explicit integrator.");
        }
        _exitLoadUpdateInterval = Math.Max(1, (int)(0.75f / Config.Agent.Dt));

        if (agentCount > 0)
        {
            SpawnAgents(agentCount);
        }
    }

    public SimulationConfig Config { get; }
    public SimulationEnvironment Environment { get; }
    public List<Agent> Agents { get; private set; } = new();
    public List<Debris> Debris { get; } = new();
    public SfmEngine SfmEngine { get; }
    public ExplosionSystem ExplosionSystem { get; }
    public ToxicFumeSystem ToxicFumeSystem { get; }
    public EvacuationSystem EvacuationSystem { get; }
    public VisibilitySystem VisibilitySystem { get; }
    public Random Random { get; }
    public int RandomSeed { get; }

    /// <summary>Emergency hazard selected before scene construction.</summary>
    public ScenarioType ScenarioType { get; private set; } = CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.Explosion;

    public bool Running { get; private set; }
    public int FrameIndex { get; private set; }
    public int? ExplosionTriggerFrame { get; internal set; }
    public Dictionary<int, Vector2> PreviousPositions { get; private set; } = new();
    public Dictionary<int, int> StuckFrames { get; private set; } = new();
    public Dictionary<string, ExitMetrics> ExitMetrics { get; } = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);

    public int DebrisHits { get; internal set; }
    public int DebrisInjuries { get; internal set; }
    public int DebrisIncapacitations { get; internal set; }
    public int DebrisFatalities { get; internal set; }

    public float CollisionRadius { get; }
    public float InteractionRadius { get; }
    public float WallFollowRadius { get; }

    /// <summary>Return nearby agents using the source spatial hash strategy.</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<Agent> NearbyAgents(Agent agent, float radius)
    {
        List<Agent> result = new();
        CollectNearbyAgents(agent, radius, result);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Fill a caller-owned buffer with nearby active agents. This avoids a new list allocation in
    /// hot loops such as SFM and panic propagation while preserving the same spatial-hash query.
    /// </summary>
    public void CollectNearbyAgents(Agent agent, float radius, List<Agent> result)
        => CollectAgentsNearPoint(agent.Position, radius, result, agent.AgentId);

    /// <summary>
    /// Fill a caller-owned buffer with active agents around an arbitrary point. Running queries
    /// use the same spatial hash as pedestrian-neighbour queries, which avoids full-population
    /// scans for doorway occupancy, exit density and other fixed-location measurements.
    /// </summary>
    public void CollectAgentsNearPoint(
        Vector2 position,
        float radius,
        List<Agent> result,
        int excludeAgentId = -1)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(result);
        result.Clear();

        float safeRadius = Math.Max(0f, radius);
        float radiusSquared = safeRadius * safeRadius;

        // Tests, builder tools and diagnostics may reposition agents directly while the
        // simulation is paused. In that state the spatial hash may intentionally be stale, so
        // use current authoritative positions. The running hot path below remains hashed.
        if (!Running)
        {
            foreach (Agent other in Agents)
            {
                if (!other.IsActive || other.AgentId == excludeAgentId)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (VectorMath.DistanceSquared(other.Position, position) <= radiusSquared)
                {
                    result.Add(other);
                }
            }

            return;
        }

        float inverse = 1f / _gridCellSize;
        int minX = (int)MathF.Floor((position.X - safeRadius) * inverse);
        int maxX = (int)MathF.Floor((position.X + safeRadius) * inverse);
        int minY = (int)MathF.Floor((position.Y - safeRadius) * inverse);
        int maxY = (int)MathF.Floor((position.Y + safeRadius) * inverse);

        for (int x = minX; x <= maxX; x++)
        {
            for (int y = minY; y <= maxY; y++)
            {
                if (!_agentGrid.TryGetValue((x, y), out List<Agent>? bucket))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                foreach (Agent other in bucket)
                {
                    if (!other.IsActive || other.AgentId == excludeAgentId)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (VectorMath.DistanceSquared(other.Position, position) <= radiusSquared)
                    {
                        result.Add(other);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public void SpawnAgents(int count)
    {
        Agents = InitAgents(Math.Max(0, count));
        FinishAgentSpawn();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Spawn the population at exact builder-selected start locations. The locations are scenario
    /// configuration, while all behavioural traits remain deterministically sampled from the run seed.
    /// </summary>
    public void SpawnAgentsAtPositions(IReadOnlyList<Vector2> positions)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(positions);
        Agents = new List<Agent>(positions.Count);
        for (int i = 0; i < positions.Count; i++)
        {
            Vector2 position = positions[i];
            if (Environment.IsPointBlocked(position, Config.Agent.Radius) && !Environment.IsSeatStart(position))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"Planned start position {i} intersects a wall or blockage.");
            }

            if (!float.IsFinite(position.X) || !float.IsFinite(position.Y) ||
                Agents.Any(other => Vector2.DistanceSquared(other.Position, position) < 4f * Config.Agent.Radius * Config.Agent.Radius))
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Planned start position {i} is invalid or overlaps another occupant.");
            Agents.Add(CreateAgent(i, position));
        }

        FinishAgentSpawn();
    }

    private void FinishAgentSpawn()
    {
        foreach (FurnitureChair chair in Environment.Furniture.SelectMany(set => set.Chairs))
        {
            Agent? occupant = Agents.FirstOrDefault(agent => Vector2.DistanceSquared(agent.Position, chair.StartPosition) < 0.000001f);
            if (occupant is null) continue;
            occupant.Chair = chair;
            occupant.Posture = SeatingPosture.Seated;
            occupant.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            chair.OccupantId = chair.OriginalOccupantId = occupant.AgentId;
        }
        BuildWallGrid();
        RebuildAgentGrid();
        PreviousPositions = Agents.ToDictionary(agent => agent.AgentId, agent => agent.Position);
        StuckFrames = Agents.ToDictionary(agent => agent.AgentId, _ => 0);
    }

    public List<Agent> InitAgents(int count)
    {
        (float width, float height) = Environment.Bounds();
        List<Agent> agents = new(count);
        float thickness = Environment.BoundaryThickness;
        float radius = Config.Agent.Radius;
        float xMin = thickness + radius + 0.08f;
        float xMax = width - thickness - radius - 0.08f;
        float yMin = thickness + radius + 0.08f;
        float yMax = height - thickness - radius - 0.08f;
        const int maxTries = 5000;

        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            Vector2? position = null;
            for (int attempt = 0; attempt < maxTries; attempt++)
            {
                Vector2 candidate = new(
                    Lerp(xMin, xMax, (float)Random.NextDouble()),
                    Lerp(yMin, yMax, (float)Random.NextDouble()));
                if (!Environment.IsPointBlocked(candidate, Config.Agent.Radius))
                {
                    position = candidate;
                    break;
                }
            }

            Vector2 safePosition = position ?? new Vector2(width / 2f, height / 2f);
            agents.Add(CreateAgent(i, safePosition));
        }

        return agents;
    }

    private Agent CreateAgent(int id, Vector2 position)
    {
        BehaviorTuningConfig behaviour = Config.Agent.Behavior;
        float speedT = Math.Clamp(
            0.5f + (AverageTwoRandoms(Random) - 0.5f) * behaviour.TraitVariation,
            0f,
            1f);
        float baseSpeed = Lerp(
            Config.Agent.BaseSpeedMin,
            Config.Agent.BaseSpeedMax,
            speedT);
        float reactionMidpoint = 0.5f * (
            Config.Agent.ReactionDelayMin + Config.Agent.ReactionDelayMax);
        float reactionHalfRange = 0.5f * (
            Config.Agent.ReactionDelayMax - Config.Agent.ReactionDelayMin);
        float reactionDelay = Math.Clamp(
            reactionMidpoint +
            (2f * AverageTwoRandoms(Random) - 1f) *
            reactionHalfRange * behaviour.ReactionVariation,
            Config.Agent.ReactionDelayMin,
            Config.Agent.ReactionDelayMax);
        DecisionStrategy strategy = Random.NextDouble() < 0.6
            ? DecisionStrategy.Nearest
            : DecisionStrategy.LeastCrowded;

        return new Agent(
            id,
            position,
            Vector2.Zero,
            baseSpeed,
            panicSpeedMultiplier: 1f,
            reactionDelay / Config.Agent.StepScale,
            strategy,
            Config.Agent)
        {
            // Trait values are sampled from bounded, non-demographic distributions.
            // The scenario seed makes the exact population reproducible.
            ThreatSensitivity = SampleCenteredTrait(
                Random, behaviour.StressSusceptibility, 0.25f,
                behaviour.TraitVariation, 0.60f, 1.40f),
            FollowTendency = SampleCenteredTrait(
                Random, behaviour.CrowdFollowing, 0.45f,
                behaviour.TraitVariation, 0f, 1f),
            HelpingTendency = SampleCenteredTrait(
                Random, behaviour.HelpingTendency, 0.45f,
                behaviour.TraitVariation, 0f, 1f),
            RouteFamiliarity = SampleCenteredTrait(
                Random, behaviour.RouteFamiliarity, 0.45f,
                behaviour.TraitVariation, 0f, 1f),
            UrgencyBias = SampleCenteredTrait(
                Random, 1f, 0.15f, behaviour.TraitVariation, 0.75f, 1.25f),
            StressRecoveryBias = SampleCenteredTrait(
                Random, 1f, 0.25f, behaviour.TraitVariation, 0.65f, 1.35f),
            PersonalSpaceBias = SampleCenteredTrait(
                Random, 1f, 0.12f, behaviour.TraitVariation, 0.80f, 1.20f),
            Assertiveness = SampleCenteredTrait(
                Random, behaviour.BottleneckAssertiveness, 0.45f,
                behaviour.TraitVariation, 0f, 1f),
            PatienceBias = SampleCenteredTrait(
                Random, 1f, 0.35f, behaviour.TraitVariation, 0.65f, 1.35f),
        };
    }

    public void TriggerExplosion(float x, float y)
    {
        if (ScenarioType == CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.Explosion)
        {
            ExplosionSystem.TriggerExplosion(this, x, y);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Change the hazard mode while the scene is not running.</summary>
    public void SetScenarioType(ScenarioType scenarioType)
    {
        if (Running || FrameIndex != 0)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Scenario type can only be changed before a run begins.");
        }

        ScenarioType = scenarioType;
        if (scenarioType != CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.ToxicFume)
        {
            ToxicFumeSystem.InvalidatePrecomputation();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Precompute the generic toxic-fume field during scenario setup.</summary>
    public void PrecomputeToxicFume()
    {
        if (ScenarioType != CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.ToxicFume)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Toxic-fume precomputation is only available in the Toxic Fume scenario.");
        }

        ToxicFumeSystem.Precompute(this);
    }

    /// <summary>Start replaying the precomputed toxic-fume field.</summary>
    public bool TriggerToxicFumeRelease()
        => ScenarioType == CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.ToxicFume && ToxicFumeSystem.TriggerRelease(this);

    public IReadOnlyList<Wall> NearbyWalls(Vector2 position, float radius)
    {
        List<Wall> result = new();
        HashSet<Wall> seen = new();
        CollectNearbyWalls(position, radius, result, seen);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>Fill caller-owned wall buffers without allocating in collision hot paths.</summary>
    public void CollectNearbyWalls(
        Vector2 position,
        float radius,
        List<Wall> result,
        HashSet<Wall> seen)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(result);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(seen);
        result.Clear();
        seen.Clear();

        float inverse = 1f / _gridCellSize;
        int minX = (int)MathF.Floor((position.X - radius) * inverse);
        int maxX = (int)MathF.Floor((position.X + radius) * inverse);
        int minY = (int)MathF.Floor((position.Y - radius) * inverse);
        int maxY = (int)MathF.Floor((position.Y + radius) * inverse);

        // Honour the requested radius; a fixed 3x3 scan missed distant wall candidates.
        for (int x = minX; x <= maxX; x++)
        {
            for (int y = minY; y <= maxY; y++)
            {
                if (!_wallGrid.TryGetValue((x, y), out List<Wall>? bucket))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                foreach (Wall wall in bucket)
                {
                    if (!seen.Add(wall))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (wall.X1 - radius <= position.X && position.X <= wall.X2 + radius &&
                        wall.Y1 - radius <= position.Y && position.Y <= wall.Y2 + radius)
                    {
                        result.Add(wall);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public void BuildWallGrid()
    {
        _wallGrid.Clear();
        float inverse = 1f / _gridCellSize;
        foreach (Wall wall in Environment.Walls)
        {
            int x1 = (int)MathF.Floor(wall.X1 * inverse);
            int x2 = (int)MathF.Floor(wall.X2 * inverse);
            int y1 = (int)MathF.Floor(wall.Y1 * inverse);
            int y2 = (int)MathF.Floor(wall.Y2 * inverse);
            for (int gx = x1; gx <= x2; gx++)
            {
                for (int gy = y1; gy <= y2; gy++)
                {
                    if (!_wallGrid.TryGetValue((gx, gy), out List<Wall>? bucket))
                    {
                        bucket = new List<Wall>();
                        _wallGrid[(gx, gy)] = bucket;
                    }

                    bucket.Add(wall);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Exact centre-point line of sight using the static-wall spatial hash. With only a few
    /// walls the simple scan is cheaper; obstacle-rich builder scenes switch to grid traversal.
    /// </summary>
    public bool HasLineOfSight(Vector2 start, Vector2 end)
        => !SegmentHitsWall(start, end, 0f, ignoreFurniture: true);

    /// <summary>
    /// Exact body-clear segment test using spatially culled wall candidates. Walls are still
    /// tested against the same inflated AABB as the original navigation guardrail.
    /// </summary>
    public bool HasTraversablePath(Vector2 start, Vector2 end, float clearance)
        => !SegmentHitsWall(start, end, Math.Max(0f, clearance));

    private bool SegmentHitsWall(Vector2 start, Vector2 end, float clearance, bool ignoreFurniture = false)
    {
        if (Environment.Walls.Count == 0)
        {
            return Environment.CircularBlockages.Any(circle =>
                !(ignoreFurniture && circle.IsFurniture) && CircleGeometry.SegmentIntersectsCircle(
                    start, end, circle.Center, circle.Radius + clearance));
        }

        // For small/moderate layouts a direct scan is cheaper than walking many grid cells along a
        // long sightline. Builder-heavy layouts switch to spatial culling once wall count is high.
        if (Environment.Walls.Count <= 48 || _wallGrid.Count == 0)
        {
            foreach (Wall wall in Environment.Walls)
            {
                if (ignoreFurniture && wall.IsFurniture) continue;
                if (SegmentIntersectsExpandedWall(start, end, wall, clearance))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            foreach (CircleBlockage circle in Environment.CircularBlockages)
            {
                if (ignoreFurniture && circle.IsFurniture) continue;
                if (CircleGeometry.SegmentIntersectsCircle(
                    start, end, circle.Center, circle.Radius + clearance))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        _segmentWallSeenScratch.Clear();
        float inverse = 1f / _gridCellSize;
        int x = (int)MathF.Floor(start.X * inverse);
        int y = (int)MathF.Floor(start.Y * inverse);
        int endX = (int)MathF.Floor(end.X * inverse);
        int endY = (int)MathF.Floor(end.Y * inverse);
        Vector2 delta = end - start;

        int stepX = delta.X > 0f ? 1 : delta.X < 0f ? -1 : 0;
        int stepY = delta.Y > 0f ? 1 : delta.Y < 0f ? -1 : 0;
        float tDeltaX = stepX == 0 ? float.PositiveInfinity : _gridCellSize / MathF.Abs(delta.X);
        float tDeltaY = stepY == 0 ? float.PositiveInfinity : _gridCellSize / MathF.Abs(delta.Y);
        float nextBoundaryX = stepX > 0 ? (x + 1) * _gridCellSize : x * _gridCellSize;
        float nextBoundaryY = stepY > 0 ? (y + 1) * _gridCellSize : y * _gridCellSize;
        float tMaxX = stepX == 0 ? float.PositiveInfinity : (nextBoundaryX - start.X) / delta.X;
        float tMaxY = stepY == 0 ? float.PositiveInfinity : (nextBoundaryY - start.Y) / delta.Y;
        int neighbourCells = Math.Max(1, (int)MathF.Ceiling(clearance / _gridCellSize));
        int maxSteps = Math.Abs(endX - x) + Math.Abs(endY - y) + 4;

        for (int step = 0; step < maxSteps; step++)
        {
            for (int ox = -neighbourCells; ox <= neighbourCells; ox++)
            {
                for (int oy = -neighbourCells; oy <= neighbourCells; oy++)
                {
                    if (!_wallGrid.TryGetValue((x + ox, y + oy), out List<Wall>? bucket))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    foreach (Wall wall in bucket)
                    {
                        if (ignoreFurniture && wall.IsFurniture) continue;
                        if (_segmentWallSeenScratch.Add(wall) &&
                            SegmentIntersectsExpandedWall(start, end, wall, clearance))
                        {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (x == endX && y == endY)
            {
                break;
            }

            if (tMaxX < tMaxY)
            {
                x += stepX;
                tMaxX += tDeltaX;
            }
            else
            {
                y += stepY;
                tMaxY += tDeltaY;
            }
        }

        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in Environment.CircularBlockages)
        {
            if (ignoreFurniture && circle.IsFurniture) continue;
            if (CircleGeometry.SegmentIntersectsCircle(
                start, end, circle.Center, circle.Radius + clearance))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static bool SegmentIntersectsExpandedWall(
        Vector2 start,
        Vector2 end,
        Wall wall,
        float clearance)
    {
        float margin = Math.Max(0f, clearance);
        if (wall.OrientedFootprint is OrientedRectangle rotated)
            return rotated.IntersectsSegment(start, end, margin);
        if (margin <= VectorMath.Epsilon)
        {
            return EvacuationSystem.LineIntersectsRect(start, end, wall);
        }

        float minX = wall.X1 - margin;
        float minY = wall.Y1 - margin;
        float maxX = wall.X2 + margin;
        float maxY = wall.Y2 + margin;
        Vector2 delta = end - start;
        float tMin = 0f;
        float tMax = 1f;

        static bool ClipAxis(
            float origin,
            float direction,
            float minimum,
            float maximum,
            ref float tMin,
            ref float tMax)
        {
            if (MathF.Abs(direction) < VectorMath.Epsilon)
            {
                return origin >= minimum && origin <= maximum;
            }

            float inverse = 1f / direction;
            float t1 = (minimum - origin) * inverse;
            float t2 = (maximum - origin) * inverse;
            if (t1 > t2)
            {
                (t1, t2) = (t2, t1);
            }

            tMin = Math.Max(tMin, t1);
            tMax = Math.Min(tMax, t2);
            return tMin <= tMax;
        }

        return ClipAxis(start.X, delta.X, minX, maxX, ref tMin, ref tMax) &&
               ClipAxis(start.Y, delta.Y, minY, maxY, ref tMin, ref tMax);
    }

    public bool BlastOver()
    {
        if (Environment.Explosion is null)
        {
            return true;
        }

        float elapsed = (FrameIndex - Environment.Explosion.TriggeredFrame) * Config.Agent.StepScale;
        return elapsed > Config.Agent.BlastWindDurationFrames + 10;
    }

    /// <summary>Toggle run/pause. As in Python, simulation cannot start before agents and an exit exist.</summary>
    public bool ToggleRunning()
    {
        if (Agents.Count == 0 || Environment.Exits.Count == 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!Running && ScenarioType == CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.ToxicFume && !ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(this))
        {
            return false;
        }

        Running = !Running;
        return true;
    }

    public void SetRunning(bool running)
    {
        if (running && (Agents.Count == 0 || Environment.Exits.Count == 0))
        {
            Running = false;
            return;
        }

        if (running && ScenarioType == CrowdSim.Core.Model.ScenarioType.ToxicFume && !ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(this))
        {
            Running = false;
            return;
        }

        Running = running;
    }

    private void RebuildAgentGrid()
    {
        // Keep cell buckets alive and clear only the cells that were occupied last frame.
        // The previous implementation cleared the dictionary and allocated fresh List<Agent>
        // buckets every physics tick, which produced GC spikes once large mouse-placed groups
        // started moving through the room.
        foreach ((int X, int Y) cell in _activeAgentGridCells)
        {
            if (_agentGrid.TryGetValue(cell, out List<Agent>? bucket))
            {
                bucket.Clear();
            }
        }

        _activeAgentGridCells.Clear();
        if (_indexedAgentCells.Length != Agents.Count)
        {
            _indexedAgentCells = new (int, int)[Agents.Count];
        }
        float inverse = 1f / _gridCellSize;
        foreach (Agent agent in Agents)
        {
            if (!agent.IsActive)
            {
                continue;
            }

            (int X, int Y) cell = (
                (int)MathF.Floor(agent.Position.X * inverse),
                (int)MathF.Floor(agent.Position.Y * inverse));
            _indexedAgentCells[agent.AgentId] = cell;
            if (!_agentGrid.TryGetValue(cell, out List<Agent>? bucket))
            {
                bucket = new List<Agent>(8);
                _agentGrid[cell] = bucket;
            }

            if (bucket.Count == 0)
            {
                _activeAgentGridCells.Add(cell);
            }

            bucket.Add(agent);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Refresh after external diagnostic edits to positions while running.</summary>
    public void RefreshSpatialIndex() => RebuildAgentGrid();

    private void RefreshAgentCell(Agent agent)
    {
        if ((uint)agent.AgentId >= (uint)_indexedAgentCells.Length ||
            !VectorMath.IsFinite(agent.Position))
        {
            return;
        }
        var previous = _indexedAgentCells[agent.AgentId];
        var current = ((int)MathF.Floor(agent.Position.X / _gridCellSize),
            (int)MathF.Floor(agent.Position.Y / _gridCellSize));
        if (current == previous)
        {
            return;
        }
        if (_agentGrid.TryGetValue(previous, out List<Agent>? oldBucket))
        {
            int index = oldBucket.IndexOf(agent);
            if (index >= 0)
            {
                oldBucket[index] = oldBucket[^1];
                oldBucket.RemoveAt(oldBucket.Count - 1);
            }
        }
        if (!_agentGrid.TryGetValue(current, out List<Agent>? bucket))
        {
            bucket = new List<Agent>(8);
            _agentGrid[current] = bucket;
        }
        if (bucket.Count == 0)
        {
            _activeAgentGridCells.Add(current);
        }
        bucket.Add(agent);
        _indexedAgentCells[agent.AgentId] = current;
    }

    private static float AverageTwoRandoms(Random random)
        => 0.5f * ((float)random.NextDouble() + (float)random.NextDouble());

    private static float SampleCenteredTrait(
        Random random,
        float centre,
        float halfRange,
        float variation,
        float minimum,
        float maximum)
    {
        float signedTriangular = 2f * AverageTwoRandoms(random) - 1f;
        return Math.Clamp(
            centre + signedTriangular * halfRange * Math.Clamp(variation, 0f, 1f),
            minimum,
            maximum);
    }

    private static float Lerp(float a, float b, float t) => a + (b - a) * t;
}
```
