## src/CrowdSim.Core/Systems/EvacuationSystem.NaturalNavigation.cs

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Systems;

public sealed partial class EvacuationSystem
{
    private readonly Queue<Agent> _naturalRecoveryQueue = new();
    private readonly Queue<Agent> _naturalRouteQueue = new();
    private readonly List<Agent> _naturalPeople = new(96);
    private readonly List<CircleBlockage> _naturalCircles = new(64);
    private readonly List<FurnitureBody> _naturalMovingFurniture = new(32);
    private object? _naturalPopulation;
    private int _naturalFrame = -1;

    public int NaturalPendingRecoveries => _naturalRecoveryQueue.Count;
    public int NaturalPendingRoutes => _naturalRouteQueue.Count;
    public int LastNaturalRecoveryProbes { get; private set; }
    public int LastNaturalRoutePlans { get; private set; }

    internal bool UsesNaturalNavigation(Simulation simulation) =>
        _config.NaturalNavigationEnabled &&
        simulation.ScenarioType is ScenarioType.Explosion or ScenarioType.ToxicFume;

    private static bool IsNaturalMover(Agent agent) =>
        agent.State is (AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured) &&
        agent.Posture == SeatingPosture.Walking &&
        agent.ExitTarget is not null &&
        agent.Intent is BehaviorIntent.Evacuate or BehaviorIntent.FollowCrowd;

    /// <summary>
    /// Deterministic FIFO work queues, serviced once per simulation step. Expensive retries
    /// cannot run simultaneously for all 600 people, and high agent IDs cannot starve behind
    /// the same low IDs. Ordinary locomotion and physical contact remain per-step work.
    /// </summary>
    internal void BeginNaturalNavigationFrame(Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (!ReferenceEquals(_naturalPopulation, simulation.Agents))
        {
            _naturalPopulation = simulation.Agents;
            _naturalRecoveryQueue.Clear();
            _naturalRouteQueue.Clear();
            _naturalFrame = -1;
        }
        if (_naturalFrame == simulation.FrameIndex) return;
        _naturalFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
        LastNaturalRecoveryProbes = 0;
        LastNaturalRoutePlans = 0;
        if (!UsesNaturalNavigation(simulation)) return;

        int recoveries = _naturalRecoveryQueue.Count;
        while (recoveries-- > 0 && LastNaturalRecoveryProbes < Math.Max(1, _config.NaturalRecoveryProbesPerStep))
        {
            Agent agent = _naturalRecoveryQueue.Dequeue();
            agent.NavigationMemory.RecoveryRequested = false;
            if (!IsNaturalMover(agent)) continue;
            if (agent.NavigationMemory.NoProgressSeconds < 0.4f &&
                !agent.NavigationMemory.LoopDetected &&
                Vector2.DistanceSquared(agent.Position, agent.NavigationMemory.RecoveryRequestPosition) > 0.64f)
                continue; // useful motion resumed while the request was waiting in the FIFO
            LastNaturalRecoveryProbes++;
            ChooseNaturalRecovery(simulation, agent);
        }

        int routes = _naturalRouteQueue.Count;
        while (routes-- > 0 && LastNaturalRoutePlans < Math.Max(1, _config.NaturalRoutePlansPerStep))
        {
            Agent agent = _naturalRouteQueue.Dequeue();
            NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
            memory.RouteQueued = false;
            if (agent.ExitTarget is null || !agent.IsActive ||
                agent.State is not (AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured or AgentState.Crawling) ||
                memory.RequestedRouteKey is not string key) continue;
            if (!string.Equals(key, $"exit:{agent.ExitTarget.Name}", StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
            if (memory.DetourGoal is not null) continue; // plan from where the detour finishes, not its old origin

            LastNaturalRoutePlans++;
            memory.RoutePlans++;
            simulation.LastRoutePlanRequests++;
            long started = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
            IReadOnlyList<Vector2> route = _routePlanner.Plan(simulation, agent.Position, memory.RequestedRouteGoal);
            simulation.LastRoutePlanningMilliseconds += Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(started).TotalMilliseconds;
            if (route.Count > 0)
            {
                agent.SetRoute(route, key, int.MaxValue);
                memory.GuidancePoint = null;
                memory.NextRouteCheckFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
                agent.FailedRouteKey = null;
                // Do not reset navigation progress/failure memory here.
            }
            else
            {
                agent.ClearRoute();
                memory.NextRouteRequestFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(0.8f + (agent.AgentId % 5) * 0.09f);
                agent.FailedRouteKey = key;
                agent.FailedRouteRetryFrame = memory.NextRouteRequestFrame;
                RequestNaturalRecovery(simulation, agent, force: false);
            }
        }
    }

    private void ObserveNaturalNavigation(Simulation simulation, Agent agent)
    {
        if (!UsesNaturalNavigation(simulation) || !IsNaturalMover(agent)) return;
        BeginNaturalNavigationFrame(simulation);
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
        if (simulation.FrameIndex < memory.NextObservationFrame) return;
        memory.NextObservationFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(
            _config.NaturalDecisionSeconds + (agent.AgentId % 3) * 0.035f);
        Vector2 target = memory.DetourGoal ?? agent.CurrentRouteWaypoint ?? agent.ExitTarget!.Position;
        bool freshFieldCost = memory.DetourGoal is null && agent.CurrentRouteWaypoint is null &&
            (simulation.FrameIndex - memory.FieldCostFrame) * _config.Dt <= 0.9f;
        memory.Observe(agent.Position, target, simulation.FrameIndex, _config.Dt,
            freshFieldCost ? memory.RemainingFieldCost : float.PositiveInfinity, memory.FieldGeometryVersion);
        if (memory.DetourGoal is not null) return;

        float threshold = _config.NaturalNoProgressSeconds * Math.Clamp(agent.PatienceBias, 0.8f, 1.25f);
        // A slow but progressing doorway queue is not a trap. Persistent failure still
        // eventually permits reconsideration, without forced shoving or teleportation.
        bool nearDoor = Vector2.DistanceSquared(agent.Position, agent.ExitTarget!.Position) < 2.25f;
        if (nearDoor) threshold = Math.Max(threshold, _config.NaturalExitReconsiderSeconds);
        bool actionableLoop = memory.LoopDetected && (!nearDoor || memory.NoProgressSeconds >= threshold);
        if (actionableLoop || memory.NoProgressSeconds >= threshold)
        {
            RequestNaturalRecovery(simulation, agent, force: actionableLoop);
        }
        else if (memory.NoProgressSeconds < 0.4f &&
                 simulation.FrameIndex >= memory.NextRecoveryFrame && !memory.RecoveryRequested)
        {
            memory.Stage = NavigationRecoveryStage.FollowingRoute;
            if ((simulation.FrameIndex - memory.LastRecoveryFrame) * _config.Dt >= 5f)
            {
                memory.RecoveryAttempts = 0; // new blockage episode, not permanent impatience
                memory.RecoveryEpisodeStartedFrame = -1;
            }
        }
    }

    internal void RequestNaturalRecovery(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, bool force)
    {
        if (!UsesNaturalNavigation(simulation) || !IsNaturalMover(agent)) return;
        BeginNaturalNavigationFrame(simulation);
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
        if (memory.RecoveryRequested || (!force && simulation.FrameIndex < memory.NextRecoveryFrame)) return;
        memory.RecoveryRequested = true;
        memory.RecoveryRequestPosition = agent.Position;
        memory.Stage = NavigationRecoveryStage.AssessingBlockage;
        _naturalRecoveryQueue.Enqueue(agent);
    }

    private void RequestNaturalRoute(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, Vector2 goal, string key)
    {
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
        memory.RequestedRouteGoal = goal;
        memory.RequestedRouteKey = key;
        if (memory.RouteQueued || simulation.FrameIndex < memory.NextRouteRequestFrame) return;
        memory.RouteQueued = true;
        _naturalRouteQueue.Enqueue(agent);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Keep valid routes, check nearby changed geometry at a staggered decision rate, and
    /// use shared exit guidance rather than one new A* search per person every two seconds.
    /// Full A* is a queued fallback/recovery, not the per-frame motor controller.
    /// </summary>
    private Vector2 ResolveNaturalRouteDirection(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, Vector2 goal, string key)
    {
        BeginNaturalNavigationFrame(simulation);
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
        float clearance = NavigationClearance();
        if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(agent.Position, goal) < 0.000001f) return Vector2.Zero;

        if (string.Equals(agent.RouteExitName, key, StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
            agent.CurrentRouteWaypoint is not null)
        {
            float reach = Math.Max(0.10f, _config.RouteWaypointReachFactor * _config.Radius);
            while (agent.CurrentRouteWaypoint is Vector2 reached &&
                   Vector2.DistanceSquared(agent.Position, reached) <= reach * reach)
                agent.AdvanceRouteWaypoint();

            if (agent.CurrentRouteWaypoint is Vector2 waypoint)
            {
                if (simulation.FrameIndex < memory.NextRouteCheckFrame)
                    return VectorMath.SafeNormalize(waypoint - agent.Position);
                memory.NextRouteCheckFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(_config.NaturalDecisionSeconds);
                // An unseen distant change does not immediately cancel the whole intention.
                float range = _config.NaturalPerceptionRadiusMeters * Math.Clamp(agent.VisibilityFactor, 0.35f, 1f);
                Vector2 toWaypoint = waypoint - agent.Position;
                Vector2 probe = agent.Position + VectorMath.SafeNormalize(toWaypoint) * Math.Min(range, toWaypoint.Length());
                if (simulation.HasTraversablePath(agent.Position, probe, clearance))
                {
                    if (agent.RouteWaypointIndex + 1 < agent.RouteWaypoints.Count)
                    {
                        Vector2 next = agent.RouteWaypoints[agent.RouteWaypointIndex + 1];
                        if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(agent.Position, next) <= range * range &&
                            simulation.HasTraversablePath(agent.Position, next, clearance))
                        {
                            agent.AdvanceRouteWaypoint();
                            waypoint = next;
                        }
                    }
                    return VectorMath.SafeNormalize(waypoint - agent.Position);
                }
                agent.ClearRoute();
                memory.GuidancePoint = null;
                memory.IgnoreSharedFieldUntilFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(1.0f);
                RequestNaturalRoute(simulation, agent, goal, key);
            }
        }

        if (string.Equals(memory.GuidanceKey, key, StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
            memory.GuidancePoint is Vector2 cached &&
            simulation.FrameIndex < memory.GuidanceRefreshFrame &&
            Vector2.DistanceSquared(agent.Position, cached) > 0.0225f)
            return VectorMath.SafeNormalize(cached - agent.Position);

        memory.GuidanceKey = key;
        memory.GuidanceRefreshFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(
            _config.NaturalDecisionSeconds + (agent.AgentId % 3) * 0.03f);
        if (simulation.HasTraversablePath(agent.Position, goal, clearance))
        {
            memory.GuidancePoint = goal;
            return VectorMath.SafeNormalize(goal - agent.Position);
        }
        if (simulation.FrameIndex >= memory.IgnoreSharedFieldUntilFrame &&
            simulation.HybridMovement.Fields.TryDirection(simulation, agent.Position,
                agent.ExitTarget?.Position ?? goal, out Vector2 fieldDirection, out float fieldCost))
        {
            memory.RemainingFieldCost = fieldCost;
            memory.FieldGeometryVersion = simulation.HybridMovement.Fields.GeometryRefreshes;
            memory.FieldCostFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
            memory.GuidancePoint = agent.Position + fieldDirection * 0.70f;
            return fieldDirection;
        }
        memory.GuidancePoint = null;
        RequestNaturalRoute(simulation, agent, goal, key);
        return TryInjuredChairClearance(simulation, agent, goal - agent.Position);
    }

    private Vector2 ApplyNaturalRecoveryDirection(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, Vector2 direction, bool exitCapture)
    {
        if (!UsesNaturalNavigation(simulation) || !IsNaturalMover(agent)) return direction;
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
        if (exitCapture && Vector2.DistanceSquared(agent.Position, agent.ExitTarget!.Position) < 1.0f)
        {
            memory.DetourGoal = null;
            return direction;
        }
        if (memory.DetourGoal is not Vector2 goal) return direction;
        float distance = Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, goal);
        if (distance <= 0.23f)
        {
            memory.SuccessfulDetours++;
            memory.DetourGoal = null;
            memory.Stage = NavigationRecoveryStage.FollowingRoute;
            memory.GuidancePoint = null;
            memory.NextRecoveryFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(0.6f);
            agent.ClearRoute();
            if (memory.ReplanAfterDetour)
            {
                // Replan from the actual completed detour position. Planning before arrival
                // would waste work and could keep pulling the agent back into the old trap.
                memory.ReplanAfterDetour = false;
                memory.IgnoreSharedFieldUntilFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(3f);
                memory.NextRouteRequestFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
                RequestNaturalRoute(simulation, agent, ExitApproachTarget(agent, agent.ExitTarget!),
                    $"exit:{agent.ExitTarget!.Name}");
            }
            return ResolveExitNavigationDirection(simulation, agent, agent.ExitTarget!);
        }
        if (memory.DetourBestDistance - distance >= 0.10f)
        {
            memory.DetourBestDistance = distance;
            memory.DetourLastProgressFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
        }
        bool failed = simulation.FrameIndex >= memory.DetourUntilFrame ||
            (simulation.FrameIndex - memory.DetourLastProgressFrame) * _config.Dt >= 1.65f;
        if (!failed && simulation.FrameIndex >= memory.DetourNextCheckFrame)
        {
            memory.DetourNextCheckFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(_config.NaturalDecisionSeconds);
            CollectNaturalCircles(simulation, agent.Position, distance + 0.5f);
            failed = !NaturalGeometryClear(simulation, agent.Position, goal, _config.Radius + 0.005f) ||
                NaturalToxicDetourWorsened(simulation, agent, goal);
        }
        if (failed)
        {
            memory.RememberFailure(goal, simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(_config.NaturalFailureMemorySeconds));
            memory.DetourGoal = null;
            memory.GuidancePoint = null;
            memory.NextRecoveryFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
            RequestNaturalRecovery(simulation, agent, force: true);
            return VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget!.Position - agent.Position);
        }
        return VectorMath.SafeNormalize(goal - agent.Position);
    }

    private void ChooseNaturalRecovery(Simulation simulation, Agent agent)
    {
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
        if (memory.RecoveryAttempts == 0 || memory.RecoveryEpisodeStartedFrame < 0)
            memory.RecoveryEpisodeStartedFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
        memory.RecoveryAttempts++;
        memory.TotalRecoveryAttempts++;
        memory.LastRecoveryFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
        // Remember the unsuccessful forward solution, not the solid obstacle's centre.
        if (agent.LastDesiredDirection.LengthSquared() > 0.01f)
            memory.RememberFailure(agent.Position + VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.LastDesiredDirection) * 1.2f,
                simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(_config.NaturalFailureMemorySeconds));
        memory.AcknowledgeLoop(simulation.FrameIndex, SecondsToFrames(2.0f));
        memory.NextRecoveryFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(0.6f + (agent.AgentId % 4) * 0.05f);
        memory.IgnoreSharedFieldUntilFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(3.0f);
        memory.GuidancePoint = null;
        if (memory.DetourGoal is Vector2 failed)
            memory.RememberFailure(failed, simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(_config.NaturalFailureMemorySeconds));
        memory.DetourGoal = null;
        agent.ClearRoute();
        ClearCircleFollow(agent);
        ClearSlowObstacleBypass(agent);
        ResetCasualtyBlockageEpisode(agent);
        agent.WallFollowDir = null;
        agent.WallFollowNormal = null;
        agent.WallFollowTangent = null;
        agent.WallFollowUntil = simulation.FrameIndex;
        agent.Exploring = false;
        agent.TempGoal = null;

        float episodeSeconds = (simulation.FrameIndex - memory.RecoveryEpisodeStartedFrame) * _config.Dt;
        bool repeatedlyUnsuccessful = memory.RecoveryAttempts >= 3 &&
            episodeSeconds >= _config.NaturalExitReconsiderSeconds;
        if ((memory.RecoveryAttempts >= 2 && memory.NoProgressSeconds >= _config.NaturalExitReconsiderSeconds) ||
            repeatedlyUnsuccessful)
            TryNaturalAlternativeExit(simulation, agent);
        memory.ReplanAfterDetour = memory.RecoveryAttempts >= 2;

        if (TryChooseNaturalRecoveryGoal(simulation, agent, out Vector2 goal))
        {
            memory.DetourGoal = goal;
            NaturalFumeRisk fumeRisk = SampleNaturalFumeRisk(simulation, agent, goal);
            memory.DetourToxicPeak = fumeRisk.Peak;
            memory.DetourToxicEnd = fumeRisk.End;
            memory.DetourStartedFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
            memory.DetourLastProgressFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
            memory.DetourBestDistance = Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, goal);
            float speed = Math.Max(0.20f, agent.CurrentDesiredSpeed / AgentConfig.ReferenceStepSeconds);
            float commitment = Math.Clamp(Math.Max(_config.NaturalDetourCommitSeconds,
                1.6f * memory.DetourBestDistance / speed), 1.0f, 10.0f);
            memory.DetourUntilFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(commitment);
            memory.DetourNextCheckFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(_config.NaturalDecisionSeconds);
            memory.Stage = memory.RecoveryAttempts == 1 ? NavigationRecoveryStage.LocalDetour : NavigationRecoveryStage.WiderDetour;
            return;
        }

        // A genuinely sealed or densely occupied space need not have a feasible detour.
        // Retain physical constraints and re-observe later, rather than teleporting anyone.
        memory.Stage = NavigationRecoveryStage.WaitingForOpening;
        RequestNaturalRoute(simulation, agent, ExitApproachTarget(agent, agent.ExitTarget!), $"exit:{agent.ExitTarget!.Name}");
    }

    /// <summary>At most 36 local candidates, one nearby-person query, and reusable geometry buffers.</summary>
    internal bool TryChooseNaturalRecoveryGoal(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, out Vector2 bestGoal)
    {
        bestGoal = default;
        if (agent.ExitTarget is null) return false;
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
        float maxLength = memory.RecoveryAttempts <= 1 ? 1.7f : 3.2f;
        float speed = agent.CurrentDesiredSpeed / AgentConfig.ReferenceStepSeconds;
        if (speed < 0.5f) maxLength = Math.Min(maxLength, 1.7f);
        maxLength = Math.Min(maxLength, _config.NaturalPerceptionRadiusMeters * Math.Clamp(agent.VisibilityFactor, 0.35f, 1f));
        CollectNaturalCircles(simulation, agent.Position, maxLength + 0.6f);
        simulation.CollectNearbyAgents(agent, maxLength + 1.25f, _naturalPeople);
        Vector2 forward = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.ExitTarget.Position - agent.Position, Vector2.UnitX);
        ReadOnlySpan<float> lengths = stackalloc float[] { 0.75f, 1.6f, 3.2f };
        float bestScore = float.NegativeInfinity;
        foreach (float length in lengths)
        {
            if (length > maxLength + 0.01f) continue;
            for (int sample = 0; sample < 12; sample++)
            {
                // Rotate the sampling fan slightly between attempts, deterministically.
                float angle = sample * MathF.Tau / 12f + (memory.RecoveryAttempts % 3 - 1) * 0.08f;
                Vector2 candidateDirection = Rotate(forward, angle);
                Vector2 candidate = agent.Position + candidateDirection * length;
                if (!NaturalGeometryClear(simulation, agent.Position, candidate, _config.Radius + 0.01f)) continue;
                float crowding = 0f;
                bool blocked = false;
                foreach (Agent other in _naturalPeople)
                {
                    if (!other.IsActive) continue;
                    float separation = _config.Radius * (other.IsCasualtyObstacle ? 2.25f : 2f) + 0.015f;
                    if (!SeparatingOrClearSegment(agent.Position, candidate, other.Position, separation))
                    {
                        blocked = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    float squared = Vector2.DistanceSquared(candidate, other.Position);
                    if (squared < 1.44f) crowding += 1f - squared / 1.44f;
                }
                if (blocked) continue;
                float clearance = 1.2f;
                foreach (CircleBlockage circle in _naturalCircles)
                    clearance = Math.Min(clearance, Vector2.Distance(candidate, circle.Center) - circle.Radius - _config.Radius);
                foreach (Wall wall in simulation.Environment.Walls)
                    clearance = Math.Min(clearance, Vector2.Distance(candidate, wall.ClosestPoint(candidate)) - _config.Radius);
                float progress = Vector2.Dot(candidateDirection, forward);
                float parity = (agent.AgentId & 1) == 0 ? 1f : -1f;
                float score = 1.1f * Math.Clamp(clearance, 0f, 1.2f) - 1.6f * crowding +
                    0.48f * progress + 0.20f * length + 0.025f * parity * MathF.Sin(angle) -
                    3.0f * memory.FailurePenalty(candidate, simulation.FrameIndex) -
                    1.3f * memory.RecentVisitPenalty(candidate, simulation.FrameIndex, _config.Dt) -
                    NaturalToxicPathPenalty(simulation, agent, candidate);
                if (score <= bestScore) continue;
                bestScore = score;
                bestGoal = candidate;
            }
        }
        return float.IsFinite(bestScore);
    }

    private void CollectNaturalCircles(Simulation simulation, Vector2 origin, float range)
    {
        _naturalCircles.Clear();
        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in simulation.Environment.CircularBlockages)
        {
            float reach = range + circle.Radius + _config.Radius;
            if (Vector2.DistanceSquared(origin, circle.Center) <= reach * reach) _naturalCircles.Add(circle);
        }
    }

    private bool NaturalGeometryClear(Simulation simulation, Vector2 start, Vector2 end, float radius)
    {
        float border = simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness + radius;
        if (end.X < border || end.Y < border || end.X > simulation.Environment.Width - border ||
            end.Y > simulation.Environment.Height - border) return false;
        foreach (Wall wall in simulation.Environment.Walls)
        {
            bool intersects = wall.OrientedFootprint is OrientedRectangle rotated
                ? rotated.IntersectsSegment(start, end, radius)
                : SegmentIntersectsAabb(start, end, wall.X1 - radius, wall.Y1 - radius, wall.X2 + radius, wall.Y2 + radius);
            if (!intersects) continue;
            Vector2 startOffset = start - wall.ClosestPoint(start);
            Vector2 endOffset = end - wall.ClosestPoint(end);
            // Permit outward release from pre-existing contact, never new penetration.
            if (startOffset.LengthSquared() <= 0.000001f ||
                startOffset.LengthSquared() > radius * radius + 0.000001f ||
                Vector2.Dot(startOffset, end - start) < 0f || endOffset.LengthSquared() < radius * radius)
                return false;
        }
        foreach (CircleBlockage circle in _naturalCircles)
            if (!SeparatingOrClearSegment(start, end, circle.Center, circle.Radius + radius)) return false;
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Analytic swept-circle clearance, including monotonic release from existing contact.</summary>
    internal static bool SeparatingOrClearSegment(Vector2 start, Vector2 end, Vector2 center, float radius)
    {
        Vector2 delta = end - start;
        Vector2 relative = start - center;
        float squared = radius * radius;
        if (relative.LengthSquared() < squared)
            return Vector2.Dot(relative, delta) >= 0f && Vector2.DistanceSquared(end, center) >= squared;
        float lengthSquared = delta.LengthSquared();
        if (lengthSquared <= 0.0000001f) return relative.LengthSquared() >= squared;
        float t = Math.Clamp(-Vector2.Dot(relative, delta) / lengthSquared, 0f, 1f);
        return (relative + delta * t).LengthSquared() >= squared;
    }

    private void TryNaturalAlternativeExit(Simulation simulation, Agent agent)
    {
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
        if (simulation.Environment.Exits.Count < 2 || agent.ExitTarget is null ||
            (simulation.FrameIndex - memory.LastExitChangeFrame) * _config.Dt < 5.0f) return;
        Exit current = agent.ExitTarget;
        Exit? best = null;
        float bestCost = float.PositiveInfinity;
        foreach (Exit exit in simulation.Environment.Exits)
        {
            if (ReferenceEquals(exit, current)) continue;
            float cost = NaturalPerceivedExitCost(simulation, agent, exit);
            if (memory.RecentlyFailedExit == exit.Name && simulation.FrameIndex < memory.FailedExitUntilFrame) cost += 20f;
            if (cost >= bestCost) continue;
            bestCost = cost;
            best = exit;
        }
        if (best is null) return;
        float currentCost = NaturalPerceivedExitCost(simulation, agent, current) + 12f;
        if (bestCost > currentCost && memory.RecoveryAttempts < 4) return;
        memory.RecentlyFailedExit = current.Name;
        memory.FailedExitUntilFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(_config.NaturalFailureMemorySeconds);
        memory.LastExitChangeFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
        memory.ExitChanges++;
        memory.Stage = NavigationRecoveryStage.ReconsideringExit;
        agent.ExitTarget = best;
        memory.ResetRouteCostObservation();
        agent.ExitCommitUntilFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(5.0f);
        agent.ResetExitCongestion();
        memory.GuidanceKey = null;
        memory.NextRouteRequestFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
    }

    private float NaturalPerceivedExitCost(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, Exit exit, float? toxicPenalty = null)
    {
        float distance = Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, exit.Position);
        float range = _config.NaturalPerceptionRadiusMeters * Math.Clamp(agent.VisibilityFactor, 0.35f, 1f);
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
        float crowdCost = 0.8f; // unknown is uncertain, not known empty
        if (distance <= range && simulation.HasLineOfSight(agent.Position, exit.Position))
        {
            crowdCost = LocalDensity(simulation, exit) * _config.ExitCongestionWeight +
                DoorwayOccupancy(simulation, exit, agent.AgentId) * _config.ExitCongestionWeight;
            memory.ExitObservations[exit.Name] = (crowdCost, simulation.FrameIndex);
        }
        else if (memory.ExitObservations.TryGetValue(exit.Name, out var observation))
        {
            float age = (simulation.FrameIndex - observation.Frame) * _config.Dt;
            crowdCost = 0.8f + (observation.Cost - 0.8f) * MathF.Exp(-age / 8f);
        }
        return distance + crowdCost + (toxicPenalty ?? NaturalToxicPathPenalty(simulation, agent, exit.Position));
    }

    internal Vector2 ApplyNaturalMovingFurnitureAvoidance(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, Vector2 direction)
    {
        // Blast-driven motion belongs to Explosion only. Ordinary furniture collision and
        // chair-pushing remain shared; Toxic Fume does not run this hazard predictor.
        if (simulation.ScenarioType != ScenarioType.Explosion ||
            !UsesNaturalNavigation(simulation) || !IsNaturalMover(agent)) return direction;
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
        if (simulation.FrameIndex >= memory.NextHazardCheckFrame)
        {
            memory.NextHazardCheckFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(_config.NaturalDecisionSeconds);
            memory.FurnitureAvoidance = Vector2.Zero;
            simulation.CollectMovingFurnitureNear(agent.Position, 5.0f, _naturalMovingFurniture);
            foreach (FurnitureBody body in _naturalMovingFurniture)
            {
                Vector2 relative = body.Position - agent.Position;
                float distance = relative.Length();
                Vector2 heading = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(agent.LastDesiredDirection, direction);
                bool perceived = distance <= 1.1f ||
                    (Vector2.Dot(heading, VectorMath.SafeNormalize(relative)) >= -0.34f &&
                     HasLineOfSight(agent.Position, body.Position, simulation.Environment.Walls));
                if (!perceived || body.Height > AgentConfig.HeightMeters + 0.4f) continue;
                Vector2 velocity = body.Velocity - agent.VelocityMetersPerSecond;
                float squaredSpeed = velocity.LengthSquared();
                if (squaredSpeed < 0.25f) continue;
                float time = -Vector2.Dot(relative, velocity) / squaredSpeed;
                if (time < 0f || time > 0.55f) continue;
                Vector2 nearest = relative + velocity * time;
                float reach = body.Radius + _config.Radius + 0.20f;
                if (nearest.LengthSquared() >= reach * reach) continue;
                Vector2 away = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(-nearest,
                    VectorMath.Perpendicular(VectorMath.SafeNormalize(velocity, Vector2.UnitX)));
                memory.FurnitureAvoidance += away * (1f - time / 0.70f);
            }
            memory.FurnitureAvoidance = VectorMath.ClampMagnitude(memory.FurnitureAvoidance, 1.0f);
        }
        // This is only a short-horizon inference from current visible velocity. No landing
        // location, future collision result or precomputed furniture trajectory is available.
        return VectorMath.SafeNormalize(direction + 1.25f * memory.FurnitureAvoidance, direction);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Systems;

public sealed partial class EvacuationSystem
{
    private readonly List<Agent> _openSpacePeople = new(64);

    /// <summary>Find a reachable local waypoint, including sideways/backward escape from a bottleneck.</summary>
    internal bool TryChooseEarlyOpenSpaceGoal(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, Vector2 forward,
        bool threatEscape, out Vector2 bestGoal)
    {
        bestGoal = default;
        if (simulation.FrameIndex < agent.NextOpenSpaceProbeFrame || forward.LengthSquared() < 1e-8f)
            return false;
        agent.NextOpenSpaceProbeFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(0.30f);
        forward = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(forward);
        simulation.CollectAgentsNearPoint(agent.Position, 3.2f, _openSpacePeople, agent.AgentId);
        float bestScore = float.NegativeInfinity;
        bool found = false;
        // Short options fit around furniture; longer options can escape a cluster.
        ReadOnlySpan<float> lengths = stackalloc float[] { 0.75f, 1.35f, 2.1f };
        foreach (float length in lengths)
        for (int sample = 0; sample < 12; sample++)
        {
            float angle = sample * MathF.Tau / 12f;
            Vector2 direction = Rotate(forward, angle);
            Vector2 candidate = agent.Position + direction * length;
            if (!simulation.HasTraversablePath(agent.Position, candidate, NavigationClearance()) ||
                !OpenSpacePathAvoidsPeople(agent, candidate)) continue;
            if (threatEscape && simulation.Environment.Explosion is Explosion blast &&
                Vector2.Distance(candidate, blast.Position) < Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, blast.Position) -
                    _config.ThreatEscapeCasualtyBypassMaxBacktrackMeters) continue;
            float crowding = 0f;
            foreach (Agent other in _openSpacePeople)
                if (other.IsActive) crowding += Math.Max(0f, 1f - Vector2.Distance(candidate, other.Position) / 0.9f);
            float clearance = Math.Clamp(EndpointClearance(simulation, candidate) / 0.8f, 0f, 1f);
            float progress = Vector2.Dot(direction, forward);
            float sidePreference = ((agent.AgentId & 1) == 0 ? 1f : -1f) * MathF.Sin(angle) * 0.015f;
            // Clear space dominates immediate exit progress; a temporary backward step is legitimate.
            float score = 1.4f * clearance - 2f * crowding + 0.3f * progress + 0.12f * length + sidePreference;
            if (score > bestScore)
            {
                bestScore = score;
                bestGoal = candidate;
                found = true;
            }
        }
        return found;
    }

    private bool OpenSpacePathAvoidsPeople(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, Vector2 goal)
    {
        simulation.CollectAgentsNearPoint(agent.Position, Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, goal) + 1f,
            _openSpacePeople, agent.AgentId);
        return OpenSpacePathAvoidsPeople(agent, goal);
    }

    /// <summary>Preserve physical body space, while allowing escape from pre-existing close contact.</summary>
    private bool OpenSpacePathAvoidsPeople(Agent agent, Vector2 goal)
    {
        int steps = Math.Max(1, (int)MathF.Ceiling(Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, goal) / 0.06f));
        foreach (Agent other in _openSpacePeople)
        {
            if (!other.IsActive) continue;
            float hardRadius = _config.Radius * (other.IsCasualtyObstacle ? 2.25f : 2f);
            float clearance = hardRadius + 0.025f;
            float previous = Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, other.Position);
            for (int step = 1; step <= steps; step++)
            {
                float distance = Vector2.Distance(Vector2.Lerp(agent.Position, goal, step / (float)steps), other.Position);
                if (distance < clearance && distance <= previous + 1e-6f) return false;
                previous = distance;
            }
            if (previous < clearance) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Systems;

public sealed partial class EvacuationSystem
{
    /// <summary>A bounded observation of the current plume, never a future-arrival prediction.</summary>
    internal readonly record struct NaturalFumeRisk(
        float Start, float Mean, float Peak, float End, float ObservedDistance)
    {
        internal float Severity =>
            (0.60f + 0.15f * ObservedDistance) * Mean + 0.40f * Peak +
            0.50f * End + 0.75f * Math.Max(0f, End - Start);
    }

    private static bool HasActiveNaturalFume(Simulation simulation) =>
        simulation.ScenarioType == ScenarioType.ToxicFume &&
        simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsReleased &&
        simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(simulation);

    /// <summary>
    /// At most five cached concentration lookups. The observation stops at the perception
    /// horizon or an occluding wall. Furniture does not occlude the existing abstract plume.
    /// A straight local sample is a perceived risk cue, not an entire route exposure forecast.
    /// </summary>
    internal NaturalFumeRisk SampleNaturalFumeRisk(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, Vector2 goal)
    {
        if (!UsesNaturalNavigation(simulation) || !HasActiveNaturalFume(simulation)) return default;
        ToxicFumeSystem fume = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem;
        float elapsed = fume.GetElapsedSeconds(simulation);
        float start = fume.GetConcentration(agent.Position, elapsed);
        Vector2 displacement = goal - agent.Position;
        float range = Math.Max(0f, _config.NaturalPerceptionRadiusMeters) *
            Math.Clamp(agent.VisibilityFactor, 0.35f, 1f);
        float length = Math.Min(displacement.Length(), range);
        if (length <= 0.0001f) return new NaturalFumeRisk(start, start, start, start, 0f);
        Vector2 delta = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(displacement) * length;
        // Most local intentions are wholly visible. One ray is enough for that common
        // case; only an occluded intention needs progressive prefix visibility checks.
        bool fullyVisible = simulation.HasLineOfSight(agent.Position, agent.Position + delta);
        float sum = start, peak = start, end = start, observed = 0f;
        int count = 1;
        for (int sample = 1; sample <= 4; sample++)
        {
            float fraction = sample / 4f;
            Vector2 position = agent.Position + delta * fraction;
            if (!fullyVisible && !simulation.HasLineOfSight(agent.Position, position)) break;
            end = fume.GetConcentration(position, elapsed);
            sum += end;
            peak = Math.Max(peak, end);
            observed = length * fraction;
            count++;
        }
        return new NaturalFumeRisk(start, sum / count, peak, end, observed);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Soft preference rather than an impassable gas wall: if all feasible directions are
    /// contaminated, recovery can still select the least costly reachable alternative.
    /// </summary>
    internal float NaturalToxicPathPenalty(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, Vector2 goal)
        => Math.Max(0f, _config.NaturalToxicRiskWeight) * SampleNaturalFumeRisk(simulation, agent, goal).Severity;

    /// <summary>
    /// Abandon a detour only when a newly worsened patch lies ahead. Rising concentration
    /// at the pedestrian's own position must not cancel a still-improving retreat.
    /// </summary>
    internal bool NaturalToxicDetourWorsened(Simulation simulation, Agent agent, Vector2 goal)
    {
        if (!HasActiveNaturalFume(simulation)) return false;
        NaturalFumeRisk risk = SampleNaturalFumeRisk(simulation, agent, goal);
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
        float awareness = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration.AwarenessConcentration;
        const float change = 0.08f;
        return risk.Peak >= awareness &&
            (risk.Peak > Math.Max(risk.Start, memory.DetourToxicPeak) + change ||
             risk.End > Math.Max(risk.Start, memory.DetourToxicEnd) + change);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Staggered local hazard steering while a bounded recovery request waits. An active
    /// recovery goal already has fume scoring/revalidation; never fight it with a second goal.
    /// Existing circle/casualty avoidance and collision resolution run after this direction.
    /// </summary>
    internal Vector2 ApplyNaturalToxicAvoidance(
        Simulation simulation, Agent agent, Vector2 direction, bool exitCapture)
    {
        if (!UsesNaturalNavigation(simulation) || !IsNaturalMover(agent) ||
            !HasActiveNaturalFume(simulation)) return direction;
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
        if (memory.DetourGoal is not null || exitCapture || direction.LengthSquared() < 0.000001f)
        {
            memory.ToxicSteeringActive = false;
            memory.NextToxicSteeringFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
            return direction;
        }
        direction = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(direction);
        if (simulation.FrameIndex < memory.NextToxicSteeringFrame &&
            Vector2.Dot(direction, memory.ToxicSteeringInput) > 0.80f)
            return memory.ToxicSteeringActive ? memory.ToxicSteeringDirection : direction;

        memory.NextToxicSteeringFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(
            _config.NaturalDecisionSeconds + (agent.AgentId % 3) * 0.035f);
        memory.ToxicSteeringInput = direction;
        memory.ToxicSteeringActive = false;
        const float lookAhead = 1.2f;
        NaturalFumeRisk forward = SampleNaturalFumeRisk(simulation, agent, agent.Position + direction * lookAhead);
        float awareness = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration.AwarenessConcentration;
        // Ordinary evacuation already moves us out of a uniformly contaminated patch.
        // Intervene for an observed increase ahead, not merely because gas is present.
        if (forward.Peak < awareness || forward.Peak <= forward.Start + 0.04f) return direction;

        RequestNaturalRecovery(simulation, agent, force: false);
        Vector2 safer = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.GetSaferDirection(simulation, agent.Position);
        if (safer.LengthSquared() < 0.000001f) return direction;
        Vector2 saferGoal = agent.Position + safer * lookAhead;
        if (!simulation.HasTraversablePath(agent.Position, saferGoal, NavigationClearance())) return direction;
        NaturalFumeRisk alternative = SampleNaturalFumeRisk(simulation, agent, saferGoal);
        if (alternative.Severity + 0.03f >= forward.Severity) return direction;
        memory.ToxicSteeringDirection = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(safer);
        memory.ToxicSteeringActive = true;
        return memory.ToxicSteeringDirection;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A progressing agent may still notice that its exit intention is becoming contaminated.
    /// Recheck at a staggered sub-second cadence, require a materially better/cleaner alternative,
    /// and apply a switch cooldown. No per-agent A* or full-grid plume rebuild occurs here.
    /// </summary>
    private void MaybeReselectNaturalToxicExit(Simulation simulation, Agent agent)
    {
        if (!HasActiveNaturalFume(simulation) || agent.ExitTarget is null ||
            simulation.Environment.Exits.Count < 2) return;
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = agent.NavigationMemory;
        if (simulation.FrameIndex < memory.NextToxicExitCheckFrame) return;
        memory.NextToxicExitCheckFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(
            0.60f + (agent.AgentId % 3) * 0.06f);
        if ((simulation.FrameIndex - memory.LastExitChangeFrame) * _config.Dt < 2.0f) return;

        Exit current = agent.ExitTarget;
        Vector2 intendedPoint = memory.DetourGoal ?? agent.CurrentRouteWaypoint ?? current.Position;
        NaturalFumeRisk risk = SampleNaturalFumeRisk(simulation, agent, intendedPoint);
        float awareness = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration.AwarenessConcentration;
        float danger = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration.DangerConcentration;
        if (risk.Peak < awareness) return;
        bool worseningAhead = risk.Peak > risk.Start + 0.06f;
        bool dangerousWithoutImprovement = risk.Start >= danger && risk.End >= risk.Start - 0.04f;
        if (!worseningAhead && !dangerousWithoutImprovement) return;

        float currentExitPenalty = NaturalToxicPathPenalty(simulation, agent, current.Position);
        float currentPenalty = Math.Max(currentExitPenalty,
            Math.Max(0f, _config.NaturalToxicRiskWeight) * risk.Severity);
        float currentCost = NaturalPerceivedExitCost(simulation, agent, current, currentExitPenalty);
        Exit? best = null;
        float bestCost = float.PositiveInfinity;
        foreach (Exit exit in simulation.Environment.Exits)
        {
            if (ReferenceEquals(exit, current)) continue;
            float hazardCost = NaturalToxicPathPenalty(simulation, agent, exit.Position);
            if (hazardCost + 0.25f >= currentPenalty) continue;
            float cost = NaturalPerceivedExitCost(simulation, agent, exit, hazardCost);
            if (memory.RecentlyFailedExit == exit.Name && simulation.FrameIndex < memory.FailedExitUntilFrame)
                cost += 3f; // a hazard can justify revisiting a previously crowded exit
            if (cost >= bestCost) continue;
            bestCost = cost;
            best = exit;
        }
        if (best is null || bestCost > currentCost * _config.ExitSwitchImprovementRatio) return;

        memory.RecentlyFailedExit = current.Name;
        memory.FailedExitUntilFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(_config.NaturalFailureMemorySeconds);
        memory.LastExitChangeFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
        memory.ExitChanges++;
        memory.Stage = NavigationRecoveryStage.ReconsideringExit;
        memory.DetourGoal = null;
        memory.ReplanAfterDetour = false;
        memory.GuidancePoint = null;
        memory.GuidanceKey = null;
        memory.ResetRouteCostObservation();
        memory.NextRouteRequestFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
        memory.NextToxicSteeringFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
        memory.ToxicSteeringActive = false;
        // Invalidate an old queued goal without removing/reordering other agents' work.
        memory.RequestedRouteKey = null;
        agent.ExitTarget = best;
        agent.ExitCommitUntilFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + SecondsToFrames(5f);
        agent.ResetExitCongestion();
        agent.ClearRoute();
        ClearCircleFollow(agent);
        ClearSlowObstacleBypass(agent);
        agent.Exploring = false;
        agent.TempGoal = null;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Core.Systems;

/// <summary>
/// Panic contagion, herding, local navigation, deadlock escape, exit reselection and
/// width-aware exit flow. The patch/guard logic from evacuation_logic.py is kept explicit.
/// </summary>
public sealed partial class EvacuationSystem
{
    public const float SnapRadius = 2.43f;
    public const int ReselectInterval = 15;

    private readonly AgentConfig _config;
    private readonly VisibilityGraphPlanner _routePlanner;
    private readonly Dictionary<Exit, (int Frame, double Credit)> _exitAdmissionCredits = new();
    private readonly List<Agent> _nearbyScratch = new(128);
    private readonly List<Agent> _exitQueryScratch = new(192);
    private readonly List<Agent> _exitCandidatesScratch = new(128);
    private readonly List<Agent> _exitEligibleScratch = new(128);
    private readonly List<Agent> _explorationCrowdScratch = new(64);
    private readonly List<Agent> _bypassScratch = new(32);
    private float[] _panicSnapshot = Array.Empty<float>();
    private bool[] _activeAlarmSnapshot = Array.Empty<bool>();
    private int[] _alarmEpisodeSnapshot = Array.Empty<int>();

    public EvacuationSystem(AgentConfig config)
    {
        _config = config;
        _routePlanner = new VisibilityGraphPlanner(config);
    }

    public static bool LineIntersectsRect(Vector2 p1, Vector2 p2, Wall wall)
    {
        if (wall.OrientedFootprint is OrientedRectangle rotated)
            return rotated.IntersectsSegment(p1, p2);
        // Avoid allocating a four-corner array for every line-of-sight test. This routine sits
        // on several hot perception/routing paths and is called thousands of times per step.
        Vector2 topLeft = new(wall.X1, wall.Y1);
        Vector2 topRight = new(wall.X2, wall.Y1);
        Vector2 bottomRight = new(wall.X2, wall.Y2);
        Vector2 bottomLeft = new(wall.X1, wall.Y2);
        return
            SegmentsIntersect(p1, p2, topLeft, topRight) ||
            SegmentsIntersect(p1, p2, topRight, bottomRight) ||
            SegmentsIntersect(p1, p2, bottomRight, bottomLeft) ||
            SegmentsIntersect(p1, p2, bottomLeft, topLeft);
    }

    public static bool HasLineOfSight(Vector2 agentPosition, Vector2 exitPosition, IReadOnlyList<Wall> walls)
    {
        foreach (Wall wall in walls)
        {
            if (wall.IsFurniture) continue;
            if (LineIntersectsRect(agentPosition, exitPosition, wall))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Return whether a circular pedestrian can translate from start to end without its
    /// body intersecting a wall. Perception intentionally keeps using centre-point LOS;
    /// navigation instead inflates each wall by the required body clearance.
    /// </summary>
    public static bool HasTraversablePath(
        Vector2 start,
        Vector2 end,
        IReadOnlyList<Wall> walls,
        float clearance)
    {
        float margin = Math.Max(0f, clearance);
        foreach (Wall wall in walls)
        {
            if (wall.OrientedFootprint is OrientedRectangle rotated
                ? rotated.IntersectsSegment(start, end, margin)
                : SegmentIntersectsAabb(start, end, wall.X1 - margin, wall.Y1 - margin,
                    wall.X2 + margin, wall.Y2 + margin))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    public void UpdatePanic(Simulation simulation)
    {
        // Snapshot panic before updating anyone so contagion does not depend on agent list order.
        // Arrays replace three per-step dictionaries; AgentId is the stable dense identifier
        // assigned when the scenario population is spawned.
        int snapshotLength = simulation.Agents.Count;
        EnsureSnapshotCapacity(snapshotLength);
        foreach (Agent candidate in simulation.Agents)
        {
            int id = candidate.AgentId;
            _panicSnapshot[id] = candidate.PanicLevel;
            _activeAlarmSnapshot[id] = candidate.IsActiveAlarmSource(simulation.FrameIndex);
            _alarmEpisodeSnapshot[id] = candidate.ActiveAlarmEpisodeId;
        }

        Explosion? explosion = simulation.Environment.Explosion;
        bool toxicFumeActive = simulation.ScenarioType == ScenarioType.ToxicFume &&
            simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsReleased;
        bool emergencyActive = explosion is not null || toxicFumeActive;

        foreach (Agent agent in simulation.Agents)
        {
            if (!agent.IsActive || agent.State is AgentState.Exited or AgentState.Dead or
                AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.TempIncap)
            {
                continue;
            }

            float panicDt = _config.Dt;
            if (simulation.Config.HybridEnabled && agent.State == AgentState.Evacuating &&
                agent.Posture == SeatingPosture.Walking && agent.ShockwaveHitFrame != simulation.FrameIndex &&
                !toxicFumeActive && agent.LocalCongestion < 0.3f)
            {
                if (agent.HybridLastPanicFrame >= 0 && (simulation.FrameIndex + agent.AgentId) % 3 != 0) continue;
            }
            if (simulation.Config.HybridEnabled && agent.HybridLastPanicFrame >= 0)
                panicDt = Math.Max(_config.Dt, (simulation.FrameIndex - agent.HybridLastPanicFrame) * _config.Dt);
            agent.HybridLastPanicFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;

            agent.ExpireAlarmIfNeeded(simulation.FrameIndex);
            agent.VisibilityFactor = simulation.VisibilitySystem.GetVisibilityFactor(simulation, agent.Position);


            float threat = 0f;
            if (explosion is not null &&
                agent.ShockwaveHit &&
                agent.ShockwaveHitFrame >= 0 &&
                !agent.BlastShielded)
            {
                float exposureAgeSeconds = Math.Max(
                    0f,
                    (simulation.FrameIndex - agent.ShockwaveHitFrame) * _config.Dt);
                if (exposureAgeSeconds <= _config.DirectThreatDurationSeconds)
                {
                    float distance = Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, explosion.Position);
                    if (distance <= _config.HeatRadius)
                    {
                        float spatial = MathF.Exp(-distance / Math.Max(_config.PanicThreatScale, 1e-5f));
                        float temporal = MathF.Exp(
                            -exposureAgeSeconds / Math.Max(_config.DirectThreatDecaySeconds, 1e-5f));
                        threat = spatial * temporal;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Toxic-fume threat is a normalized cached concentration lookup. Propagation itself
            // was precomputed during setup, so this adds no live dispersion solver to the hot loop.
            if (toxicFumeActive)
            {
                float concentration = agent.CurrentToxicConcentration;
                float awareness = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration.AwarenessConcentration;
                float toxicThreat = concentration <= awareness
                    ? 0f
                    : Math.Clamp((concentration - awareness) / Math.Max(0.05f, 1f - awareness), 0f, 1f);
                threat = Math.Max(threat, toxicThreat);
            }

            float perceptionRadius = Math.Max(
                _config.RunningContagionRadius,
                _config.EvacuationAwarenessRadius) *
                (0.45f + 0.55f * Math.Clamp(agent.VisibilityFactor, 0f, 1f));
            float socialWeighted = 0f;
            int socialSourceCount = 0;
            Vector2 runnerDirectionWeighted = Vector2.Zero;
            float runnerWeightTotal = 0f;
            float runnerIntensityWeighted = 0f;
            int visibleRunners = 0;
            Vector2 evacueeDirectionWeighted = Vector2.Zero;
            float evacueeWeightTotal = 0f;
            int visibleEvacuees = 0;
            int movingEvacuees = 0;
            int relayEpisodeId = -1;
            float relayEpisodeScore = 0f;

            simulation.CollectNearbyAgents(agent,
                Math.Max(perceptionRadius, _config.LocalCongestionRadius), _nearbyScratch);
            int congestionNeighbours = 0;
            float congestionRadiusSquared = _config.LocalCongestionRadius * _config.LocalCongestionRadius;
            foreach (Agent other in _nearbyScratch)
            {
                float distanceSquared = Vector2.DistanceSquared(agent.Position, other.Position);
                if (other.IsActive && distanceSquared <= congestionRadiusSquared)
                {
                    congestionNeighbours++;
                }
                if (!other.IsActive || other.State is AgentState.Dead or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.TempIncap)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                bool possibleAlarm = _activeAlarmSnapshot[other.AgentId];
                bool possibleAwareness = emergencyActive &&
                    other.State is (AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured);
                if (!possibleAlarm && !possibleAwareness)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float neighbourDistance = MathF.Sqrt(distanceSquared);
                if (neighbourDistance > perceptionRadius ||
                    !simulation.HasLineOfSight(agent.Position, other.Position))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float weight = MathF.Exp(-neighbourDistance / Math.Max(_config.PanicThreatScale, 1e-5f));
                float sourcePanic = Math.Clamp(_panicSnapshot[other.AgentId], 0f, 1f);
                bool activeAlarmSource = _activeAlarmSnapshot[other.AgentId];
                if (activeAlarmSource && sourcePanic >= _config.PanicSocialSignalThreshold)
                {
                    socialWeighted += sourcePanic * weight;
                    socialSourceCount++;
                    float socialEpisodeScore = sourcePanic * weight;
                    int sourceEpisodeId = _alarmEpisodeSnapshot[other.AgentId];
                    if (sourceEpisodeId >= 0 && socialEpisodeScore > relayEpisodeScore)
                    {
                        relayEpisodeScore = socialEpisodeScore;
                        relayEpisodeId = sourceEpisodeId;
                    }
                }

                float speed = other.Velocity.Length();

                // FIX15: coherent evacuation behaviour is a separate awareness cue. A calm
                // green evacuee can help an unaware pedestrian recognise that an emergency
                // response is under way, but this path never creates a panic alarm source.
                if (other.State is AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured)
                {
                    // The semantic state itself is evidence that an evacuation is under way.
                    // Count visible evacuees even if congestion has temporarily slowed them
                    // almost to a stop; use speed only when estimating directional coherence.
                    visibleEvacuees++;
                    // 0.25 was a legacy world-units-per-step floor. Scale it to metres so
                    // coherent calm evacuees are still recognised at the same relative speed.
                    float awarenessSpeedThreshold = Math.Max(
                        0.010f,
                        other.BaseSpeed * _config.EvacuationAwarenessMinSpeedFactor);
                    if (speed >= awarenessSpeedThreshold)
                    {
                        evacueeDirectionWeighted += VectorMath.SafeNormalize(other.Velocity) * weight;
                        evacueeWeightTotal += weight;
                        movingEvacuees++;
                    }
                }

                float runningThreshold = Math.Max(0.014f, other.BaseSpeed * _config.RunningContagionMinSpeedFactor);
                if (!other.CanSignalPanic || !activeAlarmSource || speed < runningThreshold)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float speedExcess = Math.Clamp((speed - runningThreshold) / Math.Max(other.BaseSpeed, 1e-5f), 0f, 1f);
                float panicWeight = 0.35f + 0.65f * Math.Clamp(_panicSnapshot[other.AgentId], 0f, 1f);
                float runnerWeight = weight * panicWeight;
                runnerDirectionWeighted += VectorMath.SafeNormalize(other.Velocity) * runnerWeight;
                runnerIntensityWeighted += speedExcess * runnerWeight;
                runnerWeightTotal += runnerWeight;
                visibleRunners++;

                int runnerEpisodeId = _alarmEpisodeSnapshot[other.AgentId];
                if (runnerEpisodeId >= 0 && runnerWeight > relayEpisodeScore)
                {
                    relayEpisodeScore = runnerWeight;
                    relayEpisodeId = runnerEpisodeId;
                }
            }

            agent.LocalCongestion = Math.Clamp(congestionNeighbours / 10f, 0f, 1f);
            float socialSourceLevel = socialSourceCount > 0
                ? socialWeighted / socialSourceCount
                : 0f;
            // Only finite active-alarm sources enter socialSourceLevel, so using the
            // source level directly restores a visible event-driven contagion wave without
            // allowing low residual panic to self-amplify after every alarm window expires.
            float social = socialSourceLevel;
            float running = 0f;
            if (visibleRunners >= _config.RunningContagionMinVisibleRunners && runnerWeightTotal > 1e-5f)
            {
                float coherence = Math.Clamp(runnerDirectionWeighted.Length() / runnerWeightTotal, 0f, 1f);
                if (coherence >= _config.RunningContagionCoherenceThreshold)
                {
                    float averageIntensity = runnerIntensityWeighted / runnerWeightTotal;
                    float crowdScale = Math.Clamp(visibleRunners / 5f, 0f, 1f);
                    running = Math.Clamp(averageIntensity * coherence * crowdScale, 0f, 1f);
                }
            }

            float evacuationAwareness = 0f;
            if (emergencyActive &&
                visibleEvacuees >= _config.EvacuationAwarenessMinVisibleEvacuees)
            {
                float coherence = movingEvacuees >= _config.EvacuationAwarenessMinVisibleEvacuees &&
                    evacueeWeightTotal > 1e-5f
                        ? Math.Clamp(
                            evacueeDirectionWeighted.Length() / evacueeWeightTotal,
                            0f,
                            1f)
                        : 0f;
                bool coherentFlow = coherence >= _config.EvacuationAwarenessCoherenceThreshold;
                bool obviousCrowdResponse = visibleEvacuees >= _config.EvacuationAwarenessCrowdOverrideCount;
                if (coherentFlow || obviousCrowdResponse)
                {
                    float crowdScale = Math.Clamp(
                        visibleEvacuees / (float)Math.Max(
                            _config.EvacuationAwarenessCrowdOverrideCount,
                            1),
                        0f,
                        1f);
                    float directionalEvidence = coherentFlow ? coherence : 0.35f;
                    evacuationAwareness = Math.Clamp(
                        0.45f * directionalEvidence + 0.55f * crowdScale,
                        0f,
                        1f);
                }
            }

            bool activeAtFrameStart = _activeAlarmSnapshot[agent.AgentId];
            bool relayedAlarmActivated = false;
            if (!activeAtFrameStart &&
                (social >= _config.SocialAlarmActivationStimulus ||
                 running >= _config.RunningAlarmActivationStimulus))
            {
                int relayFrames = Math.Max(
                    1,
                    (int)MathF.Round(_config.RelayedAlarmSignalSeconds / Math.Max(_config.Dt, 1e-5f)));
                relayedAlarmActivated = agent.TryActivateRelayedAlarm(
                    simulation.FrameIndex,
                    relayFrames,
                    _config.RelayedAlarmPanicFloor,
                    relayEpisodeId);

                // FIX14: a genuine finite alarm relay is itself a perception event.
                // Do not require the independently tuned numeric panic threshold to be
                // crossed before a wandering observer begins the startle/reaction
                // sequence. Panic still controls the intensity and SFM speed response,
                // while TryActivateRelayedAlarm preserves one relay per event episode.
                if (relayedAlarmActivated && agent.State == AgentState.Wandering)
                {
                    int freezeUntil = simulation.FrameIndex + RandomFrameRange(
                        simulation.Random,
                        _config.FreezeMinFrames,
                        _config.FreezeMaxFrames);
                    agent.BeginReaction(
                        simulation.FrameIndex,
                        freezeUntil,
                        _config.SocialAlarmReactionDelayScale);
                }
            }

            // Behavioural awareness is intentionally non-emotional. A wandering agent
            // surrounded by a coherent evacuation flow starts the normal reaction sequence,
            // but receives no panic floor and cannot relay a panic episode from this cue alone.
            if (!relayedAlarmActivated &&
                agent.State == AgentState.Wandering &&
                evacuationAwareness > 0f)
            {
                int freezeUntil = simulation.FrameIndex + RandomFrameRange(
                    simulation.Random,
                    _config.FreezeMinFrames,
                    _config.FreezeMaxFrames);
                agent.BeginReaction(
                    simulation.FrameIndex,
                    freezeUntil,
                    _config.EvacuationAwarenessReactionDelayScale);
            }

            // Behaviour-model rebuild: panic is an acute-stress variable, not the master
            // evacuation switch. Decay is time-based so the same scenario remains stable if
            // the fixed timestep changes, while current threat/social cues can still raise it
            // quickly. Low residual panic is not a source because contagion above only samples
            // finite active-alarm windows.
            float susceptibility = Math.Clamp(agent.ThreatSensitivity, 0.60f, 1.40f);
            float persistence =
                _config.Behavior.StressPersistence *
                Math.Clamp(agent.StressRecoveryBias, 0.65f, 1.35f);
            float decayTime = Math.Max(
                _config.Dt,
                _config.PanicDecayTimeConstantSeconds * persistence);
            float decayFactor = MathF.Exp(-panicDt / decayTime);
            float riseTime = Math.Max(
                _config.Dt,
                _config.PanicStimulusRiseSeconds / Math.Clamp(susceptibility, 0.75f, 1.25f));
            float riseAlpha = 1f - MathF.Exp(-panicDt / riseTime);

            // Treat current cues as a bounded acute-stress target rather than adding them to
            // panic every frame. This prevents a group of mutually visible alarmed people from
            // numerically integrating toward 1.0 simply because the same cue persists. Direct
            // exposure can sustain a high target; social/running cues produce moderate targets.
            // Per-agent susceptibility affects all genuine cues, while individual recovery bias
            // affects only how quickly stress settles after those cues disappear.
            float threatTarget = threat > 0f
                ? Math.Clamp(
                    0.35f + 0.65f * threat *
                        susceptibility *
                        Math.Clamp(2f * _config.PanicKThreat, 0f, 2f),
                    0f,
                    1f)
                : 0f;
            float socialTarget = social > 0f
                ? Math.Clamp(
                    (0.20f + _config.PanicKSocial * social) *
                    (0.80f + 0.20f * susceptibility),
                    0f,
                    0.85f)
                : 0f;
            float runningTarget = running > 0f
                ? Math.Clamp(
                    (0.18f + _config.PanicKRunning * running) *
                    (0.80f + 0.20f * susceptibility),
                    0f,
                    0.75f)
                : 0f;
            float stimulusTarget = Math.Max(threatTarget, Math.Max(socialTarget, runningTarget));
            float previousPanic = Math.Clamp(_panicSnapshot[agent.AgentId], 0f, 1f);
            float updatedPanic = stimulusTarget > previousPanic
                ? previousPanic + riseAlpha * (stimulusTarget - previousPanic)
                : stimulusTarget + (previousPanic - stimulusTarget) * decayFactor;
            updatedPanic = Math.Clamp(updatedPanic, 0f, 1f);

            if (agent.IsActiveAlarmSource(simulation.FrameIndex))
            {
                updatedPanic = Math.Max(updatedPanic, agent.ActiveAlarmPanicFloor);
            }

            agent.PanicLevel = updatedPanic;

            agent.LastThreatPanicStimulus = threat;
            agent.LastSocialPanicStimulus = social;
            agent.LastRunningPanicStimulus = running;
            agent.LastEvacuationAwarenessStimulus = evacuationAwareness;

            if (agent.State == AgentState.Wandering && agent.PanicLevel > _config.PanicActivationThreshold)
            {
                int freezeUntil = simulation.FrameIndex + RandomFrameRange(
                    simulation.Random,
                    _config.FreezeMinFrames,
                    _config.FreezeMaxFrames);
                agent.BeginReaction(simulation.FrameIndex, freezeUntil);
            }
        }
    }

    private void EnsureSnapshotCapacity(int required)
    {
        if (_panicSnapshot.Length >= required)
        {
            return;
        }

        int capacity = Math.Max(required, Math.Max(64, _panicSnapshot.Length * 2));
        Array.Resize(ref _panicSnapshot, capacity);
        Array.Resize(ref _activeAlarmSnapshot, capacity);
        Array.Resize(ref _alarmEpisodeSnapshot, capacity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Update the bounded doorway-pressure state. Panic is only one small input: local
    /// density, blocked progress, waiting time, proximity and stable assertiveness determine
    /// whether an agent yields, seeks a lateral gap, or maintains forward pressure.
    /// </summary>
    public void UpdateBottleneckInteraction(
        Simulation simulation,
        Agent agent,
        Exit exit,
        float distanceToExit)
    {
        if (agent.BottleneckLastUpdateFrame == simulation.FrameIndex)
        {
            return;
        }

        agent.BottleneckLastUpdateFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
        bool eligibleState = agent.State is
            AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured or AgentState.Crawling;
        float influenceRadius = Math.Max(
            4f * _config.Radius,
            _config.BottleneckInfluenceRadius);
        if (!eligibleState || !agent.IsActive || distanceToExit > influenceRadius)
        {
            RelaxBottleneckInteraction(agent);
            return;
        }

        int capacity = ExitCapacity(exit);
        int occupancy = DoorwayOccupancy(simulation, exit, agent.AgentId);
        float doorwayLoad = Math.Clamp(occupancy / (float)Math.Max(1, capacity), 0f, 1f);

        float densityRadius = Math.Max(4f * _config.Radius, 0.55f * influenceRadius);
        simulation.CollectNearbyAgents(agent, densityRadius, _nearbyScratch);
        int nearbyCount = 0;
        foreach (Agent other in _nearbyScratch)
        {
            if (other.IsActive && other.State != AgentState.Exited)
            {
                nearbyCount++;
            }
        }
        float density = Math.Clamp(
            nearbyCount / Math.Max(_config.BottleneckDensityReference, 1f),
            0f,
            1f);
        float proximity = Math.Clamp(1f - distanceToExit / influenceRadius, 0f, 1f);

        float desiredSpeed = Math.Max(agent.CurrentDesiredSpeed, 0.004f);
        float speedRatio = Math.Clamp(agent.Velocity.Length() / desiredSpeed, 0f, 1f);
        float blockedProgress = 1f - speedRatio;
        bool congested =
            doorwayLoad >= 0.50f ||
            density >= _config.BottleneckMinimumCongestion ||
            agent.ExitCongestionEpisodeActive;

        if (!congested)
        {
            RelaxBottleneckInteraction(agent);
            return;
        }

        if (blockedProgress >= 0.55f && proximity > 0.05f)
        {
            agent.BottleneckWaitSeconds += _config.Dt;
        }
        else
        {
            agent.BottleneckWaitSeconds = Math.Max(
                0f,
                agent.BottleneckWaitSeconds - 0.75f * _config.Dt);
        }

        float patience = Math.Clamp(agent.PatienceBias, 0.65f, 1.35f);
        float waitReference = Math.Max(
            _config.Dt,
            _config.BottleneckWaitReferenceSeconds * patience);
        float waitSignal = Math.Clamp(agent.BottleneckWaitSeconds / waitReference, 0f, 1f);
        float assertiveness = Math.Clamp(agent.Assertiveness, 0f, 1f);
        float urgencySignal = Math.Clamp(
            0.50f * Math.Clamp(agent.PanicLevel, 0f, 1f) +
            0.50f * Math.Clamp((agent.UrgencyBias - 0.75f) / 0.50f, 0f, 1f),
            0f,
            1f);

        float target =
            0.27f * density +
            0.22f * waitSignal +
            0.18f * doorwayLoad +
            0.12f * proximity +
            0.11f * assertiveness +
            0.06f * urgencySignal +
            0.04f * blockedProgress;
        if (agent.ExitCongestionEpisodeActive)
        {
            target += 0.08f;
        }

        target *= _config.Behavior.BottleneckPressureSensitivity;
        target = Math.Clamp(target, 0f, 1f);
        agent.BottleneckPressureTarget = target;

        float timeConstant = target > agent.BottleneckPressure
            ? _config.BottleneckPressureRiseSeconds
            : _config.BottleneckPressureDecaySeconds;
        float alpha = 1f - MathF.Exp(
            -_config.Dt / Math.Max(_config.Dt, timeConstant));
        agent.BottleneckPressure = Math.Clamp(
            agent.BottleneckPressure + alpha * (target - agent.BottleneckPressure),
            0f,
            1f);

        SelectBottleneckMode(
            simulation,
            agent,
            exit,
            waitSignal,
            assertiveness,
            patience);
    }

    private void RelaxBottleneckInteraction(Agent agent)
    {
        agent.BottleneckWaitSeconds = Math.Max(
            0f,
            agent.BottleneckWaitSeconds - 1.25f * _config.Dt);
        agent.BottleneckPressureTarget = 0f;
        float decay = MathF.Exp(
            -_config.Dt / Math.Max(_config.Dt, _config.BottleneckPressureDecaySeconds));
        agent.BottleneckPressure = Math.Clamp(agent.BottleneckPressure * decay, 0f, 1f);

        // Doorway behaviour is only meaningful while a real bottleneck is present. Drop
        // the committed response immediately when congestion clears while retaining a short
        // pressure decay for diagnostics.
        agent.BottleneckMode = BottleneckResponseMode.Free;
        agent.BottleneckModeUntilFrame = -1;
        agent.BottleneckLateralDirection = Vector2.Zero;
        if (agent.BottleneckPressure <= 0.05f)
        {
            agent.BottleneckPressure = 0f;
        }
    }

    private void SelectBottleneckMode(
        Simulation simulation,
        Agent agent,
        Exit exit,
        float waitSignal,
        float assertiveness,
        float patience)
    {
        bool forceYield = agent.State == AgentState.Crawling;
        if (!forceYield &&
            simulation.FrameIndex < agent.BottleneckModeUntilFrame &&
            agent.BottleneckMode != BottleneckResponseMode.Free)
        {
            return;
        }

        BottleneckResponseMode desiredMode;
        if (forceYield)
        {
            desiredMode = BottleneckResponseMode.Yield;
        }
        else
        {
            float impatience = Math.Clamp((1.35f - patience) / 0.70f, 0f, 1f);
            float pressEligibility =
                0.60f * assertiveness +
                0.25f * impatience +
                0.15f * Math.Clamp(agent.PanicLevel, 0f, 1f) +
                0.15f * waitSignal;
            bool keepPressing =
                agent.BottleneckMode == BottleneckResponseMode.Press &&
                agent.BottleneckPressure >= _config.BottleneckPressReleaseThreshold;
            bool canPress =
                (agent.BottleneckPressure >= _config.BottleneckPressThreshold || keepPressing) &&
                pressEligibility >= 0.55f;

            if (canPress)
            {
                desiredMode = BottleneckResponseMode.Press;
            }
            else if (agent.BottleneckPressure >= _config.BottleneckSeekGapThreshold)
            {
                desiredMode = BottleneckResponseMode.SeekGap;
            }
            else
            {
                desiredMode = BottleneckResponseMode.Yield;
            }
        }

        int commitFrames = Math.Max(
            1,
            (int)MathF.Ceiling(
                _config.BottleneckModeCommitSeconds / Math.Max(_config.Dt, 1e-5f)));
        bool modeChanged = desiredMode != agent.BottleneckMode;
        agent.BottleneckMode = desiredMode;
        agent.BottleneckModeUntilFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + commitFrames;

        if (desiredMode == BottleneckResponseMode.SeekGap)
        {
            agent.BottleneckLateralDirection = ChooseBottleneckGapDirection(
                simulation,
                agent,
                exit);
        }
        else
        {
            agent.BottleneckLateralDirection = Vector2.Zero;
        }

        if (!agent.ExitCongestionEpisodeActive)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (desiredMode == BottleneckResponseMode.Yield || agent.State == AgentState.Crawling)
        {
            agent.ExitYielding = true;
            if (modeChanged || agent.ExitRetryAfterFrame <= simulation.FrameIndex)
            {
                agent.ExitRetryAfterFrame = NextExitRetryFrame(simulation, agent);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            agent.ExitYielding = false;
            agent.ExitRetryAfterFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
        }
    }

    private Vector2 ChooseBottleneckGapDirection(
        Simulation simulation,
        Agent agent,
        Exit exit)
    {
        Vector2 tangent = exit.Side is "N" or "S"
            ? Vector2.UnitX
            : Vector2.UnitY;
        Vector2 forward = VectorMath.SafeNormalize(exit.Position - agent.Position);
        float probeDistance = Math.Max(
            2f * _config.Radius,
            _config.BottleneckGapProbeDistanceFactor * _config.Radius);

        float negativeScore = ScoreBottleneckGapCandidate(
            simulation,
            agent,
            tangent,
            forward,
            -1f,
            probeDistance);
        float positiveScore = ScoreBottleneckGapCandidate(
            simulation,
            agent,
            tangent,
            forward,
            1f,
            probeDistance);

        if (!float.IsFinite(negativeScore) && !float.IsFinite(positiveScore))
        {
            return Vector2.Zero;
        }

        if (MathF.Abs(positiveScore - negativeScore) < 0.01f)
        {
            return (agent.AgentId & 1) == 0 ? tangent : -tangent;
        }

        return positiveScore > negativeScore ? tangent : -tangent;
    }

    private float ScoreBottleneckGapCandidate(
        Simulation simulation,
        Agent agent,
        Vector2 tangent,
        Vector2 forward,
        float sign,
        float probeDistance)
    {
        Vector2 direction = tangent * sign;
        Vector2 candidate =
            agent.Position +
            direction * probeDistance +
            forward * (0.20f * probeDistance);
        float margin = NavigationClearance();
        if (candidate.X <= margin ||
            candidate.Y <= margin ||
            candidate.X >= simulation.Environment.Width - margin ||
            candidate.Y >= simulation.Environment.Height - margin ||
            simulation.Environment.IsPointBlocked(candidate, margin) ||
            !simulation.HasTraversablePath(
                agent.Position,
                candidate,
                margin))
        {
            return float.NegativeInfinity;
        }

        simulation.CollectNearbyAgents(agent, 2.5f * probeDistance, _nearbyScratch);
        int crowdAtCandidate = 0;
        float nearestDistance = 4f * _config.Radius;
        bool foundNearby = false;
        foreach (Agent other in _nearbyScratch)
        {
            if (!other.IsActive)
            {
                continue;
            }

            float candidateDistance = Vector2.Distance(other.Position, candidate);
            if (candidateDistance <= 2.5f * _config.Radius)
            {
                crowdAtCandidate++;
            }

            if (!foundNearby || candidateDistance < nearestDistance)
```
