```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using CrowdSim.OpenGL.Rendering;
using CrowdSim.OpenGL.Recording;
using CrowdSim.OpenGL.UI;
using ImGuiNET;
using Silk.NET.Input;
using Silk.NET.Maths;
using Silk.NET.OpenGL;
using Silk.NET.OpenGL.Extensions.ImGui;
using Silk.NET.Windowing;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL;

/// <summary>
/// Native OpenGL application shell. Silk.NET owns the window/context and Dear ImGui owns both
/// the visible controls and projected 3D draw lists. Physics remain entirely in CrowdSim.Core.
/// </summary>
public sealed class CrowdSimApplication : IDisposable
{
    private readonly IWindow _window;
    private SimulationConfig _config = SimulationConfig.CreateDefault();
    private readonly WorldRenderer _renderer = new();
    private readonly SimulationUi _ui;
    private readonly int? _randomSeed;
    private GL? _gl;
    private IInputContext? _input;
    private ImGuiController? _imgui;
    private Simulation _simulation;
    private double _stepAccumulator;
    private bool _disposed;
    private bool _graphicsDisposed;
    private SimulationVideoRecorder? _videoRecorder;
    private RuntimePerformanceStats _lastPerformanceStats;
    private bool _undoShortcutWasDown;
    private bool _rotateShortcutWasDown;
    private bool _inspectorShortcutWasDown;
    private FinalizedSceneCheckpoint? _replayCheckpoint;

    public CrowdSimApplication(int? randomSeed)
    {
        _randomSeed = randomSeed;
        _simulation = new Simulation(0, _config, randomSeed);
        _ui = new SimulationUi();

        WindowOptions options = WindowOptions.Default;
        options.Title = "Crowd Evacuation Simulation - Explosion / Toxic Fume SFM";
        options.Size = new Vector2D<int>(1600, 900);
        options.VSync = true;
        _window = Window.Create(options);

        _window.Load += OnLoad;
        _window.Render += OnRender;
        _window.FramebufferResize += OnFramebufferResize;
        _window.Closing += OnClosing;
    }

    /// <summary>Run the Silk.NET event loop.</summary>
    public int Run()
    {
        _window.Run();
        return 0;
    }

    private void OnLoad()
    {
        _gl = _window.CreateOpenGL();
        _input = _window.CreateInput();
        ImGuiFontConfig? font = CreateDashboardFont();
        _imgui = font is ImGuiFontConfig configuredFont
            ? new ImGuiController(_gl, _window, _input, configuredFont)
            : new ImGuiController(_gl, _window, _input);
        if (font is null) ImGui.GetIO().FontGlobalScale = 1.2f;

        ImGui.GetIO().ConfigFlags |= ImGuiConfigFlags.NavEnableKeyboard;
        ImGui.StyleColorsDark();
        ConfigureDashboardStyle();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Poll native keyboard state so Ctrl+Z is independent of Dear ImGui focus/key ownership.
    /// The rising-edge latch guarantees one undo per physical key press.
    /// </summary>
    private void HandlePhysicalKeyboardShortcuts()
    {
        if (_input is null)
        {
            _undoShortcutWasDown = false;
            _rotateShortcutWasDown = false;
            _inspectorShortcutWasDown = false;
            return;
        }

        bool ctrlZDown = false;
        bool rotateDown = false;
        bool reverseRotation = false;
        bool inspectorDown = false;
        foreach (IKeyboard keyboard in _input.Keyboards)
        {
            bool ctrlDown =
                keyboard.IsKeyPressed(Key.ControlLeft) ||
                keyboard.IsKeyPressed(Key.ControlRight);

            if (ctrlDown && keyboard.IsKeyPressed(Key.Z)) ctrlZDown = true;
            inspectorDown |= keyboard.IsKeyPressed(Key.F4) && !keyboard.IsKeyPressed(Key.AltLeft) &&
                !keyboard.IsKeyPressed(Key.AltRight);
            bool modifierDown = ctrlDown || keyboard.IsKeyPressed(Key.AltLeft) || keyboard.IsKeyPressed(Key.AltRight);
            if (!modifierDown && keyboard.IsKeyPressed(Key.R))
            {
                rotateDown = true;
                reverseRotation |= keyboard.IsKeyPressed(Key.ShiftLeft) || keyboard.IsKeyPressed(Key.ShiftRight);
            }
        }

        if (ctrlZDown && !_undoShortcutWasDown)
        {
            _ui.TryUndoLastPlacementShortcut(_simulation);
        }

        if (rotateDown && !_rotateShortcutWasDown) _ui.TryRotateSelectedAssetShortcut(_simulation, reverseRotation);
        _rotateShortcutWasDown = rotateDown;
        _undoShortcutWasDown = ctrlZDown;
        if (inspectorDown && !_inspectorShortcutWasDown) _ui.TryToggleInspectorShortcut();
        _inspectorShortcutWasDown = inspectorDown;
    }

    /// <summary>Use the platform's interface font without bundling or downloading font assets.</summary>
    private static ImGuiFontConfig? CreateDashboardFont()
    {
        string fonts = Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.Fonts);
        string[] candidates =
        {
            Path.Combine(fonts, "segoeui.ttf"),
            "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf",
            "/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf",
        };
        foreach (string path in candidates)
            if (File.Exists(path)) return new ImGuiFontConfig(path, 16);
        return null;
    }

    private static void ConfigureDashboardStyle()
    {
        ImGuiStylePtr style = ImGui.GetStyle();
        style.WindowRounding = 6f;
        style.ChildRounding = 6f;
        style.FrameRounding = 4f;
        style.GrabRounding = 4f;
        style.WindowPadding = new Vector2(12f, 12f);
        style.FramePadding = new Vector2(10f, 6f);
        style.ItemSpacing = new Vector2(10f, 8f);
        style.ItemInnerSpacing = new Vector2(6f, 5f);
        style.ScrollbarSize = 16f;
        style.WindowBorderSize = 1f;
        style.ChildBorderSize = 1f;
        style.FrameBorderSize = 1f;
        style.DisabledAlpha = 0.48f;

        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.Text] = new Vector4(0.88f, 0.92f, 0.97f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.TextDisabled] = new Vector4(0.57f, 0.65f, 0.75f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.WindowBg] = new Vector4(0.045f, 0.059f, 0.082f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.ChildBg] = new Vector4(0.065f, 0.082f, 0.110f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.PopupBg] = new Vector4(0.08f, 0.10f, 0.14f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.Border] = new Vector4(0.17f, 0.22f, 0.29f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.FrameBg] = new Vector4(0.09f, 0.11f, 0.14f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.FrameBgHovered] = new Vector4(0.13f, 0.17f, 0.22f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.FrameBgActive] = new Vector4(0.16f, 0.22f, 0.30f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.Button] = new Vector4(0.12f, 0.17f, 0.23f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.ButtonHovered] = new Vector4(0.18f, 0.28f, 0.39f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.ButtonActive] = new Vector4(0.15f, 0.38f, 0.58f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.Header] = new Vector4(0.13f, 0.26f, 0.38f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.HeaderHovered] = new Vector4(0.18f, 0.36f, 0.52f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.HeaderActive] = new Vector4(0.16f, 0.44f, 0.66f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.CheckMark] = new Vector4(0.24f, 0.72f, 1f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.SliderGrab] = new Vector4(0.22f, 0.65f, 0.92f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.SliderGrabActive] = new Vector4(0.32f, 0.78f, 1f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.Separator] = new Vector4(0.17f, 0.22f, 0.29f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.ScrollbarBg] = new Vector4(0.05f, 0.07f, 0.10f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.ScrollbarGrab] = new Vector4(0.22f, 0.29f, 0.38f, 1f);
        style.Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.ScrollbarGrabHovered] = new Vector4(0.28f, 0.37f, 0.48f, 1f);
    }

    private void OnRender(double deltaSeconds)
    {
        if (_gl is null || _imgui is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        long frameStart = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        long allocatedStart = GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread();
        long physicsStart = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        AdvanceSimulation(deltaSeconds);
        double physicsMilliseconds = ElapsedMilliseconds(physicsStart);
        _imgui.Update((float)Math.Max(1e-6, deltaSeconds));

        HandlePhysicalKeyboardShortcuts();

        _gl.ClearColor(0.035f, 0.040f, 0.050f, 1f);
        _gl.Clear((uint)ClearBufferMask.ColorBufferBit);

        Vector2D<int> size = _window.Size;
        bool runningBeforeUi = _simulation.Running;
        _ui.SetPerformanceStats(_lastPerformanceStats);
        long uiStart = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        _ui.Draw(_simulation, _renderer, new Vector2(Math.Max(1, size.X), Math.Max(1, size.Y)));
        double uiMilliseconds = ElapsedMilliseconds(uiStart);

        if (_ui.ConsumeSceneFinalisedRequest())
        {
            try
            {
                _replayCheckpoint = FinalizedSceneCheckpoint.Capture(
                    _simulation,
                    _ui.DesiredAgentCount,
                    _ui.ScenarioName);
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                _replayCheckpoint = null;
                _ui.NotifyScenarioOperationFailed(
                    $"Could not create the replay checkpoint: {exception.Message}");
            }
        }

        string? saveScenarioName = _ui.ConsumeScenarioSaveRequest();
        if (saveScenarioName is not null)
        {
            try
            {
                string safeName = ScenarioFileStore.SanitizeName(saveScenarioName);
                ScenarioDefinition scenario = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(
                    _simulation,
                    _ui.DesiredAgentCount,
                    safeName);
                string path = ScenarioFileStore.Save(scenario);
                _ui.NotifyScenarioSaved(safeName, path);
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                _ui.NotifyScenarioOperationFailed(exception.Message);
            }
        }

        if (_ui.ConsumeStopRecordingRequest())
        {
            StopRecording();
        }

        string? loadScenarioName = _ui.ConsumeScenarioLoadRequest();
        if (loadScenarioName is not null)
        {
            try
            {
                StopRecording();
                ScenarioDefinition scenario = ScenarioFileStore.Load(loadScenarioName);
                SimulationConfig loadedConfig = scenario.CreateConfig();
                Simulation loadedSimulation = new(0, loadedConfig, scenario.RandomSeed);
                scenario.ApplyLayout(loadedSimulation);

                _config = loadedConfig;
                _simulation = loadedSimulation;
                _replayCheckpoint = null;
                _renderer.ResetVisualState();
                _ui.NotifyScenarioLoaded(scenario);
                _stepAccumulator = 0d;
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                _ui.NotifyScenarioOperationFailed(exception.Message);
            }
        }

        if (_ui.ConsumeRestartSimulationRequest())
        {
            try
            {
                StopRecording();
                _replayCheckpoint ??= FinalizedSceneCheckpoint.Capture(
                    _simulation,
                    _ui.DesiredAgentCount,
                    _ui.ScenarioName);
                Simulation restarted = _replayCheckpoint.CreateReadySimulation();

                _config = restarted.Config;
                _simulation = restarted;
                _renderer.ResetVisualState();
                _ui.NotifySimulationRestarted();
                _stepAccumulator = 0d;
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                _ui.NotifyScenarioOperationFailed($"Replay failed: {exception.Message}");
            }
        }

        if (_ui.ConsumeNewScenarioRequest())
        {
            StopRecording();
            _config = SimulationConfig.CreateDefault();
            _simulation = new Simulation(0, _config, _randomSeed);
            _replayCheckpoint = null;
            _renderer.ResetVisualState();
            _ui.ResetForNewScenario();
            _stepAccumulator = 0d;
        }

        bool startedThisFrame = !runningBeforeUi && _simulation.Running;
        bool pausedThisFrame = runningBeforeUi && !_simulation.Running;
        if (startedThisFrame && _ui.RecordNextRun && _videoRecorder is null)
        {
            StartRecording();
        }
        else if (pausedThisFrame && _videoRecorder is not null)
        {
            StopRecording();
        }

        _imgui.Render();

        double recordingMilliseconds = 0d;
        if (_videoRecorder is not null && _simulation.Running)
        {
            long recordingStart = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
            try
            {
                _videoRecorder.Capture(_gl, Math.Max(1, size.X), Math.Max(1, size.Y), deltaSeconds);
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                StopRecording(exception.Message);
            }
            recordingMilliseconds = ElapsedMilliseconds(recordingStart);
        }

        int activeAgents = 0;
        foreach (var agent in _simulation.Agents)
        {
            if (agent.IsActive)
            {
                activeAgents++;
            }
        }

        long allocatedBytes = Math.Max(0L, GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread() - allocatedStart);
        _lastPerformanceStats = new RuntimePerformanceStats(
            FrameMilliseconds: ElapsedMilliseconds(frameStart),
            PhysicsMilliseconds: physicsMilliseconds,
            WorldDrawMilliseconds: _renderer.LastDrawMilliseconds,
            UiMilliseconds: uiMilliseconds,
            RecordingMilliseconds: recordingMilliseconds,
            AllocatedBytes: allocatedBytes,
            VisibleAgents: _renderer.LastVisibleAgentCount,
            ActiveAgents: activeAgents,
            RecordingQueueDepth: _videoRecorder?.QueuedFrames ?? 0,
            RecordingDroppedFrames: _videoRecorder?.DroppedFrames ?? 0);

        if (_ui.ExitRequested)
        {
            _window.Close();
        }
    }

    private void StartRecording()
    {
        try
        {
            string directory = Path.Combine(Environment.CurrentDirectory, "recordings");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
            string scenario = ScenarioFileStore.SanitizeName(_ui.ScenarioName);
            string path = Path.Combine(
                directory,
                $"{scenario}_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.avi");
            _videoRecorder = new SimulationVideoRecorder(path);
            _ui.NotifyRecordingStarted(path);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            _videoRecorder?.Dispose();
            _videoRecorder = null;
            _ui.NotifyRecordingFailed(exception.Message);
        }
    }

    private void StopRecording(string? error = null)
    {
        if (_videoRecorder is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        string path = _videoRecorder.OutputPath;
        try
        {
            _videoRecorder.Dispose();
            if (error is null)
            {
                _ui.NotifyRecordingStopped(path);
            }
            else
            {
                _ui.NotifyRecordingFailed(error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            _ui.NotifyRecordingFailed(exception.Message);
        }
        finally
        {
            _videoRecorder = null;
        }
    }

    private void AdvanceSimulation(double deltaSeconds)
    {
        if (!_simulation.Running)
        {
            _stepAccumulator = 0d;
            return;
        }

        double fixedStep = Math.Max(1e-6, _simulation.Config.Agent.Dt);
        // A stalled frame is not simulation time owed: admitting seconds of wall time here
        // produces a visible jump when rendering resumes. Preserve fixed physics steps.
        _stepAccumulator += Math.Clamp(deltaSeconds, 0d, fixedStep * 2d) * _ui.SimulationSpeed;

        // Protect the UI from a spiral-of-death after a breakpoint or window stall. The physics
        // step is still fixed; this only limits how many catch-up steps may run in one render tick.
        int steps = 0;
        const int maxCatchUpSteps = 8;
        long updateStarted = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        while (_stepAccumulator >= fixedStep && steps < maxCatchUpSteps)
        {
            _simulation.Step();
            _stepAccumulator -= fixedStep;
            steps++;
            if (ElapsedMilliseconds(updateStarted) >= 12d)
            {
                // Yield to rendering/input instead of doing several expensive steps unseen.
                _stepAccumulator = Math.Min(_stepAccumulator, fixedStep);
                break;
            }
        }

        if (steps == maxCatchUpSteps && _stepAccumulator > fixedStep * maxCatchUpSteps)
        {
            _stepAccumulator = fixedStep;
        }
    }

    private static double ElapsedMilliseconds(long startTimestamp)
        => (Stopwatch.GetTimestamp() - startTimestamp) * 1000.0 / Stopwatch.Frequency;

    private void OnFramebufferResize(Vector2D<int> size)
    {
        _gl?.Viewport(size);
    }

    private void OnClosing()
    {
        StopRecording();
        DisposeGraphicsResources();
    }

    private void DisposeGraphicsResources()
    {
        if (_graphicsDisposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _graphicsDisposed = true;
        _imgui?.Dispose();
        _input?.Dispose();
        _gl?.Dispose();
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        StopRecording();
        DisposeGraphicsResources();
        _window.Dispose();
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL;

internal static class Program
{
    public static int Main(string[] args)
    {
        try
        {
            int? seed = null;

            for (int i = 0; i < args.Length; i++)
            {
                switch (args[i])
                {
                    case "--seed" when i + 1 < args.Length && int.TryParse(args[i + 1], out int parsedSeed):
                        seed = parsedSeed;
                        i++;
                        break;
                }
            }

            using CrowdSimApplication application = new(seed);
            return application.Run();
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"[FATAL] {exception}");
            return 1;
        }
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/Recording/SimulationVideoRecorder.cs

```csharp
using System.Buffers;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using SharpAvi.Codecs;
using SharpAvi.Output;
using Silk.NET.OpenGL;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.Recording;

/// <summary>
/// Captures the complete rendered application framebuffer to a fixed-size Motion-JPEG AVI.
/// OpenGL readback stays on the render thread, while scaling and MJPEG encoding run on a bounded
/// worker queue so video recording cannot monopolise the simulation/UI thread.
/// </summary>
public sealed class SimulationVideoRecorder : IDisposable
{
    public const int OutputWidth = 1280;
    public const int OutputHeight = 720;
    public const int FramesPerSecond = 20;

    private readonly AviWriter _writer;
    private readonly IAviVideoStream _videoStream;
    private readonly BlockingCollection<FramePacket> _frameQueue = new(
        new ConcurrentQueue<FramePacket>(),
        boundedCapacity: 3);
    private readonly Task _worker;
    private double _captureAccumulator;
    private bool _firstFrame = true;
    private bool _disposed;
    private int _framesWritten;
    private int _droppedFrames;
    private volatile Exception? _workerException;

    public SimulationVideoRecorder(string outputPath)
    {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(outputPath);
        OutputPath = outputPath;
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(outputPath) ?? ".");

        _writer = new AviWriter(outputPath)
        {
            FramesPerSecond = FramesPerSecond,
            EmitIndex1 = true,
        };
        _videoStream = _writer.AddMJpegImageSharpVideoStream(
            OutputWidth,
            OutputHeight,
            quality: 78);
        _videoStream.Name = "CrowdSim UI recording";
        _worker = Task.Run(EncodeWorkerLoop);
    }

    public string OutputPath { get; }
    public int FramesWritten => Volatile.Read(ref _framesWritten);
    public int DroppedFrames => Volatile.Read(ref _droppedFrames);
    public int QueuedFrames => _frameQueue.Count;

    public unsafe void Capture(GL gl, int sourceWidth, int sourceHeight, double deltaSeconds)
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(SimulationVideoRecorder));
        }
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(gl);
        ThrowIfWorkerFailed();
        if (sourceWidth <= 0 || sourceHeight <= 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        _captureAccumulator += Math.Max(0d, deltaSeconds);
        double interval = 1d / FramesPerSecond;
        if (!_firstFrame && _captureAccumulator < interval)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (_firstFrame)
        {
            _firstFrame = false;
            _captureAccumulator = 0d;
        }
        else
        {
            _captureAccumulator = Math.Max(0d, _captureAccumulator - interval);
        }

        int required = checked(sourceWidth * sourceHeight * 4);
        byte[] sourceFrame = ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Rent(required);
        bool queued = false;
        try
        {
            fixed (byte* destination = sourceFrame)
            {
                gl.ReadPixels(
                    0,
                    0,
                    (uint)sourceWidth,
                    (uint)sourceHeight,
                    PixelFormat.Bgra,
                    PixelType.UnsignedByte,
                    destination);
            }

            queued = _frameQueue.TryAdd(new FramePacket(sourceFrame, sourceWidth, sourceHeight));
            if (!queued)
            {
                Interlocked.Increment(ref _droppedFrames);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            if (!queued)
            {
                ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(sourceFrame);
            }
        }
    }

    private void EncodeWorkerLoop()
    {
        byte[] outputFrame = new byte[OutputWidth * OutputHeight * 4];
        try
        {
            foreach (FramePacket packet in _frameQueue.GetConsumingEnumerable())
            {
                try
                {
                    ScaleAndFlip(packet, outputFrame);
                    _videoStream.WriteFrame(true, outputFrame);
                    Interlocked.Increment(ref _framesWritten);
                }
                finally
                {
                    ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(packet.Buffer);
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            _workerException = exception;
        }
        finally
        {
            while (_frameQueue.TryTake(out FramePacket pending))
            {
                ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(pending.Buffer);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void ScaleAndFlip(FramePacket packet, byte[] outputFrame)
    {
        int sourceWidth = packet.Width;
        int sourceHeight = packet.Height;
        byte[] sourceFrame = packet.Buffer;

        // OpenGL readback is bottom-up. Flip vertically while scaling to the stable
        // recording resolution so window resizing cannot invalidate the AVI stream.
        for (int y = 0; y < OutputHeight; y++)
        {
            int sourceTopY = (int)((long)y * sourceHeight / OutputHeight);
            int sourceY = sourceHeight - 1 - Math.Clamp(sourceTopY, 0, sourceHeight - 1);
            int outputRow = y * OutputWidth * 4;
            int sourceRow = sourceY * sourceWidth * 4;
            for (int x = 0; x < OutputWidth; x++)
            {
                int sourceX = (int)((long)x * sourceWidth / OutputWidth);
                int sourceIndex = sourceRow + Math.Clamp(sourceX, 0, sourceWidth - 1) * 4;
                int outputIndex = outputRow + x * 4;
                outputFrame[outputIndex] = sourceFrame[sourceIndex];
                outputFrame[outputIndex + 1] = sourceFrame[sourceIndex + 1];
                outputFrame[outputIndex + 2] = sourceFrame[sourceIndex + 2];
                outputFrame[outputIndex + 3] = 255;
            }
        }
    }

    private void ThrowIfWorkerFailed()
    {
        Exception? failure = _workerException;
        if (failure is not null)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Video encoder worker failed.", failure);
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        _frameQueue.CompleteAdding();
        try
        {
            _worker.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            ThrowIfWorkerFailed();
        }
        finally
        {
            _writer.Close();
            _frameQueue.Dispose();
        }
    }

    private readonly record struct FramePacket(
        byte[] Buffer,
        int Width,
        int Height);
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/Rendering/Camera3D.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.Rendering;

/// <summary>
/// Camera used by the projected 3D renderer. The default view is an elevated orthographic
/// isometric camera. A selected agent can also be followed from an agent-centred isometric
/// view or observed from a head-height first-person perspective camera.
/// </summary>
public sealed class Camera3D
{
    private const float PovNearPlane = 0.04f;
    private const float PovFieldOfViewDegrees = 72f;

    private Vector3 _forward = new(-0.70f, 0.50f, -0.50f);
    private Vector3 _right = Vector3.UnitX;
    private Vector3 _up = Vector3.UnitZ;
    private Vector3 _target;
    private Vector3 _eye;
    private Vector2 _canvasCenter;
    private Vector2 _canvasSize = Vector2.One;
    private float _cameraCenterX;
    private float _cameraCenterY;
    private float _scale = 1f;
    private float _povFocalPixels = 1f;

    /// <summary>Camera azimuth around the world Z axis, in degrees.</summary>
    public float AzimuthDegrees { get; private set; } = -35f;

    /// <summary>Camera elevation above the ground plane, in degrees.</summary>
    public float ElevationDegrees { get; private set; } = 34f;

    /// <summary>Orthographic zoom multiplier.</summary>
    public float Zoom { get; private set; } = 1f;

    /// <summary>True while the camera is configured as the selected agent's first-person view.</summary>
    public bool IsPov { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Set azimuth while keeping a practical three-dimensional viewing range.</summary>
    public void SetAzimuth(float degrees) => AzimuthDegrees = Math.Clamp(degrees, -180f, 180f);

    /// <summary>Set elevation while preventing a near-horizontal or top-down singular view.</summary>
    public void SetElevation(float degrees) => ElevationDegrees = Math.Clamp(degrees, 18f, 70f);

    /// <summary>Set the orthographic zoom multiplier.</summary>
    public void SetZoom(float zoom) => Zoom = Math.Clamp(zoom, 0.45f, 2.5f);

    /// <summary>Adjust zoom from the mouse wheel when the world canvas is hovered.</summary>
    public void AdjustZoom(float wheelDelta)
    {
        if (!IsPov)
        {
            SetZoom(Zoom * MathF.Exp(wheelDelta * 0.10f));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Restore the validated default 3D presentation camera.</summary>
    public void Reset()
    {
        AzimuthDegrees = -35f;
        ElevationDegrees = 34f;
        Zoom = 1f;
        IsPov = false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Configure the standard elevated 3D view. When <paramref name="focusWorld"/> is supplied,
    /// the selected agent is kept near the centre of the canvas while retaining the same
    /// isometric orientation.
    /// </summary>
    public void Configure(
        Vector2 canvasMin,
        Vector2 canvasMax,
        float worldWidth,
        float worldHeight,
        float maximumHeight,
        Vector2? focusWorld = null)
    {
        IsPov = false;
        _canvasSize = Vector2.Max(canvasMax - canvasMin, new Vector2(1f));
        _canvasCenter = (canvasMin + canvasMax) * 0.5f;

        Vector2 groundTarget = focusWorld ?? new Vector2(worldWidth * 0.5f, worldHeight * 0.5f);
        float targetHeight = focusWorld is null ? maximumHeight * 0.25f : 0f;
        _target = new Vector3(groundTarget.X, groundTarget.Y, targetHeight);

        float azimuth = DegreesToRadians(AzimuthDegrees);
        float elevation = DegreesToRadians(ElevationDegrees);

        // Vector from the target towards the camera.
        Vector3 cameraDirection = Vector3.Normalize(new Vector3(
            MathF.Cos(elevation) * MathF.Cos(azimuth),
            MathF.Cos(elevation) * MathF.Sin(azimuth),
            MathF.Sin(elevation)));

        _forward = -cameraDirection;
        _right = Vector3.Normalize(Vector3.Cross(_forward, Vector3.UnitZ));
        _up = Vector3.Normalize(Vector3.Cross(_right, _forward));

        float marginX = Math.Max(0.80f, worldWidth * 0.035f);
        float marginY = Math.Max(0.80f, worldHeight * 0.035f);
        float minX = -marginX;
        float maxX = worldWidth + marginX;
        float minY = -marginY;
        float maxY = worldHeight + marginY;
        float minZ = 0f;
        float maxZ = maximumHeight;

        float minCameraX = float.PositiveInfinity;
        float maxCameraX = float.NegativeInfinity;
        float minCameraY = float.PositiveInfinity;
        float maxCameraY = float.NegativeInfinity;

        // Evaluate the eight AABB corners without allocating temporary arrays every frame.
        for (int xi = 0; xi < 2; xi++)
        {
            float x = xi == 0 ? minX : maxX;
            for (int yi = 0; yi < 2; yi++)
            {
                float y = yi == 0 ? minY : maxY;
                for (int zi = 0; zi < 2; zi++)
                {
                    float z = zi == 0 ? minZ : maxZ;
                    Vector3 relative = new Vector3(x, y, z) - _target;
                    float cameraX = Vector3.Dot(relative, _right);
                    float cameraY = Vector3.Dot(relative, _up);
                    minCameraX = Math.Min(minCameraX, cameraX);
                    maxCameraX = Math.Max(maxCameraX, cameraX);
                    minCameraY = Math.Min(minCameraY, cameraY);
                    maxCameraY = Math.Max(maxCameraY, cameraY);
                }
            }
        }

        if (focusWorld is null)
        {
            _cameraCenterX = (minCameraX + maxCameraX) * 0.5f;
            _cameraCenterY = (minCameraY + maxCameraY) * 0.5f;
        }
        else
        {
            // Because _target is the followed agent, zero camera-space X/Y centres that agent.
            _cameraCenterX = 0f;
            _cameraCenterY = 0f;
        }

        float projectedWidth = Math.Max(0.001f, maxCameraX - minCameraX);
        float projectedHeight = Math.Max(0.001f, maxCameraY - minCameraY);
        const float paddingFraction = 0.90f;
        float followMultiplier = focusWorld is null ? 1f : 1.35f;
        _scale = paddingFraction * Math.Min(
            _canvasSize.X / projectedWidth,
            _canvasSize.Y / projectedHeight) * Zoom * followMultiplier;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Configure a head-height first-person camera that follows one agent's movement heading.
    /// </summary>
    public void ConfigurePov(
        Vector2 canvasMin,
        Vector2 canvasMax,
        Vector2 agentPosition,
        Vector2 heading,
        float eyeHeight)
    {
        IsPov = true;
        _canvasSize = Vector2.Max(canvasMax - canvasMin, new Vector2(1f));
        _canvasCenter = (canvasMin + canvasMax) * 0.5f;

        Vector2 groundDirection = heading.LengthSquared() > 1e-6f
            ? Vector2.Normalize(heading)
            : Vector2.UnitX;

        _eye = new Vector3(agentPosition.X, agentPosition.Y, Math.Max(0.10f, eyeHeight));

        // A slight downward pitch keeps nearby floor geometry visible without turning the
        // camera into a third-person view.
        _forward = Vector3.Normalize(new Vector3(groundDirection.X, groundDirection.Y, -0.055f));
        _right = Vector3.Normalize(Vector3.Cross(_forward, Vector3.UnitZ));
        if (_right.LengthSquared() < 1e-6f)
        {
            _right = Vector3.UnitX;
        }

        _up = Vector3.Normalize(Vector3.Cross(_right, _forward));
        float fovRadians = DegreesToRadians(PovFieldOfViewDegrees);
        _povFocalPixels = (_canvasSize.Y * 0.5f) / MathF.Tan(fovRadians * 0.5f);
    }

    /// <summary>Project one world-space 3D point into ImGui screen coordinates.</summary>
    public Vector2 Project(Vector3 world)
    {
        if (TryProject(world, out Vector2 screen))
        {
            return screen;
        }

        // Keep invalid/behind-camera geometry safely outside the clip rectangle.
        return new Vector2(-100_000f, -100_000f);
    }

    /// <summary>Try to project a world point. POV points behind the near plane are rejected.</summary>
    public bool TryProject(Vector3 world, out Vector2 screen)
    {
        if (!IsPov)
        {
            Vector3 relative = world - _target;
            float orthoCameraX = Vector3.Dot(relative, _right);
            float orthoCameraY = Vector3.Dot(relative, _up);
            screen = new Vector2(
                _canvasCenter.X + (orthoCameraX - _cameraCenterX) * _scale,
                _canvasCenter.Y - (orthoCameraY - _cameraCenterY) * _scale);
            return float.IsFinite(screen.X) && float.IsFinite(screen.Y);
        }

        Vector3 povRelative = world - _eye;
        float depth = Vector3.Dot(povRelative, _forward);
        if (!float.IsFinite(depth) || depth <= PovNearPlane)
        {
            screen = default;
            return false;
        }

        float cameraX = Vector3.Dot(povRelative, _right);
        float cameraY = Vector3.Dot(povRelative, _up);
        screen = new Vector2(
            _canvasCenter.X + cameraX / depth * _povFocalPixels,
            _canvasCenter.Y - cameraY / depth * _povFocalPixels);
        return float.IsFinite(screen.X) && float.IsFinite(screen.Y);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Project a line segment, clipping it against the POV near plane when necessary.
    /// </summary>
    public bool TryProjectSegment(Vector3 a, Vector3 b, out Vector2 screenA, out Vector2 screenB)
    {
        if (!IsPov)
        {
            bool projectedA = TryProject(a, out screenA);
            bool projectedB = TryProject(b, out screenB);
            return projectedA && projectedB;
        }

        float depthA = Vector3.Dot(a - _eye, _forward);
        float depthB = Vector3.Dot(b - _eye, _forward);
        if (depthA <= PovNearPlane && depthB <= PovNearPlane)
        {
            screenA = default;
            screenB = default;
            return false;
        }

        if (depthA <= PovNearPlane)
        {
            float t = (PovNearPlane + 0.01f - depthA) / Math.Max(1e-6f, depthB - depthA);
            a = Vector3.Lerp(a, b, Math.Clamp(t, 0f, 1f));
        }
        else if (depthB <= PovNearPlane)
        {
            float t = (PovNearPlane + 0.01f - depthB) / Math.Max(1e-6f, depthA - depthB);
            b = Vector3.Lerp(b, a, Math.Clamp(t, 0f, 1f));
        }

        bool clippedProjectedA = TryProject(a, out screenA);
        bool clippedProjectedB = TryProject(b, out screenB);
        return clippedProjectedA && clippedProjectedB;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Return camera depth. Larger values are farther from the eye and therefore should be
    /// painted first by the renderer's painter ordering.
    /// </summary>
    public float Depth(Vector3 world)
        => IsPov
            ? Vector3.Dot(world - _eye, _forward)
            : Vector3.Dot(world - _target, _forward);

    /// <summary>Project a screen position onto the simulation's Z=0 ground plane.</summary>
    public bool TryScreenToGround(Vector2 screen, out Vector2 ground)
    {
        ground = default;
        if (IsPov || _scale <= 0.0001f || MathF.Abs(_forward.Z) <= 0.0001f)
        {
            return false;
        }

        float cameraX = _cameraCenterX + (screen.X - _canvasCenter.X) / _scale;
        float cameraY = _cameraCenterY - (screen.Y - _canvasCenter.Y) / _scale;
        Vector3 planePoint = _target + _right * cameraX + _up * cameraY;
        float t = -planePoint.Z / _forward.Z;
        Vector3 worldPoint = planePoint + _forward * t;

        if (!float.IsFinite(worldPoint.X) || !float.IsFinite(worldPoint.Y))
        {
            return false;
        }

        ground = new Vector2(worldPoint.X, worldPoint.Y);
        return true;
    }

    private static float DegreesToRadians(float degrees) => degrees * MathF.PI / 180f;
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/Rendering/WorldRenderer.AgentOutlines.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using ImGuiNET;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.Rendering;

public sealed partial class WorldRenderer
{
    private const float AgentOutlineWidth = 1.1f;
    private const uint AgentOutlineColor = 0xFF000000u; // opaque black; no native call during type initialisation
    private bool _outlineAgentGeometry;

    /// <summary>
    /// Outline the convex screen silhouette of one body-part prism using its already projected
    /// eight corners. Stack storage only; no second camera projection, mesh pass or frame buffer.
    /// Subsequent body parts retain normal occlusion/painter order.
    /// </summary>
    private static void DrawProjectedBodyOutline(ImDrawListPtr draw,
        ReadOnlySpan<Vector2> projected, ReadOnlySpan<bool> visible)
    {
        Span<Vector2> points = stackalloc Vector2[8];
        int n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < projected.Length; i++)
        {
            // Match the renderer's existing near-plane handling rather than connect a
            // silhouette across unprojectable corners in first-person view.
            if (!visible[i] || !float.IsFinite(projected[i].X) || !float.IsFinite(projected[i].Y)) return;
            Vector2 p = projected[i];
            int j = n - 1;
            while (j >= 0 && (points[j].X > p.X || (points[j].X == p.X && points[j].Y > p.Y)))
            {
                points[j + 1] = points[j];
                j--;
            }
            points[j + 1] = p;
            n++;
        }
        if (n < 3) return;
        Span<Vector2> hull = stackalloc Vector2[16];
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            while (count >= 2 && OutlineCross(hull[count - 2], hull[count - 1], points[i]) <= 0f) count--;
            hull[count++] = points[i];
        }
        int lower = count + 1;
        for (int i = n - 2; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            while (count >= lower && OutlineCross(hull[count - 2], hull[count - 1], points[i]) <= 0f) count--;
            hull[count++] = points[i];
        }
        count--; // the closing corner duplicates hull[0]
        if (count < 3) return;
        // One native submission per body-part outline, rather than one per edge.
        draw.AddPolyline(ref hull[0], count, AgentOutlineColor, ImDrawFlags.Closed, AgentOutlineWidth);
    }

    private static float OutlineCross(Vector2 origin, Vector2 a, Vector2 b) =>
        (a.X - origin.X) * (b.Y - origin.Y) - (a.Y - origin.Y) * (b.X - origin.X);
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/Rendering/WorldRenderer.Barricades.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using ImGuiNET;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.Rendering;

public sealed partial class WorldRenderer
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Lightweight orange road-barrier silhouette with a broad base, tapered body and
    /// white reflector panels. Uses the shared painter renderer in overview and POV.
    /// Its conservative collision footprint is exactly the 1.5 x 0.4 metre base.
    /// </summary>
    private void DrawBarricade(ImDrawListPtr draw, FurnitureSet set, Vector4 color)
    {
        const float halfLength = FurnitureSet.BarricadeLength * 0.5f;
        const float halfWidth = FurnitureSet.BarricadeWidth * 0.5f;
        const float baseHeight = 0.16f;
        const float topHalfWidth = 0.10f;
        const float topHalfLength = halfLength - 0.04f;
        const float height = FurnitureSet.BarricadeHeight;
        DrawOrientedPrism(draw, set.Center, -halfLength, halfLength, -halfWidth, halfWidth,
            0f, baseHeight, set.Rotation, Shade(color, 0.88f));

        Span<Vector3> vertices = stackalloc Vector3[8]
        {
            LocalPoint(set.Center, set.Rotation, -halfLength, -halfWidth, baseHeight),
            LocalPoint(set.Center, set.Rotation, halfLength, -halfWidth, baseHeight),
            LocalPoint(set.Center, set.Rotation, halfLength, halfWidth, baseHeight),
            LocalPoint(set.Center, set.Rotation, -halfLength, halfWidth, baseHeight),
            LocalPoint(set.Center, set.Rotation, -topHalfLength, -topHalfWidth, height),
            LocalPoint(set.Center, set.Rotation, topHalfLength, -topHalfWidth, height),
            LocalPoint(set.Center, set.Rotation, topHalfLength, topHalfWidth, height),
            LocalPoint(set.Center, set.Rotation, -topHalfLength, topHalfWidth, height),
        };
        Span<int> order = stackalloc int[5];
        Span<float> depth = stackalloc float[6];
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
        {
            int face = i == 4 ? 5 : i; // Four sides plus the top; no hidden bottom.
            int k = face * 4;
            Vector3 center = (vertices[PrismCorners[k]] + vertices[PrismCorners[k + 1]] +
                vertices[PrismCorners[k + 2]] + vertices[PrismCorners[k + 3]]) * 0.25f;
            depth[face] = _camera.Depth(center);
            int j = i - 1;
            while (j >= 0 && depth[order[j]] < depth[face])
            {
                order[j + 1] = order[j];
                j--;
            }
            order[j + 1] = face;
        }
        foreach (int face in order)
        {
            int k = face * 4;
            Vector3 a = vertices[PrismCorners[k]], b = vertices[PrismCorners[k + 1]];
            Vector3 c = vertices[PrismCorners[k + 2]], d = vertices[PrismCorners[k + 3]];
            DrawFlatQuad(draw, a, b, c, d, Color(Shade(color, OrientedShades[face])));
            if (face is not (0 or 2)) continue;
            // Paint reflectors WITH their face, not over the completed object. Nearer
            // faces then hide far-side reflectors rather than showing them through it.
            uint white = Color(new Vector4(0.97f, 0.97f, 0.92f, color.W));
            for (int panel = 0; panel < 2; panel++)
            {
                float u0 = 0.14f + panel * 0.43f, u1 = u0 + 0.29f;
                Vector3 lowA = Vector3.Lerp(a, d, 0.58f), lowB = Vector3.Lerp(b, c, 0.58f);
                Vector3 highA = Vector3.Lerp(a, d, 0.81f), highB = Vector3.Lerp(b, c, 0.81f);
                DrawFlatQuad(draw, Vector3.Lerp(lowA, lowB, u0), Vector3.Lerp(lowA, lowB, u1),
                    Vector3.Lerp(highA, highB, u1), Vector3.Lerp(highA, highB, u0), white);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/Rendering/WorldRenderer.FixedAssets.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using ImGuiNET;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.Rendering;

public sealed partial class WorldRenderer
{
    // Built once per geometry change, not once per agent or frame.
    private readonly List<(FurnitureSet Set, Wall Bounds)> _cachedFixedFurnitureChunks = new(24);

    private void CacheFixedFurnitureChunks(Simulation simulation)
    {
        foreach (FurnitureSet set in simulation.Environment.Furniture)
        {
            if (set.StaticObstacle is not Wall rectangle) continue;
            if (set.Kind == FurnitureKind.Barricade)
            {
                // One static entity/footprint, no per-agent work or physics body.
                _cachedFixedFurnitureChunks.Add((set, rectangle));
                continue;
            }
            if (set.Kind != FurnitureKind.Stage) continue;

            // A 15 m stage must not be painter-sorted as one giant centre point: small
            // cached pieces interleave correctly with people beside its front/side edges.
            int nx = Math.Max(1, (int)MathF.Ceiling((rectangle.X2 - rectangle.X1) / 2f));
            int ny = Math.Max(1, (int)MathF.Ceiling((rectangle.Y2 - rectangle.Y1) / 2f));
            for (int y = 0; y < ny; y++)
            for (int x = 0; x < nx; x++)
            {
                float x1 = rectangle.X1 + (rectangle.X2 - rectangle.X1) * x / nx;
                float x2 = rectangle.X1 + (rectangle.X2 - rectangle.X1) * (x + 1) / nx;
                float y1 = rectangle.Y1 + (rectangle.Y2 - rectangle.Y1) * y / ny;
                float y2 = rectangle.Y1 + (rectangle.Y2 - rectangle.Y1) * (y + 1) / ny;
                _cachedFixedFurnitureChunks.Add((set, new Wall(x1, y1, x2, y2)));
            }
        }
    }

    private static Vector4 FixedFurnitureColor(FurnitureKind kind) => kind switch
    {
        FurnitureKind.Stage => new Vector4(0.29f, 0.31f, 0.34f, 1f),
        FurnitureKind.Barricade => new Vector4(1.00f, 0.32f, 0.035f, 1f),
        _ => new Vector4(0.60f, 0.39f, 0.23f, 1f),
    };

    private void DrawFixedFurniture(ImDrawListPtr draw, FurnitureSet set, Wall bounds, Vector4 color)
    {
        if (set.Kind == FurnitureKind.Barricade)
        {
            DrawBarricade(draw, set, color);
            return;
        }
        if (set.Kind == FurnitureKind.Stage)
        {
            DrawAxisAlignedPrism(draw, bounds.X1, bounds.X2, bounds.Y1, bounds.Y2,
                0f, FurnitureSet.StageHeight, color);
            return;
        }

        if (set.Table is not RectangularFurnitureBody table || table.State == ChairState.Destroyed) return;
        Vector2 center = table.Position;
        float height = table.Height;
        float heading = table.Heading;
        const float halfLength = FurnitureSet.RectangularTableLength * 0.5f;
        const float halfWidth = FurnitureSet.RectangularTableWidth * 0.5f;
        const float top = FurnitureSet.RectangularTableHeight;
        const float thickness = 0.06f;
        if (table.State is ChairState.Airborne or ChairState.Fallen)
        {
            // Same lightweight toppled-table approximation used by existing round tables.
            DrawOrientedPrism(draw, center, -halfLength, halfLength, -halfWidth, halfWidth,
                height + 0.02f, height + 0.18f, heading, color);
            return;
        }
        // Four legs and one top; no chairs or placeholder people.
        for (int x = -1; x <= 1; x += 2)
        for (int y = -1; y <= 1; y += 2)
        {
            float forward = x * (halfLength - 0.10f);
            float side = y * (halfWidth - 0.10f);
            DrawOrientedPrism(draw, center, forward - 0.045f, forward + 0.045f,
                side - 0.045f, side + 0.045f, height, height + top - thickness, heading, Shade(color, 0.66f));
        }
        DrawOrientedPrism(draw, center, -halfLength, halfLength, -halfWidth, halfWidth,
            height + top - thickness, height + top, heading, color);
    }

    private void DrawFurnitureFootprint(ImDrawListPtr draw, Wall bounds, Vector4 color)
    {
        Span<Vector2> corners = stackalloc Vector2[4];
        bounds.CopyExpandedCorners(corners, 0f);
        Vector3 a = new(corners[0], 0.025f);
        Vector3 b = new(corners[1], 0.025f);
        Vector3 c = new(corners[2], 0.025f);
        Vector3 d = new(corners[3], 0.025f);
        uint outline = Color(new Vector4(color.X, color.Y, color.Z, 1f));
        DrawWorldLine(draw, a, b, outline, 2f);
        DrawWorldLine(draw, b, c, outline, 2f);
        DrawWorldLine(draw, c, d, outline, 2f);
        DrawWorldLine(draw, d, a, outline, 2f);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using ImGuiNET;
namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.Rendering;

public sealed partial class WorldRenderer
{
    private readonly Dictionary<CircleBlockage, object> _furnitureVisuals = new();

    private void IndexFurniture(Simulation simulation)
    {
        _furnitureVisuals.Clear();
        foreach (FurnitureSet set in simulation.Environment.Furniture)
        {
            if (set.TableObstacle is not null) _furnitureVisuals[set.TableObstacle] = set;
            foreach (FurnitureChair chair in set.Chairs)
                if (chair.Obstacle is not null) _furnitureVisuals[chair.Obstacle] = chair;
        }
    }

    private void DrawFurnitureProxy(ImDrawListPtr draw, Simulation simulation, CircleBlockage proxy)
    {
        if (!_furnitureVisuals.TryGetValue(proxy, out object? item)) return;
        if (item is FurnitureSet set)
            DrawTable(draw, set.Table!, new Vector4(0.56f, 0.36f, 0.20f, 1f));
        else if (item is FurnitureChair chair)
        {
            DrawChair(draw, chair, new Vector4(0.32f, 0.42f, 0.52f, 1f));
            if (simulation.Agents.Count == 0)
                DrawSeatedPerson(draw, chair.StartPosition, chair.Heading, new Vector4(0.65f, 0.85f, 0.90f, 0.9f), 0f);
        }
    }

    private void DrawTable(ImDrawListPtr draw, FurnitureBody table, Vector4 color)
    {
        float height = table.Height;
        bool tipped = table.State is ChairState.Airborne or ChairState.Fallen;
        float top = height + (tipped ? 0.12f : 0.72f);
        DrawOrientedPrism(draw, table.Position, -0.13f, 0.13f, -0.13f, 0.13f, height, tipped ? height + 0.12f : top, table.Heading, Shade(color, 0.7f));
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++)
        {
            float a = MathF.Tau * i / 40, b = MathF.Tau * (i + 1) / 40;
            Vector2 p = table.Position + new Vector2(MathF.Cos(a), MathF.Sin(a)) * table.Radius;
            Vector2 q = table.Position + new Vector2(MathF.Cos(b), MathF.Sin(b)) * table.Radius;
            DrawFlatQuad(draw, new Vector3(p, top), new Vector3(q, top), new Vector3(q, top + 0.06f), new Vector3(p, top + 0.06f), Color(Shade(color, 0.75f)));
            if (_camera.TryProject(new Vector3(table.Position, top + 0.06f), out Vector2 c) &&
                _camera.TryProject(new Vector3(p, top + 0.06f), out Vector2 ps) && _camera.TryProject(new Vector3(q, top + 0.06f), out Vector2 qs))
                draw.AddTriangleFilled(c, ps, qs, Color(color));
        }
    }

    private void DrawChair(ImDrawListPtr draw, FurnitureChair chair, Vector4 color)
    {
        if (chair.State == ChairState.Destroyed) return;
        float h = chair.Height;
        bool tipped = chair.State is ChairState.Fallen or ChairState.Airborne;
        if (tipped)
        {
            DrawOrientedPrism(draw, chair.Position, -0.35f, 0.35f, -0.24f, 0.24f, h + 0.04f, h + 0.13f, chair.Heading, color);
            DrawOrientedPrism(draw, chair.Position, -0.35f, -0.26f, -0.24f, 0.24f, h + 0.10f, h + 0.50f, chair.Heading, color);
            return;
        }
        foreach (float forward in new[] { -0.20f, 0.20f })
            foreach (float side in new[] { -0.20f, 0.20f })
                DrawOrientedPrism(draw, chair.Position, forward - 0.025f, forward + 0.025f, side - 0.025f, side + 0.025f, 0f, 0.44f, chair.Heading, Shade(color, 0.7f));
        DrawOrientedPrism(draw, chair.Position, -0.24f, 0.24f, -0.24f, 0.24f, 0.43f, 0.49f, chair.Heading, color);
        DrawOrientedPrism(draw, chair.Position, -0.25f, -0.19f, -0.24f, 0.24f, 0.49f, 0.94f, chair.Heading, color);
    }

    private void DrawSeatedPerson(ImDrawListPtr draw, Vector2 position, float heading, Vector4 color, float rise)
    {
        // Builder seat previews do not pass through DrawAgent, but need the same contrast.
        bool previous = _outlineAgentGeometry;
        _outlineAgentGeometry = true;
        try { DrawSeatedPersonGeometry(draw, position, heading, color, rise); }
        finally { _outlineAgentGeometry = previous; }
    }

    private void DrawSeatedPersonGeometry(ImDrawListPtr draw, Vector2 position, float heading, Vector4 color, float rise)
    {
        float hip = 0.49f + 0.40f * rise;
        Vector4 limb = Shade(color, 0.78f);
        DrawOrientedPrism(draw, position, -0.12f, 0.13f, -0.19f, 0.19f, hip, hip + 0.48f, heading, color);
        DrawOrientedPrism(draw, position, -0.10f, 0.14f, -0.12f, 0.12f, hip + 0.50f, hip + 0.75f, heading, Shade(color, 1.1f));
        foreach (float side in new[] { -0.12f, 0.12f })
        {
            float knee = 0.38f * (1f - rise);
            DrawOrientedPrism(draw, position, -0.08f, knee + 0.10f, side - 0.075f, side + 0.075f, hip - 0.12f, hip, heading, limb);
            DrawOrientedPrism(draw, position, knee - 0.06f, knee + 0.08f, side - 0.07f, side + 0.07f, 0.04f, hip - 0.10f, heading, limb);
            DrawOrientedPrism(draw, position, -0.05f, 0.13f, side * 1.9f - 0.06f, side * 1.9f + 0.06f, hip + 0.04f, hip + 0.42f, heading, limb);
        }
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/Rendering/WorldRenderer.cs

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;
using CrowdSim.OpenGL.UI;
using ImGuiNET;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.Rendering;

/// <summary>
/// 3D isometric crowd renderer. Simulation physics stay on the 2D ground plane, but the world is
/// rendered as projected 3D geometry: raised walls, debris and simple humanoids with separate head,
/// torso, arms and legs. Dear ImGui submits the projected primitives through Silk.NET's OpenGL
/// backend, avoiding a second custom matrix/render pipeline.
/// </summary>
public sealed partial class WorldRenderer
{
    private const float WallHeight = 1.82f;
    private const float HumanoidHeight = 1.70f;
    private const float HumanoidWidth = 0.48f;
    private static readonly Vector4 FloorColor = new(0.80f, 0.80f, 0.80f, 1f);

    // The original baseline used a 42-world-unit-tall humanoid. Render-only overlays that
    // were authored in those legacy world units must be scaled to metres as well; otherwise
    // panic rings and debug vectors become ~25x too large after the metric conversion.
    private const float LegacyRenderUnitMeters = HumanoidHeight / 42f;
    private const float MinimumAnimationBaseSpeedMetersPerStep = 0.25f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float StandingMotionThresholdMetersPerStep = 0.08f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float CrawlMotionStartMetersPerStep = 0.03f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float CrawlMotionFullMetersPerStep = 0.20f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float HeadingMotionThresholdSquared =
        1e-5f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float PanicRingMaxExpansionMeters = 5f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float DesiredVectorLengthMeters = 32f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float AvoidanceVectorLengthMeters = 30f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float HerdVectorLengthMeters = 28f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float BlastVectorLengthMeters = 26f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private const float SfmVectorMaxLengthMeters = 45f * LegacyRenderUnitMeters;
    private readonly Camera3D _camera = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<int, Vector2> _renderPositions = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<int, Agent> _agentById = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<int, Queue<Vector2>> _trails = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<int, float> _gaitPhases = new();
    private readonly HashSet<int> _activeAgentIds = new();
    private readonly HashSet<int> _visibleAgentIds = new();
    private readonly List<int> _staleAgentIds = new();
    private readonly List<RenderEntity> _renderEntities = new(768);
    private readonly List<CachedWallChunk> _cachedWallChunks = new(128);
    private readonly CachedBlastBand[] _cachedBlastBands =
    {
        new(), new(), new(), new(), new(),
    };
    private int _cachedWallLayoutVersion = -1;
    private int _cachedBlastLayoutHash = int.MinValue;
    private int _lastTrailFrame = -1;
    private Vector2 _canvasMin;
    private Vector2 _canvasMax;
    private int? _hiddenAgentId;
    private bool _followAgent;
    private int? _selectedAgentId;
    private int _currentFrameIndex;
    private float _currentSimulationSpeed = 1f;
    private float _orthographicHumanoidScreenHeight;
    private bool _adaptiveFastHumanoids;

    /// <summary>Whether the pointer is currently inside the 3D simulation canvas.</summary>
    public bool IsHovered { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Camera used by the world and exposed to the sidebar controls.</summary>
    public Camera3D Camera => _camera;

    /// <summary>Approximate visual width of a standing humanoid in world units.</summary>
    public float AgentVisualWidth => HumanoidWidth;

    /// <summary>CPU time used by the projected world draw on the latest frame.</summary>
    public double LastDrawMilliseconds { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Number of active agents that passed the renderer's viewport culling.</summary>
    public int LastVisibleAgentCount { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Clear render-only caches such as position smoothing and trails.</summary>
    public void ResetVisualState()
    {
        _renderPositions.Clear();
        _agentById.Clear();
        _trails.Clear();
        _gaitPhases.Clear();
        _activeAgentIds.Clear();
        _visibleAgentIds.Clear();
        _staleAgentIds.Clear();
        _renderEntities.Clear();
        _cachedWallChunks.Clear();
        _cachedFixedFurnitureChunks.Clear();
        foreach (CachedBlastBand band in _cachedBlastBands)
        {
            band.Clear();
        }
        _cachedWallLayoutVersion = -1;
        _cachedBlastLayoutHash = int.MinValue;
        _lastTrailFrame = -1;
        LastVisibleAgentCount = 0;
    }

    /// <summary>Draw the complete world into the currently active ImGui child window.</summary>
    internal void Draw(
        Simulation simulation,
        bool builderMode,
        BuilderTool builderTool,
        int blockageCells,
        int exitPersonsWide,
        int agentPlacementCount,
        int? selectedAgentId,
        Agent? cameraAgent,
        bool followAgent,
        bool povEnabled,
        float simulationSpeed,
        RenderDebugOptions debug,
        float furnitureRotation = 0f,
        bool snapBarricadeEnds = true)
    {
        long drawStartTimestamp = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        Vector2 available = ImGui.GetContentRegionAvail();
        available.X = Math.Max(100f, available.X);
        available.Y = Math.Max(100f, available.Y);

        ImGui.InvisibleButton("##crowd-world-canvas", available);
        _canvasMin = ImGui.GetItemRectMin();
        _canvasMax = ImGui.GetItemRectMax();
        IsHovered = ImGui.IsItemHovered();

        _hiddenAgentId = povEnabled ? cameraAgent?.AgentId : null;
        _followAgent = followAgent && cameraAgent is not null && !povEnabled;
        _selectedAgentId = selectedAgentId;
        _currentFrameIndex = simulation.FrameIndex;
        _currentSimulationSpeed = Math.Clamp(simulationSpeed, 0.05f, 32f);

        int activeCount = 0;
        _agentById.Clear();
        foreach (Agent candidate in simulation.Agents)
        {
            _agentById[candidate.AgentId] = candidate;
            if (candidate.IsActive)
            {
                activeCount++;
            }
        }

        // Adaptive presentation only: physics remains untouched. All agent LODs use
        // world-space 3D body parts. Under load, reduced figures omit small details while
        // retaining depth, shading and animation. Hysteresis prevents repeated load switches.
        if (_currentSimulationSpeed >= 4f || activeCount >= 220 || LastDrawMilliseconds >= 20.0)
        {
            _adaptiveFastHumanoids = true;
        }
        else if (_currentSimulationSpeed <= 2f && activeCount <= 170 && LastDrawMilliseconds <= 11.0)
        {
            _adaptiveFastHumanoids = false;
        }

        if (povEnabled && cameraAgent is not null)
        {
            _camera.ConfigurePov(
                _canvasMin,
                _canvasMax,
                cameraAgent.Position,
                GetHeading(cameraAgent),
                eyeHeight: HumanoidHeight * 0.88f);
        }
        else
        {
            _camera.Configure(
                _canvasMin,
                _canvasMax,
                simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters,
                simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters,
                maximumHeight: 3.24f,
                focusWorld: _followAgent ? cameraAgent?.Position : null);
        }

        if (IsHovered && MathF.Abs(ImGui.GetIO().MouseWheel) > 0.001f && !_camera.IsPov)
        {
            _camera.AdjustZoom(ImGui.GetIO().MouseWheel);
            _camera.Configure(
                _canvasMin,
                _canvasMax,
                simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters,
                simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters,
                maximumHeight: 3.24f,
                focusWorld: _followAgent ? cameraAgent?.Position : null);
        }

        // In the orthographic overview every standing humanoid has the same projected height.
        // Measure it once instead of projecting foot/head again for every agent. POV remains
        // perspective-correct and computes size per agent because distance matters there.
        _orthographicHumanoidScreenHeight = _camera.IsPov
            ? 0f
            : EstimateHumanoidScreenHeight(Vector2.Zero);

        ImDrawListPtr draw = ImGui.GetWindowDrawList();
        draw.PushClipRect(_canvasMin, _canvasMax, true);
        draw.AddRectFilled(_canvasMin, _canvasMax, Color(0.045f, 0.052f, 0.065f, 1f));

        DrawFloor(draw, simulation);
        DrawGrid(draw, simulation);
        DrawExitMarkers(draw, simulation);
        DrawExplosionGroundEffects(draw, simulation, debug);
        DrawToxicFumeGroundEffects(draw, simulation, builderMode, debug);

        if (builderMode)
        {
            DrawPlannedAgentPlacements(draw, simulation);
        }

        if (debug.ShowCongestion)
        {
            DrawCongestion(draw, simulation);
        }

        UpdateRenderPositions(simulation);
        UpdateGaitPhases(simulation, simulationSpeed);
        UpdateTrails(simulation, debug.ShowTrails);
        DrawDepthSortedEntities(draw, simulation);
        DrawAgentOverlays(draw, simulation, selectedAgentId, debug);

        if (builderMode)
        {
            DrawBuilderPreview(draw, simulation, builderTool, blockageCells, exitPersonsWide, agentPlacementCount, furnitureRotation, snapBarricadeEnds);
        }

        DrawWorldLegend(draw, simulation, builderMode);
        draw.PopClipRect();
        LastDrawMilliseconds =
            (Stopwatch.GetTimestamp() - drawStartTimestamp) * 1000.0 / Stopwatch.Frequency;
    }

    /// <summary>Convert the current mouse position to the Z=0 simulation ground plane.</summary>
    public bool TryMouseToWorld(out Vector2 world)
    {
        world = default;
        if (!IsHovered || !_camera.TryScreenToGround(ImGui.GetMousePos(), out Vector2 candidate))
        {
            return false;
        }

        world = candidate;
        return true;
    }

    private void DrawFloor(ImDrawListPtr draw, Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (_camera.IsPov)
        {
            // First-person view uses a simple horizon/floor backdrop. The actual room geometry
            // is still projected in front of it, but we avoid projecting a giant floor quad
            // through the near plane behind the agent's head.
            float horizonY = _canvasMin.Y + (_canvasMax.Y - _canvasMin.Y) * 0.43f;
            draw.AddRectFilled(
                _canvasMin,
                new Vector2(_canvasMax.X, horizonY),
                Color(0.035f, 0.043f, 0.055f, 1f));
            draw.AddRectFilled(
                new Vector2(_canvasMin.X, horizonY),
                _canvasMax,
                Color(FloorColor));
            return;
        }

        float w = simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters;
        float h = simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters;
        DrawFlatQuad(
            draw,
            new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f),
            new Vector3(w, 0f, 0f),
            new Vector3(w, h, 0f),
            new Vector3(0f, h, 0f),
            Color(FloorColor));
    }

    private void DrawGrid(ImDrawListPtr draw, Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (!simulation.Config.Grid.Enabled)
        {
            return;
        }

        float width = simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters;
        float height = simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters;
        float step = Math.Max(0.20f, simulation.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters);
        uint color = Color(0.35f, 0.35f, 0.35f, 0.25f);

        for (float x = 0f; x <= width; x += step)
        {
            DrawWorldLine(
                draw,
                new Vector3(x, 0f, 0.05f),
                new Vector3(x, height, 0.05f),
                color,
                1f);
        }

        for (float y = 0f; y <= height; y += step)
        {
            DrawWorldLine(
                draw,
                new Vector3(0f, y, 0.05f),
                new Vector3(width, y, 0.05f),
                color,
                1f);
        }
    }

    private void DrawExitMarkers(ImDrawListPtr draw, Simulation simulation)
    {
        foreach (Exit exit in simulation.Environment.Exits)
        {
            float half = Math.Max(0.08f, exit.Size);
            Vector4 glow = new(0.08f, 0.72f, 0.95f, 0.78f);
            Vector4 post = new(0.12f, 0.82f, 1.00f, 1f);
            const float depth = 0.36f;

            if (exit.Side is "N" or "S")
            {
                DrawFlatQuad(
                    draw,
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X - half, exit.Position.Y - depth, 0.15f),
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X + half, exit.Position.Y - depth, 0.15f),
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X + half, exit.Position.Y + depth, 0.15f),
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X - half, exit.Position.Y + depth, 0.15f),
                    Color(glow));

                DrawOrientedPrism(draw, new Vector2(exit.Position.X - half, exit.Position.Y),
                    -0.08f, 0.08f, -0.08f, 0.08f, 0f, 1.38f, 0f, post);
                DrawOrientedPrism(draw, new Vector2(exit.Position.X + half, exit.Position.Y),
                    -0.08f, 0.08f, -0.08f, 0.08f, 0f, 1.38f, 0f, post);
            }
            else
            {
                DrawFlatQuad(
                    draw,
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X - depth, exit.Position.Y - half, 0.15f),
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X + depth, exit.Position.Y - half, 0.15f),
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X + depth, exit.Position.Y + half, 0.15f),
                    new Vector3(exit.Position.X - depth, exit.Position.Y + half, 0.15f),
                    Color(glow));

                DrawOrientedPrism(draw, new Vector2(exit.Position.X, exit.Position.Y - half),
                    -0.08f, 0.08f, -0.08f, 0.08f, 0f, 1.38f, 0f, post);
                DrawOrientedPrism(draw, new Vector2(exit.Position.X, exit.Position.Y + half),
                    -0.08f, 0.08f, -0.08f, 0.08f, 0f, 1.38f, 0f, post);
            }
        }
    }

    private void DrawToxicFumeGroundEffects(
        ImDrawListPtr draw,
        Simulation simulation,
        bool builderMode,
        RenderDebugOptions debug)
    {
        if (simulation.ScenarioType != ScenarioType.ToxicFume ||
            simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.SourcePosition is not Vector2 source)
        {
            return;
        }

        // The source marker remains visible even when the concentration overlay is hidden.
        DrawGroundCircle(
            draw,
            source,
            Math.Max(0.18f, simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration.InitialRadiusMeters),
            0.055f,
            new Vector4(0.18f, 0.92f, 0.48f, 0.55f),
            36);

        if (!debug.ShowToxicFume || !simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsPrecomputed)
        {
            return;
        }

        float elapsed = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsReleased
            ? simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.GetElapsedSeconds(simulation)
            : builderMode
                ? simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.PreviewTimeSeconds
                : 0f;

        int cells = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.GridCellCount;
        int stride = cells > 30000 ? 3 : cells > 6000 ? 2 : 1;
        foreach (ToxicFumeCellSample sample in simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.EnumerateCells(elapsed, 0.025f, stride))
        {
            float c = Math.Clamp(sample.Concentration, 0f, 1f);
            float half = sample.CellSizeMeters * 0.50f;
            // Green/yellow normalized field: opacity conveys concentration while remaining
            // visually distinct from the explosion's red/orange blast overlays.
            Vector4 tint = new(
                0.18f + 0.58f * c,
                0.82f - 0.18f * c,
                0.30f - 0.12f * c,
                0.07f + 0.30f * c);
            DrawFlatQuad(
                draw,
                new Vector3(sample.Center.X - half, sample.Center.Y - half, 0.065f),
                new Vector3(sample.Center.X + half, sample.Center.Y - half, 0.065f),
                new Vector3(sample.Center.X + half, sample.Center.Y + half, 0.065f),
                new Vector3(sample.Center.X - half, sample.Center.Y + half, 0.065f),
                Color(tint));

            if (debug.ShowToxicGrid)
            {
                uint gridColor = Color(new Vector4(0.55f, 1.0f, 0.66f, 0.18f));
                Vector3 a = new(sample.Center.X - half, sample.Center.Y - half, 0.07f);
                Vector3 b = new(sample.Center.X + half, sample.Center.Y - half, 0.07f);
                Vector3 c1 = new(sample.Center.X + half, sample.Center.Y + half, 0.07f);
                Vector3 d = new(sample.Center.X - half, sample.Center.Y + half, 0.07f);
                DrawWorldLine(draw, a, b, gridColor, 1f);
                DrawWorldLine(draw, b, c1, gridColor, 1f);
                DrawWorldLine(draw, c1, d, gridColor, 1f);
                DrawWorldLine(draw, d, a, gridColor, 1f);
            }
        }
    }

    private void DrawExplosionGroundEffects(
        ImDrawListPtr draw,
        Simulation simulation,
        RenderDebugOptions debug)
    {
        Explosion? explosion = simulation.Environment.Explosion;
        if (explosion is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        // Persistent analysis zones. The five annuli use the same configured radii as the
        // event physics, are clipped by room boundaries/walls, and are rendering-only after
        // the one-time shock outcome has been applied.
        if (debug.ShowBlastZones)
        {
            DrawPersistentBlastZones(draw, simulation, explosion.Position, debug);
        }

        float elapsed = Math.Max(0, simulation.FrameIndex - explosion.TriggeredFrame) * simulation.Config.Agent.StepScale;
        float shockRadius = Math.Min(
            simulation.Config.Agent.HeatRadius,
            elapsed * simulation.Config.Agent.ShockwaveSpeedMetersPerFrame);
        int frontEndFrame = (int)MathF.Ceiling(
            simulation.Config.Agent.HeatRadius /
            Math.Max(simulation.Config.Agent.ShockwaveSpeedMetersPerFrame, 1e-5f)) + 3;

        // Active event presentation remains a thin, fast, translucent shock front.
        if (elapsed <= frontEndFrame && shockRadius > 1f)
        {
            DrawShieldedGroundRing(
                draw,
                simulation,
                explosion.Position,
                Math.Max(0.04f, shockRadius - 0.28f),
                shockRadius + 0.20f,
                0.82f,
                new Vector4(0.82f, 0.92f, 1f, 0.16f),
                _adaptiveFastHumanoids ? 56 : 96);
            DrawShieldedGroundCircle(
                draw,
                simulation,
                explosion.Position,
                shockRadius,
                0.90f,
                new Vector4(0.96f, 0.99f, 1f, 0.74f),
                _adaptiveFastHumanoids ? 64 : 112);
        }
    }

    private void DrawPersistentBlastZones(
        ImDrawListPtr draw,
        Simulation simulation,
        Vector2 origin,
        RenderDebugOptions debug)
    {
        EnsurePersistentBlastCache(simulation, origin);

        // Draw outer-to-inner non-overlapping bands so the display remains readable.
        if (debug.ShowPanicZone)
        {
            DrawCachedBlastBand(draw, _cachedBlastBands[4]);
        }

        if (debug.ShowInjuryZone)
        {
            DrawCachedBlastBand(draw, _cachedBlastBands[3]);
        }

        if (debug.ShowFallenZone)
        {
            DrawCachedBlastBand(draw, _cachedBlastBands[2]);
        }

        if (debug.ShowIncapacitationZone)
        {
            DrawCachedBlastBand(draw, _cachedBlastBands[1]);
        }

        if (debug.ShowKillZone)
        {
            DrawCachedBlastBand(draw, _cachedBlastBands[0]);
        }
    }

    private void EnsurePersistentBlastCache(Simulation simulation, Vector2 origin)
    {
        var config = simulation.Config.Agent;
        HashCode hash = new();
        hash.Add(simulation.Environment.WallLayoutVersion);
        hash.Add(origin.X);
        hash.Add(origin.Y);
        hash.Add(config.HardKillRadius);
        hash.Add(config.HeatIncapacityRadius);
        hash.Add(config.FallenRadius);
        hash.Add(config.InjuryRadius);
        hash.Add(config.HeatRadius);
        int layoutHash = hash.ToHashCode();
        if (layoutHash == _cachedBlastLayoutHash)
        {
            return;
        }

        _cachedBlastLayoutHash = layoutHash;
        BuildCachedBlastBand(
            _cachedBlastBands[0], simulation, origin, 0f, config.HardKillRadius, BlastZoneStyle.Kill);
        BuildCachedBlastBand(
            _cachedBlastBands[1], simulation, origin, config.HardKillRadius, config.HeatIncapacityRadius,
            BlastZoneStyle.Incapacitation);
        BuildCachedBlastBand(
            _cachedBlastBands[2], simulation, origin, config.HeatIncapacityRadius, config.FallenRadius,
            BlastZoneStyle.Fallen);
        BuildCachedBlastBand(
            _cachedBlastBands[3], simulation, origin, config.FallenRadius, config.InjuryRadius,
            BlastZoneStyle.Injury);
        BuildCachedBlastBand(
            _cachedBlastBands[4], simulation, origin, config.InjuryRadius, config.HeatRadius,
            BlastZoneStyle.Panic);
    }

    private void BuildCachedBlastBand(
        CachedBlastBand cache,
        Simulation simulation,
        Vector2 origin,
        float innerRadius,
        float outerRadius,
        Vector4 baseColor)
    {
        cache.Clear();
        cache.FillColor = Color(new Vector4(baseColor.X, baseColor.Y, baseColor.Z, 0.075f));
        cache.OutlineColor = Color(new Vector4(baseColor.X, baseColor.Y, baseColor.Z, 0.68f));

        const int bandSegments = 128;
        float safeInner = Math.Max(0f, innerRadius);
        float safeOuter = Math.Max(safeInner + 0.02f, outerRadius);
        for (int i = 0; i < bandSegments; i++)
        {
            float angleA = MathF.Tau * i / bandSegments;
            float angleB = MathF.Tau * (i + 1) / bandSegments;
            Vector2 directionA = new(MathF.Cos(angleA), MathF.Sin(angleA));
            Vector2 directionB = new(MathF.Cos(angleB), MathF.Sin(angleB));
            Vector2 innerA = origin + directionA * safeInner;
            Vector2 outerA = origin + directionA * safeOuter;
            Vector2 innerB = origin + directionB * safeInner;
            Vector2 outerB = origin + directionB * safeOuter;
            Vector2 midpoint = (innerA + outerA + innerB + outerB) * 0.25f;

            if (!BlastZonePointIsVisible(simulation, origin, innerA) ||
                !BlastZonePointIsVisible(simulation, origin, outerA) ||
                !BlastZonePointIsVisible(simulation, origin, innerB) ||
                !BlastZonePointIsVisible(simulation, origin, outerB) ||
                !BlastZonePointIsVisible(simulation, origin, midpoint))
            {
                continue;
            }

            cache.Quads.Add(new CachedWorldQuad(
                new Vector3(innerA, 0.22f),
                new Vector3(innerB, 0.22f),
                new Vector3(outerB, 0.22f),
                new Vector3(outerA, 0.22f)));
        }

        const int outlineSegments = 144;
        Vector2 previous = origin + new Vector2(safeOuter, 0f);
        for (int i = 1; i <= outlineSegments; i++)
        {
            float angle = MathF.Tau * i / outlineSegments;
            Vector2 next = origin + new Vector2(
                safeOuter * MathF.Cos(angle),
                safeOuter * MathF.Sin(angle));
            Vector2 midpoint = (previous + next) * 0.5f;
            if (BlastZonePointIsVisible(simulation, origin, previous) &&
                BlastZonePointIsVisible(simulation, origin, midpoint) &&
                BlastZonePointIsVisible(simulation, origin, next))
            {
                cache.Outline.Add(new CachedWorldLine(
                    new Vector3(previous, 0.28f),
                    new Vector3(next, 0.28f)));
            }

            previous = next;
        }
    }

    private void DrawCachedBlastBand(ImDrawListPtr draw, CachedBlastBand cache)
    {
        foreach (CachedWorldQuad quad in cache.Quads)
        {
            DrawFlatQuad(draw, quad.A, quad.B, quad.C, quad.D, cache.FillColor);
        }

        foreach (CachedWorldLine line in cache.Outline)
        {
            DrawWorldLine(draw, line.A, line.B, cache.OutlineColor, 1.4f);
        }
    }

    private void DrawAnalysisBand(
        ImDrawListPtr draw,
        Simulation simulation,
        Vector2 origin,
        float innerRadius,
        float outerRadius,
        Vector4 baseColor)
    {
        Vector4 fill = new(baseColor.X, baseColor.Y, baseColor.Z, 0.075f);
        Vector4 outline = new(baseColor.X, baseColor.Y, baseColor.Z, 0.68f);

        DrawShieldedGroundRing(
            draw,
            simulation,
            origin,
            innerRadius,
            outerRadius,
            0.22f,
            fill,
            128);
        DrawShieldedGroundCircle(
            draw,
            simulation,
            origin,
            outerRadius,
            0.28f,
            outline,
            144);
    }

    private void DrawCongestion(ImDrawListPtr draw, Simulation simulation)
    {
        // LocalCongestion is already computed by the behaviour layer from the spatial hash.
        // Reusing it avoids a second O(N^2) density scan purely for presentation.
        foreach (Agent agent in simulation.Agents)
        {
            if (!agent.IsActive || !IsAgentOnScreen(agent.Position, 24f))
            {
                continue;
            }

            float intensity = Math.Clamp(agent.LocalCongestion, 0f, 1f);
            if (intensity <= 0.08f)
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (!_camera.TryProject(new Vector3(agent.Position, 0.08f), out Vector2 screen))
            {
                continue;
            }

            float screenRadius = 5f + 11f * intensity;
            // Purple congestion heat keeps density diagnostics visually distinct from
            // the red/orange panic ring rendered under individual agents.
            draw.AddCircleFilled(
                screen,
                screenRadius,
                Color(
                    0.48f + 0.32f * intensity,
```
