## src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/UI/CaretNumberEditor.cs

```csharp
using System.Globalization;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.UI;

/// <summary>
/// Small state holder for ImGui text-based numeric fields. Unlike DragFloat/InputFloat,
/// a normal InputText control keeps a visible insertion caret on a single click and does
/// not select the complete value unless the user explicitly selects it.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class CaretNumberEditor
{
    private readonly bool _integer;

    public CaretNumberEditor(float initialValue, bool integer = false)
    {
        _integer = integer;
        Reset(initialValue);
    }

    /// <summary>Current editable text buffer passed by reference to ImGui.InputText.</summary>
    public string Text = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>Whether the ImGui input was active during the previous frame.</summary>
    public bool WasActive { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Validation message retained while the user corrects an invalid value.</summary>
    public string? Error { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Last value copied from the simulation configuration.</summary>
    public float LastCommittedValue { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Synchronise external configuration changes without overwriting text while a user is
    /// actively editing or correcting an invalid entry.
    /// </summary>
    public void Synchronize(float currentValue)
    {
        if (WasActive || Error is not null)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (MathF.Abs(currentValue - LastCommittedValue) > 0.0001f)
        {
            Reset(currentValue);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Replace the buffer with a validated committed value.</summary>
    public void Reset(float value)
    {
        LastCommittedValue = value;
        Text = _integer
            ? MathF.Round(value).ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            : value.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        Error = null;
        WasActive = false;
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/UI/DashboardLayout.cs

```csharp
namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.UI;

/// <summary>
/// Allocates the workspace in logical pixels. Panel visibility changes the viewport width,
/// never the physical simulation or camera state. Narrow windows shrink both side panels.
/// </summary>
internal readonly record struct DashboardLayout(
    float ControlsWidth,
    float ViewportWidth,
    float InspectorWidth,
    float Gap)
{
    public const float PreferredControlsWidth = 336f;
    public const float PreferredInspectorWidth = 360f;

    /// <summary>Return positive widths whose sum, including gaps, fits the available space.</summary>
    public static DashboardLayout Calculate(float width, bool inspectorVisible, float gap = 10f)
    {
        if (!float.IsFinite(width) || width <= 0f)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(width));
        if (!float.IsFinite(gap) || gap < 0f)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(gap));

        float actualGap = Math.Min(gap, width * 0.04f);
        // Control width is independent of inspector visibility, so hiding the inspector gives
        // all of its width and its inter-panel gap back to the scene rather than to the controls.
        float controls = Math.Min(PreferredControlsWidth, width * 0.27f);
        float inspector = inspectorVisible ? Math.Min(PreferredInspectorWidth, width * 0.29f) : 0f;
        int gaps = inspectorVisible ? 2 : 1;
        float viewport = width - controls - inspector - actualGap * gaps;
        return new DashboardLayout(controls, viewport, inspector, actualGap);
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.UI;

/// <summary>Inspector destinations remain selected while the panel is hidden.</summary>
internal enum InspectorTab { Overview, Hazard, Agent, Debug }

/// <summary>
/// Presentation-only inspector state. Hiding the panel does not clear the selected agent,
/// debug overlay flags, hazard configuration, active tab, or running simulation.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class InspectorPanelState
{
    public bool IsVisible { get; private set; } = true;
    public InspectorTab ActiveTab { get; private set; } = InspectorTab.Overview;

    public void ToggleVisibility() => IsVisible = !IsVisible;

    public void SelectTab(InspectorTab tab)
    {
        if (!Enum.IsDefined(tab)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(tab));
        ActiveTab = tab;
    }

    /// <summary>Explicitly open a destination, for example from the selected-agent toolbar.</summary>
    public void Show(InspectorTab tab)
    {
        SelectTab(tab);
        IsVisible = true;
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/UI/SimulationUi.Assets.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using ImGuiNET;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.UI;

public sealed partial class SimulationUi
{
    private BuilderTool SelectedAssetTool => _assetSelection.Selected switch
    {
        BuilderAsset.SquareBlock or BuilderAsset.LargeSquareBlock => BuilderTool.Blockage,
        BuilderAsset.CircularBlock => BuilderTool.CircularBlockage,
        BuilderAsset.RoundTableSet => BuilderTool.RoundTableSet,
        BuilderAsset.SingleChair => BuilderTool.SingleChair,
        BuilderAsset.RectangularTable => BuilderTool.RectangularTable,
        BuilderAsset.Stage => BuilderTool.Stage,
        BuilderAsset.Barricade => BuilderTool.Barricade,
        _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Unknown asset selection."),
    };

    private void DrawAssetPlacementControls(Simulation simulation)
    {
        ImGui.Spacing();
        ImGui.Text("ASSETS");
        ImGui.TextWrapped("Select an asset, rotate if needed, then click the floor.");
        float cell = simulation.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters;
        string preview = BuilderAssetSelection.Label(_assetSelection.Selected, cell);
        ImGui.SetNextItemWidth(-1f);
        if (ImGui.BeginCombo("##AssetPicker", preview))
        {
            foreach (BuilderAsset asset in BuilderAssetSelection.Options)
            {
                if (asset == BuilderAsset.RoundTableSet || asset == BuilderAsset.Stage) ImGui.Separator();
                bool selected = _assetSelection.Selected == asset;
                bool unavailable = asset == BuilderAsset.Stage && simulation.Environment.HasStage;
                string label = unavailable ? "Stage - 15 x 6 m (1/1 placed)" : BuilderAssetSelection.Label(asset, cell);
                ImGui.BeginDisabled(unavailable);
                if (ImGui.Selectable(label, selected))
                {
                    _assetSelection.Select(asset);
                    ActivateSelectedAsset(simulation);
                }
                ImGui.EndDisabled();
                if (selected) ImGui.SetItemDefaultFocus();
            }
            ImGui.EndCombo();
        }
        ImGui.TextWrapped(_assetSelection.Hint);

        bool stageLimit = _assetSelection.Selected == BuilderAsset.Stage && simulation.Environment.HasStage;
        ImGui.BeginDisabled(stageLimit);
        if (_assetSelection.SupportsRotation)
        {
            if (_assetSelection.UsesQuarterTurns)
            {
                bool alongY = ((int)MathF.Round(_assetSelection.RotationDegrees / 90f) & 1) != 0;
                ImGui.Text($"Long side along {(alongY ? "Y" : "X")} | {_assetSelection.RotationDegrees:0} deg");
            }
            else if (_assetSelection.Selected == BuilderAsset.Barricade)
            {
                float degrees = _assetSelection.RotationDegrees;
                ImGui.SetNextItemWidth(-1f);
                if (ImGui.SliderFloat("##BarricadeAngle", ref degrees, 0f, 359.9f, "Angle: %.1f deg"))
                {
                    _assetSelection.SetRotation(degrees);
                    ActivateSelectedAsset(simulation);
                }
                ImGui.Text("Exact angle (degrees)");
                degrees = _assetSelection.RotationDegrees;
                ImGui.SetNextItemWidth(-1f);
                if (ImGui.InputFloat("##BarricadeExactAngle", ref degrees, 0f, 0f, "%.1f") && float.IsFinite(degrees))
                {
                    _assetSelection.SetRotation(degrees);
                    ActivateSelectedAsset(simulation);
                }
                float buttonWidth = Math.Max(1f, (ImGui.GetContentRegionAvail().X - ImGui.GetStyle().ItemSpacing.X) * 0.5f);
                if (DrawNeutralButton("-15 deg", new Vector2(buttonWidth, 0f)))
                {
                    _assetSelection.RotateStep(reverse: true);
                    ActivateSelectedAsset(simulation);
                }
                ImGui.SameLine();
                if (DrawNeutralButton("+15 deg", new Vector2(buttonWidth, 0f)))
                {
                    _assetSelection.RotateStep();
                    ActivateSelectedAsset(simulation);
                }
                ImGui.TextWrapped("R: +15 deg. Shift+R: -15 deg. 0 deg runs along X; 90 deg runs along Y.");
            }
            else
            {
                float degrees = _assetSelection.RotationDegrees;
                ImGui.SetNextItemWidth(-1f);
                if (ImGui.SliderFloat("##AssetFacing", ref degrees, 0f, 359f, "Facing: %.0f deg"))
                {
                    _assetSelection.SetRotation(degrees);
                    ActivateSelectedAsset(simulation);
                }
            }
            if (_assetSelection.Selected != BuilderAsset.Barricade &&
                DrawNeutralButton("Rotate 90 deg (R)", new Vector2(-1f, 0f)))
            {
                _assetSelection.RotateQuarterTurn();
                ActivateSelectedAsset(simulation);
            }
            ImGui.TextWrapped("Rotation changes the preview and next placement, not existing assets.");
        }
        if (_assetSelection.Selected == BuilderAsset.Barricade)
        {
            bool snap = _assetSelection.SnapBarricadeEnds;
            if (ImGui.Checkbox("Snap barricades end-to-end", ref snap))
                _assetSelection.SnapBarricadeEnds = snap;
        }

        DrawActiveButton("Place selected asset", _builderTool == SelectedAssetTool,
            () => ActivateSelectedAsset(simulation));
        ImGui.EndDisabled();
        if (stageLimit)
            ImGui.TextWrapped("Stage already placed (1/1). Select another asset, or undo the stage before replacing it.");
        else
            ImGui.TextWrapped("Green preview: fits. Red: blocked. Click repeatedly to place more; Ctrl+Z undoes the last placement.");
    }

    private void ActivateSelectedAsset(Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (_assetSelection.Selected == BuilderAsset.Stage && simulation.Environment.HasStage) return;
        _builderTool = SelectedAssetTool;
        _statusMessage = $"{BuilderAssetSelection.Label(_assetSelection.Selected, simulation.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters)} selected. " +
            (_assetSelection.SupportsRotation ? "Set the angle with the controls or R, then click to place." : "Click to place.");
    }

    /// <summary>Native R shortcut: never edits text or rotates a placed object.</summary>
    public void TryRotateSelectedAssetShortcut(Simulation simulation, bool reverse = false)
    {
        if (_mode != AppMode.Builder || !_assetSelection.SupportsRotation ||
            _builderTool != SelectedAssetTool || !_worldCanvasHovered || ImGui.GetIO().WantTextInput ||
            (_assetSelection.Selected == BuilderAsset.Stage && simulation.Environment.HasStage)) return;
        _assetSelection.RotateStep(reverse);
        _statusMessage = $"Placement rotated to {_assetSelection.RotationDegrees:0.0} deg. Existing assets are unchanged.";
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/UI/SimulationUi.Dashboard.cs

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.OpenGL.Rendering;
using ImGuiNET;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.UI;

public sealed partial class SimulationUi
{
    /// <summary>Keep the panel toggle outside the panel it controls, including while hidden.</summary>
    private void DrawDashboardHeader(Simulation simulation, UiMetrics metrics)
    {
        float rowStart = ImGui.GetCursorPosX();
        float rowWidth = ImGui.GetContentRegionAvail().X;
        string toggleLabel = _inspector.IsVisible ? "Hide inspector" : "Show inspector";
        float toggleWidth = ImGui.CalcTextSize(toggleLabel).X + 28f;

        ImGui.AlignTextToFramePadding();
        ImGui.TextColored(InfoColor, "CROWD SIM");
        ImGui.SameLine();
        (string modeLabel, Vector4 modeColor) = GetModePresentation(simulation);
        DrawBadge(modeLabel, modeColor);
        ImGui.SameLine(Math.Max(ImGui.GetCursorPosX(), rowStart + rowWidth - toggleWidth));
        if (DrawNeutralButton(toggleLabel + "##InspectorVisibility", new Vector2(toggleWidth, 30f)))
            _inspector.ToggleVisibility();
        if (ImGui.IsItemHovered())
            ImGui.SetTooltip("Show or hide the right inspector. Your selected agent, settings and overlays are retained. Shortcut: F4.");

        string scenario = simulation.ScenarioType == ScenarioType.Explosion ? "Explosion" : "Toxic Fume";
        string name = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_scenarioName) ? "Untitled scene" : _scenarioName;
        string summary = $"{scenario}  /  {name}{(_scenarioDirty ? "  [unsaved]" : string.Empty)}";
        if (rowWidth >= 1000f)
            summary += $"    |    {metrics.ElapsedSeconds:F1} s    |    {(_mode == AppMode.Builder ? simulation.Environment.PlannedAgentCount : metrics.InRoom)} in room    |    {metrics.Exited} evacuated";
        DrawFittedText(summary, ImGui.GetStyle().Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.TextDisabled]);
    }

    /// <summary>Scene actions stay fixed; only the selected control page scrolls.</summary>
    private void DrawDashboardControls(Simulation simulation, WorldRenderer renderer)
    {
        ImGui.Text(_mode == AppMode.Builder ? "SCENE BUILDER" : "SIMULATION CONTROL");
        ImGui.TextDisabled(_mode == AppMode.Builder ? "Prepare the scene, then run it." : "Run, inspect and replay your scene.");
        ImGui.Spacing();
        DrawCompactSessionControls(simulation);
        ImGui.Spacing();

        float buttonWidth = Math.Max(1f, (ImGui.GetContentRegionAvail().X - 2f * ImGui.GetStyle().ItemSpacing.X) / 3f);
        DrawControlPageButton(_mode == AppMode.Builder ? "Build" : "Run", ControlPanelTab.Scene, buttonWidth);
        ImGui.SameLine();
        DrawControlPageButton("Camera", ControlPanelTab.Camera, buttonWidth);
        ImGui.SameLine();
        DrawControlPageButton("Files", ControlPanelTab.Files, buttonWidth);
        ImGui.Spacing();

        // The primary action cannot disappear below a long list of asset/tuning controls.
        float footerHeight = _mode == AppMode.Builder ? 122f : 114f;
        float pageHeight = Math.Max(1f, ImGui.GetContentRegionAvail().Y - footerHeight - ImGui.GetStyle().ItemSpacing.Y);
        ImGui.BeginChild("##control-page-" + _controlPanelTab, new Vector2(0f, pageHeight),
            ImGuiChildFlags.AlwaysUseWindowPadding);
        ImGui.PushItemWidth(-1f);
        switch (_controlPanelTab)
        {
            case ControlPanelTab.Scene:
                if (_mode == AppMode.Builder) DrawBuilderControls(simulation);
                else DrawRuntimeControls(simulation);
                break;
            case ControlPanelTab.Camera:
                ImGui.Text("CAMERA & VIEW");
                ImGui.TextWrapped("Adjust the view here. Select a person in the scene to use Follow or Agent POV in the inspector.");
                ImGui.Spacing();
                DrawCameraControls(renderer);
                break;
            case ControlPanelTab.Files:
                DrawScenarioPersistenceControls(simulation);
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_lastRecordingPath))
                {
                    ImGui.Spacing();
                    ImGui.Text("LAST RECORDING");
                    ImGui.TextWrapped(_lastRecordingPath);
                }
                ImGui.Spacing();
                ImGui.Separator();
                if (DrawNeutralButton("Exit application", new Vector2(-1f, 32f))) ExitRequested = true;
                break;
        }
        ImGui.PopItemWidth();
        ImGui.EndChild();
        ImGui.Separator();
        if (_mode == AppMode.Builder) DrawFinaliseControls(simulation);
        else DrawRunTransportControls(simulation);
    }

    private void DrawControlPageButton(string label, ControlPanelTab tab, float width)
    {
        if (DrawNavigationButton(label + "##ControlPage", _controlPanelTab == tab, new Vector2(width, 32f)))
            _controlPanelTab = tab;
    }

    private void DrawCompactSessionControls(Simulation simulation)
    {
        float width = Math.Max(1f, (ImGui.GetContentRegionAvail().X - ImGui.GetStyle().ItemSpacing.X) * 0.5f);
        if (DrawNeutralButton("Save scene", new Vector2(width, 30f)))
        {
            _scenarioSaveRequested = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_scenarioName) ? "scenario" : _scenarioName.Trim();
            _statusMessage = "Saving authored scene configuration...";
        }
        ImGui.SameLine();
        if (DrawNeutralButton("New scenario", new Vector2(width, 30f)))
        {
            if (_scenarioDirty) _returnToSelectionConfirmation = true;
            else
            {
                simulation.SetRunning(false);
                _newScenarioRequested = true;
            }
        }
        if (_returnToSelectionConfirmation)
        {
            ImGui.TextWrapped("Discard unsaved scene changes and return to scenario selection?");
            if (DrawNeutralButton("Discard changes", new Vector2(width, 30f)))
            {
                simulation.SetRunning(false);
                _newScenarioRequested = true;
                _returnToSelectionConfirmation = false;
            }
            ImGui.SameLine();
            if (DrawNeutralButton("Keep scene", new Vector2(width, 30f))) _returnToSelectionConfirmation = false;
        }
        if (_mode == AppMode.Simulation && DrawNeutralButton("Replay from scene start", new Vector2(-1f, 30f)))
        {
            simulation.SetRunning(false);
            _restartSimulationRequested = true;
            _statusMessage = "Restoring the finalised, not-yet-started scene...";
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Transport remains usable even when the Camera or Files page is selected.</summary>
    private void DrawRunTransportControls(Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (!simulation.Running && simulation.FrameIndex == 0)
        {
            bool record = _recordNextRun;
            if (ImGui.Checkbox("Record this run", ref record))
            {
                _recordNextRun = record;
                _statusMessage = record ? "Recording will start with this run." : "Recording disarmed.";
            }
        }
        else if (_recordingActive)
        {
            ImGui.TextColored(ErrorColor, "REC");
            ImGui.SameLine();
            if (DrawNeutralButton("Stop recording", new Vector2(-1f, 26f))) _stopRecordingRequested = true;
        }
        else ImGui.TextDisabled($"Elapsed {simulation.FrameIndex * simulation.Config.Agent.Dt:F1} s  |  Playback {_simulationSpeed:F2}x");

        string label = simulation.Running ? "Pause simulation" : simulation.FrameIndex == 0 ? "Start simulation" : "Resume simulation";
        Vector4 color = simulation.Running ? PausedColor : ReadyColor;
        if (DrawActionButton(label, color, new Vector2(-1f, 40f)))
        {
            bool run = !simulation.Running;
            simulation.SetRunning(run);
            _statusMessage = simulation.Running ? "Simulation running." : !run ? "Simulation paused."
                : simulation.ScenarioType == ScenarioType.ToxicFume && !simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(simulation)
                    ? "Compute the fume dispersion before starting."
                    : "The scene needs agents and at least one exit before it can run.";
        }
    }

    private void DrawViewportToolbar()
    {
        ImGui.AlignTextToFramePadding();
        ImGui.TextDisabled(_povEnabled ? "AGENT POV" : _followSelectedAgent ? "FOLLOW VIEW" : "SCENE VIEW");
        if (SelectedAgentId is int id)
        {
            ImGui.SameLine();
            if (DrawNeutralButton($"Agent {id}##RevealAgentInspector", new Vector2(0f, 26f)))
                _inspector.Show(InspectorTab.Agent);
            if (ImGui.IsItemHovered()) ImGui.SetTooltip("Open this person's details in the right inspector.");
        }
        ImGui.Separator();
    }

    /// <summary>Explicit navigation keeps the active inspector page stable across hide/show.</summary>
    private void DrawDashboardInspector(Simulation simulation, UiMetrics metrics)
    {
        ImGui.Text("INSPECTOR");
        ImGui.TextDisabled("Overview, hazard, agent and debug.");
        ImGui.Spacing();
        float width = Math.Max(1f, (ImGui.GetContentRegionAvail().X - ImGui.GetStyle().ItemSpacing.X) * 0.5f);
        DrawInspectorPageButton("Overview", InspectorTab.Overview, width);
        ImGui.SameLine();
        DrawInspectorPageButton(simulation.ScenarioType == ScenarioType.Explosion ? "Blast" : "Fume", InspectorTab.Hazard, width);
        DrawInspectorPageButton(SelectedAgentId is int id ? $"Agent {id}" : "Agent", InspectorTab.Agent, width);
        ImGui.SameLine();
        DrawInspectorPageButton("Debug", InspectorTab.Debug, width);
        ImGui.Spacing();
        ImGui.Separator();

        ImGui.BeginChild("##inspector-page-" + _inspector.ActiveTab, Vector2.Zero,
            ImGuiChildFlags.AlwaysUseWindowPadding);
        ImGui.PushItemWidth(-1f);
        switch (_inspector.ActiveTab)
        {
            case InspectorTab.Overview:
                DrawOverviewCards(simulation, metrics);
                ImGui.Spacing();
                DrawMetricsInspectorTab(simulation, metrics);
                break;
            case InspectorTab.Hazard:
                if (simulation.ScenarioType == ScenarioType.Explosion) DrawBlastInspectorTab(simulation);
                else DrawToxicFumeInspectorTab(simulation);
                break;
            case InspectorTab.Agent:
                DrawAgentInspectorTab(simulation);
                break;
            case InspectorTab.Debug:
                DrawDebugInspectorTab(simulation);
                break;
        }
        ImGui.PopItemWidth();
        ImGui.EndChild();
    }

    private void DrawInspectorPageButton(string label, InspectorTab tab, float width)
    {
        if (DrawNavigationButton(label + "##InspectorPage-" + tab, _inspector.ActiveTab == tab, new Vector2(width, 32f)))
            _inspector.SelectTab(tab);
    }

    private static void DrawOverviewCards(Simulation simulation, UiMetrics metrics)
    {
        float width = Math.Max(1f, (ImGui.GetContentRegionAvail().X - ImGui.GetStyle().ItemSpacing.X) * 0.5f);
        DrawMetricCard("IN ROOM", metrics.InRoom, InfoColor, width);
        ImGui.SameLine();
        DrawMetricCard("EVACUATED", metrics.Exited, RunningColor, width);
        DrawMetricCard("ASSISTING", metrics.CurrentlyHelping, new Vector4(0.72f, 0.60f, 0.98f, 1f), width);
        ImGui.SameLine();
        int affected = simulation.ScenarioType == ScenarioType.ToxicFume
            ? metrics.ToxicExposed : metrics.Injured + metrics.Fallen + metrics.Crawling + metrics.TempIncap + metrics.Incapacitated + metrics.Dead;
        DrawMetricCard("AFFECTED", affected, PausedColor, width);
    }

    private static void DrawMetricCard(string label, int value, Vector4 color, float width)
    {
        ImGui.BeginChild("##metric-card-" + label, new Vector2(width, 72f),
            ImGuiChildFlags.Borders, ImGuiWindowFlags.NoScrollbar | ImGuiWindowFlags.NoScrollWithMouse);
        ImGui.TextDisabled(label);
        ImGui.TextColored(color, value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        ImGui.EndChild();
    }

    private void DrawDashboardStatus(Simulation simulation)
    {
        DrawFittedText(_statusMessage, GetStatusMessageColor(_statusMessage));
        DrawFittedText(GetActiveToolLabel(simulation) + "  |  " + GetActiveToolInstruction(simulation),
            ImGui.GetStyle().Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.TextDisabled]);
    }

    private static void DrawFittedText(string text, Vector4 color)
    {
        string fitted = FitText(text, Math.Max(1f, ImGui.GetContentRegionAvail().X));
        ImGui.TextColored(color, fitted);
        if (fitted != text && ImGui.IsItemHovered()) ImGui.SetTooltip(text);
    }

    /// <summary>Keep guidance readable at the available panel width.</summary>
    private static void DrawMutedText(string text)
    {
        ImGui.PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol.Text, ImGui.GetStyle().Colors[(int)ImGuiCol.TextDisabled]);
        ImGui.TextWrapped(text);
        ImGui.PopStyleColor();
    }

    private static string FitText(string text, float width)
    {
        if (ImGui.CalcTextSize(text).X <= width) return text;
        const string suffix = "...";
        int length = text.Length;
        while (length > 0 && ImGui.CalcTextSize(text[..length] + suffix).X > width) length--;
        return text[..length] + suffix;
    }

    private static void DrawBadge(string text, Vector4 color)
    {
        ImGui.PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol.Button, new Vector4(color.X, color.Y, color.Z, 0.16f));
        ImGui.PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol.ButtonHovered, new Vector4(color.X, color.Y, color.Z, 0.16f));
        ImGui.PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol.ButtonActive, new Vector4(color.X, color.Y, color.Z, 0.16f));
        ImGui.PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol.Text, color);
        ImGui.Button(text + "##ModeBadge", new Vector2(0f, 30f));
        ImGui.PopStyleColor(4);
    }

    private static bool DrawNavigationButton(string label, bool selected, Vector2 size)
    {
        if (selected)
        {
            ImGui.PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol.Button, new Vector4(0.13f, 0.29f, 0.44f, 1f));
            ImGui.PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol.Text, new Vector4(0.64f, 0.86f, 1f, 1f));
        }
        bool clicked = ImGui.Button(label, size);
        if (selected) ImGui.PopStyleColor(2);
        return clicked;
    }

    /// <summary>Native shortcut; toolbar buttons remain the primary visible control.</summary>
    public void TryToggleInspectorShortcut()
    {
        if (_mode != AppMode.ScenarioSelection && !ImGui.GetIO().WantTextInput)
            _inspector.ToggleVisibility();
    }
}
```

## src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/UI/SimulationUi.Layout.cs

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.OpenGL.Rendering;
using ImGuiNET;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.UI;

public sealed partial class SimulationUi
{
    private static readonly Vector4 BuilderColor = new(0.55f, 0.62f, 0.70f, 1f);
    private static readonly Vector4 ReadyColor = new(0.14f, 0.43f, 0.73f, 1f);
    private static readonly Vector4 RunningColor = new(0.18f, 0.82f, 0.42f, 1f);
    private static readonly Vector4 PausedColor = new(0.95f, 0.63f, 0.15f, 1f);
    private static readonly Vector4 ErrorColor = new(0.95f, 0.25f, 0.20f, 1f);
    private static readonly Vector4 InfoColor = new(0.30f, 0.72f, 1f, 1f);

    /// <summary>Edit a validated integer without committing incomplete text.</summary>
    private bool DrawCaretIntegerField(
        string label,
        CaretNumberEditor editor,
        int currentValue,
        int minimum,
        int maximum,
        out int committedValue)
    {
        committedValue = currentValue;
        editor.Synchronize(currentValue);

        ImGui.Text(label);
        ImGui.SetNextItemWidth(-1f);

        bool hasError = editor.Error is not null;
        if (hasError)
        {
            ImGui.PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol.FrameBg, new Vector4(0.30f, 0.07f, 0.07f, 1f));
            ImGui.PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol.Border, ErrorColor);
            ImGui.PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar.FrameBorderSize, 1f);
        }

        bool enterPressed = ImGui.InputText(
            $"##CaretInteger{label}",
            ref editor.Text,
            16,
            ImGuiInputTextFlags.CharsDecimal | ImGuiInputTextFlags.EnterReturnsTrue);
        bool isActive = ImGui.IsItemActive();
        bool escapePressed = editor.WasActive && ImGui.IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey.Escape);
        bool deactivated = editor.WasActive && !isActive;

        if (hasError)
        {
            ImGui.PopStyleVar();
            ImGui.PopStyleColor(2);
        }

        if (ImGui.IsItemHovered())
        {
            ImGui.SetTooltip(
                "Single-click places the caret. Double-click or Ctrl+A selects the complete value. " +
                "Enter or click elsewhere to commit; Escape cancels.");
        }

        bool committed = false;
        if (escapePressed)
        {
            editor.Reset(currentValue);
        }
        else if (enterPressed || deactivated)
        {
            if (int.TryParse(editor.Text, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out int parsed) &&
                parsed >= minimum && parsed <= maximum)
            {
                committedValue = parsed;
                editor.Reset(parsed);
                committed = true;
            }
            else
            {
                editor.Error = $"Enter a whole number from {minimum} to {maximum}.";
            }
        }

        editor.WasActive = isActive && !escapePressed;
        if (editor.Error is not null)
        {
            ImGui.TextColored(ErrorColor, editor.Error);
        }

        return committed;
    }

    private void DrawBlastInspectorTab(Simulation simulation)
    {
        ImGui.Text("BLAST ZONES");
        ImGui.TextDisabled("Persistent, wall-clipped post-event analysis overlays.");
        ImGui.TextDisabled("Single-click a radius field to place the blinking text caret.");
        ImGui.Separator();

        bool showZones = _debug.ShowBlastZones;
        if (ImGui.Checkbox("Show blast zones##InspectorMasterBlastZones", ref showZones))
        {
            _debug.ShowBlastZones = showZones;
        }

        AgentConfig config = simulation.Config.Agent;
        bool radiiLocked = simulation.Environment.HasExplosion();

        bool radiusChanged = false;
        radiusChanged |= DrawCaretBlastZoneRow(
            "Kill",
            "Kill",
            BlastZoneStyle.Kill,
            _debug.ShowKillZone,
            value => _debug.ShowKillZone = value,
            config.HardKillRadius,
            0.10f,
            config.HeatIncapacityRadius - 0.10f,
            radiiLocked,
            value => config.SetBlastZoneRadii(
                value,
                config.HeatIncapacityRadius,
                config.FallenRadius,
                config.InjuryRadius,
                config.HeatRadius));

        radiusChanged |= DrawCaretBlastZoneRow(
            "Incapacitation",
            "Incap",
            BlastZoneStyle.Incapacitation,
            _debug.ShowIncapacitationZone,
            value => _debug.ShowIncapacitationZone = value,
            config.HeatIncapacityRadius,
            config.HardKillRadius + 0.10f,
            config.FallenRadius - 0.10f,
            radiiLocked,
            value => config.SetBlastZoneRadii(
                config.HardKillRadius,
                value,
                config.FallenRadius,
                config.InjuryRadius,
                config.HeatRadius));

        radiusChanged |= DrawCaretBlastZoneRow(
            "Fallen / severe",
            "Fallen",
            BlastZoneStyle.Fallen,
            _debug.ShowFallenZone,
            value => _debug.ShowFallenZone = value,
            config.FallenRadius,
            config.HeatIncapacityRadius + 0.10f,
            config.InjuryRadius - 0.10f,
            radiiLocked,
            value => config.SetBlastZoneRadii(
                config.HardKillRadius,
                config.HeatIncapacityRadius,
                value,
                config.InjuryRadius,
                config.HeatRadius));

        radiusChanged |= DrawCaretBlastZoneRow(
            "Injury",
            "Injury",
            BlastZoneStyle.Injury,
            _debug.ShowInjuryZone,
            value => _debug.ShowInjuryZone = value,
            config.InjuryRadius,
            config.FallenRadius + 0.10f,
            config.HeatRadius - 0.10f,
            radiiLocked,
            value => config.SetBlastZoneRadii(
                config.HardKillRadius,
                config.HeatIncapacityRadius,
                config.FallenRadius,
                value,
                config.HeatRadius));

        radiusChanged |= DrawCaretBlastZoneRow(
            "Panic / threat",
            "Panic",
            BlastZoneStyle.Panic,
            _debug.ShowPanicZone,
            value => _debug.ShowPanicZone = value,
            config.HeatRadius,
            config.InjuryRadius + 0.10f,
            200f,
            radiiLocked,
            value => config.SetBlastZoneRadii(
                config.HardKillRadius,
                config.HeatIncapacityRadius,
                config.FallenRadius,
                config.InjuryRadius,
                value));

        if (radiusChanged)
        {
            _scenarioDirty = true;
            _statusMessage = "Blast-zone radii updated. The validated inner-to-outer order remains intact.";
            ResetBlastRadiusEditors(config);
        }

        if (_blastValidationMessage is not null)
        {
            ImGui.Spacing();
            ImGui.TextColored(ErrorColor, _blastValidationMessage);
        }

        ImGui.Separator();
        if (radiiLocked)
        {
            ImGui.BeginDisabled();
        }

        if (DrawNeutralButton("Reset Zone Defaults", new Vector2(-1f, 0f)))
        {
            config.ResetBlastZoneRadii();
            ResetBlastRadiusEditors(config);
            _scenarioDirty = true;
            _statusMessage = "Blast-zone radii restored to validated defaults.";
        }

        if (radiiLocked)
        {
            ImGui.EndDisabled();
            ImGui.TextColored(
                new Vector4(1f, 0.70f, 0.22f, 1f),
                "Radii are read-only after detonation. Visibility remains adjustable.");
        }
        else
        {
            ImGui.TextDisabled("Enter or click elsewhere to commit. Escape restores the previous value.");
        }

        ImGui.TextDisabled("Guardrail: Kill < Incap < Fallen < Injury < Panic");
        ImGui.Separator();
        DrawBlastLegend();
    }

    private bool DrawCaretBlastZoneRow(
        string label,
        string id,
        Vector4 color,
        bool currentVisibility,
        Action<bool> visibilitySetter,
        float currentRadius,
        float minimum,
        float maximum,
        bool locked,
        Action<float> commit)
    {
        CaretNumberEditor editor = GetBlastRadiusEditor(id, currentRadius);
        editor.Synchronize(currentRadius);

        bool visible = currentVisibility;
        if (ImGui.Checkbox($"##ShowBlastInspector{id}", ref visible))
        {
            visibilitySetter(visible);
        }

        ImGui.SameLine();
        ImGui.TextColored(color, $"{label} (m)");
        ImGui.SameLine(154f);

        if (locked)
        {
            ImGui.BeginDisabled();
        }

        bool committed = false;
        if (ImGui.SmallButton($"-##BlastMinus{id}"))
        {
            float next = Math.Clamp(editor.LastCommittedValue - 0.10f, minimum, maximum);
            commit(next);
            editor.Reset(next);
            _blastValidationMessage = null;
            committed = true;
        }

        ImGui.SameLine();
        ImGui.SetNextItemWidth(82f);

        bool hasError = editor.Error is not null;
        if (hasError)
        {
            ImGui.PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol.FrameBg, new Vector4(0.30f, 0.07f, 0.07f, 1f));
            ImGui.PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol.Border, ErrorColor);
            ImGui.PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar.FrameBorderSize, 1f);
        }

        bool enterPressed = ImGui.InputText(
            $"##BlastCaretRadius{id}",
            ref editor.Text,
            16,
            ImGuiInputTextFlags.CharsDecimal | ImGuiInputTextFlags.EnterReturnsTrue);
        bool isActive = ImGui.IsItemActive();
        bool escapePressed = editor.WasActive && ImGui.IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey.Escape);
        bool deactivated = editor.WasActive && !isActive;

        if (hasError)
        {
            ImGui.PopStyleVar();
            ImGui.PopStyleColor(2);
        }

        if (ImGui.IsItemHovered())
        {
            ImGui.SetTooltip(
                "Single-click places the caret. Double-click or Ctrl+A selects the complete value. " +
                "Enter or click elsewhere to commit; Escape cancels.");
        }

        if (locked)
        {
            editor.Reset(currentRadius);
        }
        else if (escapePressed)
        {
            editor.Reset(currentRadius);
            _blastValidationMessage = null;
        }
        else if (enterPressed || deactivated)
        {
            if (TryParseBoundedFloat(editor.Text, minimum, maximum, out float parsed, out string error))
            {
                commit(parsed);
                editor.Reset(parsed);
                _blastValidationMessage = null;
                committed = true;
            }
            else
            {
                editor.Error = error;
                _blastValidationMessage = $"{label}: {error}";
            }
        }

        editor.WasActive = !locked && isActive && !escapePressed;

        ImGui.SameLine();
        if (ImGui.SmallButton($"+##BlastPlus{id}"))
        {
            float next = Math.Clamp(editor.LastCommittedValue + 0.10f, minimum, maximum);
            commit(next);
            editor.Reset(next);
            _blastValidationMessage = null;
            committed = true;
        }

        if (locked)
        {
            ImGui.EndDisabled();
        }

        return committed;
    }

    private void DrawAgentInspectorTab(Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (SelectedAgentId is null)
        {
            ImGui.Text("NO AGENT SELECTED");
            ImGui.TextWrapped("Choose Select Agent on the Run page, then click a person in the scene.");
            ImGui.Spacing();
            DrawAgentLegend();
            return;
        }

        DrawSelectedAgent(simulation);
    }

    private static void DrawMetricsInspectorTab(Simulation simulation, UiMetrics metrics)
    {
        ImGui.Text("KEY METRICS");
        KeyValue("In room", metrics.InRoom.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        KeyValue("Mobile / responsive", metrics.Mobile.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        KeyValue("Evacuated", metrics.Exited.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        KeyValue("Injured", metrics.Injured.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        KeyValue("Incapacitated", (metrics.TempIncap + metrics.Incapacitated).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        KeyValue("Fatal", metrics.Dead.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        KeyValue("Going to assist", metrics.GoingToAssist.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        KeyValue("Currently helping", metrics.CurrentlyHelping.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        KeyValue("Average panic", metrics.AveragePanic.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        KeyValue("Maximum panic", metrics.MaximumPanic.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        KeyValue("Average congestion", metrics.AverageCongestion.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        KeyValue("Elapsed time", $"{metrics.ElapsedSeconds:F1} s");

        if (simulation.ScenarioType == ScenarioType.Explosion)
        {
            KeyValue("Explosion", simulation.Environment.HasExplosion() ? "TRIGGERED" : "Not triggered");
        }
        else
        {
            KeyValue("Fume release", simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsReleased ? "ACTIVE" : "Not released");
            KeyValue("Fume exposed", metrics.ToxicExposed.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            KeyValue("Fume impaired", metrics.ToxicImpaired.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            KeyValue("Fume incapacitated", metrics.ToxicIncapacitated.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            KeyValue("Avg. cum. exposure", metrics.AverageToxicExposure.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        }

        ImGui.Separator();
        ImGui.Text("EXIT FLOW");
        foreach (KeyValuePair<string, ExitMetrics> pair in simulation.ExitMetrics.OrderBy(pair => pair.Key))
        {
            ImGui.TextDisabled(pair.Key);
            ImGui.SameLine(150f);
            ImGui.Text($"density {pair.Value.Density:F0} | {pair.Value.Flow:F2}/s");
        }

        if (ImGui.CollapsingHeader("ADVANCED METRICS"))
        {
            KeyValue("Crawling", metrics.Crawling.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            KeyValue("Fallen", metrics.Fallen.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            KeyValue("Temp. incap.", metrics.TempIncap.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            KeyValue("Avg. visibility", metrics.AverageVisibility.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            KeyValue("Run-contagion agents", metrics.RunningContagion.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            KeyValue("Threat-escape", metrics.ThreatEscape.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            KeyValue("Following crowd", metrics.FollowingCrowd.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            if (simulation.ScenarioType == ScenarioType.Explosion && simulation.Environment.HasExplosion())
            {
                KeyValue("Debris hits", simulation.DebrisHits.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
                KeyValue("Debris injuries", simulation.DebrisInjuries.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
                KeyValue("Debris incap.", simulation.DebrisIncapacitations.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
                KeyValue("Debris fatal", simulation.DebrisFatalities.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            }
            else if (simulation.ScenarioType == ScenarioType.ToxicFume)
            {
                KeyValue("Peak concentration", metrics.PeakToxicConcentration.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
                KeyValue("Currently high conc.", metrics.ToxicHighConcentration.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            }
        }

        if (ImGui.CollapsingHeader("SCENARIO STATUS"))
        {
            DrawScenarioStatus(simulation);
        }
    }

    private void DrawDebugInspectorTab(Simulation simulation)
    {
        ImGui.Text("PERFORMANCE");

        KeyValue("UI total", $"{_performanceStats.UiMilliseconds:F1} ms");

        KeyValue("Allocated/frame", FormatBytes(_performanceStats.AllocatedBytes));
        KeyValue(
            "Visible agents",
            $"{_performanceStats.VisibleAgents}/{_performanceStats.ActiveAgents}");
        if (_recordingActive || _performanceStats.RecordingQueueDepth > 0 ||
            _performanceStats.RecordingDroppedFrames > 0)
        {

            KeyValue("Dropped frames", _performanceStats.RecordingDroppedFrames.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        }

        ImGui.Separator();
        DrawDebugControls(simulation);
        ImGui.Separator();
        DrawAgentLegend();
        ImGui.Separator();
        DrawModelSummary(simulation);
    }

    private static string FormatBytes(long bytes)
    {
        if (bytes < 1024)
        {
            return $"{bytes} B";
        }

        double kib = bytes / 1024.0;
        if (kib < 1024.0)
        {
            return $"{kib:F1} KiB";
        }

        return $"{kib / 1024.0:F2} MiB";
    }

    private void DrawBlastLegend()
    {
        ImGui.Text("ZONE LEGEND");
        ImGui.TextColored(BlastZoneStyle.Kill, "Kill / terminal direct outcome");
        ImGui.TextColored(BlastZoneStyle.Incapacitation, "Incapacitation");
        ImGui.TextColored(BlastZoneStyle.Fallen, "Fallen / severe");
        ImGui.TextColored(BlastZoneStyle.Injury, "Injury");
        ImGui.TextColored(BlastZoneStyle.Panic, "Panic / threat influence");
    }

    private CaretNumberEditor GetBlastRadiusEditor(string id, float currentValue)
    {
        if (_blastRadiusEditors.TryGetValue(id, out CaretNumberEditor? editor))
        {
            return editor;
        }

        editor = new CaretNumberEditor(currentValue);
        _blastRadiusEditors.Add(id, editor);
        return editor;
    }

    private void ResetBlastRadiusEditors(AgentConfig config)
    {
        ResetBlastRadiusEditor("Kill", config.HardKillRadius);
        ResetBlastRadiusEditor("Incap", config.HeatIncapacityRadius);
        ResetBlastRadiusEditor("Fallen", config.FallenRadius);
        ResetBlastRadiusEditor("Injury", config.InjuryRadius);
        ResetBlastRadiusEditor("Panic", config.HeatRadius);
        _blastValidationMessage = null;
    }

    private void ResetBlastRadiusEditor(string id, float value)
    {
        if (_blastRadiusEditors.TryGetValue(id, out CaretNumberEditor? editor))
        {
            editor.Reset(value);
        }
    }

    private static bool TryParseBoundedFloat(
        string text,
        float minimum,
        float maximum,
        out float parsed,
        out string error)
    {
        if (!float.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out parsed) ||
            !float.IsFinite(parsed))
        {
            error = "Enter a finite numeric value.";
            return false;
        }

        if (parsed < minimum || parsed > maximum)
        {
            error = $"Value must be between {minimum:0.##} and {maximum:0.##}.";
            return false;
        }

        error = string.Empty;
        return true;
    }

    private static (string Label, Vector4 Color) GetModePresentation(Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (simulation.Agents.Count == 0)
        {
            return ("BUILDER", BuilderColor);
        }

        if (simulation.Running)
        {
            return ("RUNNING", RunningColor);
        }

        return simulation.FrameIndex == 0
            ? ("READY", ReadyColor)
            : ("PAUSED", PausedColor);
    }

    private string GetActiveToolLabel(Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (_mode == AppMode.Builder)
        {
            return _builderTool switch
            {
                BuilderTool.Exit => "PLACE EXIT",
                BuilderTool.Blockage => $"PLACE BLOCKAGE - {_assetSelection.BlockageCells * simulation.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters:F1} m SQUARE",
                BuilderTool.CircularBlockage => "PLACE BLOCKAGE - CIRCULAR Ø 2.5 m",
                BuilderTool.Agents => $"PLACE {_agentPlacementCount} AGENT{(_agentPlacementCount == 1 ? string.Empty : "S")}",
                BuilderTool.RoundTableSet => "PLACE ROUND TABLE + 10 PEOPLE",
                BuilderTool.SingleChair => "PLACE CHAIR + 1 PERSON",
                BuilderTool.RectangularTable => "PLACE TABLE - 3 m x 1 m",
                BuilderTool.Stage => simulation.Environment.HasStage ? "STAGE LIMIT REACHED (1/1)" : "PLACE STAGE - 15 m x 6 m",
                BuilderTool.Barricade => $"PLACE ORANGE BARRICADE - 1.5 m | {_assetSelection.RotationDegrees:0.0} deg",
                BuilderTool.ToxicFumeSource => "SET TOXIC-FUME RELEASE POINT",
                _ => "BUILDER",
            };
        }

        if (simulation.ScenarioType == ScenarioType.Explosion &&
            _worldMode == WorldInteractionMode.PlaceExplosion && !simulation.Environment.HasExplosion())
        {
            return "EXPLOSION ARMED - CLICK WORLD";
        }

        return SelectedAgentId is int selectedId ? $"AGENT {selectedId} SELECTED" : "SELECT AGENT";
    }

    private string GetActiveToolInstruction(Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (_mode == AppMode.Builder)
        {
            return _builderTool switch
            {
                BuilderTool.Exit => "Click near a boundary wall to place an exit.",
                BuilderTool.Blockage => $"Click clear floor to place a {_assetSelection.BlockageCells * simulation.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters:F1} m square blockage.",
                BuilderTool.CircularBlockage => "Click clear floor to place a circular blockage with 2.5 m diameter.",
                BuilderTool.Agents => "Click the region where this population group should start; blocked cells are skipped automatically.",
                BuilderTool.RoundTableSet => "Click clear floor to place the round table, ten chairs and ten occupants.",
                BuilderTool.SingleChair => "Click clear floor to place a chair and its occupant.",
                BuilderTool.RectangularTable => "Click clear floor for a blast-movable table. No chairs or occupants are added.",
                BuilderTool.Stage => simulation.Environment.HasStage
                    ? "Only one stage is allowed. Undo its placement before placing another."
                    : "Click clear floor for one fixed stage. Agents go around it, not onto it.",
                BuilderTool.Barricade => "R: +15 deg; Shift+R: -15 deg. Set any angle in ASSETS. Parallel barricades can snap end-to-end.",
                BuilderTool.ToxicFumeSource => "Click clear floor to set the toxic-fume release point.",
                _ => "Choose a builder tool.",
            };
        }

        if (simulation.ScenarioType == ScenarioType.Explosion &&
            _worldMode == WorldInteractionMode.PlaceExplosion && !simulation.Environment.HasExplosion())
        {
            return "Click clear floor once to trigger the explosion and begin crowd dispersion.";
        }

        return "Click a humanoid to inspect it; use the mouse wheel over the world to zoom.";
    }

    private static Vector4 GetStatusMessageColor(string message)
    {
        if (message.Contains("failed", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            message.Contains("rejected", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            message.Contains("required", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            return ErrorColor;
        }

        if (message.Contains("saved", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            message.Contains("loaded", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            message.Contains("running", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            message.Contains("placed", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            return RunningColor;
        }

        return InfoColor;
    }

    private static bool DrawNeutralButton(string label, Vector2 size)
        => ImGui.Button(label, size);

    private static bool DrawActionButton(string label, Vector4 color, Vector2 size)
    {
        ImGui.PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol.Button, color);
        ImGui.PushStyleColor(
            ImGuiCol.ButtonHovered,
            new Vector4(
                Math.Clamp(color.X + 0.10f, 0f, 1f),
                Math.Clamp(color.Y + 0.10f, 0f, 1f),
                Math.Clamp(color.Z + 0.10f, 0f, 1f),
                color.W));
        ImGui.PushStyleColor(
            ImGuiCol.ButtonActive,
            new Vector4(color.X * 0.82f, color.Y * 0.82f, color.Z * 0.82f, color.W));
        // Amber/green actions need dark text; blue actions use the normal light text.
        float luminance = 0.2126f * color.X + 0.7152f * color.Y + 0.0722f * color.Z;
        ImGui.PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol.Text, luminance > 0.55f
            ? new Vector4(0.08f, 0.10f, 0.14f, 1f)
            : new Vector4(0.94f, 0.96f, 0.99f, 1f));
        bool clicked = ImGui.Button(label, size);
        ImGui.PopStyleColor(4);
        return clicked;
    }

    private readonly record struct UiMetrics(
        int InRoom,
        int Mobile,
        int Exited,
        int Injured,
        int Crawling,
        int Fallen,
        int TempIncap,
        int Incapacitated,
        int Dead,
        float AveragePanic,
        float MaximumPanic,
        float AverageVisibility,
        float AverageCongestion,
        int RunningContagion,
        int ThreatEscape,
        int FollowingCrowd,
        int GoingToAssist,
        int CurrentlyHelping,
        int ToxicExposed,
        int ToxicImpaired,
        int ToxicIncapacitated,
        int ToxicHighConcentration,
        float AverageToxicExposure,
        float PeakToxicConcentration,
        float ElapsedSeconds)
    {
        public static UiMetrics Capture(Simulation simulation)
        {
            int inRoom = 0;
            int mobile = 0;
            int exited = 0;
            int injured = 0;
            int crawling = 0;
            int fallen = 0;
            int tempIncap = 0;
            int incapacitated = 0;
            int dead = 0;
            int runningContagion = 0;
            int threatEscape = 0;
            int followingCrowd = 0;
            int goingToAssist = 0;
            int currentlyHelping = 0;
            int toxicExposed = 0;
            int toxicImpaired = 0;
            int toxicIncapacitated = 0;
            int toxicHighConcentration = 0;
            float toxicExposureSum = 0f;
            float peakToxicConcentration = 0f;
            int toxicExposureSamples = 0;
            float panicSum = 0f;
            float maximumPanic = 0f;
            float visibilitySum = 0f;
            float congestionSum = 0f;

            foreach (Agent agent in simulation.Agents)
            {
                switch (agent.State)
                {
                    case AgentState.Exited: exited++; break;
                    case AgentState.Injured: injured++; break;
                    case AgentState.Crawling: crawling++; break;
                    case AgentState.Fallen: fallen++; break;
                    case AgentState.TempIncap: tempIncap++; break;
                    case AgentState.Incapacitated: incapacitated++; break;
                    case AgentState.Dead: dead++; break;
                }

                if (simulation.ScenarioType == ScenarioType.ToxicFume)
                {
                    switch (agent.ToxicExposureStatus)
                    {
                        case ToxicExposureStatus.Exposed:
                            toxicExposed++;
                            break;
                        case ToxicExposureStatus.Impaired:
                            toxicExposed++;
                            toxicImpaired++;
                            break;
                        case ToxicExposureStatus.Incapacitated:
                            toxicExposed++;
                            toxicIncapacitated++;
                            break;
                    }

                    if (agent.IsActive &&
                        agent.CurrentToxicConcentration >= simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration.DangerConcentration)
                    {
                        toxicHighConcentration++;
                    }

                    toxicExposureSum += agent.CumulativeToxicExposure;
                    peakToxicConcentration = Math.Max(peakToxicConcentration, agent.PeakToxicConcentration);
                    toxicExposureSamples++;
                }

                if (!agent.IsActive)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                inRoom++;
                bool isMobile = agent.State is not
                    (AgentState.Dead or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.TempIncap or AgentState.Fallen);
                if (!isMobile)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                mobile++;
                float panic = agent.PanicLevel;
                panicSum += panic;
                maximumPanic = Math.Max(maximumPanic, panic);
                visibilitySum += agent.VisibilityFactor;
                congestionSum += agent.LocalCongestion;
                if (agent.LastRunningPanicStimulus > 0.05f) runningContagion++;

                switch (agent.Intent)
                {
                    case BehaviorIntent.ThreatEscape:
                        threatEscape++;
                        break;
                    case BehaviorIntent.FollowCrowd:
                        followingCrowd++;
                        break;
                    case BehaviorIntent.AssistCasualty:
                        if (agent.AssistPauseUntilFrame >= 0 && simulation.FrameIndex < agent.AssistPauseUntilFrame)
                            currentlyHelping++;
                        else
                            goingToAssist++;
                        break;
                }
            }

            float inverseMobile = mobile > 0 ? 1f / mobile : 0f;
            return new UiMetrics(
                InRoom: inRoom,
                Mobile: mobile,
                Exited: exited,
                Injured: injured,
                Crawling: crawling,
                Fallen: fallen,
                TempIncap: tempIncap,
                Incapacitated: incapacitated,
                Dead: dead,
                AveragePanic: panicSum * inverseMobile,
                MaximumPanic: maximumPanic,
                AverageVisibility: mobile == 0 ? 1f : visibilitySum * inverseMobile,
                AverageCongestion: congestionSum * inverseMobile,
                RunningContagion: runningContagion,
                ThreatEscape: threatEscape,
                FollowingCrowd: followingCrowd,
                GoingToAssist: goingToAssist,
                CurrentlyHelping: currentlyHelping,
                ToxicExposed: toxicExposed,
                ToxicImpaired: toxicImpaired,
                ToxicIncapacitated: toxicIncapacitated,
                ToxicHighConcentration: toxicHighConcentration,
                AverageToxicExposure: toxicExposureSamples > 0 ? toxicExposureSum / toxicExposureSamples : 0f,
                PeakToxicConcentration: peakToxicConcentration,
                ElapsedSeconds: simulation.FrameIndex * simulation.Config.Agent.Dt);
        }
    }

}
```

## src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/UI/SimulationUi.ToxicFume.cs

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using ImGuiNET;

namespace CrowdSim.OpenGL.UI;

public sealed partial class SimulationUi
{
    private void DrawScenarioSelectionScreen(Simulation simulation, Vector2 displaySize)
    {
        ImGui.SetNextWindowPos(Vector2.Zero, ImGuiCond.Always);
        ImGui.SetNextWindowSize(displaySize, ImGuiCond.Always);
        ImGuiWindowFlags flags = ImGuiWindowFlags.NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags.NoMove |
            ImGuiWindowFlags.NoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags.NoCollapse | ImGuiWindowFlags.NoSavedSettings;
        ImGui.Begin("##scenario-selection", flags);
        Vector2 available = ImGui.GetContentRegionAvail();
        float width = Math.Min(1040f, Math.Max(1f, available.X - 48f));
        float height = Math.Min(650f, Math.Max(1f, available.Y - 32f));
        ImGui.SetCursorPos(new Vector2(
            ImGui.GetCursorPosX() + Math.Max(0f, (available.X - width) * 0.5f),
            ImGui.GetCursorPosY() + Math.Max(0f, (available.Y - height) * 0.45f)));
        ImGui.BeginChild("##scenario-selection-card", new Vector2(width, height), ImGuiChildFlags.Borders);
        ImGui.TextColored(InfoColor, "CROWD SIM");
        ImGui.Spacing();
        ImGui.SetWindowFontScale(1.35f);
        ImGui.Text("Create your simulation workspace");
        ImGui.SetWindowFontScale(1f);
        ImGui.TextWrapped("Build a scene, run an event, and inspect how the crowd responds.");
        ImGui.Spacing();
        ImGui.Separator();
        ImGui.Spacing();
        ImGui.Text("CHOOSE A SCENARIO");
        DrawMutedText("Both scenarios share your scene tools and crowd behaviour controls.");
        ImGui.Spacing();

        float contentWidth = ImGui.GetContentRegionAvail().X;
        bool sideBySide = contentWidth >= 650f;
        float cardWidth = sideBySide ? (contentWidth - ImGui.GetStyle().ItemSpacing.X) * 0.5f : contentWidth;
        DrawScenarioChoice(simulation, ScenarioType.Explosion, cardWidth);
        if (sideBySide) ImGui.SameLine();
        DrawScenarioChoice(simulation, ScenarioType.ToxicFume, cardWidth);

        ImGui.Spacing();
        ImGui.Separator();
        ImGui.Spacing();
        ImGui.Text("OPEN A SAVED SCENE");
        string preview = _selectedScenarioIndex >= 0 && _selectedScenarioIndex < _savedScenarioNames.Length
            ? _savedScenarioNames[_selectedScenarioIndex] : "Choose a saved scene...";
        ImGui.SetNextItemWidth(Math.Max(1f, ImGui.GetContentRegionAvail().X - 170f));
        if (ImGui.BeginCombo("##StartupSavedScenario", preview))
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < _savedScenarioNames.Length; index++)
            {
                bool selected = index == _selectedScenarioIndex;
                if (ImGui.Selectable(_savedScenarioNames[index], selected)) _selectedScenarioIndex = index;
                if (selected) ImGui.SetItemDefaultFocus();
            }
            ImGui.EndCombo();
        }
        bool canLoad = _selectedScenarioIndex >= 0 && _selectedScenarioIndex < _savedScenarioNames.Length;
        ImGui.SameLine();
        ImGui.BeginDisabled(!canLoad);
        if (DrawNeutralButton("Open scene", new Vector2(150f, 0f)) && canLoad)
            _scenarioLoadRequested = _savedScenarioNames[_selectedScenarioIndex];
        ImGui.EndDisabled();
        ImGui.TextWrapped(_savedScenarioNames.Length == 0
            ? "No saved scenes yet. Create a scenario and use Save scene in the workspace."
            : "Saved scenes open in the builder so you can review or edit the layout before running.");
        if (ImGui.CollapsingHeader("Model notes"))
            ImGui.TextWrapped("Toxic Fume uses normalised concentration and exposure for crowd-response comparison. It is a simplified model, not real-chemical CFD.");
        ImGui.EndChild();
        ImGui.End();
    }

    /// <summary>Scenario choice cards provide the same entry points in wide and narrow windows.</summary>
    private void DrawScenarioChoice(Simulation simulation, ScenarioType type, float width)
    {
        bool explosion = type == ScenarioType.Explosion;
        Vector4 accent = explosion ? new Vector4(0.96f, 0.66f, 0.27f, 1f) : new Vector4(0.36f, 0.82f, 0.63f, 1f);
        ImGui.BeginChild("##scenario-choice-" + type, new Vector2(width, 210f), ImGuiChildFlags.Borders);
        ImGui.TextColored(accent, explosion ? "EXPLOSION" : "TOXIC FUME");
        ImGui.Spacing();
        ImGui.TextWrapped(explosion
            ? "Explore evacuation after a sudden event, including shock, debris, casualties and crowd response."
            : "Explore evacuation around a spreading plume. Compute the field during setup, then release it during the run.");
        ImGui.Spacing();
        DrawMutedText(explosion ? "Build scene > Start > Place explosion" : "Build scene > Compute plume > Start > Release");
        ImGui.Spacing();
        if (DrawActionButton(explosion ? "Create explosion scenario" : "Create toxic fume scenario", accent, new Vector2(-1f, 38f)))
        {
            simulation.SetScenarioType(type);
            _mode = AppMode.Builder;
            _controlPanelTab = ControlPanelTab.Scene;
            _builderTool = BuilderTool.Exit;
            _scenarioName = explosion ? "explosion_scenario" : "toxic_fume_scenario";
            _scenarioDirty = true;
            _inspector.SelectTab(InspectorTab.Overview);
            _statusMessage = explosion
                ? "Place exits and people, then finalise the scene."
                : "Place exits, people and a fume source. Compute dispersion before finalising.";
        }
        ImGui.EndChild();
    }

    private void DrawToxicFumeBuilderControls(Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (!ImGui.CollapsingHeader("TOXIC FUME CONFIGURATION", ImGuiTreeNodeFlags.DefaultOpen))
        {
            return;
        }

        ToxicFumeConfig config = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration;
        Vector2? source = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.SourcePosition;
        DrawMutedText("Compute the plume during setup, then preview it before running.");
        KeyValue("Release point", source is Vector2 point
            ? $"({point.X:F1} m, {point.Y:F1} m)"
            : "Not placed");

        bool sourceToolActive = _builderTool == BuilderTool.ToxicFumeSource;
        DrawActiveButton(
            source is null ? "Set Release Point" : "Move Release Point",
            sourceToolActive,
            () =>
            {
                _builderTool = BuilderTool.ToxicFumeSource;
                _statusMessage = "Toxic-fume release-point tool active. Click clear floor inside the room.";
            });

        float initialRadius = config.InitialRadiusMeters;
        float spreadSpeed = config.DispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond;
        float maxExtent = config.MaximumExtentMeters;
        float releaseDuration = config.ReleaseDurationSeconds;
        float driftDirection = config.DriftDirectionDegrees;
        float driftBias = config.DriftBias;
        float awareness = config.AwarenessConcentration;
        float danger = config.DangerConcentration;
        float impairment = config.ImpairmentExposure;
        float incapacitation = config.IncapacitationExposure;

        bool changed = false;
        changed |= DrawFullWidthSlider(
            "Initial cloud radius", "FumeInitialRadius", ref initialRadius, 0.20f, 5.0f, "%.2f m",
            "Size of the initially affected area at release time.");
        changed |= DrawFullWidthSlider(
            "Dispersion speed", "FumeSpreadSpeed", ref spreadSpeed, 0.05f, 2.0f, "%.2f m/s",
            "Abstract speed used to precompute when the plume reaches neighbouring open cells.");
        maxExtent = Math.Max(maxExtent, initialRadius);
        changed |= DrawFullWidthSlider(
            "Maximum plume extent", "FumeMaxExtent", ref maxExtent, Math.Max(2.0f, initialRadius), 60.0f, "%.1f m",
            "Maximum path distance the precomputed plume may travel from its source.");
        changed |= DrawFullWidthSlider(
            "Release duration", "FumeReleaseDuration", ref releaseDuration, 1f, 180f, "%.0f s",
            "How long each reached region remains supplied before the generic post-release decay begins.");

        if (ImGui.CollapsingHeader("FUME ADVANCED"))
        {
            changed |= DrawFullWidthSlider(
                "Drift direction", "FumeDriftDirection", ref driftDirection, 0f, 359f, "%.0f deg",
                "Abstract directional bias for the precomputed plume. 0 degrees points along +X in the simulation world.");
            changed |= DrawFullWidthSlider(
                "Directional drift", "FumeDriftBias", ref driftBias, 0f, 1f, "%.2f",
                "0 spreads symmetrically through open cells; 1 strongly favours the configured drift direction.");
            changed |= DrawFullWidthSlider(
                "Awareness threshold", "FumeAwareness", ref awareness, 0.02f, 0.80f, "%.2f",
                "Normalized concentration at which direct fume awareness can begin. This is a simulator threshold, not a chemical limit.");
            danger = Math.Max(danger, awareness + 0.05f);
            changed |= DrawFullWidthSlider(
                "High-threat threshold", "FumeDanger", ref danger, Math.Min(0.95f, awareness + 0.05f), 0.98f, "%.2f",
                "Normalized concentration that applies a stronger panic stimulus.");
            changed |= DrawFullWidthSlider(
                "Impairment exposure", "FumeImpairment", ref impairment, 1f, 120f, "%.1f",
                "Generic cumulative concentration-seconds before mobility begins to reduce.");
            incapacitation = Math.Max(incapacitation, impairment + 1f);
            changed |= DrawFullWidthSlider(
                "Incapacitation exposure", "FumeIncap", ref incapacitation, impairment + 1f, 300f, "%.1f",
                "Generic cumulative concentration-seconds before the simulator marks an agent incapacitated.");
        }

        if (changed)
        {
            config.SetValues(
                initialRadius, spreadSpeed, maxExtent, releaseDuration,
                driftDirection, driftBias, awareness, danger, impairment, incapacitation);
            simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.InvalidatePrecomputation();
            _scenarioDirty = true;
            _statusMessage = "Fume settings changed. Recompute the plume before finalising.";
        }

        ImGui.Spacing();
        bool canCompute = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.SourcePosition is not null;
        if (!canCompute)
        {
            ImGui.BeginDisabled();
        }

        if (DrawActionButton(
                simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsPrecomputed ? "Recompute Fume Dispersion" : "Compute Fume Dispersion",
                new Vector4(0.13f, 0.58f, 0.42f, 1f),
                new Vector2(-1f, 36f)))
        {
            try
            {
                simulation.PrecomputeToxicFume();
                _statusMessage =
                    $"Fume field ready: {simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.ReachableCellCount:N0} reachable cells, " +
                    $"max arrival {simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.PrecomputedMaximumArrivalSeconds:F1} s.";
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                _statusMessage = $"Fume computation failed: {exception.Message}";
            }
        }

        if (!canCompute)
        {
            ImGui.EndDisabled();
            ImGui.TextColored(new Vector4(1f, 0.67f, 0.22f, 1f), "Place a release point before computing the plume.");
        }

        if (simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(simulation))
        {
            ImGui.TextColored(new Vector4(0.28f, 0.86f, 0.48f, 1f), "READY - PRECOMPUTED");
            KeyValue("Reachable cells", simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.ReachableCellCount.ToString("N0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            KeyValue("Grid cells", simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.GridCellCount.ToString("N0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            KeyValue("Grid resolution", $"{simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.GridCellSizeMeters:F2} m");
            KeyValue("Cache", FormatBytes(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.EstimatedCacheBytes));
            KeyValue("Precompute time", $"{simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.LastPrecomputeMilliseconds:F1} ms");

            float previewMax = Math.Max(
                10f,
                simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.PrecomputedMaximumArrivalSeconds +
                config.ReleaseDurationSeconds + config.PostReleaseDecaySeconds);
            float preview = Math.Clamp(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.PreviewTimeSeconds, 0f, previewMax);
            ImGui.Text("Preview plume timeline");
            ImGui.SetNextItemWidth(-1f);
            if (ImGui.SliderFloat("##FumePreviewTimeline", ref preview, 0f, previewMax, "%.1f s"))
            {
                simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.PreviewTimeSeconds = preview;
            }
            DrawMutedText("Drag the timeline to preview the plume before running the crowd.");
        }
        else if (source is not null)
        {
            string readiness = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsPrecomputed
                ? "STALE - geometry/configuration changed; recompute dispersion."
                : "NOT READY - dispersion must be computed.";
            ImGui.TextColored(new Vector4(1f, 0.67f, 0.22f, 1f), readiness);
        }

        if (DrawNeutralButton("Reset Fume Defaults", new Vector2(-1f, 0f)))
        {
            config.ResetDefaults();
            simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.InvalidatePrecomputation();
            _scenarioDirty = true;
            _statusMessage = "Toxic-fume defaults restored. Recompute the plume.";
        }

        ImGui.Separator();
    }

    private void DrawToxicFumeRuntimeEventControls(Simulation simulation)
    {
        ImGui.Spacing();
        ImGui.Text("TOXIC FUME EVENT");
        Vector2? source = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.SourcePosition;
        KeyValue("Source", source is Vector2 point ? $"({point.X:F1}, {point.Y:F1}) m" : "Not set");

        if (simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsReleased)
        {
            ImGui.TextColored(new Vector4(0.42f, 0.90f, 0.55f, 1f), "RELEASE ACTIVE");
            KeyValue("Elapsed", $"{simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.GetElapsedSeconds(simulation):F1} s");
            DrawMutedText("The plume follows the dispersion computed during setup.");
            return;
        }

        bool canRelease = simulation.Running && simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(simulation);
        if (!canRelease)
        {
            ImGui.BeginDisabled();
        }

        if (DrawActionButton("Release Toxic Fume", new Vector4(0.14f, 0.62f, 0.40f, 1f), new Vector2(-1f, 36f)))
        {
            bool triggered = simulation.TriggerToxicFumeRelease();
            _statusMessage = triggered
                ? "Toxic fume released. Cached plume replay is now active; crowd response remains live."
                : "Toxic-fume release rejected.";
        }

        if (!canRelease)
        {
            ImGui.EndDisabled();
            DrawMutedText(simulation.Running
                ? "A valid precomputed fume cache is required."
                : "Start the simulation before releasing the fume.");
        }
    }

    private void DrawToxicFumeInspectorTab(Simulation simulation)
    {
        ToxicFumeConfig config = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration;
        ImGui.Text("TOXIC FUME FIELD");
        DrawMutedText("Inspect the plume and its concentration thresholds.");
        ImGui.Separator();

        KeyValue("Cache", simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(simulation)
            ? "READY"
            : simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsPrecomputed ? "STALE" : "Not computed");
        KeyValue("Release", simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsReleased ? "ACTIVE" : "Not released");
        if (simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsReleased)
        {
            KeyValue("Elapsed", $"{simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.GetElapsedSeconds(simulation):F1} s");
        }
        KeyValue("Initial radius", $"{config.InitialRadiusMeters:F2} m");
        KeyValue("Dispersion speed", $"{config.DispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond:F2} m/s");
        KeyValue("Maximum extent", $"{config.MaximumExtentMeters:F1} m");
        KeyValue("Release duration", $"{config.ReleaseDurationSeconds:F0} s");
        KeyValue("Drift", $"{config.DriftDirectionDegrees:F0} deg / {config.DriftBias:F2}");
        KeyValue("Awareness threshold", config.AwarenessConcentration.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        KeyValue("High-threat threshold", config.DangerConcentration.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));

        ImGui.Separator();
        bool showFume = _debug.ShowToxicFume;
        if (ImGui.Checkbox("Show concentration plume", ref showFume))
        {
            _debug.ShowToxicFume = showFume;
        }
        bool showGrid = _debug.ShowToxicGrid;
        if (ImGui.Checkbox("Show fume grid cells", ref showGrid))
        {
            _debug.ShowToxicGrid = showGrid;
        }
        DrawMutedText("Display options change the view without changing the simulation.");
    }

    private void InvalidateToxicFumeForGeometryChange(Simulation simulation)
    {
        if (simulation.ScenarioType != ScenarioType.ToxicFume)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsPrecomputed)
        {
            simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.InvalidatePrecomputation();
            _statusMessage = "Scene geometry changed. Toxic-fume dispersion must be recomputed.";
        }
    }
}
```
