## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/BarricadeAngleTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using System.Text.Json;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Free-angle footprint, placement, collision and navigation integration.</summary>
public sealed class BarricadeAngleTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData(15f)]
    [InlineData(30f)]
    [InlineData(37.5f)]
    [InlineData(45f)]
    [InlineData(60f)]
    [InlineData(120f)]
    [InlineData(225f)]
    [InlineData(359.9f)]
    [InlineData(-22.5f)]
    [InlineData(382.5f)]
    public void MetricBaseRetainsTheAuthoredAngle(float degrees)
    {
        FurnitureSet set = new(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f, 15f), Radians(degrees));
        Wall wall = Assert.IsType<Wall>(set.StaticObstacle);
        Assert.NotNull(wall.OrientedFootprint);
        OrientedRectangle shape = wall.OrientedFootprint.Value;
        float expected = (degrees % 360f + 360f) % 360f;
        Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(set.Rotation * 180f / MathF.PI - expected), 0f, 0.0001f);
        Assert.Equal(new Vector2(0.75f, 0.20f), shape.HalfExtents);
        Span<Vector2> corners = stackalloc Vector2[4];
        shape.CopyExpandedCorners(corners, 0f);
        Assert.Equal(1.5f, Vector2.Distance(corners[0], corners[1]), 4);
        Assert.Equal(0.4f, Vector2.Distance(corners[1], corners[2]), 4);
        foreach (Vector2 corner in corners)
        {
            Assert.InRange(corner.X, wall.X1 - 0.00001f, wall.X2 + 0.00001f);
            Assert.InRange(corner.Y, wall.Y1 - 0.00001f, wall.Y2 + 0.00001f);
        }
        Assert.Equal(0, FurnitureSet.GetSeatCount(FurnitureKind.Barricade));
        Assert.Null(set.Table);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EmptyBroadPhaseCornersDoNotBecomeInvisibleObstacles()
    {
        Simulation sim = WithBarrier(45f);
        Vector2 free = new(15.6f, 14.4f);
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.IsPointBlocked(free, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
        Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(free, free + new Vector2(0.1f, -0.1f), 0.2f));
        Assert.True(EvacuationSystem.HasTraversablePath(free, free + new Vector2(0.1f, -0.1f), sim.Environment.Walls, 0.2f));
        Assert.False(sim.HasTraversablePath(new Vector2(14f, 16f), new Vector2(16f, 14f), 0.2f));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(0.1f, true)]
    [InlineData(0.15f, false)]
    public void SweptBodyClearanceUsesRoundedCornersNotAnOversizedBox(float offset, bool blocked)
    {
        OrientedRectangle shape = new(new Vector2(10f), new Vector2(0.75f, 0.2f), Radians(37.5f));
        Vector2 point = shape.ToWorld(new Vector2(0.75f + offset, 0.2f + offset));
        Assert.Equal(blocked, shape.IntersectsSegment(point, point, 0.2f));
        Assert.Equal(blocked, shape.Contains(point, 0.2f));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(22.5f)]
    [InlineData(45f)]
    [InlineData(70f)]
    public void DiagonalRowsSnapFlushAndRejectRealOverlap(float degrees)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Vector2 origin = new(5f, 5f);
        OrientedRectangle shape = new(origin, new Vector2(0.75f, 0.2f), Radians(degrees));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, origin, Radians(degrees)));
        for (int i = 1; i < 8; i++)
        {
            Vector2 expected = origin + shape.AxisX * (1.5f * i);
            Vector2 requested = expected + shape.AxisY * 0.10f;
            // Reverse facing must still join the same row.
            float angle = Radians(i % 2 == 0 ? degrees + 180f : degrees);
            int version = sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion;
            Vector2 snapped = sim.Environment.SnapBarricadePlacement(requested, angle);
            Assert.InRange(Vector2.Distance(expected, snapped), 0f, 0.00002f);
            Assert.Equal(version, sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion);
            Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, snapped, angle));
        }
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.CanPlaceFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade,
            origin - shape.AxisX * 1.49f, Radians(degrees)));
        Assert.Equal(8, sim.Environment.Furniture.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DifferentAnglesDoNotSnapOrSilentlyChangeTheAngle()
    {
        Simulation sim = WithBarrier(30f);
        Vector2 requested = new Vector2(15f, 15f) + new Vector2(MathF.Cos(Radians(30f)), MathF.Sin(Radians(30f))) * 1.5f;
        Assert.Equal(requested, sim.Environment.SnapBarricadePlacement(requested, Radians(45f)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PositiveOverlapIsRejectedEvenWhenAnglesDiffer()
    {
        Simulation sim = WithBarrier(30f);
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.CanPlaceFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f), Radians(120f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.CanPlaceFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(18f, 15f), Radians(120f)));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(false)]
    [InlineData(true)]
    public void UnoccupiedCornerCanContainASmallWallOrCircle(bool circle)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Vector2 corner = new(15.55f, 14.45f);
        if (circle) sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Add(new CircleBlockage(corner, 0.08f));
        else sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(corner.X - 0.06f, corner.Y - 0.06f,
            corner.X + 0.06f, corner.Y + 0.06f));
        sim.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f), Radians(45f)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SpawnAndRestoreUseTheRealFootprint()
    {
        Simulation sim = WithBarrier(45f);
        Vector2 point = new(15.6f, 14.4f);
        sim.Environment.AgentSpawnGroups.Add(new AgentSpawnGroup(point, new[] { point }));
        ScenarioDefinition saved = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(sim, 1, "free-corner");
        Simulation restored = new(agentCount: 0, config: saved.CreateConfig());
        saved.ApplyLayout(restored);
        restored.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(restored.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions());
        Assert.Equal(point, Assert.Single(restored.Agents).Position);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(15f)]
    [InlineData(37.5f)]
    [InlineData(135f)]
    public void CollisionPushesAlongTheRotatedSurfaceNormal(float degrees)
    {
        Simulation sim = WithBarrier(degrees);
        OrientedRectangle shape = sim.Environment.Furniture[0].StaticObstacle!.OrientedFootprint!.Value;
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(new[] { new Vector2(20f) });
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.Position = shape.ToWorld(new Vector2(0f, 0.30f));
        agent.Velocity = -shape.AxisY * 0.05f;
        sim.ResolveSolidCollisions(agent);
        Vector2 local = shape.ToLocal(agent.Position);
        Assert.InRange(local.Y, 0.39999f, 0.401f);
        Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(local.X), 0f, 0.0001f);
        Assert.True(Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, shape.AxisY) >= -0.00001f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FinalContainmentDoesNotTeleportAnAgentInAFreeCorner()
    {
        Simulation sim = WithBarrier(45f);
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(new[] { new Vector2(15.6f, 14.4f) });
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        Vector2 before = agent.Position;
        sim.MoveAgent(agent);
        Assert.InRange(Vector2.Distance(before, agent.Position), 0f, 0.00001f);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(30f)]
    [InlineData(45f)]
    public void MovingAgentCannotCrossTheThinRotatedBase(float degrees)
    {
        Simulation sim = WithBarrier(degrees);
        OrientedRectangle shape = sim.Environment.Furniture[0].StaticObstacle!.OrientedFootprint!.Value;
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(new[] { shape.ToWorld(new Vector2(0f, -0.75f)) });
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            agent.Velocity = shape.AxisY * 0.2f;
            sim.MoveAgent(agent);
            Assert.True(shape.ToLocal(agent.Position).Y <= -0.399f);
        }
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.Explosion)]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.ToxicFume)]
    public void SavedAnglesAndCheckpointReplayDoNotRequantize(ScenarioType scenario)
    {
        Simulation sim = WithBarrier(37.5f);
        sim.SetScenarioType(scenario);
        ScenarioDefinition saved = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(sim, 0, "angled-barrier");
        ScenarioDefinition loaded = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ScenarioDefinition>(JsonSerializer.Serialize(saved))!;
        Simulation restored = new(agentCount: 0, config: loaded.CreateConfig());
        loaded.ApplyLayout(restored);
        Simulation replay = FinalizedSceneCheckpoint.Capture(restored, 0, "angled-barrier").CreateReadySimulation();
        Assert.Equal(Radians(37.5f), Assert.Single(replay.Environment.Furniture).Rotation, 5);
        Assert.Equal(sim.Environment.Furniture[0].StaticObstacle, replay.Environment.Furniture[0].StaticObstacle);
        Assert.False(replay.Environment.IsPointBlocked(new Vector2(15.6f, 14.4f), 0.2f));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FineGridCanConnectFromAFreeCornerInsideTheBroadPhaseBox()
    {
        Simulation sim = WithBarrier(45f);
        Vector2 start = new(15.5f, 14.5f), goal = new(17f, 13f);
        FurnitureGridPlanner planner = new(0.25f);
        IReadOnlyList<Vector2> route = planner.Plan(sim, start, goal, 0.216f);
        Assert.NotEmpty(route);
        Assert.Equal(goal, route[^1]);
        foreach (Vector2 point in route)
        {
            Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(start, point, 0.216f));
            start = point;
        }
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(15f)]
    [InlineData(37.5f)]
    [InlineData(75f)]
    public void VisibilityRouteGoesAroundActualAngledCorners(float degrees)
    {
        Simulation sim = WithBarrier(degrees);
        OrientedRectangle shape = sim.Environment.Furniture[0].StaticObstacle!.OrientedFootprint!.Value;
        Vector2 start = shape.ToWorld(new Vector2(0f, -2f)), goal = shape.ToWorld(new Vector2(0f, 2f));
        IReadOnlyList<Vector2> route = new VisibilityGraphPlanner(sim.Config.Agent).Plan(sim, start, goal);
        Assert.NotEmpty(route);
        Assert.Equal(goal, route[^1]);
        foreach (Vector2 point in route)
        {
            Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(start, point, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
            start = point;
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AngledGeometryStillReusesTheSharedExitField()
    {
        Simulation sim = WithBarrier(37.5f);
        SharedExitFields fields = new();
        Vector2 goal = new(20f, 10f);
        Assert.True(fields.TryDirection(sim, new Vector2(15.5f, 14.5f), goal, out _));
        Assert.True(fields.TryDirection(sim, new Vector2(16f, 13.5f), goal, out _));
        Assert.Equal(1, fields.FieldBuilds);
        Assert.Equal(1, fields.GeometryRefreshes);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DiagonalBarrierDoesNotBecomeABlastOrFumeWall()
    {
        Simulation sim = WithBarrier(37.5f);
        Assert.True(sim.HasLineOfSight(new Vector2(14f), new Vector2(16f)));
        Assert.False(ExplosionSystem.BlastPathIsBlocked(new Vector2(14f), new Vector2(16f), sim.Environment.Walls));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.IsFumeBlocked(new Vector2(15f), 0.2f));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OffFloorRotatedCornersAreRejected()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.CanPlaceFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f, 0.75f), Radians(45f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.CanPlaceFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f, 1.4f), Radians(45f)));
    }

    private static float Radians(float degrees) => degrees * MathF.PI / 180f;

    private static Simulation WithBarrier(float degrees)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 2731);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f), Radians(degrees)));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        return sim;
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/BarricadeTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using System.Text.Json;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Road-barrier geometry, snapping, navigation, persistence and hazard integration.</summary>
public sealed class BarricadeTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData(0f, 1.5f, 0.4f)]
    [InlineData(90f, 0.4f, 1.5f)]
    [InlineData(180f, 1.5f, 0.4f)]
    [InlineData(270f, 0.4f, 1.5f)]
    public void BarrierHasExactMetricFootprintAndNoOccupants(float degrees, float xSize, float ySize)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f, 15f), degrees * MathF.PI / 180f));
        FurnitureSet set = Assert.Single(sim.Environment.Furniture);
        Wall bounds = Assert.IsType<Wall>(set.StaticObstacle);
        Assert.Equal(xSize, bounds.X2 - bounds.X1, 4);
        Assert.Equal(ySize, bounds.Y2 - bounds.Y1, 4);
        Assert.Equal(1f, FurnitureSet.BarricadeHeight);
        Assert.True(bounds.IsFurniture);
        Assert.False(bounds.IsMovableFurniture);
        Assert.Null(set.Table);
        Assert.Empty(set.Chairs);
        Assert.Equal(0, sim.Environment.PlannedAgentCount);
        Assert.Equal(0, FurnitureSet.GetSeatCount(FurnitureKind.Barricade));
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ExistingPersistedKindNumbersAreUnchanged()
    {
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet);
        Assert.Equal(1, (int)FurnitureKind.SingleChair);
        Assert.Equal(2, (int)FurnitureKind.RectangularTable);
        Assert.Equal(3, (int)FurnitureKind.Stage);
        Assert.Equal(4, (int)FurnitureKind.Barricade);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.Explosion)]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.ToxicFume)]
    public void MultipleBarriersCanTouchAndUndoRemovesOnlyTheLast(ScenarioType scenario)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        sim.SetScenarioType(scenario);
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
            Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(10f + 1.5f * i, 10f)));
        Assert.Equal(8, sim.Environment.Furniture.Count);
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.HasStage);
        Wall last = Assert.IsType<Wall>(sim.Environment.Furniture[^1].StaticObstacle);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.UndoLast());
        Assert.Equal(7, sim.Environment.Furniture.Count);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(last, sim.Environment.Walls);
        Assert.Equal(0, sim.Environment.PlannedAgentCount);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(0f)]
    [InlineData(90f)]
    public void NearbyParallelBarrierSnapsFlushUsingTheSamePreviewPoint(float degrees)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        float angle = degrees * MathF.PI / 180f;
        Vector2 axis = degrees == 0f ? Vector2.UnitX : Vector2.UnitY;
        Vector2 center = new(15f, 15f), expected = center + axis * 1.5f;
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, center, angle));
        int version = sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion;
        Vector2 snapped = sim.Environment.SnapBarricadePlacement(expected + new Vector2(0.10f, 0.08f), angle);
        Assert.Equal(expected, snapped);
        Assert.Equal(version, sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion); // preview is read-only
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.CanPlaceFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, snapped, angle));
        FurnitureSet preview = new(FurnitureKind.Barricade, snapped, angle);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, snapped, angle));
        Assert.Equal(preview.StaticObstacle, sim.Environment.Furniture[^1].StaticObstacle);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SnappingDoesNotReachDistantOrPerpendicularBarriers()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Vector2 far = new(17.5f, 15f);
        Assert.Equal(far, sim.Environment.SnapBarricadePlacement(far, 0f));
        Vector2 near = new(16.6f, 15f);
        Assert.Equal(near, sim.Environment.SnapBarricadePlacement(near, MathF.PI / 2f));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SnapNeverPullsThePreviewIntoAnOccupiedEndpoint()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(16f, 14f, 17f, 16f));
        sim.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        Vector2 requested = new(16.6f, 15.05f);
        Assert.Equal(requested, sim.Environment.SnapBarricadePlacement(requested, 0f));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.CanPlaceFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, requested));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FootprintUsesTheThinBaseNotABoundingCircle()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f, 0.85f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(19f, 0.85f), MathF.PI / 2f));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f, 0.85f)));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.SingleChair)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.Stage)]
    public void BarrierCannotOverlapOtherAssets(FurnitureKind other)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(other, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.Single(sim.Environment.Furniture);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PlannedPeopleAndInvalidCoordinatesStillPreventPlacement()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddAgentSpawnGroupFromClick(15f, 15f, 1));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(float.NaN, 15f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f, 15f), float.PositiveInfinity));
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.Furniture);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BarrierBlocksWalkingButIsNotAFullHeightBlastOrFumeWall()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        Vector2 a = new(15f, 13f), b = new(15f, 17f);
        Assert.False(sim.HasTraversablePath(a, b, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
        Assert.True(sim.HasLineOfSight(a, b));
        Assert.False(ExplosionSystem.BlastPathIsBlocked(a, b, sim.Environment.Walls));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.IsFumeBlocked(new Vector2(15f, 15f), 0.02f));
        VisibilityGraphPlanner planner = new(sim.Config.Agent);
        IReadOnlyList<Vector2> route = planner.Plan(sim, a, b);
        Assert.NotEmpty(route);
        Assert.Equal(b, route[^1]);
        foreach (Vector2 point in route)
        {
            Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(a, point, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
            a = point;
        }
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.Explosion)]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.ToxicFume)]
    public void SaveLoadAndReplayPreserveBarrierOrientationAndStageLimit(ScenarioType scenario)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 890);
        sim.SetScenarioType(scenario);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(10f, 10f), MathF.PI / 2f));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(10f, 11.5f), MathF.PI / 2f));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(30f, 20f)));
        ScenarioDefinition saved = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(sim, 0, "road-barriers");
        Assert.Empty(saved.Blockages); // no duplicate rectangular proxies
        Assert.Empty(saved.CircularBlockages);
        ScenarioDefinition loaded = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ScenarioDefinition>(JsonSerializer.Serialize(saved))!;
        Simulation restored = new(agentCount: 0);
        loaded.ApplyLayout(restored);
        Assert.Equal(3, restored.Environment.Furniture.Count);
        Assert.Equal(2, restored.Environment.Furniture.Count(set => set.Kind == FurnitureKind.Barricade));
        Assert.Equal(MathF.PI / 2f, restored.Environment.Furniture[0].Rotation, 4);
        Assert.False(restored.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(45f, 10f)));
        Simulation replay = FinalizedSceneCheckpoint.Capture(restored, 0, "road-barriers").CreateReadySimulation();
        Assert.Equal(3, replay.Environment.Furniture.Count);
        Assert.Empty(replay.Agents);
        Assert.Equal(sim.Environment.Furniture[0].StaticObstacle, replay.Environment.Furniture[0].StaticObstacle);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.Explosion)]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.ToxicFume)]
    public void FixedBarrierRemainsPresentAfterTheHazardActuallyRuns(ScenarioType scenario)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 890);
        sim.SetScenarioType(scenario);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(28f, 0.3f, 5));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Barricade, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        FurnitureSet barrier = sim.Environment.Furniture[0];
        Wall bounds = Assert.IsType<Wall>(barrier.StaticObstacle);
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(new[] { new Vector2(40f, 25f) });
        sim.Agents[0].MarkExited(); // valid population without random crowd contacts
        if (scenario == ScenarioType.ToxicFume)
        {
            Assert.True(sim.ToxicFumeSystem.TrySetSource(sim, new Vector2(15f, 13f)));
            sim.PrecomputeToxicFume();
        }
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.True(sim.Running);
        if (scenario == ScenarioType.Explosion)
        {
            sim.TriggerExplosion(15f, 15f);
            Assert.NotNull(sim.Environment.Explosion);
        }
        else Assert.True(sim.TriggerToxicFumeRelease());
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(40, sim.FrameIndex);
        Assert.Same(bounds, barrier.StaticObstacle);
        Assert.Contains(bounds, sim.Environment.Walls);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.IsPointBlocked(barrier.Center));
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/BehaviorRebuildTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class BehaviorRebuildTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void PanicDecay_IsTimeBasedAndRemainsVisibleForSeveralSeconds()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(1, seed: 1601);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.Position = new Vector2(27.9286f, 28.3333f);
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        agent.ExitTarget = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        agent.PanicLevel = 0.80f;

        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++)
        {
            simulation.Step();
        }

        Assert.InRange(agent.PanicLevel, 0.45f, 0.70f);
        Assert.InRange(agent.LastSocialPanicStimulus, 0f, 0.0001f);
        Assert.InRange(agent.LastRunningPanicStimulus, 0f, 0.0001f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DirectlyExposedAgent_CannotBeRelayedSameEpisodeAfterDirectWindowExpires()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(1, seed: 1610);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();

        agent.ActivateDirectAlarm(
            currentFrame: 0,
            durationFrames: 2,
            panicFloor: 0.50f,
            episodeId: 1610);
        agent.ExpireAlarmIfNeeded(3);

        Assert.False(agent.IsActiveAlarmSource(3));
        Assert.False(agent.TryActivateRelayedAlarm(
            currentFrame: 3,
            durationFrames: 10,
            panicFloor: 0.45f,
            episodeId: 1610));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PersistentSocialAlarm_ApproachesBoundedStressInsteadOfSaturating()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(2, seed: 1608);
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent observer = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent source = simulation.Agents[1];

        observer.Position = new Vector2(24.2857f, 17f);
        observer.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        observer.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        observer.ExitTarget = exit;
        observer.PanicLevel = 0.45f;

        source.Position = new Vector2(25.0952f, 17f);
        source.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        source.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        source.ExitTarget = exit;
        source.PanicLevel = 0.50f;
        source.ActivateDirectAlarm(
            simulation.FrameIndex,
            durationFrames: 40,
            panicFloor: 0.50f,
            episodeId: 1608);

        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
        {
            simulation.Step();
        }

        Assert.True(observer.LastSocialPanicStimulus > 0.40f);
        Assert.InRange(observer.PanicLevel, 0.45f, 0.65f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DirectlyExposedMobileAgent_BeginsWithThreatEscapeIntent()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(1, seed: 1602);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.ShockwaveHit = true;
        agent.BlastShielded = false;
        simulation.Environment.SetExplosion(27.93f, 17.00f, simulation.FrameIndex);

        simulation.EvacuationSystem.BeginPurposefulResponse(simulation, agent);

        Assert.Equal(BehaviorIntent.ThreatEscape, agent.Intent);
        Assert.True(agent.IntentUntilFrame > simulation.FrameIndex);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DirectFront_CanSwitchAlreadyEvacuatingAgentToThreatEscape()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(1, seed: 1609);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.Position = new Vector2(38.4524f, 17f);
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        agent.ExitTarget = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();

        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        simulation.TriggerExplosion(27.93f, 17.00f);
        simulation.Debris.Clear();

        for (int i = 0; i < 12 && !agent.ShockwaveHit; i++)
        {
            simulation.Step();
        }

        Assert.True(agent.ShockwaveHit);
        Assert.Equal(BehaviorIntent.ThreatEscape, agent.Intent);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HighHelpingTrait_CanAttendNearbyCasualtyWithoutChangingCasualtyOutcome()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(2, seed: 1603);
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent helper = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent casualty = simulation.Agents[1];

        helper.Position = new Vector2(24.2857f, 17f);
        helper.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        helper.Intent = BehaviorIntent.FollowCrowd;
        helper.IntentUntilFrame = 0;
        helper.ExitTarget = exit;
        helper.HelpingTendency = 1f;
        helper.PanicLevel = 0.10f;

        casualty.Position = new Vector2(25.7024f, 17f);
        casualty.MarkFallen(simulation.FrameIndex, simulation.Random);

        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        simulation.Step();

        Assert.Equal(BehaviorIntent.AssistCasualty, helper.Intent);
        Assert.Equal(casualty.AgentId, helper.AssistTargetAgentId);
        Assert.True(helper.AssistAssignedFrame >= 0);
        Assert.True(helper.AssistLastProgressFrame >= 0);
        Assert.True(float.IsFinite(helper.AssistBestDistanceMeters));
        Assert.InRange(helper.AssistSlotIndex, 0, 1);
        Assert.Equal(AgentState.Fallen, casualty.State);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TwoHelpers_AssignedToSameCasualty_UseOppositeAssistanceSlots()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(3, seed: 1611);
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent first = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent second = simulation.Agents[1];
        Agent casualty = simulation.Agents[2];

        first.Position = new Vector2(24.0f, 16.4f);
        second.Position = new Vector2(24.0f, 17.6f);
        foreach (Agent helper in new[] { first, second })
        {
            helper.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
            helper.Intent = BehaviorIntent.FollowCrowd;
            helper.IntentUntilFrame = 0;
            helper.ExitTarget = exit;
            helper.HelpingTendency = 1f;
            helper.PanicLevel = 0.05f;
        }

        casualty.Position = new Vector2(25.4f, 17.0f);
        casualty.ExitTarget = exit;
        casualty.MarkFallen(simulation.FrameIndex, simulation.Random);

        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        simulation.Step();

        Assert.Equal(BehaviorIntent.AssistCasualty, first.Intent);
        Assert.Equal(BehaviorIntent.AssistCasualty, second.Intent);
        Assert.Equal(casualty.AgentId, first.AssistTargetAgentId);
        Assert.Equal(casualty.AgentId, second.AssistTargetAgentId);
        Assert.NotEqual(first.AssistSlotIndex, second.AssistSlotIndex);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BlockedHelper_AbandonsAssistanceAfterBoundedNoProgressWindow()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(2, seed: 1612);
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent helper = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent casualty = simulation.Agents[1];

        helper.Position = new Vector2(10.0f, 10.0f);
        helper.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        helper.Intent = BehaviorIntent.AssistCasualty;
        helper.ExitTarget = exit;
        helper.AssistanceDecisionMade = true;

        casualty.Position = new Vector2(12.0f, 10.0f);
        casualty.ExitTarget = exit;
        casualty.MarkFallen(simulation.FrameIndex, simulation.Random);

        helper.AssistTargetAgentId = casualty.AgentId;
        helper.AssistSlotIndex = 0;
        helper.AssistAssignedFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
        helper.AssistLastProgressFrame = simulation.FrameIndex;
        helper.AssistProgressAnchorPosition = helper.Position;
        helper.AssistBestDistanceMeters = Vector2.Distance(helper.Position, casualty.Position);

        // Enclose the helper with body-clear static walls so it cannot make physical progress
        // toward either assistance side. This exercises the bounded recovery/abandon path.
        simulation.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(9.35f, 9.35f, 9.45f, 10.65f));
        simulation.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(10.55f, 9.35f, 10.65f, 10.65f));
        simulation.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(9.35f, 9.35f, 10.65f, 9.45f));
        simulation.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(9.35f, 10.55f, 10.65f, 10.65f));
        simulation.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        simulation.BuildWallGrid();

        simulation.SetRunning(true);

        // The helper can still make a small amount of genuine goal-distance progress inside
        // the enclosure and may try the alternate side at the 6-second recovery stage. The
        // contract is therefore bounded *no-progress*, not a fixed 10-second assignment
        // lifetime. Give the complete retry/alternate-side sequence time to settle while
        // still proving that the helper cannot remain assigned indefinitely.
        float maximumObservedApproachSeconds =
            simulation.Config.Agent.AssistanceAbandonNoProgressSeconds +
            simulation.Config.Agent.AssistanceAlternateSideNoProgressSeconds +
            4.0f;
        int steps = (int)MathF.Ceiling(maximumObservedApproachSeconds / simulation.Config.Agent.Dt);
        for (int i = 0; i < steps && helper.Intent == BehaviorIntent.AssistCasualty; i++)
        {
            simulation.Step();
        }

        Assert.NotEqual(BehaviorIntent.AssistCasualty, helper.Intent);
        Assert.Null(helper.AssistTargetAgentId);
        Assert.Equal(-1, helper.AssistSlotIndex);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void VisibilityGraphPlanner_FindsBodyClearRouteAroundBlockage()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 1604);
        float eastX = simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters - simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2f;
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(eastX, 12.14f, personsWide: 3));
        simulation.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(21.8571f, 8.0952f, 23.4762f, 17.8095f));
        simulation.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        simulation.BuildWallGrid();

        Vector2 start = new(20.2381f, 12.1429f);
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        float clearance = simulation.Config.Agent.Radius *
            simulation.Config.Agent.NavigationClearanceFactor;

        Assert.False(EvacuationSystem.HasTraversablePath(
            start,
            exit.Position,
            simulation.Environment.Walls,
            clearance));

        IReadOnlyList<Vector2> route = simulation.EvacuationSystem.PlanBodyClearRoute(
            simulation,
            start,
            exit.Position);

        Assert.True(route.Count >= 2);
        Vector2 previous = start;
        foreach (Vector2 waypoint in route)
        {
            Assert.True(EvacuationSystem.HasTraversablePath(
                previous,
                waypoint,
                simulation.Environment.Walls,
                clearance));
            previous = waypoint;
        }

        Assert.Equal(exit.Position, route[^1]);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EvacuationRouting_UsesWaypointBeforeLegacyExploration()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 1605);
        float eastX = simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters - simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2f;
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(eastX, 12.14f, personsWide: 3));
        simulation.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(21.8571f, 8.0952f, 23.4762f, 17.8095f));
        simulation.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        simulation.BuildWallGrid();
        simulation.SpawnAgents(1);

        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.Position = new Vector2(20.2381f, 12.1429f);
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        agent.ExitTarget = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        agent.PanicLevel = 0.20f;

        simulation.EvacuationSystem.UpdateEvacAgent(simulation, agent);

        Assert.False(agent.Exploring);
        Assert.True(agent.CurrentRouteWaypoint is not null ||
            (simulation.HybridMovement.Fields.FieldBuilds > 0 && agent.NavigationMemory.GuidancePoint is not null),
            "Use static waypoints or shared exit guidance before legacy random exploration.");
        Assert.True(agent.LastDesiredDirection.LengthSquared() > 0.1f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CrawlingAgent_DoesNotActAsHerdMovementLeader()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(2, seed: 1613);
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent observer = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent crawler = simulation.Agents[1];

        observer.Position = new Vector2(28.0f, 20.0f);
        observer.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        observer.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        observer.ExitTarget = exit;

        crawler.Position = new Vector2(28.0f, 19.3f);
        crawler.ExitTarget = exit;
        crawler.MarkCrawling();
        crawler.Velocity = new Vector2(0.025f, 0f);

        Vector2 herd = simulation.EvacuationSystem.ComputeHerdDirection(simulation, observer);

        Assert.True(herd.LengthSquared() < 0.0001f);
        Assert.True(crawler.CanSignalPanic);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MobileAgent_BehindSlowCrawler_ChoosesLateralBypassWhenSideSpaceIsClear()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(2, seed: 1614);
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent pedestrian = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent crawler = simulation.Agents[1];

        pedestrian.Position = new Vector2(28.0f, 20.0f);
        pedestrian.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        pedestrian.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        pedestrian.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        pedestrian.IntentUntilFrame = -1;
        pedestrian.ExitTarget = exit;
        pedestrian.HelpingTendency = 0f;
        pedestrian.FollowTendency = 0f;
        pedestrian.PanicLevel = 0f;

        crawler.Position = new Vector2(28.0f, 19.25f);
        crawler.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        crawler.ExitTarget = exit;
        crawler.MarkCrawling();
        crawler.PanicLevel = 0f;

        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        for (int i = 0; i < 10 && pedestrian.SlowObstacleBypassGoal is null; i++)
        {
            simulation.Step();
        }

        Assert.Equal(crawler.AgentId, pedestrian.SlowObstacleBypassAgentId);
        Assert.NotNull(pedestrian.SlowObstacleBypassGoal);
        Vector2 bypassGoal = pedestrian.SlowObstacleBypassGoal!.Value;
        Assert.True(MathF.Abs(bypassGoal.X - crawler.Position.X) >= 0.50f);
        Assert.True(MathF.Abs(pedestrian.LastDesiredDirection.X) > 0.10f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ThreatEscape_CasualtyCluster_ChoosesClearLocalDetourInsteadOfPressingForward()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(4, seed: 1615);
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent pedestrian = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent centreCrawler = simulation.Agents[1];
        Agent upperCrawler = simulation.Agents[2];
        Agent lowerCrawler = simulation.Agents[3];

        // Explosion is behind the pedestrian, so the nominal ThreatEscape direction is +X.
        // Three crawling casualties occupy the forward sector while lateral/back-side floor
        // remains open. The local bypass should therefore deviate materially from +X.
        simulation.Environment.SetExplosion(18.0f, 20.0f, simulation.FrameIndex);
        pedestrian.Position = new Vector2(20.0f, 20.0f);
        pedestrian.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        pedestrian.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        pedestrian.Intent = BehaviorIntent.ThreatEscape;
        pedestrian.IntentUntilFrame = 100;
        pedestrian.ExitTarget = exit;
        pedestrian.FollowTendency = 0f;
        pedestrian.HelpingTendency = 0f;
        pedestrian.PanicLevel = 0.80f;

        centreCrawler.Position = new Vector2(20.55f, 20.00f);
        upperCrawler.Position = new Vector2(20.62f, 20.34f);
        lowerCrawler.Position = new Vector2(20.62f, 19.66f);
        foreach (Agent crawler in new[] { centreCrawler, upperCrawler, lowerCrawler })
        {
            crawler.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            crawler.ExitTarget = exit;
            crawler.MarkCrawling();
            crawler.PanicLevel = 0f;
        }

        simulation.EvacuationSystem.UpdateEvacAgent(simulation, pedestrian);

        Assert.Equal(centreCrawler.AgentId, pedestrian.SlowObstacleBypassAgentId);
        Assert.NotNull(pedestrian.SlowObstacleBypassGoal);
        Vector2 bypassDirection = Vector2.Normalize(
            pedestrian.SlowObstacleBypassGoal!.Value - new Vector2(20.0f, 20.0f));
        Assert.True(
            Vector2.Dot(bypassDirection, Vector2.UnitX) < 0.85f,
            $"Expected a meaningful local detour, got {bypassDirection}.");
        Assert.True(
            MathF.Abs(bypassDirection.Y) > 0.30f,
            $"Expected lateral clearance around the casualty cluster, got {bypassDirection}.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ThreatEscape_WhenForwardAndSidewaysAreBlocked_AllowsBoundedBackSideStep()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(4, seed: 1616);
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent pedestrian = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent centreCrawler = simulation.Agents[1];
        Agent upperSideCrawler = simulation.Agents[2];
        Agent lowerSideCrawler = simulation.Agents[3];

        simulation.Environment.SetExplosion(18.0f, 20.0f, simulation.FrameIndex);
        pedestrian.Position = new Vector2(20.0f, 20.0f);
        pedestrian.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        pedestrian.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        pedestrian.Intent = BehaviorIntent.ThreatEscape;
        pedestrian.IntentUntilFrame = 100;
        pedestrian.ExitTarget = exit;
        pedestrian.FollowTendency = 0f;
        pedestrian.HelpingTendency = 0f;
        pedestrian.PanicLevel = 0.80f;

        // The centre body blocks shallow forward detours. Two additional casualties occupy
        // the +/-60 and +/-90 degree side corridors, leaving the bounded +/-120 degree
        // back-side candidates as the first body-clear local escape choices.
        centreCrawler.Position = new Vector2(20.55f, 20.00f);
        upperSideCrawler.Position = new Vector2(20.22f, 20.55f);
        lowerSideCrawler.Position = new Vector2(20.22f, 19.45f);
        foreach (Agent crawler in new[] { centreCrawler, upperSideCrawler, lowerSideCrawler })
        {
            crawler.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            crawler.ExitTarget = exit;
            crawler.MarkCrawling();
            crawler.PanicLevel = 0f;
        }

        simulation.EvacuationSystem.UpdateEvacAgent(simulation, pedestrian);

        Assert.NotNull(pedestrian.SlowObstacleBypassGoal);
        Vector2 bypassDirection = Vector2.Normalize(
            pedestrian.SlowObstacleBypassGoal!.Value - new Vector2(20.0f, 20.0f));
        Assert.True(
            Vector2.Dot(bypassDirection, Vector2.UnitX) < -0.10f,
            $"Expected a bounded back-side step when the forward hemisphere is blocked, got {bypassDirection}.");
        Assert.True(
            MathF.Abs(bypassDirection.Y) > 0.50f,
            $"Expected the back-step to remain lateral rather than reverse directly toward the blast, got {bypassDirection}.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PurposefulEvacuation_RemainsBriskAfterAcutePanicSubsides()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(1, seed: 1606);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        agent.PanicLevel = 0f;
        agent.UrgencyBias = 1f;

        Assert.InRange(
            MathF.Abs(
                agent.CurrentDesiredSpeed -
                agent.BaseSpeed * simulation.Config.Agent.EvacuationSpeedFloorMultiplier),
            0f,
            0.0001f);
        Assert.True(agent.CurrentDesiredSpeed >= agent.BaseSpeed * 1.8f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SameSeed_ReproducesBehaviorTraits()
    {
        Simulation first = new(agentCount: 6, randomSeed: 1607);
        Simulation second = new(agentCount: 6, randomSeed: 1607);

        for (int i = 0; i < first.Agents.Count; i++)
        {
            Agent a = first.Agents[i];
            Agent b = second.Agents[i];
            Assert.Equal(a.ThreatSensitivity, b.ThreatSensitivity);
            Assert.Equal(a.FollowTendency, b.FollowTendency);
            Assert.Equal(a.HelpingTendency, b.HelpingTendency);
            Assert.Equal(a.RouteFamiliarity, b.RouteFamiliarity);
            Assert.Equal(a.UrgencyBias, b.UrgencyBias);
            Assert.Equal(a.StressRecoveryBias, b.StressRecoveryBias);
            Assert.Equal(a.PersonalSpaceBias, b.PersonalSpaceBias);
            Assert.Equal(a.Assertiveness, b.Assertiveness);
            Assert.Equal(a.PatienceBias, b.PatienceBias);
        }
    }

    private static Simulation CreateReadySimulation(int count, int seed)
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: seed);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
            simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters / 2,
            simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2,
            personsWide: 3));
        simulation.SpawnAgents(count);
        return simulation;
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/BehaviorRefinementTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class BehaviorRefinementTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void IndividualRecoveryBias_ChangesStressDecayRate()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(2, seed: 1701);
        Agent fasterRecovery = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent slowerRecovery = simulation.Agents[1];
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();

        fasterRecovery.Position = new Vector2(8.0952f, 8.0952f);
        slowerRecovery.Position = new Vector2(44.5238f, 26.3095f);
        foreach (Agent agent in simulation.Agents)
        {
            agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
            agent.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
            agent.ExitTarget = exit;
            agent.PanicLevel = 0.80f;
            agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }

        fasterRecovery.StressRecoveryBias = 0.70f;
        slowerRecovery.StressRecoveryBias = 1.30f;

        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        simulation.Step();

        Assert.True(slowerRecovery.PanicLevel > fasterRecovery.PanicLevel);
        Assert.InRange(fasterRecovery.PanicLevel, 0f, 1f);
        Assert.InRange(slowerRecovery.PanicLevel, 0f, 1f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PanicCompressesSocialSpaceWithoutDisablingPhysicalContact()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 2, randomSeed: 1702);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent other = simulation.Agents[1];
        agent.Position = new Vector2(20.2381f, 16.1905f);
        other.Position = new Vector2(20.6631f, 16.1905f);
        agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        other.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        agent.ExitTarget = new Exit("test", new Vector2(28.3333f, 16.1905f), 0.40f, "E");
        agent.PersonalSpaceBias = 1f;

        agent.PanicLevel = 0f;
        Vector2 calmForce = simulation.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(simulation, agent, Vector2.Zero);

        agent.PanicLevel = 1f;
        Vector2 compressedForce = simulation.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(simulation, agent, Vector2.Zero);

        Assert.True(VectorMath.IsFinite(calmForce));
        Assert.True(VectorMath.IsFinite(compressedForce));
        Assert.True(compressedForce.Length() < calmForce.Length());

        other.Position = new Vector2(20.6226f, 16.1905f);
        Vector2 contactForce = simulation.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(simulation, agent, Vector2.Zero);
        Assert.True(VectorMath.IsFinite(contactForce));
        Assert.True(contactForce.Length() > 0f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EmergencyUrgencyTuning_ChangesPurposefulSpeedWithinCap()
    {
        SimulationConfig defaultConfig = SimulationConfig.CreateDefault();
        SimulationConfig urgentConfig = SimulationConfig.CreateDefault();
        urgentConfig.Agent.Behavior.SetValues(
            traitVariation: BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultTraitVariation,
            reactionVariation: BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultReactionVariation,
            stressSusceptibility: BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultStressSusceptibility,
            stressPersistence: BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultStressPersistence,
            crowdFollowing: BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultCrowdFollowing,
            personalSpace: BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultPersonalSpace,
            panicSpaceCompression: BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultPanicSpaceCompression,
            emergencyUrgency: 1.20f,
            helpingTendency: BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultHelpingTendency,
            routeFamiliarity: BehaviorTuningConfig.DefaultRouteFamiliarity);

        Simulation normal = new(agentCount: 1, config: defaultConfig, randomSeed: 1703);
        Simulation urgent = new(agentCount: 1, config: urgentConfig, randomSeed: 1703);
        Agent normalAgent = normal.Agents.Single();
        Agent urgentAgent = urgent.Agents.Single();
        normalAgent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        urgentAgent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        normalAgent.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        urgentAgent.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        normalAgent.PanicLevel = 0f;
        urgentAgent.PanicLevel = 0f;
        normalAgent.UrgencyBias = 1f;
        urgentAgent.UrgencyBias = 1f;

        Assert.Equal(normalAgent.BaseSpeed, urgentAgent.BaseSpeed);
        Assert.True(urgentAgent.CurrentDesiredSpeed > normalAgent.CurrentDesiredSpeed);
        Assert.True(
            urgentAgent.CurrentDesiredSpeed <=
            urgentAgent.BaseSpeed * urgentConfig.Agent.MaximumBehaviorSpeedMultiplier + 0.0001f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ZeroTraitVariation_ProducesConfiguredPopulationCentres()
    {
        SimulationConfig config = SimulationConfig.CreateDefault();
        config.Agent.Behavior.SetValues(
            traitVariation: 0f,
            reactionVariation: 0f,
            stressSusceptibility: 1.20f,
            stressPersistence: 1.10f,
            crowdFollowing: 0.70f,
            personalSpace: 1.05f,
            panicSpaceCompression: 0.18f,
            emergencyUrgency: 1.05f,
            helpingTendency: 0.30f,
            routeFamiliarity: 0.90f,
            bottleneckAssertiveness: 0.62f,
            bottleneckPressureSensitivity: 1.10f,
            bottleneckSpaceCompression: 0.24f);

        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 4, config: config, randomSeed: 1704);
        foreach (Agent agent in simulation.Agents)
        {
            Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(agent.ThreatSensitivity - 1.20f), 0f, 0.0001f);
            Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(agent.FollowTendency - 0.70f), 0f, 0.0001f);
            Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(agent.HelpingTendency - 0.30f), 0f, 0.0001f);
            Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(agent.RouteFamiliarity - 0.90f), 0f, 0.0001f);
            Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(agent.UrgencyBias - 1f), 0f, 0.0001f);
            Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(agent.StressRecoveryBias - 1f), 0f, 0.0001f);
            Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(agent.PersonalSpaceBias - 1f), 0f, 0.0001f);
            Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(agent.Assertiveness - 0.62f), 0f, 0.0001f);
            Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(agent.PatienceBias - 1f), 0f, 0.0001f);
            Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(agent.ReactionDelayFrames - 35f), 0f, 0.0001f);
        }
    }

    private static Simulation CreateReadySimulation(int count, int seed)
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: seed);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
            simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters / 2,
            simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2,
            personsWide: 3));
        simulation.SpawnAgents(count);
        return simulation;
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/BlockageAdjacencyTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using System.Text.Json;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Placement-grid seams, float tolerance and preview/commit consistency.</summary>
public sealed class BlockageAdjacencyTests
{
    private static Vector2 GridCenter(Simulation sim, int x, int y, int cells)
    {
        float t = sim.Environment.BoundaryThickness, step = sim.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters;
        return new Vector2(t + (x + cells * 0.5f) * step, t + (y + cells * 0.5f) * step);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(1, false)]
    [InlineData(2, false)]
    [InlineData(1, true)]
    [InlineData(2, true)]
    public void TenBlocksCanTouchWithoutAnyGap(int cells, bool vertical)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Wall? previous = null;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
        {
            Vector2 click = GridCenter(sim, 3 + (vertical ? 0 : i * cells),
                3 + (vertical ? i * cells : 0), cells);
            Wall preview = sim.Environment.GetBlockagePlacementBounds(click.X, click.Y, cells);
            Assert.True(sim.Environment.CanPlaceBlockageFromClick(click.X, click.Y, cells));
            Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(click.X, click.Y, cells));
            Wall placed = sim.Environment.Blockages[^1];
            Assert.Equal(preview, placed);
            if (previous is not null)
                Assert.Equal(vertical ? previous.Y2 : previous.X2, vertical ? placed.Y1 : placed.X1);
            previous = placed;
        }
        Assert.Equal(10, sim.Environment.Blockages.Count);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(1, 2, false)]
    [InlineData(2, 1, false)]
    [InlineData(1, 2, true)]
    [InlineData(2, 1, true)]
    public void MixedSizesShareTheSameGridEdges(int firstCells, int secondCells, bool vertical)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Vector2 first = GridCenter(sim, 4, 4, firstCells);
        Vector2 second = GridCenter(sim, 4 + (vertical ? 0 : firstCells),
            4 + (vertical ? firstCells : 0), secondCells);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(first.X, first.Y, firstCells));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(second.X, second.Y, secondCells));
        Wall a = sim.Environment.Blockages[0], b = sim.Environment.Blockages[1];
        Assert.Equal(vertical ? a.Y2 : a.X2, vertical ? b.Y1 : b.X1);
        Assert.Equal(vertical ? a.X1 : a.Y1, vertical ? b.X1 : b.Y1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CornerContactIsAllowedButDuplicatePlacementIsRejected()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Vector2 first = GridCenter(sim, 4, 4, 1), diagonal = GridCenter(sim, 5, 5, 1);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(first.X, first.Y));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(diagonal.X, diagonal.Y));
        int version = sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion;
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.CanPlaceBlockageFromClick(first.X, first.Y));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(first.X, first.Y));
        Assert.Equal(version, sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion);
        Assert.Equal(2, sim.Environment.Blockages.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AFloatRoundingSliverIsNotAnOverlapButOneMillimetreIs()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(10f, 10f, 11.2f, 11.2f));
        sim.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.WallOverlapsAny(new Wall(11.2f - 0.000001f, 10f, 12.4f, 11.2f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.WallOverlapsAny(new Wall(11.2f - 0.001f, 10f, 12.4f, 11.2f)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BlockCanTouchBoundaryWithoutProtrudingOutside()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Vector2 click = GridCenter(sim, 0, 4, 1);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(click.X, click.Y));
        Assert.Equal(sim.Environment.BoundaryThickness, sim.Environment.Blockages[0].X1);
        Vector2 outside = GridCenter(sim, -1, 4, 1);
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(outside.X, outside.Y));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void JoinedBlockSeamDoesNotBecomeAWalkableCrack()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Vector2 a = GridCenter(sim, 4, 4, 1), b = GridCenter(sim, 5, 4, 1);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(a.X, a.Y));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(b.X, b.Y));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        Wall block = sim.Environment.Blockages[0];
        Assert.False(sim.HasTraversablePath(new Vector2(block.X2, block.Y1 - 1f),
            new Vector2(block.X2, block.Y2 + 1f), sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NonFiniteClicksAreRejectedWithoutMutatingTheScene()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        int version = sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion;
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.CanPlaceBlockageFromClick(float.NaN, 10f));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(10f, float.PositiveInfinity));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddBlueWallFromClick(float.NegativeInfinity, 10f));
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => sim.Environment.GetBlockagePlacementBounds(float.NaN, 0f));
        Assert.Equal(version, sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion);
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.Blockages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void JoinedMixedBlocksSurviveSaveLoadWithoutBeingResnapped()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Vector2 a = GridCenter(sim, 4, 4, 1), b = GridCenter(sim, 5, 4, 2);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(a.X, a.Y));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(b.X, b.Y, 2));
        ScenarioDefinition saved = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(sim, 0, "joined-blocks");
        ScenarioDefinition loaded = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ScenarioDefinition>(JsonSerializer.Serialize(saved))!;
        Simulation restored = new(agentCount: 0);
        loaded.ApplyLayout(restored);
        Assert.Equal(sim.Environment.Blockages.ToArray(), restored.Environment.Blockages.ToArray());
        Assert.Equal(restored.Environment.Blockages[0].X2, restored.Environment.Blockages[1].X1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AdjacentLegacyBlueTileUsesTheSameEdgeGrid()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Vector2 a = GridCenter(sim, 4, 4, 1), b = GridCenter(sim, 5, 4, 2);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(a.X, a.Y));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddBlueWallFromClick(b.X, b.Y));
        Assert.Equal(sim.Environment.Blockages[0].X2, sim.Environment.BlueWalls[0].X1);
    }
    [Theory]
    [InlineData(1)]
    [InlineData(2)]
    public void NewBlockCanMeetAnOldHalfCellShiftedBlockWithoutMovingIt(int cells)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(agentCount: 0);
        Wall legacy = new(10.8f, 10.8f, 13.2f, 13.2f);
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(legacy);
        sim.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        float size = cells * sim.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters;
        Vector2 click = new(legacy.X2 + size * 0.5f, legacy.Y1 + size * 0.5f);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(click.X, click.Y, cells));
        Assert.Same(legacy, sim.Environment.Blockages[0]);
        Assert.Equal(legacy.X2, sim.Environment.Blockages[1].X1);
        Assert.Equal(legacy.Y1, sim.Environment.Blockages[1].Y1, 4);
    }

}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/BottleneckBehaviorTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class BottleneckBehaviorTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AssertiveDelayedAgent_TransitionsToPressWithoutPanic()
    {
        (Simulation simulation, Agent focal, Exit exit) = CreateCongestedDoorway(seed: 1801);
        focal.Assertiveness = 1f;
        focal.PatienceBias = 0.65f;
        focal.UrgencyBias = 1.25f;
        focal.PanicLevel = 0f;

        AdvanceBottleneck(simulation, focal, exit, steps: 40);

        Assert.Equal(BottleneckResponseMode.Press, focal.BottleneckMode);
        Assert.True(focal.BottleneckPressure >= simulation.Config.Agent.BottleneckPressThreshold);
        Assert.True(focal.BottleneckWaitSeconds > 0f);
        Assert.InRange(focal.PanicLevel, 0f, 0.0001f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LowAssertivenessAgent_SeeksGapInsteadOfPressing()
    {
        (Simulation simulation, Agent focal, Exit exit) = CreateCongestedDoorway(seed: 1802);
        focal.Assertiveness = 0f;
        focal.PatienceBias = 1.35f;
        focal.UrgencyBias = 0.75f;
        focal.PanicLevel = 0f;

        AdvanceBottleneck(simulation, focal, exit, steps: 40);

        Assert.Equal(BottleneckResponseMode.SeekGap, focal.BottleneckMode);
        Assert.True(focal.BottleneckPressure >= simulation.Config.Agent.BottleneckSeekGapThreshold);
        Assert.True(focal.BottleneckLateralDirection.LengthSquared() > 0f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CrawlingAgent_AlwaysYieldsAtCongestedDoorway()
    {
        (Simulation simulation, Agent focal, Exit exit) = CreateCongestedDoorway(seed: 1803);
        focal.State = AgentState.Crawling;
        focal.InjurySpeedFactor = 0f;
        focal.Assertiveness = 1f;
        focal.PatienceBias = 0.65f;
        focal.PanicLevel = 1f;
        focal.BottleneckMode = BottleneckResponseMode.Press;
        focal.BottleneckModeUntilFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + 100;

        simulation.Step();
        simulation.EvacuationSystem.UpdateBottleneckInteraction(
            simulation,
            focal,
            exit,
            Vector2.Distance(focal.Position, exit.Position));

        Assert.Equal(BottleneckResponseMode.Yield, focal.BottleneckMode);
        Assert.NotEqual(BottleneckResponseMode.Press, focal.BottleneckMode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LeavingDoorwayInfluence_ReleasesCommittedModeAndDecaysPressure()
    {
        (Simulation simulation, Agent focal, Exit exit) = CreateCongestedDoorway(seed: 1804);
        focal.Assertiveness = 1f;
        focal.PatienceBias = 0.65f;
        focal.UrgencyBias = 1.25f;

        AdvanceBottleneck(simulation, focal, exit, steps: 40);
        Assert.Equal(BottleneckResponseMode.Press, focal.BottleneckMode);
        float previousPressure = focal.BottleneckPressure;

        focal.Position = new Vector2(
            simulation.Environment.Width - 4.8571f,
            simulation.Environment.Height - 4.8571f);
        simulation.Step();
        simulation.EvacuationSystem.UpdateBottleneckInteraction(
            simulation,
            focal,
            exit,
            Vector2.Distance(focal.Position, exit.Position));

        Assert.Equal(BottleneckResponseMode.Free, focal.BottleneckMode);
        Assert.True(focal.BottleneckPressure < previousPressure);
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.Zero, focal.BottleneckLateralDirection);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PressingCompressesSocialSpaceWithoutRemovingBodyContact()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 2, randomSeed: 1805);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent other = simulation.Agents[1];
        agent.Position = new Vector2(20.2381f, 16.1905f);
        other.Position = new Vector2(20.6631f, 16.1905f);
        agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        other.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        agent.ExitTarget = new Exit("test", new Vector2(28.3333f, 16.1905f), 0.40f, "E");
        agent.PersonalSpaceBias = 1f;
        agent.PanicLevel = 0f;

        agent.BottleneckMode = BottleneckResponseMode.Free;
        agent.BottleneckPressure = 0f;
        Vector2 freeForce = simulation.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(simulation, agent, Vector2.Zero);

        agent.BottleneckMode = BottleneckResponseMode.Press;
        agent.BottleneckPressure = 1f;
        Vector2 compressedForce = simulation.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(simulation, agent, Vector2.Zero);

        Assert.True(compressedForce.Length() < freeForce.Length());

        other.Position = new Vector2(20.6226f, 16.1905f);
        Vector2 contactForce = simulation.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(simulation, agent, Vector2.Zero);
        Assert.True(float.IsFinite(contactForce.X));
        Assert.True(float.IsFinite(contactForce.Y));
        Assert.True(contactForce.Length() > 0f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ScenarioRoundTrip_PreservesBottleneckTuning()
    {
        string directory = Path.Combine(
            Path.GetTempPath(),
            $"crowdsim-bottleneck-{Guid.NewGuid():N}");

        try
        {
            Simulation source = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 1806);
            source.Config.Agent.Behavior.SetValues(
                traitVariation: 0.70f,
                reactionVariation: 0.65f,
                stressSusceptibility: 1.05f,
                stressPersistence: 1.20f,
                crowdFollowing: 0.55f,
                personalSpace: 1.05f,
                panicSpaceCompression: 0.22f,
                emergencyUrgency: 1.08f,
                helpingTendency: 0.35f,
                routeFamiliarity: 0.72f,
                bottleneckAssertiveness: 0.68f,
                bottleneckPressureSensitivity: 1.22f,
                bottleneckSpaceCompression: 0.26f);
            Assert.True(source.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
                source.Config.World.WidthMeters / 2,
                source.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2,
                personsWide: 1));

            ScenarioDefinition captured = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(
                source,
                requestedAgentCount: 40,
                name: "bottleneck_roundtrip");
            ScenarioFileStore.Save(captured, directory);
            ScenarioDefinition loaded = ScenarioFileStore.Load(
                "bottleneck_roundtrip",
                directory);
            Simulation restored = new(0, loaded.CreateConfig(), loaded.RandomSeed);

            Assert.Equal(
                source.Config.Agent.Behavior.BottleneckAssertiveness,
                restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.BottleneckAssertiveness);
            Assert.Equal(
                source.Config.Agent.Behavior.BottleneckPressureSensitivity,
                restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.BottleneckPressureSensitivity);
            Assert.Equal(
                source.Config.Agent.Behavior.BottleneckSpaceCompression,
                restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.BottleneckSpaceCompression);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(directory))
            {
                Directory.Delete(directory, recursive: true);
            }
        }
    }

    private static (Simulation Simulation, Agent Focal, Exit Exit) CreateCongestedDoorway(int seed)
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: seed);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
            simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters / 2,
            simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2,
            personsWide: 1));
        simulation.SpawnAgents(10);
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();

        for (int index = 0; index < simulation.Agents.Count; index++)
        {
            Agent agent = simulation.Agents[index];
            int column = index % 5;
            int row = index / 5;
            agent.Position = new Vector2(
                exit.Position.X + (column - 2) * 0.3643f,
                simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness + 1.2143f + row * 0.4452f);
            agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
            agent.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
            agent.ExitTarget = exit;
            agent.PanicLevel = 0f;
            agent.StunnedUntilFrame = int.MaxValue;
            agent.ResetBottleneckInteraction();
        }

        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        return (simulation, simulation.Agents[0], exit);
    }

    private static void AdvanceBottleneck(
        Simulation simulation,
        Agent focal,
        Exit exit,
        int steps)
    {
        for (int index = 0; index < steps; index++)
        {
            simulation.Step();
            simulation.EvacuationSystem.UpdateBottleneckInteraction(
                simulation,
                focal,
                exit,
                Vector2.Distance(focal.Position, exit.Position));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.OpenGL.UI;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Tests the real picker state, linked without any window/OpenGL dependency.</summary>
public sealed class BuilderAssetSelectionTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void PickerIncludesEveryFurnitureKindExactlyOnce()
    {
        BuilderAssetSelection selection = new();
        List<FurnitureKind> kinds = new();
        foreach (BuilderAsset asset in BuilderAssetSelection.Options)
        {
            selection.Select(asset);
            Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(BuilderAssetSelection.Label(asset, 1.2f)));
            Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(selection.Hint));
            if (selection.Furniture is FurnitureKind kind) kinds.Add(kind);
        }
        Assert.Equal(Enum.GetValues<FurnitureKind>().OrderBy(k => k).ToArray(), kinds.OrderBy(k => k).ToArray());
        Assert.Equal(8, BuilderAssetSelection.Options.Count);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(0)]
    [InlineData(1)]
    [InlineData(2)]
    public void NonDirectionalBlocksDoNotOfferOrAccumulateRotation(int choice)
    {
        BuilderAssetSelection selection = new();
        selection.Select((BuilderAsset)choice);
        Assert.False(selection.SupportsRotation);
        selection.RotateQuarterTurn();
        Assert.Equal(0f, selection.RotationDegrees);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(5)]
    [InlineData(6)]
    public void TablesAndStageRotateByQuarterTurnsAndWrapAt360(int choice)
    {
        BuilderAssetSelection selection = new();
        selection.Select((BuilderAsset)choice);
        Assert.True(selection.UsesQuarterTurns);
        foreach (float expected in new[] { 90f, 180f, 270f, 0f })
        {
            selection.RotateQuarterTurn();
            Assert.Equal(expected, selection.RotationDegrees);
        }
        selection.SetRotation(68f);
        Assert.Equal(90f, selection.RotationDegrees);
        selection.SetRotation(-90f);
        Assert.Equal(270f, selection.RotationDegrees);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EveryAssetRemembersItsOwnFacingWhileSwitchingTools()
    {
        BuilderAssetSelection selection = new();
        selection.Select(BuilderAsset.Barricade);
        selection.RotateQuarterTurn();
        selection.Select(BuilderAsset.RectangularTable);
        Assert.Equal(0f, selection.RotationDegrees);
        selection.SetRotation(180f);
        selection.Select(BuilderAsset.SingleChair);
        selection.SetRotation(37f);
        Assert.False(selection.UsesQuarterTurns);
        selection.Select(BuilderAsset.Barricade);
        Assert.Equal(90f, selection.RotationDegrees);
        selection.Select(BuilderAsset.SingleChair);
        Assert.Equal(37f, selection.RotationDegrees);
        selection.Select(BuilderAsset.RectangularTable);
        Assert.Equal(180f, selection.RotationDegrees);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NewScenarioClearsSelectionsAndRestoresDefaultSnap()
    {
        BuilderAssetSelection selection = new();
        selection.Select(BuilderAsset.Barricade);
        selection.RotateQuarterTurn();
        selection.SnapBarricadeEnds = false;
        selection.Reset();
        Assert.Equal(BuilderAsset.SquareBlock, selection.Selected);
        Assert.True(selection.SnapBarricadeEnds);
        selection.Select(BuilderAsset.Barricade);
        Assert.Equal(0f, selection.RotationDegrees);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void InvalidSelectionOrRotationCannotPoisonThePreview()
    {
        BuilderAssetSelection selection = new();
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => selection.Select((BuilderAsset)999));
        selection.Select(BuilderAsset.Barricade);
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => selection.SetRotation(float.NaN));
        Assert.Equal(0f, selection.RotationDegrees);
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

    [Theory]

    [InlineData(-22.5f, 337.5f)]

    {

        selection.Select(BuilderAsset.Barricade);

        Assert.Equal(7.5f, selection.RotationDegrees);
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class BuilderPlacementTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void BlueWall_IsTwoGridCellsAndActsAsSolidGeometry()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 101);

        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddBlueWallFromClick(28f, 17f));
        Assert.Single(simulation.Environment.BlueWalls);

        var wall = simulation.Environment.BlueWalls[0];
        float expectedSide = 2f * simulation.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters;
        Assert.Equal(expectedSide, wall.X2 - wall.X1, 3);
        Assert.Equal(expectedSide, wall.Y2 - wall.Y1, 3);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.IsPointBlocked(
            new Vector2((wall.X1 + wall.X2) * 0.5f, (wall.Y1 + wall.Y2) * 0.5f)));
    }


    [Fact]
    public void Blockage_CanBeOneOrTwoGridCells()
    {
        Simulation oneCellSimulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 151);
        Assert.True(oneCellSimulation.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(20f, 14f, cells: 1));
        var oneCell = oneCellSimulation.Environment.Blockages.Single();
        Assert.Equal(oneCellSimulation.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters, oneCell.X2 - oneCell.X1, 3);
        Assert.Equal(oneCellSimulation.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters, oneCell.Y2 - oneCell.Y1, 3);

        Simulation twoCellSimulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 152);
        Assert.True(twoCellSimulation.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(20f, 14f, cells: 2));
        var twoCell = twoCellSimulation.Environment.Blockages.Single();
        Assert.Equal(2f * twoCellSimulation.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters, twoCell.X2 - twoCell.X1, 3);
        Assert.Equal(2f * twoCellSimulation.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters, twoCell.Y2 - twoCell.Y1, 3);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Exit_CanBeFivePersonsWide()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 153);
        float clickX = simulation.Environment.Width / 2f;
        float clickY = simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2f;

        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(clickX, clickY, personsWide: 5));
        var exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        float expectedWidth = 5f * 2f * simulation.Config.Agent.Radius;
        Assert.Equal(expectedWidth, exit.Size * 2);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AgentPlacement_FiftyAgentsSpreadsAroundBlockedFloor()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 202);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(28f, 17f));

        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddAgentSpawnGroupFromClick(28f, 17f, 50));
        Assert.Equal(50, simulation.Environment.PlannedAgentCount);

        List<Vector2> positions = simulation.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions();
        Assert.Equal(50, positions.Count);
        Assert.All(
            positions,
            position => Assert.False(
                simulation.Environment.IsPointBlocked(position, simulation.Config.Agent.Radius)));

        float minimumDistance = simulation.Config.Agent.Radius * 2f;
        for (int i = 0; i < positions.Count; i++)
        {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < positions.Count; j++)
            {
                Assert.True(
                    Vector2.Distance(positions[i], positions[j]) >= minimumDistance,
                    $"Planned agents {i} and {j} overlap.");
            }
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SpawnAgentsAtPositions_UsesMousePlannedStartPositionsExactly()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 303);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddAgentSpawnGroupFromClick(24f, 15f, 15));
        List<Vector2> starts = simulation.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions();

        simulation.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(starts);

        Assert.Equal(starts.Count, simulation.Agents.Count);
        for (int i = 0; i < starts.Count; i++)
        {
            Assert.Equal(starts[i], simulation.Agents[i].Position);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void VisibilityPlanner_RoutesAroundBlueWallLikeAnyOtherSolidObstacle()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 353);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddBlueWallFromClick(28f, 17f));
        var wall = simulation.Environment.BlueWalls.Single();
        Vector2 start = new(wall.X1 - 3.24f, (wall.Y1 + wall.Y2) * 0.5f);
        Vector2 goal = new(wall.X2 + 3.24f, (wall.Y1 + wall.Y2) * 0.5f);

        VisibilityGraphPlanner planner = new(simulation.Config.Agent);
        IReadOnlyList<Vector2> route = planner.Plan(simulation.Environment, start, goal);

        Assert.NotEmpty(route);
        Assert.Equal(goal, route[^1]);
        Assert.True(route.Count > 1, "A blue wall should force at least one intermediate waypoint.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RoomResize_WorksBeforePlacementAndLocksAfterSceneConstructionStarts()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 404);

        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.TryResizeRoom(40f, 28f));
        Assert.Equal(40f, simulation.Environment.Width, 3);
        Assert.Equal(28f, simulation.Environment.Height, 3);
        Assert.Equal(40f, simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters, 3);
        Assert.Equal(28f, simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters, 3);

        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
            simulation.Environment.Width / 2,
            simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2,
            personsWide: 3));
        Assert.False(simulation.Environment.TryResizeRoom(48f, 32f));
        Assert.Equal(40f, simulation.Environment.Width, 3);
        Assert.Equal(28f, simulation.Environment.Height, 3);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ScenarioRoundTrip_PreservesRoomBlueWallsAndMouseSpawnGroups()
    {
        string directory = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), $"crowdsim-builder-{Guid.NewGuid():N}");
        try
        {
            Simulation source = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 505);
            Assert.True(source.Environment.TryResizeRoom(44f, 29f));
            Assert.True(source.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
                source.Environment.Width / 2,
                source.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2,
                personsWide: 3));
            Assert.True(source.Environment.AddBlueWallFromClick(12f, 12f));
            Assert.True(source.Environment.AddAgentSpawnGroupFromClick(30f, 18f, 15));

            ScenarioDefinition captured = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(
                source,
                requestedAgentCount: 0,
                name: "builder_roundtrip");
            ScenarioFileStore.Save(captured, directory);
            ScenarioDefinition loaded = ScenarioFileStore.Load("builder_roundtrip", directory);

            Simulation restored = new(0, loaded.CreateConfig(), loaded.RandomSeed);
            loaded.ApplyLayout(restored);

            Assert.Equal(44f, restored.Environment.Width, 3);
            Assert.Equal(29f, restored.Environment.Height, 3);
            Assert.Single(restored.Environment.BlueWalls);
            Assert.Equal(15, restored.Environment.PlannedAgentCount);
            List<Vector2> expectedStarts = source.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions();
            List<Vector2> restoredStarts = restored.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions();
            Assert.Equal(expectedStarts.Count, restoredStarts.Count);
            for (int index = 0; index < expectedStarts.Count; index++)
            {
                Assert.Equal(expectedStarts[index], restoredStarts[index]);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(directory))
            {
                Directory.Delete(directory, recursive: true);
            }
        }
    }
}
```
