```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class ChairChainPushTests
{
    private static (Simulation Sim, List<FurnitureChair> Chairs) Scene(int count)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 731);
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(new[] { new Vector2(9.3f, 10f) });
        sim.Agents[0].State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        List<FurnitureChair> chairs = new();
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            FurnitureChair chair = new(new Vector2(10f + 0.6f * i, 10f), 0f);
            chairs.Add(chair);
            sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Add(chair.Obstacle!);
        }
        return (sim, chairs);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(2, 0.08f)]
    [InlineData(3, 0.06f)]
    public void SmallChainTranslatesTogetherWithAddedResistance(int count, float travel)
    {
        var (sim, chairs) = Scene(count);
        Assert.True(sim.TryTranslateChairGroup(chairs[0], new Vector2(0.12f, 0f)));
        foreach (FurnitureChair chair in chairs)
        {
            Assert.InRange(chair.Position.X - chair.StartPosition.X, travel - 0.0001f, travel + 0.0001f);
            Assert.Equal(chair.Position, chair.Obstacle!.Center);
            Assert.Contains(chair.Obstacle, sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
            Assert.Equal(sim.FrameIndex, chair.LastPushFrame);
        }
        Assert.False(sim.TryTranslateChairGroup(chairs[0], new Vector2(0.12f, 0f)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FourChairChainIsRejectedWithoutMovingAnyChair()
    {
        var (sim, chairs) = Scene(4);
        Assert.False(sim.TryTranslateChairGroup(chairs[0], new Vector2(0.12f, 0f)));
        Assert.All(chairs, chair => Assert.Equal(chair.StartPosition, chair.Position));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OccupiedChairStopsEntireChain()
    {
        var (sim, chairs) = Scene(3);
        chairs[2].OccupantId = 999;
        Assert.False(sim.TryTranslateChairGroup(chairs[0], new Vector2(0.12f, 0f)));
        Assert.All(chairs, chair => Assert.Equal(chair.StartPosition, chair.Position));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void WallStopsEntireChain()
    {
        var (sim, chairs) = Scene(2);
        sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(10.92f, 8f, 11.1f, 12f));
        Assert.False(sim.TryTranslateChairGroup(chairs[0], new Vector2(0.12f, 0f)));
        Assert.All(chairs, chair => Assert.Equal(chair.StartPosition, chair.Position));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CrawlingPersonStopsEntireChain()
    {
        var (sim, chairs) = Scene(2);
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(new[] { new Vector2(9.3f, 10f), new Vector2(11.15f, 10f) });
        sim.Agents[1].MarkCrawling();
        Assert.False(sim.TryTranslateChairGroup(chairs[0], new Vector2(0.12f, 0f)));
        Assert.All(chairs, chair => Assert.Equal(chair.StartPosition, chair.Position));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NormalPushFallsBackToChainInNarrowPassage()
    {
        var (sim, chairs) = Scene(2);
        Agent person = sim.Agents[0];
        person.Velocity = new Vector2(0.15f, 0f);
        sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(8f, 9.45f, 14f, 9.65f));
        sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(8f, 10.35f, 14f, 10.55f));
        Assert.True(sim.TryPushLooseChair(person, chairs[0].Obstacle!, Vector2.UnitX));
        Assert.All(chairs, chair => Assert.True(chair.Position.X > chair.StartPosition.X));
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/ChairPushingTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class ChairPushingTests
{
    private static (Simulation Sim, FurnitureChair Chair, Agent Pusher) Scene()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 731);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.SingleChair, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(new[] { new Vector2(14.3f, 15f) });
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.Velocity = new Vector2(0.15f, 0f);
        return (sim, sim.Environment.Furniture[0].Chairs[0], agent);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(ChairState.Upright)]
    [InlineData(ChairState.Fallen)]
    public void LooseChairMovesAndRetainsObstacle(ChairState state)
    {
        var (sim, chair, agent) = Scene();
        chair.State = state;
        if (state == ChairState.Fallen)
        {
            sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Remove(chair.Obstacle!);
            chair.Obstacle = chair.Obstacle! with { Radius = 0.40f };
            sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Add(chair.Obstacle);
        }
        CircleBlockage old = chair.Obstacle!;
        Assert.True(sim.TryPushLooseChair(agent, old, Vector2.UnitX));
        Assert.True(chair.Position.X > chair.StartPosition.X);
        Assert.InRange(Vector2.Distance(chair.StartPosition, chair.Position), 0.001f, 0.1201f);
        Assert.Equal(chair.Position, chair.Obstacle!.Center);
        Assert.Contains(chair.Obstacle, sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(old, sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void InjuredWalkerPushesGentlyEvenWithoutMomentum()
    {
        var (sim, chair, agent) = Scene();
        agent.State = AgentState.Injured;
        agent.InjurySpeedFactor = 0.25f;
        agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        Assert.True(sim.TryPushChairTowardGoal(agent, Vector2.UnitX));
        float displacement = Vector2.Distance(chair.StartPosition, chair.Position);
        Assert.InRange(displacement, 0.001f, 0.301f * sim.Config.Agent.Dt);
        Assert.Equal(AgentState.Injured, agent.State);
        Assert.Equal(0.25f, agent.InjurySpeedFactor);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void InjuredWalkerCanClearChairDuringFailedRouteCooldown()
    {
        var (sim, chair, agent) = Scene();
        agent.State = AgentState.Injured;
        agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        agent.FailedRouteKey = "blocked";
        agent.FailedRouteRetryFrame = sim.FrameIndex + 10;
        Vector2 direction = sim.EvacuationSystem.ResolveStaticRouteDirection(
            sim, agent, new Vector2(20f, 15f), "blocked");
        Assert.True(chair.Position.X > chair.StartPosition.X);
        Assert.True(direction.X > 0.9f);
        Assert.Equal(0, sim.LastRoutePlanRequests);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MovementPipelinePushesBeforeHardCollision()
    {
        var (sim, chair, agent) = Scene();
        sim.MoveAgent(agent);
        Assert.True(chair.Position.X > chair.StartPosition.X);
        Assert.True(Vector2.Distance(agent.Position, chair.Position) >=
            sim.Config.Agent.Radius + chair.Obstacle!.Radius - 0.001f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void WaitingAgentCanShiftChairWithoutRunningMomentum()
    {
        var (sim, chair, agent) = Scene();
        agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        agent.LocalNavigationMode = LocalNavigationMode.WaitingForGap;
        Assert.True(sim.TryPushChairTowardGoal(agent, Vector2.UnitX));
        Assert.True(chair.Position.X > chair.StartPosition.X);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MultiplePushesInOneTickCannotMultiplyChairSpeed()
    {
        var (sim, chair, agent) = Scene();
        Assert.True(sim.TryPushLooseChair(agent, chair.Obstacle!, Vector2.UnitX));
        Vector2 position = chair.Position;
        Assert.False(sim.TryPushLooseChair(agent, chair.Obstacle!, Vector2.UnitX));
        Assert.Equal(position, chair.Position);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OccupiedChairCannotBePushed()
    {
        var (sim, chair, agent) = Scene();
        chair.OccupantId = 123;
        Assert.False(sim.TryPushLooseChair(agent, chair.Obstacle!, Vector2.UnitX));
        Assert.Equal(chair.StartPosition, chair.Position);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(ChairState.Airborne)]
    [InlineData(ChairState.Destroyed)]
    public void AirborneOrDestroyedChairCannotBePushed(ChairState state)
    {
        var (sim, chair, agent) = Scene();
        chair.State = state;
        Assert.False(sim.TryPushLooseChair(agent, chair.Obstacle!, Vector2.UnitX));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TrappedChairCannotPassThroughWallOrFurniture()
    {
        var (sim, chair, agent) = Scene();
        // Forward wall and two lateral table-size footprints block all five push directions.
        sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(15.30f, 13f, 15.5f, 17f));
        sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Add(new CircleBlockage(new Vector2(15f, 16.2f), 0.90f) { IsFurniture = true });
        sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Add(new CircleBlockage(new Vector2(15f, 13.8f), 0.90f) { IsFurniture = true });
        Assert.False(sim.TryPushLooseChair(agent, chair.Obstacle!, Vector2.UnitX));
        Assert.Equal(chair.StartPosition, chair.Position);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ChairShiftsSidewaysWithoutEnteringCrawler()
    {
        var (sim, chair, _) = Scene();
        float gap = chair.Obstacle!.Radius + sim.Config.Agent.Radius * 1.25f;
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(new[] { new Vector2(14.3f, 15f), new Vector2(15f + gap, 15f) });
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        Agent crawler = sim.Agents[1];
        crawler.State = AgentState.Crawling;
        Assert.True(sim.TryPushLooseChair(agent, chair.Obstacle!, Vector2.UnitX));
        Assert.True(Vector2.Distance(chair.Position, crawler.Position) >= gap - 0.0001f);
        Assert.NotEqual(15f, chair.Position.Y);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CrawlingPersonCannotShoveFurnitureWithRunningMomentum()
    {
        var (sim, chair, agent) = Scene();
        agent.State = AgentState.Crawling;
        Assert.False(sim.TryPushLooseChair(agent, chair.Obstacle!, Vector2.UnitX));
    }
}
```

```csharp
using CrowdSim.OpenGL.UI;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Check panel allocation and inspector continuity independently of an OpenGL context.</summary>
public sealed class DashboardLayoutTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData(320f)]
    [InlineData(640f)]
    [InlineData(1000f)]
    [InlineData(1280f)]
    [InlineData(1600f)]
    [InlineData(2560f)]
    public void BothPanelStatesFitWithoutOverflowAndHidingExpandsTheViewport(float width)
    {
        DashboardLayout shown = DashboardLayout.Calculate(width, true);
        DashboardLayout hidden = DashboardLayout.Calculate(width, false);
        Assert.True(shown.ControlsWidth > 0f && shown.ViewportWidth > 0f && shown.InspectorWidth > 0f);
        Assert.Equal(width, shown.ControlsWidth + shown.ViewportWidth + shown.InspectorWidth + 2f * shown.Gap, 3);
        Assert.Equal(width, hidden.ControlsWidth + hidden.ViewportWidth + hidden.Gap, 3);
        Assert.Equal(shown.ControlsWidth, hidden.ControlsWidth);
        Assert.Equal(0f, hidden.InspectorWidth);
        Assert.Equal(shown.InspectorWidth + shown.Gap, hidden.ViewportWidth - shown.ViewportWidth, 3);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OversizedSpacingCannotConsumeTheViewportInATinyWindow()
    {
        DashboardLayout layout = DashboardLayout.Calculate(100f, true, 300f);
        Assert.True(layout.ViewportWidth > 0f);
        Assert.Equal(100f, layout.ControlsWidth + layout.ViewportWidth + layout.InspectorWidth + 2f * layout.Gap, 3);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HideShowRetainsTheDebugDestinationAndAgentSelectionDoesNotForceItOpen()
    {
        InspectorPanelState state = new();
        state.SelectTab(InspectorTab.Debug);
        state.ToggleVisibility();
        state.ToggleVisibility();
        Assert.Equal(InspectorTab.Debug, state.ActiveTab);
        Assert.True(state.IsVisible);

        state.ToggleVisibility();
        state.SelectTab(InspectorTab.Agent);
        Assert.False(state.IsVisible);
        state.Show(InspectorTab.Agent);
        Assert.True(state.IsVisible);
        Assert.Equal(InspectorTab.Agent, state.ActiveTab);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(0f)]
    [InlineData(-1f)]
    [InlineData(float.NaN)]
    [InlineData(float.PositiveInfinity)]
    public void InvalidDimensionsCannotReachImGui(float width)
        => Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => DashboardLayout.Calculate(width, true));
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/Fix15Tests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class Fix15Tests
{
    [Fact]
    public void CalmEvacuatingAgent_HasUrgencySpeedFloor()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(1, seed: 1501);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.PanicLevel = 0f;
        agent.InjurySpeedFactor = 1f;

        float expected =
            agent.BaseSpeed *
            simulation.Config.Agent.EvacuationSpeedFloorMultiplier *
            Math.Clamp(agent.UrgencyBias, 0.75f, 1.25f);

        Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(agent.CurrentDesiredSpeed - expected), 0f, 0.0001f);
        Assert.True(agent.CurrentDesiredSpeed > agent.BaseSpeed);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ActiveAlarmSocialSignal_RemainsMeaningfulWhenObserverAlreadyHasPanic()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(2, seed: 1502);
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent observer = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent source = simulation.Agents[1];

        observer.Position = new Vector2(24.2857f, 17f);
        observer.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        observer.ExitTarget = exit;
        observer.PanicLevel = 0.45f;
        observer.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;

        source.Position = new Vector2(25.0952f, 17f);
        source.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        source.ExitTarget = exit;
        source.PanicLevel = 0.50f;
        source.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        source.ActivateDirectAlarm(
            simulation.FrameIndex,
            durationFrames: 30,
            panicFloor: 0.50f,
            episodeId: 1502);

        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        simulation.Step();

        // A single source must attenuate with distance rather than cancelling its own weight.
        float expectedSignal = 0.50f * MathF.Exp(-0.8095f / simulation.Config.Agent.PanicThreatScale);
        Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(observer.LastSocialPanicStimulus - expectedSignal), 0f, 0.0001f);
        Assert.True(observer.PanicLevel > 0.45f);
        Assert.InRange(observer.PanicLevel, 0f, 0.60f);
        Assert.Equal(1502, observer.LastRelayedAlarmEpisodeId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CoherentEvacuationFlow_TriggersAwarenessWithoutCreatingPanicAlarm()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(4, seed: 1503);
        Agent observer = simulation.Agents[0];
        observer.Position = new Vector2(32.381f, 24.2857f);
        observer.State = AgentState.Wandering;
        observer.PanicLevel = 0f;

        for (int i = 1; i < 4; i++)
        {
            Agent evacuee = simulation.Agents[i];
            evacuee.Position = new Vector2(32.9881f + i * 0.3238f, 24.2857f + i * 0.0405f);
            evacuee.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
            evacuee.ExitTarget = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
            evacuee.PanicLevel = 0f;
            evacuee.Velocity = Vector2.UnitX * (evacuee.BaseSpeed * 1.2f);
        }

        // The event exists so evacuation behaviour has emergency context, but it is far
        // enough away that no direct shock/panic can reach this local test group.
        simulation.Environment.SetExplosion(4.05f, 4.05f, simulation.FrameIndex);
        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        simulation.Step();

        Assert.Equal(AgentState.WaitingToReact, observer.State);
        Assert.True(observer.LastEvacuationAwarenessStimulus > 0f);
        Assert.InRange(observer.PanicLevel, 0f, 0.0001f);
        Assert.Equal(-1, observer.ActiveAlarmEpisodeId);
        Assert.Equal(-1, observer.LastRelayedAlarmEpisodeId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ObviousEvacuatingCrowd_TriggersAwarenessEvenWhenMovementIsSlow()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(5, seed: 1504);
        Agent observer = simulation.Agents[0];
        observer.Position = new Vector2(32.381f, 24.2857f);
        observer.State = AgentState.Wandering;
        observer.PanicLevel = 0f;

        for (int i = 1; i < 5; i++)
        {
            Agent evacuee = simulation.Agents[i];
            evacuee.Position = observer.Position + new Vector2(0.4048f * i, 0.1619f * (i % 2));
            evacuee.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
            evacuee.ExitTarget = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
            evacuee.PanicLevel = 0f;
            // Even a temporarily stalled evacuation crowd is strong behavioural evidence.
            evacuee.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }

        simulation.Environment.SetExplosion(4.05f, 4.05f, simulation.FrameIndex);
        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        simulation.Step();

        Assert.Equal(AgentState.WaitingToReact, observer.State);
        Assert.True(observer.LastEvacuationAwarenessStimulus >= 0.50f);
        Assert.InRange(observer.PanicLevel, 0f, 0.0001f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EvacuationAwarenessAlone_DoesNotCreateLatePanicEpisode()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(4, seed: 1505);
        Agent observer = simulation.Agents[0];
        observer.Position = new Vector2(36.4286f, 26.3095f);
        observer.State = AgentState.Wandering;
        observer.PanicLevel = 0f;

        for (int i = 1; i < 4; i++)
        {
            Agent evacuee = simulation.Agents[i];
            evacuee.Position = new Vector2(37.0357f + i * 0.2833f, 26.3095f + i * 0.0405f);
            evacuee.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
            evacuee.ExitTarget = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
            evacuee.PanicLevel = 0f;
            evacuee.Velocity = Vector2.UnitX * (evacuee.BaseSpeed * 1.2f);
        }

        simulation.Environment.SetExplosion(4.05f, 4.05f, simulation.FrameIndex);
        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        for (int i = 0; i < 25; i++)
        {
            simulation.Step();
        }

        Assert.NotEqual(AgentState.Wandering, observer.State);
        Assert.InRange(observer.PanicLevel, 0f, 0.0001f);
        Assert.Equal(-1, observer.ActiveAlarmEpisodeId);
        Assert.Equal(-1, observer.LastRelayedAlarmEpisodeId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ScenarioJson_RoundTripPreservesGeometryRadiiAgentCountAndSeed()
    {
        string directory = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), $"crowdsim-fix15-{Guid.NewGuid():N}");
        try
        {
            Simulation source = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 4242);
            source.Config.Agent.SetBlastZoneRadii(1.01f, 2.43f, 4.45f, 7.29f, 12.95f);
            source.Config.Agent.Behavior.SetValues(
                traitVariation: 0.80f,
                reactionVariation: 0.60f,
                stressSusceptibility: 1.15f,
                stressPersistence: 1.35f,
                crowdFollowing: 0.65f,
                personalSpace: 1.10f,
                panicSpaceCompression: 0.25f,
                emergencyUrgency: 1.12f,
                helpingTendency: 0.40f,
                routeFamiliarity: 0.75f,
                bottleneckAssertiveness: 0.68f,
                bottleneckPressureSensitivity: 1.22f,
                bottleneckSpaceCompression: 0.26f);
            Assert.True(source.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
                source.Config.World.WidthMeters / 2,
                source.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2,
                personsWide: 3));
            Assert.True(source.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
                source.Config.World.WidthMeters - source.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2,
                source.Config.World.LengthMeters / 2,
                personsWide: 1));
            Assert.True(source.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(24.29f, 16.19f));

            ScenarioDefinition captured = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(
                source,
                requestedAgentCount: 321,
                name: "fix15_roundtrip");
            ScenarioFileStore.Save(captured, directory);
            ScenarioDefinition loaded = ScenarioFileStore.Load("fix15_roundtrip", directory);

            Simulation restored = new(0, loaded.CreateConfig(), loaded.RandomSeed);
            loaded.ApplyLayout(restored);

            Assert.Equal(ScenarioDefinition.CurrentVersion, loaded.Version);
            Assert.Equal(321, loaded.AgentCount);
            Assert.Equal(4242, loaded.RandomSeed);
            Assert.Equal(source.Environment.Exits.Count, restored.Environment.Exits.Count);
            Assert.Equal(source.Environment.Blockages.Count, restored.Environment.Blockages.Count);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.HardKillRadius, restored.Config.Agent.HardKillRadius);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.HeatIncapacityRadius, restored.Config.Agent.HeatIncapacityRadius);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.FallenRadius, restored.Config.Agent.FallenRadius);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.InjuryRadius, restored.Config.Agent.InjuryRadius);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.HeatRadius, restored.Config.Agent.HeatRadius);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.Behavior.TraitVariation, restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.TraitVariation);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.Behavior.ReactionVariation, restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.ReactionVariation);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.Behavior.StressSusceptibility, restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.StressSusceptibility);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.Behavior.StressPersistence, restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.StressPersistence);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.Behavior.CrowdFollowing, restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.CrowdFollowing);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.Behavior.PersonalSpace, restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.PersonalSpace);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.Behavior.PanicSpaceCompression, restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.PanicSpaceCompression);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.Behavior.EmergencyUrgency, restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.EmergencyUrgency);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.Behavior.HelpingTendency, restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.HelpingTendency);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.Behavior.RouteFamiliarity, restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.RouteFamiliarity);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.Behavior.BottleneckAssertiveness, restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.BottleneckAssertiveness);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.Behavior.BottleneckPressureSensitivity, restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.BottleneckPressureSensitivity);
            Assert.Equal(source.Config.Agent.Behavior.BottleneckSpaceCompression, restored.Config.Agent.Behavior.BottleneckSpaceCompression);

            for (int i = 0; i < source.Environment.Exits.Count; i++)
            {
                Exit expected = source.Environment.Exits[i];
                Exit actual = restored.Environment.Exits[i];
                Assert.Equal(expected.Name, actual.Name);
                Assert.Equal(expected.Side, actual.Side);
                Assert.Equal(expected.Size, actual.Size);
                Assert.Equal(expected.Position, actual.Position);
            }

            Assert.Equal(source.Environment.Blockages[0], restored.Environment.Blockages[0]);

            // The stored seed is part of the scenario contract: a fresh finalisation of
            // the same loaded geometry should reproduce the same initial population.
            source.SpawnAgents(8);
            restored.SpawnAgents(8);
            for (int i = 0; i < source.Agents.Count; i++)
            {
                Assert.Equal(source.Agents[i].Position, restored.Agents[i].Position);
                Assert.Equal(source.Agents[i].BaseSpeed, restored.Agents[i].BaseSpeed);
                Assert.Equal(source.Agents[i].Strategy, restored.Agents[i].Strategy);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(directory))
            {
                Directory.Delete(directory, recursive: true);
            }
        }
    }

    private static Simulation CreateReadySimulation(int count, int seed)
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: seed);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
            simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters / 2,
            simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2,
            personsWide: 3));
        simulation.SpawnAgents(count);
        return simulation;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using System.Text.Json;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Placement, occupancy, persistence and path safety for unoccupied rectangular assets.</summary>
public sealed class FixedAssetTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, 0f, 3f, 1f)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, 90f, 1f, 3f)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, 180f, 3f, 1f)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.Stage, 0f, 15f, 6f)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.Stage, 90f, 6f, 15f)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.Stage, 270f, 6f, 15f)]
    public void ExactFootprintsNeverCreateChairsOrPeople(
        FurnitureKind kind, float degrees, float width, float length)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 171);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(kind, new Vector2(15f, 15f), degrees * MathF.PI / 180f));
        FurnitureSet set = Assert.Single(sim.Environment.Furniture);
        Wall footprint = Assert.IsType<Wall>(set.StaticObstacle);
        Assert.Equal(width, footprint.X2 - footprint.X1, 4);
        Assert.Equal(length, footprint.Y2 - footprint.Y1, 4);
        Assert.True(footprint.IsFurniture);
        Assert.Contains(footprint, sim.Environment.Walls);
        Assert.Empty(set.Chairs);
        if (kind == FurnitureKind.RectangularTable)
        {
            RectangularFurnitureBody body = Assert.IsType<RectangularFurnitureBody>(set.Table);
            Assert.Same(footprint, body.RectangleObstacle);
            Assert.True(footprint.IsMovableFurniture);
            Assert.Null(body.Obstacle);
        }
        else
        {
            Assert.Null(set.Table);
            Assert.False(footprint.IsMovableFurniture);
        }
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions());
        Assert.Empty(sim.Agents);
        Assert.Equal(0, sim.Environment.PlannedAgentCount);
        Assert.Equal(0, FurnitureSet.GetSeatCount(kind));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.Explosion)]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.ToxicFume)]
    public void StageLimitIsOnePerScenarioAndUndoReleasesIt(ScenarioType scenario)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 171);
        sim.SetScenarioType(scenario);
        int initialWalls = sim.Environment.Walls.Count;
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.HasStage);
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.CanPlaceFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(35f, 15f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(35f, 15f)));
        Assert.Single(sim.Environment.Furniture);
        Assert.Equal(initialWalls + 1, sim.Environment.Walls.Count);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.UndoLast());
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.HasStage);
        Assert.Equal(initialWalls, sim.Environment.Walls.Count);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(35f, 15f)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void StandaloneTablesCanBePlacedMoreThanOnceWithoutChangingPopulation()
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddAgentSpawnGroupFromClick(35f, 20f, 5));
        Vector2[] people = sim.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions().ToArray();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, new Vector2(10f, 10f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, new Vector2(14f, 10f)));
        Assert.Equal(2, sim.Environment.Furniture.Count);
        Assert.Equal(people, sim.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions().ToArray());
        Assert.Equal(5, sim.Environment.PlannedAgentCount);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.Stage)]
    public void InvalidCoordinatesAndOutOfBoundsPlacementsAreAtomic(FurnitureKind kind)
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        int version = sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion;
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(kind, new Vector2(1f, 1f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(kind, new Vector2(float.NaN, 15f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(kind, new Vector2(15f, 15f), float.PositiveInfinity));
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.Furniture);
        Assert.Equal(version, sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RectangularPlacementUsesItsShortSideNotAnOversizedCircle()
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        // The table's half-width is 0.5 m; a bounding circle would wrongly reject this.
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, new Vector2(10f, 1.25f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, new Vector2(14f, 1.25f), MathF.PI / 2f));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RectangleRotationSnapsConsistentlyForPreviewAndPlacement()
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        float angle = 68f * MathF.PI / 180f;
        FurnitureSet preview = new(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, new Vector2(15f, 15f), angle);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, preview.Center, angle));
        Assert.Equal(MathF.PI / 2f, preview.Rotation, 4);
        Assert.Equal(preview.StaticObstacle, Assert.Single(sim.Environment.Furniture).StaticObstacle);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.Stage)]
    public void ExistingPeoplePreventOverlappingAssetPlacement(FurnitureKind kind)
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddAgentSpawnGroupFromClick(15f, 15f, 1));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(kind, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.Furniture);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RectanglesCannotOverlapEachOtherAndDoNotLoseChairDepartureClearance()
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, new Vector2(19f, 15f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.SingleChair, new Vector2(19f, 15f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet, new Vector2(30f, 20f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, new Vector2(32f, 20f)));
        Assert.Equal(10, sim.Environment.PlannedAgentCount);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.Stage)]
    public void AssetBlocksMovementButNotFullHeightSightOrHazardFields(FurnitureKind kind)
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(kind, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        Vector2 start = new(15f, 8f);
        Vector2 end = new(15f, 22f);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.IsPointBlocked(new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.False(sim.HasTraversablePath(start, end, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
        Assert.True(sim.HasLineOfSight(start, end));
        Assert.True(EvacuationSystem.HasLineOfSight(start, end, sim.Environment.Walls));
        Assert.False(ExplosionSystem.BlastPathIsBlocked(start, end, sim.Environment.Walls));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.IsFumeBlocked(new Vector2(15f, 15f), 0.02f));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.Stage)]
    public void GlobalPlannerFindsBodyClearAlternativeAroundAsset(FurnitureKind kind)
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(kind, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        Vector2 start = new(15f, 8f);
        Vector2 goal = new(15f, 22f);
        VisibilityGraphPlanner planner = new(sim.Config.Agent);
        IReadOnlyList<Vector2> route = planner.Plan(sim, start, goal);
        Assert.NotEmpty(route);
        Assert.Equal(goal, route[^1]);
        Vector2 previous = start;
        foreach (Vector2 point in route)
        {
            Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(previous, point, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
            previous = point;
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SpawnPlacementNearStageNeverPlacesPeopleInsideItsFootprint()
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddAgentSpawnGroupFromClick(15f, 15f, 50));
        Assert.Equal(50, sim.Environment.PlannedAgentCount);
        Assert.All(sim.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions(), point =>
            Assert.False(sim.Environment.IsPointBlocked(point, sim.Config.Agent.Radius)));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.Explosion)]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.ToxicFume)]
    public void AssetOnlySaveLoadAndReplayKeepZeroAddedOccupants(ScenarioType scenario)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 171);
        sim.SetScenarioType(scenario);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(15f, 15f), MathF.PI / 2f));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, new Vector2(25f, 15f)));
        ScenarioDefinition saved = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(sim, 0, "fixed-assets");
        Assert.Equal(0, saved.AgentCount);
        Assert.Empty(saved.Blockages); // no duplicate serialized collision proxies
        Assert.Empty(saved.CircularBlockages);
        ScenarioDefinition loaded = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ScenarioDefinition>(JsonSerializer.Serialize(saved))!;
        Simulation restored = new(randomSeed: 171);
        loaded.ApplyLayout(restored);
        Assert.Equal(scenario, restored.ScenarioType);
        Assert.Equal(2, restored.Environment.Furniture.Count);
        Assert.Equal(0, restored.Environment.PlannedAgentCount);
        Assert.Equal(2, restored.Environment.Walls.Count(wall => wall.IsFurniture));
        Assert.True(restored.Environment.HasStage);
        Assert.False(restored.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(40f, 15f)));
        Simulation replay = FinalizedSceneCheckpoint.Capture(restored, 0, "replay").CreateReadySimulation();
        Assert.Empty(replay.Agents);
        Assert.Equal(2, replay.Environment.Furniture.Count);
        Assert.True(replay.Environment.HasStage);
        Assert.False(replay.Running);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DuplicateStageCannotEnterThroughScenarioLoadingOrRestore()
    {
        ScenarioDefinition invalid = new()
        {
            Furniture = new List<FurnitureScenario>
            {
                new() { Kind = FurnitureKind.Stage, X = 15f, Y = 15f },
                new() { Kind = FurnitureKind.Stage, X = 35f, Y = 15f },
            },
        };
        Assert.Throws<InvalidDataException>(() => invalid.ValidateBasic());
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.RestoreFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(15f, 15f), 0f));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.RestoreFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(35f, 15f), 0f));
        Assert.Single(sim.Environment.Furniture);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SavedStandingAgentCannotLoadInsideStage()
    {
        ScenarioDefinition invalid = new()
        {
            AgentCount = 1,
            Furniture = new() { new() { Kind = FurnitureKind.Stage, X = 15f, Y = 15f } },
            AgentSpawnGroups = new()
            {
                new() { CenterX = 15f, CenterY = 15f,
                    Positions = new() { new() { X = 15f, Y = 15f } } },
            },
        };
        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => invalid.ApplyLayout(new Simulation()));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MixedFurnitureSavePreservesElevenSeatedPeopleNotThirteen()
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, new Vector2(25f, 15f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet, new Vector2(38f, 20f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.SingleChair, new Vector2(45f, 20f)));
        ScenarioDefinition saved = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(sim, 0, "mixed");
        saved.ValidateBasic();
        Simulation restored = new();
        saved.ApplyLayout(restored);
        restored.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(restored.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions());
        Assert.Equal(11, restored.Agents.Count);
        Assert.All(restored.Agents, agent => Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.Seated, agent.Posture));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void StageStaysFixedWhileNearbyRectangularTableIsDestroyed()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 171);
        // Regression: without an exit, SetRunning(true) correctly refuses to start.
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(sim.Environment.Width / 2f, 0.3f, 5));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, new Vector2(25f, 15f)));
        FurnitureSet stage = sim.Environment.Furniture[0];
        RectangularFurnitureBody table = Assert.IsType<RectangularFurnitureBody>(sim.Environment.Furniture[1].Table);
        Wall stageFootprint = Assert.IsType<Wall>(stage.StaticObstacle);
        Wall tableFootprint = Assert.IsType<Wall>(table.RectangleObstacle);
        int wallVersion = sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion;
        int navigationVersion = sim.Environment.NavigationLayoutVersion;
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(new[] { new Vector2(40f, 25f) });
        sim.Agents[0].MarkExited(); // isolate asset mechanics, but keep the public step API active
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.True(sim.Running, "The regression must execute a running simulation.");
        sim.TriggerExplosion(25f, 15f);
        Assert.NotNull(sim.Environment.Explosion);
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(30, sim.FrameIndex);
        Assert.Same(stageFootprint, stage.StaticObstacle);
        Assert.Contains(stageFootprint, sim.Environment.Walls);
        Assert.Null(stage.Table);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Destroyed, table.State);
        Assert.Null(table.RectangleObstacle);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(tableFootprint, sim.Environment.Walls);
        Assert.Equal(wallVersion, sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.NavigationLayoutVersion > navigationVersion);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OnlyFixedAssetsStillPreventRoomResizeUntilUndone()
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.CanResizeRoom);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.CanResizeRoom);
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.TryResizeRoom(10f, 10f));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.UndoLast());
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.CanResizeRoom);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ClearingTheLayoutRemovesFixedProxiesAndResetsStageLimit()
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        sim.Environment.ReplaceLayout(Array.Empty<Exit>(), Array.Empty<Wall>());
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.HasStage);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(sim.Environment.Walls, wall => wall.IsFurniture);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(35f, 15f)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EnlargedStageCannotBePlacedInRoomThatOnlyFitsTheOldStage()
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.TryResizeRoom(12f, 12f));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(6f, 6f)));
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.Furniture);
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.HasStage);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OriginalFurnitureEnumValuesAndOccupancyAreUnchanged()
    {
        Assert.Equal(0, (int)FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet);
        Assert.Equal(1, (int)FurnitureKind.SingleChair);
        Assert.Equal(10, FurnitureSet.GetSeatCount(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet));
        Assert.Equal(1, FurnitureSet.GetSeatCount(FurnitureKind.SingleChair));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LowStageRemainsVisibleAcrossSpatialHashSightBranch()
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        // More than 48 walls selects the spatial-hash LOS branch instead of the simple scan.
        for (int y = 0; y < 8; y++)
        for (int x = 0; x < 7; x++)
            sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(40f + x * 2f, 2f + y * 3f,
                40.5f + x * 2f, 2.5f + y * 3f));
        sim.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.Walls.Count > 48);
        Assert.True(sim.HasLineOfSight(new Vector2(15f, 8f), new Vector2(15f, 22f)));
        Assert.False(sim.HasTraversablePath(new Vector2(15f, 8f), new Vector2(15f, 22f), sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.Stage)]
    public void SharedExitGuidanceIncludesFixedFootprintAndReusesItsField(FurnitureKind kind)
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(kind, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        SharedExitFields fields = new();
        Vector2 goal = new(15f, 22f);
        Assert.True(fields.TryDirection(sim, new Vector2(15f, 10f), goal, out Vector2 direction));
        Assert.True(float.IsFinite(direction.X) && float.IsFinite(direction.Y));
        int builds = fields.FieldBuilds;
        Assert.True(fields.TryDirection(sim, new Vector2(16f, 10f), goal, out _));
        Assert.Equal(builds, fields.FieldBuilds);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ManyRectangularTablesStillAllowBoundedGridRouting()
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        for (int y = 0; y < 3; y++)
        for (int x = 0; x < 8; x++)
            Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable,
                new Vector2(5f + x * 5f, 5f + y * 5f)));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        Assert.Equal(24, sim.Environment.Furniture.Count);
        Vector2 start = new(10f, 2f);
        Vector2 goal = new(10f, 22f);
        IReadOnlyList<Vector2> route = new VisibilityGraphPlanner(sim.Config.Agent).Plan(sim, start, goal);
        Assert.NotEmpty(route);
        Vector2 previous = start;
        foreach (Vector2 point in route)
        {
            Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(previous, point, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
            previous = point;
        }
        Assert.Equal(goal, previous);
    }

}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/FurnitureBlastTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Blast furniture lifecycle checks through the public simulation API.</summary>
public sealed class FurnitureBlastTests
{
    private static (Simulation Sim, FurnitureBody Body) Scene(FurnitureKind kind)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 731);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(sim.Environment.Width / 2f, 0.3f, 5));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(kind, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(sim.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions());
        // Keep the timestep active but isolate furniture mechanics from casualty randomness.
        foreach (Agent agent in sim.Agents) agent.MarkExited();
        FurnitureSet set = sim.Environment.Furniture[0];
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        return (sim, set.Table ?? set.Chairs[0]);
    }

    private static void Advance(Simulation sim, int frames = 120)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) sim.Step();
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.SingleChair)]
    public void CenterBlastRemovesBodyAndCollisionProxy(FurnitureKind kind)
    {
        var (sim, body) = Scene(kind);
        CircleBlockage original = body.Obstacle!;
        sim.TriggerExplosion(15f, 15f);
        Advance(sim);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Destroyed, body.State);
        Assert.Null(body.Obstacle);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(original, sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.SingleChair)]
    public void NearBlastFliesOutwardThenLandsAsPersistentObstacle(FurnitureKind kind)
    {
        var (sim, body) = Scene(kind);
        CircleBlockage original = body.Obstacle!;
        sim.TriggerExplosion(11f, 15f);
        bool airborne = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < 120; i++)
        {
            sim.Step();
            airborne |= body.State == ChairState.Airborne && body.Height > 0f;
        }
        Assert.True(airborne);
        Assert.True(body.Position.X > body.StartPosition.X + 0.1f);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Fallen, body.State);
        Assert.Equal(0f, body.Height);
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.Zero, body.Velocity);
        Assert.Equal(body.Position, body.Obstacle!.Center);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(original, sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
        Assert.Contains(body.Obstacle, sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
        Assert.False(sim.HasTraversablePath(body.Position - Vector2.UnitX * 2f,
            body.Position + Vector2.UnitX * 2f, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
        Vector2 landed = body.Position;
        int version = sim.Environment.NavigationLayoutVersion;
        Advance(sim);
        Assert.Equal(landed, body.Position);
        Assert.Equal(version, sim.Environment.NavigationLayoutVersion);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.SingleChair)]
    public void WallShieldsFurnitureFromImpulse(FurnitureKind kind)
    {
        var (sim, body) = Scene(kind);
        sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(13f, 10f, 13.2f, 20f));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        sim.TriggerExplosion(11f, 15f);
        Advance(sim);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Upright, body.State);
        Assert.Equal(body.StartPosition, body.Position);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.SingleChair)]
    public void SweptFlightStopsBeforeWall(FurnitureKind kind)
    {
        var (sim, body) = Scene(kind);
        sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(16.5f, 10f, 16.7f, 20f));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        sim.TriggerExplosion(11f, 15f);
        Advance(sim);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Fallen, body.State);
        Assert.True(body.Position.X + body.Obstacle!.Radius <= 16.501f);
        Assert.True(body.Position.X > body.StartPosition.X);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DistantBlastLeavesTableIntact()
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet);
        sim.TriggerExplosion(2f, 2f);
        Advance(sim);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Upright, table.State);
        Assert.Equal(table.StartPosition, table.Position);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SaveAfterTableDestructionRestoresAuthoredTableOnReplay()
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet);
        sim.TriggerExplosion(15f, 15f);
        Advance(sim);
        Assert.Null(table.Obstacle);
        ScenarioDefinition saved = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(sim, 0, "Table replay");
        Simulation replay = new(randomSeed: 731);
        saved.ApplyLayout(replay);
        FurnitureBody restored = replay.Environment.Furniture[0].Table!;
        Assert.Equal(new Vector2(15f, 15f), restored.Position);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Upright, restored.State);
        Assert.Contains(restored.Obstacle!, replay.Environment.CircularBlockages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ToxicModeDoesNotLaunchOrDestroyTable()
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet);
        sim.SetRunning(false);
        sim.SetScenarioType(ScenarioType.ToxicFume);
        Assert.True(sim.ToxicFumeSystem.TrySetSource(sim, new Vector2(12f, 12f)));
        sim.PrecomputeToxicFume();
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.True(sim.TriggerToxicFumeRelease());
        Advance(sim, 10);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Upright, table.State);
        Assert.Equal(table.StartPosition, table.Position);
        Assert.Contains(table.Obstacle!, sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.SingleChair)]
    public void ConfiguredIncapacitationBoundaryDestroysFurniture(FurnitureKind kind)
    {
        var (sim, body) = Scene(kind);
        sim.Config.Agent.SetBlastZoneRadii(2f, 5f, 7f, 10f, 18f);
        sim.TriggerExplosion(10f, 15f); // exactly the configured incap boundary
        Advance(sim);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Destroyed, body.State);
        Assert.Null(body.Obstacle);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.SingleChair)]
    public void CloserSurvivingFurnitureTravelsFarther(FurnitureKind kind)
    {
        var near = Scene(kind);
        var far = Scene(kind);
        // Compare unobstructed travel; impacts can legitimately shorten the nearer flight.
        if (kind == FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet)
        {
            foreach (Simulation scene in new[] { near.Sim, far.Sim })
            {
                foreach (FurnitureChair chair in scene.Environment.Furniture[0].Chairs)
                    scene.Environment.CircularBlockages.Remove(chair.Obstacle!);
                scene.Environment.Furniture[0].Chairs.Clear();
            }
        }
        near.Sim.TriggerExplosion(11f, 15f); // 4 metres
        far.Sim.TriggerExplosion(3f, 15f); // 12 metres: outside the old launch radius
        Advance(near.Sim);
        Advance(far.Sim);
        float nearTravel = Vector2.Distance(near.Body.StartPosition, near.Body.Position);
        float farTravel = Vector2.Distance(far.Body.StartPosition, far.Body.Position);
        Assert.True(farTravel > 0f);
        Assert.True(nearTravel > farTravel);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SameSeedProducesIdenticalFurnitureLanding()
    {
        var first = Scene(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet);
        var second = Scene(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet);
        first.Sim.TriggerExplosion(11f, 15f);
        second.Sim.TriggerExplosion(11f, 15f);
        Advance(first.Sim);
        Advance(second.Sim);
        Assert.Equal(first.Body.Position, second.Body.Position);
        Assert.Equal(first.Body.State, second.Body.State);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class FurnitureImpactTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void EqualMassImpactTransfersMomentumAndLosesEnergy()
    {
        FurnitureBody first = new FurnitureChair(Vector2.Zero, 0f) { Velocity = new Vector2(4f, 0f) };
        FurnitureBody second = new FurnitureChair(Vector2.UnitX, 0f);
        Simulation.ApplyFurnitureContactImpulse(first, second, Vector2.UnitX, false);
        Assert.InRange(first.Velocity.X, 1.69f, 1.71f);
        Assert.InRange(second.Velocity.X, 2.29f, 2.31f);
        Assert.InRange(first.Velocity.X + second.Velocity.X, 3.999f, 4.001f);
        Assert.True(first.Velocity.LengthSquared() + second.Velocity.LengthSquared() < 16f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ChairLosesMostSpeedAgainstHeavierTable()
    {
        FurnitureBody chair = new FurnitureChair(Vector2.Zero, 0f) { Velocity = new Vector2(4f, 0f) };
        FurnitureBody table = new(Vector2.UnitX, 0f, FurnitureSet.TableRadius);
        Simulation.ApplyFurnitureContactImpulse(chair, table, Vector2.UnitX, false);
        Assert.True(chair.Velocity.X < 0.1f);
        Assert.InRange(table.Velocity.X, 0.6f, 0.7f);
        Assert.InRange(chair.Velocity.X + table.Velocity.X * 6f, 3.999f, 4.001f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PinnedTargetDoesNotGainVelocity()
    {
        FurnitureBody chair = new FurnitureChair(Vector2.Zero, 0f) { Velocity = new Vector2(4f, 0f) };
        FurnitureBody table = new(Vector2.UnitX, 0f, FurnitureSet.TableRadius);
        Simulation.ApplyFurnitureContactImpulse(chair, table, Vector2.UnitX, true);
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.Zero, table.Velocity);
        Assert.True(chair.Velocity.X < 0f);
    }

    private static (Simulation Sim, FurnitureChair Moving, FurnitureChair Target) Scene(float height)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 731);
        // SetRunning deliberately rejects a scene without an exit.
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(sim.Environment.Width / 2f, 0.3f, 5));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.SingleChair, new Vector2(10f, 10f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.SingleChair, new Vector2(13f, 10f)));
        // A distant exited agent keeps the public step API active without incidental person impacts.
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(new[] { new Vector2(20f, 20f) });
        sim.Agents[0].MarkExited();
        FurnitureChair moving = sim.Environment.Furniture[0].Chairs[0];
        FurnitureChair target = sim.Environment.Furniture[1].Chairs[0];
        moving.State = ChairState.Airborne;
        moving.Height = height;
        moving.Velocity = new Vector2(12f, 0f);
        moving.BlastApplied = true;
        target.BlastApplied = true;
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.True(sim.Running, "Impact-test scene must be running before testing furniture motion.");
        return (sim, moving, target);
    }

    private static void Advance(Simulation sim, int frames)
    {
        int initialFrame = sim.FrameIndex;
        Assert.True(sim.Running);
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(initialFrame + frames, sim.FrameIndex);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LowFlightHitsChairAndTransfersMovementThroughStepPipeline()
    {
        var (sim, moving, target) = Scene(0.1f);
        Advance(sim, 20);
        Assert.True(target.Position.X > target.StartPosition.X);
        Assert.True(moving.Position.X < target.Position.X);
        Assert.True(Vector2.Distance(moving.Position, target.Position) >=
            Simulation.FurnitureCollisionRadius(moving) + Simulation.FurnitureCollisionRadius(target) - 0.01f);
        Assert.Contains(target.Obstacle!, sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FurniturePinnedAgainstWallStopsIncomingMotion()
    {
        var (sim, moving, target) = Scene(0.1f);
        sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(13.30f, 8f, 13.5f, 12f));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        Advance(sim, 20);
        Assert.Equal(target.StartPosition, target.Position);
        Assert.True(moving.Position.X < target.Position.X);
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.Zero, target.Velocity);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HighFlightCanPassOverChairWithoutHorizontalImpact()
    {
        var (sim, moving, target) = Scene(3f);
        Advance(sim, 3);
        Assert.True(moving.Position.X > target.Position.X);
        Assert.Equal(target.StartPosition, target.Position);
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.Zero, target.Velocity);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DescendingBodyLandsOnFurnitureAndFallsWhenSupportIsRemoved()
    {
        var (sim, moving, target) = Scene(2f);
        moving.Position = target.Position;
        moving.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        Advance(sim, 15);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Fallen, moving.State);
        Assert.Same(target, moving.SupportBody);
        Assert.True(moving.Height >= Simulation.FurnitureBodyHeight(target));
        target.State = ChairState.Destroyed;
        sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Remove(target.Obstacle!);
        target.Obstacle = null;
        Advance(sim, 15);
        Assert.Null(moving.SupportBody);
        Assert.Equal(0f, moving.Height);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using System.Text.Json;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Public-API regression coverage for furniture, hazards, navigation and persistence.</summary>
public sealed class FurnitureTests
{
    private static Simulation Scene(FurnitureKind kind = FurnitureKind.SingleChair)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 731);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(sim.Environment.Width / 2f, 0.3f, 5));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(kind, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(sim.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions());
        return sim;
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet, 10, 11)]
    [InlineData(FurnitureKind.SingleChair, 1, 1)]
    public void PlacementSpawnsExactlyOneOccupantPerChair(FurnitureKind kind, int people, int obstacles)
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(kind);
        Assert.Equal(people, sim.Environment.PlannedAgentCount);
        Assert.Equal(people, sim.Agents.Count);
        Assert.Equal(obstacles, sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Count);
        Assert.All(sim.Agents, a => { Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.Seated, a.Posture); Assert.Equal(a.AgentId, a.Chair!.OccupantId); });
        Assert.Equal(people, sim.Agents.Select(a => a.Chair).Distinct().Count());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SeatedOccupantsRemainStillBeforeAnyThreat()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet);
        Vector2[] starts = sim.Agents.Select(a => a.Position).ToArray();
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(starts, sim.Agents.Select(a => a.Position).ToArray());
        Assert.All(sim.Agents, a => Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.Seated, a.Posture));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void UndoRemovesEntireSetAndOccupantsFromPlan()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 731);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.UndoLast());
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.Furniture);
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void InvalidPlacementIsAtomic()
    {
        Simulation sim = new();
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet, new Vector2(1f, 1f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.SingleChair, new Vector2(float.NaN, 10f)));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.SingleChair, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        Assert.Equal(10, sim.Environment.PlannedAgentCount);
        Assert.Single(sim.Environment.Furniture);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ChairBlocksWalkingButDoesNotShieldItsOccupant()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        Vector2 seat = sim.Agents[0].Position;
        Assert.True(sim.HasLineOfSight(seat - Vector2.UnitX * 2f, seat));
        Assert.False(sim.HasTraversablePath(seat - Vector2.UnitX * 2f, seat + Vector2.UnitX * 2f, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.IsFumeBlocked(seat, 0.02f));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReactionStartsTimedRiseThenReleasesIntoExistingMovement()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        Agent a = sim.Agents[0];
        a.BeginReaction(0, 0);
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.StandingUp, a.Posture);
        Assert.InRange(a.StandUpSeconds, 0.6f, 2.1f);
        Assert.True(a.StandUpElapsed < a.StandUpSeconds);
        for (int i = 0; i < 100 && a.Posture != SeatingPosture.Walking; i++) sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.Walking, a.Posture);
        Assert.Null(a.Chair);
        Assert.Null(sim.Environment.Furniture[0].Chairs[0].OccupantId);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(AgentState.Dead)]
    [InlineData(AgentState.Incapacitated)]
    [InlineData(AgentState.Fallen)]
    public void SeatingCannotReviveCasualties(AgentState state)
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        Agent a = sim.Agents[0];
        a.State = state;
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(state, a.State);
        Assert.NotEqual(SeatingPosture.StandingUp, a.Posture);
        Assert.Null(a.Chair);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BlastAtSeatAppliesExistingFatalityAndDestroysChair()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        sim.TriggerExplosion(15f, 15f);
        sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(AgentState.Dead, sim.Agents[0].State);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Destroyed, sim.Environment.Furniture[0].Chairs[0].State);
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ToxicExposureReachesSeatedPersonAndStartsRise()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        sim.SetScenarioType(ScenarioType.ToxicFume);
        Assert.True(sim.ToxicFumeSystem.TrySetSource(sim, new Vector2(15.5f, 15f)));
        sim.PrecomputeToxicFume();
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.True(sim.TriggerToxicFumeRelease());
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) sim.Step();
        Assert.True(sim.Agents[0].CumulativeToxicExposure > 0f);
        Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.StandingUp, sim.Agents[0].Posture);
        Assert.True(sim.ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(sim));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SaveReloadRestoresAuthoredLayoutWithoutDuplicateProxiesOrOccupants()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet);
        ScenarioDefinition saved = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(sim, 0, "Furniture test");
        Assert.Empty(saved.CircularBlockages);
        Assert.Single(saved.Furniture);
        string json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(saved);
        ScenarioDefinition loaded = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ScenarioDefinition>(json)!;
        Simulation restored = new(randomSeed: 731);
        loaded.ApplyLayout(restored);
        restored.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(restored.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions());
        Assert.Equal(10, restored.Agents.Count);
        Assert.Equal(11, restored.Environment.CircularBlockages.Count);
        Assert.All(restored.Agents, a => Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.Seated, a.Posture));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NearBlastFurnitureLandsWithinRoomAndKeepsObstacles()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet);
        FurnitureSet set = sim.Environment.Furniture[0];
        Vector2 original = set.TableObstacle!.Center;
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        sim.TriggerExplosion(11f, 15f);
        for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) sim.Step();
        Assert.NotEqual(original, set.Table!.Position);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Fallen, set.Table.State);
        Assert.Equal(set.Table.Position, set.TableObstacle!.Center);
        Assert.Contains(set.TableObstacle, sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
        Assert.All(set.Chairs, c =>
        {
            Assert.NotEqual(ChairState.Airborne, c.State);
            Assert.InRange(c.Position.X, 0f, sim.Environment.Width);
            Assert.InRange(c.Position.Y, 0f, sim.Environment.Height);
            if (c.State == ChairState.Fallen) Assert.Contains(c.Obstacle!, sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
        });
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CongestedSeatWaitsThenLeavesWhenGapOpens()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        Vector2 seat = sim.Agents[0].Position;
        List<Vector2> positions = new() { seat };
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            float angle = MathF.Tau * i / 8;
            positions.Add(seat + new Vector2(MathF.Cos(angle), MathF.Sin(angle)) * 0.8f);
        }
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(positions);
        Agent occupant = sim.Agents[0];
        occupant.BeginReaction(0, 0);
        foreach (Agent blocker in sim.Agents.Skip(1)) blocker.BeginReaction(0, 10000);
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.StandingUp, occupant.Posture);
        Assert.All(sim.Agents.Skip(1), blocker => Assert.True(
            Vector2.Distance(occupant.Position, blocker.Position) >= sim.Config.Agent.Radius * 2f - 0.001f));
        foreach (Agent blocker in sim.Agents.Skip(1)) blocker.MarkExited();
        for (int i = 0; i < 50 && occupant.Posture != SeatingPosture.Walking; i++) sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.Walking, occupant.Posture);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RestartAfterDestructionRecreatesIntactOccupiedChair()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        sim.TriggerExplosion(15f, 15f);
        sim.Step();
        ScenarioDefinition saved = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(sim, 0, "Restart furniture");
        Simulation restarted = new(randomSeed: sim.RandomSeed);
        saved.ApplyLayout(restarted);
        restarted.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(restarted.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions());
        Assert.Single(restarted.Agents);
        Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.Seated, restarted.Agents[0].Posture);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Upright, restarted.Environment.Furniture[0].Chairs[0].State);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FinalisedCheckpoint_ReplayRestoresExactReadySceneAfterRuntimeDamage()
    {
        Simulation original = Scene(FurnitureKind.RoundTableSet);
        Vector2[] authoredStarts = original.Agents.Select(agent => agent.Position).ToArray();
        FinalizedSceneCheckpoint checkpoint = FinalizedSceneCheckpoint.Capture(
            original,
            original.Agents.Count,
            "checkpoint_replay");

        original.SetRunning(true);
        original.TriggerExplosion(15f, 15f);
        for (int frame = 0; frame < 20; frame++)
        {
            original.Step();
        }

        Assert.True(original.FrameIndex > 0);
        Assert.True(original.Environment.HasExplosion());

        Simulation replay = checkpoint.CreateReadySimulation();

        Assert.False(replay.Running);
        Assert.Equal(0, replay.FrameIndex);
        Assert.False(replay.Environment.HasExplosion());
        Assert.Equal(authoredStarts, replay.Agents.Select(agent => agent.Position).ToArray());
        Assert.All(replay.Agents, agent => Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.Seated, agent.Posture));
        Assert.All(
            replay.Environment.Furniture.SelectMany(set => set.Chairs),
            chair => Assert.Equal(ChairState.Upright, chair.State));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FinalisedCheckpoint_ToxicReplayRebuildsReadyFumeCache()
    {
        Simulation original = Scene();
        original.SetScenarioType(ScenarioType.ToxicFume);
        Assert.True(original.ToxicFumeSystem.TrySetSource(original, new Vector2(12f, 12f)));
        original.PrecomputeToxicFume();
        FinalizedSceneCheckpoint checkpoint = FinalizedSceneCheckpoint.Capture(
            original,
            original.Agents.Count,
            "toxic_checkpoint");

        Simulation replay = checkpoint.CreateReadySimulation();

        Assert.False(replay.Running);
        Assert.Equal(0, replay.FrameIndex);
        Assert.False(replay.ToxicFumeSystem.IsReleased);
        Assert.True(replay.ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(replay));
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using System.Text.Json;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Regression cases for the reported 205-person furniture scene and navigation changes.</summary>
public sealed class FurnitureWorkflowRegressionTests
{
    private static ScenarioDefinition LoadFixture() => JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ScenarioDefinition>(
        File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "Fixtures", "toxic_fume_205.json")),
        new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true })!;

    private static Simulation CreateScene()
    {
        ScenarioDefinition saved = LoadFixture();
        Simulation sim = new(0, saved.CreateConfig(), saved.RandomSeed);
        saved.ApplyLayout(sim);
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(sim.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions());
        return sim;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReportedSceneLoadsWithoutMovingOrDuplicatingOccupants()
    {
        Simulation sim = CreateScene();
        Assert.Equal(205, sim.Agents.Count);
        Assert.Equal(8, sim.Environment.Furniture.Count);
        Assert.Equal(92, sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Count);
        Assert.Equal(80, sim.Agents.Count(a => a.Posture == SeatingPosture.Seated));
        Assert.Equal(sim.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions(), sim.Agents.Select(a => a.Position).ToList());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReportedSceneSurvivesFileSaveLoadRoundTrip()
    {
        string directory = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "crowdsim-regression-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
        try
        {
            ScenarioDefinition original = LoadFixture();
            ScenarioFileStore.Save(original, directory);
            ScenarioDefinition loaded = ScenarioFileStore.Load(original.Name, directory);
            Simulation sim = new(0, loaded.CreateConfig(), loaded.RandomSeed);
            loaded.ApplyLayout(sim);
            Assert.Equal(205, sim.Environment.PlannedAgentCount);
            Assert.Equal(8, sim.Environment.Furniture.Count);
        }
        finally { if (Directory.Exists(directory)) Directory.Delete(directory, true); }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReportedSceneReplaysAtFrameZeroAfterFumeAndChairDeparture()
    {
        Simulation sim = CreateScene();
        Vector2[] starts = sim.Agents.Select(a => a.Position).ToArray();
        var checkpoint = FinalizedSceneCheckpoint.Capture(sim, sim.Agents.Count, "replay_regression");
        sim.PrecomputeToxicFume();
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.True(sim.TriggerToxicFumeRelease());
        for (int frame = 0; frame < 120; frame++) sim.Step();
        Assert.Contains(sim.Environment.Furniture.SelectMany(f => f.Chairs), c => c.State == ChairState.Fallen);
        Simulation replay = checkpoint.CreateReadySimulation();
        Assert.False(replay.Running);
        Assert.False(replay.ToxicFumeSystem.IsReleased);
        Assert.Equal(0, replay.FrameIndex);
        Assert.Equal(starts, replay.Agents.Select(a => a.Position).ToArray());
        Assert.Equal(80, replay.Agents.Count(a => a.Posture == SeatingPosture.Seated));
        Assert.All(replay.Environment.Furniture.SelectMany(f => f.Chairs), c => Assert.Equal(ChairState.Upright, c.State));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RestoreStillRejectsStandingPersonInsidePhysicalChair()
    {
        ScenarioDefinition saved = LoadFixture();
        FurnitureScenario first = saved.Furniture[0];
        saved.AgentSpawnGroups.Add(new AgentSpawnGroupScenario
        {
            CenterX = first.X + FurnitureSet.SeatRingRadius, CenterY = first.Y,
            Positions = new() { new AgentStartScenario { X = first.X + FurnitureSet.SeatRingRadius, Y = first.Y } },
        });
        Simulation sim = new(0, saved.CreateConfig(), saved.RandomSeed);
        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => saved.ApplyLayout(sim));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RestoreStillRejectsOverlappingFurniture()
    {
        ScenarioDefinition saved = LoadFixture();
        saved.Furniture.Add(saved.Furniture[0]);
        Simulation sim = new(0, saved.CreateConfig(), saved.RandomSeed);
        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => saved.ApplyLayout(sim));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HeavyFurnitureRoutesRemainBodyClearBeforeAndAfterToppling()
    {
        Simulation sim = CreateScene();
        VerifyRoute(sim);
        sim.PrecomputeToxicFume();
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        sim.TriggerToxicFumeRelease();
        for (int frame = 0; frame < 110; frame++) sim.Step();
        VerifyRoute(sim);
    }

    private static void VerifyRoute(Simulation sim)
    {
        Vector2 start = new(3f, 12f), goal = new(30f, 12f);
        float clearance = sim.Config.Agent.Radius * sim.Config.Agent.NavigationClearanceFactor;
        Assert.False(sim.HasTraversablePath(start, goal, clearance));
        IReadOnlyList<Vector2> route = sim.EvacuationSystem.PlanBodyClearRoute(sim, start, goal);
        Assert.NotEmpty(route);
        Assert.Equal(goal, route[^1]);
        foreach (Vector2 next in route)
        {
            Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(start, next, clearance));
            start = next;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using Xunit;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class GuardrailTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void SfmForce_IsFiniteAndPairRepulsionIsSoftCapped()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 2, randomSeed: 42);
        Agent a = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent b = simulation.Agents[1];
        a.Position = new Vector2(20.2381f, 16.1905f);
        b.Position = new Vector2(20.2385f, 16.1905f);
        a.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        b.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        a.ExitTarget = new Exit("test", new Vector2(24.2857f, 16.1905f), 0.40f, "E");

        Vector2 force = simulation.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(simulation, a, Vector2.Zero);

        Assert.True(VectorMath.IsFinite(force));
        Assert.True(force.Length() <= SfmEngine.MaxRepulsion + 5f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BlastZoneRadii_AreConfigurableAndRemainStrictlyOrdered()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 41);
        var config = simulation.Config.Agent;

        config.SetBlastZoneRadii(60f, 50f, 40f, 30f, 20f);

        Assert.Equal(60f, config.HardKillRadius);
        Assert.True(config.HeatIncapacityRadius > config.HardKillRadius);
        Assert.True(config.FallenRadius > config.HeatIncapacityRadius);
        Assert.True(config.InjuryRadius > config.FallenRadius);
        Assert.True(config.HeatRadius > config.InjuryRadius);

        config.ResetBlastZoneRadii();

        Assert.Equal(CrowdSim.Core.Configuration.AgentConfig.DefaultHardKillRadius, config.HardKillRadius);
        Assert.Equal(CrowdSim.Core.Configuration.AgentConfig.DefaultHeatIncapacityRadius, config.HeatIncapacityRadius);
        Assert.Equal(CrowdSim.Core.Configuration.AgentConfig.DefaultFallenRadius, config.FallenRadius);
        Assert.Equal(CrowdSim.Core.Configuration.AgentConfig.DefaultInjuryRadius, config.InjuryRadius);
        Assert.Equal(CrowdSim.Core.Configuration.AgentConfig.DefaultHeatRadius, config.HeatRadius);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ExplosionZones_AreAppliedInOrderedNonOverlappingBands()
    {

        Vector2 centre = new(27.9286f, 17f);

        for (int i = 0; i < distances.Length; i++)
        {
            simulation.Agents[i].Position = centre + new Vector2(distances[i], 0f);
        }

        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        simulation.TriggerExplosion(centre.X, centre.Y);
        simulation.Debris.Clear();

        {

        }

        Assert.False(simulation.Agents[4].State is AgentState.Dead or AgentState.Incapacitated or AgentState.Fallen);
        Assert.True(simulation.Agents[4].PanicLevel >= 0.5f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PanicLevel_IncreasesDesiredSfmDriveWithoutBypassingFiniteGuardrails()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 1, randomSeed: 17);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.Position = new Vector2(27.9286f, 17f);
        agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;

        agent.PanicLevel = 0f;
        Vector2 calmForce = simulation.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(simulation, agent, Vector2.UnitX);

        agent.PanicLevel = 1f;
        agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        Vector2 panicForce = simulation.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(simulation, agent, Vector2.UnitX);

        Assert.True(VectorMath.IsFinite(calmForce));
        Assert.True(VectorMath.IsFinite(panicForce));
        Assert.True(panicForce.X > calmForce.X);
        float expectedDesiredSpeed = agent.BaseSpeed * (1f + simulation.Config.Agent.PanicSpeedGain);
        Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(agent.CurrentDesiredSpeed - expectedDesiredSpeed), 0f, 0.0001f);
    }

    [Fact]
```
