```csharp
    [Fact]
    public void DynamicRerouting_ChangesExitWhenCurrentApproachIsMateriallyWorse()
    {
        // Retained reference scorer: it intentionally has global doorway-load knowledge.
        // Natural mode instead has separate perceived-congestion/recovery tests.
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 41,
            config: new SimulationConfig { Agent = new AgentConfig { NaturalNavigationEnabled = false } });
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(16.19f, 0.28f, 3));
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(40.48f, 0.28f, 3));
        simulation.SpawnAgents(15);

        Exit congestedExit = simulation.Environment.Exits[0];
        Exit clearExit = simulation.Environment.Exits[1];
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents[0];
        agent.Position = new Vector2(20.2381f, 12.1429f);
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.ExitTarget = congestedExit;
        agent.ExitCommitUntilFrame = 0;
        agent.LastExitReselectFrame = -999;
        agent.VisibilityFactor = 1f;

        for (int i = 1; i < simulation.Agents.Count; i++)
        {
            Agent casualty = simulation.Agents[i];
            casualty.Position = congestedExit.Position + new Vector2((i % 5 - 2) * 0.2024f, 1.2143f + (i / 5) * 0.2024f);
            casualty.MarkDead();
        }

        simulation.EvacuationSystem.MaybeReselectExit(simulation, agent);

        Assert.Same(clearExit, agent.ExitTarget);
        Assert.True(agent.ExitCommitUntilFrame > simulation.FrameIndex);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ExitCongestion_ModeratePanicYieldsAfterOneSetback()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 71);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(27.93f, 0.28f, 1));
        simulation.SpawnAgents(2);

        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent blocker = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent follower = simulation.Agents[1];
        blocker.Position = exit.Position;
        blocker.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        blocker.ExitTarget = exit;
        follower.Position = exit.Position + new Vector2(0f, 0.1619f);
        follower.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        follower.ExitTarget = exit;
        follower.PanicLevel = 0.50f;

        simulation.EvacuationSystem.ApplyExitFlows(simulation);

        Assert.Equal(AgentState.Exited, blocker.State);
        Assert.True(follower.ExitCongestionEpisodeActive);
        Assert.True(follower.ExitYielding);
        Assert.True(follower.ExitRetryAfterFrame > simulation.FrameIndex);
        Vector2 firstHoldingPosition = follower.Position;

        // Refill the doorway while the follower is still in its yield interval. The
        // follower should remain stationary rather than immediately lunging/rebounding.
        blocker.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        blocker.Position = exit.Position;
        blocker.ExitTarget = exit;
        follower.Velocity = Vector2.UnitY * -2f;
        simulation.EvacuationSystem.UpdateEvacAgent(simulation, follower);

        Assert.Equal(firstHoldingPosition, follower.Position);
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.Zero, follower.Velocity);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ExitCongestion_HighPanicMaintainsPressureWithoutRepeatedSetback()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 72);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(27.93f, 0.28f, 1));
        simulation.SpawnAgents(2);

        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent blocker = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent pusher = simulation.Agents[1];
        blocker.Position = exit.Position;
        blocker.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        blocker.ExitTarget = exit;
        pusher.Position = exit.Position + new Vector2(0f, 0.1619f);
        pusher.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        pusher.ExitTarget = exit;
        pusher.PanicLevel = 1.0f;

        simulation.EvacuationSystem.ApplyExitFlows(simulation);

        Assert.True(pusher.ExitCongestionEpisodeActive);
        Assert.False(pusher.ExitYielding);
        Vector2 firstHoldingPosition = pusher.Position;

        // Simulate another failed admission attempt in the same congestion episode.
        // There must be no cumulative second pushback/bounce.
        blocker.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        blocker.Position = exit.Position;
        blocker.ExitTarget = exit;
        pusher.Position = exit.Position + new Vector2(0f, 0.1619f);
        simulation.EvacuationSystem.ApplyExitFlows(simulation);

        Assert.False(pusher.ExitYielding);
        Assert.Equal(firstHoldingPosition, pusher.Position);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Exploration_ContinuesWhenExitIsVisibleButBodyClearanceIsBlocked()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 80);
        float eastX = simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters -
            simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2f;
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(eastX, 17.97f, 3));
        simulation.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(21.8571f, 8.0952f, 23.4762f, 17.8095f));
        simulation.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        simulation.BuildWallGrid();
        simulation.SpawnAgents(1);

        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.Position = new Vector2(21.0476f, 17.9714f);
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.ExitTarget = exit;
        float clearance = simulation.Config.Agent.Radius *
            simulation.Config.Agent.NavigationClearanceFactor;

        Assert.True(EvacuationSystem.HasLineOfSight(
            agent.Position,
            exit.Position,
            simulation.Environment.Walls));
        Assert.False(EvacuationSystem.HasTraversablePath(
            agent.Position,
            exit.Position,
            simulation.Environment.Walls,
            clearance));

        simulation.EvacuationSystem.EnterExploration(agent, simulation);

        Assert.True(agent.Exploring);
        Assert.NotNull(agent.TempGoal);
        Assert.True(EvacuationSystem.HasTraversablePath(
            agent.Position,
            agent.TempGoal!.Value,
            simulation.Environment.Walls,
            clearance));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Exploration_ChoosesClearWaypointThatRecoversExitSightAroundWallEnd()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 81);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
            simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters - simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2,
            12.14f,
            3));
        simulation.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(21.8571f, 8.0952f, 23.4762f, 17.8095f));
        simulation.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        simulation.BuildWallGrid();
        simulation.SpawnAgents(1);

        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.Position = new Vector2(21.0476f, 18.2143f);
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.ExitTarget = exit;

        Assert.False(EvacuationSystem.HasLineOfSight(
            agent.Position,
            exit.Position,
            simulation.Environment.Walls));

        simulation.EvacuationSystem.EnterExploration(agent, simulation);

        Assert.True(agent.Exploring);
        Assert.NotNull(agent.TempGoal);
        Vector2 goal = agent.TempGoal!.Value;
        Assert.True(EvacuationSystem.HasLineOfSight(
            agent.Position,
            goal,
            simulation.Environment.Walls));
        Assert.True(EvacuationSystem.HasLineOfSight(
            goal,
            exit.Position,
            simulation.Environment.Walls));
        Assert.False(simulation.Environment.IsPointBlocked(
            goal,
            0.5f * simulation.Config.Agent.Radius));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Exploration_StopsImmediatelyWhenExitBecomesVisible()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 82);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(28.33f, 0.28f, 3));
        simulation.SpawnAgents(1);

        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        agent.Position = new Vector2(28.3333f, 8.9048f);
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.ExitTarget = exit;
        agent.Exploring = true;
        agent.TempGoal = agent.Position + Vector2.UnitX * 48f;
        agent.ExplorationReplanAfterFrame = simulation.FrameIndex + 100;

        Assert.True(EvacuationSystem.HasLineOfSight(
            agent.Position,
            exit.Position,
            simulation.Environment.Walls));

        simulation.EvacuationSystem.UpdateEvacAgent(simulation, agent);

        Assert.False(agent.Exploring);
        Assert.Null(agent.TempGoal);
        Assert.Equal(0, agent.ExplorationReplanAfterFrame);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HighEnergyDebris_CanIncapacitateOrKillAndIsConsumedOnImpact()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(1, seed: 55);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.Position = new Vector2(28.3333f, 17f);
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        simulation.Debris.Clear();
        simulation.Debris.Add(new Debris(
            agent.Position - new Vector2(1.2143f, 0f),
            new Vector2(1.4167f, 0f),
            ttl: 10,
            radius: 6f,
            energy: 1f));

        simulation.ExplosionSystem.UpdateDebris(simulation);

        Assert.Equal(1, simulation.DebrisHits);
        Assert.True(agent.State is AgentState.Dead or AgentState.Incapacitated);
        Assert.Empty(simulation.Debris);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void WallStopsDebrisBeforeItCanHitAgent()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(1, seed: 56);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.Position = new Vector2(28.3333f, 17f);
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        simulation.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(27.3214f, 15.7857f, 27.7262f, 18.2143f));
        simulation.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        simulation.BuildWallGrid();
        simulation.Debris.Clear();
        simulation.Debris.Add(new Debris(
            new Vector2(26.3095f, 17f),
            new Vector2(1.4167f, 0f),
            ttl: 10,
            radius: 6f,
            energy: 1f));

        simulation.ExplosionSystem.UpdateDebris(simulation);

        Assert.Equal(0, simulation.DebrisHits);
        Assert.Equal(AgentState.Evacuating, agent.State);
        Assert.Empty(simulation.Debris);
    }

    private static Simulation CreateReadySimulation(int count, int seed)
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: seed);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(27.93f, 0.28f, 3));
        simulation.SpawnAgents(count);
        return simulation;
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/HybridMovementTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Regression checks for adaptive movement and shared navigation boundaries.</summary>
public sealed class HybridMovementTests
{
    private static Simulation Scene()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 731);
        sim.Config.HybridEnabled = true;
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(0.3f, 15f, 5));
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(new[] { new Vector2(15.2f, 15.3f), new Vector2(16.4f, 15.3f) });
        foreach (Agent agent in sim.Agents)
        {
            agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
            agent.Posture = SeatingPosture.Walking;
            agent.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
            agent.ExitTarget = sim.Environment.Exits[0];
        }
        return sim;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SharedFieldReusesOneBuildAndPointsTowardExit()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        var fields = sim.HybridMovement.Fields;
        Vector2 goal = sim.Environment.Exits[0].Position;
        Assert.True(fields.TryDirection(sim, new Vector2(20f, 15f), goal, out Vector2 direction));
        Assert.True(direction.X < 0f);
        Assert.True(fields.TryDirection(sim, new Vector2(23f, 15f), goal, out _));
        Assert.Equal(1, fields.FieldBuilds);
        Assert.Equal(1, fields.GeometryRefreshes);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NewlyBlockedSampleCannotBeUsedEvenBeforeFieldRefresh()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        Vector2 position = new(20f, 15f);
        Vector2 goal = sim.Environment.Exits[0].Position;
        Assert.True(sim.HybridMovement.Fields.TryDirection(sim, position, goal, out _));
        // Simulate a newly arrived obstacle without updating the cached raster.
        sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Add(new CircleBlockage(position, 2f));
        Assert.False(sim.HybridMovement.Fields.TryDirection(sim, position, goal, out _));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OpenMovementPreservesIndividualBodiesAndSpeedLimit()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        Vector2 before = sim.Agents[0].Position;
        Vector2 otherBefore = sim.Agents[1].Position;
        sim.HybridMovement.BeginFrame(sim);
        Assert.True(sim.HybridMovement.TryAdvance(sim, sim.Agents[0]));
        Assert.True(sim.Agents[0].Position.X < before.X);
        Assert.Equal(otherBefore, sim.Agents[1].Position);
        Assert.InRange(sim.Agents[0].Velocity.Length(), 0f, sim.Agents[0].CurrentDesiredSpeed + 0.00001f);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(AgentState.Injured)]
    [InlineData(AgentState.Crawling)]
    [InlineData(AgentState.Dead)]
    public void InjuryOrCasualtyRequiresDetailedTreatment(AgentState state)
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        sim.Agents[0].State = state;
        Vector2 before = sim.Agents[0].Position;
        sim.HybridMovement.BeginFrame(sim);
        Assert.False(sim.HybridMovement.TryAdvance(sim, sim.Agents[0]));
        Assert.Equal(before, sim.Agents[0].Position);
        Assert.Equal(-1, sim.Agents[0].HybridGroupLeaderId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ObstacleForcesDetailedMovementWithoutTeleporting()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Add(new CircleBlockage(agent.Position + Vector2.UnitX, 0.3f));
        sim.HybridMovement.BeginFrame(sim);
        Vector2 before = agent.Position;
        Assert.False(sim.HybridMovement.TryAdvance(sim, agent));
        Assert.Equal(before, agent.Position);
        Assert.Equal(-1, agent.HybridGroupLeaderId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GroupsAreLimitedToFiveAndSplitWhenMemberIsInjured()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        sim.Agents.Clear();
        for (int id = 0; id < 6; id++)
            sim.Agents.Add(new Agent(id, new Vector2(15.1f + id * 0.3f, 15.3f),
                Vector2.Zero, 0.15f, 1f, 0f, DecisionStrategy.Nearest, sim.Config.Agent)
            {
                State = AgentState.Evacuating,
                Posture = SeatingPosture.Walking,
                Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate,
                ExitTarget = sim.Environment.Exits[0]
            });
        sim.HybridMovement.BeginFrame(sim);
        Assert.Equal(5, sim.Agents.Count(a => a.HybridGroupLeaderId == 0));
        Assert.Equal(-1, sim.Agents[5].HybridGroupLeaderId);
        sim.Agents[0].State = AgentState.Injured;
        Assert.False(sim.HybridMovement.TryAdvance(sim, sim.Agents[0]));
        Assert.All(sim.Agents, a => Assert.Equal(-1, a.HybridGroupLeaderId));
        Assert.All(sim.Agents.Take(5), a => Assert.True(a.HybridRegroupAfterFrame > sim.FrameIndex));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DisabledModeDoesNotAdvanceAgentsAndPersistenceRetainsOptIn()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        ScenarioDefinition definition = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(sim, 2, "hybrid");
        Assert.True(definition.CreateConfig().HybridEnabled);
        Assert.False(new Simulation().Config.HybridEnabled);
        sim.Config.HybridEnabled = false;
        Vector2 before = sim.Agents[0].Position;
        sim.HybridMovement.BeginFrame(sim);
        Assert.False(sim.HybridMovement.TryAdvance(sim, sim.Agents[0]));
        Assert.Equal(before, sim.Agents[0].Position);
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/LocalNavigationRecoveryTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>
/// Regression coverage for local obstacle/casualty recovery added after visual QA of the
/// explosion scenario. These tests protect behaviour commitment and hard body separation.
/// </summary>
public sealed class LocalNavigationRecoveryTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void CircularBlockageContact_LatchesTangentFollowInsteadOfRepeatedInwardDrive()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(1, seed: 1701);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        CircleBlockage circle = new(new Vector2(20f, 20f), CircleBlockage.DefaultRadiusMeters);
        simulation.Environment.CircularBlockages.Add(circle);

        float bodyRadius = simulation.Config.Agent.Radius;
        agent.Position = circle.Center + new Vector2(circle.Radius + bodyRadius - 0.05f, 0f);
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        agent.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        agent.ExitTarget = exit;
        agent.HelpingTendency = 0f;
        agent.FollowTendency = 0f;
        agent.LastDesiredDirection = -Vector2.UnitX;
        agent.Velocity = -Vector2.UnitX * 0.05f;

        simulation.ResolveSolidCollisions(agent);

        Assert.Equal(LocalNavigationMode.CircleFollow, agent.LocalNavigationMode);
        Assert.NotNull(agent.CircleFollowCenter);
        Assert.Equal(circle.Center, agent.CircleFollowCenter!.Value);
        Assert.NotEqual(0, agent.CircleFollowDirection);
        Vector2 radial = Vector2.Normalize(agent.Position - circle.Center);
        Assert.True(
            Vector2.Dot(agent.Velocity, -radial) <= 0.0001f,
            "Collision resolution must remove inward velocity before tangent following begins.");

        simulation.EvacuationSystem.UpdateEvacAgent(simulation, agent);

        Assert.Equal(LocalNavigationMode.CircleFollow, agent.LocalNavigationMode);
        Assert.True(
            MathF.Abs(agent.LastDesiredDirection.Y) > 0.50f,
            $"Expected a committed tangential direction, got {agent.LastDesiredDirection}.");
        Assert.True(
            Vector2.Dot(agent.LastDesiredDirection, radial) > 0f,
            "Circle following should retain a small outward component rather than push into the surface.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CasualtyStillBlockingAfterFailedBypass_SeeksClearSpacePromptly()
    {
        SimulationConfig config = new()
        {
            Agent = new AgentConfig
            {
                SlowObstacleBypassObservationSeconds = AgentConfig.ReferenceStepSeconds,
                CasualtyGapWaitMinSeconds = 1.0f,
                CasualtyGapWaitMaxSeconds = 1.0f,
            },
        };
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(2, seed: 1702, config);
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent pedestrian = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent crawler = simulation.Agents[1];

        pedestrian.Position = new Vector2(28f, 20f);
        pedestrian.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        pedestrian.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        pedestrian.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        pedestrian.ExitTarget = exit;
        pedestrian.HelpingTendency = 0f;
        pedestrian.FollowTendency = 0f;
        pedestrian.PanicLevel = 0f;
        pedestrian.PatienceBias = 1f;
        // Model the case seen in QA: one local bypass was already tried but the same casualty
        // still occupies the forward corridor. Free space should trigger a committed detour.
        pedestrian.LocalNavigationBypassAttempts = 1;

        crawler.Position = new Vector2(28f, 19.30f);
        crawler.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        crawler.ExitTarget = exit;
        crawler.MarkCrawling();
        crawler.PanicLevel = 0f;

        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        simulation.Step(); // observe the slower casualty
        simulation.Step(); // observation window elapsed; blockage remains

        Assert.Equal(LocalNavigationMode.SeekingGap, pedestrian.LocalNavigationMode);
        Assert.Equal(crawler.AgentId, pedestrian.LocalNavigationBlockerAgentId);
        Assert.NotNull(pedestrian.SlowObstacleBypassGoal);
        Assert.True(pedestrian.LastDesiredDirection.LengthSquared() > 0.1f);
        Vector2 committed = pedestrian.SlowObstacleBypassGoal!.Value;
        simulation.Step();
        Assert.Equal(committed, pedestrian.SlowObstacleBypassGoal);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ControlledPress_NeverDisablesHardCasualtyBodySeparation()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(2, seed: 1703);
        Agent pedestrian = simulation.Agents[0];
        Agent casualty = simulation.Agents[1];

        pedestrian.Position = new Vector2(20f, 20f);
        pedestrian.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        pedestrian.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        pedestrian.LocalNavigationMode = LocalNavigationMode.PressingThrough;
        pedestrian.TimeStuck = 10f;
        // A waiting/pressing pedestrian may be completely stationary; the low-speed
        // collision fast path must still enforce the larger casualty body envelope.
        pedestrian.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;

        casualty.Position = new Vector2(20.30f, 20f);
        casualty.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        casualty.MarkCrawling();

        simulation.ResolveSolidCollisions(pedestrian);

        float minimumSeparation =
            simulation.Config.Agent.Radius + 1.25f * simulation.Config.Agent.Radius;
        float actualSeparation = Vector2.Distance(pedestrian.Position, casualty.Position);
        Assert.True(
            actualSeparation >= minimumSeparation - 0.002f,
            $"Controlled press may reduce social spacing but must retain hard body separation. " +
            $"Expected >= {minimumSeparation:F3} m, got {actualSeparation:F3} m.");
    }

    private static Simulation CreateReadySimulation(
        int count,
        int seed,
        SimulationConfig? config = null)
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, config: config, randomSeed: seed);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
            simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters / 2f,
            simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2f,
            personsWide: 3));
        simulation.SpawnAgents(count);
        return simulation;
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/MetricWorldAndCircularBlockageTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class MetricWorldAndCircularBlockageTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void DefaultWorld_UsesMetresAndFixedOnePointSevenMetreAgents()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 901);

        Assert.Equal(56.0f, simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters, 3);
        Assert.Equal(34.0f, simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters, 3);
        Assert.Equal(1.70f, simulation.Config.Agent.Height, 3);
        Assert.Equal(0.20f, simulation.Config.Agent.Radius, 3);
        Assert.Equal(1.20f, simulation.Config.Grid.CellSizeMeters, 3);
        Assert.Equal(0.60f, simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness, 3);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ClampToBounds_PreservesMetricPrecisionAndUsesFullRoomExtent()
    {
        Vector2 inside = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(new Vector2(55.75f, 33.625f), 56.0f, 34.0f);
        Assert.Equal(55.75f, inside.X, 3);
        Assert.Equal(33.625f, inside.Y, 3);

        Vector2 outside = VectorMath.ClampToBounds(new Vector2(56.8f, -0.4f), 56.0f, 34.0f);
        Assert.Equal(56.0f, outside.X, 3);
        Assert.Equal(0.0f, outside.Y, 3);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CircularBlockage_IsTrueTwoPointFiveMetreDiameterSolidGeometry()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 902);

        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddCircularBlockageFromClick(28f, 17f));
        CircleBlockage circle = Assert.Single(simulation.Environment.CircularBlockages);

        Assert.Equal(2.50f, circle.Diameter, 3);
        Assert.Equal(1.25f, circle.Radius, 3);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.IsPointBlocked(circle.Center));

        Vector2 start = circle.Center - new Vector2(3f, 0f);
        Vector2 goal = circle.Center + new Vector2(3f, 0f);
        Assert.False(simulation.HasTraversablePath(start, goal, simulation.Config.Agent.Radius));

        VisibilityGraphPlanner planner = new(simulation.Config.Agent);
        IReadOnlyList<Vector2> route = planner.Plan(simulation.Environment, start, goal);
        Assert.NotEmpty(route);
        Assert.Equal(goal, route[^1]);
        Assert.True(route.Count > 1, "A circular solid blockage should force an intermediate waypoint.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CircularBlockage_UndoRemovesLastPlacedCircle()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 903);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddCircularBlockageFromClick(28f, 17f));

        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.UndoLast());
        Assert.Empty(simulation.Environment.CircularBlockages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ScenarioRoundTrip_PreservesMetricCircularBlockage()
    {
        string directory = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), $"crowdsim-metric-{Guid.NewGuid():N}");
        try
        {
            Simulation source = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 904);
            Assert.True(source.Environment.AddCircularBlockageFromClick(28f, 17f));
            CircleBlockage expected = Assert.Single(source.Environment.CircularBlockages);

            ScenarioDefinition captured = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(source, 0, "metric_circle");
            ScenarioFileStore.Save(captured, directory);
            ScenarioDefinition loaded = ScenarioFileStore.Load("metric_circle", directory);

            Assert.Equal(ScenarioDefinition.CurrentVersion, loaded.Version);
            Simulation restored = new(0, loaded.CreateConfig(), loaded.RandomSeed);
            loaded.ApplyLayout(restored);
            CircleBlockage actual = Assert.Single(restored.Environment.CircularBlockages);

            Assert.Equal(expected.Center.X, actual.Center.X, 3);
            Assert.Equal(expected.Center.Y, actual.Center.Y, 3);
            Assert.Equal(CircleBlockage.DefaultRadiusMeters, actual.Radius, 3);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(directory))
            {
                Directory.Delete(directory, recursive: true);
            }
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LegacyScenarioV1_ConvertsWorldCoordinatesToMetres()
    {
        ScenarioDefinition legacy = new()
        {
            Version = 1,
            Name = "legacy",
            RoomWidth = 1380f,
            RoomHeight = 840f,
            BlastZones = new BlastZoneScenario
            {
                Kill = 39f,
                Incapacitation = 78f,
                Fallen = 156f,
                Injury = 234f,
                Panic = 450f,
            },
        };

        ScenarioDefinition metric = ScenarioDefinition.UpgradeLegacyV1(legacy);

        Assert.Equal(2, metric.Version);
        Assert.Equal(1380f * ScenarioDefinition.LegacyMetersPerUnit, metric.RoomWidth, 3);
        Assert.Equal(840f * ScenarioDefinition.LegacyMetersPerUnit, metric.RoomHeight, 3);
        Assert.Equal(39f * ScenarioDefinition.LegacyMetersPerUnit, metric.BlastZones.Kill, 3);
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/NaturalNavigationTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Regression specifications for bounded, persistent, physically constrained recovery.</summary>
public sealed class NaturalNavigationTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void ReplanningOrChangingTargetsDoesNotPretendStationaryAgentMadeProgress()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Vector2 position = agent.Position;
        for (int frame = 0; frame <= 30; frame += 2)
        {
            agent.SetRoute(new[] { new Vector2(30f + frame % 3, 10f) }, "exit:test", frame + 100);
            agent.NavigationMemory.Observe(position, agent.CurrentRouteWaypoint!.Value, frame, 0.15f);
            agent.ClearRoute();
        }
        Assert.True(agent.NavigationMemory.NoProgressSeconds >= 4.4f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void UsefulPhysicalProgressResetsTheClock()
    {
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = new();
        Vector2 target = new(10f, 0f);
        memory.Observe(Vector2.Zero, target, 0, 0.15f);
        memory.Observe(Vector2.Zero, target, 20, 0.15f);
        Assert.True(memory.NoProgressSeconds >= 3f);
        memory.Observe(new Vector2(0.2f, 0f), target, 22, 0.15f);
        Assert.Equal(0f, memory.NoProgressSeconds);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DecreasingRouteCostRecognisesLegitimateMovementAwayFromExit()
    {
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = new();
        for (int frame = 0; frame <= 20; frame += 2)
        {
            memory.Observe(new Vector2(-frame * 0.1f, 0f), new Vector2(10f, 0f), frame, 0.15f,
                remainingFieldCost: 30f - frame * 0.2f, fieldVersion: 1);
        }
        Assert.InRange(memory.NoProgressSeconds, 0f, 0.31f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FullOrbitIsDetectedEvenWhenSomeSamplesMoveCloserToExit()
    {
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = new();
        for (int i = 0; i <= 18; i++)
        {
            float angle = i * MathF.Tau / 18f;
            memory.Observe(new Vector2(MathF.Cos(angle), MathF.Sin(angle)),
                new Vector2(10f, 0f), i * 2, 0.15f);
        }
        Assert.True(memory.LoopDetected);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FailedLocationsAreRememberedButEventuallyExpire()
    {
        NaturalNavigationMemory memory = new();
        memory.RememberFailure(new Vector2(4f, 5f), 20);
        Assert.True(memory.FailurePenalty(new Vector2(4f, 5f), 10) > 0.9f);
        Assert.Equal(0f, memory.FailurePenalty(new Vector2(10f, 5f), 10));
        Assert.Equal(0f, memory.FailurePenalty(new Vector2(4f, 5f), 21));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(0f, 0f, 3f, 0f, 1.5f, 0f, 0.5f, false)]
    [InlineData(0f, 0f, 3f, 0f, 1.5f, 1f, 0.5f, true)]
    [InlineData(0.4f, 0f, 1.2f, 0f, 0f, 0f, 0.5f, true)]
    [InlineData(0.4f, 0f, -1.2f, 0f, 0f, 0f, 0.5f, false)]
    public void SweptClearanceNeverCutsThroughBodyButAllowsSeparation(
        float sx, float sy, float ex, float ey, float cx, float cy, float radius, bool expected)
    {
        Assert.Equal(expected, EvacuationSystem.SeparatingOrClearSegment(
            new Vector2(sx, sy), new Vector2(ex, ey), new Vector2(cx, cy), radius));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DeadEndCanChooseSidewaysOrBackwardEscapeRatherThanOnlyExitwardMotion()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        agent.Position = new Vector2(12f, 10f);
        agent.NavigationMemory.RecoveryAttempts = 3;
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(12.6f, 8.8f, 13f, 11.2f));
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(9f, 8.8f, 13f, 9.1f));
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(9f, 10.9f, 13f, 11.2f));
        sim.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        Vector2 before = agent.Position;
        Assert.True(sim.EvacuationSystem.TryChooseNaturalRecoveryGoal(sim, agent, out Vector2 goal));
        Assert.True(goal.X < before.X, $"Expected retreat through the open left side, got {goal}.");
        Assert.Equal(before, agent.Position); // planning must never teleport the pedestrian
        Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(before, goal, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SealedPocketDoesNotInventAnEscapeThroughWalls()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        agent.Position = new Vector2(10f, 10f);
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(9.4f, 9.4f, 9.7f, 10.6f));
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(10.3f, 9.4f, 10.6f, 10.6f));
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(9.4f, 9.4f, 10.6f, 9.7f));
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(9.4f, 10.3f, 10.6f, 10.6f));
        sim.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        Assert.False(sim.EvacuationSystem.TryChooseNaturalRecoveryGoal(sim, agent, out _));
        Assert.Equal(new Vector2(10f, 10f), agent.Position);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MovingObstacleInvalidatesACommittedDetour()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        agent.Position = new Vector2(10f, 10f);
        agent.NavigationMemory.DetourGoal = new Vector2(12f, 10f);
        agent.NavigationMemory.DetourUntilFrame = 100;
        agent.NavigationMemory.DetourBestDistance = 2f;
        sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Add(new CircleBlockage(new Vector2(11f, 10f), 0.35f));
        sim.EvacuationSystem.UpdateEvacAgent(sim, agent);
        Assert.Null(agent.NavigationMemory.DetourGoal);
        Assert.True(agent.NavigationMemory.RecoveryRequested);
        Assert.True(agent.NavigationMemory.FailurePenalty(new Vector2(12f, 10f), sim.FrameIndex) > 0f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NaturalModeDoesNotPollUnseenRemoteDoorwayCongestion()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(3);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(0.3f, 10f, 3));
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Exit original = agent.ExitTarget!;
        agent.Position = new Vector2(28f, 20f);
        sim.Agents[1].Position = original.Position + new Vector2(-0.6f, 0f);
        sim.Agents[1].MarkCrawling();
        sim.EvacuationSystem.MaybeReselectExit(sim, agent);
        Assert.Same(original, agent.ExitTarget);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PersistentFailedSolutionsEventuallyReconsiderAnotherKnownExit()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(0.3f, 10f, 3));
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Vector2 anchor = new(28f, 10f);
        agent.Position = anchor;
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        // An external constraint holds this test pedestrian in place. We test decision
        // escalation, not evacuation time or a fictitious physical escape guarantee.
        for (int i = 0; i < 90; i++)
        {
            agent.Position = anchor;
            agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            sim.Step();
        }
        Assert.True(agent.NavigationMemory.TotalRecoveryAttempts >= 2);
        Assert.True(agent.NavigationMemory.ExitChanges >= 1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RecoveryQueueIsBoundedAndDoesNotDuplicate600Requests()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(600);
        foreach (Agent agent in sim.Agents)
        {
            sim.EvacuationSystem.RequestNaturalRecovery(sim, agent, force: true);
            sim.EvacuationSystem.RequestNaturalRecovery(sim, agent, force: true);
        }
        Assert.Equal(600, sim.EvacuationSystem.NaturalPendingRecoveries);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RecoveryBudgetServesHighIdsAsWellAsLowIds()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(8, new AgentConfig { NaturalRecoveryProbesPerStep = 2 });
        Vector2[] initial = sim.Agents.Select(a => a.Position).ToArray();
        foreach (Agent agent in sim.Agents) sim.EvacuationSystem.RequestNaturalRecovery(sim, agent, force: true);
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        for (int frame = 0; frame < 7; frame++)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < sim.Agents.Count; i++)
            {
                sim.Agents[i].Position = initial[i];
                sim.Agents[i].Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            }
            sim.Step();
            Assert.InRange(sim.EvacuationSystem.LastNaturalRecoveryProbes, 0, 2);
            Assert.InRange(sim.EvacuationSystem.LastNaturalRoutePlans, 0, sim.Config.Agent.NaturalRoutePlansPerStep);
        }
        Assert.All(sim.Agents, agent => Assert.True(agent.NavigationMemory.TotalRecoveryAttempts > 0));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SameSeedAndLayoutReproduceAdaptiveDecisions()
    {
        Simulation left = Scene(5);
        Simulation right = Scene(5);
        foreach (Simulation sim in new[] { left, right })
        {
            sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Add(new CircleBlockage(new Vector2(13f, 10f), 1.2f));
            sim.SetRunning(true);
        }
        for (int frame = 0; frame < 90; frame++)
        {
            left.Step();
            right.Step();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < left.Agents.Count; i++)
        {
            Assert.Equal(left.Agents[i].Position, right.Agents[i].Position);
            Assert.Equal(left.Agents[i].NavigationMemory.TotalRecoveryAttempts,
                right.Agents[i].NavigationMemory.TotalRecoveryAttempts);
        }
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.Explosion)]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.ToxicFume)]
    public void RecoveryIsDisabledByTheReferenceToggleInEitherScenario(ScenarioType scenario)
    {
        Simulation legacy = Scene(1, new AgentConfig { NaturalNavigationEnabled = false });
        legacy.SetScenarioType(scenario);
        legacy.EvacuationSystem.RequestNaturalRecovery(legacy, legacy.Agents[0], force: true);
        Assert.Equal(0, legacy.EvacuationSystem.NaturalPendingRecoveries);
    }

    private static Simulation Scene(int count, AgentConfig? config = null)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(config: new SimulationConfig { Agent = config ?? new AgentConfig() }, randomSeed: 4173);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(sim.Environment.Width - 0.3f, 10f, 4));
        List<Vector2> positions = new(count);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) positions.Add(new Vector2(10f + (i % 30) * 0.65f, 10f + (i / 30) * 0.65f));
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(positions);
        foreach (Agent agent in sim.Agents)
        {
            agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
            agent.Posture = SeatingPosture.Walking;
            agent.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
            agent.ExitTarget = sim.Environment.Exits[0];
            agent.FollowTendency = 0f;
            agent.HelpingTendency = 0f;
            agent.AssistanceDecisionMade = true;
        }
        return sim;
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/OpenSpaceDetourTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class OpenSpaceDetourTests
{
    private static Simulation Scene(IReadOnlyList<Vector2> positions)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 731);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(sim.Environment.Width / 2f, 0.3f, 5));
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(positions);
        sim.Agents[0].State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        foreach (Agent person in sim.Agents.Skip(1)) person.MarkCrawling();
        return sim;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CloseCrawlerDoesNotRejectEverySeparatingDirection()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(new[] { new Vector2(10f, 10f), new Vector2(10.46f, 10f) });
        Agent person = sim.Agents[0];
        Assert.True(sim.EvacuationSystem.TryChooseEarlyOpenSpaceGoal(sim, person, Vector2.UnitX, false, out Vector2 goal));
        Assert.True(Vector2.Distance(goal, sim.Agents[1].Position) > 0.475f);
        Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(person.Position, goal, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ForwardWallAllowsTemporaryBackwardDetour()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(new[] { new Vector2(10f, 10f), new Vector2(10.5f, 10f) });
        // A narrow pocket is open only behind the agent.
        sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(10.7f, 8f, 10.9f, 12f));
        sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(9f, 10.25f, 10.9f, 10.45f));
        sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(9f, 9.55f, 10.9f, 9.75f));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        Assert.True(sim.EvacuationSystem.TryChooseEarlyOpenSpaceGoal(sim, sim.Agents[0], Vector2.UnitX, false, out Vector2 goal));
        Assert.True(goal.X < 10f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FullySurroundedAgentCannotSelectPathThroughPeople()
    {
        List<Vector2> positions = new() { new Vector2(10f, 10f) };
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            float angle = MathF.Tau * i / 8f;
            positions.Add(positions[0] + new Vector2(MathF.Cos(angle), MathF.Sin(angle)) * 0.56f);
        }
        Simulation sim = Scene(positions);
        Assert.False(sim.EvacuationSystem.TryChooseEarlyOpenSpaceGoal(sim, sim.Agents[0], Vector2.UnitX, false, out _));
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/PanicMovementFixTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Geometry;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class PanicMovementFixTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData(-0.35f, 0f)]
    [InlineData(0f, 0.35f)]
    public void ContactOutsideForwardVision_StillRepels(float x, float y)
    {
        Simulation sim = Ready(2);
        Agent a = sim.Agents[0], b = sim.Agents[1];
        a.Position = new Vector2(20f, 20f);
        b.Position = a.Position + new Vector2(x, y);
        a.Velocity = b.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        a.ExitTarget = new Exit("east", new Vector2(40f, 20f), side: "E");
        Vector2 force = sim.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(sim, a, Vector2.Zero);
        Assert.True(Vector2.Dot(force, a.Position - b.Position) > 1f);
        Assert.True(VectorMath.IsFinite(force));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CoincidentBodies_GetFiniteOpposingContactForces()
    {
        Simulation sim = Ready(2);
        Agent a = sim.Agents[0], b = sim.Agents[1];
        a.Position = b.Position = new Vector2(20f, 20f);
        a.Velocity = b.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        Vector2 fa = sim.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(sim, a, Vector2.Zero);
        Vector2 fb = sim.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(sim, b, Vector2.Zero);
        Assert.True(fa.Length() > 1f);
        Assert.InRange((fa + fb).Length(), 0f, 0.001f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FreeDrivingAcceleration_IsIndependentOfMass()
    {
        Simulation sim = Ready(1);
        Agent a = sim.Agents[0];
        a.Position = new Vector2(20f, 20f);
        a.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        a.Mass = 40f;
        Vector2 light = sim.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(sim, a, Vector2.UnitX) / a.Mass;
        a.Mass = 80f;
        Vector2 heavy = sim.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(sim, a, Vector2.UnitX) / a.Mass;
        float expected = a.CurrentDesiredSpeed /
            (AgentConfig.ReferenceStepSeconds * sim.Config.Agent.RelaxationTime);
        Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(light.X - expected), 0f, 0.0001f);
        Assert.InRange((light - heavy).Length(), 0f, 0.0001f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Locomotion_UsesOneBoundedAccelerationUpdate()
    {
        Simulation sim = Ready(1);
        Agent a = sim.Agents[0];
        a.Position = new Vector2(20f, 20f);
        a.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        a.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        a.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
        Vector2 force = sim.SfmEngine.ComputeForces(sim, a, Vector2.UnitX);
        Vector2 expected = VectorMath.ClampMagnitude(force / a.Mass,
            sim.Config.Agent.MaxAccelerationMetersPerSecondSquared) *
            (sim.Config.Agent.Dt * AgentConfig.ReferenceStepSeconds);
        expected = VectorMath.ClampMagnitude(expected, a.CurrentDesiredSpeed);
        sim.EvacuationSystem.IntegrateLocomotion(sim, a, Vector2.UnitX, a.CurrentDesiredSpeed);
        Assert.InRange((a.Velocity - expected).Length(), 0f, 0.0001f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void StandingBodyOverlap_IsResolvedEvenWithoutMotion()
    {
        Simulation sim = Ready(2);
        Agent a = sim.Agents[0], b = sim.Agents[1];
        a.Position = new Vector2(20f, 20f);
        b.Position = new Vector2(20.2f, 20f);
        foreach (Agent agent in sim.Agents)
        {
            agent.BeginReaction(0, 1000);
            agent.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        sim.Step();
        Assert.InRange(Vector2.Distance(a.Position, b.Position), 0.3999f, 0.401f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SocialSignal_DecreasesWithSingleSourceDistance()
    {
        float near = SocialSignalAt(0.6f);
        float far = SocialSignalAt(3.5f);
        Assert.True(near > far + 0.1f);
        Assert.InRange(far, 0f, near);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ConstantVelocityTravel_UsesElapsedSeconds()
    {
        Vector2 normal = Travel(0.15f, 10);
        Vector2 half = Travel(0.075f, 20);
        Assert.InRange(Vector2.Distance(normal, half), 0f, 0.0001f);
        Assert.InRange(MathF.Abs(normal.X - 20.6f), 0f, 0.0001f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FiveLaneExit_HasFiveAdmissionsRatherThanThree()
    {
        Simulation sim = Ready(8, lanes: 5);
        Exit exit = sim.Environment.Exits.Single();
        foreach (Agent a in sim.Agents)
        {
            a.Position = exit.Position;
            a.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
            a.ExitTarget = exit;
            a.PanicLevel = 1f;
        }
        sim.EvacuationSystem.ApplyExitFlows(sim);
        Assert.Equal(5, sim.Agents.Count(a => a.State == AgentState.Exited));
        sim.EvacuationSystem.ApplyExitFlows(sim);
        Assert.Equal(5, sim.Agents.Count(a => a.State == AgentState.Exited));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SpatialQueries_MatchBruteForceAcrossCellBoundaries()
    {
        Simulation sim = Ready(500);
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        sim.RefreshSpatialIndex();
        List<Agent> actual = new();
        foreach (Vector2 point in new[] { new Vector2(2.43f, 2.43f), new Vector2(28f, 17f) })
        {
            foreach (float radius in new[] { 0.4f, 1.82f, 3.85f, 7f })
            {
                sim.CollectAgentsNearPoint(point, radius, actual);
                int[] expected = sim.Agents.Where(a => a.IsActive &&
                    Vector2.DistanceSquared(a.Position, point) <= radius * radius)
                    .Select(a => a.AgentId).OrderBy(id => id).ToArray();
                Assert.Equal(expected, actual.Select(a => a.AgentId).OrderBy(id => id).ToArray());
            }
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MovingAgents_KeepSpatialIndexCurrent()
    {
        Simulation sim = Ready(60);
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        List<Agent> neighbours = new();
        for (int tick = 0; tick < 40; tick++)
        {
            sim.Step();
            foreach (Agent a in sim.Agents.Where(a => a.IsActive))
            {
                sim.CollectAgentsNearPoint(a.Position, 0.01f, neighbours);
                Assert.Contains(a, neighbours);
            }
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void WallQueries_HonourRadiiLargerThanOneCell()
    {
        Simulation sim = Ready(1);
        Wall wall = new(23f, 19f, 24f, 21f);
        sim.Environment.Walls.Add(wall);
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        List<Wall> actual = new();
        sim.CollectNearbyWalls(new Vector2(20f, 20f), 3.5f, actual, new HashSet<Wall>());
        Assert.Contains(wall, actual);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SeededEmergencyRun_RemainsFiniteAndReproducible()
    {
        Simulation a = Ready(200), b = Ready(200);
        a.SetRunning(true);
        b.SetRunning(true);
        a.TriggerExplosion(28f, 17f);
        b.TriggerExplosion(28f, 17f);
        for (int tick = 0; tick < 160; tick++)
        {
            a.Step();
            b.Step();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < a.Agents.Count; i++)
        {
            Assert.True(VectorMath.IsFinite(a.Agents[i].Position));
            Assert.True(VectorMath.IsFinite(a.Agents[i].Velocity));
            Assert.InRange(a.Agents[i].PanicLevel, 0f, 1f);
            Assert.Equal(a.Agents[i].Position, b.Agents[i].Position);
            Assert.Equal(a.Agents[i].State, b.Agents[i].State);
        }
    }

    private static float SocialSignalAt(float distance)
    {
        Simulation sim = Ready(2);
        Agent observer = sim.Agents[0], source = sim.Agents[1];
        observer.Position = new Vector2(20f, 20f);
        source.Position = observer.Position + new Vector2(distance, 0f);
        source.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        source.PanicLevel = 0.8f;
        source.ActivateDirectAlarm(0, 30, 0.5f, 123);
        sim.EvacuationSystem.UpdatePanic(sim);
        return observer.LastSocialPanicStimulus;
    }

    private static Vector2 Travel(float dt, int ticks)
    {
        SimulationConfig config = new() { Agent = new AgentConfig { Dt = dt } };
        Simulation sim = new(1, config, 10);
        Agent a = sim.Agents[0];
        a.Position = new Vector2(20f, 20f);
        a.Velocity = new Vector2(0.06f, 0f);
        for (int i = 0; i < ticks; i++)
        {
            sim.MoveAgent(a);
        }
        return a.Position;
    }

    private static Simulation Ready(int count, int lanes = 3)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(0, randomSeed: 20260905);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(28f, 0.3f, lanes));
        sim.SpawnAgents(count);
        return sim;
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/RectangularTableBlastTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using System.Text.Json;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using CrowdSim.Core.Systems;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Exercise live rectangular furniture through the public fixed-step pipeline.</summary>
public sealed class RectangularTableBlastTests
{
    private static (Simulation Sim, RectangularFurnitureBody Table) Scene(
        float angle = 0f, Vector2? center = null, SimulationConfig? config = null)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(config: config, randomSeed: 731);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(sim.Environment.Width / 2f, 0.3f, 5));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable,
            center ?? new Vector2(15f, 15f), angle));
        // The asset is unoccupied. An unrelated exited agent keeps the public timestep
        // active without random person contacts affecting these mechanics tests.
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(new[] { new Vector2(40f, 25f) });
        sim.Agents[0].MarkExited();
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.True(sim.Running);
        return (sim, Assert.IsType<RectangularFurnitureBody>(sim.Environment.Furniture[0].Table));
    }

    private static void Advance(Simulation sim, int frames = 120)
    {
        int start = sim.FrameIndex;
        Assert.True(sim.Running);
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(start + frames, sim.FrameIndex);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(0f)]
    [InlineData(90f)]
    public void NearBlastMovesTableThenLeavesAnExactSettledRectangle(float degrees)
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene(degrees * MathF.PI / 180f);
        Wall original = Assert.IsType<Wall>(table.RectangleObstacle);
        int staticVersion = sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion;
        sim.TriggerExplosion(11f, 15f);
        Assert.NotNull(sim.Environment.Explosion);
        bool sawFlight = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < 120; i++)
        {
            sim.Step();
            sawFlight |= table.State == ChairState.Airborne && table.Height > 0f;
        }
        Assert.Equal(120, sim.FrameIndex);
        Assert.True(sawFlight);
        Assert.True(table.Position.X > table.StartPosition.X + 0.1f);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Fallen, table.State);
        Assert.Equal(0f, table.Height);
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.Zero, table.Velocity);
        Assert.Equal(table.StartHeading, table.Heading);
        Wall landed = Assert.IsType<Wall>(table.RectangleObstacle);
        Assert.Equal(table.Position.X - table.HalfExtents.X, landed.X1, 4);
        Assert.Equal(table.Position.Y - table.HalfExtents.Y, landed.Y1, 4);
        Assert.Equal(table.HalfExtents.X * 2f, landed.X2 - landed.X1, 4);
        Assert.Equal(table.HalfExtents.Y * 2f, landed.Y2 - landed.Y1, 4);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(original, sim.Environment.Walls);
        Assert.Contains(landed, sim.Environment.Walls);
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
        Assert.Null(table.Obstacle);
        Assert.Equal(staticVersion, sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion);
        Vector2 position = table.Position;
        int navigationVersion = sim.Environment.NavigationLayoutVersion;
        Advance(sim);
        Assert.Equal(position, table.Position);
        Assert.Equal(navigationVersion, sim.Environment.NavigationLayoutVersion);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(0f)]
    [InlineData(90f)]
    public void CentralBlastRemovesTheTableAndAllItsNavigationGeometry(float degrees)
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene(degrees * MathF.PI / 180f);
        Wall original = Assert.IsType<Wall>(table.RectangleObstacle);
        sim.TriggerExplosion(15f, 15f);
        Advance(sim, 10);
        Assert.True(table.BlastApplied);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Destroyed, table.State);
        Assert.Null(table.RectangleObstacle);
        Assert.Null(sim.Environment.Furniture[0].StaticObstacle);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(original, sim.Environment.Walls);
        Assert.Empty(sim.Environment.CircularBlockages);
        Assert.False(sim.Environment.IsPointBlocked(table.StartPosition, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
        Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(new Vector2(15f, 12f), new Vector2(15f, 18f), sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DestructionUsesTheConfiguredFurnitureZoneNotAHardCodedDistance()
    {
        SimulationConfig config = new();
        config.Agent.SetBlastZoneRadii(1f, 4f, 5f, 6f, 10f);
        var (sim, table) = Scene(config: config);
        sim.TriggerExplosion(11f, 15f); // exactly the configured inner furniture boundary
        Advance(sim, 15);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Destroyed, table.State);
        Assert.Null(table.RectangleObstacle);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ABlastBeyondTheOuterZoneLeavesTheTableIntact()
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene();
        sim.TriggerExplosion(2f, 2f);
        Advance(sim);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Upright, table.State);
        Assert.Equal(table.StartPosition, table.Position);
        Assert.NotNull(table.RectangleObstacle);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(11f)]
    [InlineData(12.5f)]
    public void FullHeightWallShieldsAgainstImpulseAndDestruction(float blastX)
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene();
        sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(13f, 10f, 13.2f, 20f));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        sim.TriggerExplosion(blastX, 15f);
        Advance(sim);
        Assert.True(table.BlastApplied);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Upright, table.State);
        Assert.Equal(table.StartPosition, table.Position);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SweptRectangleStopsBeforeItsLongEdgePassesThroughWall()
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene();
        sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(17f, 10f, 17.2f, 20f));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        sim.TriggerExplosion(11f, 15f);
        for (int i = 0; i < 120; i++)
        {
            sim.Step();
            Assert.True(table.Position.X + table.HalfExtents.X <= 17.001f);
        }
        Assert.True(table.Position.X > table.StartPosition.X);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Fallen, table.State);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ShortSideCanSlideAlongBoundaryWithoutAnOversizedCircularCollider()
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene(center: new Vector2(10f, 1.25f));
        sim.TriggerExplosion(6f, 1.25f);
        Advance(sim);
        Assert.True(table.Position.X > 10.1f);
        Assert.Equal(1.25f, table.Position.Y, 4);
        Assert.True(table.RectangleObstacle!.Y1 >= sim.Environment.BoundaryThickness);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TableDoesNotSlideThroughTheFixedFifteenBySixStage()
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene(center: new Vector2(12f, 15f));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.Stage, new Vector2(22f, 15f)));
        Wall stage = Assert.IsType<Wall>(sim.Environment.Furniture[1].StaticObstacle);
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        sim.TriggerExplosion(8f, 15f);
        for (int i = 0; i < 120; i++)
        {
            sim.Step();
            Assert.True(table.Position.X + table.HalfExtents.X <= stage.X1 + 0.001f);
        }
        Assert.Equal(15f, stage.X2 - stage.X1, 4);
        Assert.Equal(6f, stage.Y2 - stage.Y1, 4);
        Assert.Same(stage, sim.Environment.Furniture[1].StaticObstacle);
        Assert.True(table.Position.X > table.StartPosition.X);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ExactContactsDoNotHitPeopleOrChairsInClearSpaceBesideTheTable()
    {
        RectangularFurnitureBody table = new(new Vector2(15f, 15f), 0f, new Vector2(1.5f, 0.5f));
        FurnitureChair chair = new(new Vector2(15f, 16f), 0f);
        Assert.False(Simulation.FurnitureOverlapsDisc(table, table.Position, chair.Position, 0.2f));
        Assert.False(Simulation.FurnitureFootprintsOverlap(table, table.Position, chair, chair.Position));
        Assert.False(Simulation.FurnitureFootprintsOverlap(chair, chair.Position, table, table.Position));
        Assert.True(Simulation.FurnitureOverlapsDisc(table, table.Position, new Vector2(15f, 15.6f), 0.2f));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LongTablesTransferMotionWithoutMissingContactsAcrossGridCells()
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene(center: new Vector2(10f, 10f));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.RectangularTable, new Vector2(14.5f, 10f)));
        RectangularFurnitureBody target = Assert.IsType<RectangularFurnitureBody>(sim.Environment.Furniture[1].Table);
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        table.BlastApplied = target.BlastApplied = true;
        table.State = ChairState.Airborne;
        table.Height = 0.05f;
        table.Velocity = new Vector2(12f, 0f);
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++)
        {
            sim.Step();
            Assert.False(Simulation.FurnitureFootprintsOverlap(table, table.Position, target, target.Position));
        }
        Assert.True(target.Position.X > target.StartPosition.X);
        Assert.True(table.Position.X < target.Position.X);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DestructionRemovesTheOldFootprintFromTheSpatialHashToo()
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene();
        for (int y = 0; y < 8; y++)
        for (int x = 0; x < 7; x++)
            sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(40f + x * 2f, 2f + y * 3f,
                40.5f + x * 2f, 2.5f + y * 3f));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.Walls.Count > 48);
        Vector2 start = new(15f, 12f), goal = new(15f, 18f);
        Assert.False(sim.HasTraversablePath(start, goal, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
        sim.TriggerExplosion(15f, 15f);
        Advance(sim, 10);
        Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(start, goal, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MovingTableUpdatesSpatialHashWithoutLeavingItsOldFootprintBehind()
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene();
        for (int y = 0; y < 8; y++)
        for (int x = 0; x < 7; x++)
            sim.Environment.Walls.Add(new Wall(40f + x * 2f, 2f + y * 3f,
                40.5f + x * 2f, 2.5f + y * 3f));
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        Wall original = Assert.IsType<Wall>(table.RectangleObstacle);
        Vector2 originalLaneStart = new(original.X1 + 0.25f, 12f);
        Vector2 originalLaneEnd = new(originalLaneStart.X, 18f);
        Assert.False(sim.HasTraversablePath(originalLaneStart, originalLaneEnd, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
        sim.TriggerExplosion(11f, 15f);
        Advance(sim);
        Assert.True(table.Position.X > table.StartPosition.X + 0.5f);
        Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(originalLaneStart, originalLaneEnd, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
        Assert.False(sim.HasTraversablePath(table.Position - Vector2.UnitY * 3f,
            table.Position + Vector2.UnitY * 3f, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
        Assert.DoesNotContain(original, sim.Environment.Walls);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SharedFieldClearsDestroyedTableCellsWithoutInvalidatingStaticWalls()
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene();
        SharedExitFields fields = new();
        Vector2 goal = new(15f, 22f);
        Assert.True(fields.TryDirection(sim, new Vector2(15f, 10f), goal, out _));
        Assert.False(fields.TryDirection(sim, table.Position, goal, out _));
        int wallVersion = sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion;
        int oldBuilds = fields.FieldBuilds;
        sim.TriggerExplosion(15f, 15f);
        Advance(sim, 10); // also pass the bounded shared-field refresh interval
        Assert.True(fields.TryDirection(sim, table.StartPosition, goal, out _));
        Assert.True(fields.FieldBuilds > oldBuilds);
        Assert.Equal(wallVersion, sim.Environment.WallLayoutVersion);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ToxicFumeReleaseNeitherLaunchesNorDestroysTheUnoccupiedTable()
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene();
        sim.SetRunning(false);
        sim.SetScenarioType(ScenarioType.ToxicFume);
        Assert.True(sim.ToxicFumeSystem.TrySetSource(sim, new Vector2(12f, 12f)));
        sim.PrecomputeToxicFume();
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.True(sim.Running);
        Assert.True(sim.TriggerToxicFumeRelease());
        Wall original = Assert.IsType<Wall>(table.RectangleObstacle);
        Advance(sim, 10);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Upright, table.State);
        Assert.Equal(table.StartPosition, table.Position);
        Assert.Same(original, table.RectangleObstacle);
        Assert.True(sim.ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(sim));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(true)]
    [InlineData(false)]
    public void SaveAndReplayRestoreAuthoredTableNotDisplacedOrDestroyedState(bool destroy)
    {
        var (sim, table) = Scene();
        sim.TriggerExplosion(destroy ? 15f : 11f, 15f);
        Advance(sim);
        Assert.NotEqual(ChairState.Upright, table.State);
        ScenarioDefinition saved = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(sim, 0, "rectangular-table-replay");
        Assert.Empty(saved.Blockages);
        Assert.Empty(saved.CircularBlockages);
        ScenarioDefinition copy = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ScenarioDefinition>(JsonSerializer.Serialize(saved))!;
        Simulation replay = new(randomSeed: 731);
        copy.ApplyLayout(replay);
        RectangularFurnitureBody restored = Assert.IsType<RectangularFurnitureBody>(replay.Environment.Furniture[0].Table);
        Assert.Equal(table.StartPosition, restored.Position);
        Assert.Equal(ChairState.Upright, restored.State);
        Assert.NotNull(restored.RectangleObstacle);
        Assert.Empty(replay.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions());
        Assert.Single(replay.Environment.Walls.Where(wall => wall.IsMovableFurniture));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SameSeedAndLayoutProduceTheSameRectangularTableTrajectory()
    {
        var first = Scene();
        var second = Scene();
        first.Sim.TriggerExplosion(11f, 15f);
        second.Sim.TriggerExplosion(11f, 15f);
        for (int i = 0; i < 90; i++)
        {
            first.Sim.Step();
            second.Sim.Step();
            Assert.Equal(first.Table.Position, second.Table.Position);
            Assert.Equal(first.Table.Height, second.Table.Height);
            Assert.Equal(first.Table.State, second.Table.State);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class RouteRetryCostTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void FailedRouteIsNotSearchedRepeatedlyButClearDirectPathRecoversImmediately()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 731);
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(new[] { new Vector2(10f, 10f) });
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Vector2 goal = new(12f, 10f);
        CircleBlockage obstacle = new(goal, 1f);
        sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Add(obstacle);
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.Zero, sim.EvacuationSystem.ResolveStaticRouteDirection(sim, agent, goal, "test"));
        Assert.Equal(1, sim.LastRoutePlanRequests);
        Assert.True(agent.FailedRouteRetryFrame > sim.FrameIndex);
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.Zero, sim.EvacuationSystem.ResolveStaticRouteDirection(sim, agent, goal, "test"));
        Assert.Equal(1, sim.LastRoutePlanRequests);
        sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Remove(obstacle);
        Vector2 recovered = sim.EvacuationSystem.ResolveStaticRouteDirection(sim, agent, goal, "test");
        Assert.True(recovered.X > 0.9f);
        Assert.Equal(1, sim.LastRoutePlanRequests);
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/ScenarioFileStoreTests.cs

```csharp
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Regression tests for reliable, repeatable scenario persistence.</summary>
public sealed class ScenarioFileStoreTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Save_CreatesLoadableFileAndRefreshableName()
    {
        string directory = CreateTemporaryDirectory();
        try
        {
            Simulation simulation = CreateScenario();
            ScenarioDefinition scenario = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(
                simulation,
                simulation.Environment.PlannedAgentCount,
                "save works");

            string path = ScenarioFileStore.Save(scenario, directory);

            Assert.True(File.Exists(path));
            Assert.Equal("save_works.json", Path.GetFileName(path));
            Assert.Contains("save_works", ScenarioFileStore.ListScenarioNames(directory));
            ScenarioDefinition loaded = ScenarioFileStore.Load("save_works", directory);
            Assert.Equal(scenario.AgentCount, loaded.AgentCount);
            Assert.Single(loaded.Furniture);
        }
        finally
        {
            Directory.Delete(directory, recursive: true);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SaveAs_AtomicallyOverwritesAndLeavesNoTemporaryFiles()
    {
        string directory = CreateTemporaryDirectory();
        try
        {
            Simulation simulation = CreateScenario();
            ScenarioDefinition first = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(simulation, 0, "overwrite");
            ScenarioFileStore.Save(first, directory);
            Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddFurniture(
                CrowdSim.Core.Model.FurnitureKind.SingleChair,
                new System.Numerics.Vector2(20f, 15f)));
            ScenarioDefinition second = ScenarioDefinition.Capture(simulation, 0, "overwrite");

            ScenarioFileStore.Save(second, directory);

            ScenarioDefinition loaded = ScenarioFileStore.Load("overwrite", directory);
            Assert.Equal(2, loaded.Furniture.Count);
            Assert.Empty(Directory.EnumerateFiles(directory, "*.tmp"));
        }
        finally
        {
            Directory.Delete(directory, recursive: true);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DefaultDirectory_IsStablePerUserLocationWhenAvailable()
    {
        string localData = Environment.GetFolderPath(
            Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData,
            Environment.SpecialFolderOption.Create);

        Assert.True(Path.IsPathFullyQualified(ScenarioFileStore.DefaultDirectory));
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(localData))
        {
            Assert.StartsWith(
                Path.GetFullPath(localData),
                Path.GetFullPath(ScenarioFileStore.DefaultDirectory),
                OperatingSystem.IsWindows()
                    ? StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase
                    : StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }
    }

    private static Simulation CreateScenario()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(randomSeed: 991);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
            simulation.Environment.Width / 2f,
            simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2f,
            personsWide: 3));
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddFurniture(
            CrowdSim.Core.Model.FurnitureKind.SingleChair,
            new System.Numerics.Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        return simulation;
    }

    private static string CreateTemporaryDirectory()
    {
        string path = Path.Combine(
            Path.GetTempPath(),
            $"crowdsim-save-{Guid.NewGuid():N}");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(path);
        return path;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class SeatDepartureRecoveryTests
{
    private static Simulation Scene()
    {
        Simulation sim = new(randomSeed: 731);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(sim.Environment.Width / 2f, 0.3f, 5));
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddFurniture(FurnitureKind.SingleChair, new Vector2(15f, 15f)));
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(sim.Environment.GetPlannedAgentPositions());
        Agent person = sim.Agents[0];
        person.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
        person.Posture = SeatingPosture.StandingUp;
        person.StandUpSeconds = 1f;
        person.StandUpElapsed = 1f;
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.True(sim.Running);
        return sim;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DepartingPersonMakesPartialProgressThenReleasesSeat()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        Agent person = sim.Agents[0];
        Vector2 start = person.Position;
        sim.Step();
        Assert.True(Vector2.Distance(start, person.Position) > 0f);
        Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.StandingUp, person.Posture);
        for (int i = 0; i < 30 && person.Posture != SeatingPosture.Walking; i++) sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.Walking, person.Posture);
        Assert.Null(person.Chair);
        Assert.Null(sim.Environment.Furniture[0].Chairs[0].OccupantId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DestroyedSeatDoesNotKeepAgentWaitingForDeparturePath()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        FurnitureChair chair = sim.Environment.Furniture[0].Chairs[0];
        sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Remove(chair.Obstacle!);
        chair.Obstacle = null;
        chair.State = ChairState.Destroyed;
        sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(SeatingPosture.Walking, sim.Agents[0].Posture);
        Assert.Null(sim.Agents[0].Chair);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CompletedStandUpCanPushLooseChairButNotOccupiedSeat()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene();
        Agent person = sim.Agents[0];
        FurnitureChair loose = new(person.Position + new Vector2(0.7f, 0f), 0f);
        sim.Environment.CircularBlockages.Add(loose.Obstacle!);
        Assert.True(sim.TryPushLooseChair(person, loose.Obstacle!, Vector2.UnitX));
        FurnitureChair occupied = sim.Environment.Furniture[0].Chairs[0];
        Assert.False(sim.TryPushLooseChair(person, occupied.Obstacle!, Vector2.UnitX));
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/SimulationBasicTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using Xunit;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class SimulationBasicTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void InitialState_StartsWithWanderingAgents()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 10, randomSeed: 7);

        Assert.Equal(10, simulation.Agents.Count);
        Assert.Equal(0, simulation.FrameIndex);
        Assert.All(simulation.Agents, agent => Assert.Equal(AgentState.Wandering, agent.State));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RunningGuardrail_RequiresAtLeastOneExit()
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 10, randomSeed: 7);

        Assert.False(simulation.ToggleRunning());
        Assert.False(simulation.Running);

        Assert.True(AddNorthExit(simulation));
        Assert.True(simulation.ToggleRunning());
        Assert.True(simulation.Running);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Explosion_StartlesAgentsThenTheyReact()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(10);
        Vector2 centre = new(simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters / 2f, simulation.Config.World.LengthMeters / 2f);
        for (int i = 0; i < simulation.Agents.Count; i++)
        {
            simulation.Agents[i].Position = centre + new Vector2(7.2857f + i * 0.081f, 0f);
        }

        Assert.True(simulation.ToggleRunning());
        simulation.TriggerExplosion(centre.X, centre.Y);
        simulation.Debris.Clear(); // isolate startle/front timing from debris-impact outcomes
        Assert.DoesNotContain(simulation.Agents, agent => agent.State == AgentState.WaitingToReact);

        // At ~7.3 m and 1.21 m/step, the abstract shock front reaches these agents after
        // several simulation frames; startle is therefore synchronized to front arrival.
        for (int frame = 0; frame < 8; frame++)
        {
            simulation.Step();
        }

        Assert.Contains(
            simulation.Agents,
            agent => agent.State is AgentState.WaitingToReact or AgentState.Injured or AgentState.Evacuating);

        for (int frame = 0; frame < 100; frame++)
        {
            simulation.Step();
        }

        Assert.Contains(
            simulation.Agents,
            agent => agent.State is AgentState.Evacuating or AgentState.Injured or AgentState.Exited);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ExitFlow_AllowsAgentToLeaveThroughTrueOpening()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateReadySimulation(1);
        Exit exit = simulation.Environment.Exits.Single();
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.Position = exit.Position;
        agent.ExitTarget = exit;
        agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;

        simulation.EvacuationSystem.ApplyExitFlows(simulation);

        Assert.Equal(AgentState.Exited, agent.State);
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.Zero, agent.Velocity);
    }

    private static Simulation CreateReadySimulation(int count)
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount: 0, randomSeed: 1234);
        Assert.True(AddNorthExit(simulation));
        simulation.SpawnAgents(count);
        return simulation;
    }

    private static bool AddNorthExit(Simulation simulation)
        => simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
            simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters / 2,
            simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2,
            personsWide: 3);
}
```
