## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/ToxicFumeScenarioTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using CrowdSim.Core.Persistence;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

public sealed class ToxicFumeScenarioTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Precompute_BuildsDeterministicArrivalFieldBeforeRuntime()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateToxicSimulation(agentCount: 0);
        Vector2 source = new(28f, 17f);
        Assert.True(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.TrySetSource(simulation, source));

        simulation.PrecomputeToxicFume();

        Assert.True(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsPrecomputed);
        Assert.True(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(simulation));
        Assert.True(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.ReachableCellCount > 0);
        Assert.True(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.GetConcentration(source, 0f) > 0.8f);
        Assert.True(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.GetConcentration(source, 2f) > 0.8f);

        Vector2 downstream = source + new Vector2(3f, 0f);
        Assert.Equal(0f, simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.GetConcentration(downstream, 1f));
        Assert.True(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.GetConcentration(downstream, 20f) > 0f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RuntimeRelease_UsesCachedFieldAndAccumulatesAgentExposure()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateToxicSimulation(agentCount: 1);
        Vector2 source = new(28f, 17f);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.Position = source;
        agent.BeginReaction(0, 1000); // Hold position so this test isolates exposure from locomotion.

        Assert.True(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.TrySetSource(simulation, source));
        simulation.PrecomputeToxicFume();
        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.True(simulation.Running);
        Assert.True(simulation.TriggerToxicFumeRelease());

        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++)
        {
            simulation.Step();
        }

        Assert.True(agent.CumulativeToxicExposure > 0f);
        Assert.True(agent.PeakToxicConcentration > 0f);
        Assert.True(agent.FirstToxicExposureFrame >= 0);
        Assert.NotEqual(ToxicExposureStatus.Clear, agent.ToxicExposureStatus);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FumeIncapacitation_RemainsPermanentAfterPlumeClears()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateToxicSimulation(agentCount: 1);
        Vector2 source = new(28f, 17f);
        Agent agent = simulation.Agents.Single();
        agent.Position = source;
        agent.BeginReaction(0, 1000); // Hold position so exposure progression is deterministic.

        ToxicFumeConfig config = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration;
        config.SetValues(
            config.InitialRadiusMeters,
            config.DispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond,
            config.MaximumExtentMeters,
            1.0f, // Short release so the local concentration clears during this test.
            config.DriftDirectionDegrees,
            config.DriftBias,
            config.AwarenessConcentration,
            config.DangerConcentration,
            1.0f,
            2.0f);

        Assert.True(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.TrySetSource(simulation, source));
        simulation.PrecomputeToxicFume();
        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.True(simulation.TriggerToxicFumeRelease());

        for (int i = 0; i < 30 && agent.State != AgentState.Incapacitated; i++)
        {
            simulation.Step();
        }

        Assert.Equal(AgentState.Incapacitated, agent.State);
        Assert.Equal(ToxicExposureStatus.Incapacitated, agent.ToxicExposureStatus);
        Assert.Equal(0f, agent.ToxicMobilityFactor);
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.Zero, agent.Velocity);

        // Continue well beyond release + post-release decay. Incapacitation is latched for
        // the remainder of the run and must never recover to impaired/normal movement.
        for (int i = 0; i < 420; i++)
        {
            simulation.Step();
        }

        Assert.Equal(0f, simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.GetCurrentConcentration(simulation, source), 3);
        Assert.Equal(AgentState.Incapacitated, agent.State);
        Assert.Equal(ToxicExposureStatus.Incapacitated, agent.ToxicExposureStatus);
        Assert.Equal(0f, agent.ToxicMobilityFactor);
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.Zero, agent.Velocity);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GeometryChange_MakesPrecomputedCacheUnusableUntilRecomputed()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateToxicSimulation(agentCount: 1);
        Assert.True(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.TrySetSource(simulation, new Vector2(28f, 17f)));
        simulation.PrecomputeToxicFume();
        Assert.True(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(simulation));

        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddBlockageFromClick(8f, 8f, cells: 1));
        simulation.BuildWallGrid();

        Assert.False(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(simulation));
        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.False(simulation.Running);
    }


    [Fact]
    public void ConfigurationChange_InvalidatesPrecomputedCacheByRevision()
    {
        Simulation simulation = CreateToxicSimulation(agentCount: 0);
        Assert.True(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.TrySetSource(simulation, new Vector2(28f, 17f)));
        simulation.PrecomputeToxicFume();
        Assert.True(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(simulation));

        ToxicFumeConfig config = simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration;
        config.SetValues(
            config.InitialRadiusMeters,
            config.DispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond + 0.05f,
            config.MaximumExtentMeters,
            config.ReleaseDurationSeconds,
            config.DriftDirectionDegrees,
            config.DriftBias,
            config.AwarenessConcentration,
            config.DangerConcentration,
            config.ImpairmentExposure,
            config.IncapacitationExposure);

        Assert.False(simulation.ToxicFumeSystem.IsCacheValidFor(simulation));
        simulation.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.False(simulation.Running);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Version2Scenario_UpgradesToExplosionMode()
    {
        ScenarioDefinition legacy = new() { Version = 2, Name = "legacy" };

        ScenarioDefinition upgraded = ScenarioDefinition.UpgradeLegacyV2(legacy);

        Assert.Equal(ScenarioDefinition.CurrentVersion, upgraded.Version);
        Assert.Equal(ScenarioType.Explosion, upgraded.ScenarioType);
        Assert.NotNull(upgraded.ToxicFume);
    }

    private static Simulation CreateToxicSimulation(int agentCount)
    {
        Simulation simulation = new(agentCount, randomSeed: 1234);
        Assert.True(simulation.Environment.AddExitFromClick(
            simulation.Config.World.WidthMeters / 2f,
            simulation.Environment.BoundaryThickness / 2f,
            personsWide: 3));
        simulation.SetScenarioType(ScenarioType.ToxicFume);
        return simulation;
    }
}
```

## tests/CrowdSim.Tests/ToxicNaturalNavigationTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Numerics;
using CrowdSim.Core;
using CrowdSim.Core.Configuration;
using CrowdSim.Core.Model;
using Xunit;

namespace CrowdSim.Tests;

/// <summary>Scenario integration, perception limits and bounded-work regression specifications.</summary>
public sealed class ToxicNaturalNavigationTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.Explosion)]
    [InlineData(ScenarioType.ToxicFume)]
    public void GenericRecoveryIsEnabledInBothScenarios(ScenarioType scenario)
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1, scenario: scenario);
        Assert.True(sim.EvacuationSystem.UsesNaturalNavigation(sim));
        sim.EvacuationSystem.RequestNaturalRecovery(sim, sim.Agents[0], force: true);
        Assert.Equal(1, sim.EvacuationSystem.NaturalPendingRecoveries);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PrecomputedButUnreleasedFumeDoesNotAffectNavigation()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Prepare(sim, new Vector2(29.75f, 17.25f));
        Vector2 goal = agent.Position + new Vector2(2f, 0f);
        Assert.True(sim.ToxicFumeSystem.GetConcentration(new Vector2(29.75f, 17.25f), 0f) > 0.8f);
        Assert.Equal(0f, sim.EvacuationSystem.NaturalToxicPathPenalty(sim, agent, goal));
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.UnitX,
            sim.EvacuationSystem.ApplyNaturalToxicAvoidance(sim, agent, Vector2.UnitX, false));
        Assert.False(agent.NavigationMemory.RecoveryRequested);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RecoveryPrefersAClearCandidateOverContaminatedExitwardSpace()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Prepare(sim, new Vector2(29.75f, 17.25f));
        Release(sim);
        agent.NavigationMemory.RecoveryAttempts = 1;
        float forwardPenalty = sim.EvacuationSystem.NaturalToxicPathPenalty(
            sim, agent, agent.Position + new Vector2(1.6f, 0f));
        Assert.True(forwardPenalty > 0f);
        Assert.True(sim.EvacuationSystem.TryChooseNaturalRecoveryGoal(sim, agent, out Vector2 goal));
        Assert.True(sim.EvacuationSystem.NaturalToxicPathPenalty(sim, agent, goal) < forwardPenalty);
        Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(agent.Position, goal, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FuturePlumeAndPreviewTimeAreNotReadAsCurrentHazards()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Vector2 goal = agent.Position + new Vector2(2f, 0f);
        Prepare(sim, new Vector2(35.25f, 17.25f));
        Release(sim);
        sim.ToxicFumeSystem.PreviewTimeSeconds = 40f;
        Assert.True(sim.ToxicFumeSystem.GetConcentration(goal, 40f) > 0f);
        Assert.Equal(0f, sim.EvacuationSystem.SampleNaturalFumeRisk(sim, agent, goal).Peak);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FumeObservationDoesNotReachBeyondTheConfiguredPerceptionHorizon()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1, new AgentConfig { NaturalPerceptionRadiusMeters = 1f });
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Vector2 source = new(31.25f, 17.25f);
        Prepare(sim, source);
        Release(sim);
        Assert.True(sim.ToxicFumeSystem.GetCurrentConcentration(sim, source) > 0.8f);
        var risk = sim.EvacuationSystem.SampleNaturalFumeRisk(sim, agent, source);
        Assert.Equal(0f, risk.Peak);
        Assert.InRange(risk.ObservedDistance, 0f, 1f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FumeObservationStopsAtAnOccludingWall()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(28.9f, 15f, 29.1f, 20f));
        sim.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        Prepare(sim, new Vector2(30.25f, 17.25f));
        Release(sim);
        var risk = sim.EvacuationSystem.SampleNaturalFumeRisk(sim, sim.Agents[0], new Vector2(32.25f, 17.25f));
        Assert.Equal(0f, risk.Peak);
        Assert.True(risk.ObservedDistance < 0.7f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NewlyContaminatedDetourIsAbandonedAndRemembered()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Vector2 goal = agent.Position + new Vector2(2f, 0f);
        Prepare(sim, new Vector2(29.75f, 17.25f));
        agent.NavigationMemory.DetourGoal = goal;
        agent.NavigationMemory.DetourUntilFrame = 100;
        agent.NavigationMemory.DetourBestDistance = 2f;
        // The previously clear intention has zero remembered concentration.
        Assert.False(sim.EvacuationSystem.NaturalToxicDetourWorsened(sim, agent, goal));
        Release(sim);
        Assert.True(sim.EvacuationSystem.NaturalToxicDetourWorsened(sim, agent, goal));
        sim.EvacuationSystem.UpdateEvacAgent(sim, agent);
        Assert.Null(agent.NavigationMemory.DetourGoal);
        Assert.True(agent.NavigationMemory.RecoveryRequested);
        Assert.True(agent.NavigationMemory.FailurePenalty(goal, sim.FrameIndex) > 0f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RisingLocalExposureDoesNotCancelAnImprovingRetreat()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Prepare(sim, agent.Position);
        Release(sim);
        Vector2 retreat = agent.Position - new Vector2(1.6f, 0f);
        var risk = sim.EvacuationSystem.SampleNaturalFumeRisk(sim, agent, retreat);
        Assert.True(risk.Start > 0.8f);
        Assert.True(risk.End < risk.Start);
        Assert.False(sim.EvacuationSystem.NaturalToxicDetourWorsened(sim, agent, retreat));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void UsefulDetourIsNotOverriddenByACompetingFumeSteeringGoal()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Prepare(sim, new Vector2(29.75f, 17.25f));
        Release(sim);
        agent.NavigationMemory.DetourGoal = agent.Position + Vector2.UnitY;
        Vector2 result = sim.EvacuationSystem.ApplyNaturalToxicAvoidance(sim, agent, Vector2.UnitY, false);
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.UnitY, result);
        Assert.False(agent.NavigationMemory.RecoveryRequested);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void WorseningFumeCanChangeExitWithoutWaitingForAStuckTimer()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(0.3f, 17f, 4));
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Exit initial = agent.ExitTarget!;
        ToxicFumeConfig fume = sim.ToxicFumeSystem.Configuration;
        fume.SetValues(5f, fume.DispersionSpeedMetersPerSecond, fume.MaximumExtentMeters,
            fume.ReleaseDurationSeconds, fume.DriftDirectionDegrees, fume.DriftBias,
            fume.AwarenessConcentration, fume.DangerConcentration,
            fume.ImpairmentExposure, fume.IncapacitationExposure);
        Prepare(sim, new Vector2(34.25f, 17.25f));
        Release(sim);
        Assert.Equal(0f, agent.NavigationMemory.NoProgressSeconds);
        sim.EvacuationSystem.MaybeReselectExit(sim, agent);
        Assert.NotSame(initial, agent.ExitTarget);
        Assert.Equal(1, agent.NavigationMemory.ExitChanges);
        Assert.Null(agent.CurrentRouteWaypoint);
        Exit selected = agent.ExitTarget!;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) sim.EvacuationSystem.MaybeReselectExit(sim, agent);
        Assert.Same(selected, agent.ExitTarget);
        Assert.Equal(1, agent.NavigationMemory.ExitChanges);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HybridOpenSpaceMovementStillChecksEachAgentsFumeHazard()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1, hybrid: true);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Prepare(sim, new Vector2(29.75f, 17.25f));
        Release(sim);
        sim.HybridMovement.BeginFrame(sim);
        Assert.True(sim.HybridMovement.TryAdvance(sim, agent));
        Assert.True(agent.NavigationMemory.RecoveryRequested);
        Assert.True(agent.LastDesiredDirection.X < 0f);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ToxicFumeDoesNotReuseStaleFlyingFurnitureAvoidance()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        agent.NavigationMemory.FurnitureAvoidance = Vector2.UnitY;
        agent.NavigationMemory.NextHazardCheckFrame = 100;
        Assert.Equal(Vector2.UnitX,
            sim.EvacuationSystem.ApplyNaturalMovingFurnitureAvoidance(sim, agent, Vector2.UnitX));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IncapacitationCancelsQueuedRecoveryWithoutMovingTheBody()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        Prepare(sim, new Vector2(45f, 28f));
        sim.EvacuationSystem.RequestNaturalRecovery(sim, agent, true);
        agent.MarkIncapacitated();
        Vector2 start = agent.Position;
        Release(sim);
        sim.Step();
        sim.Step();
        Assert.Equal(AgentState.Incapacitated, agent.State);
        Assert.Equal(start, agent.Position);
        Assert.Equal(0, agent.NavigationMemory.TotalRecoveryAttempts);
        Assert.Equal(0, sim.EvacuationSystem.NaturalPendingRecoveries);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ToxicRecoveryDeduplicatesSixHundredRequests()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(600);
        foreach (Agent agent in sim.Agents)
        {
            sim.EvacuationSystem.RequestNaturalRecovery(sim, agent, true);
            sim.EvacuationSystem.RequestNaturalRecovery(sim, agent, true);
        }
        Assert.Equal(600, sim.EvacuationSystem.NaturalPendingRecoveries);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ToxicRecoveryRespectsTheBudgetAndServesLaterAgentIds()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(8, new AgentConfig { NaturalRecoveryProbesPerStep = 2 });
        Prepare(sim, new Vector2(45f, 28f));
        Vector2[] anchors = sim.Agents.Select(a => a.Position).ToArray();
        foreach (Agent agent in sim.Agents) sim.EvacuationSystem.RequestNaturalRecovery(sim, agent, true);
        Release(sim);
        for (int frame = 0; frame < 7; frame++)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < sim.Agents.Count; i++)
            {
                sim.Agents[i].Position = anchors[i];
                sim.Agents[i].Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            }
            sim.Step();
            Assert.InRange(sim.EvacuationSystem.LastNaturalRecoveryProbes, 0, 2);
            Assert.InRange(sim.EvacuationSystem.LastNaturalRoutePlans, 0, sim.Config.Agent.NaturalRoutePlansPerStep);
        }
        Assert.All(sim.Agents, a => Assert.True(a.NavigationMemory.TotalRecoveryAttempts > 0));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ToxicRecoveryCanRetreatFromADeadEndWithoutTeleportation()
    {
        Simulation sim = Scene(1);
        Agent agent = sim.Agents[0];
        agent.Position = new Vector2(12f, 10f);
        agent.NavigationMemory.RecoveryAttempts = 3;
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(12.6f, 8.8f, 13f, 11.2f));
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(9f, 8.8f, 13f, 9.1f));
        sim.Environment.Blockages.Add(new Wall(9f, 10.9f, 13f, 11.2f));
        sim.Environment.RebuildWalls();
        sim.BuildWallGrid();
        Prepare(sim, new Vector2(45f, 28f));
        Release(sim);
        Vector2 before = agent.Position;
        Assert.True(sim.EvacuationSystem.TryChooseNaturalRecoveryGoal(sim, agent, out Vector2 goal));
        Assert.True(goal.X < before.X);
        Assert.Equal(before, agent.Position);
        Assert.True(sim.HasTraversablePath(before, goal, sim.Config.Agent.Radius));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SameSeedReproducesToxicRecoveryDecisions()
    {
        Simulation left = Scene(5);
        Simulation right = Scene(5);
        foreach (Simulation sim in new[] { left, right })
        {
            Prepare(sim, new Vector2(29.75f, 17.25f));
            Release(sim);
        }
        for (int frame = 0; frame < 80; frame++) { left.Step(); right.Step(); }
        for (int i = 0; i < left.Agents.Count; i++)
        {
            Assert.Equal(left.Agents[i].Position, right.Agents[i].Position);
            Assert.Equal(left.Agents[i].NavigationMemory.TotalRecoveryAttempts,
                right.Agents[i].NavigationMemory.TotalRecoveryAttempts);
            Assert.Equal(left.Agents[i].ExitTarget?.Name, right.Agents[i].ExitTarget?.Name);
        }
    }

    private static Simulation Scene(int count, AgentConfig? agentConfig = null,
        ScenarioType scenario = ScenarioType.ToxicFume, bool hybrid = false)
    {
        Simulation sim = new(config: new SimulationConfig
        {
            Agent = agentConfig ?? new AgentConfig(),
            HybridEnabled = hybrid,
        }, randomSeed: 4173);
        Assert.True(sim.Environment.AddExitFromClick(sim.Environment.Width - 0.3f, 17f, 4));
        sim.SetScenarioType(scenario);
        List<Vector2> positions = new(count);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            positions.Add(new Vector2(28.25f + (i % 30) * 0.65f, 17.25f + (i / 30) * 0.65f));
        sim.SpawnAgentsAtPositions(positions);
        foreach (Agent agent in sim.Agents)
        {
            agent.State = AgentState.Evacuating;
            agent.Posture = SeatingPosture.Walking;
            agent.Intent = BehaviorIntent.Evacuate;
            agent.ExitTarget = sim.Environment.Exits[0];
            agent.FollowTendency = 0f;
            agent.HelpingTendency = 0f;
            agent.AssistanceDecisionMade = true;
        }
        return sim;
    }

    private static void Prepare(Simulation sim, Vector2 source)
    {
        Assert.True(sim.ToxicFumeSystem.TrySetSource(sim, source));
        sim.PrecomputeToxicFume();
    }

    private static void Release(Simulation sim)
    {
        sim.SetRunning(true);
        Assert.True(sim.Running);
        Assert.True(sim.TriggerToxicFumeRelease());
    }
}
```

## validation/angle_geometry_reference_check.py

```python
"""Independent float32 port/reference checks, NOT execution of the C# implementation."""
import math, json, random
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, Point, LineString
R = random.Random(27351)
f=np.float32
H=np.array([.75,.20],dtype=np.float32)
def axis(deg):
    t=f(f(deg)*f(math.pi)/f(180));a=np.array([f(math.cos(t)),f(math.sin(t))],dtype=np.float32)
    a[np.abs(a)<1e-6]=0;a/=np.linalg.norm(a)
    return np.array([a,[-a[1],a[0]]],dtype=np.float32)
def local(pt,c,a): return np.array([np.dot(pt-c,v) for v in a],dtype=np.float32)
def world(pt,c,a): return c+a[0]*pt[0]+a[1]*pt[1]
def poly(c,a): return Polygon([world(v*H,c,a) for v in np.array([[-1,-1],[1,-1],[1,1],[-1,1]],dtype=np.float32)])
def box(x,y,h):
    near,far=f(0),f(1)
    d=y-x
    for k in range(2):
        if abs(d[k])<1e-8:
            if x[k]<-h[k] or x[k]>h[k]:return False
        else:
            first=f((-h[k]-x[k])/d[k]);last=f((h[k]-x[k])/d[k])
            if first>last:first,last=last,first
            near=max(near,first);far=min(far,last)
            if near>far:return False
    return True

def sweep(x,y,c,a,m):
    x,y=local(x,c,a),local(y,c,a)
    if not box(x,y,H+m):return False
    if m==0 or box(x,y,H+np.array([m,0],dtype=np.float32)) or box(x,y,H+np.array([0,m],dtype=np.float32)):return True
    delta=y-x;ll=np.dot(delta,delta)
    for corner in [H,-H,H*np.array([1,-1]),H*np.array([-1,1])]:
        t=np.clip(np.dot(corner-x,delta)/ll,0,1) if ll>1e-12 else 0
        if np.dot(x+t*delta-corner,x+t*delta-corner)<=m*m:return True
    return False

def sat(c1,a1,c2,a2,tolerance=0):
    for v in list(a1)+list(a2):
        r1=sum(H[k]*abs(np.dot(a1[k],v)) for k in range(2));r2=sum(H[k]*abs(np.dot(a2[k],v)) for k in range(2))
        if r1+r2-abs(np.dot(c2-c1,v))<=tolerance:return False
    return True

counts={'swept_disc_vs_polygon':0,'point_clearance_vs_polygon':0,'sat_overlap_vs_polygon':0,'disc_separation':0,'flush_diagonal_contacts':0,'diagonal_overlap_rejections':0}
for i in range(5000):
    c=np.array([R.uniform(2,50),R.uniform(2,30)],dtype=np.float32);a=axis(R.uniform(0,360));p=poly(c,a)
    pt=np.array([R.uniform(-2,2),R.uniform(-2,2)],dtype=np.float32)+c
    end=np.array([R.uniform(-2,2),R.uniform(-2,2)],dtype=np.float32)+c;m=f(R.uniform(0,.45))
    actual=sweep(pt,end,c,a,m);distance=LineString([pt,end]).distance(p)
    assert actual==(distance<=m) or abs(distance-m)<2e-5,('sweep',i,distance,m)
    counts['swept_disc_vs_polygon']+=1
    outside=np.maximum(np.abs(local(pt,c,a))-H,0);actual=np.dot(outside,outside)<=m*m;distance=Point(pt).distance(p)
    assert actual==(distance<=m) or abs(distance-m)<2e-5,('contains',i,distance,m)
    counts['point_clearance_vs_polygon']+=1
    c2=c+np.array([R.uniform(-2,2),R.uniform(-2,2)],dtype=np.float32);a2=axis(R.uniform(0,360));p2=poly(c2,a2)
    actual=sat(c,a,c2,a2);area=p.intersection(p2).area
    assert actual==(area>1e-10) or area<1e-8 and p.distance(p2)<2e-5,('sat',i,area)
    counts['sat_overlap_vs_polygon']+=1
    q=world(np.array([R.uniform(-.9,.9),R.uniform(-.35,.35)],dtype=np.float32),c,a);r=f(.2)
    ql=local(q,c,a);closest=np.clip(ql,-H,H);diff=ql-closest;d2=np.dot(diff,diff)
    correction=np.zeros(2,dtype=np.float32)
    if d2>1e-12:
        if d2<r*r:
            d=f(math.sqrt(d2));corr=diff*((r-d+f(1e-5))/d);correction=a[0]*corr[0]+a[1]*corr[1]
    else:
        depths=H-np.abs(ql)+r;k=0 if depths[0]<depths[1] else 1
        correction=a[k]*(-1 if ql[k]<0 else 1)*(depths[k]+f(1e-5))
    after=q+correction
    assert Point(after).distance(p)>=float(r)-2e-5,('separation',i,Point(after).distance(p))
    counts['disc_separation']+=1
for degree in np.linspace(0,359,360):
    c=np.array([15,15],dtype=np.float32);a=axis(degree)
    for reverse in (False,True):
        a2=axis(degree+180 if reverse else degree)
        assert not sat(c,a,c+a[0]*f(1.5),a2,1e-4),('flush',degree,reverse)
        counts['flush_diagonal_contacts']+=1
        assert sat(c,a,c+a[0]*f(1.49),a2,1e-4),('overlap',degree,reverse)
        counts['diagonal_overlap_rejections']+=1
result={'verification_type':'independent Python float32 algorithm/reference check; not C# execution','seed':27351,'checks':counts,'total':sum(counts.values()),'result':'passed'}
Path('angle_geometry_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
```

## run_instructions.md

````markdown
# Current revision: always-3D agents

Agents retain a simplified 3D body at low zoom and use additional detail at close zoom. No extra setting is needed. The surrounding walls remain transparent.

Extract into a new folder, then follow the build/run commands below. Open **Camera** and test the Zoom slider from **0.45× to 2.50×** after finalising a scene. See docs/ALWAYS_3D_AGENTS.md for checks and validation.

---

# Current revision: transparent perimeter walls

Only the visual room perimeter is hidden. Use the setup/build commands below; there is no new setting to enable. The physical room bounds and all existing interactions remain active.

See docs/TRANSPARENT_PERIMETER_WALLS.md for validation and user checks. Extract to a fresh folder and rebuild; old compiled output is not included.

---

# Setup and execution

## 1. Prerequisites

Install the **.NET 8 SDK** and use a desktop with an OpenGL-capable graphics driver. This project targets net8.0 with C# 12. Visual Studio 2022 with .NET desktop development support is an optional alternative to the command line.

The validated SDK was **8.0.415**. All direct NuGet versions are pinned in Directory.Packages.props; requirements.txt is an informational .NET package inventory, not a Python/pip file.

## 2. Extract and build

Extract the archive to a new folder and open a terminal in CrowdSimCs, beside CrowdSim.sln. Do not reuse the old project's bin/obj folders.

```powershell
dotnet restore CrowdSim.sln
dotnet build CrowdSim.sln -c Release --no-restore
```

The same forward-slash commands work in PowerShell, Command Prompt and a Linux/macOS shell with the SDK installed.

## 3. Run the tests

```powershell
dotnet test tests/CrowdSim.Tests/CrowdSim.Tests.csproj -c Release --no-build --no-restore
```

There are 404 expanded cases, including tests for panel width allocation and inspector page retention. See docs/PROFESSIONAL_UI_VERIFICATION.md for the delivery environment's execution details.

## 4. Launch

```powershell
dotnet run --project src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/CrowdSim.OpenGL.csproj -c Release --no-build -- --seed 42
```

Remove `-- --seed 42` to use a random seed. Open CrowdSim.sln in Visual Studio and select CrowdSim.OpenGL as the startup project if preferred.

## 5. Build a scene

1. Choose **Explosion** or **Toxic Fume**, or open a saved scene.
2. On the **Build** page, set **1. Room size** before placing items.
3. Open **2. Exits**, choose the width and click **Place Exit**. Click a boundary wall in the scene.
4. Use **3. Assets & furniture** to choose and place objects. Rotation controls appear for applicable assets. Ctrl+Z undoes the last placement; R/Shift+R rotate supported placement previews.
5. Open **4. People**, choose a group size, click **Place Agents** and click clear floor. Seated furniture includes its occupants.
6. For Toxic Fume, set the release point and **compute dispersion** in the builder's fume section before finalising. The control page scrolls independently.
7. Click the fixed **Finalise Scene** button. If disabled, read the reason immediately below it; hover truncated text for its full message.

## 6. Run and inspect

- **Start simulation / Pause simulation / Resume simulation** stay visible beneath the left control page. Select **Record this run** before a fresh start to record AVI output.
- The **Run** page controls playback speed and event placement/release. Start before placing the explosion or releasing fumes.
- **Camera** offers labelled rotation, elevation and zoom controls. The mouse wheel over the scene also zooms.
- Click **Select Agent** on Run, then click near a person's feet in the scene. The **Agent** inspector opens its details; use its scrolling area for Follow and POV actions.
- **Overview** shows summary metrics. **Blast/Fume** shows hazard settings. **Debug** contains performance data, overlays and legends.
- **Hide inspector** in the top-right corner hides the whole right panel and expands the scene. **Show inspector** restores it. **F4** performs the same toggle outside text entry. Visibility and active page are retained during the current session.
- Selecting an agent while hidden retains the hidden panel. Click the **Agent N** button above the viewport to explicitly reopen its details.
- Debug overlays remain enabled while their settings panel is hidden.
- **Replay from scene start** restores the finalised scene checkpoint at frame zero; start it again when ready.

## 7. Save and load

**Save scene** is always available near the top of the left panel. On **Files**, edit the scenario name, save, refresh the list or load a saved configuration while paused. **New scenario** returns to scenario selection; unsaved changes have a discard/keep prompt.

Authored starting positions, room layout, hazard parameters and behavioural configuration are saved. Runtime moved positions, injuries, panic and elapsed time are excluded. Saved scenarios use the existing per-user CrowdSimCs/scenarios directory (on Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%/CrowdSimCs/scenarios); the included scenarios folder remains a compatibility source.

AVI recording, asset dimensions, free-angle barricades, speed limits, both simulation models and existing replay behaviour remain available.

## 8. Rebuild after editing

```powershell
dotnet build CrowdSim.sln -c Release
dotnet test tests/CrowdSim.Tests/CrowdSim.Tests.csproj -c Release --no-build
dotnet run --project src/CrowdSim.OpenGL/CrowdSim.OpenGL.csproj -c Release --no-build
```

No precompiled binaries are distributed. Rebuild before using --no-build.
````

## How it works

The top bar updates inspector visibility before the pure layout allocator sizes the workspace. The remembered inspector page and rendering options are separate state, so hiding only removes its UI region and gives that space to the viewport. Scrollable tool pages retain a fixed primary action footer. Silk.NET/ImGui continue to provide native windowing, input and rendering, while the unchanged core performs all crowd and hazard simulation.
